Global Sales & Services Operations (GSSO) is the team that helps shape Gartner's mission-critical sales and services priorities and works with sales and services leaders to drive tactical and analytical insights. As an associate on the GSSO team, you'll be at the forefront of the ongoing transformation of Gartner's sales and services teams, which are delivering approximately $4.9B in annual revenue and working to drive sustained double-digit growth. You will partner with business leaders across Gartner to support global sales and services teams comprised of nearly 9,000 associates who sell to and service every major function, industry and market sector around the world.  

About the role

The Sr. Data Scientist role is part of the Territory Planning & Analytics (TP&A) team in GSSO. The TP&A team is focused on designing the optimal territory investment, design and alignment strategy to maximize Sales (and Services) productivity.

This is an internal consulting team that partners with Gartner’s sales leaders to determine where, when, and how the company should direct its substantial investment in incremental sales professionals. The individual in this role will collaborate with sales leaders to guide strategic investment and go-to-market decisions at regional and global levels.

What you will do: 

  • Build and incorporate LLMs/RAG for simplifying user’s experience.
  • Stay on top of fast-moving AI/ML models and technologies, particularly in LLMs, conversational AI, and agentic systems
  • Continuous monitoring and evaluation of model performance and metrics.
  • Take ownership of algorithms and drive enhancements/optimizations based on business requirements with proper documentation and code-reusability
  • Be responsible for high quality data science solutions with respect to accuracy and coverage.
  • Be accountable for solutions’ scalability, stability, and business adoption
  • Responsible for maintaining proper documentation and further code-reusability principles
  • Responsible for ownership of algorithms and its enhancements/optimizations as per business requirement
  • Mentor junior data scientists on chatbot development, LLM applications, and best practices

What you will need:

  • BS/MS/PhD in Computer Science or other technology, Math, Physics, Statistics or Economics (focus on ML/AI, Information Retrieval a plus)
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience building conversational AI systems, chatbots, LLM applications, or other advanced machine learning/artificial intelligence solutions to drive business impact
  • Minimum 4+ years of experience in python coding and statistical analysis
  • Working experience in some of the following data science areas:
    • Large Language Models (LLMs) and Generative AI
    • Conversational AI, chatbot development, and dialogue systems
    • Natural Language Processing and text mining
    • Search and Recommendation systems
    • Prompt engineering, LLM fine-tuning, and model optimization
    • AI agent architectures and orchestration
       
  • Strong working knowledge of Lean product principles, software development lifecycle, and machine learning life cycle.
  • Ability to implement latest ML research to improve our current algorithms
  • Practical, intuitive problem solver with proven ability to translate business objectives into actionable data science tasks and implement state-of-the-art ML research into production systems
  • Experience with cloud computing services such as AWS or Azure ML
  • Experience and proficiency with Python, machine learning tools (e.g., scikit-learn, spacy, nltk), statistical packages (e.g., Scipy), SQL/relational databases (e.g., Oracle) and NoSQL databases (e.g., MongoDB, graph database), distributed machine learning (spark), Linux and shell scripting
  • Practical, intuitive problem solver with a demonstrated ability to translate business objectives into actionable data science tasks and translate quantitative analysis into actionable business strategies

What you will get:

  • Competitive salary, generous paid time off policy, charity match program Group Medical Insurance, Parental Leave, Employee Assistance Program (EAP) and more!
  • Collaborative, team-oriented culture that embraces diversity 
  • Professional development and unlimited growth opportunities

#LI-MP4 #GSSO

Who are we?

At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.

Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.

Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.

What makes Gartner a great place to work?

Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.

We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.

Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.

We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.

Gartner is the world authority on AI

At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.

It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.

What do we offer?

Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.

In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.

Ready to grow your career with Gartner? Join us.

title: Marketing Specialist (Operations)
description_html:
Global Sales & Services Operations (GSSO) is the team that helps shape Gartner's mission-critical sales and services priorities and works with sales and services leaders to drive tactical and analytical insights. As an associate on the GSSO team, you'll be at the forefront of the ongoing transformation of Gartner's sales and services teams, which are delivering approximately $4.9B in annual revenue and working to drive sustained double-digit growth. You will partner with business leaders across Gartner to support global sales and services teams comprised of nearly 9,000 associates who sell to and service every major function, industry and market sector around the world. 

About the Role:


As a Marketing Specialist within the Global Marketing team, you will play a key role in designing and executing digital and in-person marketing programs that showcase Gartner’s value to prospective clients. You will join the Invitational Strategy & Tech Team, responsible for creating impactful marketing experiences that convert prospects into clients through high-touch live events and innovative programs. Reporting to the Manager of Marketing, you will identify technology needs, support marketing automation, and partner with cross-functional teams to ensure successful execution and continuous process improvement.

What You Will Do:

Marketing Technology

  • Support the end-to-end rollout and ongoing adoption of marketing strategies and workflows to achieve sales and marketing objectives.
  • Oversee, implement, and integrate tools such as CRM (e.g., Salesforce) related to Marketing programs.
  • Maintain work process flows by coordinating information and requirements with related operational departments and contributing to business improvement initiatives.
  • Collaborate closely with Sales Technology, Global Sales Operations, and IT to communicate user feedback and help prioritize enhancements that address critical business needs.

Operational Excellence

  • Serve as a liaison between Experiential Marketing, Sales Operations, Conferences, and IT to identify, define, and prioritize system enhancements that improve operational efficiency.
  • Assist in creating and maintaining business requirements, project plans, and process documentation to ensure clear communication and alignment across stakeholders.
  • Integrate ongoing end-user feedback into enhancement roadmaps to ensure solutions remain relevant and impactful.

Reporting and Tracking

  • Track key performance indicators (KPIs), analyse data, and provide actionable insights to leadership.
  • Conduct data analysis to evaluate process performance, adoption rates, and business impact, delivering recommendations for broader rollout or process improvement.
  • Provide timely, data-driven updates to leadership and stakeholders to support informed decision-making and continuous optimization of team initiatives.
  • Gather feedback from sales and operations to refine processes and improve effectiveness.
  • Conduct quantitative data analysis using tools such as Excel and Salesforce to uncover trends and insights.

Collaboration and Stakeholder Management

  • Work cross-functionally with Marketing, IT, Sales, and Conferences to translate operational insights into actionable narratives and tools for the sales and services teams.
  • Participate in business improvement teams and maintain work process flows by coordinating information and requirements with related operational departments.

What You Will Need:

  • Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or equivalent preferred.
  • 1–3 years of experience in project management, sales operations, or CRM support (Salesforce experience preferred).
  • Strong organizational and communication skills.
  • Analytical mindset with proficiency in Excel and basic data analysis.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a cross-functional team environment.
  • Eagerness to learn, adapt, and contribute to process improvements.

What You Will Get:

  • Competitive salary, generous paid time off, charity match program, group medical insurance, parental leave, Employee Assistance Program (EAP), and more.
  • Collaborative, team-oriented culture that embraces diversity.
  • Professional development and unlimited growth opportunities.

title: Team Lead, Product Ops
description_html:
About thi s  role   

This is a unique opportunity for a creative and charismatic individual to be part of the product operations team for  Gartner Peer Insights (GPI) .   GPI’s  mission is to transform the way enterprise software & services are bought and sold by creating the industry standard for reviews and ratings. We are looking for a Team Lead, Product operations, to scale Reviews and Customer Experience Management operations. You will work directly with senior stakeholders and be the natural extension of operations horsepower. You will have the opportunity to work on several business initiatives and be empowered to lead to problem solving, leading to continuous improvement. If you have strong business acumen, ability to work with cross-functional teams and enjoy working in a fast-paced lean startup team at an established brand, this is the role for you.  

What you will do:   

  • Own end-to-end delivery of customer experience work stream and have expertise in review validation and moderation, ensuring high quality and timely resolution of user and stakeholder issues. 

  • Lead and mentor a team of associates, providing coaching, feedback, and support for continuous development and high performance.  

  • Coordinate with cross-functional teams (Product, Vendor Relations, Research & Advisory, Legal, etc.) to ensure seamless delivery and proactive engagement for user satisfaction. 

  • Oversee stakeholder management, clear and empathetic communication with both internal and external partners and building strong feedback loops. 

  • Champion process optimization, best practices for reducing turnaround times (TAT), and metrics-driven improvements to enhance quality and operational efficiency. 

  • Lead escalation management and handle complex customer issues, ensuring prompt and effective resolution while upholding platform trust and integrity. 

  • Own operational reporting, including tracking of interactions, quality, and performance metrics critical for delivering on CEM KPIs, user CSAT, and operational success. 

  • Conduct regular audits of interactions and content, implementing governance standards to protect platform integrity and long-term user trust. 

  • Develop onboarding modules for new hires and lead periodic training and knowledge sharing sessions for the team. 

  • Assess and balance team workload, helping prioritize and optimize efforts to maximize productivity and impact. 

Here is a sample of some initiatives you would   work on:   

  • Innovate and improve customer experience and review validation processes (leveraging data, technology, and automation) to increase productivity per associate. 

  • Partner with business units to manage vendor relationships and internal escalations, supporting GPI’s growth and industry leadership. 

What you’ll need:   

  • Master’s/MBA degree is a plus with a graduation in engineering or exposure to Digital Products. 

  • Minimum of 4-5 years of relevant industry experience in Product Operations, Tech/IT or Research/Consulting. 

  • Proven team leadership experience and ability to identify gaps/provide training for team development. 

  • Passion for continuous, metrics-based process and operational improvement. 

  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with experience managing stakeholders at all levels. 

  • Project management experience and the ability to provide independent, fact-based recommendations. 

  • Advanced Microsoft Office skills (Excel, PowerPoint). 

  • Experience managing workload and priorities in a fast-paced, international environment. 

What we offer:   

In addition to an outstanding work environment with rapid advancement potential, Gartner associates enjoy exceptional compensation and benefits, including: 

  • Competitive base salary  

  • Flexible work environment  

  • A great work culture  

Who are we?

At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.

Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.

Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. description_html:
About GDX 

Gartner Digital Experience (GDX) builds and manages the digital platforms that deliver Gartner’s value to clients. Our mission is to create simple, consistent, and high-value digital experiences across products, tools, AI experiences, and emails. We bring together product management, design, engineering, and data science to help clients quickly find and use insights. 

About the Role 

The Product Operations Manager will own and improve the product operating system that powers GDX. This role will drive launch readiness, structured execution of key programs, and scalable content operations. You will partner closely with Product Leadership to create consistent ways of planning, measuring, and launching products. This role is not about project tracking. It is about product leverage.  

This role requires strong end-to-end ownership, critical thinking, and product judgment. The right candidate will proactively identify gaps, challenge assumptions, and improve how teams make product decisions, not just how they execute. 

In this role, you will also manage a small team, helping them grow, stay aligned to priorities, and deliver high-quality outcomes. 

Key Responsibilities 

Drive Product Operations and Customer Readiness 

  • Build and run clear operating rhythms, updates, and documentation across Product, Engineering, PMM, Client Success, and Communications to improve alignment and launch readiness. 

  • Proactively identify gaps, risks, dependencies, and ownership issues, and drive resolution before they impact delivery or customer outcomes

  • Bring customer feedback, usage data, and operational signals into product planning, and use structured problem solving to improve decisions and trade-offs.  

Lead Content Operations at Scale 

  • Own and improve content tagging, taxonomy, and metadata operations to support discovery, adoption, and engagement across digital platforms.  

  • Build scalable workflows, quality checks, and standards that improve content accuracy, consistency, and discoverability.

  • Use content and experience data to identify gaps, improve the user experience, and influence product and operational priorities.  

Lead and develop the Team (People Management) 

  • Lead a small Product Ops team (2-3 direct reports).  

  • Set clear goals, priorities, and expectations for the team.  

  • Provide coaching, feedback, and career development support.  

  • Create a culture of ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement.  

  • Coach team members to think beyond task execution by building stronger ownership, judgment, and problem-solving skills. 

What You Need 

  • 5 to 7 years of experience in Product Management, Product Operations, Strategy, or Platform Operations, with at least 1 year of people management or strong dotted-line leadership experience.  

  • Strong understanding of digital product discovery and delivery, with solid product management fundamentals such as problem framing, prioritization, trade-off thinking, and defining success metrics.  

  • Strong end-to-end ownership mindset, with the ability to independently drive ambiguous work from problem definition to outcome.  

  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills, with the ability to turn data into clear insights, identify gaps, challenge assumptions, and surface risks early.  

  • Experience building or improving product development processes and simplifying complex problems into repeatable systems.  

  • Ability to influence without authority across Product, Engineering, Design, Marketing, Sales, and Service.  

  • Experience leading multiple programs at the same time, with a practical problem-solving and hands-on approach.  

  • Strong written and presentation communication skills, with comfort working in ambiguity and driving clarity across teams.

title: Specialist (Survey Benchmarking & Quantitative Research- Statstics/R/Python)
description_html:
About this role:

Benchmarking and Diagnostic Specialist is an individual contribution role with focus on managing portfolio of benchmarking and diagnostic.  The selected incumbent will be part of the B&D CoE working with researchers addressing cutting-edge strategic issues facing today’s senior-most functional executives at leading global corporations. The role provides excellent exposure to a full range of topics related to the management of GBS functions, as well as the opportunity to apply and further develop statistical concepts.

This position is for researchers interested in conducting quantitative research, analysis and reporting using proprietary benchmarking and survey data. The team members enjoy exposure to the full array of data related work: data management and quality; benchmarking and forming surveys; quantitative insight generation and some exposure to advanced data management tools and techniques focused on peeling apart ideas in search of insight. 

Who you are :

We are looking for creative, analytically strong, articulate and self-motivated individuals who would like to develop a strong knowledge of the terrain along with building consultative problem-solving skills. Unlike management consulting, investment banking, or law, our strategic research positions do not depend on a special appetite or aptitude for sales or business development. Our search for talent is centered, without exception, on the ability to run deep on a logical, philosophical, or economic problem and resurface with rigorous original insight. Some of the shared characteristics of our successful hires include:

  • Excellent verbal communication skills, as you will be leading discussions with our global client base and senior leaders across Gartner

  • Working knowledge of data visualization tools such as Power BI

  • Working knowledge of running supervised and unsupervised descriptive analysis including regression

  • Experience in sampling methodologies, survey questionnaire design, and data management

  • Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Excel (array functions, VBA)

  • Basic knowledge and/or strong interest in working with statistical packages, especially SPSS and/or R

What you will do:

  • Assist in creating primary data collection instruments (surveys, web data, etc.), sampling methodologies, and modelling

  • Analyzing large, complex, disparate data sets to identify actionable insights for senior executives, using basic descriptive analysis as well as robust inferential analyses, including correlation, and regression

  • Conceptualize and create custom client-facing research deliverables such as client presentations, webinars and tools

  • Conceptualize and create automation scripts based on VBA, R, Python  to  make reporting more efficient and insights easy to consume

  • Plan test schedules or strategies in accordance with project scope. Participate in product design reviews to provide input on functional requirements.

  • Collaborating with researchers and analysts to identify areas where data/quantitative analysis can play a role in strengthening Gartner’s research.

What you will need:

  • Master’s degree in Economics / Statistics / other related fields.

  • 0-2 years of relevant work experience in data analysis, quantitative research, analytics or benchmarking

  • Demonstrated ability to teach and relay ideas, engage clients and work in global teams

What we offer:

In addition to an outstanding work environment with rapid advancement potential, Gartner research team enjoys exceptional benefits, including:

  • Competitive base salary

  • Great on the job learning

  • A great work culture

title: Sr Software Engineer (4-7 yrs of exp in ITOM, CMDB, CSDM & ITSM)
description_html:
About Gartner IT:  

Join a world-class team of skilled engineers who build creative digital solutions to support our colleagues and clients.  We make a broad organizational impact by delivering cutting-edge technology solutions that power Gartner.  Gartner IT values its culture of nonstop innovation, an outcome-driven approach to success, and the notion that great ideas can come from anyone on the team.

About this Role:

We are looking for a motivated and well-rounded  ServiceNow Developer  with strong technical expertise and a passion for building scalable solutions. You will work closely with stakeholders, architects, and business analysts to design, develop, and implement ServiceNow solutions that drive continuous improvement across Gartner.

What You’ll Do:

  • Design, develop, and implement solutions within the ServiceNow platform following best practices.

  • Provide guidance to junior developers and participate in code reviews to ensure quality and compliance.

  • Conduct code reviews to ensure code quality based on ServiceNow best practices.

  • Proactively identify issues, troubleshoot issues and provide fixes, work on Support tickets.

  • Help stakeholders adopt to new features of ServiceNow.

  • Maintain knowledge of the latest ServiceNow features.

  • Document processes or Technical Design Documents.

  • Work closely with the stakeholders and the ServiceNow Product owner, ServiceNow Architect and Business Analyst to build solutions.

What You’ll Need:

4-7+ years’ experience in software development in ServiceNow

Must Have:

  • Hands-on experience working on ITOM ( Discover y, Service Mapping , CMDB, CSDM , Event Management, Service Graph Connectors ), HRSD (Employee Centre), ITSM Pro (Virtual Agent, Predictive Intelligence, Performance Analytics). Experience in end-to-end implementation or major enhancements in at least two of these areas.

  • Possess advanced ServiceNow Technical skills - Business Rules, Script Includes, Client scripts, UI Policies, ACLs, Import Sets, Transform maps, MID Server configuration.

  • Worked on Integrating ServiceNow with other tools.

  • Understanding of Generative AI and LLM’s including Agentic AI framework from ServiceNow.

  • Experience guiding junior developers.

  • Experience collaborating with Business Analyst and Architect to provide solutions and estimate level of effort.

  • Familiarity with Agile development practices and tools (e.g., Jira).

  • Good communication skills and interpersonal skills.

  • Certifications: Certified ServiceNow Administrator, Certified Implementation Specialist in ITOM or HRSD or ITSM / Certified application developer.

Who you are:

  • Effective time management skills and ability to meet deadlines.

  • Excellent communications skills interacting with technical and business audience’s.

  • Excellent organization, multitasking, and prioritization skills.

  • Intellectual curiosity and passion for technology, with a willingness to embrace new ideas and master concepts rapidly.

  • Commitment to delivering high-quality solutions on time and within budget.

Don’t meet every single requirement? We encourage you to apply anyway. You might just be the right candidate for this, or other roles.

The role is well suited for candidates coming from either a Data & Analytics background or an Endpoint Engineering background who can combine technical expertise with analytics and visualization to improve digital workplace outcomes.

This role helps Gartner IT move from reactive support to proactive issue prevention by identifying friction points, automating repeatable work, enabling remediation, and supporting communication campaigns that improve employee behavior and technology outcomes.

The role requires a strong analytical mindset, the ability to work with complex datasets, and the ability to boil technical data down into simple, actionable stories that help teams understand what is happening, why it matters, and what should be done next.

What You’ll Do:

Data & Analytics Engineering

  • Build and maintain DEX data pipelines using Nexthink, NQL, Microsoft Intune telemetry, and automation outputs.

  • Build dashboards and reporting solution that translate Digital workplace data into actionable insights.

  • Clean, enrich, normalize, and validate datasets for downstream consumption by dashboards, data lakes, automation engines, and Digital Workplace teams.

  • Perform deep analysis to identify: Patterns, Anomalies, Repeat issues, Employee friction points, Automation opportunities & Campaign opportunities

  • Create reusable datasets, queries, dashboards, and summaries that support operational and strategic decision-making.

Automation Development

  • Develop, maintain, and improve Python and PowerShell-based automations.

  • Support integrations between Nexthink, Intune, automation outputs, and other enterprise systems.

  • Build automations that reduce manual effort, improve endpoint health, and prevent recurring help desk tickets.

  • Ensure automations include: Logging, Validation, Error handling, Measurement & Rollback considerations

​Insight Generation & Storytelling

  • Convert complex analytical findings into clear narratives, simple visuals or summaries, Actionable recommendations & Prioritized next steps

  • Help answer key operational questions like what issue is occurring, how widespread is the issue, which employees or devices are impacted, what is the likely cause, what action should Gartner take and how will success be measured?

  • Support the design and execution of automation communication campaigns that influence employee behavior and reduce friction.

  • Analyze campaign results and employee response data to determine whether the intended behavior or outcome was achieved.

Collaboration & Continuous Improvement

  • Work closely with Digital Workplace, Service Operations, and engineering stakeholders to understand business needs and technical constraints.

  • Continuously monitor experience metrics to proactively identify emerging issues.

  • Use AI-driven tools where appropriate to assist with scripting, diagnostics, hypothesis generation, documentation, and resolution drafting.

What you’ll need:

  • 2-4 years of experience in Data Analytics, Data Engineering, Endpoint Engineering, Automation Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

  • Strong hands-on experience with Python and/or PowerShell scripting.

  • Experience building dashboards, reporting solutions, data pipelines and analytics workflow.

  • Ability to analyze complex datasets and translate findings into clear recommendations.

  • Exposure to Digital Workplace, endpoint management, DEX telemetry, Intune, or similar enterprise technology data.

  • Experience with Nexthink, NQL, Intune telemetry, endpoint management platforms, or similar Digital Experience (DEX) tools is preferred

Who you are:

  • A strong communicator

  • Able to work independently or within a team proactively in a fast-paced environment.

Don’t meet every single requirement? We encourage you to apply anyway. You might just be the right candidate for this, or other roles.

title: Data Analytics Lead
description_html:
Global Sales & Services Operations (GSSO) is the team that helps shape Gartner's mission-critical sales priorities and works with sales & services leaders to drive tactical and analytical insights. As an associate on the GSSO team, you'll be at the forefront of the ongoing transformation of Gartner's sales force, which delivers approximately $4.9B in annual revenue and working to drive sustained double-digit growth. You will partner with business leaders across Gartner to support a global sales force comprised of more than 5,000 associates and service leaders comprised of approximately 2500 people who sell to & service every major function, industry and market sector around the world.

About the role:

This role is part of the Services Analytics Automation team that will lead and drive enterprise‑wide data and analytics initiatives on behalf of the Services organization, acting as the strategic bridge between Business stakeholders, the Chief Data Office (CDO), and IT. You will shape the data vision for Services, translate complex business needs into scalable analytics solutions, and ensure data is trusted, governed, and decision‑ready across the enterprise.

What you will do:

Own and Drive Enterprise Data Initiatives

  • Serve as Product Owner for Services‑led data and analytics initiatives, owning end‑to‑end delivery from problem definition to business impact
  • Partner closely with Business leaders, CDAO, and IT to align on data strategy, priorities, and execution
  • Translate complex, ambiguous business problems into clear analytical requirements, technical specifications, and prioritized backlogs

Build Scalable, High‑Impact Data Solutions

  • Define, analyse, and model large, complex datasets across multiple internal and external sources using SQL and Python
  • Design, build, and maintain scalable analytics and data solutions using SQL, Python, Databricks, and modern enterprise data platforms
  • Drive data transformation, integration, and cleansing to deliver reliable, reusable, decision‑ready datasets
  • Identify and implement opportunities for automation, performance optimization, and platform scalability

Ensure Data Trust, Quality, and Governance

  • Own data quality for assigned Service domains, establishing controls, standards, and best practices to ensure accuracy, consistency, and reliability
  • Partner with the Chief Data Office on data governance, quality frameworks, modelling standards, and analytics platform alignment

Lead and Develop Talent

  • Lead and mentor a team of analysts and data engineers, fostering strong ownership, accountability, and engineering discipline
  • Coach teams on analytics best practices, data architecture, modelling, and governance, raising overall data maturity for Services
  • Collaborate with IT and engineering partners to deliver secure, well‑integrated, enterprise‑grade solutions

What You Will Lead:

  • 7+ years of experience in analytics, data engineering, or advanced data roles
  • Strong hands‑on expertise with SQL, Python, and Databricks
  • Proven experience building analytical datasets, data pipelines, and scalable data solutions on modern data platforms
  • Solid understanding of data management, data quality, and data governance principles
  • Experience leading or mentoring analytics and/or data engineering professionals
  • Strong problem‑solving skills with the ability to influence and engage senior business and technology stakeholders
  • Comfort operating in a cross‑functional, enterprise environment, balancing speed, scale, and governance

What you will get:

  • Competitive salary, generous paid time off policy, charity match program, Group Medical Insurance, Parental Leave, Employee Assistance Program (EAP) and more!
  • Collaborative, team-oriented culture that embraces diversity
  • Professional development and unlimited growth opportunities

At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.

Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.

Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.

What makes Gartner a great place to work?

Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.

We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.

Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.

We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.

Gartner is the world authority on AI

At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.

It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.

title: Help Desk Specialist (Azure AD, Office 365, VPN & Mac)
description_html:
About Gartner IT:

Join a world-class team of skilled IT Operation Support Professionals who build the first line of attack for our associates for any of their IT related Support requests or issues and at the same time act as the first line of defense for tier 3 Technical Teams to give them cover for consequences resulted from new upgrades and technology push in the IT environment.  We make a broad organizational impact by delivering cutting-edge technology solutions that power our Associates to achieve our common goal with great efficiency and success.  Gartner IT values its culture of nonstop innovation, an outcome-driven approach to success, and the notion that great ideas can come from anyone on the team. 

About the role:

Gartner is looking for a well-rounded and motivated Technical Support Specialist to join its HelpDesk (Tier 1) support team which is responsible for building Trust as Business Enabling Partner that Delivers World Class Customer Support Experience.

What you will do:

  • Act as the first point of contact for phone calls, chats, and Self-Service Tickets from internal associates regarding IT & Facilities related issues and queries.

  • Log all phone calls, and chats, in our Ticketing tool, updating with relevant information, and escalating as necessary within SLAs and to Gartner standards.

  • Maintain accurate up-to-date status on all tickets with proper follow-up data and documentation.

  • Ensure that all associates have been properly communicated before closing a ticket request.

  • Provide first-line troubleshooting and resolutions upon initial contact, using our internal knowledgebase & various tools, and ensure we keep our First contact resolution high as possible.

  • Assist associates with installation, configuration, and ongoing usability of system hardware and Software.

  • Assist with mobile device issues (Apple, Android, Windows Phone – any others)

  • Perform basic hardware troubleshooting remotely.

  • Develop and maintain a technical documentation knowledge base for desktop hardware and software applications and contribute to keeping the existing Knowledge base up to date.

  • Meet or exceed all Helpdesk metrics and process requirements - Ticket management protocols, time tracking, communication requirements, etc.

  • Treat all customers with courtesy and professionalism.

  • Liaise with IT colleagues, Tier 2 and Tier 2 IT teams, other Business units, and with your peers and Shift Managers whenever needed to ensure you do the right thing always.

  • Responsible for providing phone and chat-based technical support for all Gartner applications and systems by identifying the issue(s), determining, and executing appropriate resolution or escalation, and communicating that resolution or escalation to the associate.

  • Collaborate with Next level teams on urgent issues, Warm Handoffs, and explore opportunities for process enhancements.

  • Actively work on open lines of communication between you and Gartner Associates, peers in Technical Support, and others in IT.

  • Assist Tier 3 with supporting and maintaining IT infrastructure and mobile technology. Work closely with Tier 3 on maintenance of current systems and introduction of new technology.

  • Bridge the gap and do the handholding for Junior Techs wherever needed in line with our goal of maximizing FCR

  • Improve first call resolution with enhanced customer support experience with minimizing DSATs (target -no DSATs)

  • Knowledge of AI & Gen AI functionality embedded in IT support Operations for innovation.

What you will need :

  • Strong IT professional with 1-4 years of experience in Customer Support and IT operation Support working in a 24X7 Environment in a rotational shift with a No-limit mindset. The candidate should have strong qualitative and quantitative problem-solving skills along with high on ownership, responsibility, and accountability. Knowledge of ITIL Framework (ITIL Certified – Preferred)

Must have-

  • Degree in Bachelor of Science/ Technology.

  • Good communication skills, able to clearly and correctly express complex technical concepts in English, both verbally and in writing to support a Global organization

  • Good understanding on Active directory and PowerShell

  • Working Experience with macOS and iOS to support apple products.

  • Working Knowledge of Microsoft Intune Admin Support

  • Working Knowledge of Exchange Admin – Intra ID

  • Working knowledge of Service Management Ticketing Tools like ServiceNow

  • Working Knowledge of Contact Center and Chat Support

  • Strong understanding of Windows Operating Systems

  • Strong Understanding of Network concepts and troubleshooting

  • Strong understanding of VPN Technologies

  • Capable of working 24 X 7 X 365 in a rotational shift environment

  • Amazing problem-solving skills

  • Ability to occasionally adjust work schedule to meet business needs.

  • Ability to maintain Accurate technical knowledgebase, documentation, policies, and processes to a high level.

Good to have-

  • HDI Certified

  • Microsoft Certified Professional

  • Working understanding of SQL & Oracle

  • Data Analytics tools – Power BI

Who you are:

  • Graduate/Postgraduate in Science and Technology.

  • Excellent communication and prioritization skills.

  • Able to work independently or within a team proactively in a fast-paced demanding 24X7 environment.

  • Owns success – Takes responsibility for the successful delivery of the solutions.

  • Strong desire to improve upon their skills in software development, frameworks, and technologies

Don’t meet every single requirement? We encourage you to apply anyway. You might just be the right candidate for this, or other roles.

title: Senior Director, Analyst – Tech CEO Business and Strategy Advisor on Cybersecurity and AI
description_html:
Senior Director, Analyst – Tech CEO Business and Strategy Advisor on Cybersecurity and AI (Tech CEO Research Organization)

Location: Remote India

About the Role:

Gartner Analysts are industry thought leaders who create must-have insights, market predictions, and best practices for a broad range of world-leading organizations. As a Senior Director within Gartner’s Tech CEO Research Organization, you will serve as a trusted advisor to Tech CEOs of small and midsize cybersecurity providers, helping them navigate growth strategies, market dynamics, and technology innovation in a rapidly evolving threat landscape.

You will leverage exceptional research and analytical skills to produce pragmatic and provocative insights that Tech CEOs can apply to achieve key objectives. This role combines deep cybersecurity expertise with strategic business insight, enabling you to guide Tech CEOs through complex challenges such as scaling operations, differentiating offerings, and responding to emerging threats.

What You Will Do

  • Create innovative, thought-provoking, and highly leveraged “must-have” insights focused on cybersecurity and AI in security market trends, growth strategies, and leadership practices for small and midsize providers.
  • Engage directly with Tech CEOs via virtual and in-person meetings, Gartner conferences, and industry events to address strategic challenges and provide tailored recommendations.
  • Develop actionable frameworks and best practices to help Tech CEOs accelerate decision-making and execution in areas such as threat intelligence, compliance, and product innovation.
  • Analyze and predict market shifts in cybersecurity technologies (e.g., AI-driven security, cloud security, zero trust,) and competitive dynamics.
  • Deliver compelling presentations and thought leadership content for Gartner events, client briefings, and professional associations.
  • Collaborate with peers across Gartner’s Insights community to shape research agendas and share provocative ideas that influence the cybersecurity market.

What You Will Need:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience; Graduate degree preferred
  • 12+ years of relevant experience in cybersecurity leadership roles (e.g., Tech CEO, or senior executive within a cybersecurity provider).
  • Experience working in small or mid-size technology providers
  • Demonstrate executive presence; can immediately establish credibility with executives and additional stakeholders
  • Strong organizational skills; ability to work under tight deadlines and produce high quality deliverables
  • Demonstrate excellence in research and writing ability
  • Strong written and verbal proficiency, analytical and presentation skills; ability to engage clients and respond effectively to questions
  • Proficient in analyzing and synthesizing data; can effectively apply patterns and frameworks while drawing and defending conclusions to client challenges
  • Strong communicator who is able to explain complex concepts concisely and simply
  • Subject matter expert comfortable presenting at large and small-scale speaking engagements
  • Strong business and financial acumen
  • Deep knowledge of the global and competitive landscape within subject area as well as the interplay in that market
  • Ability to work independently, while also being intrinsically motivated to collaborate across teams and support the workflow of others, in a multicultural global team
  • Learning agile and adept with navigating highly matrixed environments
  • Ability to represent Gartner's research methodology and strategies effectively at all levels
  • Willingness and ability to travel up to 25% (where applicable)

title: Data Scientist (Classical ML, NLP & LLM/GenAI/Agentic AI)
description_html:
About the role :

We are looking for a Data Scientist to lead high impact Data Science initiatives that convert diverse data into actionable insights and decision support. You will be responsible for designing, executing and implementing solutions that drive research excellence, operational efficiency and revenue growth.

What you'll do :

  • Partner with stakeholders to frame the problem. Work directly with technical leaders and domain experts to translate ambiguous questions into well-posed analytical problems, align on success metrics, communicate trade-offs clearly, and recommend the most effective approach—ML/AI, classical analytics, or rule-based decisioning—based on impact, constraints, and maintainability

  • Develop methodologies across the full spectrum . Apply and extend methods across supervised learning, unsupervised learning, Generative / Agentic AI, NLP, etc

  • Apply LLMs and agentic systems pragmatically, and drive adoption of evolving capabilities . Continuously evaluate new models, tooling, and patterns; run fast, measurable prototypes; and scale the winners into production RAG/agent workflows—owning evaluation, guardrails, and hallucination control

  • Deliver production ready solutions . Derive approaches from first principles when off-the-shelf methods don’t fit, prototype hands-on, and carry solutions from data cleaning and feature engineering through model development, evaluation, deployment—ensuring quality in terms of its accuracy, stability and scalability

  • Communicate insights in business terms . Convey complex technical concepts to diverse audiences and influence key stakeholders and leaders across the organization

What you'll need :

  • 3- 6 years in applied ML / applied AI, with hands-on experience building and deploying models in production environments

  • Bachelor's or Master's (or PhD) in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Economics, or a related quantitative field. Equivalent demonstrable expertise is welcome

  • Demonstrated experience working across multiple areas such as supervised ML, unsupervised ML, optimization, recommendation systems, forecasting, and LLM/agentic systems/ RAG, agentic workflows, evaluation frameworks, prompt engineering, fine-tuning trade-offs, and vector databases

  • Proven track record of owning solutions end-to-end—from problem framing and method selection to productionization, monitoring, and iteration in real-world environments

  • Experience with graph algorithms is a plus (knowledge graphs, graph traversal, community detection, graph rag etc

  • Experience in business applications such as churn analysis, customer profiling, and recommendation systems

  • NLP techniques: vector databases, embeddings, topic modeling, and fine-tuning of transformer models like BERT to enhance text analytics capabilities

  • Expert-level Python. Comfortable with the scientific stack (NumPy, pandas, scikit-learn, PyTorch) and with writing clean, tested, modular code

  • Distributed computing (Spark / Snowflake / BigQuery) for large-scale data and training

  • Cloud (AWS / Azure / GCP) — model training, deployment, scaling, cost-awareness

  • Working knowledge of Agentic AI Frameworks like LangChain, LangGraph and Deep-Agents or equivalent

  • Deep learning fundamentals: understanding when to apply deep learning approaches and how to train and evaluate them effectively in practice

What we offer:

  • Problems worth solving. Real ambiguity, real scale, real impact — not toy problems wrapped in a framework

  • A seat at the table. Direct partnership with leadership on what we build and why

  • Competitive salary, generous paid time off policy, charity match program, Group Medical Insurance, Parental Leave, Employee Assistance Program (EAP) and more!

  • Collaborative, team-oriented culture that embraces diversity

  • Professional development and unlimited growth opportunities

title: Manager Software Engineer - DEX Automation & Engineering
description_html:
About the role

The Manager of DEX Automation & Engineering leads the design, development, and operational maturity of data-driven automation platforms that convert Digital Employee Experience telemetry into actionable insights, automated remediation, and behavior-changing communication campaigns.

This role sits at the intersection of engineering, analytics, automation, and experience design. The team’s mission is to help Gartner IT move from a reactive support model to a proactive operating model by identifying issues before employees are impacted, reducing or eliminating avoidable help desk tickets, and continuously optimizing Gartner’s Digital Workplace for the best possible employee technology experience.

This leader will guide a small team responsible for building and maintaining end-to-end data pipelines, integrating Nexthink, Intune, automation outputs, and other enterprise data sources, and translating complex datasets into clear, compelling narratives that influence technical decisions and employee behavior at scale.

What You’ll Do

*Platform & Data Engineering 

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable DEX data pipelines that ingest, transform, enrich, and operationalize data from:

  • Nexthink, including NQL-based datasets

  • Microsoft Intune and MDM telemetry

  • Automation outputs and remediation results

  • Workflow platforms, service management platforms, and external enterprise data source

  • Develop integrations that feed downstream systems, including dashboards, automation engines, analytics platforms, and data lakes.

  • Ensure DEX datasets are trusted, reusable, and consumable by Digital Workplace, Service Operations, and leadership teams.

*Automation & Integration Leadership

  • Lead the development and maintenance of Python and PowerShell-based automations that reduce manual effort, improve reliability, and prevent recurring issues.

  • Ensure automations are secure, reliable, measurable, and aligned to ITIL Change Management expectations. 

  • Partner across Digital Workplace to identify repeatable support patterns that should become automated, remediated, or eliminated.

*Analytics, Storytelling & Behavioral Engineering 

  • Design and support automation communication campaigns that influence employee behavior, reduce friction, and prevent issues before tickets are created. 

  • Use both technical telemetry and employee response data to improve future automation and communication strategies.

  • Help Gartner IT move beyond “reporting what happened” toward “shaping what happens next.”

*Leadership & Influence 

  • Lead and mentor engineers and analysts, setting technical direction, delivery expectations, and quality standards.

  • Build an operating model for DEX Automation & Engineering, including intake, prioritization, sprint planning, release governance, and outcome reporting.

  • Partner closely across Digital Workplace, Service Operations, Identity, Security, and platform teams.

  • Define and track value metrics

What you will need

  • 8-14 years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, automation engineering, platform engineering, or a related technical discipline.

  • 2+ years of technical leadership experience, including mentoring engineers, leading delivery, or setting technical standards.

  • Strong hands-on experience with Python and PowerShell.

  • Experience designing and maintaining production-grade automations, integrations, or data pipelines.

  • Demonstrated ability to synthesize complex datasets and communicate insights clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Experience with Nexthink, NQL, Intune telemetry, endpoint management platforms, or similar Digital Experience (DEX) tools is preferred

Who you are:

  • Fluent in English (written and spoken) with confidence engaging senior leadership and executive stakeholders Able to work independently or within a team proactively in a fast-paced AGILE-SCRUM environment.

  • Owns success – Takes responsibility for successful delivery of the solutions.

  • Ardent desire to improve upon their skills in software development, frameworks, and technologies.

  • Strong stakeholder management, mediation, and relationship‑building skills across technology and business teams

What we offer:

In addition to an outstanding work environment with rapid advancement potential, Gartner associates enjoy exceptional compensation and benefits, including: An upbeat, positive culture. Integrity, objectivity, collaboration, results, and a no-limits mind-set are central to our values

Limitless growth. We work with you to help you meet your goals and advance within the company. Encouragement to be innovative and challenge status quo. Exposure to industry leading training and development. Performance-based recognition and rewards.

title: Account Executive, LE HT
description_html:
About this role:

The Account Executive is a field sales role responsible for client retention and growth. Account Executives build trust-based relationships with C-Level Executives and their teams. They understand the mission-critical priorities of their clients and ensure clients receive the value from the Gartner relationship that they expect, while also identifying opportunities for stronger value delivery with alternative product offerings.

Account Executives will be given a territory of Large Enterprise clients.

In our End-User Large Enterprise segment, Account Executives work with clients who have +$1bil in annual revenue.

In our Tech Vendor Large Enterprise segment, Account Executives work with clients who have +$500mil in annual revenue.

What you will do:

  • Drive value delivery with current Gartner clients, ensuring clients maximize the value they receive from their Gartner services

  • Identify, cultivate, qualify and close client growth opportunities through cross-sell and upsell

  • Continually build a pipeline of high-quality opportunities to deliver against your sales metrics, ensuring KPI’s are met.

  • Quota responsibility for your assigned territory.

  • Manage complex high-revenue sales across matrix and diverse business environments.

  • Own forecasting and account planning on a monthly/quarterly/annual basis.

What you will need:

  • 5-8+ years' B2B sales experience, preferably within complex, intangible sales environments

  • Experience selling to and/or influencing C-Level Executives

  • Proven track record of meeting and exceeding sales targets.

  • Proven ability to own, manage, and forecast a complex sales process.

  • Willingness to conduct travel as needed.

  • Bachelor's degree preferred

What you will get:

  • Competitive salary, generous paid time off policy, charity match program, and more!

  • Uncapped commission structure

  • World-class sales training programs and skill development programs

  • Annual “Winners Circle” event attendance at exclusive destinations for top performers

  • Collaborative, team-oriented culture that embraces inclusion

This is a new role in the Security Analytics and Automation team, within Gartner’s expanding Security Operations practice. As part of the team, you will help enhance our capabilities to identify and validate vulnerabilities in Gartner’s security controls, procedures and infrastructure.

As a Purple Team Engineer, you will use your knowledge of attacker TTPs (red team) to improve our capability to detect and respond to threats (blue team).

You will play a key role in defending Gartner’s network and intellectual properties. Our team is filled with lifelong learners who are consistently researching ways to better defend and stay ahead of the threats of tomorrow. We are a collaborative, flexible group, where good ideas are brought forth and acted upon, whether they come from the most experienced or the newest members of the team.

What you will need:

  • Previous experience conducting analysis and investigation of cybersecurity incidents

  • Experience using SIEM or XDR for log analysis and alert creation

  • Extensive experience utilizing security tools such as EDR (including live response), web proxy, WAF and email security tools

  • Experience with cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP)

  • Digital Forensics and Incident Response (DFIR) skills

  • Ability to query using various query languages such as SPL, SQL, KQL.

  • Threat hunting experience preferred

  • Ability to communicate effectively and possess excellent prioritization skills.

  • Ability to automate tasks and code solutions to repetitive problems (Python, PowerShell, Bash)

  • Previous red/purple team experience (practical or lab based) is a plus

What will you do:

  • Develop new attack emulations based on use-cases and strategy, drawing from threat intelligence and current events

  • Review and tune existing emulations to ensure high-fidelity tests are conducted in a thoughtful manner which allows rapid identification of any gaps in controls

  • Work closely with teams such as the Security Operations Center (SOC), Threat Intelligence, and Detection Engineering to help identify gaps in existing controls

  • Assist and support SOC analysts during ad-hoc Incident Response activities

  • Utilize programming and scripting to automate workflows

  • Conduct proactive Penetration Testing activities and offensive exercises

  • Assist in the development of innovative and cutting-edge detection content aligned with ATT&CK, Cyber Kill Chain, and various other cybersecurity frameworks

  • Bring your own ideas and solutions to a fast-paced, growing, and evolving team centered around operational excellence

  • Effectively collaborate with team members spread across multiple geographies, ensuring seamless communication and coordination for successful outcomes

Who you are

  • Knowledge of MITRE ATT&CK, Cyber Kill Chain or other behavioral information security frameworks.

  • Familiarity with use of offensive techniques and tools

  • Python, Bash, PowerShell or other programming/ scripting language experience

  • 1-2 years of relevant Information Security or Penetration Testing experience

  • Bachelor’s in Computer Science, Information Security, Engineering, or commensurate experience in Information security is preferred

  • Passion for security and solving tomorrow’s problems

  • Willingness to learn new technology platforms

  • Strong team player

  • Innovation mindset – Takes opportunities to make existing processes more efficient and thinks “automation first”

What will make you stand out:

  • Penetration Testing skills

  • Ability to find and solve problems.

  • Experience implementing integrations between tools utilizing APIs

  • Previous experience with Attack Emulation Platforms

  • Custom scripting, implementation, or security tooling for Cloud Platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)

title: Agentic Search, Sr. Platform Product Manager
description_html:
We are looking for an impact-driven, Senior Product Manager within our AI Products and Insights team, to lead our Next-Gen Agentic Search Platform, powering content discovery, and downstream AI experiences across the enterprise, including AskGartner.

In this role, you will own the product strategy and evolution of the platform that determines how content is ingested, enriched, indexed, retrieved, and served across the enterprise. You will help modernize our search stack by advancing lexical and vector retrieval capabilities, while ensuring the platform integrates effectively with emerging agentic and LLM-based orchestration patterns.

You will work at the intersection of search, AI, and platform product management, shaping a foundational capability used by multiple downstream teams and products. This is an opportunity to solve deep technical product problems, influence platform architecture, and drive broad enterprise impact in a complex, fast-evolving ecosystem.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the strategy, roadmap and delivery for Agentic Search Platform, aligning priorities to enterprise AI strategy, client use-cases, and downstream product needs.
  • Lead platform transformation initiatives, including migration from Solr to OpenSearch, integration with modern Agentic patterns and LLM-orchestration frameworks, while maintaining continuity for downstream consumers.
  • Define and evolve end-to-end indexing strategy and retrieval architecture, including pipelines for ingestion, enrichment, indexing, to better leverage diverse and evolving enterprise content sources.
  • Drive measurable improvements to ranking and relevance through AI/ML-based retrieval and reranking approaches (e.g., learning-to-rank, semantic retrieval, hybrid search patterns), improving precision/recall, engagement, and core experience metrics.
  • Establish a rigorous evaluation framework and guardrails for Search platform performance, including relevancy, latency, reliability, and scalability, and use those insights to guide prioritization and continuous improvement.
  • Enable downstream teams by building robust, well-defined Search APIs and services, and platform abstractions that reduce friction and accelerate development across surfaces.
  • Expand platform adoption by bringing Search capabilities to new domains and product surfaces, increasing enterprise-wide leverage.
  • Own cross-functional coordination and communication—driving alignment across Product, Engineering, Data Science, and dependent teams, and managing complex dependencies in a fast-paced environment.

What We’re Looking For

Experience & Background

  • 5–7+ years of product management experience, with meaningful exposure to technical platforms and enterprise SaaS products.
  • Deep understanding of search and retrieval systems, including indexing strategies, metadata enrichment, retrieval workflows, ranking mechanisms, and modern search ecosystems (e.g., OpenSearch/Elasticsearch).
  • Hands-on experience with LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG, and vector databases
  • Demonstrated experience working with AI/ML-powered relevance and ranking systems, with practical understanding of model tradeoffs, feature engineering, evaluation frameworks (offline metrics + online experimentation), and what it takes to operationalize these systems in production.
  • Track record of shipping technical products or platforms from zero-to-one and scaling them through adoption and iteration.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with ability to diagnose gaps in system behavior or output quality, and translate them into structured, high impact improvements.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex AI-ML and system concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Proven ability to influence cross-functional teams in a global, matrixed environment.

Who You Are

  • Genuinely curious, you dig into problems because you want to understand them, not just resolve them. You read broadly, ask good questions, and notice things others miss.
  • Proactive and self-directed, you don’t wait for assignments. You see gaps, form a point of view, and move toward solutions before being asked.
  • Humble and learning-oriented, you’re comfortable saying “I don’t know” and genuinely excited to learn from the people around you, regardless of their title.
  • Sincere about the work, you care about building something meaningful, not just shipping features. You take pride in craft and hold yourself to a high standard because the work matters to you, not because someone is watching.
  • A clear, honest communicator, you can articulate complex tradeoffs to technical and non-technical audiences, and you default to transparency over spin.
  • Driven by impact, you measure your own success by whether the product got better and users got more value, not by how many things you launched.
  • Comfort with ambiguity: you’ve operated in environments where the right answer wasn’t obvious and you had to develop conviction through experimentation and judgment.
  • Comfortable operating in 0-to-1 innovation environments: you can create structure where little exists, make pragmatic tradeoffs, and drive work from early discovery through initial launch.

Why This Role

  • Shape a product used by hundreds of thousands of enterprise decision-makers worldwide, with direct visibility into how your work moves business outcomes.
  • Work at the frontier of applied AI in enterprise, rethinking how humans interact with deep institutional knowledge.
  • Join a high-caliber, tight-knit product team that values rigorous thinking, intellectual honesty, and building things that matter.
  • Operate with real ownership: the team is small enough that your judgment directly shapes what gets built, and senior enough that your voice is heard in strategic conversations.
  • Learn and grow in an environment that invests in product management as a craft, with structured development, mentorship, and a culture of continuous improvement.

title: Sr Digital Product Manager (AI- Products)
description_html:
The Opportunity  

AskGartner is building toward becoming the AI-powered strategic advisor for enterprise clients, a product that puts the full depth of Gartner’s research, proprietary data, and expert knowledge at clients’ fingertips to drive better decisions against their most critical priorities. Few AI products in the world operate over a knowledge base this rich: decades of analyst research, peer-sourced vendor insights, and real-world practitioner data spanning every major industry and technology domain. 

You’ll be shaping the core chat and embedded AI experiences that serve as the primary surface through which hundreds of thousands of professionals interact with Gartner’s intelligence and help build out the broader AI Products and Insights portfolio. You’ll work across products, engineering, data science, design, and research to decide what gets built, how it behaves, and why it matters. 

If you want to build an AI product that changes how the world’s largest enterprises make decisions, and you want to see the impact of your work in real user behavior and business outcomes, this is the role. 

What You’ll Do  

  • Own end-to-end product delivery for core AskGartner experiences, from discovery through launch and iteration, across the chat interface and its embedded integrations throughout Gartner’s digital products. 

  • Define and drive the product roadmap for AI-powered features, making judgment calls on scope, sequencing, and tradeoffs with a bias toward shipping incremental improvements over waiting for perfect solutions. 

  • Develop and maintain a rigorous evaluation sensibility: understand what a good answer looks like, what a good experience feels like, and identify precisely where the product falls short, then translate those gaps into concrete, shippable improvements. 

  • Drive quantitative and qualitative analysis to validate product decisions and inform direction. Use engagement data, retention metrics, user research, and direct product observation to build conviction and move the product forward. 

  • Translate complex user needs into clear product requirements that engineering and data science teams can execute against, bridging the gap between client problems and technical solutions. 

  • Design and run experiments to validate product hypotheses, measuring what’s working and course-correcting what isn’t, prioritizing learning velocity over exhaustive planning. 

  • Develop a deep understanding of how enterprise clients research, evaluate, and make technology and strategic decisions, and use that understanding to inform product intuition. 

  • Contribute to the team’s product management craft: participating in reviews, sharing learnings, and helping raise the bar on how we think about and build products. 

In practice, you’ll typically be working across multiple opportunities at different stages of development simultaneously, some still in the vague problem-space phase, others nearing implementation. Much of your time will be spent bridging that gap: guiding conversations with stakeholders and teams to sharpen scope, pressure-test solution designs, and moving work toward a weekly release. You’ll be hands-on with the product itself, paying close attention to the nuance of what’s being shipped and taking full ownership of the quality of what goes out the door. 

What We’re Looking For  

Experience & Background  

  • 5–7+ years of product management experience, with meaningful time spent on B2B or enterprise SaaS products. 

  • Demonstrated experience working on AI/ML-powered products, you understand model capabilities and limitations, prompt engineering tradeoffs, evaluation methodologies, and what it takes to ship AI features that work for users. 

  • Familiarity with AI/ML architectures, pipelines, and tooling (e.g., LLMs, agent frameworks, retrieval systems, embeddings). You don’t need to build these yourself, but you need to have informed conversations with the engineers and data scientists who do. 

  • Track record of shipping user-facing products from zero-to-one or through meaningful inflection points, not just maintaining existing features. 

  • Comfortable operating in 0-to-1 innovation environments: you can create structure where little exists, make pragmatic tradeoffs, and drive work from early discovery through initial launch. 

  • Comfort with ambiguity: you’ve operated in environments where the right answer wasn’t obvious and you had to develop conviction through experimentation and judgment. 

Who You Are  

  • Genuinely curious, you dig into problems because you want to understand them, not just resolve them. You read broadly, ask good questions, and notice things others miss. 

  • Proactive and self-directed, you don’t wait for assignments. You see gaps, form a point of view, and move toward solutions before being asked. 

  • Humble and learning-oriented, you’re comfortable saying “I don’t know” and genuinely excited to learn from the people around you, regardless of their title. 

  • Sincere about the work, you care about building something meaningful, not just shipping features. You take pride in craft and hold yourself to a high standard because the work matters to you, not because someone is watching. 

  • A clear, honest communicator, you can articulate complex tradeoffs to technical and non-technical audiences, and you default to transparency over spin. 

  • Driven by impact, you measure your own success by whether the product got better and users got more value, not by how many things you launched. 

Why This Role  

  • Shape a product used by hundreds of thousands of enterprise decision-makers worldwide, with direct visibility into how your work moves business outcomes. 

  • Work at the frontier of applied AI in enterprise, not a chatbot wrapper, but a product rethinking how humans interact with deep institutional knowledge. 

  • Join a high-caliber, tight-knit product team that values rigorous thinking, intellectual honesty, and building things that matter. 

  • Operate with real ownership: the team is small enough that your judgment directly shapes what gets built, and senior enough that your voice is heard in strategic conversations. 

  • Learn and grow in an environment that invests in product management as a craft, with structured development, mentorship, and a culture of continuous improvement. 

Who are we?

At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.

Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.

Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.

What makes Gartner a great place to work?

Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.

We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.

Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.

We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.

Gartner is the world authority on AI

At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.

It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.

What do we offer?

Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.

In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.

Ready to grow your career with Gartner? Join us.

title: Sr Software Engineer (4+ yrs in Anaplan Development)
description_html:
About Gartner IT:
Join a world-class team of skilled engineers who build creative digital solutions to support our colleagues and clients.  We make a broad organizational impact by delivering cutting-edge technology solutions that power Gartner.  Gartner IT values its culture of nonstop innovation, an outcome-driven approach to success, and the notion that great ideas can come from anyone on the team.  

About the role:

We are seeking an Anaplan Architect who specializes in designing, building, and supporting financial planning models using the Anaplan platform. In this role, you will join a fast-paced, challenging environment and work on data that help manage sales performance.

What you'll do:

  • Support, design, and model solutions for the Anaplan application while interacting with end users, consultants, and third-party application vendors.

  • Ensure delivery of a quality finance/corporate systems application experience.

  • Use problem-solving and analytical skills to enhance the performance of existing models and build out new Anaplan model structures.

  • Figure out complex problems and think about how to make processes more efficient.

  • Build and plan the delivery of user stories based on business requirements.

  • Design & develop Anaplan forecast models that cover relevant business processes and requirements.

  • Work in an agile environment with cross-functional and geographically dispersed teams.

What you'll need:

  • 4+ total years of Anaplan Experience with 1+ years of experience in architecting Anaplan models.

  • Must have at least Level 2 Anaplan Model Builder certification but preferred Level 3.

  • 2+ years' experience with data visualization/dashboarding.

  • Experience in data integration a plus.

  • Excellent communication and prioritization skills.

  • Ability to work independently or within a team, proactively, in a fast-paced environment.

  • Strong desire to improve upon their skills in software development, frameworks, and technologies.

  • Familiarity with basic data integration scripting concepts and ETL technologies is preferred but not required.

Who you are:

  • Enthusiastic about learning new techniques, strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Good judgment, prompt decision-making ability, responsibility, and accountability.

  • Commitment to teamwork.

  • Excellent communication, analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.

  • Organized, focused, self-directed, and innovative, e.g. able to design a modeling solution without explicit direction.

  • Strong partnering capabilities, with the ability to influence others.

  • Owns success and takes responsibility for the successful delivery of the solutions.
