description_text:
JOB LEVEL

P30

EMPLOYEE ROLE

Individual Contributor

Role Description

We are looking for a skilled Software Developer with strong Java expertise and a solid foundation in data structures and algorithms. The ideal candidate will have experience building and operating scalable backend systems, working with cloud and CI/CD ecosystems, and collaborating across teams to deliver reliable, secure, and high-quality software.

This role requires strong problem-solving ability, ownership attitude, and effective communication skills to work in a fast-paced engineering environment.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services using Java.
  • Write clean, efficient, and testable code following best engineering practices.
  • Implement and optimize algorithms and data structures for performance-critical systems.
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines and automation workflows.
  • Collaborate with multi-functional teams including DevOps, Security, and Product.
  • Participate in design reviews, code reviews, and technical discussions.
  • Solve production issues and ensure system reliability at scale.
  • Contribute to user documentation and internal presentations.

Required Qualifications
  • 4-6 years of hands-on software development experience.
  • Strong proficiency in Java and object-oriented design principles.
  • Solid understanding of data structures and algorithms.
  • Experience with relational databases (preferably Oracle or similar).
  • Familiarity with build and dependency tools such as Maven.
  • Experience with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins.
  • Working knowledge of cloud platforms (preferably AWS).
  • Experience with messaging systems such as ActiveMQ (or similar).
  • Exposure to modern deployment and GitOps tools (e.g., Argo CD).
  • Strong debugging, problem-solving, and analytical skills.

Application Security Requirements
  • Working knowledge of the OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities (e.g., injection, broken authentication, XSS, SSRF, insecure deserialization) and how to mitigate them in Java applications.
  • Familiarity with authentication and authorization frameworks such as OAuth 2.0, OIDC, JWT, and SAML.
  • Understanding of secure handling of secrets, credentials, and API keys (e.g., using vaults, KMS, or environment-based secret management).
  • Experience integrating security tooling into CI/CD pipelines, including SAST, DAST, SCA, and dependency vulnerability scanning (e.g., SonarQube, Snyk, Checkmarx, OWASP Dependency-Check).
  • Knowledge of cryptographic fundamentals: encryption (at rest and in transit), hashing, digital signatures, and TLS configuration.
  • Understanding of input validation, output encoding, session management, and secure error handling.
  • Awareness of threat modeling techniques and ability to participate in security design discussions.
  • Ability to triage, prioritize, and remediate security vulnerabilities reported by scanners or penetration testers.

Preferred / Good to Have
  • Experience working with large-scale systems.
  • Understanding of PKI, digital certificates, and code-signing workflows.
  • Familiarity with software supply chain security concepts.
  • Experience building secure and compliant engineering systems.
  • Exposure to containerization and Kubernetes environments.
  • Prior experience in performance optimization and system design.

Soft Skills
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to clearly present technical ideas and solutions.
  • Ownership attitude with attention to quality and detail.
  • Ability to work independently and in a team environment.
  • Comfortable engaging with interested parties and leadership when required.

Internal Opportunities

Creativity, curiosity, and constant learning are celebrated aspects of your career growth journey. We’re glad that you’re pursuing a new opportunity at Adobe!

Put your best foot forward:

1. Update your Resume/CV and Workday profile – don’t forget to include your uniquely ‘Adobe’ experiences and volunteer work.

2. Visit the Internal Mobility page on Inside Adobe to learn more about the process and set up a job alert for roles you’re interested in.

3. Check out these tips to help you prep for interviews.

4. If you are applying for a role outside of your current country, ensure you review the International Resources for Relocating Employees on Inside Adobe, including the impacts to your Benefits, AIP, Equity & Payroll. 

Once you apply for a role via Workday, the Talent Team will reach out to you within 2 weeks. If you move into the official interview process with the hiring team, make sure you inform your manager so they can champion your career growth.

At Adobe, you will be immersed in an exceptional work environment that is recognized around the world. You will also be surrounded by colleagues who are committed to helping each other grow through our unique Check-In approach where ongoing feedback flows freely. If you’re looking to make an impact, Adobe's the place for you. Discover what our employees are saying about their career experiences on the Adobe Life blog and explore the meaningful benefits we offer.

Adobe is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other applicable characteristics protected by law. Learn more.

The Opportunity

The I&A team within Adobe’s Unified Platform is seeking a Senior Product Manager to lead enterprise-level storage solutions for enterprise unlock across Adobe’s B2B business. Our team develops the workflows, features, and monetization approaches that support enterprise product growth and enhance enterprise readiness for continued expansion.

In this role, you will take responsibility for enterprise-level storage administrative controls to support compliant, scalable use of Adobe solutions. Storage & Content Governance will serve as a key foundation. You will work with teams from engineering, design, development, analytics, and go-to-market to define and deliver meaningful product experiences.

This role is ideal for a seasoned Product Manager who is ready to take on greater ownership. You’ll have meaningful autonomy, real impact, and strong mentorship throughout.

What you'll Do

  • Define and own platform capability vision, strategy, and roadmap for enterprise-grade storage usage insights & governance.
  • Make and communicate clear, well-reasoned tradeoffs across quality, customer value, and schedule—bringing collaborators and engineering along.
  • Integrate AI tools into your own PM workflows to accelerate discovery, requirements development, prototyping, and iteration.
  • Partner with go-to-market, engineering, design, and analytics teams to launch product features.
  • Be the customer advocate at every step—help the entire product team see what makes the difference between just another feature and genuine customer delight!

What you need to succeed

  • 4-6+ years of product management experience, with a demonstrated track record of driving initiatives from conception to launch.
  • Attention to detail and exposure to building & shipping user experience based capability & features.
  • Strong data orientation: comfortable working directly with data, defining success metrics, and using quantitative insights to guide prioritization and strategy.
  • Actively uses AI tools to support PM work—including research, drafting requirements, synthesizing insights, and exploring product tradeoffs.
  • Excellent business intuition, good judgment, and the ability to influence key collaborators without direct authority.
  • A bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience is required; an MBA or master’s degree or equivalent experience in a related field is preferred.

Job Description Summary

Develops, interprets and implements financial concepts for financial planning and control. Performs technical analysis to determine present and future financial performance. Gathers, analyzes, prepares and summarizes recommendations for financial plans, acquisition activity, trended future requirements and operating forecasts.

Job Description

Position Summary:

This is an exciting opportunity to join the India COE team as we continue to shift to drive the business through data-driven forecasts and providing influential insights. This Senior Financial Analyst position will partner with the Finance Manager at HQ to support reporting and analysis for one of the verticals in the DX organization. In this role, you will be responsible for a wide range of projects in support of key business decisions and fiscal deliverable. You will develop and maintain frameworks for quarterly & annual budgets, drive consolidation of in-quarter outlook forecast, analyze and report on financial data, partner with geographically dispersed finance colleagues, and provide recommendations to management.

Responsibilities include:

  • Prepare reporting for annual/quarterly budgets and weekly/monthly forecasts, ensuring a high level of headcount and expense predictability for the identified organization, review for completeness and summarize key variances
  • Prepare trended analytics for key areas such as headcount attrition, employee costs, and travel spend
  • Generate outlook and controller’s letter reporting
  • Leverage Power BI/Tableau to create and maintain centralized and common reporting and analytical solutions
  • Prepare journal entries, reconcile balance sheet accounts and quarterly international charge outs
  • Drive continual process improvements, framework enhancements in support of generating meaningful data-driven insights
  • Collaborate with finance controllers/consolidators to drive fiscal deliverable, gain comprehension of variance drivers, and challenge assumptions/methodologies employed
  • Ad-hoc analysis as required, and self-initiated projects encouraged

Requirements:

  • Positive attitude and comfort in an environment subject to change as the business evolves
  • Bachelor's degree in business, finance or related field; CPA/MBA/Chartered Accountant preferred, but not mandatory
  • 10+ years of FP&A (or related) experience required, preferably with a US-based company
  • Strong analytical and accounting skills; must understand key business drivers, ability to communicate financial implications/business impact and provide recommendations with attention to detail
  • Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to take charge, set objectives, drive to results
  • Exceptional follow-through capabilities

JOB LEVEL

P30

EMPLOYEE ROLE

Individual Contributor

Adobe is looking for a highly motivated and versatile Research Scientist to join its Media and Data Science Research (MDSR) Laboratory. This lab operates within the Customer Experience Orchestration (CXO) business unit. The position offers an outstanding chance to participate in world-class research that will define future digital experiences.

As part of our ambitious team, you will work on innovative research problems and implement solutions to revolutionize how businesses operate. You will have the chance to turn your research ideas into successful products and disseminate them at top conferences and journals.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and guide research projects in fields like Natural Language Processing, Computational Social Science, and Machine Learning.
  • Work together with product teams to transform research developments into meaningful products.
  • Build challenging evaluations related to creative intelligence and marketing performance.
  • Develop scalable synthetic data generation and evaluation techniques.
  • Manipulate and analyze complex, high-volume, high-dimensionality data from diverse sources.
  • Train models and run experiments to study data and model quality.
  • Continuously improve research experiments and clearly share insights with the team.
  • Integrate core machine learning models into the Adobe Experience Manager and Adobe Experience Platform.
  • Collaborate with product, development, and engineering teams to rapidly prototype and transition conceptual prototypes from research to production.

Requirements

  • PhD degree and 3 years of experience, or six years of experience, in applied research in Computer Science, Statistics, Economics, or other relevant technical fields.
  • Hands-on experience and a track record of deploying solutions in production environments.
  • Multiple publications in leading conferences such as ICLR, NeurIPS, ICML, PNAS, Nature, Science, ACL, EMNLP, CHI, WWW, KDD, CVPR, etc.
  • Demonstrated experience in one or more of the following fields: Large Language Models, Natural Language Processing, Computational Social Science, Behavioral Sciences, Agentic Workflows, Social Network Analysis, Causal Inference, Recommendation Systems, Multimodal Content Understanding.

You Will Thrive In This Role If You

  • Experience in deriving concrete conclusions and actionable insights from large datasets.
  • Ability to take research risks and solve hard problems independently.
  • Are a great teammate who is willing to take on a variety of tasks to contribute to the success of the team.
  • Have a proven track record and an impulse for empirical research, answering complex questions with data.
  • Are capable of leading ambitious projects and possess clear communication skills.
  • Have experience designing high-quality research experiments and assessments with quick cycles.
  • Have experience working in complex technical environments, improving research velocity.
  • Possess a flexible analytic approach that allows for results at varying levels of precision.

Internal Opportunities

Creativity, curiosity, and constant learning are celebrated aspects of your career growth journey. We’re glad that you’re pursuing a new opportunity at Adobe!

Put your best foot forward:

1. Update your Resume/CV and Workday profile – don’t forget to include your uniquely ‘Adobe’ experiences and volunteer work.

2. Visit the Internal Mobility page on Inside Adobe to learn more about the process and set up a job alert for roles you’re interested in.

3. Check out these tips to help you prep for interviews.

4. If you are applying for a role outside of your current country, ensure you review the International Resources for Relocating Employees on Inside Adobe, including the impacts to your Benefits, AIP, Equity & Payroll. 

Once you apply for a role via Workday, the Talent Team will reach out to you within 2 weeks. If you move into the official interview process with the hiring team, make sure you inform your manager so they can champion your career growth.

At Adobe, you will be immersed in an exceptional work environment that is recognized around the world. You will also be surrounded by colleagues who are committed to helping each other grow through our unique Check-In approach where ongoing feedback flows freely. If you’re looking to make an impact, Adobe's the place for you. description_html: <p style="text-align:inherit"></p><p style="text-align:left"><b>JOB LEVEL</b></p>M70/P70<p style="text-align:left"><b>EMPLOYEE ROLE</b></p>People Manager<p style="text-align:inherit"></p><p style="text-align:inherit"></p><h1>About Adobe & Global Sales Strategy & Operations Organization</h1><p></p><p>Adobe is a global leader in digital experiences, empowering everyone—from individuals to the world’s largest enterprises—to create, deliver, and optimize exceptional customer experiences. Adobe’s culture is rooted in creativity, innovation, and impact, with a strong commitment to integrity, inclusion, and continuous learning. We believe in building technology that enables people and businesses to do their best work, and we invest deeply in our people to help them grow, lead, and thrive.</p><p>The Global Sales Operations organization partners with Adobe’s sales leadership to drive clarity, focus, and execution excellence across the global go-to-market engine. The team brings together strategy, insights, systems, and operational rigor to simplify complexity, improve productivity, and scale what works. As Adobe continues to grow, Global Sales Operations plays a central role in shaping how data, technology, and AI are leveraged to deliver consistent, high-quality outcomes for customers and the business.</p><p></p><h2><b>Role Summary</b></h2><p>This role leads a high-impact enterprise function responsible for transforming how sales and operations teams use data, analytics, and technology to drive growth, productivity, and better decision-making. The leader will own the strategy and execution of an AI-first analytics ecosystem, modern data platforms, and scaled technology operations that enable faster, smarter, and more consistent business outcomes.</p><p></p><h2><i>Strategic Leadership & Executive Partnership</i></h2><p>This role is a key member of the Global Sales Operations leadership team and serves as a trusted advisor to senior executives. As part of the senior leadership staff, the role contributes directly to shaping global sales operations strategy, setting priorities, and defining how analytics, technology, and AI are used to enable growth at scale.<br /><br />The leader will influence enterprise-wide decisions, partner closely with peers across Sales, Finance, Marketing, and Product, and help translate corporate strategy into executable, measurable programs that drive impact across regions and customer segments.</p><p></p><h2><i>India Site Leadership</i></h2><p>In addition to the global charter, this role serves as the senior site leader for Global Sales Operations investments in India. The role provides strategic and cultural leadership across India-based teams, ensuring strong alignment with global priorities while fostering an inclusive, high-performance environment.<br />As site leader, the role represents the organization locally, partners with regional leadership, and helps shape the long-term talent, capability, and investment strategy for India as a critical hub for innovation, scale, and enterprise impact.</p><p></p><h2><i>Why This Role / Why Now</i></h2><p>Enterprises are at an inflection point where traditional reporting and fragmented analytics are no longer sufficient to support the speed, scale, and complexity of modern go-to-market execution. Advances in cloud data platforms and applied AI now make it possible to shift from reactive reporting to proactive, insight-driven decision-making.</p><p>This role exists to lead that transformation—consolidating analytics experiences, modernizing data foundations, and embedding intelligence directly into daily workflows. The timing is critical: the organization is scaling globally, raising expectations on productivity and execution rigor, and investing in AI to fundamentally change how decisions are made across sales and operations.</p><p></p><h2><b>Key Responsibilities</b></h2><ul><li>Define and deliver an enterprise-wide analytics and intelligence strategy that shifts the organization from static reporting to AI-powered decision intelligence.</li><li>Lead the design and scale-up of a unified analytics experience that consolidates fragmented reporting into a single, intuitive interface for business and field users.</li><li>Drive modernization of the data platform, including cloud-native architectures, modular data pipelines, and self-service experimentation capabilities.</li><li>Embed advanced analytics and AI directly into business workflows, enabling insights and recommendations in the flow of work.</li><li>Transform technology support operations through intelligent automation, conversational AI, and workflow-driven self-service solutions.</li><li>Partner closely with sales, marketing, finance, and operations leaders to align metrics, planning rhythms, and decision frameworks.</li><li>Establish strong governance, prioritization, and execution rigor to balance ‘run-the-business’ stability with ‘change-the-business’ innovation.</li></ul><h2></h2><h2><b>Top Programs You Will Own</b></h2><ul><li>One Command Center (OCC) Expansion: Enterprise Analytics Transformation: Evolving analytics from dashboards to AI-driven decision intelligence, including predictive insights and conversational analytics.</li><li>Unified Analytics Experience: Consolidating disparate reporting tools into a single, role-based analytics interface with strong adoption and self-service.</li><li>Data Platform Modernization: Migrating to cloud-native, modular data platforms that accelerate time-to-insight and support advanced analytics and AI.</li><li>Workflow-Embedded Insights: Delivering insights and recommendations directly within CRM and operational workflows.</li><li>Intelligent Technology Operations: Transforming support and operations through automation, conversational interfaces, and end-to-end workflow orchestration.</li></ul><h2></h2><h2><b>Leadership & People Responsibilities</b></h2><ul><li>Lead and develop a diverse, multi-disciplinary JOB LEVEL

M70/P70

EMPLOYEE ROLE

People Manager

About Adobe & Global Sales Strategy & Operations Organization

Adobe is a global leader in digital experiences, empowering everyone—from individuals to the world’s largest enterprises—to create, deliver, and optimize exceptional customer experiences. Adobe’s culture is rooted in creativity, innovation, and impact, with a strong commitment to integrity, inclusion, and continuous learning. We believe in building technology that enables people and businesses to do their best work, and we invest deeply in our people to help them grow, lead, and thrive.

The Global Sales Operations organization partners with Adobe’s sales leadership to drive clarity, focus, and execution excellence across the global go-to-market engine. The team brings together strategy, insights, systems, and operational rigor to simplify complexity, improve productivity, and scale what works. As Adobe continues to grow, Global Sales Operations plays a central role in shaping how data, technology, and AI are leveraged to deliver consistent, high-quality outcomes for customers and the business.

Role Summary

This role leads a high-impact enterprise function responsible for transforming how sales and operations teams use data, analytics, and technology to drive growth, productivity, and better decision-making. The leader will own the strategy and execution of an AI-first analytics ecosystem, modern data platforms, and scaled technology operations that enable faster, smarter, and more consistent business outcomes.

Strategic Leadership & Executive Partnership

This role is a key member of the Global Sales Operations leadership team and serves as a trusted advisor to senior executives. As part of the senior leadership staff, the role contributes directly to shaping global sales operations strategy, setting priorities, and defining how analytics, technology, and AI are used to enable growth at scale.

The leader will influence enterprise-wide decisions, partner closely with peers across Sales, Finance, Marketing, and Product, and help translate corporate strategy into executable, measurable programs that drive impact across regions and customer segments.

India Site Leadership

In addition to the global charter, this role serves as the senior site leader for Global Sales Operations investments in India. The role provides strategic and cultural leadership across India-based teams, ensuring strong alignment with global priorities while fostering an inclusive, high-performance environment.
As site leader, the role represents the organization locally, partners with regional leadership, and helps shape the long-term talent, capability, and investment strategy for India as a critical hub for innovation, scale, and enterprise impact.

Why This Role / Why Now

Enterprises are at an inflection point where traditional reporting and fragmented analytics are no longer sufficient to support the speed, scale, and complexity of modern go-to-market execution. Advances in cloud data platforms and applied AI now make it possible to shift from reactive reporting to proactive, insight-driven decision-making.

This role exists to lead that transformation—consolidating analytics experiences, modernizing data foundations, and embedding intelligence directly into daily workflows. The timing is critical: the organization is scaling globally, raising expectations on productivity and execution rigor, and investing in AI to fundamentally change how decisions are made across sales and operations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and deliver an enterprise-wide analytics and intelligence strategy that shifts the organization from static reporting to AI-powered decision intelligence.
  • Lead the design and scale-up of a unified analytics experience that consolidates fragmented reporting into a single, intuitive interface for business and field users.
  • Drive modernization of the data platform, including cloud-native architectures, modular data pipelines, and self-service experimentation capabilities.
  • Embed advanced analytics and AI directly into business workflows, enabling insights and recommendations in the flow of work.
  • Transform technology support operations through intelligent automation, conversational AI, and workflow-driven self-service solutions.
  • Partner closely with sales, marketing, finance, and operations leaders to align metrics, planning rhythms, and decision frameworks.
  • Establish strong governance, prioritization, and execution rigor to balance ‘run-the-business’ stability with ‘change-the-business’ innovation.

Top Programs You Will Own

  • One Command Center (OCC) Expansion: Enterprise Analytics Transformation: Evolving analytics from dashboards to AI-driven decision intelligence, including predictive insights and conversational analytics.
  • Unified Analytics Experience: Consolidating disparate reporting tools into a single, role-based analytics interface with strong adoption and self-service.
  • Data Platform Modernization: Migrating to cloud-native, modular data platforms that accelerate time-to-insight and support advanced analytics and AI.
  • Workflow-Embedded Insights: Delivering insights and recommendations directly within CRM and operational workflows.
  • Intelligent Technology Operations: Transforming support and operations through automation, conversational interfaces, and end-to-end workflow orchestration.

Leadership & People Responsibilities

  • Lead and develop a diverse, multi-disciplinary organization spanning data engineering, analytics, product management, and technology operations.
  • Build a high-performance culture with clear accountability, strong succession planning, and a consistent focus on raising the performance bar.
  • Design lean operating models that improve speed, quality, and span of control while investing in future-ready skills.
  • Act as a visible, trusted leader who can influence across boundaries and drive alignment at senior levels.

Leadership Competencies

  • Strategic and systems thinking: Ability to connect business strategy, data, and technology into scalable solutions.
  • Outcome orientation: Focus on measurable business impact, not just delivery of tools or platforms.
  • Change leadership: Proven ability to lead large-scale transformation in complex, global environments.
  • Customer-centric mindset: Deep empathy for end users and a bias toward simplifying their experience.
  • Execution rigor: Strong prioritization, governance, and follow-through while operating at speed.
  • Talent builder: Commitment to developing leaders, strengthening succession, and building future-ready capabilities.

Success Measures (12–24 months)

  • Strong adoption and sustained engagement of enterprise analytics platforms across field and operations users.
  • Measurable reduction in reporting complexity and manual analytics effort through consolidation and automation.
  • Faster time-to-insight and improved engineering productivity enabled by modern data platforms and AI-assisted development.
  • Significant improvements in operational efficiency through intelligent self-service and automated support workflows.
  • Clear business impact demonstrated through improved decision quality, productivity, and revenue-supporting outcomes.

Required Experience & Capabilities

  • Senior leadership experience building and running enterprise-scale analytics, data, or technology organizations.
  • Proven track record delivering modern BI, analytics, or data platforms with high adoption and business impact.
  • Strong understanding of cloud data architectures, advanced analytics, and applied AI/ML in business contexts.
  • Experience leading large transformation programs across complex, global stakeholder environments ((Sales Ops, Marketing, Finance, CRM, platform engineering).
  • Ability to translate business strategy into scalable technology and analytics solutions.

Leadership Profile

The ideal candidate is a strategic yet hands-on leader who combines strong business acumen with deep analytics and technology expertise. They are comfortable operating in ambiguity, making trade-offs, and driving change at scale. They bring a customer-centric mindset, a bias for action, and the credibility to partner with senior executives across the enterprise.

Internal Opportunities

Creativity, curiosity, and constant learning are celebrated aspects of your career growth journey. We’re glad that you’re pursuing a new opportunity at Adobe!

Put your best foot forward:

1. Update your Resume/CV and Workday profile – don’t forget to include your uniquely ‘Adobe’ experiences and volunteer work.

2. Visit the Internal Mobility page on Inside Adobe to learn more about the process and set up a job alert for roles you’re interested in.

3. Check out these tips to help you prep for interviews.

4. If you are applying for a role outside of your current country, ensure you review the International Resources for Relocating Employees on Inside Adobe, including the impacts to your Benefits, AIP, Equity & Payroll. 

Once you apply for a role via Workday, the Talent Team will reach out to you within 2 weeks. If you move into the official interview process with the hiring team, make sure you inform your manager so they can champion your career growth.

At Adobe, you will be immersed in an exceptional work environment that is recognized around the world. You will also be surrounded by colleagues who are committed to helping each other grow through our unique Check-In approach where ongoing feedback flows freely. If you’re looking to make an impact, Adobe's the place for you. Discover what our employees are saying about their career experiences on the Adobe Life blog and explore the meaningful benefits we offer.

Adobe is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other applicable characteristics protected by law. Learn more.

 

Adobe aims to make Adobe.com accessible to any and all users. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation to navigate our website or complete the application process, email accommodations@adobe.com or call (408) 536-3015.

At Adobe, we're changing the world. How? We give people the tools to bring their ideas to life and create content that makes life more fun and work more meaningful. We give businesses and organizations the power to truly engage their customers. We're the ones behind the gorgeously designed content that streams across your laptop, TV, phone, and tablet every day—and we're the ones who harness the massive power of big data to help companies move from data to insight and insight to action by delivering content that people crave most.  We're a company that understands that product innovation comes from people innovation, and that's why we invest in cultivating leaders throughout the organization. If you're passionate about leading from where you sit, join us.  

The challenge

Adobe is looking for a React JS developer with strong computer science background and experience to develop the next generations of creative cloud applications. You will build elegant applications on world-class technologies that bring the creative Adobe experience to millions of users, anywhere and anytime.

Desired Skills and Experience

What you'll do

  • Design and implement robust, performant features in the Creative Cloud application using React JS and C++

  • Collaborate with product managers, designers, and senior engineers to translate requirements into scalable technical solutions.
  • Write clean, well-tested, maintainable code with strong attention to performance and reliability.
  • Participate in code reviews, provide constructive feedback, and uphold team engineering standards.
  • Debug and resolve complex issues across native and web layers of the application.
  • Contribute to architectural discussions and influence the technical direction of the CCD platform.
  • Work in an agile environment with regular sprints, standups, and iterative delivery.

Educational Qualifications:

  • B.E./B. Tech in Computer Science or a related field. 

Technical Expertise:

  • 2-3 years of expertise in ReactJS, data structure and algorithm
  • Good understanding of object oriented design & product life cycles
  • Should have excellent computer science fundamentals including but not limited to architecture, design, and performance; and an ability to contribute anywhere in the stack and wear different hats.
  • Most importantly, an ability and curiosity to solve problems and a passion for continuously evolving the implementation with latest advancements
  • Knowledge of application development on multiple platforms including various flavours of Windows and Macintosh

Personal Skills

  • Works well in a team.
  • Self-starter requiring minimal supervision.
  • Ability to learn quickly and adapt to changing priorities and requirements.
  • Excellent communication and prioritisation skills.

About Adobe

Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.

Our 30,000+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours. 


Let’s Adobe together

At Adobe, we believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. Learn more about Adobe life, including our values and culture, focus on people, purpose and community, Adobe for All, comprehensive benefits programs, the stories we tell, the customers we serve, and how you can help us advance our mission of empowering everyone to create.

Adobe is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Learn more.

Adobe aims to make our Careers website and recruiting process accessible to any and all users. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation to navigate our website or complete the application process, email accommodations@adobe.com or call +1 408-536-3015. 

AI Use Guidelines for Interviews:
Our interviews are designed to reflect your own skills and thinking. The use of AI or recording tools during live interviews is not permitted unless explicitly invited by the interviewer or approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation. If these tools are used inappropriately or in a way that misrepresents your work, your application may not move forward in the process.

At Adobe, we empower employees to innovate with AI — and we look for candidates eager to do the same. As part of the hiring experience, we provide clear guidance on where AI is encouraged during the process and where it’s restricted during live interviews. See how we think about AI in the hiring experience.

stakeholders.</p><p></p><p></p><p><b>What you’ll do</b></p><p></p><p>• Lead end-to-end delivery of Adobe ACS consulting engagements for Americas Region clients, ensuring projects are delivered on practices, resource planning, and continuous improvement initiatives within the ACS Consulting GDC team<br />• Collaborate effectively across time zones, ensuring GDC team members are aligned with Americas clients and internal stakeholders</p><p></p><p><b>What you need to succeed</b></p><p><br />• 15+ years of overall experience, with at least 5 years in a delivery management or program management role within a professional services or consulting organization</p><p>• Proven track record of successfully delivering large-scale Adobe Experience Cloud implementations (AEM, Adobe Commerce, AEP, Analytics, Target, Campaign, or Marketo) for enterprise clients</p><p>• Strong experience managing offshore delivery teams servicing Americas Region clients, with demonstrated ability to operate across time zones</p><p>• Solid understanding of project management methodologies (Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, Hybrid) and the ability to tailor delivery frameworks to client needs</p><p><br />• Excellent communication and executive stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build trusted relationships with Americas-based clients and internal leadership</p><p></p><p></p><p><b>Must-have skills</b></p><ul><li>Demonstrated ability to manage delivery P&L, track budgets, and report on project financials for consulting engagements</li><li>Experience managing distributed, cross-functional teams and driving accountability in a GDC/offshore delivery model servicing clients in the Americas Region</li><li>Strong familiarity with Adobe Experience Cloud products and how they are implemented in enterprise consulting contexts</li><li>Willingness and ability to work flexible hours to accommodate Americas time zones (EST/PST) from the Bangalore GDC</li><li>AI-Driven Delivery – Demonstrated experience leveraging AI and automation tools to enhance delivery outcomes, including the use of AI-assisted project planning, predictive risk management, intelligent resource optimization, and GenAI-powered productivity tools across the delivery lifecycle. Ability to champion AI adoption within GDC delivery teams and advise Americas clients on integrating AI capabilities into their consulting engagements</li></ul><p></p><p><b>Nice to have skills</b></p><p></p><ul><li>PMP, Prince2, or SAFe certification, or equivalent project/program management credential</li></ul><ul><li>Prior experience in an Adobe ACS or Managed Services consulting delivery role</li><li>Exposure to digital marketing strategy, customer experience platforms, and data-driven personalization technologies</li><li>Experience working with Americas-based enterprise clients across industries such as retail, financial services, media, or technology</li></ul><p></p><p><b>What leading at Adobe means </b></p><p></p><p>At Adobe, we’re passionate about developing leaders at all levels of the organization from individual contributors to people managers. Job Description

Position: Senior Delivery Manager – ACS Consulting

Business Unit: ACS Consulting GDC

Location: Bangalore

Our company

We’re changing the world. How? We give people the tools to bring their ideas to life and build content that makes life more fun and work more significant. We give businesses and organizations the power to truly engage their customers. Adobe is behind the gorgeously crafted content that streams across your laptop, TV, phone, and tablet every day—and we’re the ones who harness the extensive power of big data to help companies move from data to insight and insight to action by delivering content that people have an appetite for most. We’re a company that encourages leadership. If you’re passionate for leadership, join us.

The Challenge

Adobe is looking to hire an experienced, consulting-focused Senior Delivery Manager to join the ACS Consulting GDC team in India, supporting delivery for the Americas Region. In this senior leadership role, you will be responsible for end-to-end delivery of complex Adobe consulting engagements across North America, managing cross-functional teams, and ensuring customer success across the full project lifecycle. You will work closely with Americas-based clients, solution architects, and engineering teams to translate business requirements into measurable outcomes while driving continuous improvements in delivery quality and efficiency. This role requires flexibility to overlap with Americas time zones and strong cross-cultural communication skills to effectively partner with geographically distributed stakeholders.

What you’ll do

• Lead end-to-end delivery of Adobe ACS consulting engagements for Americas Region clients, ensuring projects are delivered on time, within scope, and on budget
• Serve as the primary delivery point of contact for Americas-based customers, managing escalations, stakeholder communications, and executive reporting
• Manage and mentor a team of project managers, consultants, technical leads and architects based in the GDC, fostering a high-performance delivery culture aligned with Americas business hours and client expectations
• Partner with Sales, Solution Architecture, and Practice leads to scope, estimate, and transition new engagements from pre-sales into delivery
• Drive governance, risk management, and delivery health across a portfolio of concurrent Adobe Experience Cloud projects (AEM, Adobe Commerce, AEP, Analytics, Target, Campaign, Marketo, etc.)
• Champion delivery best practices, resource planning, and continuous improvement initiatives within the ACS Consulting GDC team
• Collaborate effectively across time zones, ensuring GDC team members are aligned with Americas clients and internal stakeholders

What you need to succeed


• 15+ years of overall experience, with at least 5 years in a delivery management or program management role within a professional services or consulting organization

• Proven track record of successfully delivering large-scale Adobe Experience Cloud implementations (AEM, Adobe Commerce, AEP, Analytics, Target, Campaign, or Marketo) for enterprise clients

• Strong experience managing offshore delivery teams servicing Americas Region clients, with demonstrated ability to operate across time zones

• Solid understanding of project management methodologies (Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, Hybrid) and the ability to tailor delivery frameworks to client needs


• Excellent communication and executive stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build trusted relationships with Americas-based clients and internal leadership

Must-have skills

  • Demonstrated ability to manage delivery P&L, track budgets, and report on project financials for consulting engagements
  • Experience managing distributed, cross-functional teams and driving accountability in a GDC/offshore delivery model servicing clients in the Americas Region
  • Strong familiarity with Adobe Experience Cloud products and how they are implemented in enterprise consulting contexts
  • Willingness and ability to work flexible hours to accommodate Americas time zones (EST/PST) from the Bangalore GDC
  • AI-Driven Delivery – Demonstrated experience leveraging AI and automation tools to enhance delivery outcomes, including the use of AI-assisted project planning, predictive risk management, intelligent resource optimization, and GenAI-powered productivity tools across the delivery lifecycle. Ability to champion AI adoption within GDC delivery teams and advise Americas clients on integrating AI capabilities into their consulting engagements

Nice to have skills

  • PMP, Prince2, or SAFe certification, or equivalent project/program management credential
  • Prior experience in an Adobe ACS or Managed Services consulting delivery role
  • Exposure to digital marketing strategy, customer experience platforms, and data-driven personalization technologies
  • Experience working with Americas-based enterprise clients across industries such as retail, financial services, media, or technology

What leading at Adobe means

At Adobe, we’re passionate about developing leaders at all levels of the organization from individual contributors to people managers. Anyone who’s considering a career with us should know that we evaluate leadership based on these five capabilities:

  • Demonstrating Strong EQ (Be Aware) – Having a keen sense of self awareness is the foundation of leadership at Adobe. As a leader, we look to you to inspire teams to greatness with empathy and mindfulness of your impact on others from interns to the Board of Directors. And whether you’re in headquarters, New York, London, Tokyo or Bangalore, you’re attuned to emotional, situational and cultural surroundings and adapt your approach accordingly.
  • Selecting Talent (Be a Recruiter) – You’re on top of current and future talent needs as the business evolves because one of your key goals is to build robust teams. You do so by adopting a meticulous approach to hiring outstanding talent and are intentionally inclusive to attract diversity of ideas and experiences.
  • Role Modeling Check-In (Be a mentor) – annual reviews and rankings is not what Adobe believes in. That’s why, feedback flows continually at Adobe. You’re an inspirational and effective mentor; a leader who discusses expectations, feedback and development regularly with your direct reports. To succeed in this role, you’ll need to address performance gaps early and optimally, and be open to seeking feedback from others to improve your performance and your team's performance
  • Leading Change (Be an Agent of Change) – Change leadership is what you do! You proactively identify opportunities to align team goals with organizational change. You’re great at building support for change because you connect with conviction and you help those around you to see both the rational and mechanics for business changes and how to adapt accordingly
  • Scaling the Business (Be an Owner) – You’re someone who sees and understands the vision of the company. You’re able to articulate business strategy and develop business processes, systems and structures to make performance balanced. Your mission is to deliver an exceptional customer experience by promoting shared goals and driving accountability

About Adobe

Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.

Our 30,000+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours. 


Let’s Adobe together

At Adobe, we believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. Learn more about Adobe life, including our values and culture, focus on people, purpose and community, Adobe for All, comprehensive benefits programs, the stories we tell, the customers we serve, and how you can help us advance our mission of empowering everyone to create.

Adobe is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Learn more.

Our interviews are designed to reflect your own skills and thinking. The use of AI or recording tools during live interviews is not permitted unless explicitly invited by the interviewer or approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation. If these tools are used inappropriately or in a way that misrepresents your work, your application may not move forward in the process.

description_text:
The Opportunity

Join Adobe's Expert Solution Consulting (XSC) team as an Expert Solution Consultant with a specialization in Content AI & Optimization. This role presents a remarkable opportunity to lead the adoption of Adobe's groundbreaking Content AI & Optimization solutions – LLM Optimizer, Brand Concierge, and Adobe Sites Optimizer. The role also supports the integration of Semrush capabilities into the Brand Visibility suite. Responsibilities will include serving as a strategic consultant to the world’s most successful enterprise brands, guiding them through the complex landscape of SEO, GEO, conversational and transactional AI, brand authenticity, and content efficiency. For those with a strong passion for technical SEO, GEO strategy, and AI search ecosystems, this role is a great fit!


What You'll Do

  • Lead technical discovery, solution composition, and POV execution across Adobe’s optimization and governance suite to secure technical wins in collaboration with our Sales team.

  • Drive AI adoption by showcasing how Adobe content optimization solutions deliver high-quality, safe, and brand-accurate AI-generated output.

  • Elevate customer content visibility and performance through the use of Sites Optimizer to diagnose and improve CWV, authoring workflows, and SEO scalability.

  • Elevate brand trust by deploying Brand Concierge to safeguard brand equity across various content ecosystems and contributors.

  • Present impactful demonstrations that showcase the tangible results of optimization initiatives.

  • Develop playbooks, POV templates, competitive battlecards, and demo assets to scale your impact. Host internal training sessions to empower the team.

What you need to succeed

  • 5–8+ years of experience in technical pre-sales, consulting, or solution architecture for SEO, CMS/DXP, AI/LLM, or brand governance solutions.

  • Profound understanding of search engine optimization, generative engine optimization strategy, and content visibility boosted by advanced tools.

  • Hands-on experience with platforms like Google Search Console, BrightEdge, Conductor, Semrush, or Ahrefs.

  • Practical knowledge of Core Web Vitals, front-end performance, and tagging strategies.

  • Ability to articulate how LLMs, RAG pipelines, guardrails, and timely evaluations influence customer trust and discoverability.

  • Outstanding storytelling skills to translate technical solutions into business value for CMO and CTO audiences.

About Adobe

Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.

Our 30,000+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours. 


Let’s Adobe together

At Adobe, we believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. Learn more about Adobe life, including our values and culture, focus on people, purpose and community, Adobe for All, comprehensive benefits programs, the stories we tell, the customers we serve, and how you can help us advance our mission of empowering everyone to create.

Adobe is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Learn more.

Adobe aims to make our Careers website and recruiting process accessible to any and all users. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation to navigate our website or complete the application process, email accommodations@adobe.com or call +1 408-536-3015. 

AI Use Guidelines for Interviews:
Our interviews are designed to reflect your own skills and thinking. The use of AI or recording tools during live interviews is not permitted unless explicitly invited by the interviewer or approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation. If these tools are used inappropriately or in a way that misrepresents your work, your application may not move forward in the process.

At Adobe, we empower employees to innovate with AI — and we look for candidates eager to do the same. As part of the hiring experience, we provide clear guidance on where AI is encouraged during the process and where it’s restricted during live interviews. See how we think about AI in the hiring experience.

Expected Pay Range:

 

Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several  U.S. geographic markets, and we pay differently based on those defined markets. The U.S. pay range for this position is $178,200 -- $289,000 annually. Pay within this range varies by work location and may also depend on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for the job location during the hiring process.

 

 

In California, the pay range for this position is $199,600 - $289,000 In New York, the pay range for this position is $199,600 - $289,000 In Washington, the pay range for this position is $191,000 - $276,500

At Adobe, for sales roles starting salaries are expressed as total target compensation (TTC = base + commission), and short-term incentives are in the form of sales commission plans.  Non-sales roles starting salaries are expressed as base salary and short-term incentives are in the form of the Annual Incentive Plan (AIP).

In addition, certain roles may be eligible for long-term incentives in the form of a new hire equity award.

The opportunity:

From the moment you wake up in the morning until you go to bed at night consider the media you consume, the adverts you see, the apps you use, the websites you browse and almost all of the shopping you do online throughout the day. Chances are that many of those interactions and experiences were touched by an Adobe product.

We have an exciting opportunity for a Senior Solution Architect to join our Professional Services team in EMEA, based in Germany.

This role is for a strategic, customer-facing architect who can help customers modernize content operations for the AI era. You will work with customers and prospects to understand their goals, capture requirements, shape scope, and translate complex needs into compelling solution direction that connects Adobe technology to clear business value.

While a strong foundation in CMS platforms and Adobe Experience Manager is essential, this is not simply a product architecture role. We are looking for someone who can elevate customer conversations—helping organizations rethink how content is planned, created, governed, activated, and optimized through Content Supply Chain, AI-enabled workflows, and emerging agentic approaches.

You will act as a trusted advisor to stakeholders ranging from business leaders to technical teams, using your CMS and digital experience background to bring credibility to strategic discussions. Working closely with Sales, Delivery, Product, and Partner teams, you will lead discovery, shape roadmaps, create compelling presentations and proposals, and help customers understand how Adobe can accelerate transformation across content operations, experience delivery, and long-term innovation.

This is a highly collaborative, customer-facing role suited to someone who combines strategic thinking, technical credibility, and strong communication skills to help customers move from vision to action. The role is based in Paris with hybrid working and travel across EMEA of up to 30%.

What you’ll do:

  • Lead business and technical discovery sessions to understand customer objectives, requirements, constraints, risks and success measures
  • Capture and translate customer needs into clear solution strategies, recommendations, scoped proposals, and phased roadmaps
  • Create compelling customer-ready presentations, proposals, estimates, and solution narratives that articulate the value of Adobe technology
  • Help customers modernize content operations through Content Supply Chain strategies, AI-enabled workflows, and agentic approaches to experience delivery
  • Connect business priorities to architecture direction and help customers understand how Adobe solutions support transformation outcomes
  • Use your AEM and CMS background as a foundation for broader conversations around governance, reuse, metadata, operating models, and scalable content delivery
  • Advise customers on architecture approaches, integration patterns, risks, and best practices across enterprise CMS and digital experience environments
  • Partner closely with Sales, Delivery, Product, and Partner teams to shape opportunities and support successful customer outcomes
  • Present confidently to executive and technical audiences, simplifying complex topics in business-friendly language and helping customers buy into the vision

What you’ll need to succeed:

  • Significant experience in consulting, professional services, pre-sales, delivery, or enterprise digital transformation
  • Around 10+ years of relevant experience in customer-facing roles involving solutioning, scoping, advisory work, or strategic consulting
  • Strong experience with enterprise CMS platforms, with Adobe Experience Manager preferred
  • Experience capturing requirements, defining scope, supporting estimation, and developing proposals or customer-facing recommendations
  • Ability to translate business requirements into solution direction and communicate value clearly to both executive and technical stakeholders
  • Strong understanding of digital experience architecture, CMS integration patterns, and enterprise content management strategies
  • Interest in helping customers apply Content Supply Chain, AI-enabled workflows, and emerging agentic capabilities to real business challenges
  • Fluency in English and German is required. Any other european language would be a plus.

As our many awards will tell you, at Adobe you’ll be immersed in an exceptional work environment that is recognized around the world. You’ll be surrounded by colleagues who are committed to helping each other grow through our unique Check-In approach where ongoing feedback flows freely. JOB LEVEL

P50

EMPLOYEE ROLE

Individual Contributor

The Adobe Experience Cloud (https://www.adobe.com/experience-cloud.html) is a $3B+ business serving enterprise customers, including over 95% of Fortune 500 organizations.

Marketo Engage, AJOB2B , part of Adobe Experience Cloud, is a leading marketing automation platform that empowers businesses to orchestrate personalized customer engagement at scale. Marketo provides capabilities across campaign management, lead nurturing, customer journey orchestration, analytics, and real-time engagement, enabling enterprises to deliver impactful digital experiences across channels.

About the Role

We are seeking a Lead Backend major , full stack Architect to join the Marketo Engineering team and help shape the next generation of scalable backend platform capabilities. This role focuses on designing and building highly scalable, reliable, and intelligent backend systems that power enterprise-scale marketing automation workloads handling billions of customer interactions and events.
 

This role goes beyond feature development—you will define architectural direction, influence engineering standards, and drive AI-first innovation across teams while acting as a recognized technical leader.

What You’ll Do

Architecture, Platform & Innovation

  • Own and drive end-to-end architecture and development for core backend platform components, influencing foundational architecture and long-term technical strategy.

  • Design scalable distributed systems, APIs, data pipelines, and event-driven architectures capable of supporting enterprise-scale workloads.

  • Lead architecture and design reviews, providing expert mentorship and constructive feedback to improve system quality, scalability, and resilience.

  • Drive AI-first platform solutions, incorporating AI/ML capabilities into backend services to enable intelligent automation, optimization, and personalization.

  • Innovate and contribute breakthrough ideas, evaluating and promoting adoption across products and engineering teams.

  • Define and evolve architectural patterns, backend engineering standards, and platform guidelines across organizations.

Engineering Execution & Platform Development

  • Lead development of complex, high-impact backend services and platform capabilities.

  • Establish and enforce coding standards, testing strategies, observability practices, and automation frameworks to improve scalability, reliability, and maintainability.

  • Drive AI-enabled engineering practices to improve developer productivity and software quality.

  • Own DevOps lifecycle end-to-end: development, CI/CD, deployment automation, monitoring, observability, and production reliability.

  • Refactor and modernize legacy systems to improve performance, scalability, and operational efficiency.

  • Drive performance optimization, fault tolerance, security, and high availability across backend systems.

Leadership & Cross-Team Influence

  • Act as a technical leader across business units, influencing platform strategy, engineering practices, and architectural decisions.

  • Lead cross-team technical discussions, synthesizing diverse viewpoints into scalable and maintainable solutions.

  • Partner with architects, product managers, and engineering leaders to define long-term technical vision and roadmap.

  • Influence hiring decisions and contribute to building a high-performing engineering organization.

Encouraging Collaboration & Providing Guidance

  • Mentor engineers across levels on backend architecture, distributed systems, scalability, and engineering excellence.

  • Actively contribute through internal technical talks, architecture reviews, blogs, and engineering forums.

  • Encourage and guide contributions to technical papers, conferences, and industry discussions.

Ownership & Execution

  • Operate as a self-directed technical leader, handling ambiguous and complex problem spaces.

  • Drive initiatives independently while guiding peers and junior engineers.

  • Provide clear technical summaries, architectural recommendations, and strategic insights to leadership.

Requirements

  • B.Tech / M.Tech in Computer Science (or equivalent) from a premier institute.

  • 12+ years of software development experience with strong expertise in backend platform engineering and distributed systems architecture.

  • Deep understanding of scalable system architecture, microservices, APIs, event-driven systems, and cloud-native platform design.

  • Strong expertise in Java, Scala, Go, Python, or similar backend technologies.

  • Experience with distributed data systems, messaging platforms, caching, and large-scale data processing architectures.

  • Strong understanding of cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP and modern DevOps practices.

  • Proven experience leading complex technical initiatives and influencing cross-team architecture.

  • Strong foundation in data structures, algorithms, software design principles, and backend engineering best practices.

  • Experience or strong inclination toward AI-powered product capabilities and AI-assisted engineering practices.

  • Demonstrated ability to mentor, lead, and grow engineering talent.

  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to articulate complex technical ideas clearly.

Why This Role

This is a high-impact role where you will:

  • Influence core backend architecture powering enterprise-scale marketing automation

  • Drive AI-first transformation in platform and backend engineering

  • Work on systems handling billions of customer interactions and events every week

  • Build the future of customer engagement technology at Adobe

title: Sr. Computer Scientist - Infra Engineering
description_html: <div><b>Role Overview</b><br />We are looking for a Senior Infrastructure Developer with 10+ years of experience to own, evolve, and scale the platform that powers our most demanding ML training workloads. This is not a "keep the lights on" role — you will be architecting systems, writing production-grade code, leading multi-quarter projects across geo-distributed teams, and setting the reliability bar for an infrastructure that thousands of GPU hours depend on every day.<br />You bring deep Kubernetes expertise, strong networking fundamentals, a developer's mindset, and the leadership instincts to navigate ambiguity and drive alignment across cross-functional stakeholders. You have operated systems at massive scale and felt the weight of that responsibility.<br /><b>About the Platform</b><br />You will be working on a cutting-edge platform designed to train and serve large-scale machine learning models. The platform supports everything from small-scale experimentation to massive, distributed training jobs running on GPU clusters spanning thousands of accelerators. It provides ML engineers and researchers with the tools to onboard, monitor, and scale their workloads — whether a lightweight prototype or a production-grade deep learning model powering real-world applications.<br /><br /><b>Key platform capabilities:</b></div><p><b>Dynamic GPU orchestration </b>using Kubernetes with custom schedulers and resource topology awareness. <b>Training & inference workflows </b>end-to-end pipeline support from data ingestion through model serving. <b>Observability & cost tracking </b>full-stack visibility across compute, network, and storage layers. <b>Self-service developer tooling </b>enabling high-velocity experimentation without platform bottlenecks. <b>Multi-cloud infrastructure </b>primarily AWS with Azure/GCP expansion underway.</p><div><br />Your contributions will directly determine the reliability, scalability, and efficiency of this platform — and the speed at which AI teams can innovate.<br /><b>What You’ll Do</b></div><p><b>Architect for scale </b>Design and evolve Kubernetes-native infrastructure capable of running distributed GPU training jobs at massive scale, with an obsession for reliability and efficiency. <b>Lead cross-geo initiatives </b>Own complex, multi-team projects end-to-end — write design docs, align stakeholders across time zones, and drive delivery in ambiguous, fast-moving environments. <b>Codify infrastructure </b>Define and ship cloud infrastructure through IaC (Terraform/Pulumi). Treat infra changes with the same rigor, testing, and review as application code. <b>Build observability </b>Design and maintain deep observability stacks — metrics, distributed tracing, log aggregation, SLO/SLI frameworks — that surface problems before they become incidents. <b>Write production code </b>Build automation, internal tooling, operators, and platform services in Go, Python, or Rust. This is not a YAML-only role. <b>Own reliability </b>Lead incident response, post-mortems, and reliability reviews. Drive systemic fixes, not just workarounds. Set the on-call culture. <b>Solve hard networking problems </b>Debug and resolve complex cluster networking issues — CNI, BGP, service mesh, DNS at scale, east-west traffic, high-throughput tuning. <b>Mentor and grow the team </b>Raise the technical bar through code reviews, architectural guidance, and knowledge sharing with engineers across experience levels.  </p><div><br /><b>What You Bring</b><br /><b>Core Requirements:</b><br /><b>Kubernetes & GPU Infrastructure</b></div><ul><li>10+ years in SRE, platform engineering, or infrastructure roles</li><li>Expert-level Kubernetes internals: scheduler, kubelet, CRDs, operators, admission controllers</li><li>Proven experience running GPU/accelerator training workloads at scale</li><li>Multi-cluster management, federation, and workload placement strategies</li><li>Helm, Kustomize, GitOps (Flux/ArgoCD) — and knowing when not to use them.</li></ul><div><b>Cloud & Infrastructure as Code</b></div><ul><li>Deep AWS hands-on experience required (VPC, EKS, EC2, S3, IAM, TGW)</li><li>Terraform or Pulumi — production-grade, modular, tested</li><li>CI/CD for infrastructure: drift detection, plan gating, rollback strategies</li><li>Cost optimization, reserved capacity planning, and spot instance management at scale</li></ul><div><b>Observability</b></div><ul><li>Prometheus, Grafana, AlertManager — at scale, not just lab setups</li><li>Distributed tracing: OpenTelemetry, Jaeger, Tempo</li><li>Log aggregation: Loki, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch</li><li>SLO/SLI design, error budget policy, and multi-tier description_text:
Role Overview
We are looking for a Senior Infrastructure Developer with 10+ years of experience to own, evolve, and scale the platform that powers our most demanding ML training workloads. This is not a "keep the lights on" role — you will be architecting systems, writing production-grade code, leading multi-quarter projects across geo-distributed teams, and setting the reliability bar for an infrastructure that thousands of GPU hours depend on every day.
You bring deep Kubernetes expertise, strong networking fundamentals, a developer's mindset, and the leadership instincts to navigate ambiguity and drive alignment across cross-functional stakeholders. You have operated systems at massive scale and felt the weight of that responsibility.
About the Platform
You will be working on a cutting-edge platform designed to train and serve large-scale machine learning models. The platform supports everything from small-scale experimentation to massive, distributed training jobs running on GPU clusters spanning thousands of accelerators. It provides ML engineers and researchers with the tools to onboard, monitor, and scale their workloads — whether a lightweight prototype or a production-grade deep learning model powering real-world applications.

Key platform capabilities:

Dynamic GPU orchestration using Kubernetes with custom schedulers and resource topology awareness. Training & inference workflows end-to-end pipeline support from data ingestion through model serving. Observability & cost tracking full-stack visibility across compute, network, and storage layers. Self-service developer tooling enabling high-velocity experimentation without platform bottlenecks. Multi-cloud infrastructure primarily AWS with Azure/GCP expansion underway.


Your contributions will directly determine the reliability, scalability, and efficiency of this platform — and the speed at which AI teams can innovate.
What You’ll Do

Architect for scale Design and evolve Kubernetes-native infrastructure capable of running distributed GPU training jobs at massive scale, with an obsession for reliability and efficiency. Lead cross-geo initiatives Own complex, multi-team projects end-to-end — write design docs, align stakeholders across time zones, and drive delivery in ambiguous, fast-moving environments. Codify infrastructure Define and ship cloud infrastructure through IaC (Terraform/Pulumi). Treat infra changes with the same rigor, testing, and review as application code. Build observability Design and maintain deep observability stacks — metrics, distributed tracing, log aggregation, SLO/SLI frameworks — that surface problems before they become incidents. Write production code Build automation, internal tooling, operators, and platform services in Go, Python, or Rust. This is not a YAML-only role. Own reliability Lead incident response, post-mortems, and reliability reviews. Drive systemic fixes, not just workarounds. Set the on-call culture. Solve hard networking problems Debug and resolve complex cluster networking issues — CNI, BGP, service mesh, DNS at scale, east-west traffic, high-throughput tuning. Mentor and grow the team Raise the technical bar through code reviews, architectural guidance, and knowledge sharing with engineers across experience levels.  


What You Bring
Core Requirements:
Kubernetes & GPU Infrastructure
  • 10+ years in SRE, platform engineering, or infrastructure roles
  • Expert-level Kubernetes internals: scheduler, kubelet, CRDs, operators, admission controllers
  • Proven experience running GPU/accelerator training workloads at scale
  • Multi-cluster management, federation, and workload placement strategies
  • Helm, Kustomize, GitOps (Flux/ArgoCD) — and knowing when not to use them.
Cloud & Infrastructure as Code
  • Deep AWS hands-on experience required (VPC, EKS, EC2, S3, IAM, TGW)
  • Terraform or Pulumi — production-grade, modular, tested
  • CI/CD for infrastructure: drift detection, plan gating, rollback strategies
  • Cost optimization, reserved capacity planning, and spot instance management at scale
Observability
  • Prometheus, Grafana, AlertManager — at scale, not just lab setups
  • Distributed tracing: OpenTelemetry, Jaeger, Tempo
  • Log aggregation: Loki, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch
  • SLO/SLI design, error budget policy, and multi-tier alerting
Networking Fundamentals
  • Deep TCP/IP, DNS, TLS, HTTP/2, gRPC — not just surface familiarity
  • CNI plugins: Cilium, Calico, Flannel — trade-offs and production behavior
  • Service mesh (Istio/Linkerd), ingress controllers, and API gateways
  • Network debugging under load: packet captures, eBPF traces, kernel counters
Coding & System Design
  • Production-quality code in Go, Python, or Rust — you ship, not just script
  • Distributed systems design consistency, availability, failure modes
  • Kubernetes operator authoring and controller-runtime patterns
  • Strong code review culture — you raise the bar, not just the PR count
  • Technical writing: design docs, ADRs, runbooks that others actually read
Leadership & Cross-Geo Collaboration
  • Led multi-quarter, cross-functional projects from whiteboard to production
  • Thrives in ambiguity — creates structure and momentum without a perfect spec
  • Experienced in async-first collaboration across distributed, cross-timezone teams
  • Strong communicator: can translate infra complexity to product and leadership audiences
  • Self-driven — you identify the problem, propose the solution, and own the outcome
Bonus Points:
  • Azure / GCP hands-on depth
  • ML training pipeline internals
  • eBPF-based observability / networking
  • Chaos engineering & game days
  • Open-source infrastructure contributions
  • Security, compliance & audit experience

Why This Role
  • You will write software, not just YAML. This is a coding role as much as it is an operations role.
  • You will work on real AI infrastructure challenges — the kind that research papers get written about, not buzzword slide decks.
  • You will have impact across developer productivity, platform scalability, and service reliability simultaneously.
  • You will lead. This is not an IC-only position — you will shape the technical direction of the team and the platform.
  • You will join a team that values code quality, systems thinking, blameless culture, and genuine ownership.
  • You will architect systems at a scale most engineers never get to touch — thousands of GPUs, petabytes of data movement, milliseconds of scheduling latency that matter
If you have seen what breaks at scale and have built the systems, the culture, and the habits to make sure it never breaks again — we want to talk.

Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.

Our 30,000+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact.
