About the Role

Adobe is seeking a Machine Learning Engineer to join the Adobe Genuine Engineering team. This group protects Adobe's ecosystem from fraud, abuse, and misuse using intelligent systems worldwide.

In this position, you will build and develop machine learning models from scratch, including custom transformer-based frameworks, to identify fraudulent actions, stop account sharing, and protect the experience of hundreds of millions of users. You will manage the entire model lifecycle: raw behavioral data and feature engineering, architecture development, large-scale GPU training, deployment, and monitoring.

The team is actively building in-house behavioral foundation models that learn identity-preserving representations from long sequences of user activity. This is a role for an engineer who wants to own deep learning systems end-to-end — not consume pre-built ones.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and train deep learning models from scratch, including custom transformer and attention-based architectures for long behavioral event sequences.
  • Own the full training stack: event tokenization, temporal and positional embeddings, self-supervised pretraining (e.g., masked modeling, contrastive learning), and downstream fine-tuning.
  • Train large models efficiently on GPU infrastructure using mixed-precision training, gradient accumulation/checkpointing, efficient attention, and distributed strategies (DDP, FSDP, or equivalent).
  • Build and optimize feature pipelines on Databricks and Spark, transforming raw behavioral events into high-quality model inputs.
  • Translate prototypes into production ML systems — scalable, reliable, and observable — and drive inference performance through architectural and serving-side optimization.
  • Contribute to MLOps practices: experiment tracking, model versioning, CI/CD, automated retraining, and production monitoring.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with data science, product, and platform teams; mentor junior engineers on experimentation rigor, deployment process, and responsible AI.
  • Stay current with advances in ML/AI and bring relevant innovations into Adobe's products.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or Master’s degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Data Science, or related field.
  • 8+ years of professional experience building and deploying ML solutions at scale.
  • Strong programming expertise in Python, with hands-on experience in PyTorch, TensorFlow, or similar frameworks.
  • Deep understanding of the end-to-end ML lifecycle—from data collection to deployment and monitoring.
  • Strong grasp of model optimization, inference efficiency, and production system integration.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in fraud detection, anomaly detection, or behavioral modeling.
  • Exposure to Adobe Experience Platform (AEP) or other large-scale SaaS ecosystems.

JOB LEVEL

P40

EMPLOYEE ROLE

Individual Contributor

Computer Scientist
Location: Noida
Experience: 6–9 Years
Team: AI Platform Engineering
Role Overview
We are looking for an experienced Infrastructure Developer (6–9 years) to help design, build, and scale the platform that powers our most demanding ML training workloads. This is a hands-on engineering role where you will write production-grade code, drive meaningful technical initiatives, and contribute to the reliability of an infrastructure that thousands of GPU hours depend on every day.
You bring strong Kubernetes skills, solid networking fundamentals, a developer’s mindset, and the ability to own projects end-to-end with limited supervision. You have operated systems at significant scale and are ready to step up into broader technical leadership.
About the Platform
You will be working on a cutting-edge platform designed to train and serve large-scale machine learning models. The platform supports everything from small-scale experimentation to large distributed training jobs running on GPU clusters with thousands of accelerators. It provides ML engineers and researchers with the tools to onboard, monitor, and scale their workloads — whether a lightweight prototype or a production-grade deep learning model powering real-world applications.
Key platform capabilities:
•    Dynamic GPU orchestration using Kubernetes with custom schedulers and resource topology awareness.
•    Training & inference workflows end-to-end pipeline support from data ingestion through model serving.
•    Observability & cost tracking full-stack visibility across compute, network, and storage layers.
•    Self-service developer tooling enabling high-velocity experimentation without platform bottlenecks.
•    Multi-cloud infrastructure primarily AWS with Azure/GCP expansion underway.
Your contributions will directly influence the reliability, scalability, and efficiency of this platform — and the speed at which AI teams can innovate.
What You’ll Do
•    Build for scale Design and improve Kubernetes-native infrastructure that runs distributed GPU training jobs reliably and efficiently. You will own significant components and drive their evolution.
•    Lead focused initiatives Own meaningful projects end-to-end — write design docs, gather input from stakeholders, and deliver under realistic timelines, often collaborating with engineers across time zones.
•    Codify infrastructure Define and ship cloud infrastructure through IaC (Terraform/Pulumi). Apply the same rigor, testing, and review discipline to infra changes as to application code.
•    Strengthen observability Contribute to and extend deep observability stacks — metrics, distributed tracing, log aggregation, SLO/SLI frameworks — that surface problems before they become incidents.
•    Write production code Build automation, internal tooling, operators, and platform services in Go, Python, or Rust. This is not a YAML-only role.
•    Own reliability Participate in incident response, post-mortems, and reliability reviews. Drive systemic fixes, not just workarounds. Be a strong contributor to on-call culture.
•    Solve hard networking problems Debug and resolve complex cluster networking issues — CNI, BGP, service mesh, DNS at scale, east-west traffic, throughput tuning.
•    Mentor and grow Raise the technical bar through code reviews, design feedback, and knowledge sharing with peers and more junior engineers.
What You Bring
Core Requirements
Kubernetes & GPU Infrastructure
•    6–9 years in SRE, platform engineering, or infrastructure roles
•    Strong working knowledge of Kubernetes internals: scheduler, kubelet, CRDs, operators, admission controllers
•    Hands-on experience running GPU/accelerator training workloads in production
•    Familiarity with multi-cluster management and workload placement strategies
•    Helm, Kustomize, GitOps (Flux/ArgoCD) — practical experience and good judgment on when to use them
Cloud & Infrastructure as Code
•    Solid hands-on AWS experience (VPC, EKS, EC2, S3, IAM; TGW a plus)
•    Production experience with Terraform or Pulumi — modular and tested
•    CI/CD for infrastructure: drift detection, plan gating, rollback strategies
•    Working understanding of cost optimization, reserved capacity, and spot instance management
Observability
•    Prometheus, Grafana, AlertManager — production experience, not just lab setups
•    Exposure to distributed tracing: OpenTelemetry, Jaeger, or Tempo
•    Log aggregation: Loki, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch
•    Comfort with SLO/SLI design, error budgets, and multi-tier alerting
Networking Fundamentals
•    Strong TCP/IP, DNS, TLS, HTTP/2, gRPC fundamentals
•    Practical experience with CNI plugins: Cilium, Calico, or Flannel — and their trade-offs
•    Familiarity with service mesh (Istio/Linkerd), ingress controllers, and API gateways
•    Ability to debug under load: packet captures, eBPF traces, kernel counters
Coding & System Design
•    Production-quality code in Go, Python, or Rust — you ship, not just script
•    Solid grasp of distributed systems fundamentals: consistency, availability, failure modes
•    Experience writing Kubernetes operators or working with controller-runtime patterns
•    Engaged code reviewer — thoughtful, constructive, and consistent
•    Clear technical writer: design docs, ADRs, runbooks that others can actually use
Collaboration & Ownership
•    Has delivered meaningful, cross-functional projects from design to production
•    Comfortable with ambiguity — can break down a problem and make progress without a perfect spec
•    Experience working async across distributed teams and time zones
•    Strong communicator — can explain infra trade-offs clearly to peers and partner teams
•    Self-driven — identifies problems, proposes solutions, and follows through to outcomes
Bonus Points
•    Azure / GCP hands-on experience
•    Familiarity with ML training pipeline internals
•    eBPF-based observability or networking
•    Chaos engineering or game day participation
•    Open-source infrastructure contributions
•    Security, compliance, or audit exposure
Why This Role
•    You will write software, not just YAML. This is a coding role as much as it is an operations role.
•    You will work on real AI infrastructure challenges — the kind that research papers get written about, not buzzword slide decks.
•    You will see your impact across developer productivity, platform scalability, and service reliability.
•    You will grow. This role gives you room to step into broader technical leadership over time.
•    You will join a team that values code quality, systems thinking, blameless culture, and genuine ownership.
•    You will work on systems at a scale most engineers never get to touch — thousands of GPUs, petabytes of data movement, milliseconds of scheduling latency that matter.

If you have built and operated real infrastructure, care about doing it well, and are ready to take on broader scope — we want to talk.
 

Internal Opportunities

Creativity, curiosity, and constant learning are celebrated aspects of your career growth journey. We’re glad that you’re pursuing a new opportunity at Adobe!

Put your best foot forward:

1. Update your Resume/CV and Workday profile – don’t forget to include your uniquely ‘Adobe’ experiences and volunteer work.

2. Visit the Internal Mobility page on Inside Adobe to learn more about the process and set up a job alert for roles you’re interested in.

3. Check out these tips to help you prep for interviews.

4. If you are applying for a role outside of your current country, ensure you review the International Resources for Relocating Employees on Inside Adobe, including the impacts to your Benefits, AIP, Equity & Payroll. 

Once you apply for a role via Workday, the Talent Team will reach out to you within 2 weeks. If you move into the official interview process with the hiring team, make sure you inform your manager so they can champion your career growth.

JOB LEVEL

P40

EMPLOYEE ROLE

Individual Contributor

The opportunity

We’re looking for a Senior Product Designer to help develop and scale the plug-in ecosystem for Firefly Enterprise Engine Studio. This role centers on crafting intuitive, flexible, and extensible experiences that enable Firefly capabilities to integrate seamlessly across Adobe products and third-party platforms such as Figma.

You’ll play a key role in crafting how developers, designers, and enterprise teams extend Firefly workflows—making powerful creative tools accessible, configurable, and easy to adopt. 
If you enjoy crafting platforms, thinking in systems, and building tools that other tools depend on, this role is for you. 

What you’ll do

As a Senior User Experience Designer, you’ll take charge of and develop core elements of the Firefly and GenStudio plug-in experience, collaborating closely with product, engineering, and partner teams. You will build end-to-end experiences for the Firefly plug-in ecosystem, including:

  • Plug-in discovery, installation, configuration, and lifecycle management

  • Uniformity across Adobe applications and external platforms

  • Partner with product managers and researchers to incorporate customer and developer feedback into build decisions

  • Collaborate with engineers to build scalable UX patterns for platform and ecosystem features

  • Build wireframes, high-fidelity designs, and interactive prototypes to explore and validate ideas

  • Ensure builds align with Adobe’s design systems, accessibility standards, and platform guidelines

  • Contribute to shared UX patterns and documentation that support consistency across plug-ins and integrations

What you’ll bring

  • 8 + years of experience in product, systems, or interaction development.

  • Strong experience designing platforms, tools, or extensible systems (SDKs, plug-ins, integrations, or admin workflows)

  • Ability to simplify complex, technical workflows into intuitive user experiences

  • Solid craft in building across interaction design, information architecture, and visual design

  • Hands-on experience with Figma and prototyping tools; comfort iterating quickly based on feedback

  • Experience collaborating closely with engineers and understanding technical constraints

  • Familiarity with developer-facing or enterprise workflows is a strong plus

  • Passion for accessibility, usability, and inclusive building

Preferred Accessibility Build Skills 

  • Experience crafting accessible and inclusive interfaces for people with disabilities

  • Familiarity with WCAG standards and testing for accessibility compliance

  • Certifications such as CPACC, WAS, CPWA, or ADS from IAAP are a plus

You’ll thrive in this role if you…

  • Enjoy crafting systems more than one-off screens

  • Like thinking about edge cases, scalability, and long-term evolution

  • Are curious about how tools connect, extend, and integrate

  • Balance user empathy with technical reality

  • Take ownership and enjoy shipping high-quality work in collaboration with cross-functional partners

Internal Opportunities

Creativity, curiosity, and constant learning are celebrated aspects of your career growth journey. We’re glad that you’re pursuing a new opportunity at Adobe!

Put your best foot forward:

1. Update your Resume/CV and Workday profile – don’t forget to include your uniquely ‘Adobe’ experiences and volunteer work.

2. Visit the Internal Mobility page on Inside Adobe to learn more about the process and set up a job alert for roles you’re interested in.

3. Check out these tips to help you prep for interviews.

4. If you are applying for a role outside of your current country, ensure you review the International Resources for Relocating Employees on Inside Adobe, including the impacts to your Benefits, AIP, Equity & Payroll. 

Once you apply for a role via Workday, the Talent Team will reach out to you within 2 weeks. If you move into the official interview process with the hiring team, make sure you inform your manager so they can champion your career growth.

JOB LEVEL

M40

EMPLOYEE ROLE

People Manager

The Opportunity!

Build the AI engine behind a creative product millions rely on every day.

We believe that a modern tool for building should be lightweight and easy to use, with low friction and outstanding performance. We are reimagining the creative process powered through a highly collaborative experience that works seamlessly across multiple surfaces.

Adobe Express is where ideas transform into creations at blazing speed. Behind every AI-powered moment our users tap into, there's a foundation and increasingly, that foundation is agentic. Prompt pipelines, tool calling, retrieval-augmented generation, multi-step reasoning, orchestration across models and services.

We're hiring an Engineering Manager to lead the team that builds and operates that foundation inside one of Adobe's flagship products. You will be leading a team that is building AI assistants and agentic workflows on top of LLMs, understanding what breaks at scale, and making the calls that turn a promising prototype into something millions of people actually use. You don't need to fine-tune models. But you need to deeply understand how they're wired together into something that works.

Curiosity is what will set you apart in this role. New models, new agent frameworks, new evaluation patterns, you are reading the papers, following the releases, and already thinking about what it means for your team next quarter. In a space that rewrites itself every few months, the people who thrive here are the ones who genuinely can't help but stay current.

And you know how to lead. You build high-performing teams, raise the bar on what good looks like, and create the conditions for engineers to do their best work. You manage up and across with clarity, translating technical complexity into crisp signal for stakeholders, and holding the line on what your team can realistically deliver. You're comfortable partnering across geographies and time zones, working fluidly with teams in the US, Europe, and In

What you'll do!

  • Lead, grow, and develop a team of strong engineers by attracting top talent, mentoring through change, and crafting the conditions for great work.

  • Drive the technical direction for the AI framework underpinning every AI experience in Adobe Express.

  • Own delivery end-to-end, architecture choices, execution risk, dependencies, and clear signal to senior leadership on what matters.

  • Partner closely with product, research, and development to turn ambitious AI ideas into systems that actually scale.

  • Stay ahead of where the field is going with new models, new patterns, new evaluation methods and translate that into product impact.

  • Build a team culture that's inclusive, candid, fast paced, and genuinely fun to be part of.

What you bring!

  • 12+ years in software engineering, with 4+ years leading engineering teams through real product delivery.

  • Hands-on experience building AI-powered features on top of LLMs, you have worked with prompt pipelines, tool calling, RAG, or agent orchestration frameworks and understand what it takes to move from prototype to production at scale. You deeply understand how models are wired together into something that works. Experience with fine-tuning models is a bonus.

  • An insatiable curiosity about where AI is heading. You follow model releases, read the papers, track new frameworks, and translate what's emerging into decisions that matter for your team and product.

  • A track record of driving AI adoption beyond a single team by defining success metrics, crafting governance practices, and enabling safe, scalable usage across an organization.

  • Strong technical depth and the analytical instincts to make sharp calls with incomplete information.

  • Experience leading in diverse, global, collaborative environments.

  • A Bachelor's or advanced degree in Computer Science (or equivalent experience).

  • A real sense of humor. The work is serious; we don't have to be.

Internal Opportunities

Creativity, curiosity, and constant learning are celebrated aspects of your career growth journey. We’re glad that you’re pursuing a new opportunity at Adobe!

Put your best foot forward:

1. Update your Resume/CV and Workday profile – don’t forget to include your uniquely ‘Adobe’ experiences and volunteer work.

2. Visit the Internal Mobility page on Inside Adobe to learn more about the process and set up a job alert for roles you’re interested in.

3. Check out these tips to help you prep for interviews.

4. If you are applying for a role outside of your current country, ensure you review the International Resources for Relocating Employees on Inside Adobe, including the impacts to your Benefits, AIP, Equity & Payroll. 

Once you apply for a role via Workday, the Talent Team will reach out to you within 2 weeks. If you move into the official interview process with the hiring team, make sure you inform your manager so they can champion your career growth.

At Adobe, you will be immersed in an exceptional work environment that is recognized around the world. You will also be surrounded by colleagues who are committed to helping each other grow through our unique Check-In approach where ongoing feedback flows freely. If you’re looking to make an impact, Adobe's the place for you. Discover what our employees are saying about their career experiences on the Adobe Life blog and explore the meaningful benefits we offer.

Adobe is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other applicable characteristics protected by law. Learn more.

 

Adobe aims to make Adobe.com accessible to any and all users. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation to navigate our website or complete the application process, email accommodations@adobe.com or call (408) 536-3015.

We give everyone—from emerging artists to global brands— everything they need to design and deliver exceptional digital experiences. We’re passionate about empowering people to build breathtaking and powerful images, videos, and apps, and transform how companies interact with customers across every screen.</p><p>We’re on a mission to hire the very best and are committed to crafting exceptional employee experiences where everyone is respected and has access to equal opportunity. We realize that new insights can come from everywhere in the organization, and we know the next big idea could be yours.</p><p></p><p><b>Opportunity </b></p><p></p><p>Security is foundational to Adobe’s product development and operational excellence. Our security practices are deeply embedded across our software lifecycle and are continuously refined through collaboration with global partners, leading researchers, and industry organizations. These efforts ensure Adobe remains at the forefront of threat detection, prevention, and incident response.</p><p>We are seeking a <b>Senior Director of Security India </b>to lead and expand Adobe’s global security engineering capabilities, with a strong focus on our India operations. This executive will play a critical role in shaping Adobe’s security strategy, driving innovation, and building trust with our customers by ensuring their data is protected and privacy is preserved.</p><p></p><p><b>Role Summary </b></p><p></p><p>As a Senior Director, you will be responsible for the strategic leadership and operational excellence of Adobe’s Security organization in India. You will collaborate closely with the CSO, global engineering leaders, and cross-functional partners to shape and drive enterprise-wide security initiatives, in addition to engaging externally with CTO/CIO/CISOs of our APAC customers. This role requires a visionary leader with deep technical expertise, strong people leadership, and a proven track record of influencing at the executive level.</p><p></p><p><b>What You’ll Do </b></p><ul><li><b>Strategic Leadership</b>: Define and implement the long-term vision for Adobe’s security engineering function in India, aligned with global security priorities.</li><li><b>Site Presence: </b>Continue to build the security brand and presence in India with leaders across Adobe.</li><li><b>Customer-Facing</b>: Engage with CTO/CIO/CISOs of our APAC customer to help build trust in our products, build relationships and help answer their security related questions, and in case of a security incident, quickly come up to speed to lead customer confidence calls.</li><li><b>Global Collaboration</b>: Partner with the CSO and senior leaders across engineering, legal, and cloud infrastructure to drive cohesive security strategies.</li><li><b>Operational Excellence</b>: Oversee delivery of high-impact security services, ensuring operational efficiency, scalability, and continuous improvement.</li><li><b>Innovation & Engineering</b>: Lead teams in developing innovative solutions for application security, cloud security, and cyber defense.</li><li><b>Risk Management</b>: Champion enterprise risk mitigation strategies, including threat modeling, vulnerability management, and incident response.</li><li><b>Talent Development</b>: Build and mentor a high-performing team of security engineers, researchers, and ethical hackers. Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, and inclusion.</li><li><b>Stakeholder Engagement</b>: Establish trust and influence with senior executives, internal partners, and external vendors to advance Adobe’s security posture.</li><li><b>Compliance & Governance</b>: Ensure adherence to global security standards, regulatory requirements, and internal policies.</li><li><b>Thought JOB LEVEL

M70/P70

EMPLOYEE ROLE

People Manager

Senior Director, Security India

About Us

Changing the world through digital experiences is what Adobe’s all about. We give everyone—from emerging artists to global brands— everything they need to design and deliver exceptional digital experiences. We’re passionate about empowering people to build breathtaking and powerful images, videos, and apps, and transform how companies interact with customers across every screen.

We’re on a mission to hire the very best and are committed to crafting exceptional employee experiences where everyone is respected and has access to equal opportunity. We realize that new insights can come from everywhere in the organization, and we know the next big idea could be yours.

Opportunity

Security is foundational to Adobe’s product development and operational excellence. Our security practices are deeply embedded across our software lifecycle and are continuously refined through collaboration with global partners, leading researchers, and industry organizations. These efforts ensure Adobe remains at the forefront of threat detection, prevention, and incident response.

We are seeking a Senior Director of Security India to lead and expand Adobe’s global security engineering capabilities, with a strong focus on our India operations. This executive will play a critical role in shaping Adobe’s security strategy, driving innovation, and building trust with our customers by ensuring their data is protected and privacy is preserved.

Role Summary

As a Senior Director, you will be responsible for the strategic leadership and operational excellence of Adobe’s Security organization in India. You will collaborate closely with the CSO, global engineering leaders, and cross-functional partners to shape and drive enterprise-wide security initiatives, in addition to engaging externally with CTO/CIO/CISOs of our APAC customers. This role requires a visionary leader with deep technical expertise, strong people leadership, and a proven track record of influencing at the executive level.

What You’ll Do

  • Strategic Leadership: Define and implement the long-term vision for Adobe’s security engineering function in India, aligned with global security priorities.
  • Site Presence: Continue to build the security brand and presence in India with leaders across Adobe.
  • Customer-Facing: Engage with CTO/CIO/CISOs of our APAC customer to help build trust in our products, build relationships and help answer their security related questions, and in case of a security incident, quickly come up to speed to lead customer confidence calls.
  • Global Collaboration: Partner with the CSO and senior leaders across engineering, legal, and cloud infrastructure to drive cohesive security strategies.
  • Operational Excellence: Oversee delivery of high-impact security services, ensuring operational efficiency, scalability, and continuous improvement.
  • Innovation & Engineering: Lead teams in developing innovative solutions for application security, cloud security, and cyber defense.
  • Risk Management: Champion enterprise risk mitigation strategies, including threat modeling, vulnerability management, and incident response.
  • Talent Development: Build and mentor a high-performing team of security engineers, researchers, and ethical hackers. Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, and inclusion.
  • Stakeholder Engagement: Establish trust and influence with senior executives, internal partners, and external vendors to advance Adobe’s security posture.
  • Compliance & Governance: Ensure adherence to global security standards, regulatory requirements, and internal policies.
  • Thought Leadership: Represent Adobe in industry forums, contribute to security research, and drive awareness of emerging threats and standard processes.
  • Complexity: Navigate a highly matrixed organization, building on strong partnerships across regions to shape security strategy, execution, and long-term Adobe success and reputation.

What You Need to Succeed

  • B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science, Security Engineering, or related field.
  • 15+ years of progressive experience in security engineering, including 10+ years in leadership roles with global scope.
  • Proven success leading large-scale security programs across cloud, application, and enterprise environments.
  • Deep expertise in cybersecurity frameworks, threat intelligence, and secure software development practices.
  • Strong understanding of infrastructure as code, security automation, and compliance as code.
  • Experience managing cross-functional teams, building strong partnerships across regions, influencing senior partners, and building customer relationships.
  • Recognized as an influential, innovative, and collaborative leader in the industry.
  • Certifications such as CISM, CISA, or CISSP are a plus.
  • Exceptional communication, critical thinking, and executive presence, both internally and externally.
  • Demonstrated commitment to inclusive practices.

Internal Opportunities

Creativity, curiosity, and constant learning are celebrated aspects of your career growth journey. We’re glad that you’re pursuing a new opportunity at Adobe!

Put your best foot forward:

1. Update your Resume/CV and Workday profile – don’t forget to include your uniquely ‘Adobe’ experiences and volunteer work.

2. Visit the Internal Mobility page on Inside Adobe to learn more about the process and set up a job alert for roles you’re interested in.

3. Check out these tips to help you prep for interviews.

4. If you are applying for a role outside of your current country, ensure you review the International Resources for Relocating Employees on Inside Adobe, including the impacts to your Benefits, AIP, Equity & Payroll. 

Once you apply for a role via Workday, the Talent Team will reach out to you within 2 weeks. If you move into the official interview process with the hiring team, make sure you inform your manager so they can champion your career growth.

At Adobe, you will be immersed in an exceptional work environment that is recognized around the world. You will also be surrounded by colleagues who are committed to helping each other grow through our unique Check-In approach where ongoing feedback flows freely. If you’re looking to make an impact, Adobe's the place for you. Discover what our employees are saying about their career experiences on the Adobe Life blog and explore the meaningful benefits we offer.

Adobe is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other applicable characteristics protected by law. Learn more.

 

Adobe aims to make Adobe.com accessible to any and all users. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation to navigate our website or complete the application process, email accommodations@adobe.com or call (408) 536-3015.

Job Title: Product Consultant: Adobe Learning Manager (LMS) 

 

Overview: 

As a Product Consultant for Adobe Learning Manager, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the successful implementation and integration of our LMS solution – Adobe Learning Manager for our customers during onboarding. This role involves managing complex projects, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and providing expert guidance to clients to ensure their specific needs are met. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in LMS implementation, project management, and client relationship management.  

 

What You’ll Do: 

Project Management: 

  • Lead and manage multiple LMS implementation projects simultaneously, ensuring they are delivered on time, and within scope. 

  • Develop comprehensive project plans, including timelines, milestones, and risk management. 

  • Conduct regular project status meetings with customers and internal teams to ensure alignment and address any issues promptly. 

Customer Consultation: 

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for customers during the onboarding phase, providing expert advice and support. 

  • Conduct thorough needs analysis to understand customer requirements and tailor LMS solutions to meet their specific needs. 

  • Translate complex technical information for customers, ensuring they understand and can effectively use the system. 

  • Facilitate customer training sessions and workshops to ensure successful adoption and utilization of Learning Manager. 

Technical Expertise: 

  • Implement configuration, customization, and integration of Adobe Learning Manager with other customer systems. 

  • Help customers set up SSO, Out-of-the-box and API integrations.

  • Collaborate with Product Management and Engineering teams to prioritize and resolve any roadblocks to implementation. 

 

Documentation and Reporting: 

  • Create detailed implementation documentation, including project plans, configuration guides, and training materials. 

  • Prepare regular project reports and presentations for customers and internal stakeholders. 

  • Maintain accurate records of all project activities, issues, and resolutions. 

Continuous Improvement: 

  • Stay up-to-date with the latest trends and best practices in LMS implementation and e-learning technologies. 

  • Contribute to the development and improvement of implementation methodologies and processes. 

  • Mentor and support junior implementation consultants, providing guidance and knowledge sharing. 

 

What you’ll need to succeed: 

Education:  

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Education Technology, or a related field.  

Experience: 

  • Minimum of 11 years of experience in implementing Learning Management Systems or similar SAAS-based solutions.  

  • Proven track record of managing and delivering complex projects successfully. 

  • Strong technical background with experience in system integration, data migration, and configuration. 

Skills: 

  • Strong Technical skills in the areas of SSO, API and Integrations with SAAS Products

  • Flair for AI and experience in using Gen AI is required.

  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build strong customer relationships. 

  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills. 

  • Proficiency in LMS platforms, e-learning standards (e.g., SCORM, xAPI), and related technologies. 

  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment. 

About Adobe

Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.

Our 30,000+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours. 


Let’s Adobe together

At Adobe, we believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. Learn more about Adobe life, including our values and culture, focus on people, purpose and community, Adobe for All, comprehensive benefits programs, the stories we tell, the customers we serve, and how you can help us advance our mission of empowering everyone to create.

Adobe is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Learn more.

Adobe aims to make our Careers website and recruiting process accessible to any and all users. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation to navigate our website or complete the application process, email accommodations@adobe.com or call +1 408-536-3015. 

AI Use Guidelines for Interviews:
Our interviews are designed to reflect your own skills and thinking. The use of AI or recording tools during live interviews is not permitted unless explicitly invited by the interviewer or approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation. If these tools are used inappropriately or in a way that misrepresents your work, your application may not move forward in the process.

At Adobe, we empower employees to innovate with AI — and we look for candidates eager to do the same. As part of the hiring experience, we provide clear guidance on where AI is encouraged during the process and where it’s restricted during live interviews. See how we think about AI in the hiring experience.

JOB LEVEL

P40

EMPLOYEE ROLE

Individual Contributor

Adobe is looking for a Solution Account Manager (SAM) to help customers grow, succeed, and realize measurable value from their investment in Adobe solutions. This role brings together account management and customer success, with clear ownership of maintaining revenue, renewal, and expansion.

You will partner with a defined set of customers to understand their priorities, strengthen adoption, and identify new ways Adobe can support their business. Your success will be measured by customer outcomes, long-term relationships, and steady revenue growth.

What You’ll Do

  • Manage a portfolio of accounts with responsibility for retention, renewals, and expansion revenue

  • Build positive relationships with business and technical stakeholders, including senior decision-makers

  • Create and implement account plans that connect customer goals to measurable outcomes

  • Drive product adoption and usage, helping customers realize value quickly and consistently

  • Identify, develop, and close upsell and cross-sell opportunities aligned to customer priorities

  • Lead renewal conversations early, reducing risk and improving forecast accuracy

  • Monitor account health using data and insights, and take action to improve engagement and outcomes

  • Partner with Sales, Customer Success, Consulting, Support, and Partners to deliver a consistent customer experience

  • Share customer feedback to influence product, strategy, and go-to-market decisions

  • Stay informed on industry trends and digital experience solutions to guide customer conversations

What You Bring

  • Experience in account management, customer success, or sales, leading all aspects of revenue retention and growth

  • A track record of expanding existing accounts through upsell or cross-sell

  • Ability to connect technology solutions to business outcomes

  • Confidence working with senior stakeholders and navigating complex organizations

  • Clear and effective communication skills across written, verbal, and presentation formats

  • Comfort using data to guide decisions and prioritize actions

  • Experience coordinating efforts between departments to overcome issues and deliver results

  • Familiarity with SaaS, digital marketing, or enterprise technology solutions

How You Work

  • You focus on customer outcomes and measurable impact

  • You take ownership and follow through on commitments

  • You collaborate across teams to move work forward

  • You stay curious, ask questions, and look for innovative ways to solve problems

Internal Opportunities

Creativity, curiosity, and constant learning are celebrated aspects of your career growth journey. We’re glad that you’re pursuing a new opportunity at Adobe!

Put your best foot forward:

1. Update your Resume/CV and Workday profile – don’t forget to include your uniquely ‘Adobe’ experiences and volunteer work.

2. Visit the Internal Mobility page on Inside Adobe to learn more about the process and set up a job alert for roles you’re interested in.

3. Check out these tips to help you prep for interviews.

4. If you are applying for a role outside of your current country, ensure you review the International Resources for Relocating Employees on Inside Adobe, including the impacts to your Benefits, AIP, Equity & Payroll. 

Once you apply for a role via Workday, the Talent Team will reach out to you within 2 weeks. If you move into the official interview process with the hiring team, make sure you inform your manager so they can champion your career growth.

At Adobe, you will be immersed in an exceptional work environment that is recognized around the world. You will also be surrounded by colleagues who are committed to helping each other grow through our unique Check-In approach where ongoing feedback flows freely. If you’re looking to make an impact, Adobe's the place for you. Discover what our employees are saying about their career experiences on the Adobe Life blog and explore the meaningful benefits we offer.

Adobe is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other applicable characteristics protected by law. Learn more.

 

Adobe aims to make Adobe.com accessible to any and all users. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation to navigate our website or complete the application process, email accommodations@adobe.com or call (408) 536-3015.

description_text:
Position Title: Master Trainer – Sales Capability Development

Location: Remote

Business Unit: ICX Enablement

About the Role

We are looking for a Master Trainer – Sales Capability Building to help our sellers and advisors build confidence, strengthen customer conversations, and improve business impact. In this role, you will design and deliver engaging learning experiences that help teams grow consultative selling skills, communicate value clearly, and create stronger customer relationships.

You will partner across Sales, Product Marketing, Support, and Enablement teams to create scalable programs that improve seller performance across regions and experience levels. This role combines facilitation expertise, commercial understanding, storytelling, and modern AI-enabled learning approaches.

If you are passionate about coaching people, building high-impact learning experiences, and helping teams succeed in a fast-changing technology environment, we would love to hear from you.

What You’ll Do

Design and Deliver Sales Learning Programs

  • Create and facilitate engaging instructor-led, virtual, and blended learning experiences focused on:
    • Consultative and value-based selling
    • Expansion selling and customer acquisition
    • Customer conversation excellence
    • New user growth and adoption
  • Lead interactive workshops using storytelling, simulations, role plays, and customer-based scenarios.
  • Build practical learning journeys that improve seller readiness, confidence, and execution.
  • Adapt programs for different regions, business priorities, and learner needs.

Strengthen Sales Messaging and Reinforcement

  • Coach sellers and advisors on engaging effectively with business and creative decision-makers.
  • Develop sales enablement assets including:
    • Discovery frameworks
    • Talk tracks
    • Objection-handling guides
    • Call preparation tools
  • Build reinforcement strategies that improve learning retention and field adoption.
  • Partner with frontline managers to integrate coaching into everyday workflows.

Drive AI-Enabled Learning Innovation

  • Use AI-powered tools to create personalized and adaptive learning experiences.
  • Explore innovative learning formats including simulations, conversational AI, and digital practice environments.
  • Apply learning analytics and feedback insights to improve program quality and learner outcomes.
  • Support adoption of enablement platforms, AI copilots, and modern learning technologies.

Collaborate Across Teams

  • Partner with Sales, Product Marketing, Support, and Instructional Design teams to align enablement programs with business priorities.
  • Ensure learning content reflects current Adobe solutions, customer trends, and industry insights.
  • Contribute to a culture of continuous learning, experimentation, and knowledge sharing.

What You’ll Bring

Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in sales enablement, capability building, learning and development, or sales training within the technology or SaaS industry.
  • 2+ years of customer-facing sales experience.
  • Experience facilitating engaging learning experiences for sales or customer-facing teams.
  • Experience designing scenario-based learning programs using simulations, storytelling, and role-play activities.
  • Familiarity with AI-enabled learning tools, LMS platforms, reinforcement solutions, or conversational AI technologies.

Skills

  • Strong facilitation, coaching, communication, and storytelling skills.
  • Ability to translate business value into clear and compelling customer conversations.
  • Strong collaboration and leadership management skills.
  • Comfort using learning analytics, dashboards, and performance insights to improve outcomes.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.
  • Growth mindset with curiosity about emerging learning technologies and AI-enabled enablement.

Education

  • Bachelor’s or postgraduate degree in Business Administration, Technology, Computer Applications, Strategy, Learning, or a related field.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Certifications in sales training, adult learning, AI for learning and development, digital learning, or learning analytics.
  • Experience working with global or distributed teams.

About Adobe

Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.

Our 30,000+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours. 


Let’s Adobe together

At Adobe, we believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. Learn more about Adobe life, including our values and culture, focus on people, purpose and community, Adobe for All, comprehensive benefits programs, the stories we tell, the customers we serve, and how you can help us advance our mission of empowering everyone to create.

Adobe is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Learn more.

Adobe aims to make our Careers website and recruiting process accessible to any and all users. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation to navigate our website or complete the application process, email accommodations@adobe.com or call +1 408-536-3015. 

AI Use Guidelines for Interviews:
Our interviews are designed to reflect your own skills and thinking. The use of AI or recording tools during live interviews is not permitted unless explicitly invited by the interviewer or approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation. If these tools are used inappropriately or in a way that misrepresents your work, your application may not move forward in the process.

At Adobe, we empower employees to innovate with AI — and we look for candidates eager to do the same. As part of the hiring experience, we provide clear guidance on where AI is encouraged during the process and where it’s restricted during live interviews. See how we think about AI in the hiring experience.

JOB LEVEL

P30

EMPLOYEE ROLE

Individual Contributor

P30

Job Description Summary

Develops, interprets and implements financial concepts for financial planning and control. Performs technical analysis to determine present and future financial performance. Gather, analyze, prepare and summarizes recommendations for financial plans, acquisition activity, trended future requirements and operating forecasts.

Job Description

Position Summary:

This is an exciting opportunity to join the India Shared Services Finance team as we continue to shift to drive the business through data-driven forecasts and providing influential insights. This Senior Financial Analyst position will support Mfg. COGs, Localization Mktg and headcount and expense planning. In this role, you will be responsible for a wide range of projects in support of key business decisions and fiscal deliverable. You will develop and maintain frameworks for quarterly & annual budgets, drive consolidation of in-quarter outlook forecast, analyze and report on financial data,

Responsibilities include:

  • Preparing annual/quarterly budgets and weekly/monthly forecasts for Mfg. COGs, ensuring a high level of accuracy, analyzing units / cost of sales trend, E&O inventory analysis, accruals/allocations of direct costs (Mfg.COGs), GL recon, monthly/quarterly reporting.
  • Prepare reporting for annual/quarterly budgets and weekly/monthly forecasts, ensuring a high level of headcount and expense predictability for the identified organization, review for completeness and summarize key variances
  • Prepare trended analytics for key areas such as headcount attrition, employee costs, and travel spend
  • Generate outlook and controller’s letter reporting
  • Leverage Power BI/Tableau to create and maintain centralized and common reporting and analytical solutions     
  • Drive continual process improvements, framework enhancements in support of generating meaningful data-driven insights
  • Collaborate with finance controllers/consolidators to drive fiscal deliverable, gain comprehension of variance drivers, and challenge assumptions/methodologies employed
  • Ad-hoc analysis as required, and self-initiated projects encouraged

Requirements:

  • Positive attitude and comfort in an environment subject to change as the business evolves
  • Bachelor's degree in business, finance or related field; CA/MBA preferred.
  • 10+ years of FP&A (or related) experience required, preferably with a US-based company
  • Strong analytical and accounting skills; must understand key business drivers, ability to communicate financial implications/business impact and provide recommendations with attention to detail
  • Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to take charge, set objectives, drive to results
  • Exceptional follow-through capabilities
  • Willingness and ability to quickly master new tools and processes
  • Advanced Excel skills are essential, and experience in Tableau and Anaplan are preferred. SAP and PowerPoint are also useful.

Internal Opportunities

Creativity, curiosity, and constant learning are celebrated aspects of your career growth journey. We’re glad that you’re pursuing a new opportunity at Adobe!

  • innovative solutions

  • Provide on-call support as needed to ensure system reliability and uptime.

description_text:
The Opportunity

Lead Adobe’s global in-house Social & Programmatic buying function across all regions! This role coordinates the regional pods for EMEA, driving unified execution across paid social, organic social, and programmatic channels to improve full-funnel performance.

What you'll Do

  • Manage and mentor a team of 5+ social media buyers, ensuring flawless daily campaign execution across platforms
  • Remain hands-on in-platform (Meta, TikTok, Snap, LinkedIn, etc.), supporting campaign builds, optimizations, and troubleshooting
  • Convert global strategy into regionally appropriate action plans, taking into account market nuances and platform differences
  • Coordinate campaign lifecycle: planning, setup, QA, launch, optimization, and reporting
  • Ensure strong operational rigor across tagging, tracking, pacing, and delivery
  • Monitor performance and guide optimizations across audiences, creatives, bidding strategies, and placements
  • Partner with cross-functional teams (Creative, Analytics, Marketing Ops, Programmatic teams) to ensure seamless execution
  • Leverage platform automation and AI tools to improve efficiency and performance

What you need to succeed

  • 4–6+ years of hands-on paid social experience across major platforms
  • Proven experience managing campaigns end-to-end and optimizing toward performance goals
  • Prior team leadership or mentorship experience preferred
  • Solid grasp of regional market subtleties and audience behaviors
  • Familiarity with programmatic buying concepts or DSP platforms is a plus
  • Experience with social platform automation (Smartly.IO, Sprinklr etc), AI features, or performance tools
  • Strong analytical skills and ability to translate data into actionable insights
  • Excellent organization, communication, and multitasking abilities

The opportunity

Adobe Design is hiring a Product Designer for our Document Cloud team to work on an exciting, fast-paced initiative in the education space. You'll join a multidisciplinary team designing creative tools that empower teachers and students worldwide.

You'll shape products like Adobe Acrobat, Express, Sign, and Scan, used by 700M+ monthly active users across platforms. Help us design the future of documents.

Our team has a strong legacy of innovation: recognized in TIME's Best Inventions for Liquid Mode (2023) and Acrobat's AI Assistant (2024), and named Fast Company's Most Innovative Company in Applied AI (2026) for activating PDFs with AI. If crafting intuitive experiences at this scale excites you, we'd love to hear from you.

What you'll do

  • Apply a growth mindset to experiments across acquisition, monetization, and engagement in the education space

  • Translate user needs into scalable design solutions that reach real classrooms

  • Advocate for the user by uncovering insights from feedback, research, and analytics to inform design decisions for education and learning experiences

  • Define strategy and vision for AI-first products, designing intuitive GenAI experiences that deliver step-change improvements in user workflows

  • Explore ideas through sketches, storyboards, wireframes, and interactive prototypes

  • Partner with product managers, engineers, and cross-functional teams to ship new products

What you need to succeed

  • 5+ years of product design experience with a proven track record of shipping successful products 

  • Passion for solving complex design and technology problems through systems thinking 

  • History of close collaboration with design, product, engineering, and users from ideation to launch 

  • Ability to integrate data, analytics, and user research to craft and validate solutions with measurable impact on user and business outcomes 

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex problem spaces and design strategy to stakeholders at all levels 

  • Skill in facilitating brainstorms, building compelling presentations, and pitching concepts to drive creative thinking 

  • Ability to collaborate and inform open-ended design projects that may be ambiguous or ill-defined in their early stages

description_text:
Firefly Enterprise group is building the next generation of scalable APIs and workflow solutions for Adobe’s enterprise customers.

Firefly Enterprise Video API team is looking for a passionate Machine Learning Engineer to enable and accelerate the Video APIs powered by pioneering machine learning models. In this role, you’ll collaborate closely with ML researchers, product engineers, and infrastructure teams to take ML models from experimentation to full-scale deployment, bringing groundbreaking AI experiences to our users

What You’ll Do

  • Lead the design, development, and deployment of GenAI backend services for video, building GPU‑optimized and highly efficient model pipelines.

  • Translate research innovations and prototypes into scalable, reliable ML systems across Adobe’s cloud platforms.

  • Optimize model and service performance, ensuring scalability, reliability, and robustness through continuous monitoring and iteration.

  • Enhance MLOps workflows, including CI/CD, model versioning, evaluation pipelines, and automated retraining systems.

  • Collaborate cross‑functionally with product, research, and infrastructure teams to define requirements and deliver high‑impact solutions.

  • Stay ahead of the curve, bringing the latest ML advancements into Adobe’s products—from cloud to on‑device optimizations.

What You’ll Need to Succeed

  • Master's in Computer Science, AI/ML, or related field; or B.Tech with strong, proven ML experience.

  • 8+ years of experience in AI/ML engineering, model development, or large‑scale distributed systems.

  • Strong programming skills in Python and experience with ML frameworks like PyTorch and TensorFlow.

  • Deep expertise in Generative Video AI, including diffusion, GAN, and transformer‑based models—especially in areas such as temporal consistency and multimodal generation.

  • Solid understanding of model optimization, inference efficiency, GPU acceleration, and production ML integration.

  • Demonstrated success delivering cloud‑scale, data‑driven products with broad customer adoption.

  • Strong command of AI/ML fundamentals, frameworks, and modern toolchains.

  • Excellent communication, technical leadership, and collaboration skills.

  • Experience working in a matrixed organization, driving alignment, and delivering results.

description_text:
JOB LEVEL

P40

EMPLOYEE ROLE

Individual Contributor

The Opportunity

Changing the world through digital experiences is what Adobe’s all about. We give everyone—from emerging artists to global brands—everything they need to design and deliver exceptional digital experiences. We’re passionate about empowering people to craft beautiful and powerful images, videos, and apps, and transform how companies interact with customers across every screen.

We believe that a modern design tool should be lightweight and easy to use, with low friction and amazing performance. We are reimagining the creative process powered through a highly collaborative experience that works seamlessly across multiple surfaces. We favor excellence over shortcuts, and quality over scope as we build products for the next decade and beyond. As a senior engineer on this team you would be designing and building tools and features for designers pushing the technology boundaries of what is possible on the web.

If you’re looking to be part of a team that is building the data systems and services that power the web, welcome to Creative Cloud.

What you'll do

  • Spearhead the end-to-end design, development, and deployment of data systems, from architectural planning through production rollout.
  • Develop and maintain both batch and real-time data pipelines to power key products and business initiatives.
  • Architect and refine data models to effectively support evolving business and product needs.
  • Partner with cross-functional stakeholders—including product managers, data scientists, and engineers—to build scalable solutions and enable data-informed decision-making.
  • Foster strong collaboration with backend, data science, and machine learning teams to ensure smooth integration and interoperability of data systems.
  • Help shape long-term data strategy and advance best practices in data engineering across the organization.
  • Design and develop new features and tools collaborating with other engineers, product managers, designers and user researchers.
  • Uphold high standards of quality, performance, and reliability through comprehensive monitoring, testing, and validation processes.
  • Experienced in basic analytics, data quality monitoring, experiment logging, visualization and dashboards.
  • Knowledgeable in building data pipelines for LLM workflows.
  • Hands-on experience in Prompting.
  • Experience building scalable, cloud-native services at large scale is a strong plus.
  • Grow with the support of your team, and help others on the team grow by providing thoughtful feedback and uplifting those around you.
  • Strive to build an inclusive team supporting diverse opinions.
  • Work closely with customers to understand their workflows and needs, and adapt or pivot quickly based on their feedback.
  • Be a part of a team that works like a startup inside Adobe giving you best of both worlds.

What you need to succeed

  • Based in Bangalore.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in computer science.
  • 9+ years of software development experience.
  • Knowledge of AI/ML
  • Extensive experience in designing, building, and operating distributed data platforms and streaming systems (e.g., Databricks, Kafka etc.) at a large scale.
  • Expertise in data modeling and data warehousing, with hands-on experience working with both relational and columnar databases.
  • Experience with integrating machine learning models into data systems, LLM models, & Data Science technologies
  • Strong hands-on experience developing in Javascript, Typescript, Python.
  • Hands-on experience in Node.js, Rest APIs and tools like Grafana, Splunk, Prometheus.
  • Experience with container technologies like Docker, Kubernetes and CI/CD pipeline.
  • Experience with AWS or Azure cloud services.
  • Knowledge of security concepts and protocols for services on the cloud.
  • Collaborate with backend and ML teams to integrate feature signals and optimize performance
  • An interest in and ability to learn new technologies.
  • Ability to tackle problems in a sustainable way, always striving to improve process and learn.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills; can effectively articulate complex ideas and influence others through well-reasoned explanations.

Bonus Qualifications

  • Experience developing for multiple devices and platforms.
  • Experience with monitoring tools.
  • Experience with Agile development processes.
  • A good sense of humour!

Internal Opportunities

Creativity, curiosity, and constant learning are celebrated aspects of your career growth journey. We’re glad that you’re pursuing a new opportunity at Adobe!

Put your best foot forward:

1. Update your Resume/CV and Workday profile – don’t forget to include your uniquely ‘Adobe’ experiences and volunteer work.

2. Visit the Internal Mobility page on Inside Adobe to learn more about the process and set up a job alert for roles you’re interested in.

3. Check out these tips to help you prep for interviews.

4. If you are applying for a role outside of your current country, ensure you review the International Resources for Relocating Employees on Inside Adobe, including the impacts to your Benefits, AIP, Equity & Payroll. 

Once you apply for a role via Workday, the Talent Team will reach out to you within 2 weeks. If you move into the official interview process with the hiring team, make sure you inform your manager so they can champion your career growth.

At Adobe, you will be immersed in an exceptional work environment that is recognized around the world. You will also be surrounded by colleagues who are committed to helping each other grow through our unique Check-In approach where ongoing feedback flows freely. If you’re looking to make an impact, Adobe's the place for you. Discover what our employees are saying about their career experiences on the Adobe Life blog and explore the meaningful benefits we offer.

Adobe is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other applicable characteristics protected by law. Learn more.

 

Adobe aims to make Adobe.com accessible to any and all users. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation to navigate our website or complete the application process, email accommodations@adobe.com or call (408) 536-3015.

title: Technical Consultant
description_html: <p><b>The Opportunity</b></p><p>Adobe Campaign Consultant is a technical role that requires providing Consulting advice and support to Clients for Implementing Adobe Campaign solution and any technical advisory required afterwards. This is a client-facing role and requires consultant to collaborate closely with the client, understand their technical and business requirements and then Implement Adobe Campaign solution in a manner client gets most value out of the solution. Consultant’s main objective is to drive successful delivery and maintaining a high level of satisfaction for our customer.</p><p>You will enable client success by providing innovative solutions leveraging Adobe’s Digital Marketing Suite of products. You will develop coding best practices and solutions that integrate with the client’s current online infrastructure including mobile and any third party advertising efforts. The role includes utilizing and developing best practices for integrating Digital Marketing Products with existing websites, providing support and training to other marketing specialists as needed, mentoring new Development Consultants, maintaining documentation of solutions and integrations, continuing education on new technologies and platforms that provide benefit to the Digital Marketing Suite and the implementations and delivering top notch solutions to clients.</p><p><b>What you'll Do </b></p><p>Provide Implementation consultancy, Customer Assistance and post-implementation support to Adobe Campaign clients in their deployment and use of Adobe Campaign solution. Specifically (but not limited to):</p><ul><li>Work with Clients to assess requirements</li><li>Configure & Design Adobe Campaign to meet customer business needs by understanding their database architecture and setting-up ETL and data-flows</li><li>Configure the Adobe Campaign solution to customers’ requirement including Campaigns set-ups, building web pages using Scripting</li><li>Develop customer specific solutions where necessary and document them</li><li>Proactive problem diagnosis, troubleshooting and resolution</li><li>Create Implementation plans for new and existing clients</li><li>Knowledge transfer/Training to customers on solution implemented</li><li>Product Installations, Upgrades and Configuration activities</li><li>Reporting on project delivery to Project Management and Manage projects on your own in smaller projects which don’t have dedicated Project Managers</li><li>Build great working relationship with Onshore Consulting team, Learn and Adopt best- practices from such teams globally</li><li>Work closely with the Quality Assurance team to ensure professional delivery of technical implementations</li><li>Act as a Development lead point of contact with Digital Marketing Consultants</li><li>Learn multiple Adobe Digital Marketing Solutions and provide multi-product Enablement and Integration solutions to strategic clients</li><li>Work with Digital Marketing Consultants to make recommendations in regards to Digital Marketing Suite technical implementations</li><li>Support additional team members by mentoring and teaching</li><li>Work closely with the Quality Assurance team to ensure professional delivery of Business Consulting Service to your clients</li></ul><p><b>What you need to succeed </b></p><ul><li>Expertise and Experience in SQL (Oracle / SQL Server / PostgreSQL)</li><li>Programming experience (Javascript / Java / VB / C# / PHP)</li><li>Knowledge on Web Technologies like HTML, CSS would be a plus</li><li>Good communication skills to ensure effective customer interactions, communications, and documentation</li><li>Self-starter - Organized and highly motivated</li><li>Fast learner, ability to learn new technologies/languages</li><li>Knowledge of HTML DOM manipulation and page load events a plus</li><li>Project Management skills a plus</li><li>Ability to develop creative solutions to problems</li><li>Able to multi-task in a dynamic environment</li><li>Able to work independently with minimal supervision</li><li>Experience leading team members will be a plus</li></ul><p><b>Technology Summary</b></p><p>Adobe's solutions meet the needs of a diverse customer base that spans from consumer to enterprise. The Digital Marketing Suite enables online marketing agility to enable organizations to attract new audiences, deliver targeted, relevant content, and optimize site campaigns real-time for increased click-through, conversions, and revenue. By combining Adobe's content creation tools and ubiquitous clients with Adobe's Online Marketing Suite, Adobe is well positioned to deliver solutions that can transform the future of engaging experiences and ecommerce across all digital content, platforms and devices. For designers, developers, and online marketers, an integrated workflow - with optimization capabilities embedded in the creation tools - will streamline the creation and delivery of relevant content and applications. This optimization will enable advertisers and advertising agencies, publishers, and e-tailers to realize greater ROI from their digital media investments and improve their end users' experiences.</p><p>Adobe Campaign (erstwhile Neolane) is a world-class, cross channel campaign management solution that powers marketers as they harness the intelligence of an integrated customer profile, build meaningful relationships with their customers, deliver relevant offers and messages, and orchestrate great experiences – in real-time; all through an open and flexible architecture.</p><p><b>What leading at Adobe means</b></p><p>At Adobe, we’re passionate about developing leaders at all levels of the organization from individual contributors to people managers. Anyone who’s considering a career with us should know that we evaluate leadership based on these five capabilities:</p><ul><li>Demonstrating Strong EQ (Be Aware) – Having a keen sense of self awareness is the foundation of leadership at Adobe. Whether you’re an individual contributor or a people manager, you’re someone who’s empathetic and mindful of your impact on others.</li><li>Selecting Talent (Be a Recruiter) – You’re a guardian and an ambassador for selecting talent at Adobe! You recommend and recruit only the best. You embrace diversity of ideas, experiences and working styles because you know that diverse teams drive better business results.</li><li>Role Modeling Check-In (Be a Coach) – We don’t believe in annual reviews and rankings. That’s why, feedback flows constantly at Adobe.
