The Opportunity

Adobe Campaign Consultant is a technical role that requires providing Consulting advice and support to Clients for Implementing Adobe Campaign solution and any technical advisory required afterwards. This is a client-facing role and requires consultant to collaborate closely with the client, understand their technical and business requirements and then Implement Adobe Campaign solution in a manner client gets most value out of the solution. Consultant’s main objective is to drive successful delivery and maintaining a high level of satisfaction for our customer.

You will enable client success by providing innovative solutions leveraging Adobe’s Digital Marketing Suite of products. You will develop coding best practices and solutions that integrate with the client’s current online infrastructure including mobile and any third party advertising efforts. The role includes utilizing and developing best practices for integrating Digital Marketing Products with existing websites, providing support and training to other marketing specialists as needed, mentoring new Development Consultants, maintaining documentation of solutions and integrations, continuing education on new technologies and platforms that provide benefit to the Digital Marketing Suite and the implementations and delivering top notch solutions to clients.

What you'll Do

Provide Implementation consultancy, Customer Assistance and post-implementation support to Adobe Campaign clients in their deployment and use of Adobe Campaign solution. Specifically (but not limited to):

  • Work with Clients to assess requirements
  • Configure & Design Adobe Campaign to meet customer business needs by understanding their database architecture and setting-up ETL and data-flows
  • Configure the Adobe Campaign solution to customers’ requirement including Campaigns set-ups, building web pages using Scripting
  • Develop customer specific solutions where necessary and document them
  • Proactive problem diagnosis, troubleshooting and resolution
  • Create Implementation plans for new and existing clients
  • Knowledge transfer/Training to customers on solution implemented
  • Product Installations, Upgrades and Configuration activities
  • Reporting on project delivery to Project Management and Manage projects on your own in smaller projects which don’t have dedicated Project Managers
  • Build great working relationship with Onshore Consulting team, Learn and Adopt best- practices from such teams globally
  • Work closely with the Quality Assurance team to ensure professional delivery of technical implementations
  • Act as a Development lead point of contact with Digital Marketing Consultants
  • Learn multiple Adobe Digital Marketing Solutions and provide multi-product Enablement and Integration solutions to strategic clients
  • Work with Digital Marketing Consultants to make recommendations in regards to Digital Marketing Suite technical implementations
  • Support additional team members by mentoring and teaching
  • Work closely with the Quality Assurance team to ensure professional delivery of Business Consulting Service to your clients

What you need to succeed

  • Expertise and Experience in SQL (Oracle / SQL Server / PostgreSQL)
  • Programming experience (Javascript / Java / VB / C# / PHP)
  • Knowledge on Web Technologies like HTML, CSS would be a plus
  • Good communication skills to ensure effective customer interactions, communications, and documentation
  • Self-starter - Organized and highly motivated
  • Fast learner, ability to learn new technologies/languages
  • Knowledge of HTML DOM manipulation and page load events a plus
  • Project Management skills a plus
  • Ability to develop creative solutions to problems
  • Able to multi-task in a dynamic environment
  • Able to work independently with minimal supervision
  • Experience leading team members will be a plus

Technology Summary

Adobe's solutions meet the needs of a diverse customer base that spans from consumer to enterprise. The Digital Marketing Suite enables online marketing agility to enable organizations to attract new audiences, deliver targeted, relevant content, and optimize site campaigns real-time for increased click-through, conversions, and revenue. By combining Adobe's content creation tools and ubiquitous clients with Adobe's Online Marketing Suite, Adobe is well positioned to deliver solutions that can transform the future of engaging experiences and ecommerce across all digital content, platforms and devices. For designers, developers, and online marketers, an integrated workflow - with optimization capabilities embedded in the creation tools - will streamline the creation and delivery of relevant content and applications. This optimization will enable advertisers and advertising agencies, publishers, and e-tailers to realize greater ROI from their digital media investments and improve their end users' experiences.

Adobe Campaign (erstwhile Neolane) is a world-class, cross channel campaign management solution that powers marketers as they harness the intelligence of an integrated customer profile, build meaningful relationships with their customers, deliver relevant offers and messages, and orchestrate great experiences – in real-time; all through an open and flexible architecture.

What leading at Adobe means

At Adobe, we’re passionate about developing leaders at all levels of the organization from individual contributors to people managers. Anyone who’s considering a career with us should know that we evaluate leadership based on these five capabilities:

  • Demonstrating Strong EQ (Be Aware) – Having a keen sense of self awareness is the foundation of leadership at Adobe. Whether you’re an individual contributor or a people manager, you’re someone who’s empathetic and mindful of your impact on others.
  • Selecting Talent (Be a Recruiter) – You’re a guardian and an ambassador for selecting talent at Adobe! You recommend and recruit only the best. You embrace diversity of ideas, experiences and working styles because you know that diverse teams drive better business results.
  • Role Modeling Check-In (Be a Coach) – We don’t believe in annual reviews and rankings. That’s why, feedback flows constantly at Adobe. To succeed, you’ll meet frequently with your manager to receive ongoing feedback, set challenging performance expectations, and pursue continuous development opportunities.
  • Leading change (Be an Agent of Change) – You readily adapt to business changes. Ambiguity or uncertainty never seems to stop you from working productively. You’re maniacally focused on execution and you’re always looking at new approaches to resolving issues.
  • Scaling the Business (Be an Owner) – You approach your role as if you own the business. The buck stops with you. Your goal is to always deliver an exceptional customer experience by listening to feedback and continuously looking to improve efficiencies.

Get to know the team

The Digital Marketing team is focused on building the Adobe Marketing Cloud. With the Adobe Marketing Cloud, marketers have a complete set of analytics, social, advertising, targeting, web experience, and cross-channel campaign management solutions and a real- time dashboard that brings together everything they need to know about their marketing campaigns. Marketers can get from data to insights to action, faster and smarter than ever, and deliver the ideal experience to every customer, every time.

With Adobe’s rich heritage in content creation tools, Adobe is uniquely positioned to deliver an integrated workflow from content creation to monetization. Ultimately, designers, developers, marketers, advertisers, and publishers benefit from a streamlined workflow with analytics and optimization capabilities embedded into the creation tools, enabling the delivery of the right content to the right audience at the right time, regardless of the channel.

See what our employees have to say about their careers on the Engineering teams at Adobe in this video.

More reasons why Adobe life is the good life

  • Skip those awful “performance reviews.”
  • Work in a place that cultivates great leaders throughout the organization. A place that understands that product innovation comes from people innovation.
  • Feed your brain and grow your skills with our educational assistance program.
  • Take off for a four-week sabbatical after five years of employment. (As in “don’t even check your email the whole time.”)
  • Give to your favorite cause each year, and we’ll match your charitable donation
  • Enjoy serious discounts on the Adobe software that will make friends jealous.
  • Those “best places to work” lists love us (in multiple countries), here’s why.
  • Put your mind at ease with our health and welfare benefits, industry-competitive salary, and more.
  • The work is awesome. The people are awesome. We think there’s no better place to make an impact. See what our employees are sharing about Adobe life.

At Adobe, you will be immersed in an exceptional work environment that is recognized throughout the world on Best Companies lists. You will also be surrounded by colleagues who are committed to helping each other grow through our unique Check-In approach where ongoing feedback flows freely.

If you’re looking to make an impact, Adobe's the place for you. Discover what our employees are saying about their career experiences on the Adobe Life blog and explore the meaningful benefits we offer.

Adobe is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome and encourage diversity in the workplace regardless of gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or veteran status.

About Adobe

Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.

Our 30,000+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours. 


Let’s Adobe together

At Adobe, we believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. Learn more about Adobe life, including our values and culture, focus on people, purpose and community, Adobe for All, comprehensive benefits programs, the stories we tell, the customers we serve, and how you can help us advance our mission of empowering everyone to create.

Adobe is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Learn more.

Adobe aims to make our Careers website and recruiting process accessible to any and all users. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation to navigate our website or complete the application process, email accommodations@adobe.com or call +1 408-536-3015. 

AI Use Guidelines for Interviews:
Our interviews are designed to reflect your own skills and thinking. The use of AI or recording tools during live interviews is not permitted unless explicitly invited by the interviewer or approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation. If these tools are used inappropriately or in a way that misrepresents your work, your application may not move forward in the process.

At Adobe, we empower employees to innovate with AI — and we look for candidates eager to do the same. As part of the hiring experience, we provide clear guidance on where AI is encouraged during the process and where it’s restricted during live interviews. See how we think about AI in the hiring experience.

This role is crucial in driving revenue growth through strategic cross-sell and upsell initiatives. The incumbent would be responsible for helping the customers adopt the solution with ease, optimizing their product experience and guiding them to internal support teams if need be. This role entails nurturing and co-selling with partners where a rep. will be responsible for the entire gambit of account management like Strategic Account planning, Client Need assessment, building connects strategies with multiple stakeholders, conducting extensive account reviews, driving growth through cross-selling / upselling, and building long-term relationships. KPIs for this role will be maximizing Net ARR by growing Gross and mitigating Cancels.

What you’ll do as an Account Manager

• Plays a critical role in developing and managing relationships with large customers from the ICX-Reseller book of business.

• Build Connects and nurture strong relationships with managers and decision-makers in these large accounts. Expand business relationships beyond IT and Procurement into the C-Suite. You will need to map target org at departmental level to succeed in this role.

• Drive revenue growth by identifying upsell and cross-sell opportunities. You would be responsible for driving Net ARR from the allocated customers for the various Digital Media solutions.

• One of the key measurement metrics will be how well a rep can reach out to the large book of business, building connections and engagements.

• Account manager’s primary goal will be to understand Customer’s business needs / pain points on document workflows & creative content creation, offer solutions, and foster long-term partnerships that drive business growth.

• Managing the opportunity pipeline from week to week, providing accurate and timely updates to management on progress and outlook. As an Account manager, you will be responsible and measured on how well you are executing on the key products such as Acrobat, Acrobat AI, Express, Acrobat Sign

• Research customer contracts and purchasing history in Adobe's various customer management systems & external sources such as LinkedIn, ZoomInfo, etc. to figure out the expansion opportunity in an account.

•Devise customized connect strategy based on the account plan.

•Identify the segments that have a high propensity for Adobe’s solutions and then plan customer outreach and meetings.

•Sell into multiple levels of an organization, performing outbound prospecting to existing customers to identify new business relationships.

•Engage customers daily via Teams / Video calls to conducting extensive account reviews.

•During the account review understand clients' strategic goals, challenges, and pain points, and propose tailored solutions to address them. Develop and execute strategic account plans that align with clients' business objectives.

•Lead negotiations and pricing discussions to achieve mutually beneficial outcomes.

•You will serve as a trusted advisor ensuring the successful deployment of products.

•Address any issues or concerns promptly to maintain positive client relationships.

•Stay informed about industry trends, regulatory changes, and the competitive landscape of Document / Creative domain. Provide clients with valuable insights and thought leadership on industry best practices.

•Collaborate with Solution Specialists to maximize footprint of growing Adobe Solution streams like Adobe Acrobat & Sign, Creative Cloud, Substance, Stock etc.

•Act as the voice of the client within the organization, representing their interests and needs.

What you need to succeed

•MM/Enterprise Segment exposure and proven ability to manage a large customer set.

•3 + Years’ experience in a similar role, with experience in selling SAAS solutions preferred.

•Proven track record leading a matrixed organization to sell SAAS solutions and the ability to expand influence on multiple stakeholders in the customer environment

•Ability to forge and maintain strong business relationships from IT to the C-Suite.

•Excellent communication and presentation skills and capable of presenting with any person, at any level within a customer.

•Proven experience of using quantitative and qualitative analysis to identify new sales opportunities.

•Should have skills that clearly demonstrate the ability to manage accounts and sell solutions.

•Flair for technology and ability to lead a customer conversation with value-selling rather than product features pitch.

•Ability to independently give basic product demos to customers.

•International Sales Experience with exposure to NA markets preferably. •Working hours will coincide with the US Time Zones

•Bachelor’s Degree or Equivalent

  • Manage multiple competing projects or tasks independently, effectively balancing work between critical short term issues with longer term strategic goals.

description_text:
The Opportunity

Adobe Researchers are developing the next generation of advanced technologies and user experiences, inventing a future where Adobe enables new forms of creativity, frees people from routine tasks, and allows enterprises to understand and act quickly on customer and business insights. Our research labs are actively published in leading journals and conferences, work with product teams on high profile features, and explore new product opportunities across various domains. We are especially interested in fostering ongoing collaborations that last beyond the internship and become part of your PhD thesis.

Adobe Research focuses on the following research areas:

  • Content Intelligence

  • AI & Machine Learning

  • Computer Graphics (2D&3D)

  • Data Intelligence

  • Computer Vision, Imaging & Video

  • Audio

  • Systems and Languages

  • Natural Language Processing

  • Human Computer Interaction

  • AR, VR & 360 Photography

  • Document Intelligence

  • Intelligent Agents & Assistants

What you will do

Under the direction of an Adobe Research mentor, you will:

  • Pursue a research problem to apply to Adobe’s products and with the possibility of academic publication

  • Develop new algorithms, run experiments, and produce demonstration prototypes

  • Document and present your work, both verbally and in writing

What you will need

  • Current PhD student in computer science, or related field

  • Sufficient research skills and background in your chosen subject area

  • Strong communication skills and teamwork experience

  • Passion for solving real-world problems with web-scale data using and inventing innovative Machine Learning algorithms.

About Adobe

Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.

Our 30,000+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours.

At Adobe, we believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. Learn more about Adobe life, including our values and culture, focus on people, purpose and community, Adobe for All, comprehensive benefits programs, the stories we tell, the customers we serve, and how you can help us advance our mission of empowering everyone to create.

Adobe is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Learn more.

Our interviews are designed to reflect your own skills and thinking. The use of AI or recording tools during live interviews is not permitted unless explicitly invited by the interviewer or approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation. title: Strategic Partnerships & Alliances
description_html: <p></p><p><b>About the Role</b></p><p>We are seeking a highly strategic and operationally driven Strategic Partner Program Lead to design, launch, and scale our strategic partner ecosystem. This role will serve as the primary owner of partner strategy, partner operations, and relationship management across technology alliances, global system integrators (GSIs), resellers, co-sell partners, and contingent staffing vendors.</p><p>The ideal candidate brings a strong combination of ecosystem strategy, commercial acumen, program management discipline, and executive relationship management. You will work cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Marketing, HR, Procurement, Legal, Finance, and Operations to build scalable partner programs that drive measurable business growth, accelerate product adoption, improve workforce flexibility, and optimize partner investment ROI.</p><p></p><p><b>Key Responsibilities</b></p><p><b>Partner Strategy & Program Design</b></p><ul><li>Define and evolve the company’s strategic partner program framework including partner tiers, engagement models, governance structures, and performance benchmarks.</li><li>Develop scalable onboarding, enablement, and certification pathways for partners.</li><li>dentify strategic partnership opportunities aligned with company growth priorities and product roadmap.</li><li>Conduct competitive and market analysis description_text:
About the Role

We are seeking a highly strategic and operationally driven Strategic Partner Program Lead to design, launch, and scale our strategic partner ecosystem. This role will serve as the primary owner of partner strategy, partner operations, and relationship management across technology alliances, global system integrators (GSIs), resellers, co-sell partners, and contingent staffing vendors.

The ideal candidate brings a strong combination of ecosystem strategy, commercial acumen, program management discipline, and executive relationship management. You will work cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Marketing, HR, Procurement, Legal, Finance, and Operations to build scalable partner programs that drive measurable business growth, accelerate product adoption, improve workforce flexibility, and optimize partner investment ROI.

Key Responsibilities

Partner Strategy & Program Design

  • Define and evolve the company’s strategic partner program framework including partner tiers, engagement models, governance structures, and performance benchmarks.
  • Develop scalable onboarding, enablement, and certification pathways for partners.
  • dentify strategic partnership opportunities aligned with company growth priorities and product roadmap.
  • Conduct competitive and market analysis to strengthen ecosystem positioning.

Partner Relationship Management

  • Manage strategic partnerships across the full lifecycle including prospecting, negotiation, onboarding, and expansion.
  • Build executive-level relationships with partner stakeholders.
  • Lead Executive Business Reviews (EBRs).
  • Negotiate partnership agreements, and commercial terms.

Contingent Staffing Partner Management

  • Manage partnerships with contingent staffing vendors and MSPs.
  • Govern preferred supplier lists (PSLs) and contingent workforce compliance.
  • Negotiate rate cards, SLAs, and staffing vendor agreements.
  • Track contingent workforce KPIs including fill rates, time-to-fill, and supplier performance.

Partner Cost & Resource Management

  • Develop partner cost models and ROI measurement frameworks.
  • Manage partner budgets, spend forecasting, and financial governance.
  • Conduct spend analytics and optimize resource allocation across partner programs.
  • Negotiate co-investment and cost-sharing arrangements with strategic partners.

Program Operations & Analytics

  • Maintain partner operational infrastructure including CRM hygiene and contract repositories.
  • Define and monitor partner KPI frameworks.
  • Deliver executive reporting on partner program health, ROI, and strategic recommendations.
  • Drive operational improvements and scalable partner processes.

Qualifications

Required

  • 10+ years of experience in partner management, strategic alliances, ecosystem development, or related functions.
  • Proven track record building and scaling B2B partner programs with measurable revenue impact.
  • Strong commercial negotiation and stakeholder management capabilities.
  • Experience managing contingent workforce vendors and staffing partnerships.
  • Strong analytical, operational, and financial management skills.
  • Excellent executive communication and presentation skills.
  • Proficiency with CRM, PRM, VMS, and partner management platforms.
  • Ability to operate effectively in fast-paced and ambiguous environments.

Preferred

  • Experience in SaaS, cloud infrastructure, AI/data, or enterprise software ecosystems.
  • Knowledge of product-led growth (PLG) and partner-led acquisition models.
  • Familiarity with MDF, rebates, deal registration, and partner incentive programs.
  • MBA or equivalent advanced degree.
  • Experience in high-growth or product-development environments.

Core Competencies

  • Relationship Builder
  • Strategic Thinker
  • Data-Driven Operator
  • Program Leader
  • Executive Communicator
  • Ecosystem Mindset

About Adobe

Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.

  • Architect Content Supply Chain solutions connecting work management platforms to content creation, approval, publishing, and analytics systems
  • Guide customers through pre and post-sales, translating complex integration needs into scalable, business-ready solutions
  • Drive data migration from legacy client tools and systems as part of broader implementation engagements
  • Collaborate with and influence delivery, pre-sales, and project teams on technical direction across engagements

  • 10+ years in software development with 8+ years in client-facing integration or implementation consulting
  • Hands-on experience with work management platforms (Workfront, Asana, Monday.com, or similar) and IPaaS tools (MuleSoft, Dell Boomi, Workfront Fusion, or similar)
  • Practical AI experience including agentic frameworks (LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen), LLM APIs, prompt engineering, and multi-agent orchestration
  • Background in Content Supply Chain, Martech, or digital marketing operations

Job Description

Knowledge & Skills:

  • Exhibits a high degree of autonomy, is determined, and should be a go-getter with the ability to multitask and stay on top of a lot of things simultaneously

  • Excellent verbal, presentation, and written communication skills.

  • Have a good understanding of Gen AI tech stack.

  • Leads by example. Sets high standards & communicates expectations of high achievement to others.

  • Establishes credibility with peers and senior managers and is a driving force for change across the organization.

  • Ability to tie team objectives back to the broader organizational objectives and goals.

  • Should have good knowledge of a software product development lifecycle. 

  • Knowledge of agile development techniques and project management tools.

  • Strong conflict resolution and negotiation skills.

  • Ability to communicate in a geographically distributed environment with diverse collaborators and to operate in ambiguous situations while bringing clarity.

Some Key Responsibilities:

  • Coordinate all aspects of the business for development and release of technologies, products, features & functions in the organisation.

  • Build the project schedule, including putting together the framework and identifying dependencies—negotiating with 3rd parties/internal teams. 

  • Understand and assess critical paths and dependencies for delivering and shipping products / services and facilitate discussions between product/client teams, product management and engineering. 

  • Effectively negotiate, persuade and motivate extended project teams & senior management across BUs, provide justifiable proposals and recommendations, and clearly outline courses of action to follow.

  • Assess future challenges on projects and initiatives and mobilize immediate and extended team members to take action, proactively addressing issues. 

  • Initiate, develop and effectively completes plans for change (new process, tool, etc) across multiple teams.

  • Identify, track, monitor and communicate project-related issues, scope changes, variances and contingencies arising during project implementation.

Our Company:

At Adobe, we’re changing the world. How? We give people the tools to bring their ideas to life and create content that makes life more fun and work more meaningful. We give businesses and organizations the power to engage their customers truly. We're the ones behind the gorgeously designed content that streams across your laptop, TV, phone, and tablet every day—and we’re the ones who harness the massive power of big data to help companies move from data to insight and insight to action by delivering content that people crave most.

We’re a company that understands that product innovation comes from people innovation, and that’s why we invest in cultivating leaders throughout the organization. If you’re passionate about leading from where you sit, join us and structures to make performance sustainable. Your mission is to deliver an exceptional customer experience by promoting shared goals and driving accountability.

Job Description Summary

Ensures that the customer is satisfied with company projects and services. Works closely with Sales Account Manager and oversees day-to-day relationship with client. Ensures that schedules and budgets are met according to contractual agreements. Works with client to cultivate future projects and qualify new opportunities. Consults with other team members (project management/services/support/customer care) to be sure mutual objectives are met.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a Techno-functional Customer Success Manager to join our team. Adobe Learning Manager is Adobe’s Learning Management System (LMS), and we are looking for passionate learning technology professionals who will work with our customers to help them derive the best use of the LMS.

In this position, you will be a trusted advisor, working with customers to fine-tune their learning and development strategies and ensure their success. You will partner with the customer through their lifecycle and work to develop and grow the account.

To succeed, you will need a proven ability to: candidates who desire to make an impact in the learning & development and technology domain to join our team based out of Bengaluru, India.

In this role, you will: 

In this role, you will be responsible to: 

• Provide consulting services in the domains of learning design and technologies. 

• Manage client relationships – especially working remotely to assess client maturity and satisfaction. 

• Interact with a broad level of client contacts – from Learning Managers to CLOs and Directors 

• Present complex technical & functional information in a clear manner, both written and verbal 

• Manage multiple customers (and engagements) concurrently. 

• Identify growth opportunities – identify opportunities to both upsell & cross-sell on your accounts. 

What You'll Do 

In this role, you will be responsible to: 

• Customer Relationship Management: Building and maintaining strong relationships with customers, understanding their needs, and ensuring their satisfaction with the product & services. 

• Technical Expertise: Demonstrating a deep understanding of the product and its technical aspects, including API integration use cases, understanding customer use cases, and recommending solutions. 

• Product Adoption: Assisting customers in effectively implementing and adopting the product, ensuring they achieve their desired outcomes and maximizing the value they derive from it. 

• Business Acumen: Having a strong understanding of the customer's business goals, challenges, and industry trends and leveraging that knowledge to provide strategic guidance and align the product with their objectives. 

• Product Feedback and Enhancement: Gathering customer feedback, analyzing trends, and providing valuable insights to the product development team to drive continuous improvement and enhance the product's features and functionality. 

• Renewals and Expansion: Managing the renewal process by engaging with customers to ensure contract renewals. Identifying opportunities for upselling and cross-selling products or additional features to existing customers, working closely with the sales team to drive revenue growth, and advocating for the product's value proposition. 

• Proficiency in delivering seamless presentations for Strategic Business Reviews (SBRs), conducting Training sessions, product demos covering API offerings, and sharing Best Practices with new and existing customers. 

What you need to succeed 

To be successful in this role, you will possess: 

• A combined 7-10 years in the domain of learning technologies to consult with additional responsibilities in sales/post-sales and solution consulting. 

• Ability to develop deep product and technical ecosystem knowledge. 

• A deep understanding of the eLearning market and experience administering LMS’ or managing L&D programs will be a bonus. 

• A strong empathy for customers AND passion for revenue and growth 

• Strong leadership skills with proven ability to influence inside and outside of the organization. 

• An ability to manage or influence through persuasion, negotiation, and consensus building. 

• A detail-focused way of thinking supported by excellent communication and presentation skills.  

• A Bachelor’s degree or a master’s degree or equivalent experience in business management, engineering, or relevant fields.  

• A minimum of 3-4 years of demonstrated exceptional customer management. 

At Adobe, you will be immersed in an exceptional work environment that is recognized throughout the world on Best Companies lists. You will also be surrounded by colleagues who are committed to helping each other grow through our unique Check-In approach where ongoing feedback flows freely. If you’re looking to make an impact, Adobe's the place for you. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

Category Manager – Cross Border Trade

Location: Mumbai, India

About eBay

eBay Inc. is a global commerce leader connecting millions of buyers and sellers across 190 markets around the world. Our mission is to create economic opportunity for individuals, entrepreneurs, businesses, and organizations of all sizes.

At eBay, we are reinventing the future of global commerce empowering people to buy, sell, connect, and thrive across borders. We foster a culture driven by curiosity, innovation, inclusion, and impact, where bold ideas and diverse perspectives are valued.

If you’re passionate about building scalable businesses and driving meaningful impact at a global level, eBay offers the opportunity to do work that matters.

About the Team

The Emerging Markets team drives eBay’s cross-border trade business across more than 170 countries. The team is located across different countries and helps our sellers connect their unique inventory with over 134 million buyers globally.

Our team plays a pivotal role in accelerating category growth, enabling seller success, and expanding eBay’s global marketplace footprint.

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly driven and strategic Category Manager to lead growth initiatives across key categories within eBay’s Cross Border Trade business.

In this role, you will own category performance end-to-end including business growth, seller ecosystem development, assortment expansion, and strategic execution. You will work closely with enterprise sellers, partners, and cross-functional teams to unlock new opportunities and scale category performance globally.

The ideal candidate is a proactive self-starter with strong business acumen, analytical rigor, and stakeholder management skills, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment.

Key Responsibilities

Category & Business Management

  • Own the end-to-end business performance and growth strategy for assigned categories, including GMV, seller growth, and key business metrics
  • Define and execute category strategies covering selection expansion, pricing, promotions, and seller experience
  • Identify emerging market trends, competitive insights, and whitespace opportunities to drive sustainable growth;
  • Identify, onboard, and scale high-potential sellers and strategic partners within the cross-border ecosystem; Build and manage strong relationships with enterprise sellers, brands, and marketplace partners
  • Partner closely with Product, Marketing, Analytics, Operations, and Seller Success teams to deliver category growth initiatives
  • Leverage data and business insights to measure impact, identify opportunities, and improve decision-making

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in Category Management, Business Development, Consulting, or E-commerce/Marketplace environments
  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Business, Economics, Marketing, or a related field; MBA preferred
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with experience using data to drive business decisions
  • Proven track record of building and scaling businesses, categories, or seller ecosystems
  • Experience managing enterprise seller or strategic partner relationships
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and influencing skills
  • Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with strong ownership and execution focus
  • Understanding of cross-border trade and global e-commerce ecosystems is a plus
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint

Commercial Teammate (MSO Reactive) supports large merchants, high value/potential and/or new sellers with their day to day operational issues by phone/chat and email, working with the relevant key partners (e.g. Business Unit, Trust team) closely to help sellers’ maintain their standards and healthy selling practices.
Providing a timely resolution as well as maintaining a positive relationship with the account management group. This teammate will be the primary point of contact for AM’s and proactively connect with sellers either via phone or emails to help resolve their issues.
Responsibilities
 
  • Handle day to day reactive issues with customers email and chat channel.
  • Outreach could be phone
  • Complete assigned tasks and responsibilities in a timely and efficient manner
  • Collaborate with other team members to achieve business goals and contribute to initiatives to help improve team performance and processes.
  • Meet and exceed the turnaround time and quality of delivery as per the specified target, have an eye for details.
  • Work as per defined processes and SLA – outlook issue process
  • Act as a trusted advisor to sellers and account managers on defect review/removal, eMBG case review/auctioning, technical issues, product issues, and standards and policy related issues that can hamper sales growth.
  • Resolve issues for merchants of any eBay specific impediment to growth and sales (including defect reviews/removal, eMBG case review/action, technical issues, standards and policy related issues)
  • Coach merchants so that issues and policies do not impede their business in future and help them develop a proactive approach to avoidance (as opposed to resolution after the fact). Including adoption of eBay tools and/or standard processes
  • Interact with internal partners, advisors, policy makers and technical teams to assist with speedy resolution
  • Establish a trusting relationship between eBay and the customer while maintaining a high level of detail and accuracy
  • Share timely findings with the Account Manager and key stakeholder.
  • Share learning with team in daily huddles for exciting/unique issue/query worked.
  • Be empathetic to customer concerns and display a candid desire to serve with ownership through to resolution
  • At times, use negotiation and influence to advocate on behalf of eBay and/or the customer
  • Summarize and provide customer feedback to management
  • Conduct Outreach activities (outbound phone and/or email) including but not limited to – Outreach to customers with product/policy information/education/rollout– Outreach to customers to drive sustainable business growth for high quality sellers and help to maintain a healthy top seller community. E.g. coach customers in regard to policies that may impede progress on their account or result in selling restriction, support to correct listing that are in violation, share best practices to avoid violations etc.
  • Handle escalated complicated cases
Qualification & Skills required: -
 
  • Graduation is Mandatory
  • Demonstrate strong probing and problem solving skills
  • Skilled in multi-tasking, including the ability to be flexible and adapt to changes quickly
  • Expert knowledge of MS Office especially PPT and Excel.
  • Data interpretation and Quality insight understanding is an added advantage to succeed in this role.
  • Ability to work well in a team environment and collaborate effectively with others.
  • Excellent time management, strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Self-starter with a positive attitude.
  • Ability to remain professional at all times.
  • 3+ years of experience in customer service/ecommerce/handling email or chat services

Additional Details

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

About eBay

Looking for a company that inspires passion, courage and imagination, where you can be part of the team sculpting the future of global commerce? Want to shape how millions of people buy, sell, connect, and share around the world? If you’re passionate about joining a purpose driven community that is dedicated to creating an ambitious & rewarding environment with a work culture that’s been genuinely committed to diversity & inclusion since its founding more than 20 years ago, join eBay – A company you can be proud to be a part of! Here, you can just be yourself, do your best work, and have an important impact on people across the globe.

eBay Inc (NASDAQ: EBAY) is a global commerce leader including the Marketplace, and Classifieds platforms. Founded in 1995 in San Jose, California, eBay is one of the world’s largest and most vibrant marketplaces for discovering great value and unique selection.

The vision for eBay is to become the trusted, ubiquitous platform for global commerce, built by the best technology team in the industry, powering compelling multi-screen experiences, core marketplace capabilities, powerful insights, and the next generation commerce ecosystem. eBay delivers a personalized shopping experience and seamless access to inventory from down the street and around the world. With over 170 million active buyers, 300+million app downloads, and more than a Billion listings at any given time, we are one of the world’s largest online marketplaces, connecting people with the things they love virtually anytime, anywhere.

Role Overview

The Monetisation team is responsible for maximising long-term value creation for the company across buyers, sellers and partners. As Monetisation Manager, you will be an integral part of this team and will work on some of the largest and most complex elements of eBay’s business strategy, contributing to its financial performance (top and bottom line) and defining the relationships eBay has with its customers and partners representing the firm’s largest source of competitive advantage.



 

This role will report into Senior Manager, Vertical Monetization & New Revenue Strategy, and will support the team in leading eBay’s monetization strategy related to innovative revenue models and pricing and promotion plans to support key verticals to drive growth. You will need to operate cross-functionally in the day-to-day workings with various teams including product, engineering, finance, marketing, analytics and customer service while at the global level it will be essential to collaborate effectively with the other major markets (across North America, Europe and Australia) to execute global initiatives 

Key Job Responsibilities

  • Partner closely with Product and Engineering teams to design, test, and launch new fee and monetization capabilities, informed by end-to-end buyer and seller journeys

  • Analyze and optimize existing fee structures as a core monetization lever by developing more granular pricing points and elasticity-driven recommendations

  • Build and apply pricing models (elasticity, pricing impact analysis, demand forecasting) to inform rate card changes and promotional strategies

  • Deliver actionable insights using quantitative and qualitative data to evaluate pricing performance, campaign effectiveness, and competitive dynamics

  • Develop data-backed recommendations on pricing activities, including rate card updates and promotions, based on customer needs, product features, and market benchmarks

  • Collaborate with global stakeholders to communicate insights clearly and support execution of pricing and monetization initiatives

  • Identify and scope high-impact opportunities for pricing and monetization product enhancements through structured analysis and experimentation

  • Support growth of priority categories through tailored buyer- and seller-side monetization strategies, including promotions, incentives, and targeted levers

Skills & Qualifications:

Ideal candidates will have had exposure to a pricing role at some point in their career and would need to demonstrate versatility in their career.

 

  • 5+ years of experience across pricing, product, finance, or adjacent roles, with demonstrated depth in pricing and monetization problem-solving

  • Experience in marketplace businesses strongly preferred; alternatively, experience in retail or marketing-driven environments with C2C and B2C pricing exposure

  • Background in revenue management and pricing of services, including experience supporting or owning fee and rate card design

  • Proven ability to own key metrics, independently drive analysis, and deliver outcomes on complex, cross-functional initiatives

  • Strong analytical capabilities with hands-on proficiency in Excel, and presentation tools (PowerPoint or Google Slides)

  • Solid understanding of pricing analytics, elasticity concepts, fee structures, discounts, and incentive mechanisms

  • Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, global, cross-functional environment with evolving priorities

  • Comfortable working through ambiguity, applying structured thinking to loosely defined problems

  • Clear, concise communicator with the ability to influence stakeholders through data-backed insights and storytelling

  • Strong attention to detail and ability to integrate analytical rigor with commercial judgment, balancing customer experience and business impact

Role Terms:

  • Expected Start Date: April 2026

  • Location: The role will be in a hybrid mode and the candidate needs to be based out of eBay’s Bengaluru office

Additional requirements: Flexibility is required to attend telephone or video conference meetings in late evenings during some days of the week with global partners.

Additional Details

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

About eBay

Looking for a company that inspires passion, courage and imagination, where you can be part of the team sculpting the future of global commerce? Want to shape how millions of people buy, sell, connect, and share around the world? If you’re passionate about joining a purpose driven community that is dedicated to creating an ambitious & rewarding environment with a work culture that’s been genuinely committed to diversity & inclusion since its founding more than 20 years ago, join eBay – A company you can be proud to be a part of! Here, you can just be yourself, do your best work, and have an important impact on people across the globe.

eBay Inc (NASDAQ: EBAY) is a global commerce leader including the Marketplace, and Classifieds platforms. Founded in 1995 in San Jose, California, eBay is one of the world’s largest and most vibrant marketplaces for discovering great value and unique selection.

The vision for eBay is to become the trusted, ubiquitous platform for global commerce, built by the best technology team in the industry, powering compelling multi-screen experiences, core marketplace capabilities, powerful insights, and the next generation commerce ecosystem. eBay delivers a personalized shopping experience and seamless access to inventory from down the street and around the world. With over 170 million active buyers, 300+million app downloads, and more than a Billion listings at any given time, we are one of the world’s largest online marketplaces, connecting people with the things they love virtually anytime, anywhere.

Role Overview

The Monetisation team is responsible for maximising long-term value creation for the company across buyers, sellers and partners. As Senior Pricing and Promotions Analyst, you will be an integral part of this team and will work on innovating and executing some of the most impactful and complex elements monetization levers of eBay’s business strategy, contributing to its financial performance (top and bottom line) and defining the relationships eBay has with its customers and partners representing the firm’s largest source of competitive advantage.

This role will report into Senior Manager, C2C Monetization, and will support the team in a range of Monetisation domains, including implementing pricing rate card changes and promotions, managing ad-hoc campaigns as well as supporting competitive analyses and driving insights for any future fee optimisation. As a member of our monetisation team, you will be responsible for the flawless execution of programmes and initiatives, by working cross-functionally across with product, engineering, finance, marketing, analytics and customer service as well as regional Monetization teams.

Key Job Responsibilities

  • Partner closely with Product and Engineering teams to set up, test, and launch new fee and monetization capabilities, informed by end-to-end buyer and seller journeys

  • Own setup and QA for promotions and price changes in pricing tools; implement rigorous controls, anomaly detection, and rollback plans.

  • Own Pricing & Promotion Operations activities.

  • Support execution of special pricing deals via CRM (Salesforce) tools.

  • Deliver actionable insights using quantitative and qualitative data to evaluate pricing performance, campaign effectiveness, and competitive dynamics

  • Analyse experiments (A/B, pre-post etc) for pricing and incentive changes; establish guardrails and advise on campaign effectiveness

  • Support growth of priority categories through tailored buyer- and seller-side monetization strategies, including promotions, incentives, and targeted levers

  • Analyzing competitors and industry trends to inform strategic decisions, optimize processes, and drive business performance.

Skills & Qualifications:

Ideal candidates will have had exposure to a pricing role at some point in their career and would need to demonstrate versatility in their career.

 

  • 3+ years of experience across pricing, product, finance, or adjacent roles, with demonstrated depth in pricing and monetization problem-solving

  • Experience in marketplace businesses strongly preferred; alternatively, experience in retail or marketing-driven environments with C2C and B2C pricing exposure

  • Proficiency in tools SQL, data wrangling at scale (Spark/Hive) and exposure to enterprise seller incentives and CRM-driven pricing workflows

  • Strong analytical capabilities with hands-on proficiency in Excel, and presentation tools (PowerPoint or Google Slides)

  • Strong attention to detail and ability to integrate analytical rigor with commercial judgment, balancing customer experience and business impact

  • Solid understanding fee structures, discounts, and incentive mechanisms

  • Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, global, cross-functional environment with evolving priorities

  • Comfortable working through ambiguity, applying structured thinking to loosely defined problems

  • Clear, concise communicator with the ability to influence stakeholders through data-backed insights and storytelling

Role Terms

  • Expected Start Date: April 2026

  • Location: The role will be in a hybrid mode and the candidate needs to be based out of eBay’s Bengaluru office

Additional requirements: Flexibility is required to attend telephone or video conference meetings in late evenings during some days of the week with global partners.

Additional Details

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.

 

We use cookies to enhance your experience and may use AI tools for administrative tasks in the hiring process. To learn how we handle your personal data and use AI responsibly, please visit our Talent Privacy Notice, Privacy Center, and AI Hiring Guidelines.

Competitive Analytics Manager
eBay Inc. is a global commerce leader that connects millions of buyers and sellers around the world. We exist to enable economic opportunity for individuals, entrepreneurs, businesses, and organizations of all sizes. eBay Marketplaces operates in 190 markets worldwide.
Are you looking for a company that inspires passion, courage, and imagination—where you can help shape the future of global commerce? Do you want to influence how millions of people buy, sell, connect, and share? If you’re interested in joining a purpose-driven community dedicated to building an ambitious and inclusive workplace, join eBay—a company you can be proud to be part of.
________________________________________

About the Team

The Global Competitive Strategy & Insights team delivers high-impact insights that guide eBay’s senior leadership as they navigate an increasingly dynamic commerce landscape. The team partners closely with global verticals, horizontal initiative teams, and functional leaders to identify opportunities, assess competitive dynamics, and inform enterprise-level strategic decisions that shape eBay’s growth trajectory.

We connect market data, trends, competitive intelligence, and analytics into actionable strategies that help leadership accelerate growth, sharpen eBay’s competitive position, and make informed investment decisions.
________________________________________

About the Role

The Competitive Analytics Manager plays a critical role within the Global Competitive Strategy & Insights team. This role drives high-quality competitive analytics, builds scalable dashboards and models, and actively contributes to the team’s AI-enabled transformation.

This role partners closely with US-based team members and stakeholders, providing analytical leadership, operational support, and execution excellence across time zones. The ideal candidate is technically strong, highly collaborative, intellectually curious, and motivated to automate and scale how competitive insights are generated and delivered.
________________________________________
Key Responsibilities

Own Competitive Analytics & Reporting

  • Build, maintain, and enhance dashboards tracking inventory, GMV, supply-demand metrics, market growth, and share trends.
  • Develop and maintain competitive benchmarking across focus categories, initiatives, triangulating vendor data and external intelligence.
  • Monitor market and competitor metrics and proactively surface meaningful insights to US-based team members and leadership.
  • Contribute to monthly and quarterly reporting cycles and strategy deck development.

Partner Closely with Team & Stakeholders

  • Serve as a key analytical partner to US-based Competitive Strategy team members, supporting ongoing projects and strategic initiatives.
  • Provide timely analytical support aligned with PST working hours through partial overlap.
  • Translate business questions into structured analytical approaches and deliverables.
  • Proactively communicate progress, risks, and updates to ensure seamless collaboration across geographies.
  • Step into ad hoc and fast-turn requests to support priorities.

Leverage AI & Automation in Daily Workflows

  • Proactively explore and implement AI solutions (e.g., ChatGPT, Gemini, eBay internal AI tools) to improve speed, accuracy, and depth of analysis.
  • Support the development and deployment of AI agents and automated workflows for competitive insights.
  • Continuously identify opportunities to reduce manual work and increase efficiency through automation.

Data Integration & Pipeline Collaboration

  • Collect and integrate vendor data into scalable, interactive visualizations and models.
  • Partner with Data Engineering to automate vendor data pipelines and improve data reliability.
  • Manage vendor relationships, scope data requirements, and ensure timely and accurate data feeds.

Drive Operational Excellence

  • Take ownership of improving data gathering, validation, and visualization processes to enhance efficiency and accuracy.
  • Provide technical guidance to team members on data feasibility, methodology, and timelines.
  • Identify scalability challenges and propose technical or workflow solutions.
  • Maintain strong attention to detail and high standards of execution.

Requirements

  • 6+ years of experience in Data Analytics or Data Science roles.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Analytics, Data Science, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field.
  • Expert proficiency in SQL, Tableau, Excel. Strong proficiency in PowerPoint. Python is a plus.
  • Experience working with large, multi-source datasets and solving scalability challenges through technical solutions.
  • Strong understanding of AI applications in analytics workflows.
  • Experience working in a global/onshore-offshore team model with regular collaboration across time zones.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to support US-based team members remotely.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience integrating vendor and third-party datasets.
  • Exposure to AI agent building, prompt engineering, or workflow automation frameworks.
  • Experience in eCommerce, marketplaces, or competitive intelligence environments.

Success in the Role

  • Seamless collaboration and strong partnership with US-based team members.
  • Consistent delivery of accurate, high-impact competitive reporting.
  • Demonstrated proactive adoption of AI and automation tools.
  • Reduced manual effort through workflow improvements and tooling enhancements.
  • Trusted execution partner who enables the broader team to move faster.

Additional Details

We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

Competitive Analytics Senior Analyst
eBay Inc. is a global commerce leader that connects millions of buyers and sellers around the world. We exist to enable economic opportunity for individuals, entrepreneurs, businesses, and organizations of all sizes. eBay Marketplaces operates in 190 markets worldwide.
Are you looking for a company that inspires passion, courage, and imagination—where you can help shape the future of global commerce? Do you want to influence how millions of people buy, sell, connect, and share? If you’re interested in joining a purpose-driven community dedicated to building an ambitious and inclusive workplace, join eBay—a company you can be proud to be part of.
________________________________________

About the Team

The Global Competitive Strategy & Insights team delivers high-impact insights that guide eBay’s senior leadership as they navigate an increasingly dynamic commerce landscape. The team partners closely with global verticals, horizontal initiative teams, and functional leaders to identify opportunities, assess competitive dynamics, and inform enterprise-level strategic decisions that shape eBay’s growth trajectory.

We connect market data, trends, competitive intelligence, and analytics into actionable strategies that help leadership accelerate growth, sharpen eBay’s competitive position, and make informed investment decisions.
________________________________________

About the Role

The Senior Analyst – Competitive Analytics & AI Insights is a key contributor within the Global Competitive Strategy & Insights team. This role drives high-quality competitive analysis, builds scalable dashboards and models, and actively contributes to the team’s AI-enabled transformation.

This role partners closely with US-based team members and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver timely, accurate, and actionable insights. The ideal candidate is technically strong, detail-oriented, intellectually curious, and motivated to leverage AI and automation to improve analytics efficiency.

Key Responsibilities

Deliver Competitive Analytics & Reporting

  • Build, maintain, and enhance dashboards tracking inventory, GMV, supply-demand metrics, market growth, and share trends.
  • Develop and maintain competitive benchmarking models across focus categories and horizontal initiatives using vendor data and external intelligence.
  • Deliver clear, executive-ready analyses with thoughtful commentary on key drivers, trends, and risks.
  • Monitor business metrics and proactively surface actionable insights.

Partner Closely with US Team & Stakeholders

  • Collaborate with US-based team members to support ongoing strategic initiatives and reporting needs.
  • Provide timely analytical support aligned with PST working hours through partial overlap.
  • Translate business questions into structured analyses and deliverables.
  • Communicate progress, timelines, and potential risks clearly and proactively.

Apply AI & Automation in Analytics

  • Proactively leverage AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Gemini, eBay internal AI tools) to improve speed, accuracy, and insight generation.
  • Support automation initiatives by identifying repetitive workflows that can be streamlined.
  • Continuously explore new tools and techniques to enhance productivity and insight quality.

Data Integration & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Collect and integrate vendor data into interactive visualizations and scalable models.
  • Partner with Data Engineering team to improve data reliability and pipeline efficiency.
  • Support vendor relationship management and data requirement scoping.
  • Contribute to monthly and quarterly reporting cycles and strategy deck development.

Operational Excellence

  • Ensure high accuracy, strong attention to detail, and timely delivery of outputs.
  • Identify opportunities to improve processes, enhance data quality, and increase efficiency.
  • Support ad hoc analyses and deep dives aligned with team priorities.

Requirements

  • 4–7 years of experience in Data Analytics, Data Science, or related analytical roles.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Analytics, Data Science, Computer Science, Economics, or a related quantitative field.
  • Strong proficiency in SQL, Tableau, Excel, and PowerPoint; Python is a plus.
  • Experience working with large datasets and building dashboards/models from scratch.
  • Strong understanding of how AI tools can be applied to analytics workflows.
  • Experience working in cross-functional or global team environments preferred.
  • Strong analytical thinking, communication skills, and attention to detail.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience integrating vendor and third-party datasets.
  • Exposure to automation tools, scripting, or AI-enabled workflows.
  • Experience in eCommerce, marketplaces, or competitive intelligence.

Success in the Role

  • Consistently delivers accurate, insightful, and executive-ready analyses.
  • Proactively applies AI tools to improve productivity and insight quality.
  • Builds trust with US-based stakeholders through reliable execution.
  • Identifies opportunities for automation and process improvement.

Additional Details

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.

 

We use cookies to enhance your experience and may use AI tools for administrative tasks in the hiring process. To learn how we handle your personal data and use AI responsibly, please visit our Talent Privacy Notice, Privacy Center, and AI Hiring Guidelines.

We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

About eBay

eBay Inc. is a global commerce leader that connects millions of buyers and sellers around the world. We exist to enable economic opportunity for individuals, entrepreneurs, businesses, and organizations of all sizes. eBay Marketplaces operates in 190 markets worldwide.

Are you looking for a company that inspires passion, courage, and imagination—where you can help shape the future of global commerce? Join eBay and help influence how millions of people buy, sell, connect, and share.

About the Team

The Global Competitive Strategy & Insights team delivers high-impact insights that guide eBay’s senior leadership in navigating a dynamic commerce landscape. We connect market data, trends, and competitive intelligence into actionable strategies that shape enterprise-level strategic decisions.

As the team evolves, we are investing in scalable data infrastructure and automation to significantly enhance how competitive insights are generated and delivered.

About the Role

The Competitive Data Engineering & Analytics Manager is a hybrid role that combines strong data engineering ownership with advanced analytics execution. This role is responsible for building and scaling end-to-end data pipelines, integrating third-party/vendor data into eBay’s data ecosystem, and enabling reliable, automated, and self-serve analytics.

In addition to owning data infrastructure, this role drives competitive analytics, builds dashboards, and accelerates the team’s AI-enabled transformation through automation and tooling.

The ideal candidate is equally comfortable designing data pipelines and delivering business insights, with a strong bias toward automation, scalability, and system thinking.

Key Responsibilities

Own Data Engineering & Pipeline Development

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines to ingest, transform, and integrate third-party/vendor datasets into the data warehouse.
  • Establish robust ETL/ELT frameworks to ensure data quality, reliability, and timeliness
  • Partner with Data Engineering teams to optimize data models, storage, and compute efficiency.
  • Define data schemas, validation checks, and monitoring systems to ensure high data integrity.
  • Reduce manual data handling by building automated ingestion and transformation workflows.

Lead Data Integration & Vendor Data Strategy

  • Own end-to-end onboarding of external/vendor data sources—from scoping requirements to pipeline deployment.
  • Manage vendor relationships and ensure consistent, high-quality data delivery.
  • Standardize and unify disparate data sources into a coherent and scalable data model.

Build Scalable Reporting & Visualization

  • Develop automated dashboards and reporting layers using Tableau (or similar BI tools).
  • Enable self-serve analytics by creating reusable data models and semantic layers.
  • Improve performance and usability of dashboards through optimization and standardization.

Leverage AI & Automation

  • Implement AI-driven workflows (e.g., LLMs, internal tools) to automate data processing, analysis, and reporting.
  • Build and deploy automated pipelines and agents for competitive intelligence generation.
  • Continuously identify opportunities to reduce manual work and improve efficiency.

Partner with Stakeholders

  • Collaborate across time zones with strong communication and execution discipline.
  • Support both long-term strategic projects and fast-turn ad hoc requests.

Drive Operational Excellence

  • Identify scalability bottlenecks and propose technical solutions.
  • Establish best practices for data governance, pipeline reliability, and analytics workflows.
  • Provide technical guidance on feasibility, timelines, and data methodologies.

Requirements

  • 6+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Data Analytics, or hybrid roles.
  • Strong proficiency in SQL, and good knowledge of Python and experience building data pipelines.
  • Experience working with data warehouses.
  • Experience ingesting and integrating third-party/vendor datasets.
  • Hands-on experience with BI tools such as Tableau.
  • Strong understanding of data modeling, ETL/ELT processes, and data quality management
  • Experience automating workflows and improving data scalability.
  • Familiarity with AI/ML or LLM-based tools in analytics workflows.
  • Strong communication skills and experience working in global teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in eCommerce, marketplaces, or competitive intelligence domains.
  • Experience building data platforms or reusable analytics frameworks.
  • Exposure to AI agents, prompt engineering, or automation frameworks.

Success in the Role

  • Successfully builds and scales reliable data pipelines for external data ingestion.
  • Enables automated, self-serve competitive analytics across the organization.
  • Reduces manual effort through strong automation and system design.

Additional Details

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible.
