description_text:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

We are seeking a Data Scientist to help build the future of AI-powered selling experiences. In this role, you will partner closely with Product and Engineering teams to develop analytics, experimentation strategies, and data-driven insights that simplify listing flow, improve listing quality, and accelerate seller growth.

You will work on high-impact initiatives such as AI-assisted listing flows, personalized seller guidance, LLM-powered insights, and scalable experimentation frameworks that directly influence product roadmap and business outcomes. This role is ideal for a strong senior data scientist who can independently own analytics workstreams, apply structured thinking to ambiguous problems, and translate data into actionable recommendations that improve both user experience and business performance.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and analyze A/B tests to evaluate product features and AI-powered experiences

  • Define success metrics, measurement frameworks, and experimentation strategies to support product development and launches

  • Analyze user behavior, product funnels, and engagement patterns to find opportunities to improve seller activation, efficiency, and success

  • Partner closely with Product and Engineering teams to inform roadmap prioritization, feature design, and iteration decisions

  • Conduct deep-dive analyses to understand performance across seller segments, categories, and product workflows

  • Build scalable data pipelines, dashboards, and monitoring tools to track product performance and experimentation results

  • Find opportunities to use AI and advanced analytics to improve seller experience and product effectiveness

  • Translate complex analyses into clear, actionable insights and recommendations for technical and non-technical partners

  • Improve analytics workflows and tooling to increase insights velocity, scalability, and impact

  • Ensure data quality, tracking integrity, and measurement reliability to support accurate experimentation and decision-making

Required Qualifications

  • Master’s degree or equivalent in Data Science, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field

  • Master's + 4-7 years or 6-9 years of professional experience in product analytics, data science, or a related analytical role

  • Strong SQL skills and experience working with large-scale, complex datasets

  • Hands-on experience designing, executing, and analyzing A/B tests

  • Solid foundation in statistics, experimentation, modeling and causal inference

  • Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, and structured reasoning skills

  • Experience partnering cross-functionally with Product and Engineering teams

  • Ability to independently own analyses and translate data into actionable product insights

  • Strong communication skills with the ability to influence both technical and non-technical stakeholders

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working on marketplace, e-commerce platforms or large-scale technology products

  • Experience with AI-powered product features or LLM/GenAI 

  • Experience building scalable analytics tools, data models, or experimentation frameworks

Why Join This Team

You will play a key role in shaping the future of AI-powered selling at eBay. Your work will directly influence product strategy, accelerate innovation, and improve the experience for millions of sellers worldwide. You will operate at the intersection of analytics, product, and AI—solving high-impact problems and helping drive marketplace growth through data-driven decision-making.

Additional Details

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.

 

We use cookies to enhance your experience and may use AI tools for administrative tasks in the hiring process. To learn how we handle your personal data and use AI responsibly, please visit our Talent Privacy Notice, Privacy Center, and AI Hiring Guidelines.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

Role: Senior Manager, Data Science & Analytics – Search Product Analytics Lead

Overview

We are seeking a Senior Manager / Lead Data Scientist to own the Search Product Analytics function at eBay. In this role, you will partner closely with the Search product and engineering teams, using eBay’s vast data ecosystem to uncover insights, influence the Search roadmap, and drive customer-centric innovation across our marketplace.

You will manage a team of data scientists, champion experimentation excellence, and develop analytics strategy for one of eBay’s most critical user experiences — Search. This role combines hands-on analytics depth, strategic impact, and leadership responsibility.

Key Responsibilities

1. Strategic Analytics Leadership

  • Serve as the analytics leader for eBay’s Search product, setting the vision for data-driven decision-making and influencing long-term strategy.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, and Business collaborators to define success metrics, establish analytical frameworks, and guide prioritization.
  • Lead the end-to-end analytics roadmap for Search — from opportunity sizing and hypothesis generation to measurement, experimentation, and impact evaluation.

2. Experimentation & Measurement

  • Develop, implement, and interpret A/B tests and causal inference studies to evaluate new Search experiences, ranking models, and personalization algorithms.
  • Translate complex analytical outcomes into clear, actionable insights for non-technical audiences.
  • Promote standard processes in experimental design, metric definition, and statistical rigor across teams.

3. Team Leadership & Development

  • Lead, mentor, and grow a high-performing analytics team; develop career paths and champion a culture of curiosity, rigor, and impact.
  • Partner with recruiting and analytics leadership to attract and retain top analytical talent.
  • Provide coaching and technical mentorship to ensure consistent analytic quality and scalability across projects.

4. Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Act as the analytics link between Search, Personalization, Ads, and Buyer Experience teams to ensure well-rounded understanding of user intent and behavior.
  • Drive alignment across product areas, ensuring consistent measurement standards and shared findings.
  • Advocate for data democratization by building intuitive reporting, self-serve tools, and metric documentation.

5. Operational & Execution Excellence

  • Evaluate feature and experiment performance, ensuring decisions are rooted in robust data analysis.
  • Enable rapid insight generation through automation and scalable experimentation pipelines.
  • Continuously improve analytical workflows and frameworks for speed and reliability.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 8+ years of experience in product analytics, data science, or experimentation roles; 2+ years leading analytics teams.
  • Strong command of A/B testing design, causal inference, and experimentation measurement.
  • Deep expertise in SQL, Python/R, and data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau).
  • Strong foundation in statistics, machine learning fundamentals, and data-driven hypothesis testing.
  • Proven record of delivering insights that drive measurable business and product impact.
  • Able to translate data into actionable narratives and influence senior executives.
  • Known to work in highly matrixed, cross-functional environments.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Advanced degree or equivalent experience in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, etc.).
  • Experience in Search, Ranking, or Personalization analytics within e-commerce or digital marketplaces.
  • Familiarity with big data platforms, experimentation frameworks, and LLM/AI tools
  • Experience building or influencing data and metric infrastructure for large-scale experimentation systems.
  • Strong presentation and partner management skills, with ability to influence at VP+ levels.

What You’ll Gain

  • Opportunity to shape the future of eBay’s Search experience, a core pillar of buyer engagement.
  • High visibility and ownership over analytics strategy for one of eBay’s most data-rich domains.
  • An environment that encourages innovation, curiosity, and technical excellence.

Please see the Talent Privacy Notice for information regarding how eBay handles your personal data collected when you use the eBay Careers website or apply for a job with eBay.

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.

Recommendations are a core part of how our buyers navigate eBay’s vast and varied inventory. Our team develops innovative state-of-the-art recommendations systems, including deep learning based retrieval systems for personalized recommendations, machine learned ranking models, GenAI/LLM powered recommendations, as well as sophisticated MLOps in a high volume traffic industrial setting.</span></b></p><p></p><p><b><span>We are building cutting edge recommender systems powered by the latest ML, NLP, LLM/GenAI/RAG and AI technologies! We are looking for a top-tier applied researcher who can lead and drive forward our research in personalization, with the business goal of enabling personalized discovery of eBay unique inventory through dynamic feeds, both for eBay enthusiasts as well as first time visitors.</span></b></p><p></p><p><b><span>The scope of research includes but is not limited to sophisticated ML models for personalized recall and ranking that uses very large-scale attention models, graph neural networks, few-shot learning, and other techniques to better model factors relevant to people’s interests, cohort memberships, and trends. description_text:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

About the team and the role: 

Our Recommendations team works on delivering recommendations at scale and in near real time to our buyers on our eBay e-commerce marketplace website and native app platforms. Recommendations are a core part of how our buyers navigate eBay’s vast and varied inventory. Our team develops innovative state-of-the-art recommendations systems, including deep learning based retrieval systems for personalized recommendations, machine learned ranking models, GenAI/LLM powered recommendations, as well as sophisticated MLOps in a high volume traffic industrial setting.

We are building cutting edge recommender systems powered by the latest ML, NLP, LLM/GenAI/RAG and AI technologies! We are looking for a top-tier applied researcher who can lead and drive forward our research in personalization, with the business goal of enabling personalized discovery of eBay unique inventory through dynamic feeds, both for eBay enthusiasts as well as first time visitors.

The scope of research includes but is not limited to sophisticated ML models for personalized recall and ranking that uses very large-scale attention models, graph neural networks, few-shot learning, and other techniques to better model factors relevant to people’s interests, cohort memberships, and trends. Also in scope are deep user understanding, advanced user embeddings, interpretable user models, and interest graphs - both global and personal. Furthermore, we are looking to expand into video recommendations as well as live commerce, so this is an exciting new area for us to explore.

What you will accomplish:

  • Work with unique and large data sets of unstructured multimodal data representing eBay's vast and varied inventory, including billions of items and millions of users

  • Develop and deploy innovative AI models to production which have direct measurable impact on eBay buyers, working with a global team of applied researchers and ML engineers

  • Drive marketplace GMB as well as advertising revenue via organic and sponsored recommendations

  • Publish research work in Tier 1 conferences as well as write IP and tech blogs

What you will bring:

  • BS in Computer Science or related area with 5+ years of relevant work experience in Machine Learning / AI / NLP / LLM. MS or PhD preferred

  • Experience with building personalized recommender systems or other forms of personalization technology

  • Python and PyTorch framework

  • Hands on engineering skills to build and deploy ML models in production on prem or using cloud services

  • Experience in Java/Scala is a plus

  • Experience with big data pipelines (Hadoop, Spark) is a plus

  • Experience with Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt engineering, and GenAI coding assistants is a plus

Links to some of our previous work:

  • Tech Blog 2025 (Multimodal GenAI)

  • Tech Blog 2025 (GenAI Agentic Platform)

  • RecSys 2024 Workshop paper

  • Google Cloud Blog 2024

  • eBay Tech Blog 2023

  • eBay Tech Blog 2022

  • RecSys 2021 paper

Please see the Talent Privacy Notice for information regarding how eBay handles your personal data collected when you use the eBay Careers website or apply for a job with eBay.

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.

description_text:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

Analytics is undergoing a fundamental shift, from traditional data science toward AI-driven analytics product development. As business intelligence evolves into intelligent, AI-powered tooling, we are looking for someone eager to help lead this transformation.

This role sits at the intersection of analytics, product, and AI. You will play a key part in reimagining our Business Intelligence ecosystem as a suite of AI-native applications, stepping into the role of an AI Analytics Product Manager.

We are building toward a future where business and product teams can diagnose performance, uncover insights, and take action through AI-enabled experiences. If you’re motivated to move beyond analysis into productizing intelligence and want to shape how eBay interacts with data in the AI era, this is an opportunity to be at the forefront of that journey.

About the role

Join us to design and operate the data and intelligence layer that powers agentic analytics — AI systems developed by the Data Science Analytics org that turn questions into grounded, actionable insights. You’ll focus less on generic API plumbing and more on data quality, explainability, and analytical correctness. Your work ensures every answer is traceable to its data source, statistically sound, and interpretable by both humans and machines. You’ll design pipelines that retrieve, validate, and summarize data — transforming raw facts into narratives that drive decisions across eBay.

What you’ll do

  • Build data intelligence services: design FastAPI endpoints that expose metrics, diagnostics, and insights as composable analytical functions.

  • Operationalize data access: connect to warehouses and lakes, generate efficient SQL or DuckDB queries, and design Parquet pipelines that surface clean, ready-to-analyze data.

  • Enable analytical reasoning: support retrieval-augmented generation and grounding so that every AI-produced statement can be backed by verifiable numbers, tables, or queries.

  • Improve insight reliability: define schemas, metadata, and lineage that make it clear where data came from, how it was transformed, and what assumptions were applied.

  • Measure analytical performance: instrument pipelines with metrics for latency, cost, freshness, accuracy, and coverage; define thresholds that balance insight quality with compute efficiency.

  • Partner across disciplines: work with data scientists, AI developers and Analytics Product Managers to implement analytics products.

  • Ensure compliance and governance: implement privacy-aware joins, role-based access, and redaction of PII while maintaining analytical reproducibility.

Must-have

  • 3+ years building analytics pipelines, APIs, backend-for-frontend and insight-serving systems.

  • Deep understanding of SQL, data modeling, query optimization, and columnar formats (Parquet, DuckDB).

  • Experience turning analytical logic (diagnostics, KPIs, A/B metrics) into reusable services or models.

  • Familiarity with LLM/agent integrations for analytics (structured tool calls, grounded outputs).

  • Strong observability mindset — tracking data freshness, success rates, and cost per insight.

  • Commitment to data accuracy, reproducibility, and explainability.

Nice to have

  • Background in applied AI, data science Analytics, BI, or experimentation platforms.

  • Exposure to LLM prompt optimization and human evaluation.

  • Experience in software deployment (e.g. Kubernetes).

Success looks like

Analytical agents return accurate, well-cited insights that analysts trust. Every metric and narrative is explainable, reproducible, and performant — meeting SLAs for latency and accuracy without sacrificing interpretability.

Additional Details

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.

 

We use cookies to enhance your experience and may use AI tools for administrative tasks in the hiring process. To learn how we handle your personal data and use AI responsibly, please visit our Talent Privacy Notice, Privacy Center, and AI Hiring Guidelines.

description_text:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

We are looking for a highly motivated security engineer to join eBay's Global Information Security team to take on the problems of tomorrow while continuing to build and secure the foundation of today.  The Application Security team ensures all eBay products are secured via optimized security processes and solutions. 

The Application Security team is dedicated to securing all eBay products through the implementation of optimized security solutions and processes.

We need a hands-on Security Engineer to research, craft, and implement capabilities and defenses to secure and protect eBay's critical infrastructure.

 

What you will accomplish

  • Secure eBay through security attacks reduction by implementing foundational product security fixes

  • Perform regular security assessments that include threat modeling or architectural design reviews of AI systems and applications that might be developed in-house or sourced externally

  • Strong familiarity with AI/ML, LLM concepts, implementations and their security implications

  • Own processes for continuously fine-tuning security rules and processes for efficient detection and mitigation

  • Experience with working in the Security / Risk / Fraud space to build end-end security solutions to reduce monetary losses due to security loopholes and fraud

  • Develops scalable security management tools and processes

  • Collaborate with peer InfoSec teams in security incident investigations, and driving security charter across organization

  • Knowledge of integration of security automation solutions with systems like GitHub and Open Source Security solutions is a plus

  • Review security findings/violations reports and coordinate remediation efforts 

  • Build automated test suites for common application (OWASP10) vulnerabilities

What you will bring

  • BS degree or an MS degree in Computer Science or Information Security or closed related fields with appropriate years of experience; We prefer 6-8 years of hands-on experience.

  • 5+ years Application Security experience; or 5+ years Software Engineering experience including some Application Security experience

  • Hands-on development experience in Node.js or Java languages 

  • Good understanding of OWASP top 10 vulnerabilities, as it relates to secure product development including AI/ML and LLM technologies

  • Experience in containers, container orchestration technologies like Docker, Kubernetes is preferred

  • Hands-on experience with Web Application Firewalls and Bot Management solutions is a plus 

  • Experience with monitoring and reporting with large scale data technologies such as Kibana, Elastic Search, Hadoop and similar technologies is a plus

  • Self-starter and Effective communicator

  • Ability to build automation tools for security processes for web applications

  • Ability to multi-task and thrive in a small team in a fast-paced environment

  • Ability to deep-dive into data and analyze for security and fraud anomalies.

  • Ability to clearly articulate issues and communicate to leadership and partner teams in an effective and personable manner

Additional Details

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.

 

We use cookies to enhance your experience and may use AI tools for administrative tasks in the hiring process. To learn how we handle your personal data and use AI responsibly, please visit our Talent Privacy Notice, Privacy Center, and AI Hiring Guidelines.

  • Implement CI/CD Processes: Integrate and maintain continuous integration and continuous deployment pipelines to ensure efficient development and deployment workflows.

  • Collaborate with Teams: Work with cross-functional teams to integrate networking solutions and learn from senior engineers.

  • Contribute to Open-Source Projects: Participate in projects to keep eBay at the forefront of technology.

Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or related fields.

  • Experience: 5 years in networking and traffic management.

  • Technical Skills: Proficiency in C++ and Go, Kubernetes, Kubernetes CNI, and IPAM management.

  • Soft Skills: Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.

Preferred Skills

  • Familiarity with Envoy for traffic management.

  • Contributions to open-source projects.

  • Relevant certifications and experience in medium-scale environments.

  • Experience in Agile methodologies.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary and benefits.

  • Professional growth and advancement opportunities.

  • Access to the latest tools and technologies.

Application Process

Interested candidates should submit their resume and a cover letter highlighting their suitability for this position through the given application link. eBay is an Equal Opportunity Employer, valuing diversity within its workforce.

This position is ideal for candidates with a solid background in networking and traffic management, looking to grow and innovate within a collaborative and tech-driven environment.

description_text:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

Want to help change the future of retail? Are you looking for a unique and visible role shaping Compliance policy at eBay?

Fast-paced, dynamic, and proactive, eBay’s Compliance team is dedicated to making eBay a safe and compliant platform for the millions of buyers and sellers who make up the eBay community. 

Key Compliance team initiatives at eBay involve accurate detection and enforcement of content which is in violation of eBay policy (and applicable law). The Compliance team is committed to maintaining and enhancing eBay as a safe and reliable marketplace for our hundreds of millions of customers worldwide. The team focuses on continuously improving the customer experience to ensure it remains the most secure global marketplace.

As a Data Scientist in the Compliance team you will work directly with the Compliance business unit (and partner teams - Product, Engineering, Design) to identify opportunities, assess impacts, and integrate insights into operational strategies. Your role will involve using predictive analytics to guide marketplace decisions, ensuring that solutions align with organizational goals while adapting to changing market and economic conditions. Additionally, you will develop the overall infrastructure and operational strategy to achieve measurable impact and scalability across the Compliance organization's focus areas.
 

Responsibilities:

  • Drive Strategic Insights: Apply strategic, operational, and analytics processes to secure agreement for long-term solutions, influencing leaders across the Compliance organization and fostering a culture of achieving goals.

  • Analyze & Identify Opportunities: Conduct analysis of key issues to identify significant opportunities for improving customer experience for buyers and sellers on the platform.

  • Define & Monitor Metrics: Develop Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to track the experience of users on the platform. Monitor these metrics to understand the underlying causes of metric movements.

  • Accountability & Results: Define business objectives and measure progress in achieving results. Commit to goals and lead complex projects focused on enhancing customer experience, and delivering top- and bottom-line results for eBay.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with leaders in Compliance, Product Management, Engineering, and Design to integrate insights into operational strategies.

To be successful in this role:

  • Educational Background & Experience: Bachelor's degree with 3+ years (or Masters/PhD with 1+ years) of relevant experience across at least two areas like Quantitative Research, Analytics, or Data Science.

  • Data Analysis Expertise: Skilled in recognizing trends and implications within data to support informed decision-making.

  • Technical Skills: Proficiency in programming (Python/R) and data querying (SQL).

  • Problem-Solving: Strong creativity in solving problems.

  • Execution & Results: Proven ability to deliver results in challenging situations.

  • Customer Advocacy: Experience in acting as the voice of the customer, synthesizing diverse views to achieve alignment.

  • Communication with Leaders: Ability to convey insights drawn from data to senior-level executives.

Additionally, the following background and experience is helpful:

  • Prior experience marketplace Compliance

  • Ability to present complex analyses and insights effectively in simple terms.

  • Experience in a leading technology company.

  • Background in e-commerce product.

  • Experience with Natural Language Processing or LLM/GenAI is a plus.

Additional Details

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.

 

We use cookies to enhance your experience and may use AI tools for administrative tasks in the hiring process. To learn how we handle your personal data and use AI responsibly, please visit our Talent Privacy Notice, Privacy Center, and AI Hiring Guidelines.

Your role will involve using predictive analytics to guide marketplace decisions, ensuring that solutions align with organizational goals while adapting to changing market and economic conditions. Additionally, you will develop the overall infrastructure and operational strategy to achieve measurable impact and scalability across the Compliance organization's focus areas.
 

Responsibilities:

  • Drive Strategic Insights: Apply strategic, operational, and analytics processes to secure agreement for long-term solutions, influencing leaders across the Compliance organization and fostering a culture of achieving goals.

  • Analyze & Identify Opportunities: Conduct analysis of key issues to identify significant opportunities for improving customer experience for buyers and sellers on the platform.

  • Define & Monitor Metrics: Develop Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to track the experience of users on the platform. Monitor these metrics to understand the underlying causes of metric movements.

  • Accountability & Results: Define business objectives and measure progress in achieving results. Commit to goals and lead complex projects focused on enhancing customer experience, and delivering top- and bottom-line results for eBay.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with leaders in Compliance, Product Management, Engineering, and Design to integrate insights into operational strategies.

To be successful in this role:

  • Educational Background & Experience: BA/BS degree with 5+ years (or Masters/PhD with 3+ years) of relevant experience across at least two areas like Quantitative Research, Analytics, or Data Science.

  • Data Analysis Expertise: Skilled in recognizing trends and implications within data to support informed decision-making.

  • Technical Skills: Proficiency in programming (Python/R) and data querying (SQL).

  • Problem-Solving: Strong creativity in solving problems.

  • Execution & Results: Proven ability to deliver results in challenging situations.

  • Customer Advocacy: Experience in acting as the voice of the customer, synthesizing diverse views to achieve alignment.
    Communication with Leaders: Ability to convey insights drawn from data to senior-level executives.

  • Availability: Flexible and capable of working remotely across multiple time zones. Regular availability is required for meetings between 9:00 AM and 12:00 PM (PDT).

Additionally, the following background and experience is helpful:

  • Prior experience marketplace Compliance

  • Ability to present complex analyses and insights effectively in simple terms.

  • Experience in a leading technology company.

  • Background in e-commerce product.

  • Experience with Natural Language Processing or LLM/GenAI is a plus.

At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

About eBay

eBay is a global commerce leader that connects millions of buyers and sellers around the world. We exist to enable economic opportunity for individuals, entrepreneurs, businesses, and organizations of all sizes. Our portfolio of brands includes eBay Marketplace and eBay Classifieds Group, operating in 190 markets around the world.

Position Summary:

We are seeking a highly motivated and seasoned Senior Engineering Manager for Site Reliability Engineering to support the expansion of our Cloud Data Technologies (CDT) into Bengaluru (INDIA). This role is at the intersection of platform engineering, reliability, and intelligent automation. You will lead a high-performing team of Site Reliability Engineers responsible for the availability, performance, and evolution of our internal engineering platforms.

The ideal candidate will possess a unique blend of SRE expertise, software development management experience, and a passion for building self-healing, AI driven systems that operate at a global scale.

Key Responsibilities:

Leadership & People Management -

  • Team Growth: Lead, mentor, and grow a team of Engineers, fostering a culture of collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.

  • Career Development: Conduct regular 1:1s, providing guidance, performance evaluations, and support for career progression.

  • Recruitment: Actively participate in growing the engineering organization through strategic recruiting and team building.

  • Strategic Direction: Provide technical leadership and align SRE activities with global business goals and product vision.

  • Cross-Functional Partnership: Partner with Software Development, Infrastructure and Product Management teams to ensure infrastructure integrity, security compliance, and service resilience. 

  • Global Integration: Collaborate with global leadership to ensure seamless execution across distributed teams and time zones.

Reliability & Platform Evolution -

  • Intelligent Automation: Drive the roadmap for AI driven and agent-based workflows to reduce toil and enable "closed-loop" automation (detect → diagnose → remediate).

  • Service Excellence: Own the reliability, availability, and performance of critical services and internal platforms, defining and tracking SLIs/SLOs and error budgets.

  • Drive the adoption of cloud-native technologies and best practices, including containerization, microservices, CI/CD, observability, and platform standardization.

  • Incident Leadership: Oversee incident triage, root cause analysis (RCA), and post-mortems to ensure systemic improvements.

  • Guardrails & Safety: Design and implement validation pipelines and safety mechanisms to allow automated systems to safely act on production environments.

Required Qualifications:

  • Experience: 12+ plus years of experience in Infrastructure, SRE, or Software Development, including 4+ years of people management leading reliability or platform engineering teams.

  • Automation Mastery: Proven experience building or integrating automation frameworks and AI agent based systems

  • Technical Depth: Strong understanding of Cloud-Native architectures, microservices, and modern data platforms.

  • Operational Excellence: Deep expertise in observability (monitoring, logging, tracing) and managing large-scale distributed systems.

  • Communication: Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate complex reliability trends and AI driven insights into updates for executive leadership.

  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with Chaos Engineering or resilience testing.

  • A history of driving platform standardization across large, global engineering organizations.

  • Expertise in Kubernetes-based control planes and telemetry infrastructure.

Additional Details

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.

 

We use cookies to enhance your experience and may use AI tools for administrative tasks in the hiring process. To learn how we handle your personal data and use AI responsibly, please visit our Talent Privacy Notice, Privacy Center, and AI Hiring Guidelines.

Are you a seasoned JavaScript engineer with a passion for building platforms that enable other developers to do their best work? The eBay Infrastructure Engineering team is looking for a Senior Platform Engineer with 3-5 years of experience to join our team in Bangalore.

In this role, you'll be a core part of the Frameworks team, which is responsible for the JavaScript frameworks that power all of eBay's user-facing web interfaces. You'll work on our Node.js Developer Platform and MUSE, a lightweight React-based framework for internal tools at eBay. Your "customers" will be your fellow eBay developers, and you'll play a critical role in their success.

You'll collaborate closely with your US-based counterparts within the Frameworks team to deliver on the product roadmap and enhance our developer platforms.

What you’ll be doing

  • Platform Development: Build and roll out features for our Node.js and MUSE frameworks.

  • Developer Support: Provide direct support to developers, debugging issues and triaging requests in our Slack channels.

  • Maintenance & Operations: Manage monthly releases, Node.js runtime upgrades, and software upgrades.

  • Tooling & Automation: Enhance our software upgrade tooling and support our continuous integration and deployment pipelines with tools like NPM, Docker, and Jenkins.

  • System Integration: Integrate our frameworks with critical eBay systems, including single sign-on (SSO), cloud services, logging, metrics, and security.

  • Performance & Security: Conduct performance testing and ensure our platforms are secure with regular open-source security upgrades.

  • Web Technologies: Work with a range of modern web technologies, including Webpack, Vite, and React.

Required skills and experience

  • 3-5 years of professional experience in software engineering.

  • Strong expertise in JavaScript, Typescript, Node.js, and React.

  • Knowledge of web technologies - Webpack, Vite

  • Experience with Kubernetes, Docker

  • Experience with a range of developer tooling and workflows.

  • Experience developing REST and GraphQL APIs

  • A collaborative mindset and excellent communication skills.

If you're excited about building robust, scalable platforms for developers at a global company, we'd love to hear from you.

At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

About the team and the role

Identity is foundational to how users safely access and interact with eBay’s global marketplace. The Identity team owns the core systems and workflows that power account creation, authentication, account security, different account models and trust signals across millions of buyers and sellers worldwide. As eBay continues to evolve its platform and expand its ecosystem, identity is increasingly delivered as a platform capability (Identity-as-a-Service) that enables secure and seamless experiences across products, devices, and partners and evolves from single-user accounts to multi-user, role-based identity systems supporting families and teams. 


We’re hiring a Senior Product Manager to join the Identity product team and lead the end-to-end buyer registration and activation funnel — from first touch and progressive onboarding through first purchase — with a dual mandate: increase conversion while reducing fraud and friction.

Core responsibilities

  • Drive buyer-side registration, progressive capture, account verification gating and the first-purchase activation experience.
    Design and run experiments to increase registration completion and buyer activation while reducing bot/synthetic signups.

  • Use data, experimentation, and customer insights to identify friction points and prioritize improvements across the journey.

  • Partner closely with Security, Fraud/Risk, Payments, Trust & Safety, Design and Legal to implement secure, compliant experiences.

  • Instrument and own buyer onboarding KPIs and data-driven experiment cycles.

  • Maintain a prioritized backlog and clear acceptance criteria.
     

Required experience & skills

  • 7+ years product management experience, ideally in consumer onboarding, registration, or identity-related products.

  • Track record designing flows that balance fraud prevention, ease-of-use and global UX consistency (including progressive profiling / necessary stepup verification flows).

  • Track record designing elegant, mobile-first onboarding experiences that minimize friction, increase activation, and scale globally. Comfortable running usability studies, prototyping flows with Design and iterating on UX based on qualitative feedback.

  • Experience optimizing sign-up → first purchase/listing funnels and owning activation metrics (activation rate, time-to-first-purchase, onboarding NPS).

  • Familiarity with fraud mitigation, progressive profiling, and modern auth patterns as well as AI/ML for signal enrichment (fraud models, behavioral scoring), behavioral biometrics.

  • Strong experimentation and analytics skills; experience collaborating with cross functional teams

  • Proven ability to influence engineers, security, fraud, payments, design and legal partners; decisive, with strong stakeholder management in multi-team environments.

  • Hands-on AI + prototyping - Practical experience using AI/LLM tools to prototype product ideas, generate UX copy/logic, and accelerate discovery. Comfortable building interactive UI prototypes in Figma/tools and converting those prototypes into engineering-ready artifacts.

Additional Details

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.

Payments is one of the company’s major growth enablers. Putting customers at the heart of everything we do, we connect communities and empower our people to deliver exceptional commerce experiences to drive eBay’s long-term growth and market share. eBay seeks an experienced Product Manager to develop, optimize and scale the capabilities of eBay's Payments Platform. 

This role involves tackling the challenges of evolving a robust marketplace payment solution into a scalable, multi-tenant "Payments-as-a-Service" platform. A critical challenge is to decouple our existing payment boundaries to build a "plug-and-play" suite of services — including embedded payments, compliance, and risk — that can be seamlessly adopted by any tenant, for example eBay subsidiaries. The Product Manager will lead the strategic evolution of the financial services, crafting future-proof interfaces and customizable design components that handle operational heavy-lifting while ensuring tenant isolation and independent scale.

What you will accomplish:

  • Define and drive the product vision for the "Payments-as-a-Service" track, evolving our embedded payments capabilities for marketplaces as well as a full PayFac offering for subsidiaries and future clients.

  • Partner with cross-functional teams to design "fit-for-purpose" boundaries between the marketplace and payments layers, ensuring services like acquiring, payouts, financial reporting and ledgering are modular and scalable.

  • As the product owner, lead the development of both API-first services and "drop-in" UX components (SDKs) that allow marketplace as well as PayFac tenants to quickly onboard and ramp. 

  • Analyze data and industry trends to identify optimization hypotheses for multi-tenant scaling, focusing on automating onboarding, compliance checks, and financial reconciliation for partners.

  • Clearly set the product/backlog prioritization with a balance of near-term outcomes (e.g., migrating subsidiary sellers to the new platform) and longer-term investments in platform future-proofing.

  • Build a case for your hypotheses, A/B test implementation strategies, and implement winners that reduce integration time and operational burden for our tenants.

  • Effectively communicate strategies & trade-offs all the way from senior leaders to the development team, ensuring alignment on the shift from internal tools to commercial-grade SaaS capabilities.

What you will bring:

  • Engineering Degree/MBA degree or equivalent preferred

  • 7+ years of product management experience, and 

  • 3+ years of experience in payments domain and platform payments processing. Deep knowledge of the payments landscape, embedded payments, white label solutions or PayFac models

  • Proven track record of creating "API-first" platforms and client-facing SDKs/UI components (e.g., drop-in frames for critical data collection).

  • Strategic mindset with the ability to plan execution towards a final "As-a-Service" vision, anticipating future regulatory and scalability needs for diverse tenants

  • Comfortable making the "tough calls" on trade-offs - balancing speed-to-market with the long-term health of a multi-tenant platform.

  • Ability to use data to formulate product perspectives, justify platform investments, and define success metrics for platform health and reliability.

  • Experienced in managing complex stakeholder relationships (Legal, Treasury, Risk, and Engineering) to achieve "win-win" outcomes for the platform and its tenants.

  • Balances technical depth and sharp eye for high-leverage outcomes; able to communicate what is possible and what will have the biggest impact on business

  • Drive executions with a focus on quality, customer-centricity, scalability, and reliability.

What you will bring:

  • Deep expertise in building and scaling loyalty programs, digital wallets, fintech products, or monetization platforms.

  • Demonstrated success in driving innovation, product growth, and delivering high-quality customer experiences with a customer-centric and data-driven approach. Ability to understand user needs and find simple and creative ways to solve them.

  • Experience leading cross-functional teams and navigating highly complex cross-functional projects end-to-end. Ability to influence and drive decisions in ambiguous situations.

We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

About eBay:

Are you seeking a company that encourages passion, courage, and creativity? Join eBay, where you can be part of a dynamic team crafting the future of global commerce. At eBay, we empower millions of people to buy, sell, connect, and share worldwide. In eBay Payments, you will be an integral member of a growing organization that inspires passion, courage, and inventiveness - creating the future of global commerce and making an important, positive impact on millions of eBay sellers and shoppers around the world. If you are looking for a special place to take your Payments career to the next level, we want to talk with you.

Role Overview:

eBay needs a skilled Sr. Product Manager to lead the advancement of our Seller Payments team. This position emphasizes finding opportunities and implementing strategies with measurable effects. The role calls for strategic insight to promote innovation and boost market efficiency globally. The successful candidate will have a demonstrated ability to develop global product strategies and work alongside regional business leaders, product teams, and domain experts. They focus on building core payment capabilities and tailoring features for local market success. Outstanding ability to build relationships and influence partners at all levels is essential.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Strategic Leadership: Define and complete the product strategy and roadmap for Seller Payments, ensuring a strengths-based approach with a global perspective.
  • Agile Product Ownership: Serve as the Product Owner, providing clear product vision to the scrum team and co-leading the Agile process with engineering counterparts to reach roadmap achievements.
  • Prioritization & Planning: Establish product/backlog prioritization, balancing immediate deliverables with long-term technology investments.
  • Platform Development: Translate commerce requirements into versatile payment capabilities adaptable to various processors, types, and models.
  • AI Integration: Leverage AI to enhance product capabilities, improve decision-making processes, and optimize user experiences!
  • Evangelism & Collaboration: Act as a product evangelist, working closely with business partners and engineering leaders to align strategies.
  • Communication & Influence: Effectively communicate strategies and trade-offs to senior leaders and development teams, encouraging alignment and understanding.
  • Innovation & Improvement: Incorporate market trends and technological developments into effective improvements for Seller Payments.

Job Requirements:

  • Expertise: Deep subject matter expertise in technologies and products crucial for launching payment solutions at scale globally.
  • Agile Experience: Proficient in agile development processes.
  • UX Focus: Experience in developing innovative product features with a strong emphasis on UX development.
  • AI Skills: Knowledge of AI technologies and their use in product management to foster innovation and improve efficiency.
  • Analytical Skills: Ability to ask insightful questions to build product perspectives and articulate requirements.
  • Balance & Impact: Skill in balancing technical possibilities with business impact, communicating effectively to drive significant outcomes.
  • Relationship Building: Proven ability to build strong internal and external relationships, actively listen, communicate clearly, and work toward mutually beneficial solutions.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Engineering Degree or MBA degree or equivalent experience preferred
  • 5+ years of robust product management experience preferably in e-commerce/marketplaces
  • 3+ years of experience in payments domain, Deep understanding of payments domain would be preferred

Additional Details

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.

To be successful in this role, you will need to have a consistent track record in product management, with a focus on building/ managing platforms and a passion for creating products and services that deliver a delightful user experience. You should also have the ability to use data and analytics to drive product decisions. Most importantly, you should be a highly motivated self-starter with strong technical competence. You will need to think strategically, communicate effectively, and engage with various partners. 
 

What you will accomplish:

  • Lead our product execution for Value Added Services and its corresponding platform product needs

  • Solid understanding of APIs (REST/GraphQL), including how they are designed, documented, integrated, and used to enable scalable product features and third-party integrations.

  • Build and implement a compelling roadmap supporting services business growth goals

  • Develop innovative tools with AI capabilities to drive  platform's vision

  • Collaborate with researchers, analysts, designers and engineers charged with improving service experiences

  • Innovate and reinforce the field of our engineering operations, from sprint reviews to definition of done. Drive a culture of quality, customer-centricity, scalability, and reliability

  • Act as the primary advocate for the product, ensuring it meets the needs of customers

  • Apply data and analytics to drive product decisions

  • Collaborate with partners across the organization to ensure product success

  • Communicate product progress and updates to collaborators

  • Ensure product aligns with all applicable industry regulations

  • Monitor and analyze user feedback to identify areas of improvement

  • Work with designers and engineers to ensure a high-quality user experience

  • Master's degree in a technology or equivalent business area, or equivalent experience.

  • 8+ years of experience as a technical product leader, with significant time and success in large scale enterprise or platform-centric organizations,, ideally eCommerce or marketplace company.

  • Experience with launching AI-powered platform capabilities that unlock new use cases, accelerate ecosystem growth, or redefine how teams build on the platform.

  • Strategic problem solver who favors action and is passionate about enabling innovation through platforms

  • Proficiency in  working with engineering teams delivering software products and features using Agile/Scrum  methodologies

  • Proficiency in basic data analysis using tools such as Excel, SQL, Tableau

  • Experience in e-commerce delivering both buying and selling experiences

Senior Manager, Applied Research – Shipping AI
 

At eBay, we don’t just enable commerce—we shape how the world connects, trades, and thrives. If you’re driven by innovation, impact, and building at global scale, join us in redefining the future of e-commerce.

About the Team

Our Shipping team sits at the core of the end-to-end e-commerce experience. From influencing purchase decisions to ensuring a seamless post-purchase journey, we power trust and satisfaction for millions of buyers and sellers worldwide.

We build and deploy advanced machine learning systems to tackle complex logistics challenges—accurate delivery predictions, cost optimization, carrier network modeling, and more. Operating at massive scale, we leverage modern MLOps to deliver high-performance, low-latency solutions across a global marketplace.

The Opportunity

We are building a next-generation Shipping Intelligence Platform powered by advanced AI technologies including deep learning, NLP, and large language models (LLMs).

We are seeking a Senior Manager, Applied Research to lead a high-impact team of researchers and engineers. This leader will drive innovation from ideation to production—delivering scalable AI systems that directly impact customer experience, operational efficiency, and business outcomes.

This is an opportunity to:

  • Lead & Grow Talent: Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing team of applied researchers and ML engineers.

  • Drive AI Innovation: Define and execute the AI/ML roadmap for shipping intelligence, leveraging NLP, LLMs, recommender systems, and multimodal learning.

  • Deliver at Scale: Own the end-to-end lifecycle—from research and prototyping to production deployment in a high-volume, low-latency environment.

  • Influence Product & Strategy: Partner with Product, Engineering, Analytics, and Operations leaders to shape the future of shipping experiences on eBay.

  • Advance Personalization & Recommendations: Drive strategies that improve discovery, engagement, and conversion across the marketplace.

  • Leverage Big Data: Work with large-scale structured and unstructured datasets, including multimodal inventory and user behavior data.

  • Experience and working knowledge of Vertex O-Series preferred 

  • Experience with SAP/S4HANA preferred 

 

Basic Qualifications:

At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

About the Team and Role

eBay's Site Network Engineering team designs and engineers the production fabrics connecting eBay's server fleet across data centers, POPs, and other properties. We run 100% SONiC-based open networking in production across six switch vendor families on multiple merchant silicon families. Zero availability-impacting fabric incidents every year since the SONiC transition began.

You will establish SONiC platform engineering as an in-house function — this is a greenfield mandate, not a backfill. You own the full stack from ASIC layer through production deployment, with direct influence on architecture, release quality, and vendor strategy. A near-term goal is converging to a single SONiC release across all six vendor families; this role is central to that.

What You'll Do

  • Drive end-to-end platform enablement for new switch hardware (transceivers/CMIS, optics qualification and tuning, thermal/PSU/fan/watchdog/sensors, EEPROM, LED/CPLD/FPGA as required).

  • Lead ASIC SDK + SAI integration: vendor SDK integration/customization, SAI behavior tuning/modeling, syncd adaptations, dataplane correctness, performance, and stability.

  • Design production reliability across the stack: warm/fast reboot correctness, upgrade safety, and high availability under load (hitless patterns where applicable).

  • Debug and resolve complex issues across kernel/drivers → SDK/firmware → SONiC services (SWSS/orchagent, Redis DBs, containers), with strong bias for reproducibility and root-cause closure.

  • Deliver features on real hardware and meet scale/performance targets (buffers/QoS/queues/counters/telemetry, link/port behavior, failure handling).

  • Define and operationalize release processes: gating, rollback strategy, known-issue management, and production-readiness standards.

  • Serve as key technical interface with ASIC vendors and ODMs, driving escalations and influencing outcomes.

  • Build CI/CD pipelines, automated testing (PTF, SpyTest or equivalent), hardware-in-the-loop validation, and regression coverage.

  • Contribute to upstream SONiC when appropriate and define a responsible fork/upstream strategy.

  • Mentor peers and contribute to team growth as we scale (people management not required).

What Success Looks Like (First 6–12 Months)

  • Enable or materially stabilize at least one ASIC/platform family with measurable improvements (reboot reliability, crash rate, performance baselines, scale targets).

  • Deliver a repeatable ASIC SDK integration + qualification pipeline.

  • Establish foundational processes (testing, CI/CD, release discipline, vendor engagement) so the capability scales smoothly.

Must-Have Qualifications

  • Strong Linux systems software development background with C/C++ and expert debugging skills (gdb, perf, strace, core dumps).

  • Production experience programming switching ASICs via vendor SDKs and/or SAI — including integration, behavioral tuning, and performance/stability troubleshooting.

  • Delivered SDK/SAI-based switching features on real hardware in a production or production-like environment.

  • Working knowledge of SONiC internals or equivalent NOS (SAI/syncd, SWSS/orchagent, Redis DBs, container model) with ability to ramp quickly.

  • Ability to lead ambiguous technical initiatives and drive cross-functional delivery across sites/time zones.

Strong Differentiators

  • Track record partnering with merchant silicon vendors, including escalation management and influencing outcomes.

  • Direct upstream contributions to SONiC, SAI, FRR, or Linux kernel networking.

  • Deep SAI behavioral expertise (ACL, QoS, buffers, ECMP, counters, telemetry).

  • Optics qualification, tuning, and vendor-specific behavior across transceiver families.

Additional Details

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.

The Global Information Security (GIS) Team makes sure that eBay continues to be a safe virtual marketplace. The Application Security Engineering team makes sure all business processes are secured, via optimized process and automation. In collaboration with the product developers, the team hardens eBay’s security through security attack reduction by driving foundational product security fixes.

What you will Accomplish:

We are looking for experienced security developers to join us in the Application Security Engineering team.

You will help develop and support innovative solutions that strengthen the secure DevOps offerings of the security application group. You will complete processes that fine-tune security rules and improve detection and mitigation efficiency. You will provide hands-on engineering support to secure DevOps and ML DevOps automations. You will collaborate with peer InfoSec teams during security incident investigations and reviews, driving the security charter across the organization. Additionally, you will help develop scalable security management tools and test suites that help securely release eBay’s public facing product lines. The ideal candidate person will be a software developer with engineering experience working on Security attack surface reduction through foundational product security fixes.


What you’ll bring:


- BSCS degree with 7-9 years of experience or an MS degree with 6+ years of experience
- Strong hands-on product architecture and development experience with web applications are required; experience in secure DevOps space is expected
- Strong development experience in development of user interface of web-based tools (Node.js, React JS, Angular JS)

- Strong familiarity with AI/ML, LLM concepts, implementations and their security implications; Familiarity with AI developer tools (Copilot, Claude, Cursor etc) is a major plus

- Knowledge of integration of security automation solutions with systems like GitHub and Open-Source Security solutions is a plus

- Ability to build automation tools and REST API-s for security processes and web applications on Java (with Spring MVC) and familiarity with databases (Hadoop, noSQL, Oracle, etc) is required. Knowledge of other languages like Python is a plus. Knowledge of GraphQL is a plus
- Ability to deep dive into SAST/DAST/SCA scan data (from security scanning tools like Appscan, Checkmarx, semgrep) and logs to analyze for security gaps will be a major plus
- General understanding of Security in CI/CD process and basic usage of AI tools and terminologies

- Working experience with product development teams in a continuous delivery developer role is highly desirable. The developer is expected to be comfortable delivering in short sprints in an Agile framework

- Familiarity with generation of metrics via real time dashboards and self-healing automated application monitoring. Data analytics experience would be a major plus
- Experience in performing threat modelling, security reviews, security incident troubleshooting are beneficial for the day to day work

- Good presentation skills are expected ; ability to clearly articulate and present issues to diverse audience in an effective and personable manner.
- Ability to determine risk based on context and adjust quickly to the security needs of a highly agile organization
- Highly motivated developer to pick new skills as required and apply to delivery processes

At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

About eBay AI Platform

At eBay, we are building a next-generation AI platform to power intelligent, AI-driven experiences across our global marketplace. Our platform supports the full lifecycle of large-scale foundation models—from distributed pretraining on high-performance GPU clusters to high-throughput production inference—enabling commerce intelligence for hundreds of millions of users worldwide.

We focus on building state-of-the-art AI runtime infrastructure leveraging vLLM and TensorRT-LLM as pluggable inference engines behind a standardized AI runtime layer, alongside Megatron-LM and DeepSpeed for distributed training—integrated with provisioned throughput management, a distributed KV cache, prefill/decode disaggregation, and a robust MLOps stack spanning experiment management, fine-tuning automation, and production observability.
 

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Software Engineer specializing in AI runtimes and MLOps to design and operate the systems that bring eBay's foundation models from research to production. You will own the inference runtime stack, the distributed training infrastructure, and the MLOps tooling that ties them together—enabling ML researchers and Applied Scientists to move fast without sacrificing reliability or performance.

You will work on production LLM/VLM inference serving with vLLM and TensorRT-LLM via a standardized AI runtime layer, implement distributed inference optimizations including prefill/decode disaggregation, distributed KV cache management, and LLM-aware request routing—develop large-scale distributed training pipelines using Megatron-LM and DeepSpeed on high-performance GPU clusters—and build the MLOps stack that automates the end-to-end model lifecycle.
 

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and operate production AI inference runtimes using vLLM and TensorRT-LLM behind a standardized AI runtime layer.
  • Implement and optimize distributed inference architectures with prefill/decode disaggregation.
  • Design and optimize a distributed KV cache system across nodes.
  • Develop and optimize large-scale distributed training pipelines using Megatron-LM and DeepSpeed.
  • Profile and resolve distributed training bottlenecks using NVIDIA and PyTorch performance tools.
  • Implement inference optimizations such as quantization, speculative decoding, continuous batching, and FlashAttention.
  • Build and operate an Inference Request Router for authentication, routing, and throughput management.
  • Develop and operate multi-LoRA adapter hosting with hot-swap routing and lifecycle management.
  • Build and maintain the MLOps stack, including experiment tracking, model versioning, automated evaluation, and CI/CD.
  • Develop and operate fine-tuning pipelines such as SFT, RLHF, DPO, and LoRA.
  • Build fault-tolerant distributed training infrastructure with checkpointing, failure detection, and recovery.
  • Build regression testing and benchmarking systems to improve training and inference performance.
     

What We’re Looking For

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience building distributed systems or ML platform infrastructure.
  • Strong programming skills in Python and/or Golang.
  • Familiarity with CUDA or Triton kernel development is a plus.
  • Hands-on experience deploying and operating LLM inference engines such as vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, NVIDIA Triton, or SGLang.
  • Deep understanding of LLM inference internals, including KV cache management, PagedAttention, continuous batching, and request routing.
  • Experience building or optimizing distributed training pipelines using Megatron-LM, DeepSpeed, FSDP, or equivalent frameworks.
  • Strong understanding of model parallelism strategies and their trade-offs.
  • Proficiency with NVIDIA tooling such as NCCL, DCGM, Nsight Systems, and PyTorch Profiler.
  • Experience implementing inference optimizations including quantization, speculative decoding, FlashAttention, and multi-LoRA serving.
  • Experience building MLOps workflows including experiment tracking, model registry, evaluation automation, and CI/CD.
  • Experience developing fine-tuning pipelines such as SFT, RLHF, DPO, or LoRA at scale.
  • Strong expertise in Kubernetes and containerized GPU environments.
  • Strong debugging and performance optimization skills across CUDA runtimes, distributed training, and ML serving systems.

Additional Details

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.

 

We use cookies to enhance your experience and may use AI tools for administrative tasks in the hiring process. To learn how we handle your personal data and use AI responsibly, please visit our Talent Privacy Notice, Privacy Center, and AI Hiring Guidelines.
