At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

We are looking for a highly motivated Senior Mobile Application Security Engineer to join eBay's Application Security team under Global Information Security to tackle the problems of tomorrow while continuing to build and secure the foundation of today.

The Application Security team ensures all eBay products are secured via optimized security processes and solutions. 

We need a hands-on senior Mobile Application Security Engineer with engineering experience to research, craft, and implement capabilities and defenses to secure and protect eBay's critical Mobile Native applications and supporting infrastructure.

What you will accomplish

  • Perform Mobile Application Security architecture, design reviews and assessments of eBay Mobile Native product solutions (iOS, Android). This includes Mobile Native applications covering eBay Marketplaces and its Adjacencies. 

  • Engineer and implement Mobile Native Security solutions for iOS and Android leveraging AI / LLM capabilities as needed.

  • Develop scalable static and dynamic Application security scanning solutions for Mobile Native along with security management tools and processes

  • Provide hands-on engineering support for Native security solutions

  • Own processes for continuously fine-tuning Mobile security rules and processes for efficient detection and mitigation

  • Review Mobile native security findings/violations reports and coordinate remediation efforts

  • Collaborate with peer InfoSec teams in security incident investigations, and drive the security charter across organizations

What you will bring

  • BSCS degree with 5-7 years of experience or an MS degree with 3+ years of experience

  • 3+ years Mobile Security engineering experience in the Application space or 3+ years Software Engineering experience including Mobile Native Security experience covering iOS and Android

  • Hands-on experience in performing Mobile Native Application Security architecture and design reviews, security scanning including security incidents troubleshooting

  • Hands-on development experience in iOS and Android technologies including Swift, Kotlin and usage of AI / LLM related technologies. 

  • Good understanding of OWASP top 10 vulnerabilities for Mobile Native, as it relates to secure product development including AI / LLM technologies and their security implications

  • Mobile Systems design experience and familiarity with Identity authentication & authorization concepts

  • Additional familiarity with Mobile Device Management (MDM) and Mobile Application Management (MAM) is a plus.

  • Experience in containers, container orchestration technologies like Docker, Kubernetes is preferred

  • Ability to clearly articulate issues and communicate with leadership and partner teams in an effective and personable manner

  • Self-starter and Effective communicator

  • Ability to multi-task and thrive in a small team in a fast-paced environment

Additional Details

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.

 

We use cookies to enhance your experience and may use AI tools for administrative tasks in the hiring process. To learn how we handle your personal data and use AI responsibly, please visit our Talent Privacy Notice, Privacy Center, and AI Hiring Guidelines.

At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

Looking for a company where you can shape how the world buys, sells, and gives? Where you’ll be part of a work culture that’s been genuinely committed to diversity and inclusion since its founding more than 30 years ago? Where you can just be yourself, do your best work, and have a meaningful impact? If so, we’d love to talk to you.​

We are the Protections team, driving the transformation of the post purchase ecosystem through Cancellations, Returns, Refunds, eBay Money Back Guarantee, Item Not Received, Chargebacks and Seller Standards experiences. Our products are available on web and native applications, serving millions of global users and building trust at every step. We are a data-driven, agile team that embraces AI innovation and fosters a culture of continuous improvements and learning. Join us to make an impact on one of the world’s largest e-commerce websites.

What you'll do and learn:

  • Translate requirements to software design and create clean, efficient, extensible, maintainable code.

  • Responsible for subsytems  within a large domain, possessing in-depth knowledge and expertise. Taking full responsibility for the entire software life cycle, including design, development, testing, deployment, observability and monitoring.

  • Serve as a key player in influencing and guiding others towards the right technical decisions.

  • Identifying areas of features likely to change and integrating flexibility in the design for these area improving engineering velocity.

  • Collaborate effectively with cross-functional partners to develop innovative solutions that adhere to development goals and principles.

  • Practices evidence-centered design making features testable, ensuring high quality and improving velocity in continuous delivery.

  • Manage project features, break into sub-tasks, identify and resolve issues for efficient execution.

  • Provide technical guidance,  code review for immediate team and other teams, coaching, and mentorship to individual team members.

  • Identify gaps and issues across systems and functional areas, propose solutions, build the engineering roadmap, and drive resolution.

  • Leads and improves E2E testing quality and increase delivery velocity across features.

  • Lead engineering support, release, and on-call responsibilities for an "always-on" 24/7 site.

What you bring:

  • Innovative, team player, excellent communication and decision-making

  • Strong sense of ownership and interpersonal skills to work effectively across teams

  • Strong learning ability, self-driven         

  • Excited about new and innovative technologies within immediate field of expertise               

  • Attending knowledge sharing sessions, both within the company and externally  

  • Learning transferable skills      

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in EE, CS or other related field or equivalent exp.

  • 6+ years of experience in working in Java, GraphQL, Spring/Springboot, REST APIs, messaging systems and/or or other backend programming languages

  • Building data-driven applications (RDBMS, NoSQL, ElasticSearch)

  • Experiences in leading small to mid-size projects independently.

  • Delivers results in fast-paced environments (agile, TDD, CI/CD)

  • Familiarity with shift left approach is a plus

Additional Details

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

Looking for a company where you can shape how the world buys, sells, and gives? Where you’ll be part of a work culture that’s been genuinely committed to diversity and inclusion since its founding more than 30 years ago? Where you can just be yourself, do your best work, and have a meaningful impact? If so, we’d love to talk to you.​

We are the Protections team, driving the transformation of the post purchase ecosystem through Cancellations, Returns, Refunds, eBay Money Back Guarantee, Item Not Received, Chargebacks and Seller Standards experiences. Our products are available on web and native applications, serving millions of global users and building trust at every step. We are a data-driven, agile team that embraces AI innovation and fosters a culture of continuous improvements and learning. Join us to make an impact on one of the world’s largest e-commerce websites.

What you'll do and learn:

  • Develop features that are modular and loosely coupled

  • Able to translate product and design documents into clean, high-quality, crash-free, well-tested and maintainable production code autonomously.

  • Write unit tests and automation code for all shipped features

  • Conduct code review for immediate team

  • Develop and maintain technical documentation to support software applications.

  • Propose and evaluate multiple design options, providing estimates for each.

  • Structure and complete tasks independently, meeting deadlines and milestones.

  • Effectively communicate assumptions and seek clarification from stakeholders, ensuring alignment and understanding across all domains.

What you bring:

  • Innovative, team player, excellent communication and decision-making

  • Strong sense of ownership and interpersonal skills to work effectively across teams

  • Strong learning ability, self-driven         

  • Excited about new and innovative technologies within immediate field of expertise               

  • Attending knowledge sharing sessions, both within the company and externally  

  • Learning transferable skills       

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in EE, CS or other related field or equivalent exp.

  • 4+ years professional experience in native mobile development

  • Understanding of advanced Kotlin language features, coroutines, lambdas

  • Experience with dependency management tools in android, artifactory, gradle

  • Understanding of system design for large scale consumer mobile applications.

  • Familiarity with CI/CD tools

  • Experience implementing modern platform design patterns

  • Basic proficiency with memory management

  • Understanding of testing android applications using platform tools

  • Experience with production monitoring

Additional Details

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.

 

We use cookies to enhance your experience and may use AI tools for administrative tasks in the hiring process. To learn how we handle your personal data and use AI responsibly, please visit our Talent Privacy Notice, Privacy Center, and AI Hiring Guidelines.

description_text:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

At eBay, we’re redefining how millions of sellers power their businesses and Financial Reporting sits at the heart of that transformation. As a Sr. Technical Product Manager – Financial Reporting (Payments), you will shape the future of how sellers understand their cash flow, profitability, payouts, fees, and tax obligations. In this role, you will create a trusted, AI-powered financial intelligence platform that empowers entrepreneurs to make smarter decisions and grow with confidence.

You’ll lead the evolution of eBay’s financial reporting ecosystem, simplifying complex payment data, unifying fragmented systems, and delivering intuitive, customizable insights for everyone from micro-sellers to large enterprises. By leveraging AI and advanced analytics, you’ll help surface actionable insights such as order-level profitability, fee optimization opportunities, cash flow forecasting, cost-saving recommendations, and personalized growth signals. You’ll transform compliance-driven reporting into predictive, insight-led tools that help sellers reinvest wisely, reduce expenses, and scale more profitably.

If you’re passionate about fintech, data-rich products, and applying AI to solve meaningful problems at global scale, this role offers the opportunity to directly impact seller trust, unlock smarter financial decision-making, and shape the financial backbone of one of the world’s largest marketplaces. Join us and help build the future of seller financial intelligence at eBay.

You are:

  • AI-Forward & Data Fluent : You understand how AI, analytics, and automation can transform financial data into intelligent insights. You think beyond dashboards — toward predictive signals, anomaly detection, personalization, and decision-support systems that help customers grow, optimize costs, and operate more profitably. You are comfortable partnering with engineering and data science teams to translate models, data pipelines, and platform capabilities into scalable product experiences.

  • Collaborative & Influential: You thrive in complex, matrixed environments and know how to align engineering, design, data, legal, tax, and operations around a bold vision. You communicate clearly across all levels — from executives to developers — and simplify the complex without losing rigor. You’re comfortable with ambiguity and can create clarity, momentum, and shared ownership across distributed global teams.

  • Strategic & Future-Oriented: You think in platforms, not features. You develop a long-term product strategy grounded in customer value, competitive differentiation, and evolving industry trends across fintech, payments, and commerce. You anticipate regulatory shifts, ecosystem integrations, and AI disruption — and proactively shape your roadmap to stay ahead.

  • Customer-Obsessed & Insight-Driven: You deeply empathize with customers and understand end-to-end financial workflows — from reconciliation and tax preparation to profitability analysis and cash flow management. You build products that reduce friction, increase trust, and turn financial complexity into clarity.

  • Relentless Executor: You combine bold thinking with disciplined execution. You operate with urgency, resilience, and strong judgment — balancing innovation with operational excellence. You dive into the details when needed, make data-driven decisions, and consistently deliver measurable business impact.

You have:

  • 5+ years of product management experience building data-intensive, fintech, payments, or financial systems products at scale

  • Experience translating complex financial or technical requirements into intuitive, high-impact customer experiences

  • Strong understanding of payments, money movement, reconciliation, reporting systems, and/or tax workflows

  • Experience working with AI/ML-powered features, advanced analytics, or data platform teams

  • Proven ability to define and execute strategy in cross-functional, global, matrixed organizations

  • Strong analytical skills with comfort interpreting large datasets and driving data-informed decisions

  • Excellent communication skills — able to influence without authority and make complex topics simple

  • Experience operating across global markets and regulatory environments

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, Computer Science, or related field

Benefits:

Benefits are an essential part of your total compensation for the work you do every day. Whether you’re single, in a growing family, or nearing retirement, eBay offers a variety of comprehensive and competitive benefit programs to meet your needs. Including maternal & paternal leave, paid sabbatical, and plans to help ensure your financial security today and in the years ahead because we know feeling financially secure during your working years and through retirement is important.

Here at eBay, we love creating opportunities for others by connecting people from widely diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and geographies. So, being diverse and inclusive isn’t just something we strive for, it is who we are, and part of what we do each and every single day. We want to ensure that as an employee, you feel eBay is a place where, no matter who you are, you feel safe, included, and that you have the opportunity to bring your unique self to work. To learn about eBay’s Diversity & Inclusion click here: https://www.ebayinc.com/our-company/diversity-inclusion/.

Additional Details

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.

 

We use cookies to enhance your experience and may use AI tools for administrative tasks in the hiring process. To learn how we handle your personal data and use AI responsibly, please visit our Talent Privacy Notice, Privacy Center, and AI Hiring Guidelines.

We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

Looking for a company where you can shape how the world buys, sells, and gives? Where you’ll be part of a work culture that’s been genuinely committed to diversity and inclusion since its founding more than 30 years ago? Where you can just be yourself, do your best work, and have a meaningful impact? If so, we’d love to talk to you.​

We are the Protections team, driving the transformation of the post purchase ecosystem through Cancellations, Returns, Refunds, eBay Money Back Guarantee, Item Not Received, Chargebacks and Seller Standards experiences. Our products are available on web and native applications, serving millions of global users and building trust at every step. We are a data-driven, agile team that embraces AI innovation and fosters a culture of continuous improvements and learning. Join us to make an impact on one of the world’s largest e-commerce websites.

What you'll do and learn:

  • Translate requirements to software design and create clean, efficient, extensible, maintainable code.

  • Responsible for subsytems  within a large domain, possessing in-depth knowledge and expertise. Taking full responsibility for the entire software life cycle, including design, development, testing, deployment, observability and monitoring.

  • Serve as a key player in influencing and guiding others towards the right technical decisions.

  • Identifying areas of features likely to change and integrating flexibility in the design for these area improving engineering velocity.

  • Collaborate effectively with cross-functional partners to develop innovative solutions that adhere to development goals and principles.

  • Practices evidence-centered design making features testable, ensuring high quality and improving velocity in continuous delivery.

  • Manage project features, break into sub-tasks, identify and resolve issues for efficient execution.

  • Provide technical guidance,  code review for immediate team and other teams, coaching, and mentorship to individual team members.

  • Identify gaps and issues across systems and functional areas, propose solutions, build the engineering roadmap, and drive resolution.

  • Leads and improves E2E testing quality and increase delivery velocity across features.

  • Lead engineering support, release, and on-call responsibilities for an "always-on" 24/7 site.

What you bring:

  • Innovative, team player, excellent communication and decision-making

  • Strong sense of ownership and interpersonal skills to work effectively across teams

  • Strong learning ability, self-driven         

  • Excited about new and innovative technologies within immediate field of expertise               

  • Attending knowledge sharing sessions, both within the company and externally  

  • Learning transferable skills       

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in EE, CS or other related field or equivalent exp.

  • 6+ years of experience in building large scale, distributed web platforms/APIs with 2+ years as a lead developer responsible for specific functional areas.

  • Experiences in leading small to mid-size projects independently.

  • Experience in designing GraphQL/Restful APIs, and building server-side components in Java, NodeJS or other backend programming languages.

  • Experience in building web applications with modern JavaScript frameworks (e.g. React, Angular)

  • Building data-driven applications (RDBMS, NoSQL, ElasticSearch) 

  • Delivers results in fast-paced environments (agile, TDD, CI/CD)

Additional Details

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

Are you looking to join a community that values creativity, empathy, and collaboration? At eBay, we’re building a supportive environment where everyone belongs. As part of TCGplayer, you’ll help hobbyists connect through a marketplace they love. We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager who is passionate about building community and creating seamless mobile experiences. If you’re interested in joining a purpose driven community that is dedicated to crafting an impactful and inclusive work environment, join eBay – a company you can be proud to be with.

Who We Are

TCGplayer, now a part of eBay, connects hobbyists and hobby businesses through a vibrant marketplace for collectible card games and related products. We are dedicated to customer-focused innovation to provide a welcoming destination and tools for collectors, players, and professional sellers. Our platform serves millions of buyers and tens of thousands of retailers in a market worth more than $25B.

Sr Product Manager – Mobile App

The TCGplayer mobile app plays a critical role in this ecosystem, enabling customers to discover products, manage their collections, and engage with the broader marketplace from anywhere. We are seeking a Senior Product Manager – Mobile to help guide and deliver the roadmap for the TCGplayer mobile application across iOS and Android platforms.

In this role, you will work closely with the Manager of Product Management (based in the United States) to bring mobile product initiatives to life. While the broader mobile strategy is defined by product leadership, you will be responsible for guiding that strategy by partnering closely with engineering, design, and analytics teams to deliver high-quality mobile experiences.


You will play a hands-on role in shaping product requirements, collaborating with engineers during sprint cycles, and ensuring mobile features are delivered with clarity, quality, and measurable impact.
The ideal candidate is a strong execution-focused product manager who thrives in fast-moving environments, enjoys working closely with engineering teams, and has deep experience building and iterating on consumer mobile applications.

Essential Functions
As a Senior Product Manager – Mobile, you will:
● Implement the mobile product roadmap in close partnership with the Manager of Product Management and cross-functional teams.
● Collaborate daily with iOS and Android engineering teams to plan, refine, and deliver mobile features.
● Translate product initiatives into clear user stories, product requirements, and acceptance criteria to guide engineering execution.
● Manage and prioritize the mobile product backlog, ensuring work is clearly defined and aligned with roadmap priorities.
● Participate in sprint ceremonies including planning, backlog refinement, and retrospectives to ensure efficient product development cycles.
● Partner with design and engineering teams to deliver intuitive, high-quality mobile experiences for the TCGplayer mobile app.
● Work with analytics and experimentation platforms (e.g., Amplitude, Braze, Segment) to measure feature performance and advise product improvements.

● Support product experimentation efforts designed to improve acquisition, onboarding, activation, and retention within the mobile app.
● Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders across product, engineering, design, and operations to ensure alignment and successful product delivery.
● Ensure new mobile features integrate seamlessly with the broader TCGplayer marketplace and customer experience.
● This role is based in Bengaluru, India, and collaborates closely with global product and engineering teams.
● You are able to maintain at least four hours of daily overlap with U.S. Eastern Time to support collaboration with global teammates. Occasional overlap with U.S. Pacific Time may also be required.

Secondary Functions
You will also contribute to the continued growth of TCGplayer’s product organization by:
● Communicating product priorities and outcomes clearly with stakeholders across teams.
● Using data and experimentation to evaluate product performance and guide future improvements.
● Continuously refining product development processes to improve execution and delivery efficiency.
● Supporting a collaborative and inclusive team culture that values curiosity,
accountability, and customer focus.

Competency (Knowledge, Skills and Abilities)
● 6–10 years of product management experience, including experience working on consumer mobile applications.
● Demonstrated experience delivering features for consumer iOS and Android mobile products.
● Strong experience collaborating closely with engineering teams throughout the product development lifecycle.
● Experience working in Agile development environments with cross-functional teams.
● Experience managing product backlogs and translating product ideas into actionable engineering work.

● Strong experience with product analytics and experimentation, including platforms such as Amplitude, Braze, Segment, or similar tools.
● Strong communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively with engineering, design, and cross-functional stakeholders.
● Ability to balance multiple priorities and implement effectively in a fast-paced product environment.
● Collaborative problem-solving approach with a focus on delivering measurable product outcomes.

Required Qualifications
● Demonstrated success as a product manager delivering consumer-facing mobile experiences.
● Experience working closely with engineering teams to deliver mobile features at scale.
● Strong analytical thinking and experience using data to advise product decisions.

● Experience working in collaborative, cross-functional product teams.

Preferred Qualifications (should have)
● Familiarity with collectible card games such as Pokémon or Magic: The Gathering is strongly preferred.
● Experience working on marketplace, e-commerce, or gaming products.
● Experience building products that support experimentation, growth, or customer engagement.
● Background in agile product development, product ownership, or related certifications.

Additional Details

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.

 

We use cookies to enhance your experience and may use AI tools for administrative tasks in the hiring process. To learn how we handle your personal data and use AI responsibly, please visit our Talent Privacy Notice, Privacy Center, and AI Hiring Guidelines.

The team partners closely with Product, Engineering, Finance, and Legal to ensure VAT/DST requirements are embedded into systems and business models as regulations evolve across Europe, the Middle East, Africa and Asia Pacific.
This role, VAT specialist – EMEA VAT, focuses on VAT and DST strategy, compliance, technology enablement, and risk management. It plays a key role in translating regulatory requirements into scalable solutions, supporting cross-border trade, and strengthening VAT/DST governance. The position based in Bangalore reports within the EMEA Indirect Tax team and contributes to global tax initiatives.

What you will accomplish:

  • Support VAT compliance across EMEA by overseeing multi-jurisdictional requirements, including EU VAT Directive, UK VAT, OSS/IOSS, tax on services and deemed supplier rules

  • Improve accuracy and scalability of VAT/DST processes by partnering with Accounting, Controlling, Product and Engineering to enhance tax determination, reporting, and data integrity

  • Translate complex VAT/DST regulations into system logic and business requirements to support platform and tax engine enhancements

  • Manage VAT/DST compliance activities, including preparation of the returns, filings, coordination with shared services teams and external advisors, and continuous process improvements

  • Support VAT audits and tax authority interactions, working with internal teams to develop strategies to support timely and effective resolution

  • Monitor legislative changes and implement required updates across systems and business processes

  • Provide clear VAT/DST guidance and training to cross-functional teams, supporting business initiatives, expansions, and governance frameworks

  • Support reconciliation verifying data consistency with processes and alignment with expectations

  • Ad-hoc support in case of other internal activities (i.e.: preparation of presentations, preparation of meetings, etc.)

  • Archive management – verify and update the team and tax documentation archive ensuring all documents are correctly stored, in line with company standards. 

  • Support the team with internal tasks such as management of vendors’ onboarding process, management of procurement and purchase orders workflows, support with budget forecasts.

  • Identify and support automation, usage of AI and process improvements to redefine the data management


What you will bring:

  • Experience managing VAT/DST compliance across multiple jurisdictions in an international organisation 

  • Ability to apply VAT/DST expertise within technology environments, including tax engines, ERP systems (e.g., SAP S/4HANA), and automation tools

  • Strong collaboration skills with experience working across Product, Engineering, Finance, and Legal teams

  • Proven experience managing VAT audits and engaging with tax authorities

  • Analytical and research skills to assess legislative changes and business impact

  • Clear communication skills, with the ability to explain complex VAT concepts to diverse audiences

Additional requirements:

  • 3-5 years of indirect tax experience, focused on VAT/DST

  • Background in public accounting and/or a multinational organisation

  • Degree in Tax, Accounting, Finance, Legal, Information Systems, or related field; professional qualification preferred

  • Fluency in English; additional European languages are beneficial

  • Experience with data analytics or AI-enabled tools is a plus

  • Ability to work in a hybrid role both remotely and in person from eBay’s Bangalore office and collaborate across time zones

description_text:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

Job Description 

  • Looking for a company that inspires passion, courage, and creativity, where you can be on the team shaping the future of global commerce? Want to shape how millions of people buy, sell, connect, and share around the world? If you’re interested in joining a purpose driven community that is dedicated to crafting an ambitious and inclusive work environment, join eBay – a company you can be proud to be with.

  • We’re on a mission to build the most intelligent and scalable product knowledge system in eCommerce, powered by AI, structured data, and next-gen taxonomy/ontology strategies.
    We’re looking for a Group Product Manager who thrives at the intersection of structured data, AI/ML, and search optimization—someone who can define the strategy, drive execution, and collaborate deeply with AI, data, and engineering teams to improve how millions of customers discover products.
    In this high-agency, startup-like role, you’ll own and scale the AI-driven product knowledge ecosystem, ensuring our taxonomy, ontology, and catalog data power better search, recommendations, and personalization experiences!

    We are seeking a Group Product Manager, who is passionate about data, search, recommendation, online commerce, AI/ML, generative AI, LLMs, and buyer experience, to lead the Product team. The candidate should be comfortable dealing with ambiguity and have experience defining requirements, driving cross team collaboration, and communicating with executives. In this role, you will work with product managers, engineers, applied researchers, user researchers, designers, and analytics teams to define solutions and make data-driven decisions. This person will be responsible for leveraging generative AI technology to revolutionize Product Knowledge based application cutting across Search, Recommendations and Personalized experiences for eBay to ensure the success of our AI-based features.
     

Responsibilities:

  • Define, implement & own the Product Strategy and Roadmap for products powered by generative AI that will cut across the Product Knowledge organization powering applications across the e-commerce application stack - from retrieval to ads to experiences

  • Translate product strategy into clear and concise specifications, make functional and user interface design tradeoffs, handle product launches, and lead the product successes post-launch.

  • Data driven product decisions with a balance of near-term deliverables and longer-term investment in technology platforms

  • Communicate strategies and trade-offs up to senior leaders and down to development teams

  • Put the customer first, understand market specific nuances, and identify algo improvements to address unique user & application specific needs

  • Drive collaboration across multiple teams to ensure teams are aligned and are working towards solving customer problems

  • Drive A/B testing to identify launch candidates that improve organizational goals

  • Define key metrics and evaluation frameworks to track the impact of structured data improvements on search, recommendations, and personalization.

  • Deeply Integrate with AI/ML Teams – Work hand-in-hand with AI, data science, and engineering to build scalable, automated solutions for listing classification and aspect intelligence and listing annotation

Preferred qualifications:

  • 10+ years with a strong track record product management experience, having previous experience building customer centric products

  • 6+ years of experience in AI/ML product management with specific emphasis on knowledge graphs, a 2+ of years of experience in GenAI and using LLMs to drive business outcomes

  • Strong understanding of product classification, metadata structuring, and entity resolution techniques.

  • Experience optimizing product search, recommendations, and structured navigation.

  • Technical Comfort – Familiarity with SQL, APIs, data pipelines, and AI/ML workflows.

  • A proven track record building new, innovative, and engaging customer experiences informed by customer data from various sources (market research, A/B testing, user research)

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to use data to back up assumptions, recommendations, and drive decision making

  • Technically savvy (prefer a technical role in past, or Computer Science Degree)

  • Passionate advocate for user

  • Demonstrated leadership ability, self-motivated and directed, entrepreneurial ability to innovate quickly

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

Additional Details

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.

 

We use cookies to enhance your experience and may use AI tools for administrative tasks in the hiring process. To learn how we handle your personal data and use AI responsibly, please visit our Talent Privacy Notice, Privacy Center, and AI Hiring Guidelines.

About the Role

We’re on a mission to build the most intelligent and scalable product knowledge system in eCommerce, powered by AI, structured data, and next-gen taxonomy/ontology strategies.

We’re looking for a Product Manager who thrives at the intersection of structured data, AI/ML, and search optimization—someone who can define the strategy, drive execution, and collaborate deeply with AI, data, and engineering teams to improve how millions of customers discover products.

In this high-agency, startup-like role, you’ll own and scale the AI-driven product knowledge ecosystem, ensuring our taxonomy, ontology, and catalog data power better search, recommendations, and personalization experiences.

What You’ll Do

  • Define & Implement Product Knowledge Strategy – Own the roadmap for taxonomy, ontology, structured data, and knowledge graph initiatives, aligning with AI/ML and Product teams.

  •  Drive AI-Powered Taxonomy & Ontology Development – Partner with data scientists, engineers, and analysts to build, test, and scale ML-driven classification, entity resolution, and knowledge graph models.

  •  Improve Search & Product Discovery – Ensure our structured product data directly enhances search relevance, filtering, and recommendation algorithms.

  •  Develop & Enforce Data Standards – Lead governance for taxonomy updates, structured metadata, and attribute standardization, ensuring a scalable and accurate catalog.

  •  Enable LLMs for Product Knowledge – Work with AI teams to develop LLM-powered solutions for automated tagging, classification, and enrichment.

  •  Measure & Iterate – Define key metrics and evaluation frameworks to track the impact of structured data improvements on search, recommendations, and personalization.

  •  Deeply Integrate with AI/ML Teams – Work hand-in-hand with AI, data science, and engineering to build scalable, automated solutions for product classification and catalog intelligence.

 What We’re Looking For

  • Product Leadership in Data/AI – 10+ years in product management, ideally in eCommerce, search, recommendations, or AI-driven product knowledge systems.

  • AI & Data Fluency – Experience working with ML models, knowledge graphs, LLMs, and structured data strategies to drive business outcomes.

  • Taxonomy & Ontology Expertise – Strong understanding of product classification, metadata structuring, and entity resolution techniques.

  • Search & Discovery Focus – Experience optimizing product search, recommendations, and structured navigation.

  • Technical Comfort – Familiarity with SQL, APIs, data pipelines, and AI/ML workflows.

  • High-Agency & Execution-Driven – Startup-like attitude with the ability to drive cross-functional alignment, influence without authority, and deliver results fast.

  • Strong Analytical & Communication Skills – Ability to translate data-driven insights into clear product strategies.

Why Join Us?

  • Shape the AI-powered future of eCommerce product discovery.

  • Be at the forefront of AI-driven taxonomy, ontology, and knowledge graph development.

  • Work in a high-agency, startup-like culture where your decisions directly impact millions of users.

  • Collaborate with ground breaking AI/ML teams to redefine structured data for eCommerce.

  • Drive innovations that enhance search, personalization, sellingg  and product discovery.

Additional Details

  • Set the strategy and operating model for research platforms and systems, including Qualtrics and downstream integrations, ensuring seamless data flows, strong data quality, and fit-for-purpose tooling across teams.

  • Oversee vendor strategy and spend, including selection, onboarding, performance management, and business reviews, in close partnership with Procurement—optimizing investment while maintaining methodological excellence.

  • Build and develop a high-performing Research Operations team, fostering a culture of continuous improvement, experimentation, and learning as the insights and AI landscape evolves.

What you will bring:

  • Extensive experience leading research operations, insights platforms, or data-enabled operations, with ownership of systems, vendors, budgets, and governance in a complex, global organization.

  • Demonstrated ability to apply AI and automation to research or data workflows, translating emerging capabilities into practical, scalable operational solutions.

  • Deep expertise in survey and research operations, including survey design methodology and execution—covering research standards and approaches, sampling strategy, questionnaire design and writing, and end-to-end delivery across qualitative and quantitative methods.

  • Proven leadership in vendor management and procurement partnership, including gap analysis, spend optimization, and performance-driven supplier relationships.

  • Strong cross-functional leadership skills and recognized thought leadership, with the ability to influence across Insights, Analytics, Product, Technology, Legal, Privacy, and Procurement while advancing best practices in research operations.

  • People leadership experience with a track record of building, coaching, and scaling teams, combined with a growth mindset and comfort leading change in fast-evolving environments.

At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

As an LLM Inference Engineer on our AI Platform team, you’ll remove the compute-scaling bottleneck for production LLMs. Your job is to make frontier-model inference fast, efficient, reliable, and observable—the “last mile” from GPUs to APIs that products depend on. This role sits at the intersection of HPC, GPU systems, and MLOps, and requires strong intuition for how model architecture, runtimes, and hardware interact.
What You’ll Do

  • Own production inference: Take models from handoff to production-grade serving, including release engineering, capacity planning, cost optimization, and incident response.

  • Tune inference performance: reduce end-to-end latency and increase throughput across real production traffic patterns.

  • Optimize runtimes and servers: Scale inference across heterogeneous GPU fleets; optimize stacks such as vLLM, Triton, and related components (e.g., schedulers, KV cache, batching, memory).

  • Benchmark and measure: Build benchmarking suites, metrics, and tooling to quantify latency, throughput, GPU utilization, memory, and cost.

  • Reliability and observability: Improve monitoring, tracing, and alerting; participate in incident response and postmortems to harden systems.

  • Apply and ship new optimizations: Evaluate research and implement pragmatic inference optimizations (e.g., quantization, paging, kernel/runtimes improvements).

  • Partner cross-functionally: Work with data science and product teams to translate business requirements into performance and availability SLOs.

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of strong development experience

  • Experience deploying and operating LLM inference services in production.

  • Strong production coding skills in Python plus Go or Rust (systems-level implementation and debugging).

  • Experience with ML frameworks and runtimes: PyTorch, vLLM, SGLang  (and/or TensorRT).

  • Knowledge of GPU architecture and performance (profiling, memory bandwidth/latency tradeoffs); CUDA/kernel programming is a strong plus.

  • Solid understanding of LLM inference and optimization techniques: continuous batching, KV cache management, quantization, speculative decoding (nice-to-have), etc.

  • 3+ years hands-on experience in performance optimization and systems programming for AI/ML workloads.

  • Demonstrated ability to deliver measurable production improvements (e.g., 2X throughput, lower p95/p99 latency, reduced GPU cost).

  • Proven skill in root-cause analysis: finding bottlenecks across model, runtime, networking, and infrastructure.

Additional Details

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.

Looking for a company where you can shape how the world buys, sells, and gives? Where you’ll be part of a work culture that’s been genuinely committed to diversity and inclusion since its founding more than 30 years ago? Where you can just be yourself, do your best work, and have a meaningful impact? If so, we’d love to talk to you.​

We are the Protections team, driving the transformation of the post purchase ecosystem through Cancellations, Returns, Refunds, eBay Money Back Guarantee, Item Not Received, Chargebacks and Seller Standards experiences. Our products are available on web and native applications, serving millions of global users and building trust at every step. We are a data-driven, agile team that embraces AI innovation and fosters a culture of continuous improvements and learning. Join us to make an impact on one of the world’s largest e-commerce websites.

What you'll do and learn:

  • Develop features and services in highly scalable and reliable frontend and/or backend systems in a distributed system environment.

  • Able to translate product and design documents into clean, high-quality, well-tested and maintainable production code autonomously

  • Write test automations and practice continuous integration.

  • Conduct code review for the immediate team.

  • Develop and maintain technical documentation to support software applications.

  • Practices evidence-centered design making features testable, ensuring high quality and improving velocity in continuous delivery.

  • Accountable for multiple subsystems within a larger domain, taking full responsibility for their entire life cycle, including design, development, testing, deployment, observability and monitoring.

  • Propose and evaluate multiple design options, providing estimates for each.

  • Structure and complete tasks independently, meeting deadlines and milestones.

  • Effectively communicate assumptions and seek clarification from stakeholders, ensuring alignment and understanding across all domains.

  • Lead engineering support, release, and on-call responsibilities for an "always-on" 24/7 site.

What you bring:

  • Innovative, team player, excellent communication and decision-making

  • Strong learning ability, self-driven                

  • Excited about new and innovative technologies within immediate field of expertise        

  • Attending knowledge sharing sessions, both within the company and externally

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in EE, CS or other related field or equivalent exp.

  • 4+ years of experience in building large scale, distributed web platforms/APIs as full stack developer

  • Strong CS foundation (data structures, algorithms, OOPs, OOA/D)

  • Experiences in building server-side components (e.g. Java, Sprint/SprintBoot, or other backend programming languages/frameworks, GraphQL) with familiarity with modern Frontend frameworks (e.g. ReactJS, Angular, Marko), or vice versa. 

  • Building data-driven applications (RDBMS, NoSQL, ElasticSearch) 

  • Delivers results in fast-paced environments (agile, TDD, CI/CD)

At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

About the Role
At the intersection of AI, data science, and product discovery, we’re crafting the next generation of eCommerce experiences—and we’re looking for a dynamic leader to help make that vision real.

As Manager of Data Science – Knowledge Management, you’ll be a key architect behind the structured data that fuels search, recommendations, and AI-driven personalization. You’ll lead with both hands-on expertise and strategic insight, bridging the worlds of LLMs, taxonomy, knowledge graphs, and scalable analytics.

This is a high-agency, high-impact role embedded in our Product Knowledge organization, where you’ll drive meaningful innovation across catalog systems, metadata, and data-driven product experiences. If you thrive in a fast-paced, startup-like environment and are passionate about turning complex data into magical customer experiences, this is your stage.

What You’ll Lead & Deliver

  • Optimize Product Knowledge at Scale
    Conduct deep analytical dives using SQL and Python to enhance taxonomy, ontology, and structured catalog data that directly impact product discovery.

  • Build LLM-Powered Solutions
    Use prompt engineering and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to create scalable, AI-powered tools for classification, data enrichment, and catalog intelligence.

  • Design Model Evaluation Frameworks
    Establish robust metrics and test beds to evaluate semantic search models, embeddings, and ML-powered classification systems.

  • Turn Data into Strategy
    Translate insights into action by partnering with Product, Engineering, and AI teams—driving roadmap priorities for catalog optimization, entity resolution, and knowledge graph evolution.

  • Prototype & Experiment Rapidly
    Move quickly to test ideas and validate structured data strategies. Build proof-of-concepts that can scale into enterprise-level solutions.

  • Partner for Production Impact
    Collaborate closely with applied ML, engineering, and product teams to refine and operationalize AI models in real-world, high-scale systems.

What You Bring

  • 7+ years of experience in analytics, data science, or ML roles

  • Advanced proficiency in SQL and Python for analytics, automation, and experimentation

  • Familiarity with eCommerce discovery, product classification, and search or recommendation systems

  • Hands-on experience with LLMs, prompt engineering, or RAG (preferred but not required)

  • Strong grasp of model evaluation, including metrics design and benchmarking

  • A startup mindset—bias for action, high ownership, and comfort with ambiguity

At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

About the Role
At the intersection of AI, data science, and product discovery, we’re crafting the next generation of eCommerce experiences—and we’re looking for a dynamic leader to help make that vision real.

As Manager of Data Science – Knowledge Management, you’ll be a key architect behind the structured data that fuels search, recommendations, and AI-driven personalization. You’ll lead with both hands-on expertise and strategic insight, bridging the worlds of LLMs, taxonomy, knowledge graphs, and scalable analytics.

This is a high-agency, high-impact role embedded in our Product Knowledge organization, where you’ll drive meaningful innovation across catalog systems, metadata, and data-driven product experiences. If you thrive in a fast-paced, startup-like environment and are passionate about turning complex data into magical customer experiences, this is your stage.

What You’ll Lead & Deliver

  • Optimize Product Knowledge at Scale
    Conduct deep analytical dives using SQL and Python to enhance taxonomy, ontology, and structured catalog data that directly impact product discovery.

  • Build LLM-Powered Solutions
    Use prompt engineering and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to create scalable, AI-powered tools for classification, data enrichment, and catalog intelligence.

  • Design Model Evaluation Frameworks
    Establish robust metrics and test beds to evaluate semantic search models, embeddings, and ML-powered classification systems.

  • Turn Data into Strategy
    Translate insights into action by partnering with Product, Engineering, and AI teams—driving roadmap priorities for catalog optimization, entity resolution, and knowledge graph evolution.

  • Prototype & Experiment Rapidly
    Move quickly to test ideas and validate structured data strategies. Build proof-of-concepts that can scale into enterprise-level solutions.

  • Partner for Production Impact
    Collaborate closely with applied ML, engineering, and product teams to refine and operationalize AI models in real-world, high-scale systems.

What You Bring

  • 7+ years of experience in analytics, data science, or ML roles

  • Advanced proficiency in SQL and Python for analytics, automation, and experimentation

  • Familiarity with eCommerce discovery, product classification, and search or recommendation systems

  • Hands-on experience with LLMs, prompt engineering, or RAG (preferred but not required)

  • Strong grasp of model evaluation, including metrics design and benchmarking

  • A startup mindset—bias for action, high ownership, and comfort with ambiguity

  • Excellent communicator with the ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders

Why You’ll Love It Here

  • Drive real impact at the core of product discovery innovation

  • Work hands-on with cutting-edge AI and data platforms

  • Collaborate with some of the best minds in AI, Product, and Engineering

  • Own high-visibility projects in a startup-like, high-trust culture

  • Build scalable, magical, and relevant product data systems used by millions

Additional Details

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. As a Senior Software Architect, you will play a critical role in defining and evolving the architecture of eBay’s next-generation shipping and logistics platforms. You will partner closely with engineering, product, and business teams to solve complex logistics challenges, drive architectural innovation, and improve platform scalability, reliability, and operational excellence.

  • Lead the architecture and design of large-scale distributed systems powering eBay’s Shipping platform

  • Drive development of high-performance backend services with strong focus on scalability, reliability, and resiliency

  • Define and implement architectural strategies that improve transaction efficiency, system throughput, and customer experience

  • Design scalable integrations with global carrier and logistics ecosystems

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, product, payments, and fulfillment teams to deliver innovative platform capabilities

  • Mentor engineers and technical leads, promoting engineering excellence, best practices, and architectural standards

  • Evaluate and adopt emerging technologies to improve platform performance, interoperability, and operational efficiency

  • Contribute hands-on to critical system design, implementation, troubleshooting, and production operations

What You Bring

  • 12+ years of software development experience building large-scale, high-volume distributed systems

  • Strong experience designing and architecting microservices-based cloud platforms

  • Proven expertise in backend system architecture and scaling platforms for significant user and transaction growth

  • Experience in shipping, logistics, supply chain, or fulfillment domains is highly preferred

  • Proficiency in Java or Python, with deep understanding of distributed systems and backend engineering principles

  • Strong knowledge of cloud-native technologies, APIs, event-driven architectures, and CI/CD practices

  • Demonstrated ability to solve complex technical problems and influence architectural decisions across teams

  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • Experience working in Agile environments and modern software delivery practices

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent practical experience)

We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

About Team and Role:

The Payment Ops Tech team is seeking an Engineer to help build and scale eBay’s global Compliance Operations platform. This platform is the technical backbone for our regulatory strategy, powering critical systems for KYC, AML, Sanctions Screening, Product Safety & Tax compliance. In this role, you will take ownership of specific project modules and features—from design through deployment—with mentorship and guidance from senior engineers. You will contribute to the development of high-performance distributed systems, building robust APIs, event processing workflows and batch jobs. As an active practitioner of TDD and DevOps, you will maintain high code quality and gain valuable exposure to integrating AI/ML models into production environments. If you are a proactive developer with strong Java fundamentals and a passion for solving complex backend challenges within a collaborative team, we want to hear from you.
Responsibilities
  • Own project modules or minor features from design through deployment with guidance from senior engineers.
  • Contribute to the development of distributed software applications, including APIs, event processing, and batch jobs.
  • Execute automated testing at the unit and integration levels to maintain code health.
  • Participate in brainstorming and assist in building prototypes for new initiatives.
  • Support software releases, site upgrades, and the application of security patches.
  • Engage in code reviews to learn and maintain high-quality, consistent implementation standards.

Qualifications
  • Master’s degree in Computer Science (or related); OR a Bachelor’s degree with 3+ years of relevant experience. (Educational background in Machine Learning is a plus).
  • 3+ years of practical experience in software development and distributed systems.
  • Proficiency in Java 17+, Spring Framework, and Spring Boot.
  • Solid understanding of Spring Batch, OOP, and Data Structures & Algorithms.
  • Experience working with Event Processing (Kafka, JMS, or MQ) and Relational/NoSQL databases.
  • Working knowledge of RESTful APIs (Spring MVC, Jersey, etc.) and Microservices concepts.
  • Familiarity with AI/ML concepts or exposure to integrating ML models in production environments.
  • Experience with Agile methodology and DevOps practices, including CI/CD pipelines.
  • Proficient in Test-Driven Development (TDD) and testing frameworks like JUnit and Mockito.
  • Basic understanding of Cloud infrastructure (AWS/Azure/GCP) and Docker/Containerization.
  • Ability to troubleshoot technical issues and provide support across the software development life cycle.
  • Strong communication skills and a proactive approach to collaborating within a team environment.

Additional Details

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.

The Global Facilities Operations team, part of Enterprise Management Resources, is responsible for delivering safe, resilient, and high-quality workplace environments across eBay’s global footprint.

As the Country Facilities Manager for India, you will lead facilities operations across multiple sites, partnering with business and functional leaders to deliver consistent, scalable services that support both employee experience and business performance. This is the senior-most facilities role in-country, reporting to the APAC Regional Facilities Manager.
 

This role combines strategic and operational leadership with a strong people-first approach, crafting environments where employees feel supported, included, and able to do their best work.

What you will accomplish

  • Lead facilities operations across India, creating safe, compliant, and high-performing workplace environments aligned with global standards
  • Build trusted, collaborative relationships with collaborators, actively listening and translating business needs into effective workplace solutions
  • Drive vendor performance and accountability through clear SLAs, benchmarks, and governance frameworks
  • Manage operating budgets and optimise costs while maintaining high service quality and employee experience
  • Standardise processes and practices across sites while adapting to local requirements
  • Foster an inclusive, people-first workplace culture that supports employee wellbeing, engagement, and efficiency

What you will bring

  • 7+ years experience leading multi-site facilities or workplace operations within a country or region. Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Facilities Management, Engineering, Business, Hospitality, or a related field and relevant certifications (e.g. CFM, FMP, LEED, PMP) are advantageous.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead with empathy, build inclusive teams, and compose a positive and encouraging workplace culture
  • Strong skills in managing collaborators, with the ability to understand perspectives and influence effectively in a matrixed organisation
  • Expertise in vendor management, including contract oversight and performance improvement
  • Strong financial competence and ability to balance critical thinking with hands-on operational execution in a dynamic environment

The Global Information Security (GIS) Team makes sure that eBay continues to be a safe virtual marketplace. The Application Security Engineering team makes sure all business processes are secured, via optimized process and automation. We are looking for experienced security developers to join us in the Application Security Engineering team.

You will help develop and support innovative solutions that strengthen the secure DevOps offerings of the security application group. You will complete processes that fine-tune security rules and improve detection and mitigation efficiency. You will provide hands-on engineering support to secure DevOps and ML DevOps automations. You will collaborate with peer InfoSec teams during security incident investigations and reviews, driving the security charter across the organization. Additionally, you will help develop scalable security management tools and test suites that help securely release eBay’s public facing product lines. The ideal candidate person will be a software developer with engineering experience working on Security attack surface reduction through foundational product security fixes.

What you’ll bring:


- BSCS degree with 5-7 years of experience or an MS degree with 3+ years of experience
- Proven hands-on product development experience with web applications is required;

- General understanding of Security in CI/CD process and basic usage of AI tools and terminologies are required

- Strong familiarity with AI/ML, LLM concepts, implementations and their security implications;

- Familiarity with AI developer tools (Copilot, Claude, etc) will be highly advantageous

- Knowledge of integration of security automation solutions with systems like GitHub and Open-Source Security solutions is advantageous

- Strong Programming experience in development of user interface of web-based tools (Node.js, React JS, Angular JS)
- Ability to build automation tools and REST API-s for security processes and web applications on Java (with Spring MVC) and familiarity with databases (Hadoop, noSQL, Oracle, etc) is required. Knowledge of other languages like Python is a plus. Knowledge of GraphQL is a plus
- Ability to deep dive into SAST/DAST/SCA scan data (from security scanning tools like Invicti, Appscan, Checkmarx, semgrep) and logs to analyze for security gaps will be a major plus

- Working experience with product development teams in Agile frameworks in a continuous delivery process is expected.

- Basic understanding of threat modelling, security reviews, security incident troubleshooting would be very beneficial for the day to day tasks

- Familiarity with generation of metrics via real time dashboards and self-healing automated application monitoring. Data analytics experience would be a major plus
- Ability to clearly articulate issues and professionally communicate in an effective manner.
- Ability to identify risk based on context and adjust quickly to the security needs

model) with ability to ramp quickly.</span></li><li><span>Ability to lead ambiguous technical initiatives and drive cross-functional delivery across sites/time zones.</span></li></ul><p></p><h2>Strong At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

About the Team and Role

eBay's Site Network Engineering team designs and engineers the production fabrics connecting eBay's server fleet across data centers, POPs, and other properties. We run 100% SONiC-based open networking in production across six switch vendor families on multiple merchant silicon families. Zero availability-impacting fabric incidents every year since the SONiC transition began.

You will establish SONiC platform engineering as an in-house function — this is a greenfield mandate, not a backfill. You own the full stack from ASIC layer through production deployment, with direct influence on architecture, release quality, and vendor strategy. A near-term goal is converging to a single SONiC release across all six vendor families; this role is central to that.

What You'll Do

  • Drive end-to-end platform enablement for new switch hardware (transceivers/CMIS, optics qualification and tuning, thermal/PSU/fan/watchdog/sensors, EEPROM, LED/CPLD/FPGA as required).
  • Lead ASIC SDK + SAI integration: vendor SDK integration/customization, SAI behavior tuning/modeling, syncd adaptations, dataplane correctness, performance, and stability.
  • Design production reliability across the stack: warm/fast reboot correctness, upgrade safety, and high availability under load (hitless patterns where applicable).
  • Debug and resolve complex issues across kernel/drivers → SDK/firmware → SONiC services (SWSS/orchagent, Redis DBs, containers), with strong bias for reproducibility and root-cause closure.
  • Deliver features on real hardware and meet scale/performance targets (buffers/QoS/queues/counters/telemetry, link/port behavior, failure handling).
  • Define and operationalize release processes: gating, rollback strategy, known-issue management, and production-readiness standards.
  • Serve as key technical interface with ASIC vendors and ODMs, driving escalations and influencing outcomes.
  • Build CI/CD pipelines, automated testing (PTF, SpyTest or equivalent), hardware-in-the-loop validation, and regression coverage.
  • Contribute to upstream SONiC when appropriate and define a responsible fork/upstream strategy.
  • Mentor peers and contribute to team growth as we scale (people management not required).

What Success Looks Like (First 6–12 Months)

  • Enable or materially stabilize at least one ASIC/platform family with measurable improvements (reboot reliability, crash rate, performance baselines, scale targets).
  • Deliver a repeatable ASIC SDK integration + qualification pipeline.
  • Establish foundational processes (testing, CI/CD, release discipline, vendor engagement) so the capability scales smoothly.

Must-Have Qualifications

  • Strong Linux systems software development background with C/C++ and expert debugging skills (gdb, perf, strace, core dumps).
  • Production experience programming switching ASICs via vendor SDKs and/or SAI — including integration, behavioral tuning, and performance/stability troubleshooting.
  • Delivered SDK/SAI-based switching features on real hardware in a production or production-like environment.
  • Working knowledge of SONiC internals or equivalent NOS (SAI/syncd, SWSS/orchagent, Redis DBs, container model) with ability to ramp quickly.
  • Ability to lead ambiguous technical initiatives and drive cross-functional delivery across sites/time zones.

Strong Differentiators

  • Track record partnering with merchant silicon vendors, including escalation management and influencing outcomes.
  • Direct upstream contributions to SONiC, SAI, FRR, or Linux kernel networking.
  • Deep SAI behavioral expertise (ACL, QoS, buffers, ECMP, counters, telemetry).
  • Optics qualification, tuning, and vendor-specific behavior across transceiver families.

Additional Details

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible.
