description_text:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

Looking for a company that inspires passion, courage, and creativity—where you can help shape the future of global commerce? At eBay, you’ll work on technology that impacts how millions of people buy, sell, connect, and share around the world.

We’re a purpose-driven, inclusive community committed to innovation and empowering small businesses globally.

Join the Customer Support Technology team building the backend systems that power eBay’s global customer service experience. You will design and implement scalable APIs, contribute to workflow frameworks and automation services, and set a higher standard on reliability, performance, and observability across a 20‑year codebase that continues to evolve.

This is an IC role with a strong hands‑on focus—expect to spend 75% of your time designing and coding, with the remainder on reviews, tooling, and cross‑team collaboration. You’ll own components end‑to‑end, write high‑quality tests, and partner closely with product, SRE, and analytics to improve agent productivity and customer outcomes.

Must‑Have

  • BS/MS in CS, EE, or related field (or equivalent practical experience).

  • 8+ years of backend engineering experience (Java preferred) building distributed services and public/internal APIs.

  • Proficiency in Java (11+), Spring Boot, and REST API design; familiarity with SOAP and GraphQL a plus.

  • Messaging & stream processing concepts (e.g., Kafka, Flink or equivalents).

  • Datastores: Oracle and at least one NoSQL system; strong SQL fundamentals.

  • Agile & DevOps: CI/CD (Jenkins/GitHub Actions), containers (Docker/Kubernetes), IaC basics, monitoring/alerting.

  • Quality discipline: unit/integration tests (JUnit/TestNG), code coverage, code reviews, and clean code practices.

  • Ability to translate requirements into clean, efficient, extensible, maintainable code; solid debugging/problem‑solving.

  • We value engineers who think in systems, communicate clearly, and ship pragmatically.

Additionally:

  • Working knowledge of modern frontend technologies (e.g., JavaScript/TypeScript, React or Angular) sufficient to contribute to UI components and integrations when needed

Preferred

  • Experience with customer‑support–adjacent systems (case/contact management, workflow orchestration, SaaS integrations).

  • Familiarity with AI‑assisted development and automation (agent assist, summarization, test generation).

  • Exposure to observability stacks (Prometheus/Grafana/Splunk), OAuth2/OIDC security, and zero‑downtime releases.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, and evolve backend APIs and services for agent tools, workflow engines, and automation platforms.

  • Write well‑tested code; define observability (metrics/logs/traces) and contribute to SLOs with SRE.

  • Profile and improve latency, throughput, and reliability; assist with on‑call rotations (follow‑the‑sun).

  • Review PRs, author design docs/RFCs, and partner with product to translate functional requirements.

  • Triage and reduce tech debt, participate in post‑incident reviews, and drive preventative fixes.

  • Mentor juniors or led a small workstream as a tech lead within a squad.

Here at eBay, we love creating opportunities for others by connecting people from widely diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and geographies. So, being diverse and inclusive isn’t just something we strive for, it is who we are, and part of what we do each and every single day. We want to ensure that as an employee, you feel eBay is a place where, no matter who you are, you feel safe, included, and that you have the opportunity to bring your unique self to work. To learn about eBay’s Diversity & Inclusion click here: https://www.ebayinc.com/our-company/diversity-inclusion/.

Additional Details

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.

 

We use cookies to enhance your experience and may use AI tools for administrative tasks in the hiring process. To learn how we handle your personal data and use AI responsibly, please visit our Talent Privacy Notice, Privacy Center, and AI Hiring Guidelines.

Recommendations are a core part of how our buyers navigate eBay’s vast and varied inventory. Our team develops state-of-the-art recommendations systems, including deep learning based retrieval systems for personalized recommendations, machine learned ranking models, GenAI/LLM powered recommendations, as well as advanced MLOps in a high volume traffic industrial e-commerce setting.

We are building cutting edge recommender systems powered by the latest ML, NLP, LLM/GenAI/RAG and AI technologies. Additionally, we are building production integrations with Google GCP Vertex AI platforms to supercharge our item recommendation algorithms. Come join our innovative engineering and applied research team!

This is an opportunity to:

  • Influence how people will interact with eBay’s recommender systems in the future, and how recommender systems technology will evolve

  • Work with unique and large data sets of unstructured multimodal data representing eBay's vast and varied inventory, including billions of items and millions of users

  • Develop and deploy state-of-the-art AI models to production which have direct measurable impact on eBay buyers

  • Deploy big data technology and large scale data pipelines

  • Drive marketplace GMB as well as advertising revenue via organic and sponsored recommendations

Qualifications:

  • MS in Computer Science or related area with 3 years of relevant work experience (or BS/BA with 5 years) in Engineering / Machine Learning / AI

  • Experience building large scale distributed applications and expertise in any OO language (Scala, Java, etc.) 

  • Experience building with no sql databases and key value stores (MongoDB, Redis, etc)

  • Generalist with a can do attitude and willingness to learn/pick up new skill sets as needed

  • Experience with big data pipelines (Hadoop, Spark) is a plus 

  • Experience in AI applied research and industrial recommendation systems is a plus

  • Experience with Large Language Models (LLMs) and prompt engineering is a plus

description_text:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

As a Capacity Planning Engineer at eBay, you will play a vital role in influencing the financial architecture of our ecommerce platform. This is an outstanding opportunity to lead the charge in optimizing our resource management and ensuring flawless operations across our engineering stack.

Responsibilities:

  • Partner with platform teams to plan and execute capacity strategy across hybrid environments (on-prem Kubernetes, Azure, GCP)

  • Basic understanding of AI including tokens, LLMs, Vector Database, Prefill-Decode process, Semantic caching, scalability and sizing needed to collaborate with the platform team for capacity planning

  • Basic understanding of the Hadoop Platform, Spark, MapReduce, HDFS, Data Compression techniques, bottlenecks and sizing concepts needed to collaborate with the platform team for capacity planning

  • Partner with Search Platform and Engineering teams to help with basic capacity planning exercise around sizing index and traffic growth

  • Analyze infrastructure demand, utilization, and performance to forecast capacity needs and optimize allocation across compute, storage, and network resources

  • Coordinate capacity intake and resource prioritization, balancing requirements across data centers, supply chain, and network infrastructure

  • Monitor system performance and utilization to identify bottlenecks and underutilized resources; drive optimization initiatives to improve efficiency and cost

  • Design and develop dashboards and observability solutions using Grafana, Prometheus, etc. to provide actionable insights

  • Provide regular reporting on capacity status, trends, forecasts, and optimization opportunities to enable data-driven decision-making

  • Perform and contribute to root cause analysis of capacity-related incidents; implement corrective actions to improve availability, reliability, and customer experience

  • Evaluate and improve capacity engineering processes, tools, and methodologies to increase accuracy, efficiency, and scalability

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Engineering, Platforms, Product, Data Center) to align infrastructure capacity with business objectives and upcoming initiatives

  • Conduct “what-if” and scenario modeling to assess the impact of traffic growth, new features, and infrastructure changes

  • Support large-scale, federated Kubernetes environments to ensure high availability, scalability, and efficient resource utilization

  • Contribute to tooling and automation for capacity planning, performance analysis, and workload optimization

  • Ensure infrastructure meets performance targets, SLAs, and business continuity requirements while maintaining efficient utilization

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in a technical field. 

  • 2 years work experience as a software engineer, cloud engineer or capacity planning Engineer 

  • Proven experience managing highly complex, technically challenging projects

  • Strong engineering, scripting, and data analysis skills; self-sufficient data analyst and technologist. Cloud experience is a plus

Preferred Qualifications

  • Masters in engineering and CS degrees preferred

  • 2 years of pertinent work experience

  • Excellent oral/written communication, and analytical skills.

  • Outstanding organizational, prioritization, and multitasking skills.

  • Proven ability to work as a teamplayer, ability to work on tasks independently and deliver solutions in a highly complex, dynamic environment

Additional Details

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.

 

We use cookies to enhance your experience and may use AI tools for administrative tasks in the hiring process. To learn how we handle your personal data and use AI responsibly, please visit our Talent Privacy Notice, Privacy Center, and AI Hiring Guidelines.

We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

About the Team and Role:

TCGplayer connects hobbyists and hobby businesses to communities. We relentlessly improve the exchange of things and thoughts that fuel passions, providing the most compelling destination and tools for collectible card game enthusiasts and professional sellers! TCGplayer, now a part of eBay, promotes and drives growth of our products and services by connecting a global community of millions of buyers with tens of thousands of retailers in a $25B global collectible hobby market.

The Mobile Application Team owns our commitment to empower hobbyists to effortlessly engage with our marketplace, driving growth and loyalty. We embody innovation, agility, and a relentless focus on the hobbyist to create exceptional experiences. Our mobile engineering team thrives on a core foundation of quality, collaboration, ownership, and an unwavering commitment to excellence.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will architect and develop exceptional mobile experiences that empower our hobbyists. We are looking for a team member driven by user-centric approaches, innovation, collaboration, agility, and commitment to quality. You will lead the charge in critical architectural and development guidelines that define our mobile application products.   Your strategic vision and leadership will be key in ensuring our mobile experience is at the forefront of technology and provides unparalleled hobbyists experiences.


What you will accomplish: 

  • Provide technical expertise for mobile engineering across the organization, influencing architecture, standards, and guidelines

  • Design, architect independent feature with hands-on develop high-quality native mobile solutions that scale to millions of users

  • Partnering with Lead on mobile platform architecture, ensuring security, reliability, performance, and an exceptional user experience

  • Influence the mobile technical roadmap, balancing short-term delivery with long-term platform health

  • Partner closely with Staff/lead Engineer, designers, backend engineers, cloud platform teams, and ML engineers to deliver cohesive, end-to-end features

  • Lead initiatives that improve development velocity, quality, observability, and operational excellence

  • Identify technical risks early, communicate tradeoffs clearly, and implement mitigation strategies

  • Champion guidelines for development, testing, deployment, monitoring, and on-call readiness

  • Ship Product features capabilities using feature flags, experimentation frameworks, and gradual rollouts, and iterate based on real-world usage and feedback

 

What you will bring: 

  • 5+ years of experience building native mobile applications, with deep, hands-on expertise in iOS (Swift/SwiftUI required)

  • Deep understanding of mobile architecture, design patterns, lifecycle management, and performance optimization

  • Experience building secure, consumer-facing mobile apps with high availability and scalability

  • Hands-on experience with WebView integrations alongside native UI components

  • Experience with Computer Vision and real-time frame processing.

  • Experience with shared C++ components across iOS and Android.

  • Experience integrating AI/ML capabilities into production mobile applications

  • Strong understanding of secure data handling & privacy considerations, including PII, consent management, and regional compliance requirements

Collaboration: 

  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain technical decisions, tradeoffs, risks, and opportunities to both technical and non-technical collaborators

  • Experience working in Agile or Scrum environments

  • Ability to conduct research, analyze results, and apply findings to real-world product decisions

  • Experience participating in “on-call” support for critical systems.

Why You’ll Love Working Here:

  • A culture that values collaboration, diversity, ownership, and passion

  • Opportunity to work on products used by millions of hobbyists worldwide

  • The chance to shape the future of mobile and AI-powered experiences at scale

Additional Details

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.

description_text:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

About Team and Role:

TCGplayer connects hobbyists and hobby businesses to communities. We relentlessly improve the exchange of things and thoughts that fuel passions, providing the most compelling destination and tools for collectible card game enthusiasts and professional sellers! TCGplayer, now a part of eBay, promotes and drives growth of our products and services by connecting a global community of millions of buyers with tens of thousands of retailers in a $25B global collectible hobby market.

The Mobile Application Team owns our commitment to empower hobbyists to effortlessly engage with our marketplace, driving growth and loyalty. We embody innovation, agility, and a relentless focus on the hobbyist to create exceptional experiences. Our mobile engineering team thrives on a core foundation of quality, collaboration, ownership, and an unwavering commitment to excellence.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will architect and develop exceptional mobile experiences that empower our hobbyists. We are looking for a team member driven by user-centric approaches, innovation, collaboration, agility, and commitment to quality. You will lead the charge in critical architectural and development standard methodologies that define our mobile application products.   Your strategic vision and leadership will be key in ensuring our mobile experience is at the forefront of technology and provides unparalleled hobbyists experiences.

 
What you will accomplish: 

  • Provide technical expertise for mobile engineering across the organization, influencing architecture, standards, and best practices

  • Design, architect independent feature with hands-on develop high-quality native mobile solutions that scale to millions of users

  • Partnering with Lead on mobile platform architecture, ensuring security, reliability, performance, and an exceptional user experience

  • Influence the mobile technical roadmap, balancing short-term delivery with long-term platform health

  • Partner closely with Staff/lead Engineer, designers, backend engineers, cloud platform teams, and ML engineers to deliver cohesive, end-to-end features

  • Lead initiatives that improve development velocity, quality, observability, and operational excellence

  • Identify technical risks early, communicate tradeoffs clearly, and implement mitigation strategies

  • Champion best practices for development, testing, deployment, monitoring, and on-call readiness

  • Ship Product features capabilities using feature flags, experimentation frameworks, and gradual rollouts, and iterate based on real-world usage and feedback

 

What you will bring: 

  • 7+ years of experience building native mobile applications, with deep, hands-on expertise in Android (Kotlin/Jetpack required)

  • Deep understanding of mobile architecture, design patterns, lifecycle management, and performance optimization

  • Experience building secure, consumer-facing mobile apps with high availability and scalability

  • Hands-on experience with WebView integrations alongside native UI components

  • Experience with Computer Vision and real-time frame processing.

  • Experience with shared C++ components across iOS and Android.

  • Experience integrating AI/ML capabilities into production mobile applications

  • Strong understanding of secure data handling & privacy considerations, including PII, consent management, and regional compliance requirements

Collaboration: 

  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain technical decisions, tradeoffs, risks, and opportunities to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • Experience working in Agile or Scrum environments

  • Ability to conduct research, analyze results, and apply learnings to real-world product decisions

  • Experience participating in “on-call” support for critical systems.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • A culture that values collaboration, diversity, ownership, and passion

  • Opportunity to work on products used by millions of hobbyists worldwide

  • The chance to shape the future of mobile and AI-powered experiences at scale

Additional Details

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.

 

We use cookies to enhance your experience and may use AI tools for administrative tasks in the hiring process. To learn how we handle your personal data and use AI responsibly, please visit our Talent Privacy Notice, Privacy Center, and AI Hiring Guidelines.

We are seeking a Senior IT Auditor with experience in IT auditing to join eBay’s Global Internal Audit team located in Bengaluru, India. This position is hybrid, requiring physical attendance at least three days each week.

In this role, you will help implement IT audits throughout eBay Inc. You will collaborate with global audit team members and partners across different time zones. Your work includes performing control testing, identifying control gaps and business risks, and contributing to meaningful, outcome-focused audit results.

This position reports to the Senior Manager, Internal Audit and plays a key role in strengthening audit execution and collaboration across our global Internal Audit organization.

The ideal candidate is analytical, diligent, and collaborative, with a strong sense of ownership and a desire to contribute beyond meeting requirements.

What you will accomplish:

  • Complete IT audit programs, including control build and operating efficiency testing, following Internal Audit methodology.

  • Collaborate with Internal Audit team members across regions to implement and complete audit engagements, including working across time zones as needed.

  • Identify control weaknesses, process gaps, and business risks, then convert risks into clear, actionable audit issues and recommendations.

  • Draft audit documentation and findings, and support the preparation of clear, concise, and impactful audit reports.

  • Facilitate issue tracking, validation of remediation, and timely closure of audit findings.

  • Contribute to continuous improvement of audit processes and find opportunities to improve audit efficiency and value to the organization.

What you will bring:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

  • 4+ years of experience in internal audit, external audit, compliance, risk management, finance, and/or business operations.

  • Professional certification such as CPA, CIA, CISA, or equivalent preferred.

  • Knowledge of business workflows and internal controls, along with the skill to pinpoint control gaps and areas for improving operations.

  • Analytical and problem-solving skills, with a practical, solution-focused approach.

  • Demonstrated written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly communicate audit results to diverse collaborators across functions, regions, and levels (including senior management).

  • Proven ability to manage multiple audit assignments and priorities in a fast-paced, global environment.

  • Proactive, driven by achieving goals, and collaborative working style, with a strong focus on quality and accountability.

  • High attention to detail and dedication to accuracy.

  • Ability to travel occasionally, as business needs require.

Additional Details

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.

 

We use cookies to enhance your experience and may use AI tools for administrative tasks in the hiring process. To learn how we handle your personal data and use AI responsibly, please visit our Talent Privacy Notice, Privacy Center, and AI Hiring Guidelines.

description_text:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

About the team and the role:

TCGplayer connects hobbyists and hobby businesses to communities. We relentlessly improve the exchange of things and thoughts that fuel passions, providing the most compelling destination and tools for collectible card game enthusiasts and professional sellers! TCGplayer, now a part of eBay, promotes and drives growth of our products and services by connecting a global community of millions of buyers with tens of thousands of retailers in a $25B global collectible hobby market.

As a Software Engineer II, you will help design, build, and maintain the systems that power TCGplayer's Customer Experience (CX) platform. Your work will enable our CX agents to efficiently support both Buyers and Sellers across every aspect of TCGplayer's business. You will contribute to modernizing applications into a microservice-based architecture, integrate with internal systems and third-party platforms, and collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable and reliable customer support solutions.

Build and deliver scalable enterprise applications and platform services using C#/.NET, modern frontend technologies, event-driven systems, and AWS cloud services.

What you will accomplish:

  • Develop backend services and APIs using C#/.NET.

  • Build and support enterprise applications and microservices.

  • Contribute to event-driven solutions using Apache Kafka.

  • Develop user-facing features using React.js/Vue.js.

  • Integrate applications with internal and external systems.

  • Participate in performance optimization, testing, and production support.

  • Implement monitoring, logging, and CI/CD best practices.

  • Collaborate with senior engineers on architecture and technical design.

What you will bring:

  • 4–6 years of experience in C#/.NET 6/7/8 development.

  • Experience with ASP.NET Core and REST API development.

  • Experience with React.js/Vue.js and JavaScript/TypeScript.

  • Experience with Python is good to have.

  • Experience with Apache Kafka, Event-Driven Architecture, and Microservices.

  • Hands-on experience with AWS (EC2, ECS/EKS, Lambda, S3, RDS, DynamoDB).

  • Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, Terraform, and Git.

  • Experience with PostgreSQL and/or MySQL.

  • MongoDB experience is a plus.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field.

  • Experience building and supporting enterprise applications in production.

  • Exposure to cloud-native development and distributed systems.

Additional Details

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.

 

We use cookies to enhance your experience and may use AI tools for administrative tasks in the hiring process. To learn how we handle your personal data and use AI responsibly, please visit our Talent Privacy Notice, Privacy Center, and AI Hiring Guidelines.

Overview

The Senior Systems Engineer  will be part of the Data Services team under the Information Technology Services and Solutions group that will design and develop data applications and integrations for eBay’s global business and corporate services. This hands-on role will have the responsibility of developing, leading, and overseeing multiple data and integration related technology activities at a time. The candidate will provide architectural solutions, lead software development teams, perform software development, build POC, product and tool road maps, partner with multiple application development teams across the globe to influence business solutions and co-ordinate multiple data and integration projects across the enterprise.

You will also be part of designing and overseeing the delivery of functional & technical components for data catalog solutions. You will partner closely with production teams, design and develop dev-ops solutions and ensure smooth handoffs to sustaining teams and design solutions that are stable, scalable, and optimized for monitoring as well as participate in support operations

Responsibilities:

  • Installation and maintenance of software and hardware for BI related applications and systems in Production/DEV/QA.

  • Provide BI administration in key areas such as Security, Patching, System Utilization/Capacity, Performance tuning/Optimization, and Issue troubleshooting and root cause analysis.

  • Monitoring of the health and performance of the system and infrastructure.

  • Maintaining linux server environments both onPrem and in the cloud.

  • Design and maintain automated CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions) to streamline code deployment.

  • Work with development and business teams to resolve issues and maintain a healthy SDLC with end-to-end solutions.

  • Manage & Implement solutions around data governance, security, and compliance provided by the Application provider.

  • Maintain standard operating procedures and technical documentation.

Skills / Requirements:

  • Intermediate/Advanced knowledge & experience with SQL, Linux/Shell.

  • Comfortable with administering a Linux server not limited to patching, user access etc.

  • Hands-on admin experience on Tableau, MicroStrategy/Strategy reporting tools highly preferred.

  • Good understanding of Data Warehousing and Relational database concepts & technologies. 

  • Ability to setup and automate BI platform related activities using scripting languages like Python/Shell scripting.

  • Ability to work on building Jenkins pipelines, github actions.

  • Ability to build/maintain dashboards to capture BI user tracking/logging, usage monitoring and reporting at an enterprise level.

  • Ability to build frameworks that can be used for report server upgrade, refresh data source/report and take regular backup via Rest APIs.

  • Ability to manage and own complex tasks requiring cross-team coordination

  • Adhere to eBay Standards and participate in the IT organization's activities to develop new eBay SOP as industry standards and procedures evolve.

  • Administer all aspects of a company's bare-metal/cloud-based applications, including its comprehensive user access permissions and security.

  • Strong project and time management skills with an ability to set and maintain multiple, and often competing priorities.

  • Good english language skills written & oral

  • Strong desire to learn and develop additional skills and expertise over time, driving process evolution.

  • Self-starter that is highly adaptable, able to thrive in a changing, dynamic environment

  • Strong understanding of BI technologies and concepts.

The Value You Deliver:

  • Applying your past experiences and help set up & establish a well governed, secure, scalable, and highly performing BI foundation that can be used across enterprise and to advocate for procedures

  • Looking for Continuous process improvement possibilities with an "automate first" mentality 

  • Digging into the details and understanding unique technical and business processes.

  • Assisting with development and delivery of product vision, strategy, systems, and operational processes

description_text:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

At eBay, we’re more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re transforming how the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers across 190+ markets worldwide. We are constantly pushing boundaries to reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our culture is built on putting customers first, embracing authenticity, encouraging bold ideas, and enabling everyone to bring their unique selves to work every day. Together, we are shaping the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and builders working to connect people, foster communities, and create economic opportunity for all.

About the team and the role:

As a Senior MTS Software Engineer in eBay’s Identity team, you will design, build, and scale critical identity services that power authentication and user trust across the platform.

This includes systems such as:

  • Authentication & Authorization
  • User Onboarding & Management
  • Web Services Security
  • Device Fingerprinting
  • Account Linking / Entity Resolution

You will work on modern identity protocols like OAuth and OpenID Connect, supporting hundreds of millions of users across web and mobile platforms.

As a senior engineer, you will play a key role across the full product lifecycle — from architecture and design to development, deployment, and continuous improvement — collaborating closely with Product, Design, and Architecture teams.

What you'll do and learn:

  • Lead and deliver complex technical initiatives independently across teams and domains

  • Define and drive technical strategy, architecture, and long-term roadmap
  • Author and influence Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) to guide engineering direction
  • Own large functional areas with deep technical expertise
  • Design scalable, secure, and high-performance systems with a strong systems mindset
  • Drive projects end-to-end from concept to production
  • Act as a change agent to elevate engineering standards, culture, and best practices
  • Mentor engineers and promote knowledge sharing across teams
  • Build flexible and future-proof systems to adapt to evolving platform needs
  • Lead support, release processes, and on-call for a 24/7 always-on platform
  • Evaluate and adopt emerging technologies to improve performance, scalability, and compliance

What you will bring:

Technical Expertise

  • Strong backend development experience in Java or Kotlin (required)
  • Deep experience building large-scale distributed systems and APIs
  • Strong system design expertise including:
    • REST / GraphQL APIs (GraphQL preferred)
    • Messaging systems
    • RDBMS and NoSQL databases
    • Containers and infrastructure layers
  • Experience implementing identity and federation protocols (OAuth, OpenID Connect)
  • Proven ability to drive architecture across multiple domains

Leadership & Impact

  • Experience defining and executing technical strategy and roadmap
  • Strong ability to influence stakeholders and align on complex architectural decisions
  • Track record of improving engineering velocity and code quality across teams
  • Experience leading large cross-team initiatives from inception to delivery

Mindset & Collaboration

  • Excellent decision-making skills in ambiguous and fast-changing environments
  • Strong ownership, communication, and collaboration skills
  • Passion for mentoring, coaching, and growing teams
  • Growth mindset with continuous learning and adaptability
  • Ability to work across adjacent domains (product, program, people management)

Qualification

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
  • 10+ years of experience building large-scale distributed systems
  • 5+ years as a technical lead or architect in identity management domain owning end-to-end system design

Additional Details

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.

 

We use cookies to enhance your experience and may use AI tools for administrative tasks in the hiring process. To learn how we handle your personal data and use AI responsibly, please visit our Talent Privacy Notice, Privacy Center, and AI Hiring Guidelines.

We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

About the Role

At eBay, we’re redefining global commerce through technology. Our platform powers millions of daily interactions across 190+ markets, enabling seamless buying experiences for customers worldwide.

Join our Core Buyer Engineering team to build innovative, scalable systems that shape the future of ecommerce.

As a Senior MTS – Architect (Senior Staff Software Engineer), you will lead the design and development of large-scale, distributed systems that power eBay’s buyer experience.

You will drive technical strategy, architecture, and innovation, while mentoring engineers and influencing cross-team engineering decisions to deliver high-performance, reliable, and accessible systems.

You will leverage strong backend expertise in Java or Kotlin (mandatory) to build and scale mission-critical services.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and evolve scalable, distributed, and highly available systems

  • Develop high-performance backend services using Java/Kotlin

  • Ensure reliability, performance, and accessibility across the platform

  • Translate complex business problems into clean, scalable technical solutions

  • Own and drive architecture for large functional domains

  • Establish and guide engineering best practices and design standards

  • Define and influence technical strategy and long-term roadmaps

  • Balance short-term delivery with long-term scalability and innovation

  • Partner with Product, Design, and Data teams to deliver impactful solutions

  • Mentor engineers, conduct design/code reviews, and elevate engineering quality

  • Drive testable, maintainable, and high-quality code using modern engineering practices

  • Lead release processes, reliability initiatives, and on-call for a 24/7 platform

  • Identify system and productivity bottlenecks and drive improvements

  • Design systems with flexibility to support evolving business needs

Qualifications

Technical Expertise

  • Expert-level backend development experience in Java or Kotlin (mandatory)

  • Proven experience building and scaling distributed, high-availability systems

  • Strong system design expertise (APIs, messaging systems, databases, cloud infrastructure)

  • Experience driving architecture and technical strategy across teams

  • Familiarity with modern DevOps practices and Shift-Left approaches

Experience

  • 10+ years of software engineering experience

  • Proven track record of leading large-scale, complex system delivery

  • Experience driving cross-team technical initiatives end-to-end

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience)

Soft Skills & Leadership

  • Strong decision-making skills in ambiguous and fast-paced environments

  • High ownership, accountability, and excellent communication skills

  • Proven ability to influence and align stakeholders across teams

  • Passion for mentoring and building strong engineering culture

Growth & Learning Mindset

  • Self-driven with strong curiosity and continuous learning attitude

  • Actively participates in knowledge sharing (internal/external)

  • Continuously expands into adjacent domains (product, systems, leadership)

Why Join eBay

At eBay, your work touches millions of buyers and sellers around the world. You’ll join a culture that values innovation, inclusivity, and continuous improvement—where you can make a real impact, grow your career, and help shape the future of global commerce.

Additional Details

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.

Job Description for Collaboration Platforms Systems Administrator (Remote)

Position Title: Collaboration Systems Administrator

Location: Bangalore, India (Remote)

Closest Office Address: 

eBay Bangaloroo Office

Embassy Tech Village, Tower 3A Wing B (Iris), 10th Floor, Devarabisanahalli, Kadubeesanahalli, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560103


Employment Type: Full-Time, Contract 

Note: Requires on-call rotation 5 days per month.

About eBay's Collaboration Platforms Team

The Collaboration Platforms Team at eBay plays a critical role in optimizing and maintaining eBay’s suite of corporate communication and productivity tools. 

Job Summary:

As the Collaboration Systems Administrator, you will manage and support eBay's collaboration tools, including Email, Google Workspace, Office 365, Cisco CES, Ironport, and Microsoft Exchange, Slack, Lucidchart, Figma, Monday.com. Your role involves ensuring the seamless operation, support and integration of these platforms to drive efficiency and innovation across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

  • Platform Management: Administer and maintain collaboration tools, including Google Workspace, Microsoft Exchange, Microsoft SharePoint and O365, Cisco CES and Ironport to meet eBay's evolving business needs.

  • Technical Support: Provide technical, escalation and backend support and solutions for collaboration systems.

  • Tool Integration: Assist in integrating various collaboration platforms to optimize processes and workflows.

  • Innovation and Improvement: Investigate new technologies and methodologies to further enhance collaboration capabilities.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with other departments such as service desk, Information security, networking, etc. to implement and refine solutions that boost productivity and efficiency.

Job Description

Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or related fields.

About the team and the role:

As a MTS Software Engineer within eBay's Identity team, you will focus on developing and supporting Identity Services including Authentication, Authorization, Onboarding, User Management, Web Services Security, Device Fingerprinting, and Account Linking/Entity Resolution.

Your work will involve implementing ID Federation protocols like OAuth and OpenId Connect. This role is crucial in maintaining the eBay platform, servicing hundreds of millions of users across both Desktop and Mobile.

As a senior engineer, you'll take part throughout the product development lifecycle—from conceptual design to product launch—while working closely with Product Managers, Designers, and Architectural teams.

What you'll do and learn:

  • Independently lead complex technical initiatives within and beyond your team.

  • Drive technical direction and roadmap, leads across domain teams and guides others towards the right technical decisions. 

  • Authors ADRs (Architecture Decision Records) that serves as blueprint or a proposed solution for a given technical problem and influences overall tech strategy

  • Responsible for one or more large functional areas possessing in-depth knowledge and expertise.

  • Demonstrate strong systems mindset, go beyond immediate needs, proactively addressing performance, security, and future-proofing solutions.

  • Take ownership of complex projects, driving them from conception to successful implementation.

  • Change agency to set high bar and uplevel across teams on culture, process and engineering practices. Empower teams through effective collaboration, knowledge sharing, and tool building.

  • Identifying areas in the company platforms likely to change and integrating flexibility in the design for these area improving engineering velocity

  • Long term technology vision to continually modernize and keep systems relevant in constantly changing environments

  • Lead engineering support, release, and on-call responsibilities for an "always-on" 24/7 site.

  • Evaluate and implement emerging technologies that boost system performance and facilitate easier compliance with global payment regulations.

What you will bring:

  • Experience in creating and driving technical strategy and roadmap across multiple domains. Balanced trade-offs to ship scalable solutions supporting long-term goals.

  • Successfully forge alignments with key stakeholders on signficant architecture decisions and technical direction for ambiguous problem areas through Architectural Decision Records (ADR)

  • Developed and drove adoption of technical practices that improved team velocity to deliver high-quality code across the organization.

  • Solid knowledge in end to end system design from frontend to backend involving JavaScript frameworks, Rest APIs, Messaging Systems, RDBMS/NOSQL, Containers, Infrastructure layer, with deep knowledge in several key components. Experience in GraphQL is preferable.  

  • Experiences in leading complex technical initiatives across teams independently from inception to successful delivery. 

  • Excellent decision-making skills, thrive on dealing with ambiguities and changes. 

  • Strong sense of ownership and communication skills , embrace diverse ideas across organization and align on a mutually agreed direction to get things done and move forward.

  • Deeply care about growing others, great at mentoring and coaching, creating a large positive impact on organizational culture. 

  • Strong learning ability, self-driven                        

  • Attending knowledge sharing sessions, both within the company and externally  

  • Learning transferable skills  

  • Growth mindset and constantly looking for opportunities to learn                      

  • Learns adjacent areas (project management, people management, product management) in addition to core technical skills to better support the organization

  • Bachelor's degree in EE, CS or other related field.

  • 10+ years of experience in building large scale, distributed web platforms/APIs with 6+ years as an architect/technical lead responsible for the end to end product scope across multiple domains.

At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

About the Team

CS Tech is where engineering meets real customer impact. We build the help solutions eBay customers rely on and the tools our teammates use to support customer service interactions globally. The organization owns teammate tools, help experiences, customer service quality platforms, access management, and issue management for critical site incidents.

As part of CS Tech, you'll have the opportunity to work on strategic engineering initiatives focused on platform modernization, AI-enabled transformation, and operational excellence. We are evolving enterprise-scale customer support platforms into scalable, cloud-native, API-driven, and intelligent systems that improve customer experience, operational efficiency, and agent productivity worldwide.


Role Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled End-to-End (E2E) Quality Engineering (QE) Engineer with strong expertise in Playwright, Selenium, and advanced troubleshooting to ensure the quality, reliability, and performance of complex distributed systems.

This role requires a technically strong engineer who can go beyond test execution — someone who can debug deeply, identify root causes, and collaborate effectively with development teams to prevent production issues.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain robust E2E automation frameworks using Playwright and Selenium.

  • Build scalable UI and API automation suites integrated into CI/CD pipelines.

  • Perform deep technical troubleshooting across UI, backend services, APIs, and integrations.

  • Conduct root cause analysis (RCA) for production and pre-production defects.

  • Validate complex workflows across distributed systems and third-party integrations.

  • Collaborate with Engineering, Product, and DevOps teams to ensure high release confidence.

  • Improve test coverage, stability, and execution speed of automation suites.

  • Contribute to automation best practices, code reviews, and framework improvements.

  • Support regression, functional, integration, and performance testing efforts.

What You'll Bring

  • 6+ years of experience in Quality Engineering/Test Automation.

  • Strong hands-on experience with Playwright.

  • Proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or similar programming languages.

  • Experience in UI, API, Integration, and E2E testing.

  • Strong debugging, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis skills.

  • Good understanding of REST APIs, CI/CD pipelines, and modern web technologies.

  • Ability to collaborate across Engineering, Product, and Operations teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Genesys Cloud, IVR systems, or Contact Center technologies.

  • Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure).

  • Experience with AI-assisted test automation.

  • Familiarity with Docker and Kubernetes.

Additional Details

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.

 

We use cookies to enhance your experience and may use AI tools for administrative tasks in the hiring process. To learn how we handle your personal data and use AI responsibly, please visit our Talent Privacy Notice, Privacy Center, and AI Hiring Guidelines.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

MTS 2 Software Engineer – eBay

About the Role

At eBay, we’re redefining global commerce through technology. As a Staff Software Engineer, in Core Buyer Engineering org you’ll design and build large-scale, distributed systems that power millions of customer interactions daily. You’ll shape technical strategy, drive innovation, and mentor engineers across teams to deliver seamless, performant, and accessible experiences for our global users.

Responsibilities

  • Architect and Build: Design, develop, and maintain scalable, distributed, and highly available systems that ensure exceptional performance, reliability, and accessibility for eBay’s marketplace platform.
     

  • Technical Leadership: Translate complex business requirements into clean, efficient, and maintainable software solutions. Take ownership of large functional areas, providing deep technical expertise and driving architectural direction.
     

  • Strategic Influence: Contribute to and influence technical strategy and long-term roadmaps, balancing immediate business needs with long-term engineering excellence.
     

  • Collaboration and Mentorship: Partner with cross-functional teams—including Product, Design, and Data Science—to build innovative solutions. Mentor engineers, conduct code reviews, and provide technical guidance across teams.
     

  • Quality and Velocity: Apply evidence-driven design principles to create testable, maintainable features that improve engineering velocity and support continuous delivery.
     

  • Operational Excellence: Lead release processes, on-call rotations, and site reliability initiatives for an “always-on” global commerce platform.
     

  • Continuous Improvement: Identify productivity bottlenecks, propose system improvements, and advocate for best practices in design and development.
     

  • Engineering Roadmap: Anticipate future changes and design with flexibility in mind to support evolving business and technical needs.
     

Qualifications

Technical Skills

  • Proven experience designing and delivering complex, distributed, and high-availability systems at scale.
     

  • Strong proficiency in multiple programming languages and frameworks, with deep expertise in at least one or two (e.g., Java, Kotlin, Scala, Python, or Node.js).
     

  • Experience influencing and executing technical strategy and architecture roadmaps, with a balance of short-term impact and long-term innovation.
     

  • Familiarity with Shift Left approaches and modern DevOps practices.
     

  • Experience leading cross-functional engineering initiatives and delivering large-scale software solutions end-to-end.
     

Experience

  • 8+ years of professional experience in software development, with a track record of technical excellence and cross-team impact.
     

  • Demonstrated success leading the delivery of large, complex systems in fast-paced environments.
     

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).
     

Soft Skills & Culture Fit

  • Exceptional decision-making skills with the ability to navigate ambiguity and adapt to change.
     

  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability, with excellent communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate across multiple divisions and stakeholders.
     

  • Passionate about mentoring, coaching, and fostering a culture of continuous learning and technical excellence.
     

  • Demonstrated ability to drive alignment and make high-impact technical decisions across teams.
     

Learning Mindset

  • Curious, self-driven, and proactive about learning new technologies and industry trends.
     

  • Regularly participates in internal and external knowledge-sharing sessions.
     

  • Embraces a growth mindset, continuously seeking opportunities to expand skill sets and improve team capabilities.
     

Why Join eBay

At eBay, your work touches millions of buyers and sellers around the world. You’ll join a culture that values innovation, inclusivity, and continuous improvement—where you can make a real impact, grow your career, and help shape the future of global commerce.

Additional Details

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.

 

We use cookies to enhance your experience and may use AI tools for administrative tasks in the hiring process. To learn how we handle your personal data and use AI responsibly, please visit our Talent Privacy Notice, Privacy Center, and AI Hiring Guidelines.

description_text:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

About the Team

CS Tech is where engineering meets real customer impact. We build the help solutions eBay customers rely on and the tools our teammates use to support customer service interactions globally. The organization owns teammate tools, help experiences, customer service quality platforms, access management, and issue management for critical site incidents.

As part of CS Tech, you'll help drive platform reliability, automation, and operational excellence across large-scale customer support systems. This role offers an opportunity to work on modernizing enterprise platforms through automation, AI-enabled solutions, and intelligent operations.

Role Overview
We are looking for a highly motivated L2 Support Engineer with strong automation expertise to join our engineering team. This role will provide advanced production/application support, drive automation initiatives to reduce manual effort, and improve system reliability and operational efficiency across business-critical platforms.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide L2 production support for customer-facing and internal business-critical applications.

  • Troubleshoot, analyze, and resolve complex issues across distributed systems and integrations.

  • Perform root cause analysis (RCA) and implement permanent fixes to prevent recurrence.

  • Design and implement automation solutions to reduce operational toil and improve MTTR.

  • Develop scripts/tools for monitoring, alerting, log analysis, and self-healing workflows.

  • Support and maintain contact center platforms and integrations.

  • Partner with Engineering, QE, Infrastructure, and Business teams during releases and incidents.

  • Participate in on-call rotations and ensure SLA compliance.

  • Drive continuous improvement of support processes and platform stability.

What You'll Bring

  • 4+ years of experience in Application Support, Production Support, L2 Support, or Site Reliability Engineering.

  • Strong programming/scripting skills in Java, Python, Shell, or similar technologies.

  • Experience building automation solutions to reduce operational effort and improve system reliability.

  • Strong troubleshooting and root cause analysis skills in complex distributed environments.

  • Experience with APIs, integrations, monitoring, and observability tools.

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Contact Center technologies, including:

    • Genesys Cloud

    • IVR systems

    • ACD routing and call flows

  • Experience leveraging AI-powered tools and intelligent automation.

  • Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure), CI/CD, and DevOps practices.

  • Knowledge of SQL/NoSQL databases and performance troubleshooting.

  • Someone who automates repetitive work and continuously improves operational efficiency.

  • An engineer who can move from reactive support to proactive, self-healing solutions.

  • Comfortable operating in large-scale customer support environments.

  • A strong team player who thrives in cross-functional collaboration.

Additional Details

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.

 

We use cookies to enhance your experience and may use AI tools for administrative tasks in the hiring process. To learn how we handle your personal data and use AI responsibly, please visit our Talent Privacy Notice, Privacy Center, and AI Hiring Guidelines.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

At eBay, our customer support teammates are at the heart of delivering exceptional customer experiences. This role is an opportunity to fundamentally reimagine the tooling and user experience.

You’ll be designing the next generation of teammate tools, including AI-powered experiences, that help agents resolve issues faster, reduce cognitive load, and focus on what matters most: helping customers. Your work will directly impact thousands of teammates globally and millions of customer interactions every day.

You’ll play a critical role in moving us toward a more intelligent, streamlined, and human-centered support ecosystem, shaping how AI and automation show up in real-world, high-pressure environments.

If you’re passionate about solving problems, influencing product strategy, and designing tools that make an important difference at scale, this is a chance to have outsized impact.

Responsibilities

  • Design intuitive, efficient, and scalable experiences for internal teammate tools that empower customer support agents to deliver faster, higher-quality assistance
  • Deeply understand multi-step support workflows, systems, and problems, and translate them into streamlined, usable solutions
  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Data Science, and Operations to shape product direction and ensure solutions meet both business goals and teammate needs
  • Use research and data to inform and validate design decisions, balancing priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Plan and conduct end-to-end research (e.g., interviews, shadowing, usability testing) with support teammates, or collaborate with research partners when needed
  • Act as the voice of the teammate by identifying research opportunities during planning and bringing insights into product strategy and prioritization
  • Design for real-world conditions such as high-volume workflows, cognitive load, multitasking, and time pressure
  • Contribute to and evolve design patterns and systems for internal tools, ensuring consistency and scalability across the ecosystem
  • Collaborate early and often with cross-functional partners and fellow designers to co-create solutions and iterate quickly

Qualifications

We’re looking for candidates who:

  • Have experience designing UX for complex systems, internal tools, or workflow-driven products (e.g., customer support tools, enterprise software, AI-assisted tools)
  • Are skilled at translating user needs, behavioral insights, and operational constraints into clear product requirements and design solutions
  • Can independently plan and execute research, including contextual inquiry (e.g., observing teammates in their workflow), interviews, and usability testing
  • Have a strong ability to synthesize research into actionable insights that influence product and design decisions
  • Are comfortable facilitating workshops, co-creation sessions, and design critiques with cross-functional teams
  • Excel at simplifying complex problems and designing for efficiency, clarity, and speed
  • Communicate clearly and confidently through presentations, storytelling, and artifacts (flows, wireframes, prototypes)
  • Are proactive, self-driven, and able to navigate ambiguity while maintaining momentum
  • Can manage multiple projects and priorities effectively, setting clear expectations and delivering on commitments
  • Are based in India and prepared to work primarily in U.S. time zones to support close collaboration with global partners

Additional Details

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. CS Tech is where engineering meets real customer impact. We build the help solutions eBay customers rely on and the tools our teammates use to support customer service interactions globally.

We are seeking a Lead Architect to drive architecture strategy, platform modernization, and enterprise transformation across eBay’s Customer Support Technology ecosystem.

This is a senior individual contributor (IC) role responsible for defining technical vision, architecture standards, and modernization roadmaps for business-critical platforms used globally. You will partner closely with Engineering, Product, Infrastructure, Security, Data, and AI teams to build scalable, cloud-native, API-driven, and AI-enabled solutions.

What You'll Do

  • Define and drive architecture strategy for customer support platforms and enterprise workflow systems.

  • Lead modernization of legacy applications into scalable, cloud-native, and AI-enabled architectures.

  • Design enterprise APIs, microservices, event-driven systems, and integration frameworks.

  • Establish architecture standards, best practices, and reusable design patterns across engineering teams.

  • Partner with cross-functional teams to align technology strategy with business objectives.

  • Drive architecture governance, technical reviews, and long-term platform evolution.

  • Champion scalability, reliability, security, observability, and operational excellence.

  • Mentor engineers and technical leaders while influencing architectural direction across multiple organizations.

What You'll Bring

  • 12+ years of software engineering experience with deep expertise in enterprise architecture and distributed systems.

  • Proven experience modernizing large-scale enterprise applications and customer-facing platforms.

  • Strong technical expertise in:

    • Java / Spring Boot

    • React and modern web architectures

    • APIs, Microservices, and Distributed Systems

    • Event-Driven Architectures

    • Cloud-Native Design Patterns

  • Experience driving large-scale transformation and modernization initiatives.

  • Strong communication, collaboration, and technical leadership skills.

  • Ability to influence engineering direction across teams without direct authority.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience modernizing legacy platforms into cloud-native architectures.

  • Experience with AI-enabled applications, GenAI solutions, intelligent workflows, or conversational platforms.

  • Knowledge of Kafka, Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD, GraphQL, and cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure).

  • Experience with enterprise integrations, workflow orchestration, and large-scale SaaS ecosystems.

  • Familiarity with event streaming, real-time processing, and asynchronous architectures.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for a technical leader who can simplify complex problems, define scalable architecture strategies, and drive modernization across a broad enterprise ecosystem. The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise with strong business understanding and is passionate about building modern, scalable, and maintainable platforms that improve customer and teammate experiences at global scale.

Why Join Us?

You'll play a pivotal role in shaping the future architecture of eBay's customer support platforms. Your work will directly influence platform modernization, AI adoption, enterprise integration strategy, operational efficiency, and the technology roadmap supporting millions of customer interactions worldwide.

At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

MTS 1 Software Engineer – Backend

About the Role

At eBay, we facilitate connections between buyers and sellers worldwide using efficient, dependable technology. As a Staff Software Engineer within the Buyer Payments team, you'll create backend systems supporting Checkout and Orders in a leading online marketplace. You'll manage vital services, promote technical expertise, and enhance eBay's global commerce platform.

Responsibilities

  • Design & Development: Convert business demands into durable, scalable, and reliable backend solutions through the application of modern technologies such as Java, GraphQL, Spring Boot, REST APIs, and messaging frameworks.
  • Ownership & Delivery: Take full responsibility for subsystems within a large domain — from design and development through testing, deployment, observability, and monitoring.
  • Technical Influence: Act as a key technical contributor and advisor within your team, influencing design and architecture decisions to ensure scalability, reliability, and performance.
  • Continuous Improvement: Identify areas of change and proactively design flexibility into systems to enhance engineering velocity and adaptability.
  • Collaboration: Work cross-functionally with product managers, designers, and other engineers to deliver innovative, high-quality features that align with business objectives.
  • Quality & Testability: Promote and carry out design guided by information, constructing features that are easy to test and upkeep for quality and ongoing delivery.
  • Execution & Mentorship: Break down complex features into deliverable components, resolve blockers, and support others through code reviews, technical guidance, and mentorship.
  • Reliability & Support: Participate in release management, site reliability initiatives, and on-call rotations to ensure the availability and performance of an “always-on” 24/7 platform.
  • Engineering Excellence: Lead efforts to improve end-to-end testing, CI/CD processes, and overall development velocity across features and services.

Qualifications

Technical Skills

  • Extensive experience with Java, GraphQL, Spring/Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, and messaging platforms like Kafka, RabbitMQ, or equivalents.
  • Experience in building data-driven applications using RDBMS, NoSQL, and ElasticSearch.
  • Verified skill in providing high-quality software in fast-paced agile contexts following TDD, CI/CD, and automation protocols.
  • Familiarity with Shift Left testing approaches and modern DevOps principles.

Experience

  • 6+ years of experience developing, maintaining, and scaling backend systems in production environments.
  • Demonstrated expertise in designing, building, and operating large-scale distributed systems.
  • Strong understanding of software lifecycle management, system reliability, and observability.

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).

Soft Skills & Team Alignment

  • Innovative and collaborative — thrives in a dynamic, cross-functional environment.
  • Excellent communication and decision-making skills, with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
  • Proven capability to collaborate efficiently across diverse teams and interested parties.

Embracing a learning approach

  • Dedicated and curious, with a passion for learning new technologies and frameworks.
  • Actively participates in knowledge sharing sessions, both internally and externally.
  • Excited about exploring emerging trends in backend engineering, cloud infrastructure, and scalable systems.
  • Committed to continuous learning and applying transferable skills to new challenges.

Why Join eBay

At eBay, your contributions influence the trajectory of worldwide commerce. You will become a member of a diverse and forward-thinking setting that appreciates originality, technical expertise, and teamwork. Come aboard to develop technology that enables individuals and societies across the globe — and witness your influence on a global level!

Additional Details

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.

 

We use cookies to enhance your experience and may use AI tools for administrative tasks in the hiring process. To learn how we handle your personal data and use AI responsibly, please visit our Talent Privacy Notice, Privacy Center, and AI Hiring Guidelines.
