At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

Platform Engineer – Developer Platform, Productivity & Experience Engineering

About the Team

The Developer Platform, Productivity & Experience Engineering team within eBay’s Global Technology (CT) builds and operates the AI/ML-powered eBay Developer Platform.

Our scope includes:

  • Continuous Delivery platform

  • Enterprise Testing platform

  • AI-driven no-code/low-code developer tools

  • Developer Productivity and Engineering Velocity platforms

Our mission is to eliminate friction in the software development and delivery lifecycle and enable engineers to ship high-quality software at scale.

About the Role

We are seeking a strong Platform Engineer with hands-on experience building distributed systems and modern web applications.

You will:

  • Design and develop scalable microservices and backend systems

  • Build frontend applications for internal developer platforms (React preferred)

  • Architect distributed systems that operate reliably at scale

  • Develop platform capabilities that power CI/CD, testing, and developer workflows

Your work will directly impact how thousands of engineers build, test, and release software at eBay.

What You’ll Bring

  • Strong programming fundamentals and system design skills

  • Experience building microservices and distributed systems in production

  • Experience with Java/Kotlin and Spring Boot

  • Experience building REST APIs and event-driven systems

  • Frontend development experience (React preferred)

  • Experience with Kubernetes and cloud-native systems

  • Experience with Tekton and CI/CD systems is a plus

  • Experience building testing or contract-testing frameworks is a plus

Strong ownership mindset, collaboration skills, and a passion for improving developer experience are essential.

Role Clarification

This is a Platform Engineering role requiring hands-on development of microservices, distributed systems, and frontend applications.

It is not a Quality Engineering (QE) or DevOps role. Engineers on this team own the systems they build end-to-end — including designing, developing, and maintaining high-quality automated tests (unit, integration, end-to-end, performance, and reliability). There are no separate QE roles within most teams at eBay; quality is built in and owned by the engineers developing the software.

Additional Details

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.

 

We use cookies to enhance your experience and may use AI tools for administrative tasks in the hiring process. To learn how we handle your personal data and use AI responsibly, please visit our Talent Privacy Notice, Privacy Center, and AI Hiring Guidelines.

eBay Inc. is a leading global commerce platform that connects millions of buyers and sellers, providing economic opportunities worldwide. We are committed to putting the customer at the heart of everything we do. Join us to create impactful solutions that resonate with our customers globally.

Position Overview:

This is not a traditional people-management role. We're looking for a leader who can dive deep into architecture discussions, review production code, influence platform strategy, and guide engineering teams through complex technical challenges while building a high-performance engineering culture.

You will lead teams responsible for building and evolving mission-critical backend platforms that power experiences for millions of users globally.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead the design, development, and evolution of highly scalable backend systems and distributed platforms.

  • Stay actively involved in architecture, design reviews, technical decision-making, and critical code paths.

  • Drive modernization initiatives including migration from monolithic systems to cloud-native microservices architectures.

  • Partner closely with architects, product leaders, and engineering teams to define long-term technology strategy.

  • Champion engineering excellence through code quality, performance optimization, observability, resiliency, and operational excellence.

  • Build, mentor, and grow high-performing engineering teams across multiple geographies and time zones.

  • Foster a culture of innovation, ownership, continuous learning, and customer obsession.

  • Lead large-scale platform transformations that improve developer productivity, system reliability, and customer experience.

  • Influence organization-wide engineering practices, architecture standards, and technology roadmaps.

Required Qualifications:

Technical Excellence

  • 12+ years of software engineering experience with a strong track record of leading high-performing engineering teams.

  • Deep hands-on expertise in Java, Spring Boot, Microservices, Distributed Systems, Event-Driven Architectures, Cloud Platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure), and modern data technologies.

  • Proven success building and scaling high-throughput, low-latency platforms serving millions of customers.

  • Strong architectural acumen across scalability, resiliency, observability, and performance engineering.

  • Passionate about technology with the ability to dive deep into code, influence design decisions, and drive engineering excellence.

  • Knowledge of DORA, SPACE, and modern engineering productivity frameworks.

  • Experience with AI/ML-driven platform capabilities.

  • Background in marketplace, ecommerce, fintech, or large-scale consumer platforms.

Leadership Excellence

  • Proven leader with experience building, mentoring, and scaling world-class engineering teams.

  • Strong ability to attract top talent, develop future technical leaders, and foster a culture of ownership and innovation.

  • Experience leading globally distributed teams and delivering results across multiple time zones.

  • Balances strategic vision with execution, driving both business outcomes and technical excellence.

Why Join Us?

Shape the future of e-commerce through innovative and user-centered design practices. Work closely with executive leadership to drive impactful changes that delight our clients. Be a pivotal part of a transformative journey at eBay, building a culture that blends architectural excellence with agility.

description_text:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

Looking for a company that encourages passion, courage and imagination, where you can be part of the team shaping the future of global commerce? Want to craft how millions of people buy, sell, connect, and share around the world? If you’re interested in joining a purpose-driven community that is dedicated to creating an ambitious and inclusive workplace, join eBay – a company you can be proud to be a part of.

If you are up for the challenge to build new and cutting-edge large-scale internet web services and applications used by millions of business sellers around the globe every day—and drive critical, meaningful, and impactful changes to one of the world's largest internet properties—then join us on the Core Inventory & Listing Experience team.

We are seeking a talented, creative, and passionate MTS 1 Backend Software Engineer to architect, design, and develop innovative, highly performant, and available software in the form of web services and applications across various device form factors. These solutions will help business sellers worldwide onboard, manage inventory and listings, and grow their businesses on the largest global marketplace.

What You Will Accomplish

  • Deliver highly scalable, reliable backend systems powering eBay’s global selling experience used by 25M+ sellers

  • Drive improvements in performance, scalability, and accuracy at the very top of eBay’s commerce funnel

  • Enable seamless onboarding, inventory management, and listing experiences for business sellers worldwide

  • Build and evolve distributed, fault-tolerant systems across data centers that directly support billions of dollars in quarterly revenue

  • Own and deliver major features end-to-end—from architecture and design through development, testing, deployment, and ongoing support

  • Influence architectural decisions, contribute to system design discussions, and help shape the technical direction of core platform services

  • Identify technical risks, plan implementations, and lead execution to deliver high-quality, scalable solutions

  • You will contribute at the very core of eBay’s selling experience, delivering an engaging platform for more than 25 million sellers across 22 countries.

  • Performance, reliability, scalability, and accuracy are critical, as this area sits at the top of the funnel for eBay’s global e-commerce ecosystem.

What You Will Bring

  • BS in EE/CS or equivalent experience; 5+ years building highly scalable distributed systems (or Master’s with 4+ years, or PhD with 3+ years)

  • Strong expertise in Java and/or Scala, with solid foundations in data structures, algorithms, and concurrent programming

  • Deep understanding of system design and ability to lead projects through to completion

  • Experience with REST/SOAP services, design patterns, OOA/D, and internet-scale applications

  • Hands-on experience with relational and/or NoSQL databases (Oracle, MongoDB, Cassandra, Couchbase), and search technologies like Elasticsearch

  • Familiarity with applying AI tools for code generation, automated testing, or intelligent system development

  • Strong collaboration and influencing skills across cross-functional and global teams

  • Experience driving architecture discussions, producing design documentation, and contributing to code reviews and testing

  • Solid understanding of performance, scalability, security, and modern web technologies

  • Creativity, curiosity, and a passion for continuous innovation

  • Strong ownership mindset and drive for results

  • Ability to learn quickly, think big, and execute effectively

  • Excellent communication and teamwork skills

  • A desire to build impactful solutions while having fun along the way

Additional Details

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.

 

We use cookies to enhance your experience and may use AI tools for administrative tasks in the hiring process. To learn how we handle your personal data and use AI responsibly, please visit our Talent Privacy Notice, Privacy Center, and AI Hiring Guidelines.

The GDS Platform addresses this by building a fully declarative data platform — one that accepts dataset specifications, maintains a comprehensive view of the total data flow graph, and automatically produces optimized pipelines to systematically eliminate these inefficiencies at scale.

As an engineer on this team, you will contribute to the systems that power this platform — from computation graph management to pipeline optimization and dataset lifecycle. Your work will directly reduce operational waste across eBay's data infrastructure.

Note: This is a Data Platform Engineering role. Familiarity with Spark, Flink, and the Hadoop ecosystem is useful context, but your primary responsibility is building the platform itself — not authoring pipelines.

What you’ll do and learn

  • Own and deliver major components of eBay’s Data Platforms — from design through production rollout.

  • Design and evolve distributed systems powering ingestion, streaming, lakehouse/warehouse, catalog, and governance.

  • Contribute to long-term architecture through design reviews and authoring architecture design documents, ensuring scalability and resilience.

  • Build systems that balance latency, correctness, and cost while ensuring security and compliance.

  • Drive operational excellence for services you own, including observability and incident response.

  • Collaborate across product, infra, and analytics teams to align execution with business needs.

  • Learn and grow in areas like governance, orchestration, and privacy engineering.
     

What you bring

  • Experience designing large-scale distributed systems (compute, storage, APIs, streaming).

  • Ability to independently deliver complex projects from requirements to production.

  • Systems thinker who anticipates bottlenecks, schema evolution, and reliability issues.

  • Strong communication skills to influence cross-team technical outcomes.

  • Growth mindset with curiosity to learn new technologies.
     

What we bring

  • Impact at scale: powering global analytics and ML systems.

  • Challenging problems: streaming, freshness/correctness, and multi-cloud resiliency.

  • Collaborative culture that values inclusion and knowledge sharing.

  • Support & growth: flexibility, benefits, and career development resources.

  • Focus on reliability and sustainable on-call practices.
     

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of software engineering experience, primarily in distributed systems or data platforms.

  • Proven ability to design and deliver critical systems with impact.

  • Proficiency in Java/Python, CI/CD, and containerized environments.

  • Hands-on expertise in tools like Kafka/Flink, Spark, Delta/Iceberg, Kubernetes, NoSQL/columnar stores.

  • Experience in streaming and batch data platforms.

  • Strong foundation in algorithms and distributed design.

  • BS/MS in CS or equivalent experience.

Additional Details

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

About Team and Role:

TCGplayer connects hobbyists and hobby businesses to communities. We relentlessly improve the exchange of things and thoughts that fuel passions, providing the most compelling destination and tools for collectible card game enthusiasts and professional sellers! TCGplayer, now a part of eBay, promotes and drives growth of our products and services by connecting a global community of millions of buyers with tens of thousands of retailers in a $25B global collectible hobby market.

The Mobile Application Team owns our commitment to empower hobbyists to effortlessly engage with our marketplace, driving growth and loyalty. We embody innovation, agility, and a relentless focus on the hobbyist to create exceptional experiences. Our mobile engineering team thrives on a core foundation of quality, collaboration, ownership, and an unwavering commitment to excellence.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will architect and develop exceptional mobile experiences that empower our hobbyists. We are looking for a team member driven by user-centric approaches, innovation, collaboration, agility, and commitment to quality. You will lead the charge in critical architectural and development guidelines that define our mobile application products.   Your strategic vision and leadership will be key in ensuring our mobile experience is at the forefront of technology and provides unparalleled hobbyists experiences.


What you will accomplish: 

  • Provide technical expertise for mobile engineering across the organization, influencing architecture, standards, and guidelines

  • Design, architect independent feature with hands-on develop high-quality native mobile solutions that scale to millions of users

  • Partnering with Lead on mobile platform architecture, ensuring security, reliability, performance, and an exceptional user experience

  • Influence the mobile technical roadmap, balancing short-term delivery with long-term platform health

  • Partner closely with Staff/lead Engineer, designers, backend engineers, cloud platform teams, and ML engineers to deliver cohesive, end-to-end features

  • Lead initiatives that improve development velocity, quality, observability, and operational excellence

  • Identify technical risks early, communicate tradeoffs clearly, and implement mitigation strategies

  • Champion guidelines for development, testing, deployment, monitoring, and on-call readiness

  • Ship Product features capabilities using feature flags, experimentation frameworks, and gradual rollouts, and iterate based on real-world usage and feedback

 

What you will bring: 

  • 5+ years of experience building native mobile applications, with deep, hands-on expertise in Android (Kotlin/Jetpack required)

  • Deep understanding of mobile architecture, design patterns, lifecycle management, and performance optimization

  • Experience building secure, consumer-facing mobile apps with high availability and scalability

  • Hands-on experience with WebView integrations alongside native UI components

  • Experience with Computer Vision and real-time frame processing.

  • Experience with shared C++ components across iOS and Android.

  • Experience integrating AI/ML capabilities into production mobile applications

  • Strong understanding of secure data handling & privacy considerations, including PII, consent management, and regional compliance requirements

Collaboration: 

  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain technical decisions, tradeoffs, risks, and opportunities to both technical and non-technical collaborators

  • Experience working in Agile or Scrum environments

  • Ability to conduct research, analyze results, and apply findings to real-world product decisions

  • Experience participating in “on-call” support for critical systems.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • A culture that values collaboration, diversity, ownership, and passion

  • Opportunity to work on products used by millions of hobbyists worldwide

  • The chance to shape the future of mobile and AI-powered experiences at scale

Additional Details

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

 

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

 

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

About the Team and Role

The eBay Cloud team powers the foundational cloud infrastructure that supports thousands of eBay applications. As one of the largest private cloud platforms in the industry, we operate and manage hundreds of Kubernetes clusters across diverse environments, comprising millions of compute instances.

Our team is responsible for the full lifecycle management of these clusters—including provisioning, OS and Kubernetes upgrades, technical refreshes, and decommissioning. We also customize the Linux operating system for our Kubernetes platform, enhancing the kernel to meet eBay’s rigorous scalability, reliability, and security requirements.

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Cloud Engineering Manager to lead a team responsible for the development, operations, and governance of one of the largest private clouds in the world based on Kubernetes.

You will guide and mentor a team of hardworking engineers in building and maintaining robust, secure, and scalable cloud offerings that empower eBay’s core product engineering organizations and initiatives.

We require a unique blend of cloud expertise, software development management experience, and strong leadership skills. The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of cloud-native technologies, experience managing and developing software engineering teams, passion for building scalable and reliable systems, and excellent people skills to cultivate a high-performing team.

What you will accomplish:

Leadership & People Management

Lead and mentor a team of cloud engineers, fostering a strong culture of collaboration and continuous improvement.

Conduct regular one-on-one meetings with team members, providing guidance, feedback, and support for their career development.

Lead performance evaluations and provide constructive feedback and actively participate in all phases of growing the engineering organization through recruiting, team

building, etc.

Cloud Engineering, Operations & Governance: 

Lead and coordinate engineering activities to successfully plan, communicate, and deliver on product features on time while designing for quality, observability, and

scalability.

Ensure full software lifecycle instrumentation from requirement ideation to software development to deployment.

Drive the adoption of cloud-native technologies and standard processes, such as containerization, service mesh, microservices, etc.

Collaboration with internal partners and team members:

Cloud engineering and operations teams, product, and PMO on engineering resource allocation and project schedules in accordance with our strategic organizational priorities.

Cloud SRE team to champion automation to enhance efficiency and reliability.

Operations teams on maintaining a highly available cloud infrastructure to ensure eBay’s products and services are available to our customers.

Fleet management team on capacity planning, resource allocation, and cost optimization for the private cloud.

Information security teams to ensure integrity and compliance of the cloud infrastructure by implementing appropriate security controls and monitoring.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.

  • 10+ years of software engineering experience, including 3+ years of people management or technical leadership.

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to bridge technical and design perspectives.

  • Strong technical background with a deep understanding of cloud-native architectures and technologies (e.g., Kubernetes, containerization, service mesh, microservices).

  • Demonstrated knowledge of DevOps and Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles and practices.

  • Experience with software development, networking, security, and storage technologies in a large-scale cloud environment.

  • Experience working in large, distributed global teams and supporting medium or large-scale technology organizations with multiple internal partners.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Direct experience with customizing and maintaining Linux operating system kernels for large-scale, high-performance computing platforms.

  • Experience in capacity planning, resource allocation, and cost optimization for large private cloud infrastructure.

  • Knowledge of software development, networking, security, and storage technologies in a cloud environment and proven understanding of cloud-native architectures, microservices,

  • and DevOps and SRE principles.

  • Deep expertise in implementing and championing automation to enhance efficiency and reliability, particularly in collaboration with SRE teams.

  • Professional certifications related to Kubernetes (e.g., CKA, CKS) or cloud infrastructure.

  • Proven ability to work closely with Information Security teams on compliance, security controls, and monitoring for cloud infrastructure.

  • Understanding of developer experience (DX) principles for API-driven platforms.

  • Strong product mindset — balancing security rigor with customer empathy and usability.

Additional Details

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.

 

We use cookies to enhance your experience and may use AI tools for administrative tasks in the hiring process. To learn how we handle your personal data and use AI responsibly, please visit our Talent Privacy Notice, Privacy Center, and AI Hiring Guidelines.

eBay’s Shipping team powers critical buying and selling decisions by delivering optimized shipping choices and seamless post-purchase experiences at global scale. We build and operate highly distributed, low-latency, high-availability systems that enable borderless commerce for millions of users.

As a Principal Architect, you will lead the design and evolution of next-generation shipping and fulfillment platforms. You will drive enterprise-scale architectural strategy, solve complex logistics challenges, and build resilient, high-throughput systems that integrate with a fragmented global carrier ecosystem.

What you will accomplish:

  • Define and drive enterprise architecture for large-scale, distributed shipping platforms across global markets

  • Design and deliver high-performance, resilient backend systems with strong SLAs (availability, latency, scalability)

  • Lead architectural initiatives to improve transaction efficiency, throughput, and customer experience

  • Build and evolve microservices-based platforms integrating with global carriers and logistics partners

  • Collaborate cross-functionally (product, payments, fulfillment) to deliver innovative, scalable solutions

  • Mentor senior engineers and architects; champion engineering excellence and best practices

  • Evaluate and adopt emerging technologies to enhance performance, interoperability, and system reliability

What you will bring:

  • 15+ years of experience building and architecting large-scale enterprise platforms.

  • Proven track record of operating at Principal level or equivalent, influencing beyond immediate team

  • Deep expertise in enterprise architecture, distributed systems, and microservices at scale

  • Strong experience in supply chain / logistics domain (shipping, fulfillment, carrier ecosystems preferred)

  • Proficiency in Java, C++, or Python with strong backend engineering depth

  • Experience designing systems for high throughput, low latency, and global scale

  • Strong understanding of cloud-native architectures, CI/CD, and modern engineering practices

  • Exceptional ability to influence senior stakeholders and communicate complex technical strategies

  • Bachelor’s or higher degree in Computer Science or related field (or equivalent experience)

Key Traits for Success

  • Strategic thinker with ability to connect architecture to business impact

  • Systems-level mindset across domains and organizational boundaries

  • Technical authority with deep credibility and hands-on problem-solving ability

  • Mentor and multiplier who elevates teams and drives engineering excellence

  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity and driving alignment at scale

description_text:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

About eBay AI Platform

At eBay, we are building a next-generation AI platform to power intelligent, AI-driven experiences across our global marketplace. Our platform runs on large-scale Kubernetes-based compute infrastructure spanning on-premise GPU clusters, high-performance training environments, and hybrid cloud bursting to deliver GPU capacity at scale.

We focus on building resilient, high-performance Kubernetes-native infrastructure—spanning Custom Resource Definitions and operators, a custom AI-aware GPU scheduler, multi-NIC RDMA networking, GPU pool management, and distributed Ray compute via KubeRay—deployed across multiple availability zones with a global dispatcher for unified workload placement across training and inference pools.
 

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Software Engineer specializing in Kubernetes and GPU Infrastructure to design and operate the foundational systems that power eBay's AI platform. You will own critical layers of our infrastructure—from Kubernetes CRD-based automation and a custom AI-aware GPU scheduler to RDMA-optimized multi-NIC GPU clusters and large-scale training environments—enabling our ML teams to train and serve AI models at eBay scale.

You will work on Kubernetes operator development, Gateway API and hybrid cloud networking, multi-NIC RDMA fabric design, a global GPU scheduler with cross-availability-zone dispatch, GPU pool management with provisioned throughput integration, topology-aware workload placement, and KubeRay infrastructure—partnering closely with ML Platform, AI Research, and Networking teams.
 

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and build Kubernetes Custom Resource Definitions (CRDs) and operators for ML workloads, GPU node pools, and RayService CRDs.
  • Architect and operate Kubernetes networking layers including Gateway API, Service Load Balancers, and API gateways for hybrid cloud connectivity.
  • Design, deploy, and operate multi-NIC Kubernetes clusters with RDMA-enabled networking.
  • Implement and optimize RDMA networking using GPUDirect RDMA, RoCE, and InfiniBand for distributed GPU workloads.
  • Build and operate a custom AI-aware GPU scheduler with topology-aware placement, preemption, and GPU defragmentation.
  • Design and manage GPU pool management systems across on-premise and cloud-burst GPU environments.
  • Deploy and operate KubeRay infrastructure for distributed Ray clusters supporting training and inference workloads.
  • Implement cloud bursting and spot or preemptible GPU scheduling to improve utilization.
  • Automate GPU asset provisioning, node configuration, and cluster lifecycle management using Infrastructure-as-Code and GitOps.
  • Implement networking policies, multi-tenant isolation, RBAC, and security controls across the Kubernetes environment.
  • Build observability for GPU utilization, NCCL communication, scheduler decisions, and network throughput.
  • Collaborate with ML Platform, AI Research, and Networking teams to optimize infrastructure for training and online inference.

     

What We’re Looking For

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience building distributed systems or infrastructure platforms with deep Kubernetes expertise.
  • Strong programming skills in Go and/or Python.
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes controller development frameworks such as Kubebuilder, Operator SDK, or controller-runtime.
  • Deep understanding of Kubernetes internals including the API server, etcd, scheduler, controller manager, and kubelet.
  • Hands-on experience designing Kubernetes networking including Gateway API, CNI plugins, service load balancing, and hybrid cloud architectures.
  • Experience designing and operating multi-NIC Kubernetes clusters using NVIDIA Network Operator, SR-IOV device plugins, or equivalent tooling.
  • Strong understanding of RDMA networking protocols and NCCL configuration for distributed GPU workloads.
  • Experience with Kubernetes GPU scheduler frameworks and GPU pool management, including MIG partitioning and preemption policies.
  • Hands-on experience deploying and operating KubeRay for distributed Ray workloads.
  • Experience with GPU asset lifecycle management, bare-metal provisioning automation, and GitOps-based CD tooling such as Argo CD.
  • Familiarity with GPU technologies including NVIDIA CUDA, NVLink, NVSwitch, device plugins, and the GPU Operator ecosystem.
  • Experience with observability tooling such as Prometheus, Grafana, and OpenTelemetry.
  • Strong debugging and performance optimization skills across GPU driver stacks, RDMA networking, and distributed Kubernetes infrastructure.

Additional Details

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.

 

We use cookies to enhance your experience and may use AI tools for administrative tasks in the hiring process. To learn how we handle your personal data and use AI responsibly, please visit our Talent Privacy Notice, Privacy Center, and AI Hiring Guidelines.

description_text:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

About eBay AI Platform
 

At eBay, we are building a next-generation AI platform to power intelligent, AI-driven experiences across our global marketplace. The platform's control plane exposes the full ML lifecycle through the AI Hub developer portal—serving ML researchers, Applied Scientists, and Data Engineers across eBay's global organization with reliable, self-service tooling for experimentation, model management, and production deployment.

We focus on building the ML Platform Control Plane—composed of the AI Metadata Service, Model Management System (MMS), Experiment Management System (EMS), and Deployment Service—as well as developer-facing tooling including a Python SDK for the AI platform, Jupyter and Ray Workspace environments, the AI Hub portal built on React and Node.js, and production observability via standardized AI runtime metrics and monitoring dashboards.
 

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Software Engineer specializing in AI Platform infrastructure and MLOps services to design, build, and operate the control plane that ties together eBay's entire ML ecosystem. This is a high-impact, full-stack platform role where you will own both core backend MLOps services and the developer-facing AI Hub interface—ensuring every ML practitioner at eBay has reliable, efficient, and intuitive tools to build AI at scale.

You will work on ML Platform Control Plane services (AI Metadata Service, MMS, EMS, Deployment Service), the Experiment Management System built on MLflow, the Model Management System with Python SDK integration, AI Metadata Service, Ray Workspace and JupyterHub notebook infrastructure, distributed tracing and observability across platform services, the AI Hub portal built on React and Node.js, and production monitoring dashboards—all integrated with GitOps-based CI/CD pipelines.
 

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and build the ML Platform Control Plane services, including the AI Metadata Service, Management Service, and Deployment Service.
  • Develop and operate the Experiment Management System (EMS) built on MLflow for experiment tracking, metrics, artifacts, and lifecycle governance.
  • Build and maintain the Model Management System (MMS), including model versioning, lineage tracking, stage transitions, and deployment gating.
  • Design and operate the AI Metadata Service to store and serve metadata across experiments, model versions, training runs, datasets, and ML pipelines.
  • Build and manage AI Workspace environments, including JupyterHub and Ray Workspaces on Kubernetes.
  • Implement distributed tracing and observability across ML Platform services using tools such as OpenTelemetry and Jaeger.
  • Design and build the AI Hub portal using React and Node.js.
  • Develop and maintain the Python SDK for the AI platform.
  • Build and maintain production monitoring and dashboards using Prometheus and Grafana.
  • Build and operate CI/CD pipelines for ML workflows and platform services using Argo CD and GitOps-based tooling.
  • Collaborate with ML researchers, Applied Scientists, and Data Engineers to improve developer workflows and platform usability.
  • Improve reliability, scalability, and developer experience across ML Platform control plane services.
     

What We’re Looking For

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience building scalable distributed systems or platform engineering solutions.
  • Strong programming skills in Python and/or Java.
  • Proficiency in TypeScript and JavaScript for React and Node.js development.
  • Hands-on experience with MLOps services such as MLflow, Weights & Biases, or equivalent systems.
  • Experience designing and operating model management systems with versioning, lineage, and approval workflows.
  • Experience building metadata services and scalable data stores for ML platforms.
  • Hands-on experience with Jupyter Notebook and Ray Workspace environments.
  • Experience implementing distributed tracing across microservices and ML platform components.
  • Proficiency with React and Node.js for developer-facing web portals and internal tools.
  • Experience designing and building Python SDKs for platform consumption.
  • Strong expertise with monitoring and observability tooling such as Prometheus and Grafana.
  • Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, and GitOps-based CD tooling such as Argo CD.
  • Strong API design, debugging, and performance optimization skills.

Additional Details

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.

As a Senior Software Development Manager in the Identity domain, you will lead critical engineering initiatives that power eBay’s global customer experience. You will drive the design, development, and operational excellence of systems that enable efficient, intelligent, and personalized support across both digital self-service and especially in agent-assisted channels.

This position is based in Bengaluru, India and will require active collaboration with global teams across North America, Europe, and APAC. Success requires a readiness to work across time zones and occasionally modify working hours to align with customers from different regions.

You’ll lead the creation and integration of scalable platforms that improve customer outcomes and support agent productivity—while developing a world-class engineering team focused on innovation, reliability, and measurable impact.

It is expected that the candidate will have solid understanding of computer science fundamentals, especially on SDLC in distributed applications. It’s essential that you will have strong software development experiences with SOA, SOAP web services, Restful APIs, and messaging solutions. This position would be a best fit for someone who has been a technical lead in the past in the development of complex distributed systems. You are expected to be self-motivated, produce high quality work and have strong communication skills in addition to being comfortable working in a matrix-ed environment, collaborating across globally distributed teams.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead the design, development, and end-to-end ownership of scalable APIs, internal frameworks, batch processing programs, and email systems that power customer support actions, automate workflows, enable case resolution, and deliver personalized, timely, and compliant customer communications.

  • Build, manage, and scale a high-performing, globally distributed engineering team, fostering a culture of technical excellence, collaboration, inclusion, and continuous learning.

  • Provide strong technical and people leadership, guiding system architecture, implementation, and career development for team members.

  • Drive seamless integration with world-class customer support platforms and tools, enabling robust workflows and extending internal capabilities with best-in-class SaaS solutions.

  • Champion the adoption of AI and intelligent tooling to enhance developer productivity, improve code quality, and automate testing, monitoring, and deployment processes.

  • Lead Agile software development practices, driving iteration, velocity, and alignment with evolving business goals.

  • Establish and evolve DevOps practices, including CI/CD automation, observability, reliability engineering, and infrastructure management.

  • Work closely with customers across Product, Design, Support Operations, and Infrastructure to align engineering priorities with strategic customer support objectives.

  • Ensure all systems are secure, resilient, and scalable, with proactive monitoring, incident management, and high availability.

  • Influence the long-term technical vision and roadmap for customer support technologies, contributing to platform strategy and innovation.

What will you bring?

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, with a minimum of 12 years of software development experience, including 6 years in engineering leadership and team management. Equivalent experience accepted.

  • A proven track record of building and scaling world-class engineering teams, with a strong emphasis on attracting top talent, mentorship, team engagement, and technical excellence.

  • Demonstrated success in leading globally distributed, high-impact teams that deliver complex backend systems and integrations.

  • Deep experience with enterprise-scale customer support tools and platforms

  • Technical expertise in Java, Python, Spring Boot, distributed systems architecture, data processing, and messaging technologies such as Kafka and Flink.

  • Strong hands-on experience with Agile methodologies and DevOps, including CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), infrastructure as code, and monitoring systems.

  • Passion for incorporating AI-assisted development tools and frameworks to accelerate delivery, ensure code quality, and optimize engineering workflows.

  • Strong critical thinking and effective communication skills, with the ability to influence collaborators, coordinate cross-functional teams, and translate business needs into scalable solutions.

  • A customer-focused approach, driven by the goal of transforming support experiences through technology that is fast, reliable, and human-centered.

  • Willingness to collaborate across global time zones, with flexibility to adjust working hours as needed to support cross-regional communication and decision-making.

Additional Details

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. At eBay, we’re more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re transforming how the world shops and sells. Our platform connects millions of buyers and sellers in over 190 markets, crafting economic opportunities for all. Our customers guide us, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are encouraged, and everyone can bring their outstanding selves to work every day.

The Search, Recommendations, and Product Knowledge team ensures seamless, engaging shopping experiences on and off our marketplace through intelligent computing at scale.

We seek a Technical Program Manager to drive efforts in buyer memory/personalization systems that improve eBay’s discovery and shopping. You will be responsible for managing the entire delivery process of complex programs. Your role includes translating product and engineering roadmaps into actionable plans and collaborating with engineering, science, and product teams to deliver meaningful experiences for buyers and sellers.

Key Responsibilities

  • Drive delivery for Search, PK, Memory, and Knowledge Catalog programs, managing the process from problem definition to launch and subsequent post-launch refinement.

  • Convert product and engineering roadmaps into prioritized, sequenced plans featuring clear objectives, owners, timelines, and success criteria.

  • Coordinate cross-functional teams (Product, Engineering, Science, Development, Analytics, GCX or equivalent experience) to deliver features such as memory-powered personalization, catalog quality improvements, and search relevance changes.

  • Identify and manage risks, issues, and dependencies early, drive mitigations, and bring up clear options and trade-offs when needed.

  • Define and track program benchmarks (search relevance, surface rate, memory adoption, catalog coverage and quality, latency, reliability metrics) and use them to steer execution.

  • Navigate ambiguity by structuring problem statements, clarifying ownership, and iterating toward solutions with incremental, testable achievements.
     

Requirements

  • 5–7+ years of experience in technical program management, project management, or similar roles delivering multi-team initiatives in technology or e-commerce environments.

  • Experience managing extensive, data-intensive, or distributed systems such as search, ranking, recommendations, or data/ML platforms.

  • Solid understanding of structured data models (entities, relationships, taxonomies, schemas) and their role in discovery, analytics, and user experiences.

  • Strong program execution skills: prioritizing, planning, scheduling, dependency management, and risk/issue management across multiple teams.

  • Established experience partnering with various groups (Product, Engineering, Science, Build, Analytics, Finance, GCX) and promoting agreement in complicated, multi-interest environments.

  • Excellent written and verbal presentation skills, including the ability to explain intricate Search/PK/Memory problems and trade-offs to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Proficiency using data, dashboards, experimentation, and modern delivery tools (e.g., Jira) to make decisions, prioritize work, and communicate impact.
     

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building personalization, or data- and machine learning-based systems at scale.

  • Solid grasp of product catalog/knowledge graph systems (entities, attributes, taxonomies) and how they impact discovery and browsing experiences.

  • Familiarity with user-memory or personalization systems (cross-session signals, profiles, histories) and their integration with search, recommendations, or PK.

  • Experience using AI tools to improve TPM workflows such as status reporting, risk tracking, documentation, and dependency management.

  • Practical experience with Airtable, Claude Code, and Jira, or similar tools used for planning, execution tracking, portfolio reporting, and engineering workflows.

Additional Details

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.

At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

Analytics is undergoing a fundamental shift, moving from traditional data science and manual reporting toward AI-driven analytics product development. As business intelligence evolves into intelligent, AI-powered tooling, we are looking for someone eager to help lead this transformation.

This role sits at the critical intersection of business analytics, prototyping, and AI engineering. You will play a key part in reimagining our Business Intelligence ecosystem by stepping into the role of an AI Analytics Prototyper.

We are building toward a future where business and product teams can diagnose performance, uncover insights, and tak1e action through AI-enabled experiences. If you’re motivated to move beyond ad-hoc analysis into designing the blueprints for AI agents, mapping out deep business logic, and building functional prototypes that our developers will productionize, this is an opportunity to be at the forefront of shaping how eBay interacts with data in the AI era.

About the role: Join us to act as the analytical engine behind our agentic AI systems. You will bridge the gap between complex business diagnostics and Agentic analytics product development. You will focus on deep-dive business analysis, creating the analytical logic, and building functional prototypes (e.g., via Python, Streamlit, or Jupyter). You ensure the AI system's answers are accurate, verifiable, logical, and easy for stakeholders to understand and act.

What you’ll do

  • Build AI analytics prototypes: Create functional prototypes using Python, Streamlit, SQL, and similar tools to show how AI agents should analyze data and generate business narratives

  • Drive Business Diagnostics: Deep dive into business performance (e.g., GMV variances, funnel conversion, traffic trends etc), uncover root-cause drivers, and translate this manual diagnostic logic into structured rules and workflows for AI agents.

  • Validate & Evaluate AI Outputs: Define the queries, transformations, metrics, and validation logic needed to ensure AI-generated insights are accurate and verifiable.

  • Bridge business and technical teams: Translate business needs into schemas, metadata, logic trees, and tool-call requirements for data product and AI development teams.

  • Evaluate AI output quality: Test prototypes and model outputs for accuracy, relevance, statistical soundness, and hallucination risk

  • Partner Across Disciplines: Work with business leaders, data scientists, and AI developers to move prototypes toward scalable production systems.

Must-have:

  • 8+ years in advanced data analytics, business performance diagnostics, or data science.

  • Strong hands-on experience building functional data prototypes, automated workflows, or internal tooling (e.g., using Python, Pandas, Streamlit, Gradio, or Jupyter Notebooks).

  • Deep expertise in SQL, data modeling, and dissecting complex business metrics (e.g., isolating mix vs. rate impacts, A/B testing, cohort analysis).

  • Exceptional business acumen—the ability to look at a variance in a dashboard, manually diagnose the "why" behind it, and document that analytical thought process into a repeatable algorithm.

  • Familiarity with LLM/agent integrations (understanding how structured tool calls, prompts, and retrieval-augmented generation work conceptually).

  • Obsessive commitment to data accuracy, reproducibility, and explainability.

Nice to have:

  • Background in e-commerce, marketplace analytics, or corporate finance/business performance tracking.

  • Exposure to LLM prompt optimization, chaining, and human-in-the-loop evaluation.

  • Experience partnering directly with software engineering or platform teams to hand off prototype code for productionization.

Success looks like: You successfully bridge the gap between executive business questions and Agentic Analytics development. Your prototypes and diagnostic blueprints enable the development team to build highly accurate, trustworthy AI agents that automate deep performance analysis. Because of your logic and testing, analysts and executives trust the AI's insights implicitly.

 

Additional Details

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.

 

We use cookies to enhance your experience and may use AI tools for administrative tasks in the hiring process. To learn how we handle your personal data and use AI responsibly, please visit our Talent Privacy Notice, Privacy Center, and AI Hiring Guidelines.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

About the Role

We're looking for an Platform Reliability Engineer to own the reliability, operability, and evolution of our internal engineering platform. This is a hands-on role at the intersection of platform engineering, reliability, and intelligent automation with a clear mandate: reduce toil, improve observability, and enable systems (AI agents) to safely operate at scale.

You'll work directly with engineering teams to harden services, respond to incidents, and build automation that makes the platform increasingly self-managing over time. A key aspect of this role is designing and operating AI-driven and agent-based workflows, including the guardrails, validation systems, and observability needed to allow automated systems to safely generate and act on changes in production environments.

What You'll Do

  • Own reliability, availability, and performance of the internal platform and critical services

  • Participate in on-call rotations; lead incident triage, debugging, root cause analysis, and post-mortems

  • Build and operate platform automation and AI-powered workflows (including agent-based systems) to reduce manual operational effort

  • Design and implement guardrails, validation pipelines, and safety mechanisms for automated and AI-generated changes to code and infrastructure

  • Enable closed-loop automation systems (detect → diagnose → remediate → validate) to improve system resilience

  • Define and track SLIs and SLOs; use reliability data to guide engineering decisions

  • Standardize build, deployment, and release workflows for safe, predictable delivery, including automation-friendly and AI-integrated pipelines

  • Identify and remediate security vulnerabilities across systems and services, including risks introduced by automated changes

  • Partner with development teams on service design, resilience, and operability, with an emphasis on automation-first and AI-compatible system design

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience operating production platforms or large-scale distributed systems

  • Proven track record in incident management, on-call operations, and production debugging

  • Strong programming skills in Java, Python, Go, Shell, or equivalent

  • Hands-on experience with observability tooling (monitoring, alerting, logging, tracing)

  • Experience building or maintaining CI/CD pipelines and release processes

  • Familiarity with platform upgrades, dependency management, and system lifecycle operations

  • Experience building or integrating AI-driven (agent-based) automation frameworks, or strong interest in this space

  • Working knowledge of Linux-based production environments

  • Strong communication and cross-team collaboration skills

Nice to Have

  • Experience with SRE frameworks: SLOs, error budgets, reliability reviews

  • Experience with chaos engineering or resilience testing

  • Background in building self-healing systems

  • History of driving platform standardization across large engineering organizations

What Success Looks Like at 6 Months

  • Platform reliability metrics are tracked, visible, and trending in the right direction

  • On-call burden is measurably reduced through automation and better runbooks

  • At least one significant automation or autonomous remediation initiative shipped and adopted by engineering teams

  • Platform upgrades and rollouts are executed safely with documented processes

  • AI-driven or automated changes are safely deployed with clear guardrails, observability, and rollback mechanism

Key Traits

Strong ownership mentality. Calm under pressure. Bias toward automation. Systems thinker who doesn't just fix problems but builds systems that prevent, detect, and autonomously remediate issues over time.

Additional Details

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. description_text:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

About the Team

We are the engineering team within Customer Service Technology under eBay’s Global Technology Organization. The team owns eBay’s core knowledge and content management platform for customer service, powering capabilities such as HelpHub, CSKB, conversational help, in-flow help, email experiences, and other customer- and agent-facing surfaces that depend on accurate, governed content at scale.

Our mission is to build a single-sourced, AI-powered content ecosystem that enables teams to create once and deliver everywhere. We focus on delivering fast, consistent, and trustworthy experiences across channels through scalable platform services, intuitive user interfaces, and seamless integrations.

As a Full Stack Developer on the team, you will work across frontend applications, backend services, APIs, and platform integrations to build reliable, high-performing solutions that improve both customer and internal experiences. You will collaborate closely with Product, Design, Content, Data, and platform teams to deliver modern, end-to-end applications with strong usability, performance, and maintainability.

What You Will Do

  • Translate product and business requirements into scalable technical designs and deliver clean, efficient, maintainable code across the full stack.

  • Design, develop, test, and deploy full stack applications, including responsive user interfaces, backend services, and APIs.

  • Build intuitive frontend experiences using modern web technologies while ensuring accessibility, usability, and performance.

  • Develop and enhance backend systems, services, and integrations that support content delivery, workflow automation, and knowledge experiences at scale.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Product, UX, Content, and Data to deliver end-to-end solutions aligned with business goals.

  • Contribute to architecture discussions and help drive best practices for frontend and backend development, code quality, testing, and observability.

  • Improve engineering productivity by identifying opportunities for better tooling, reusable components, and streamlined development workflows.

  • Design for flexibility and scale by anticipating evolving requirements and creating extensible systems and UI patterns.

  • Participate in code reviews, technical design reviews, release processes, and production support for business-critical applications.

  • Support operational excellence through monitoring, debugging, incident response, and continuous improvement of application reliability and performance.

What you will bring:

  • 4+ years of software development experience with strong computer science fundamentals and problem-solving skills.

  • Strong experience in full stack development, including backend services and modern frontend frameworks.

  • Proficiency in Java and/or Python for backend development, with experience building scalable APIs and distributed services.

  • Proficiency in JavaScript or TypeScript and experience with modern frontend frameworks such as React, Marko, or Node.js-based applications.

  • Hands-on experience building responsive, user-friendly web applications with a strong understanding of frontend architecture, state management, and component-based design.

  • Experience working with REST and/or GraphQL APIs and integrating frontend applications with backend services.

  • Solid understanding of databases and data access patterns, including relational and NoSQL systems.

  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, Git, automated testing, and modern software engineering practices in an Agile environment.

  • Experience building or integrating AI-powered features is a plus, including LLM-based workflows, API integrations, evaluation, monitoring, and guardrails.

  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools to improve delivery speed and code quality is a plus.

Additional Details

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.

 

We use cookies to enhance your experience and may use AI tools for administrative tasks in the hiring process. To learn how we handle your personal data and use AI responsibly, please visit our Talent Privacy Notice, Privacy Center, and AI Hiring Guidelines.

eBay is a global commerce leader that connects millions of buyers and sellers around the world. We empower people and create economic opportunities for individuals, businesses, and communities. We're driven by a vision to create a more sustainable form of commerce that benefits the environment and society as a whole. Join us as we continue to innovate and shape the future of e-commerce.

Job Description:

Cloud Data Technologies (CDT) team at eBay is responsible for all the data infrastructure and management of end-to-end data lifecycle for all eBay data from onsite to analytics use cases. We are seeking a Software Engineer passionate about data-driven technologies and architectures.

About the Role

We’re seeking a Member of Technical Staff 1 (Software Engineer) who can work independently and is an expert in distributed systems. You’ll design and deliver well-scoped services and features that advance eBay’s Core Data Platform—improving scalability, reliability, and developer experience. 

What you will accomplish:

  • Design, build, test and deploy software components for a highly available and large distributed system.

  • Perform development and operational tasks to maintain uptime & reliability SLAs of the platform.

  • Consistently deliver high-quality and on-time product releases and deploy to production.

  • Collaborate with product management, customers, peer teams and engineers.

  • Participate in and/or lead engineering discussions, technical evaluations, design reviews and other project discussions.

  • Follow internal Quality and Reliability engineering processes to meet or exceed established standards.

What you will bring:

  • Bachelor’s/Master’s/Ph.D. in Computer Science, Engineering or related field.

  • 7+ years work experience in software design and implementation, ideally in large scale, 24x7 dedicated distributed systems.

  • Expertise in object-oriented design and backend software development using Java (preferred), Python, or similar technologies.

  • Excellent understanding of computer science fundamentals, data structures, algorithms and distributed systems.

  • Experience with agile development methodologies in an iterative development environment.

  • Experience using open-source technologies and/or contributing to open source software.

  • Proven track record with understanding requirements and translating them into high quality engineering work.

  • Proactive and upbeat engineer with a strong bias for action.

  • Strong verbal & written communication skills and attention to detail.

  • Experience working with large volume of data is a plus

Why Join CDT @ eBay

  • Impact at scale: Your platform work powers analytics and ML across a global marketplace.

  • Hard problems: Streaming freshness/correctness, storage/compute efficiency, multi-region resiliency.

  • Collaborative culture: Inclusive team that values autonomy, craftsmanship, and knowledge sharing.

  • Growth: Strong mentorship, career development resources, and sustainable on-call practices.

Additional Details

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. description_text:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

About the team

We are the Digital Services team within Customer Service Technology under eBay’s Global Technology Organization. We own the end-to-end online customer service experience across web and native mobile, helping millions of buyers and sellers get fast, effective help every day.

Our mission is to keep members in-journey and resolve issues through intuitive, compliant self-service experiences, driving high containment and deflection, lower customer effort (CES), and reduced assisted contact. We design and build the experiences that enable customers to quickly find answers, resolve issues through self-service, and get support when needed. . Partnering closely with Product, Design, Data, and Platform teams, we deliver intuitive, reliable, and scalable solutions that improve the end-to-end customer service journey. 

Our engineers work across frontend applications, backend services, APIs, and platform integrations using a modern, diverse tech stack that includes Java, Node.js, web services, native iOS and Android, and a variety of data stores such as NoSQL and Oracle, with a strong focus on quality, observability, and collaboration in a highly distributed environment.

What you'll do and learn:

  • Translate requirements into software designs and deliver clean, efficient, extensible, and maintainable frontend code.

  • Own and deliver significant features or subsystems within a larger domain across the software lifecycle, including design, development, testing, deployment, observability, and monitoring.

  • Design and build responsive, accessible, and high-performing web experiences using modern frontend technologies and frameworks.

  • Collaborate effectively with Product, Design, Data, and Platform partners to deliver intuitive and reliable customer experiences.

  • Identify areas of the product likely to evolve and help design flexible, reusable solutions that improve maintainability and engineering velocity.

  • Apply strong engineering practices to ensure features are testable, high quality, and continuously deliverable.

  • Break down project features into clear implementation tasks, identify risks and dependencies, and drive execution with minimal supervision.

  • Participate in technical discussions, design reviews, and code reviews, contributing thoughtful input and sound engineering judgment.

  • Support and improve end-to-end testing quality, frontend reliability, and delivery velocity across features.

  • Contribute to debugging, release support, production monitoring, and on-call responsibilities for an always-on 24/7 site.

What you bring:

  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability, with solid collaboration and interpersonal skills.

  • Self-driven with a strong ability to learn quickly and adapt to changing priorities.

  • Passion for building intuitive, high-quality user experiences and exploring new technologies within your area of expertise.

  • Commitment to continuous learning through internal and external knowledge-sharing.

  • Interest in developing broad, transferable skills and growing as an engineer.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in EE, CS, or a related field.

  • 4+ years of experience designing and building frontend systems using JavaScript/TypeScript, CSS, React, Node.js, and server-side rendering frameworks.

  • Strong experience integrating frontend applications with REST and/or GraphQL APIs.

  • Strong understanding of web fundamentals, browser behavior, performance optimization, accessibility, and responsive design.

  • Experience with modern frontend architecture patterns, reusable component design, and styling methodologies such as BEM.

  • Experience with build and development tooling such as Webpack, Express.js, and related frontend ecosystem tools.

  • Demonstrated success delivering results in fast-paced environments using Agile, TDD, CI/CD, and modern engineering practices.

  • Ability to build scalable, reliable, and high-performing user-facing applications.

Additional Details

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.

 

We use cookies to enhance your experience and may use AI tools for administrative tasks in the hiring process. To learn how we handle your personal data and use AI responsibly, please visit our Talent Privacy Notice, Privacy Center, and AI Hiring Guidelines.
