Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

Join the group at eBay passionate about Customer Support Technology to compose, build, and evolve the intelligent platform systems that power our global customer support ecosystem. As a Software Engineer 3, you will lead initiatives across DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), release engineering, integration of quality engineering automation to improve platform reliability, deployment safety, engineering efficiency, and operational scalability.

This is a hands-on engineering role focused on building scalable automation frameworks, CI/CD platforms, intelligent operational tooling, observability systems, and automated QE integration testing solutions. You will work across teams to drive operational excellence, reduce manual effort, improve release quality, and enable reliable service operations at scale.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, and enhance scalable CI/CD, build, deployment, and release engineering systems

  • Build and sustain QE integration automation test systems supporting release quality and platform reliability

  • Build automated validation frameworks incorporated within CI/CD pipelines for functional, integration, regression, and reliability testing

  • Develop and maintain AI/AE-powered operational automation systems to improve engineering productivity and operational efficiency

  • Build intelligent automation solutions for monitoring, alerting, diagnostics, remediation, and release validation

  • Improve deployment safety through automated quality gates, release verification, and observability-driven automation

  • Lead troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and resolution of complex production incidents

  • Develop self-service platform tooling and automation frameworks for engineering teams

  • Improve platform health through proactive monitoring, telemetry, SLOs, SLIs, and operational metrics

  • Collaborate with QE, platform, infrastructure, and application engineering teams to improve release confidence and system resiliency

  • Contribute to architectural decisions for cloud-native platform systems and operational tooling

  • Mentor junior engineers and help promote technical and functional excellence across teams

  • Participate in on-call rotations and incident response leadership as needed

Must-Have Qualifications

  • BS/MS in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent practical experience)

  • 4–7 years of experience in software engineering, DevOps, SRE, platform engineering, or related areas

  • Strong programming and scripting skills in Java, Python, Go, or similar languages

  • Strong experience with:

    • CI/CD systems and release automation

    • Distributed systems and cloud-native architectures

    • Production operations and reliability engineering

  • Experience building automation frameworks and operational tooling

  • Experience developing or maintaining automated testing frameworks and QE integration systems

  • Strong understanding of integration testing, regression automation, and release validation strategies

  • Experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD and deployment workflows

  • Strong understanding of observability concepts including metrics, logging, tracing, and alerting

  • Experience debugging complex distributed production environments

Additionally

  • Experience building backend services and APIs supporting deployment, automation, or operational systems

  • Ability to design scalable automation solutions with minimal operational overhead

  • Experience collaborating across engineering organizations to improve developer productivity and operational efficiency

  • Understanding of reliability concepts such as SLOs, SLIs, error budgets, incident response, and operational excellence

  • Ability to balance system reliability, release velocity, and quality engineering objectives

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, and container orchestration technologies

  • Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code and configuration management tools

  • Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure

  • Experience with AI-assisted developer tooling, intelligent automation systems, or agentic workflow platforms

  • Familiarity with observability tools including Splunk, Grafana, Prometheus, and OpenTelemetry

  • Experience with QE automation frameworks and continuous testing platforms

  • Exposure to AIOps, predictive monitoring, or self-healing infrastructure systems

  • Experience driving platform modernization and engineering productivity initiatives

What Success Looks Like

  • Improves platform reliability, scalability, and deployment safety

  • Builds automation systems that significantly reduce operational toil and manual validation effort

  • Improves release quality and engineering productivity through scalable QE integration automation systems

  • Develops effective AI-enabled engineering and operational automation solutions

  • Leads resolution and prevention of complex production issues

  • Enables faster, safer, and more reliable software releases through intelligent automation and quality gates

  • Demonstrates strong ownership, technical leadership, and cross-team collaboration

  • Mentors engineers and contributes to a strong culture of operational and engineering excellence

Team & Impact

You’ll be part of eBay’s Customer Support Technology team responsible for enabling reliable, scalable, and intelligent service operations across customer support platforms. Your work will directly improve platform resiliency, release velocity, operational automation, quality engineering integration, and developer productivity through advanced DevOps, SRE, AI-driven engineering systems, and QE automation frameworks.

Here at eBay, we love creating opportunities for others by connecting people from widely diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and geographies. So, being diverse and inclusive isn’t just something we strive for, it is who we are, and part of what we do each and every single day. We want to ensure that as an employee, you feel eBay is a place where, no matter who you are, you feel safe, included, and that you have the opportunity to bring your unique self to work. To learn about eBay’s Diversity & Inclusion click here: https://www.ebayinc.com/our-company/diversity-inclusion/.

description_text:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

Senior Manager, Software Development 

About the Team and Role

At eBay, we connect millions of people around the world, empowering them to buy, sell, and discover value through technology. We’re driven by purpose, passion, and innovation — and we’re looking for a Senior Manager, Software Development to lead a diverse, cross-functional engineering team spanning backend, frontend, full-stack, iOS, and Android disciplines.

In this role, you’ll guide talented engineers in building scalable, resilient, and high-performing applications that power one of the world’s largest online marketplaces. You’ll drive architectural vision, enable technical excellence, and foster a culture of ownership, inclusion, and continuous learning — helping shape the future of global commerce at eBay.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead Engineering Execution: Manage and mentor a multidisciplinary team of backend, frontend, full-stack, and mobile engineers across levels, fostering a culture of innovation, accountability, and technical excellence.
     

  • Drive Architecture and Design: Architect and evolve scalable, distributed, and fault-tolerant systems that serve millions of daily users globally.
     

  • Own End-to-End Delivery: Oversee the full software lifecycle — from concept and design through implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing site reliability.
     

  • Technical Leadership: Guide technical direction for the team, providing expertise in backend technologies (Java, Python, Node.js), microservices, APIs, and modern web and mobile frameworks.
     

  • Champion Quality and Security: Ensure best practices for code quality, observability, performance, and security are embedded throughout the development and release process.
     

  • Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Partner closely with product management, design, payments, and platform teams to align technology strategies with eBay’s business objectives.
     

  • Operational Excellence: Implement CI/CD pipelines, lead production readiness reviews, and maintain high service uptime for our “always-on” global platform.
     

  • Innovation and Growth: Stay ahead of emerging technologies (AI/ML, event-driven systems, cloud-native tools) and drive adoption of modern engineering patterns that enhance developer productivity and product velocity.
     

  • Mentor and Develop Talent: Coach engineers and engineering managers, providing guidance on career development, technical growth, and effective cross-team collaboration.
     

What You’ll Bring

  • Extensive Technical Background:
     

    • 12+ years of hands-on software development experience building large-scale, high-volume systems using Java, Python, Node.js, or Scala.
       

    • Proven success designing and delivering microservices and event-driven architectures in cloud-based environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
       

    • Deep understanding of RESTful APIs, RDBMS/NoSQL databases, ElasticSearch, and container orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).
       

    • Familiarity with frontend frameworks (ReactJS, Angular, or equivalent) and mobile app ecosystems (iOS/Android).
       

  • Leadership Experience:
     

    • Minimum 5 years of engineering management experience, leading multi-tier teams with engineers across backend, frontend, and mobile disciplines.
       

    • Strong track record of scaling teams, improving delivery efficiency, and building a healthy, inclusive team culture.
       

    • Demonstrated ability to balance hands-on technical leadership with strategic organizational guidance.
       

  • Domain Expertise:
     

    • Experience in Payments, Financial Services, or related transaction-heavy systems preferred.
       

    • Understanding of security, compliance, and regulatory standards within financial or commerce platforms.
       

  • Operational & Agile Mastery:
     

    • Expertise in Agile methodologies, iterative delivery, and project management within complex product ecosystems.
       

    • Skilled in designing and implementing CI/CD pipelines, monitoring systems, and release automation frameworks.
       

  • Soft Skills and Leadership Qualities:
     

    • Exceptional communication and decision-making skills; capable of influencing technical and non-technical stakeholders alike.
       

    • Strong sense of ownership, resilience, and adaptability — embracing challenges and differences to drive results.
       

    • Passionate about mentoring and enabling others to reach their full potential, including distributed and remote teams.
       

Nice to Have

  • Experience applying AI or machine learning to real-world product or infrastructure challenges.
     

  • Contributions to open-source projects or active engagement in the software engineering community.
     

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field (Master’s degree preferred).
     

Why Join eBay

At eBay, your work touches millions of lives every day. You’ll lead a team that builds technology at global scale — enabling trust, opportunity, and innovation in commerce. We foster an environment where diverse perspectives are valued, bold ideas are celebrated, and continuous learning is encouraged.

Additional Details

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.

 

We use cookies to enhance your experience and may use AI tools for administrative tasks in the hiring process. To learn how we handle your personal data and use AI responsibly, please visit our Talent Privacy Notice, Privacy Center, and AI Hiring Guidelines.

Our goal is to create exceptional customer experiences that enable buyers and sellers to connect and transact seamlessly across the world’s largest marketplace. We’re a collaborative team of analytical thinkers and innovators focused on building secure, scalable, and efficient payment systems that power global commerce.

We’re looking for an exceptional, motivated, and detail-oriented professional with strong experience in finance, payments and business analytics to join our team. In this role, you’ll bring curiosity, analytical rigor, identify trends, and define business requirements.  You’ll partner with cross-functional teams and external organizations to enhance operational efficiency, drive platform innovation, and support business operations and product improvements that elevate the customer experience. 

You will also manage the day-to-day operations of our vendor portals and payment accounts, including compliance and audit readiness. Drawing on your global eCommerce payments experience and analytical acumen, you will translate insights into actionable recommendations and well-defined business solutions that support sustainable growth.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Research and analyze global payment trends, emerging technologies, and the competitive landscape to identify opportunities for innovation and improvement

  • Present research findings, payment trends and process improvement opportunities to stakeholders

  • Create and document business requirements, policies and procedures that support the execution of the strategic vision

  • Partner with product managers and cross-functional teams to ensure alignment and successful delivery of payment platform initiatives

  • Collaborate with business development and finance teams to develop data driven  business cases and recommendations

  • Act as a liaison between vendors and internal teams to facilitate smooth daily operations and resolve issues efficiently

  • Define, manage and implement compliance policies; oversee vendor portal access and coordinate with auditors to ensure SOX and other regulatory compliance requirements are met

Qualifications

  • BA/BS required, MBA preferred in finance, economics, business, information technology or a related field

  • 3+ years of experience in ecommerce, payments, investment banking, cross border, payment networks or related fields. Experience in fintech is a plus

  • 3+ years in product strategy, product management, and/or go-to-market roles

  • Strong business judgement and quantitative analytical skills with the ability to engage deeply in technical discussions as needed

  • Solid understanding of global payments ecosystems, gateways, and cross border transactions processes

  • Proven ability to extract insights from research and analysis to inform business recommendations

  • Excellent communication skills, being clear, concise and effective in both written and verbal formats

  • High intellectual curiosity, passion for problem solving and comfort operating in ambiguous, fast paced environments

  • Ability to foster relationships and influence across teams and partners without direct authority

  • Innovative mindset with a proactive approach to identifying and solving problems 

  • Capable of managing multiple projects simultaneously in a dynamic, evolving work environment

We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

About the Team

The Finance Innovation & Transformation (FIT) organization partners closely with FP&A, Accounting, Tax, Treasury, and Technology teams to modernize financial planning, improve data transparency, and enable faster, more confident decision making across the enterprise.

FIT focuses on aligning planning processes, systems, and data to support scalable forecasting, accurate reporting, and operational excellence across Finance.

The Role

We are seeking a Business Systems Analyst – Finance Systems with a strong FP&A orientation to support the accuracy, reliability, and usability of eBay’s financial planning and reporting ecosystem. This role works across Anaplan, SAP S/4HANA, SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC), and automation tools to ensure that Finance stakeholders have trusted data for planning, forecasting, and performance analysis.

The ideal candidate brings a deep understanding of FP&A processes and financial systems, with demonstrated strength in auditing data, reconciling variances, and resolving reporting issues across integrated platforms.

What You Will Accomplish

  • Support day‑to‑day operations of FP&A‑critical systems including Anaplan, SAP S/4HANA, and SAC, ensuring stable planning and reporting cycles

  • Partner closely with FP&A teams during budgeting, forecasting, and outlook cycles, supporting data readiness, validation, and issue resolution

  • Assist in the design, requirements and testing of Anaplan planning models, S4 implementations, & SAC reports, documenting requirements and test scripts, and testing to ensure implementation accuracy & success

  • Perform end‑to‑end audits and reconciliations between planning, ERP, and reporting systems to ensure forecast and actuals alignment

  • Investigate and explain plan vs. actual, forecast vs. forecast, and reporting variances, identifying root causes related to data, mappings, or system behavior

  • Validate planning master data, hierarchies, drivers, and assumptions to ensure consistency across models and reports

  • Support management and executive reporting by ensuring data accuracy, timing, and transparency

  • Leverage automation, AI and analytics tools to streamline reconciliations, variance analysis, and validation checks, reducing manual effort

  • Support user acceptance testing (UAT) for planning model changes, system upgrades, and new integrations impacting FP&A processes

  • Maintain validation reports, reconciliation frameworks, and documentation to support auditability and repeatable planning cycles

  • Collaborate with Accounting, IT, and data teams to resolve integration, timing, and data quality issues affecting forecasts and reports

  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives focused on forecast accuracy, planning efficiency, and data trust

What You Will Bring

  • 5+ years of experience supporting FP&A, finance systems, or financial planning and reporting processes

  • Hands‑on experience with planning and reporting platforms such as Anaplan, SAP Analytics Cloud, SAP S/4HANA, or similar tools

  • Solid experience in auditing, reconciling, and validating planning and actuals data across multiple systems

  • Ability to analyze and resolve forecasting and reporting discrepancies with clear, finance‑based explanations

  • Demonstrated expertise in FP&A processes, including budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, and management reporting

  • Experience supporting planning-to-ERP integrations and understanding how upstream data impacts forecasts

  • Proficiency with automation or data preparation tools (e.g., Alteryx, advanced Excel) to support FP&A analysis and controls

  • Ability to handle competing priorities during critical planning and close timelines

  • Good communication skills, with the ability to translate system behavior into FP&A‑relevant insights

  • Exposure to global FP&A operations or COE models preferred

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Technology, or related field, or equivalent experience

Additional Details

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.

At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

Intake Form – Senior UX Designer, Mobile

1. Position Details

  • Job Title: Sr. UX Designer – Mobile

  • Hiring Manager: John Corrigan

  • Interview Lead: Jazon Hart

  • Team: TCGplayer – UX Design Team

  • Location: Bangalore

  • Relocation: No

  • Grade: T25

2. Role Summary

As a User Experience Designer, you will apply your domain expertise and knowledge of UX best practices to drive high-impact product improvements for our TCGplayer mobile app — a critical customer-facing platform connecting hobbyists with our marketplace. You will join us as we explore emerging design-to-code workflows and AI-augmented design tools, contributing to how we work as we continue building our mobile design capability. In this role, you will partner with cross-functional peers to design and deliver user-centered solutions for both buyers and sellers. You will create thoughtful mobile experiences through an established design process grounded in research and validated through user testing.

Our User Experience Design team prides itself on fostering camaraderie, embracing diversity, and bringing passion to the work. We value curiosity, craft, and a desire to stay connected to the real world. You do not need to be a hobbyist or gamer to thrive in TCGplayer's UX Design organization, but you should be comfortable with ambiguity and excited to support our commitment to making hobbies and games accessible, fun, and rewarding for everyone. If you are equal parts empathy and ambition, this is an opportunity to take risks, stretch yourself, and grow alongside teammates who will support you.

What you will accomplish

  • Explore new design-to-code workflows alongside the design lead, including AI-assisted tools and evaluating designs in working code rather than only in static deliverables

  • Balance traditional UX deliverables with evolving modern workflows

  • Create UX deliverables throughout the design process, evolving designs from early concepts, wireframes, and prototypes to final specifications

  • Deliver high-value features across multiple projects, ensuring design solutions support user needs, align with business goals, and positively impact key performance metrics

  • Apply advanced knowledge of Figma to create, iterate, and hand off design assets while working within an established design system

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teammates to deliver high-quality solutions that drive value, inform product strategy, and support data-driven decision-making

  • Participate in user testing, workshops, and research efforts to gather insights and validate design decisions

  • Gain leadership approval and team alignment through compelling storytelling that clearly communicates your ideas and design rationale

  • Build knowledge about trends in the trading card game (TCG) space, mobile commerce, and best-in-class mobile app experiences — actively sharing relevant ideas and inspiration

3. Key Skills and Technologies

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in a dedicated User Experience Design role with a BA/BS degree in Design, Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), or equivalent practical experience

  • Comfort with technical environments and willingness to work alongside engineering tools and AI-augmented workflows

  • Strong portfolio showcasing end-to-end user-centered design solutions and problem-solving skills with measurable impact, including demonstrated experience in mobile app design

  • Experience designing mobile applications (iOS and/or Android), with a strong focus on mobile-first user experiences, touch interactions, and mobile design patterns

  • Mastery of standard interactive design tools such as Figma, plus an understanding of mobile design constraints and platform-specific guidelines (iOS Human Interface Guidelines, Material Design)

  • Extensive experience using research, user testing, and quantitative and qualitative data to inform design decisions, with a focus on usability testing and solution mapping for mobile applications

  • Expertise in adaptive mobile design across device sizes (phones, tablets), mobile-first design, and WCAG accessibility standards

  • Proven ability to work effectively within an agile environment and a multidisciplinary team, including fellow designers, product managers, software engineers, and stakeholders

  • Proven experience managing all aspects of a design project from strategy through execution, launch, and support in a software development environment

  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with the gaming, hobby, or collectibles community — particularly trading card games

  • Experience designing for mobile commerce and marketplace applications

  • Understanding of mobile app performance considerations and their impact on UX

  • Experience evaluating and refining designs in working code rather than solely in design tools

Additional Details

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.

 

We use cookies to enhance your experience and may use AI tools for administrative tasks in the hiring process. To learn how we handle your personal data and use AI responsibly, please visit our Talent Privacy Notice, Privacy Center, and AI Hiring Guidelines.

At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

About the Team

We are the Product Development team within Customer Service Technology, part of eBay’s Global Technology Organization. Our mission is to build and operate scalable, reliable platforms that power customer service experiences across eBay.

Our engineers work across the stack—developing frontend applications, backend services, APIs, and integrations—using a modern technology ecosystem that includes Node.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, and NoSQL databases. We emphasize scalability, observability, and strong collaboration in a distributed environment, while continuously evolving our systems to improve customer experience and operational efficiency.

Role Overview

As a Software Engineer 3, you will play a key role in developing and enhancing a call center application (ICX platform). You will work on improving existing features, resolving technical challenges, and contributing to new initiatives that elevate customer support experiences.

You will join a growing team and collaborate closely with cross-functional partners to build scalable, resilient, and AI-enabled systems.

What You Will Do

  • Translate product and business requirements into scalable designs and deliver clean, maintainable code.

  • Design, build, test, and deploy full-stack applications, including user interfaces, backend services, APIs, and integrations.

  • Develop scalable, resilient systems that power customer self-service experiences across web and internal platforms.

  • Collaborate with Product, Design, Data, and Platform teams to deliver end-to-end solutions aligned with engineering standards.

  • Design flexible, reusable systems that accommodate frequent change and improve long-term velocity.

  • Improve developer productivity through better tooling, reusable components, and streamlined processes.

  • Ensure high-quality, testable, and observable systems using modern engineering and operational practices.

  • Participate in design reviews, contribute to architecture decisions, and provide thoughtful code reviews.

  • Identify systemic gaps, propose pragmatic solutions, and contribute to the engineering roadmap.

  • Support production systems through monitoring, debugging, incident response, and on-call rotation for a 24/7 platform.



What You Will Bring

  • 3+ years of software development experience with strong computer science fundamentals.

  • Experience building full-stack applications, including frontend, backend services, and API integrations.

  • Strong proficiency in TypeScript and Node.js, with experience building scalable APIs (REST and/or GraphQL).

  • Experience designing and integrating distributed systems in high-scale environments.

  • Solid understanding of databases and data access patterns, including NoSQL systems.

  • Familiarity with Agile development, CI/CD pipelines, Git, testing strategies, and modern engineering practices.

  • Experience leveraging AI-assisted development tools (e.g., code generation, test automation, code review aids) to improve productivity and code quality.

Additional Details

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. description_text:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

About the Team

We are the engineering team within Customer Service Technology under eBay’s Global Technology Organization. The team owns eBay’s core knowledge and content management platform for customer service, powering capabilities such as HelpHub, CSKB, conversational help, in-flow help, email experiences, and other customer- and agent-facing surfaces that depend on accurate, governed content at scale. Our mission is to build a single-sourced, AI-powered content ecosystem that enables teams to create once and deliver everywhere. We focus on delivering fast, consistent, and trustworthy experiences across channels through scalable platform services, intuitive user interfaces, and seamless integrations.

As a Full Stack Developer on the team, you will work across frontend applications, backend services, APIs, and platform integrations to build reliable, high-performing solutions that improve both customer and internal experiences. You will collaborate closely with Product, Design, Content, Data, and platform teams to deliver modern, end-to-end applications with strong usability, performance, and maintainability.

What You Will Do

  • Translate product and business requirements into scalable technical designs and deliver clean, efficient, maintainable code across the full stack.

  • Design, develop, test, and deploy full stack applications, including responsive user interfaces, backend services, and APIs.

  • Build intuitive frontend experiences using modern web technologies while ensuring accessibility, usability, and performance.

  • Develop and enhance backend systems, services, and integrations that support content delivery, workflow automation, and knowledge experiences at scale.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Product, UX, Content, and Data to deliver end-to-end solutions aligned with business goals.

  • Contribute to architecture discussions and help drive best practices for frontend and backend development, code quality, testing, and observability.

  • Improve engineering productivity by identifying opportunities for better tooling, reusable components, and streamlined development workflows.

  • Design for flexibility and scale by anticipating evolving requirements and creating extensible systems and UI patterns.

  • Participate in code reviews, technical design reviews, release processes, and production support for business-critical applications.

  • Support operational excellence through monitoring, debugging, incident response, and continuous improvement of application reliability and performance.

What you will bring:

  • 4+ years of software development experience with strong computer science fundamentals and problem-solving skills.

  • Strong experience in full stack development, including backend services and modern frontend frameworks.

  • Proficiency in Java and/or Python for backend development, with experience building scalable APIs and distributed services.

  • Proficiency in JavaScript or TypeScript and experience with modern frontend frameworks such as React, Marko, or Node.js-based applications.

  • Hands-on experience building responsive, user-friendly web applications with a strong understanding of frontend architecture, state management, and component-based design.

  • Experience working with REST and/or GraphQL APIs and integrating frontend applications with backend services.

  • Solid understanding of databases and data access patterns, including relational and NoSQL systems.

  • Hands-on experience building or integrating AI-powered applications, including working with large language models, prompts, and evaluation/monitoring of AI features.

  • Practical experience implementing or contributing to retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) workflows, such as designing retrieval pipelines, integrating vector or semantic search, and grounding LLM outputs in internal data and policies.

  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, Git, automated testing, and modern software engineering practices in an Agile environment.

  • Experience building or integrating AI-powered features is a plus, including LLM-based workflows, API integrations, evaluation, monitoring, and guardrails.

  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools to improve delivery speed and code quality is a plus.

Additional Details

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.

 

We use cookies to enhance your experience and may use AI tools for administrative tasks in the hiring process. To learn how we handle your personal data and use AI responsibly, please visit our Talent Privacy Notice, Privacy Center, and AI Hiring Guidelines.

At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

As a Senior Software Engineer in the Customer Support Technology team at eBay, you will play a pivotal role in building the systems that power world-class customer service experiences across the globe. You’ll work on platforms that drive intelligent automation, empower agent workflows, and deliver high-quality support at scale—impacting millions of customers every day.

This position is based in Bengaluru, India, but you'll collaborate actively with teams in North America, Europe, and APAC. Success in this role requires a willingness to work across time zones and occasionally adjust your schedule to support distributed team coordination and decision-making.

You will contribute as a strong individual contributor, while also mentoring junior engineers and leading technical efforts on key projects within the Customer Support Platform team.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain robust backend systems and services using Java, with deep hands-on expertise in API frameworks such as SOAP, REST, and GraphQL.

  • Own the development of scalable APIs, workflow and action frameworks, batch processing systems, and email delivery platforms that drive core customer support functions.

  • Collaborate with product managers, architects, and peer engineers to transform business needs into scalable, reliable, and maintainable technical solutions.

  • Lead key projects within the team, owning components end-to-end—from technical design and implementation to deployment and support.

  • Integrate with world-class customer support platforms ensuring seamless and secure connectivity between internal systems and external services.

  • Provide technical mentorship and code reviews to junior engineers, encouraging high coding standards, architectural rigor, and collaborative learning.

  • Contribute to a strong DevOps culture, supporting CI/CD automation, observability, and resilient operations for your services.

  • Work in an Agile environment, participating in sprint planning, backlog refinement, estimation, and retrospectives.

  • Apply hands-on experience with AI development tools (e.g., smart code generation) to improve efficiency and improve software quality.

What will you bring?

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

  • 8+ years of professional software development experience, with a focus on Java-based backend systems in large-scale, distributed environments.

  • Deep expertise in API development using SOAP, REST, and GraphQL.

  • Experience building and operating systems that support high availability, resilience, and performance under scale.

  • Familiarity with customer support technologies and integrations with External platforms like Salesforce, or Genesys is a strong advantage.

  • Strong understanding of Agile development practices and modern DevOps principles, including CI/CD, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and observability tools.

  • Practical experience with AI-assisted development tools, and a proactive approach to adopting and applying intelligent solutions that **boost** engineering speed and software reliability.

  • Excellent debugging, problem-solving, and analytical skills.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a collaborative approach and the ability to mentor peers and lead by example.

  • Flexibility and openness to collaborate across global time zones, with occasional schedule adjustments to support international team coordination.

Additional Details

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. description_text:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

What Will You Do
We are looking for an Applied Researcher to work on large‑scale image and text based problems that power customer‑facing experiences.
You will work across the full lifecycle of a project—from problem formulation and modeling to bringing solutions into production. You’ll have meaningful ownership of your work end to end within the team, taking ideas from exploration to deployment and iteration.
Your work will include:

  • Exploring and prototyping new modeling approaches, including adapting ideas from recent research papers to real‑world problems
  • Developing ML models for image, text, and multimodal use cases
  • Working with large‑scale datasets and building practical ML pipelines.
  • Deploying models into production and measuring their impact

We value people who enjoy combining research thinking with hands‑on execution, and who like seeing their ideas shipped, measured, and improved in production.
If you love a good challenge, and are good at handling complexity - we’d love to hear from you!
eBay is an amazing company to work for. Being on the team, you can expect to benefit from:

  • A competitive salary - including stock grants and a yearly bonus
  • A healthy work culture that promotes business impact and at the same time highly values your personal well-being
  • Being part of a force for good in this world - eBay truly cares about its employees, its customers, and the world’s population, and takes every opportunity to make this clearly apparent

Job Responsibilities

  • Review relevant academic and industry research, prototype promising ideas, and validate them through experiments and production metrics
  • Design and deliver applied ML solutions involving image and/or text data
  • Productionize and operate ML models as part of customer‑facing systems, with support available when needed
  • Analyze data, define success metrics, and iterate based on results
  • Work closely with your manager and peers within the team to scope problems and prioritize impact
  • Participate in technical discussions, reviews, and knowledge sharing within the organization

Minimum Qualifications

  • Strong interest in applied machine learning and real‑world ML systems
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field
  • 6+ years of experience working on applied research, ML models or data‑driven systems
  • Solid foundations in machine learning, statistics, and software engineering
  • Strong programming experience in Python
  • Good communication and collaboration skills

Additional Details

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.

 

We use cookies to enhance your experience and may use AI tools for administrative tasks in the hiring process. To learn how we handle your personal data and use AI responsibly, please visit our Talent Privacy Notice, Privacy Center, and AI Hiring Guidelines.

Senior Platform Engineer – Dev Environment & Reliability

Developer Platform, Productivity & Experience Engineering | eBay

About the Team
 

The Developer Platform, Productivity & Experience Engineering team within eBay’s Global Technology organization builds and operates eBay’s AI/ML-powered Internal Developer Platform (IDP).

Our portfolio includes:

  • Continuous Delivery platform

  • Enterprise Testing platform

  • AI-driven no-code/low-code developer tools

  • Software Engineering Intelligence platform

  • Developer Productivity and Engineering Velocity platforms

Our mission is to remove friction from the software development and delivery lifecycle and enable engineers to deliver secure, high-quality software quickly and safely at scale.
 

About the Role

We are hiring Senior Platform Engineers to modernize and scale eBay’s development and staging environments — mission-critical infrastructure that underpins software delivery and forms a core foundation of our Internal Developer Platform (IDP).

Instability in development environments directly impacts pipeline success and developer productivity. In this role, you will drive reliability improvements, reduce systemic friction, and ensure our infrastructure scales securely and efficiently as eBay grows.
 

What You’ll Do

  • Design and build microservices (Java / Spring Boot) that extend and integrate with eBay’s IDP

  • Develop intuitive front-end experiences for the Internal Developer Platform using React

  • Build, operate, and scale Kubernetes-based development environments

  • Design automated, reproducible, and highly reliable dev/staging infrastructure

  • Reduce pipeline failures caused by environment dependencies

  • Drive automation and operational excellence through Python scripting

  • Strengthen the scalability, resilience, and performance of eBay’s Internal Developer Platform
     

What You’ll Bring

  • Proven experience building microservices using Java / Spring Boot

  • Frontend development experience with React

  • Strong Python scripting and automation skills

  • Deep expertise in Kubernetes and cloud-native infrastructure

  • Strong distributed systems and platform engineering fundamentals

  • High ownership mindset with focus on reliability, scalability, and developer productivity


This is a hands-on Platform Engineering role focused on designing and building critical developer infrastructure — not a QE, administrator, or support role.

Additional Details

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.

 

We use cookies to enhance your experience and may use AI tools for administrative tasks in the hiring process. To learn how we handle your personal data and use AI responsibly, please visit our Talent Privacy Notice, Privacy Center, and AI Hiring Guidelines.

description_text:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

Director – Product Management, Product Knowledge
Build the Data-Powered, AI-Driven Future of Product Discovery

About the Role
We’re on a mission to redefine how people discover, explore, and connect with products online—and we need a visionary product leader to take us there.

As Director of Product Management, you’ll lead the strategy and execution for our Product Knowledge and Catalog Platform—the intelligence layer that powers everything from search and recommendations to personalization and generative AI. You’ll shape how structured data, AI/ML, and LLMs come together to build scalable, magical, and deeply relevant customer experiences at massive scale.

You’ll work at the heart of a high-performing, cross-functional team—collaborating with AI researchers, data scientists, and engineers to build the foundational data products that power discovery for millions of users.

This is a rare opportunity to lead in a high-agency, startup-style environment with the resources and reach of a global platform.

What You’ll Own

  • Catalog Intelligence at Scale
    Lead the development of robust, intelligent, and flexible catalog systems. Create automated, scalable ways to structure, enrich, and normalize product data across categories and geographies.

  • Vision for Product Knowledge
    Define and own the product vision for taxonomy, ontology, metadata, and knowledge graphs that power our search and AI platforms.

  • Build Magical Data Products
    Launch internal tools and APIs that feel like magic—powerful, intuitive, and built with scale and automation in mind. Make structured data work harder and smarter across all surfaces.

  • Power Discovery Through AI & LLMs
    Partner with AI and data science teams to use LLMs, embeddings, and prompt engineering for entity resolution, classification, and content enrichment—fueling delightful discovery.

  • Design for Relevance & Impact
    Focus relentlessly on customer experience—ensuring your products make search more relevant, recommendations smarter, and exploration more intuitive.

  • Drive Product Excellence
    Define metrics, establish feedback loops, and iterate quickly. Marry technical depth with customer empathy to shape products that solve real problems beautifully.

  • Collaborate to Deliver
    Partner across Product, Engineering, AI/ML, Trust, and Catalog Ops to launch products that are both deeply technical and profoundly user-centered.

What We’re Looking For

  • 12+ years of product management experience, with 5+ years leading teams in platform, data, or AI-driven environments

  • Proven track record building structured data platforms, knowledge systems, or eCommerce catalog infrastructure

  • Strong understanding of taxonomy, metadata strategy, and product classification

  • Experience working with AI/ML teams, including familiarity with LLMs and semantic search (a plus)

  • A bias for scalable solutions—you know how to build for today and architect for tomorrow

  • Obsession with relevance, automation, and magic—you craft products that delight both internal and external users

  • Strong communicator with a track record of cross-functional leadership and influence

  • Comfort working in fast-paced, iterative environments—you thrive in ambiguity and move with urgency

Why You’ll Love This Role

  • Build the backbone of product discovery for one of the world’s largest eCommerce platforms

  • Lead a portfolio that touches AI, structured data, and real-time customer experience

  • Create scalable systems that drive magical user experiences at global scale

  • Work with world-class teams in AI/ML, data science, and engineering

  • Enjoy high ownership, fast execution, and a culture that values bold ideas and real impact

Additional Details

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. description_text:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

About the Role

eBay's Customer Support Technology (CS Tech) Digital Experience team is looking for a Senior Engineering Manager. This role will lead all aspects of developing customer-facing support experiences across web and mobile platforms.

The team owns eBay's Help Hub, Seller Help, Conversational Help, and emerging AI-powered support experiences. Our mission is to reduce customer effort and assisted contacts by delivering personalized, intelligent, and seamless support journeys at scale.

This role combines technical leadership, organizational leadership, and product partnership to drive modern digital experiences powered by web, mobile, cloud, and AI technologies. You will lead engineering teams in India while partnering closely with Product, UX, AI/ML, and global engineering teams to shape the future of customer support at eBay.

What You Will Do

Lead Engineering Teams

  • Build, lead, and mentor high-performing engineering teams.

  • Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, inclusion, and continuous learning.

  • Develop engineering talent and grow future technical and people leaders.

  • Drive strong execution, ownership, and engineering excellence across the organization.

Deliver Customer-Centric Digital Experiences

  • Lead the development of customer support experiences across web and mobile platforms.

  • Partner with Product and UX teams to create intuitive, personalized, and streamlined customer journeys.

  • Drive improvements that reduce customer effort and increase self-service success.

Drive AI-Powered Innovation

  • Lead the adoption of AI-powered customer experiences, including conversational help, intelligent recommendations, agentic workflows, and automated support solutions.

  • Partner with AI/ML teams to deliver scalable and trustworthy AI experiences.

  • Champion AI-enabled development practices and engineering productivity improvements.

Provide Technical Leadership

  • Drive architecture, design, and modernization of customer-facing applications and services.

  • Lead the adoption of cloud-native, API-first, and event-driven architectures.

  • Ensure solutions meet high standards for scalability, reliability, security, accessibility, and performance.

Champion Operational Excellence

  • Drive standard processes across software development, CI/CD, observability, reliability, and service ownership.

  • Improve engineering velocity, platform stability, and customer experience through automation and continuous improvement.

  • Partner effectively with global stakeholders to deliver strategic outcomes.

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years of software engineering experience, including experience leading engineering teams and delivering large-scale customer-facing applications.

  • Proven experience building modern web and mobile experiences.

  • Strong hands-on expertise in Java and modern frontend technologies such as React.

  • Experience designing scalable APIs, microservices, and distributed systems.

  • Strong understanding of software architecture, reliability, observability, security, and operational excellence.

  • Experience partnering with Product, UX, and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver customer-focused solutions.

  • Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

  • Proven track record of building and developing high-performing teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building customer support, self-service, or digital experience platforms.

  • Experience with AI-powered applications, conversational AI, GenAI, or agentic workflows.

  • Experience with technologies such as Java, Spring Boot, React, Node.JS, Kafka, Kubernetes, Docker, GraphQL, and cloud platforms.

  • Experience with personalization, experimentation, analytics, and customer journey optimization.

  • Experience leading modernization and digital transformation initiatives.

What We're Looking For

We are seeking a leader who:

  • Is passionate about building exceptional customer experiences.

  • Combines strong people leadership with technical credibility.

  • Can influence across Product, UX, AI, and Engineering teams.

  • Balances innovation with execution excellence.

  • Champions modern engineering practices and innovation powered by advanced technology.

  • Builds inclusive, high-performing teams focused on delivering customer impact.

Why Join Us

Here at eBay, we love creating opportunities for others by connecting people from widely diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and geographies. So, being diverse and inclusive isn’t just something we strive for, it is who we are, and part of what we do each and every single day. We want to ensure that as an employee, you feel eBay is a place where, no matter who you are, you feel safe, included, and that you have the opportunity to bring your unique self to work. To learn about eBay’s Diversity & Inclusion click here: https://www.ebayinc.com/our-company/diversity-inclusion/.

Additional Details

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.

 

We use cookies to enhance your experience and may use AI tools for administrative tasks in the hiring process. To learn how we handle your personal data and use AI responsibly, please visit our Talent Privacy Notice, Privacy Center, and AI Hiring Guidelines.

title: Associate Manager - Data Science
description_html: Overview Data Science Team works in developing Machine Learning (ML) and Artificial Intelligence (AI) projects. Specific scope of this role is to develop ML solution in support of ML/AI projects using big analytics toolsets in a CI/CD environment. Analytics toolsets may include DS tools/Spark/Databricks, and other technologies offered by Microsoft Azure or open-source toolsets. This role will also help automate the end-to-end cycle with Azure Pipelines. You will be part of a collaborative interdisciplinary team around data, where you will be responsible of our continuous delivery of statistical/ML models. You will work closely with process owners, product owners and final business users. This will provide you the correct visibility and understanding of criticality of your developments. Responsibilities Delivery of key Advanced Analytics/Data Science projects within time and budget, particularly around DevOps/MLOps and Machine Learning models in scope Active contributor to code & development in projects and services Partner with data engineers to ensure data access for discovery and proper data is prepared for model consumption. Partner with ML engineers working on industrialization. Communicate with business stakeholders in the process of service design, training and knowledge transfer. Support large-scale experimentation and build data-driven models. Refine requirements into modelling problems. Influence product teams through data-based recommendations. Research in state-of-the-art methodologies. Create documentation for learnings and knowledge transfer. Create reusable packages or libraries. Ensure on time and on budget delivery which satisfies project requirements, while adhering to enterprise architecture standards Leverage big data technologies to help process data and build scaled data pipelines (batch to real time) Implement end-to-end ML lifecycle with Azure Databricks and Azure Pipelines Automate ML models deployments Qualifications BE/B.Tech in Computer Science, Maths, technical fields. Overall 2-4 years of experience working as a Data Scientist. 2+ years’ experience building solutions in the commercial or in the supply chain space. 2+ years working in a team to deliver production level analytic solutions. Fluent in git (version control). Understanding of Jenkins, Docker are a plus. Fluent in SQL syntaxis. 2+ years’ experience in Statistical/ML techniques to solve supervised (regression, classification) and unsupervised problems. 2+ years’ experience in developing business problem related statistical/ML modeling with industry tools with primary focus on Python or Pyspark development. Data Science – Hands on experience and strong knowledge of building machine learning models – supervised and unsupervised models. Knowledge of Time series/Demand Forecast models is a plus Programming Skills – Hands-on experience in statistical programming languages like Python, Pyspark and database query languages like SQL Statistics – Good applied statistical skills, including knowledge of statistical tests, distributions, regression, maximum likelihood estimators Cloud (Azure) – Experience in Databricks and ADF is desirable Familiarity with Spark, Hive, Pig is an added advantage Business storytelling and communicating data insights in business consumable format. Fluent in one Visualization tool. Strong communications and organizational skills with the ability to deal with ambiguity while juggling multiple priorities Experience with Agile methodology for team work and analytics ‘product’ creation. Experience in Reinforcement Learning is a plus. Experience in Simulation and Optimization problems in any space is a plus. Experience with Bayesian methods is a plus. Experience with Causal inference is a plus. Experience with NLP is a plus. Experience with Responsible AI is a plus. Experience with distributed machine learning is a plus Experience in DevOps, hands-on experience with one or more cloud service providers AWS, GCP, Azure(preferred) Model deployment experience is a plus Experience with version control systems like GitHub and CI/CD tools Experience in Exploratory data Analysis Knowledge of ML Ops / DevOps and deploying ML models is preferred Experience using MLFlow, Kubeflow etc. will be preferred Experience executing and contributing to ML OPS automation infrastructure is good to have Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills Stakeholder engagement-BU, Vendors. Experience building statistical models in the Retail or Supply chain space is a plus

title: Consumer & Shop Insights Assoc Manager
description_html: Overview Provide advanced analytics support for the EMEA Sector in the Insights Services Center; a part of the broader Global Business Services function in Hyderabad, India. This role will help to enable accelerated growth for PepsiCo by developing custom descriptive analytics approaches for EMEA to drive deeper understanding of business performance drivers both at the National / Regional / State /City level. Primary responsibilities include developing/enhancing statistical models to address key business questions associated with Growth Driver Modeling, Pricing, Assortment, Market Structure, Innovation Forecasting, and Category Growth Forecasts, Portfolio growth model, Ambition related assignments for the key markets of EMEA. Additionally, this role will also support the consumer insight team by collating learnings from a variety of sources, to help inform the development of future insights strategies for various brands with in Bevareages / Snacks . The role will have short-term responsibilities for knowledge transfer from the Vendors and effectively establishing business process and communication methods with teams they support; both are crucial requirements to enabling the organization to deliver answers to on-going business questions Responsibilities Functional Responsibilities: Support delivery of descriptive and predictive analytics as defined by the SLA (Service Level Agreement) within the EMEA Business Service Service Center Execute deep descriptive analytics of business performance and drivers to supplement standard reporting and inform data-driven decisions Identify, assess, and visualize key market share drivers for EMEA Categories, as a growth catalyst to prioritize and enable brand planning across portfolio Support EMEA region’s annual SKU optimization process for the portfolio; analyzing impact by channel, customers and region as needed based on HQ delivered recommendations & targets Advise and share Advanced Analytics models and best practices with Regional Category Managers to leverage and build Advanced Analytics capability. Develop, maintain, and apply statistical models to business questions - including forecasting, price sensitivities/corridors, drivers analysis, market structure, etc. Forecast market growth leveraging (PGM – an internal tool) on an annual basis to inform PEP’s long-term expectations for growth Collate and format consumer learnings from custom insight outputs, sales performace reporting, industry periodicals, and social listening resources, etc to help inform and develop future consumer insights strategies Provide responses to ad-hoc follow-ups when double-click (additional questions) required with tables/charts for relevant data Support relationships with the key end-user stakeholders in EMEA and region offices Own flawless execution of analytics exercises Responsible for managing multiple priorities; being able to manage deadlines and deliverables Lead communication with Business Partners and potentially end-users on matters such as available capacity, changes of scope of existing projects and planning of future projects Deliver outputs in line with the agreed timelines and formats Flag and monitor any business risks related to delivering the requested outputs Partner with stakeholders and service center leadership to develop and finetune internal COE processes (work-flow mapping, pain-points and bottlenecks management) both related to service delivery and internal center operations Improve existing processes based on frequent Business Partner & end-user feedback loop People and Project Management Responsibilities Leading a team of 4-5 data scientists and modelers Develop new skillsets among team members related to advanced analytics by conducting training and period review Promotes cross functional seamless communication, sharing know how and creating same quality of experience across sector markets Qualifications 10-14 years of experience in data science, analytics, or applied machine learning roles. Candidates from consulting background are preferred Experience in leading mid-sized teams of data scientists and modelers Strong track record of delivering hands‑on analytical and ML solutions with measurable business impact. Strong foundation in probability, statistics, and classical machine learning algorithms. Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL, R Hands‑on experience with ML libraries (e.g., scikit‑learn) and deep learning frameworks (PyTorch and/or TensorFlow). Have been hands-on modeler in the past specifically in market mix /attribution modeling, CPG domain preferred. Experience in translating business problem into analytics framework and vice versa Well versed in statistical techniques Educational Background- BE/B TECH/ MSC Economics or Statistics, MBA preferred for Analytics translator High degree of familiarity with CPG and Food & Beverage industry data sources, including Nielsen/IRi (POS and HH panel), GlobalData, Kantar Worldpanel, etc. Deep understanding of CPG industry business performance outputs and causal measures, their relationships, and how to address business questions in a robust way that translates to simple outputs Experience with Agile development methods. Strong collaborator: Interested and motivated by working with others. Actively creates and participates in opportunities to co-create solutions across markets; will be willing and able to embrace Responsive Ways of Working Can easily see how insights/research learning can improve businesses impact and frames up reporting efforts and opportunities to inform business decisions Proven analytics, shopper research experience, or consumer insights experience applying statistics to CPG industry business problems Operational experience from business servicing sector and/or consulting experience would be a plus

title: R&D Digital Platforms Asst Analyst
description_html: Overview This role will partner the Experience Consumer Research team located in India Capability Center (ICC) to ensure exceptional service is provided in support of Sensory Consumer Experience. This role will create actionable reports for Consumer Research studies, and coordinate with in-market ICC employees, to develop clear plans for projects to be completed on-time, in-full and on-budget with proper quality controls in place. Responsibilities Work closely with key Program Manager, Data Analyst and Programmer to create an actionable research report for each Consumer research study, while ensuring best practices. Leverage existing global EXP Consumer Research Transformation & Report Continuous Improvement processes and protocols for each research study report. Seamlessly work across EyeQuestion AutoReport program, Harmoni, and other programs to synthesize key findings and recommendations. While ensuring each report follows best practice format guidelines, storytelling and imagery are also critical to elevate understanding and business impact. Share reports with Program Manager for final review. Provide revisions and additional builds as requested by EXP category scientist and/or Category Lead. Partner closely with Program Manager, programmer, and analyst to identify new methods and processes to increase efficiency and quality. Work visibly & transparently in Microsoft Teams and other office 365 tools. Qualifications BS in a relevant scientific discipline (e.g. Data Science, Sensory science, Statistics) preferred, background in statistical analysis techniques, Sensory, and processes a plus (requirement: ability to interpret data analysis). 5-6yrs experience in quantitative consumer research, designs/ systems. Working knowledge of sensory and statistical analysis programs Ability to interpret complex data and distil into useful and actionable information. Advanced English Skills and Spanish Skills (depending on language of report) System: EyeQuestion, Harmoni, LabVantage, O365 Ability to rapidly learn computer applications/programs & navigate systems.

title: Digital Product Manager
description_html: Overview PepsiCo Digital Product team, as part of Strategy & Transformation, provides end-to-end products and solutions that focus on having the right data and insights, accessible for the right people, driving their business goals at the right time, across the globe. These products enable a unique competitive advantage to delight both our customers and consumers and create a catalyst for a PepsiCo data-driven culture. The Product Management team will lead the creation of the next generation of infrastructure, data science insights, and business applications that drive business value across global teams. We will achieve this by delivering a vision and strategic roadmap for best-in-class platforms, and consistently executing against key milestones in direct collaboration with global engineering and data science teams. Responsibilities Support product strategy and direction; define and prioritize product requirements, features and functionality across portfolio with product managers Support key stakeholders, business engagement, and product managers to socialize product plans and requirements, research, brainstorm and validate new functionality, and address any product issues Support the technical vision alongside engineering team and executive management, influence, and lead cross-functional teams on strategic product direction Support driving the lifecycle of all products, from inception and build to commercialization and adoption, ensuring the continuous improvement of products Support the vision, interpret global business needs, ultimately drive implementation. Demonstrate passion for excellence related to product design, delivery, and engineering Work collaboratively with regional and global partners Product Strategy and Roadmap: Develop a comprehensive product strategy and roadmap Identify key metrics and performance indicators to measure the success and effectiveness of the digital application. User Research and Requirements Gathering: Partner with our Service Design team to engage with users to understand their preferences, pain points, and expectations regarding brand loyalty programs. Translate user needs and requirements into clear product specifications and user stories. Feature Definition and Prioritization: Collaborate with design and development teams to define and prioritize features that enhance the product experience Work closely with stakeholders to manage expectations and align feature prioritization with business objectives. Agile Development and Project Management: Utilize Agile methodologies to drive the product development process, including sprint planning, backlog grooming, and sprint reviews. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure efficient execution of the product roadmap and timely delivery of features. Monitor project timelines, budgets, and resources to ensure successful project completion. User Experience and Engagement: Conduct usability tests, A/B testing, and other user feedback mechanisms to continuously improve the app's user experience. Data Analysis and Optimization: Utilize analytics tools to monitor user behavior, engagement, and conversion rates among users. Use data-driven insights to make informed decisions regarding feature updates, user flows, and overall app performance. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree required; Bachelor’s degree in quantitative or engineering related field preferred; Master’s degree preferred 10+ years of product management focused on enterprise or supply chain with experience creating strategic product roadmaps and working with cross-functional teams in a highly-matrixed environment Experience building and launching products from ideation through launch and revision. Skills, Abilities, Knowledge: Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, along with the ability to influence and demonstrate confidence in communications with senior level management Proven track record of overseeing a portfolio of multiple projects Positive and flexible attitude to enable adjusting to different needs in an ever-changing environment Strong knowledge and experience in agile methodologies, experience working with multiple scrum teams on simultaneous builds Proactively drives impact and engagement while bringing others along Ability to lead others without direct authority
