JOB LEVEL

P40

EMPLOYEE ROLE

Individual Contributor

SAP SD / S4HANA Logistics Implementation and Configuration:

o Lead the design, implementation, and optimization of SAP SD/Logistics modules

o Conduct thorough analysis of business requirements and configure the SAP system accordingly to meet business needs.

o Oversee integration between SAP SD/LOGISTICS and other SAP modules (e.g., MM, SD, RAR, FSCM and external systems).

2. Team Leadership:

o Lead and mentor a team of SAP SD/Logistics consultants and non SAP consultants.

o Coordinate and support team efforts to resolve system issues, implement improvements, and ensure timely deliverables

o Provide guidance on best practices and solutions to complex issues.

3. System Maintenance and Support:

o Monitor and maintain the integrity of the SAP systems and applications.

o Provide ongoing system support, including troubleshooting and resolving issues in a timely manner.

o Ensure system enhancements and changes align with business goals and objectives.

o Participate period, Quarter and year end closures

4. Process Optimization:

o Work closely with business process owners to identify opportunities for process improvement and system enhancements.

o Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure SAP SD/LOGISTICS processes are integrated and optimized across the organization.

o Support end-users by providing training, documentation, and troubleshooting assistance.

5. Project Management:

o Lead or participate in SAP SD/LOGISTICS - related tasks & metrics

o Ensure that KPIs are met and deliverables are achieved on time and with good CSAT.

6. Stakeholder Collaboration:

o Liaise with business stakeholders to understand requirements and propose SAP-based solutions.

o Communicate regularly with management regarding project status, issues, and progress.

o Support the implementation of SAP SD/LOGISTICS best practices across the organization.

o Maintain healthy relations with business, internal & external teams.

7. Compliance and Reporting:

o Ensure compliance with audit regulations and internal controls.

o Work closely with team in preparing audit related documentation and reports.

o Ensure that SAP SD/LOGISTICS processes are aligned with corporate governance standards while delivering solutions

Required Skills and Qualifications:

· Education: Masters or Bachelor’s degree in in relevant domain. Relevant certifications (e.g., SAP SD/ S4HANA LOGISTICS) are a plus.

· Experience:

o Minimum 10+ years of experience in SAP SD/ S4HANA LOGISTICS with at least 3-4 years in a lead role.

o Strong understanding of business processes and SAP integration with other modules (MM, FICO, & 3rd party system, etc.).

o Proven experience in leading SAP SD/ S4HANA LOGISTICS implementations and/or Support projects.

o Experience in managing a team of SAP consultants and/or non SAP consultants

o settings, report generation, and troubleshooting.

o Debug knowledge is an added advantage.

· Technical Skills:

o In-depth knowledge of SAP SD/ S4HANA LOGISTICS configuration and functionalities.

o Experience with SAP Fiori, RAR, EDI, Group reporting or other reporting tools is must.

o Strong understanding of accounting principles and financial reporting.

· Project Management:

o Proven experience in managing and delivering SAP projects.

o Familiarity with project management methodologies

· Soft Skills:

o Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

o Strong problem-solving abilities and attention to detail.

o Ability to work under pressure and handle multiple priorities.

o Leadership skills and the ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams.

o Strong business acumen and the ability to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions.

Preferred Qualifications:

· Strong SAP S/4HANA experience.

· Experience with global SAP SD/ S4HANA LOGISTICS implementations or support across multiple regions.

· Exposure to industry-specific SAP SD/ S4HANA LOGISTICS solutions (e.g., manufacturing, retail, services etc.,).

JOB LEVEL

P20

EMPLOYEE ROLE

Individual Contributor

Software Engineer II – Document AI

About the Role

Ensures the quality, reliability, and scalability of software products through systematic testing, automation, and quality engineering practices. Develops, maintains, and delivers test plans, test cases, and automated test frameworks for functional, integration, regression, and end-to-end testing. Analyzes requirements, software architecture, logs, and test results to identify defects and drive quality improvements.

Collaborates closely with engineering and product teams to solve issues, perform root-cause analysis, and ensure successful product releases. Contributes to automation infrastructure, CI/CD quality processes, and testing standard methodologies. For AI-powered workflows and services, validates functionality, workflows, and data-driven outcomes to deliver a high-quality customer experience.

What You'll Do

  • Test AI-powered features and workflows within the Document AI product ecosystem.

  • Participate in all phases of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), including requirement analysis, test planning, estimation, execution, automation, release validation, and defect triaging.

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable automation frameworks and test suites for functional, integration, regression, and end-to-end testing.

  • Validate APIs, backend services, and workflow integrations across cloud-based applications.

  • Implement functional and user-centric test scenarios manually whenever required.

  • Collaborate closely with developers, product managers, and other collaborators to ensure high-quality product releases.

  • Analyze logs, solve issues, perform root-cause analysis, and help improve overall product quality.

  • Contribute to continuous quality improvements by identifying automation opportunities and process enhancements.

  • Work as part of a highly motivated Agile team operating in fast-paced release cycles.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.

  • 2+ years of experience in Software Quality Engineering, Test Automation

  • Strong programming and scripting skills in Python. Experience with Java, JavaScript, or C/C++ is a plus.

  • Good understanding of software testing methodologies including functional, Integration, System, Regression, Acceptance, and Performance Testing.

  • Experience developing and maintaining automated test frameworks and test infrastructure.

  • Good understanding of CI/CD concepts and hands-on experience with tools such as Jenkins or similar automation platforms.

  • Ability to read, understand, and debug code to identify quality issues early in the development lifecycle.

  • Good understanding of Windows and macOS platforms; Linux knowledge is a plus.

  • Familiarity with REST APIs, web services, and cloud-based applications.

  • Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills.

Nice to Have

  • Exposure to AI/ML-powered applications, model validation, or data-driven testing.

  • Experience with observability and analytics platforms such as Splunk, Power BI, Adobe Analytics, Grafana, or similar tools.

  • Knowledge of web technologies such as HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

  • Hands-on experience with Python libraries such as NumPy, Pandas, OpenCV, PyTest, or similar frameworks.

  • Experience testing cloud-native applications and microservices architectures.

You Will Convince Us That You

  • Enjoy solving complex technical problems and continuously learning new technologies.

  • Have excellent verbal and written communication skills.

  • Can effectively collaborate across teams to understand requirements and deliver high-quality solutions.

  • Possess strong analytical and debugging abilities with a passion for software quality.

  • Take ownership of assigned work and consistently deliver results with attention to detail.

  • Thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced, and Agile environment.

Internal Opportunities

Creativity, curiosity, and constant learning are celebrated aspects of your career growth journey. We’re glad that you’re pursuing a new opportunity at Adobe!

Put your best foot forward:

1. Update your Resume/CV and Workday profile – don’t forget to include your uniquely ‘Adobe’ experiences and volunteer work.

2. Visit the Internal Mobility page on Inside Adobe to learn more about the process and set up a job alert for roles you’re interested in.

3. Check out these tips to help you prep for interviews.

4. If you are applying for a role outside of your current country, ensure you review the International Resources for Relocating Employees on Inside Adobe, including the impacts to your Benefits, AIP, Equity & Payroll. 

Once you apply for a role via Workday, the Talent Team will reach out to you within 2 weeks. If you move into the official interview process with the hiring team, make sure you inform your manager so they can champion your career growth.

At Adobe, you will be immersed in an exceptional work environment that is recognized around the world. You will also be surrounded by colleagues who are committed to helping each other grow through our unique Check-In approach where ongoing feedback flows freely. If you’re looking to make an impact, Adobe's the place for you. Discover what our employees are saying about their career experiences on the Adobe Life blog and explore the meaningful benefits we offer.

We do not discriminate based on gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other applicable characteristics protected by law. Learn more.

description_html: <div><h2><b>Senior Manager, Analytics Business Partnering, India</b></h2><p>The Senior Manager, Analytics Business Partnering will serve as the People Analytics leader for India, driving people insights that inform strategic decisions for one of Adobe’s largest and most dynamic workforce populations. This is an exciting and impactful role; sitting at the intersection of people data, business strategy, and senior leadership impact! Successful hire must work credibly with senior leaders and deliver rigorous, high-quality analyses. Leading a small team of analysts, this leader will serve as the primary connection point between Adobe’s global People Analytics function and India internal customers (Sr business leaders, HRBPs, and Employee Experience (EX) team).</p><h2><b>What You’ll Do:</b></h2><ul><li><h2>Executive Influence & Personal Leadership</h2></li></ul><p>Build and maintain trusted relationships with senior EX and Business Leaders in India, serving as their primary point of contact for People Analytics.</p><p>Engage with business executives and EX leaders to understand their strategic priorities, surface the right analytical questions, and translate ambiguous asks into clear, actionable work.</p><p>Present people insights in a way that drives decisions, with an ability to adapt framing and level of detail for a variety of audiences.</p><p>Represent India’s workforce context and business priorities within the global People Analytics team, ensuring relevant local nuances are reflected in broader analyses and recommendations.</p><ul><li><h2>Analytical Leadership and Judgment</h2></li></ul><p>Define accurate questions from complex, sometimes ambiguous business problems, and determine the appropriate analytical approach to answer them.</p><p>Lead analyses that combine people data, external research, and business context to address strategic challenges.</p><p>Ensure the integrity and rigor of analytical outputs produced by the team, setting a high quality bar and providing substantive review!</p><ul><li><h2>Team Leadership</h2></li></ul><p>Manage and develop a small team of analysts, setting clear expectations, providing regular feedback, and building their skills over time.</p><p>Coordinate and prioritize the team’s work in alignment with the needs of internal clients in India region and People Analytics team's roadmap priorities.</p><p>Foster ways of working that are rigorous, collaborative, and aligned with both India EX and People Analytics team standards and processes.</p><ul><li><h2>Cross-Functional Contribution</h2></li></ul><p>Actively participate in and contribute to both the global People Analytics team and EX India, including shared initiatives, capability development, and knowledge sharing.</p><p>Partner with sub-functions in People Analytics team (BI, Data Science, Research, Workforce Strategy), so that together we deliver integrated, description_text:
Senior Manager, Analytics Business Partnering, India

The Senior Manager, Analytics Business Partnering will serve as the People Analytics leader for India, driving people insights that inform strategic decisions for one of Adobe’s largest and most dynamic workforce populations. This is an exciting and impactful role; sitting at the intersection of people data, business strategy, and senior leadership impact! Successful hire must work credibly with senior leaders and deliver rigorous, high-quality analyses. Leading a small team of analysts, this leader will serve as the primary connection point between Adobe’s global People Analytics function and India internal customers (Sr business leaders, HRBPs, and Employee Experience (EX) team).

What You’ll Do:

  • Executive Influence & Personal Leadership

Build and maintain trusted relationships with senior EX and Business Leaders in India, serving as their primary point of contact for People Analytics.

Engage with business executives and EX leaders to understand their strategic priorities, surface the right analytical questions, and translate ambiguous asks into clear, actionable work.

Present people insights in a way that drives decisions, with an ability to adapt framing and level of detail for a variety of audiences.

Represent India’s workforce context and business priorities within the global People Analytics team, ensuring relevant local nuances are reflected in broader analyses and recommendations.

  • Analytical Leadership and Judgment

Define accurate questions from complex, sometimes ambiguous business problems, and determine the appropriate analytical approach to answer them.

Lead analyses that combine people data, external research, and business context to address strategic challenges.

Ensure the integrity and rigor of analytical outputs produced by the team, setting a high quality bar and providing substantive review!

  • Team Leadership

Manage and develop a small team of analysts, setting clear expectations, providing regular feedback, and building their skills over time.

Coordinate and prioritize the team’s work in alignment with the needs of internal clients in India region and People Analytics team's roadmap priorities.

Foster ways of working that are rigorous, collaborative, and aligned with both India EX and People Analytics team standards and processes.

  • Cross-Functional Contribution

Actively participate in and contribute to both the global People Analytics team and EX India, including shared initiatives, capability development, and knowledge sharing.

Partner with sub-functions in People Analytics team (BI, Data Science, Research, Workforce Strategy), so that together we deliver integrated, high-quality work to internal customers.

What We’re Looking For:

  • 10+ years of experience in People Analytics, HR strategy, or a related field, with at least 2-3 years (required) in a people leadership role.
  • Demonstrated ability to engage and influence senior leaders with data and insights, including comfort presenting to and advising executive-level audiences.
  • Strong skill in translating ambiguous business questions into clear analytical plans with defined scope and deliverables, and influencing partners who would be collaborating on this work.
  • Deep understanding of the HR landscape, workforce trends, and the challenges facing large organizations in India and globally.
  • Analytical proficiency sufficient to lead and review rigorous work, including demonstrated familiarity with statistical methods, quantitative analysis, and data storytelling.
  • Ability to work across time zones and contribute to a globally distributed team while maintaining a strong local presence and focus.
  • Zeal for actively incorporating AI into your work, while modelling ethical & responsible AI use with people data.

About Adobe

Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.

Our 30,000+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours.

What you’ll do

  • Set the vision and provide strategic marketing leadership for the Creativity & Productivity (C&P) portfolio in India.

  • Build effective relationships with Go-to-Market, Product Marketing Management, Comms, A.com, Corporate Marketing and other functions to ensure the India marketing strategy is aligned and delivered effectively.
  • Set and communicate the cross-functional team’s marketing priorities, adapting and making necessary trade-offs.
  • Mange the marketing budget, working with Corporate and regional PMM to allocate across the product portfolio and manage spend to achieve targets.
  • Lead and develop a high-performing cross-functional team and cultivate a working environment aligned to Adobe’s values.
  • Oversee efforts to enhance and localize the Adobe brand for the India market, ensuring cultural relevance and resonance.
  • Influence the martech/infrastructure used internally to shape the future of Adobe and the industry.
  • Develop strategic partnerships for the C&P business unit in India collaborating with the Corp Partnerships team.
  • Play a key role in quarterly business and marketing reviews, defining the ‘narrative’ for India and influencing the Executive team including the India SVP and Country Manager to again agreement on strategic shifts and trade-offs.
  • Establish meaningful regional targets to measure the effectiveness of marketing programs, gaining agreement from Corporate.
  • Use data analytics and market insights to identify key drivers for growth and optimization.

What you need to succeed

  • Demonstrated track record of working in a global marketing organization as well as “matrixed” functions to deliver more than double digital growth. Excellent project management skills and the ability to work in a fast-paced environment, with attention to detail.
  • 15+ years of marketing leadership experience in B2C, in software or a technology related field.
  • Deep understanding of the digital marketing (including social & influencer) and media landscape in India with a customer-first approach.
  • Strong understanding of digital business models and demonstrated impact creating and launching initiatives to drive conversion, paid member value expansion and increase customer engagement and retention.
  • Demonstrated success in fast-paced environments, rapidly anticipating and adapting to shifting priorities with strong project management skills.
  • Excellent leadership skills, showing strength in motivating a team to exceed goals.
  • Strong analytical and data-driven decision-making skills.
  • Exceptional critical thinking, with the ability to translate market insights into actionable marketing strategies focused on outcomes.
  • Outstanding communication, presentation and negotiation skills (verbal and written) in English. Fluent Hindi.  Additional local languages highly desirable.
  • Ability to engage and manage culturally diverse team members cross-functionally. Proven success in influencing executives, VP and/or “C” level.

  • Experience working with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).

Position Summary

The Digital Video Group's portfolio consists of world class products across desktops (Windows and Mac) to professional customers. Some of the products and technologies that the team develops include Adobe Premiere Pro, Adobe Media Encoder, After Effects, etc. As part of the team, you will be responsible for one or more of the following:
* Build impactful cross-platform modules to support sequence workflows across DVA products
* Develop features in core components which help make apps more reliable and scalable
* Implement unit tests and simulate end-to-end use cases to evaluate performance and stability
* Develop back-end infrastructure and automation to help detect performance degradation during continuous integration
* Participate in design and architecture of overall product and lead the same for your feature-set
* Develop imaging or video processing algorithms that can solve some of the hard problems faced by our customers

The key responsibilities include:
* Work collaboratively with a global team of engineers, product managers, and designers to create shared software components to enable a new generation of desktop video and audio creation applications
* Partner with internal client teams to integrate those components into their product, to ensure that product features apply those components correctly and completely, and to optimize the end-to-end workflow to delight the customer
* As an Individual contributor, develop new frameworks and features to improve performance and stability for the full product development cycle from early specs, prototypes to implementation to release and maintenance
* Strengthen space-time performance optimizations, usability and stability of products
* Understand the resource constraints of devices and implement robust and efficient solutions with respect to CPU processing and memory utilization
 

Requirements
• Typically, 6+ years of hands-on design and development experience
• B.Tech. / M.Tech. in computer science and engineering from a premier institute.
• Proficient in C++, object-oriented design, problem-solving skills, data structures, and algorithms.

• Knowledge of image or video processing, GPU, or experience in imaging or video is a plus.
• Solid in design at the system or application level.
• Strong debugging and solving skills at the system / application level.

The Opportunity

Join Adobe’s Digital Experience organization in Bengaluru as a Product Manager 3 and lead one of our most important enterprise capabilities. You will manage forecasting within a connected ecosystem that includes Sales Performance Management, Forecasting, and upstream planning systems. This provides a single, reliable view of pipeline and ARR forecasts, which directly supports executive decision-making. This outstanding opportunity lets you join a world-class team and make a meaningful impact!

What You’ll Do

  • Take full responsibility for Sales Performance Management and forecasting systems from start to finish
  • Define product strategy and roadmap for pipeline visibility, forecast rollups, and data-based predictions
  • Lead cross-system integration and architecture, ensuring scalable, reliable data flows
  • Partner with Sales, RevOps, and Finance to align forecast definitions, pipeline stages, and revenue assumptions
  • Improve forecast accuracy, pipeline coverage, and predictability through data insights
  • Work with engineering teams to bring to bear AI/ML, LLMs, or automation frameworks (e.g., copilots, agents, orchestration tools)
  • Proven capability to outline, convey, and secure agreement on multi-year product roadmaps for platform or enterprise products

Skills Required

  • 6–8 years in Product Management, ideally within Sales Performance Management, Forecasting, RevOps, or related platforms
  • Experience owning complex, multi-system enterprise products or SPM and Forecasting platforms
  • Strong comprehension of sales pipeline oversight, sales performance tracking, and forecasting procedures
  • Strong experience partnering with engineering, architecture, and operations teams in Agile/Scrum environments
  • Experience managing complex, multi-system initiatives through disciplined prioritization and execution
  • Strong data and analytical abilities with experience working on data models, pipelines, and forecasting inputs
  • Proven ability to drive cross-functional alignment and roadmap execution at scale

Requirements & Product Discovery

  • Strong ability to elicit, structure, and validate business requirements through interviews, workshops, and discovery sessions with collaborators, customers, and other interested parties
  • Experience conducting fit-gap analysis (current vs. future state) to define MVP scope and strategic roadmap
  • Ability to challenge and refine requirements to ensure alignment with business value, outcomes, and scalability

Documentation & Communication

  • Expertise in crafting clear, structured product artifacts, including:

Product Requirements Documents (PRDs)

1. Business Requirements Documents (BRDs)

Process flows, journey maps, and personas

  • Ability to detail end-to-end business processes and system interactions, including downstream impacts across coordinated platforms
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey complex concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences

Backlog Management & Delivery Readiness

  • Proven experience translating requirements into epics, features, and user stories with clear acceptance criteria
  • Strong backlog ownership, including prioritization, refinement, and sprint readiness
  • Ability to outline test scenarios and UAT criteria, ensuring delivered features meet business expectations
  • Familiarity with Agile methodologies and tools (e.g., Jira, Workfront)

Cross-Functional Leadership & Alignment

  • Ability to lead and influence across Sales, RevOps, Finance, Engineering, and Architecture without direct authority
  • Experience driving alignment on scope, priorities, and definitions across complex collaborator groups
  • Comfortable presenting to and influencing senior leadership and governance forums (e.g., PRB/ARB)

Analytical & Problem-Solving

  • Strong capability to detect problems in data, process, or system build
  • Experience using data to drive product decisions, prioritization, and continuous improvement
  • Ability to recognize root causes of business and system challenges and convert them into actionable solutions

Execution & Operational Excellence

  • Experience managing products through full lifecycle (discovery → definition → delivery → release → optimization)
  • Strong focus on detail with the capability to handle dependencies, risks, and delivery schedules

You will have the opportunity to work across a number of different industries, business personas and teams. The Opportunity
Adobe is looking for a high-energy, driven, and self-motivated individual to join Adobe's Customer Experience Orchestration team as a Business Development Representative (BDR) Rover supporting our sales teams.

Experience-1.5-3 Years

In this role, you will be our first line of contact with prospects. You will excel in establishing meaningful conversations with a variety of IT and C-level decision makers in a variety of industries, and you will prospect, educate, qualify, and develop target accounts to generate sales-ready meetings and opportunities.

Through account-based sales development, you will identify and build sales pipeline that leads to revenue growth. You will have the opportunity to work across a number of different industries, business personas and teams. This role is ideal for a highly motivated early-in-career professional who is resilient and keen to learn new skills in building and executing business development prospecting.

Measurement

. Your day to day activities will be at times across differing segments within the organisation. In the future, as your success continues, you will be moved to a dedicated account patch, once your area of specialisation is uncovered and developed. The compensation is 70:30, with ramp sales targets initially.


What You’ll Do Day to Day

  • Generate sales pipeline through inbound/outbound prospecting activities via telephone, video, and email

  • Build awareness into the account base through regular email campaigns, drive attendance to live and online webinars and assist with event/webinar follow ups.

  • Research accounts, identify key players, generate interest and develop accounts to uncover and develop opportunities for Adobe’s products.

  • Handle and overcome prospect objections with confidence.

  • Become a trusted resource and develop positive relationships with your sales ecosystem and peers.

  • Update CRM, Outreach, and other tools as necessary to ensure the capture of key activity history & ensure a smooth hand-off to the Account Executive as necessary.

  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of Adobe's competitive positioning in the marketplace.

  • Meet and exceed monthly, quarterly, and annual pipeline generating targets to ensure territory revenue objectives and pipeline linearity.

What You Will Need to Succeed

  • A track record of achieving measurable sales goals, in IT, or any other sales-focused environment.

  • Attention to detail to support accurate entry and management of lead data in a CRM system as required.

  • Positive and energetic phone skills, excellent listening skills, strong writing and presentation skills

  • An interest in sales prospecting tactics and technologies.

  • An interest in marketing technologies.

  • An interest in developing and learning new skills.

  • Motivated by individual and team achievement.

  • Highly organised with the ability to work in fast-paced environment.

  • Resilience.

Adobe for All

Adobe strives to create an environment where our employees can do their best work and drive their career growth and development based on their personal goals. From fair-pay practices to Employee Networks and programs designed to make everyone feel included, we're committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace for all.

Take the plunge and jump in
Liking what you have read and keen to jump in? Thinking you might not have all the skills we are looking for? Just take the plunge and apply – we know that by bringing together a diverse group of people, we become so much better together. We'd love to see where we can help drive Creativity for All together.

About Adobe

Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.

Our 30,000+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours. 


Let’s Adobe together

At Adobe, we believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. Learn more about Adobe life, including our values and culture, focus on people, purpose and community, Adobe for All, comprehensive benefits programs, the stories we tell, the customers we serve, and how you can help us advance our mission of empowering everyone to create.

Adobe is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Learn more.

Adobe aims to make our Careers website and recruiting process accessible to any and all users. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation to navigate our website or complete the application process, email accommodations@adobe.com or call +1 408-536-3015.

Our interviews are designed to reflect your own skills and thinking. The use of AI or recording tools during live interviews is not permitted unless explicitly invited by the interviewer or approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation. If these tools are used inappropriately or in a way that misrepresents your work, your application may not move forward in the process.

description_text:
JOB LEVEL

M70/P70

EMPLOYEE ROLE

People Manager

About the Role

The Senior Director, Regional Delivery (GDC) is a critical leadership role responsible for driving delivery excellence across North America, ensuring strong execution, governance, and alignment to business outcomes within a highly matrixed, global environment.

Beyond operations, this role will lead the evolution of AI-driven delivery models, shifting toward scalable, outcome-led approaches. Central to this role is a proactive customer-centric mindset - anticipating customer needs ahead of engagement, defining desired outcomes, and building delivery strategies, processes, and KPIs aligned to measurable impact. This leader will design with the customer in mind from the outset, ensuring solutions are purposeful, forward-looking, and drive long-term value.

Key Responsibilities

Regional Consolidation & Leadership

  • Serve as the single point of accountability for GDC delivery across Americas
  • Directly drive delivery operations, strategy, and execution for the Americas region, acting as the hands-on leader for all GDC delivery activities
  • Partner with regional leaders to operate as a co-owner of business outcomes, not just a delivery function

Strategic Delivery Management

  • Develop and implement regional delivery strategies that support business growth, customer satisfaction, and operational excellence
  • Collaborate with Sales, Presales, Product, and Customer Success teams to define and execute delivery roadmaps
  • Ensure consistent delivery methodologies, best practices, and frameworks across regions
  • Build capability within the group to drive successful execution of newly launched subscription services SKU (integrated services)
  • Champion the delivery of integrated services across regions, ensuring seamless collaboration and unified customer experiences
  • Drive adoption of AI-enabled delivery practices across the lifecycle (sales → implementation → go-live → monetization)
  • Identify and scale step-change improvements in delivery speed, productivity, and customer impact, beyond incremental gain

Business Performance & Growth

  • Own delivery KPIs, including revenue acceleration, margin goals, backlog management, and customer satisfaction across regions
  • Define and track impact beyond traditional KPIs, including time-to-value, transformation outcomes, and customer business impact – grow this customer centricity 
  • Drive operational reporting, forecasting, and cost management in partnership with finance and operations teams
  • Identify opportunities for new offerings, accelerators, and differentiated service models

Customer & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Engage directly with key customers to shape transformation agendas and co-create outcomes, not just manage delivery execution
  • Represent GDC delivery in executive-level workshops, presentations, and strategic discussions.
  • Foster strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders to drive business outcomes.

Talent Development & Team Leadership

  • Build, mentor, and develop high-performing regional delivery teams
  • Champion talent development, succession planning, and career growth for direct and indirect reports
  • Develop strong first-line leaders with a focus on accountability, coaching, and performance outcomes
  • Cultivate a culture of innovation, ownership, and continuous improvement

Qualifications

  • 18+ years of experience in delivery and consulting, with significant leadership experience in global/regional roles
  • Proven track record of managing large, complex delivery organizations across multiple geographies
  • Deep expertise in SaaS, cloud platforms, digital transformation, and enterprise software delivery
  • Strong commercial acumen, with experience in deal structuring, proposals, and contract negotiations
  • Demonstrated experience in driving transformation initiatives, including AI-led or automation-driven delivery evolution
  • Ability to operate across both strategic and hands-on execution layers, especially in evolving or 0→1 environments
  • Exceptional communication, stakeholder management, and executive presence
  • Willingness to travel internationally as required

What Success Looks Like

  • Delivery evolves from efficiency-led to impact-led transformation
  • Measurable improvements in speed, scalability, and customer outcomes, not just cost optimization 
  • Introduction of new delivery models or approaches that differentiate Adobe in the market 
  • Strong alignment with regions as a co-owner of outcomes, not just a delivery function

Preferred Skills

  • Experience in Americas delivery leadership or direct customer engagement in that region.
  • Knowledge of Adobe solutions, CRM, web analytics, campaign management, and digital marketing technologies.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and conflict resolution skills.
  • Ability to lead in a matrixed, multicultural environment.

Internal Opportunities

Creativity, curiosity, and constant learning are celebrated aspects of your career growth journey. We’re glad that you’re pursuing a new opportunity at Adobe!

Put your best foot forward:

1. Update your Resume/CV and Workday profile – don’t forget to include your uniquely ‘Adobe’ experiences and volunteer work.

2. Visit the Internal Mobility page on Inside Adobe to learn more about the process and set up a job alert for roles you’re interested in.

3. Check out these tips to help you prep for interviews.

4. If you are applying for a role outside of your current country, ensure you review the International Resources for Relocating Employees on Inside Adobe, including the impacts to your Benefits, AIP, Equity & Payroll. 

Once you apply for a role via Workday, the Talent Team will reach out to you within 2 weeks. If you move into the official interview process with the hiring team, make sure you inform your manager so they can champion your career growth.

At Adobe, you will be immersed in an exceptional work environment that is recognized around the world. You will also be surrounded by colleagues who are committed to helping each other grow through our unique Check-In approach where ongoing feedback flows freely. If you’re looking to make an impact, Adobe's the place for you. Discover what our employees are saying about their career experiences on the Adobe Life blog and explore the meaningful benefits we offer.

Adobe is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other applicable characteristics protected by law. Learn more.

The Opportunity

India is one of Adobe’s fastest growing and most dynamic markets, requiring culturally relevant, marketing programs across multiple products including Photoshop, Acrobat, Firefly and more.

As a Customer Marketing Specialist for India, you will play a critical role in implementing and scaling innovative marketing programs. You’ll bring campaigns to life with speed, precision, and quality - working across local, regional and global teams in a fast-paced, highly matrixed environment.

As a data-driven marketer you’ll have expertise in digital content creation, social/influencer marketing, WhatsApp, email, and optimizing for SEO, LLM, and paid-media.

This role is designed for a strong executor who takes ownership, thrives in complexity, and consistently delivers high-quality outcomes.

What you’ll do

  • Implement marketing programs for India across key customer segments (such as Creators, Creative Professionals, Business Professionals, and Students), owning end-to-end campaign execution, including timelines, briefs, content creation/localization and approval.
  • Manage creative agencies closely to ensure execution is on-brand, culturally relevant, and on time.
  • Partner closely with internal teams for integrated campaign delivery across Media, Social, PR, Lifecycle Marketing, SEO and Adobe.com.
  • Support the Director of India Customer Marketing to create local campaigns based on customer insights as well as adapt global creative to suit local culture, needs and trends.
  • Monitor and optimise campaign performance, reporting to key interested parties on results.
  • Operate effectively within Adobe’s global–regional–local marketing model

What you bring

  • 4+ years of hands-on experience implementing digital marketing for B2C in India, with strong expertise in social first programs including user generated content.
  • Proven experience managing creative/advertising agencies to deliver high-quality work, on time.
  • Strong organizational and project management skills with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Curiosity and customer-first mentality that translates into highly relevant messaging and content creation for Indian customers.
  • Ability to operate independently on complex workstreams.
  • Pro-active learner & data-driven approach to marketing.
  • Basic understanding of LLM/AI optimisation for marketing.
  • Fluent in English and Hindi essential (written and verbal), another regional language is a plus
  • General knowledge of Adobe Creative Cloud Tools, Adobe Analytics
  • Relevant Bachelor’s degree e.g. Communications, Marketing, Business

The Opportunity

Adobe Creative Cloud Extensibility Team is looking for passionate engineers who are crafting the future of design and creativity. If you’re passionate about building world-class web experiences used by millions globally and developing highly scalable, extensible frontend platforms, this is the role for you.

We are in search of a Senior Engineer with comprehensive experience in modern web technologies, strong architectural capabilities, and a commitment to delivering pixel-perfect, high-performance user experiences. You will be instrumental in transforming how users interact with Adobe products across international markets.

As a member of the Extensibility team, you build and refine frontend systems. These systems deliver embedded experiences across Adobe and external platforms. You will also support a common, scalable UI ecosystem.

In this role, you will:

  • Build and develop high-quality, scalable applications using modern JavaScript, TypeScript etc
  • Translate complex product and build requirements into intuitive, performant, and accessible user interfaces
  • Define and improve frontend architecture for extensible and embedded web experiences across Creative Cloud
  • Build reusable components, libraries, and patterns that enable consistency across products
  • Collaborate closely with build, product, and backend teams to deliver cohesive end-to-end solutions
  • Ensure performance, responsiveness, and cross-browser compatibility at scale
  • Conduct code reviews and uphold high standards for code quality, testing, and maintainability
  • Drive adoption of modern frontend guidelines, including state management, modular architecture, and build tooling
  • Troubleshoot and resolve UI performance and scalability issues in complex production environments
  • Contribute to a collaborative, globally distributed engineering culture

Must Haves:

  • 10+ years of experience in frontend or fullstack development with a strong frontend focus
  • Extensive knowledge of JavaScript, TypeScript, React, HTML, and CSS
  • Strong understanding of modern frontend architecture, including building with reusable parts and state management patterns
  • Experience building large-scale, high-performance web applications
  • Proficiency with frontend build tools and ecosystems (e.g., Webpack, Vite, Babel, npm/yarn)
  • Solid understanding of web performance optimization, accessibility (a11y), and responsive development
  • Experience integrating with backend services via APIs (REST/GraphQL)
  • Strong problem-solving, debugging, and analytical skills
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills
  • Bachelor’s degree or Master’s degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science or related field

Nice-to-Haves:

  • Experience working with or contributing to build systems or UI component libraries
  • Familiarity with extensibility frameworks, plugins, or SDK development
  • Exposure to micro-frontend architectures
  • Experience with testing frameworks (Jest, Playwright, Cypress, etc.)
  • Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and modern DevOps practices
  • Awareness of internationalization (i18n) and localization challenges in frontend development
  • Experience collaborating across multiple teams and geographies

About the Role 

We’re looking for a Full Stack Java Developer who enjoys building reliable, scalable applications across backend and frontend systems. In this role, you’ll work on well-defined problems, contribute to meaningful features, and collaborate with teammates to deliver solutions that improve customer experience. 

You’ll use modern development practices, including AI-assisted tools, to write high-quality code and continuously improve how we build software. 
 

What You’ll Do 

  • Build and maintain applications using Java (Spring Boot or similar) and modern frontend technologies 

  • Develop features across APIs, services, and user interfaces 

  • Troubleshoot issues and fix bugs across different parts of the system 

  • Write clean, testable code and contribute to code reviews 

  • Deploy and validate your work in shared environments 

  • Contribute to component-level design with a focus on performance and reliability 

  • Apply standard design patterns and improve existing solutions 

  • Use AI-powered development tools to write, test, and debug code more efficiently 

  • Explore ways AI can improve workflows, automation, or product features 

  • Work closely with product managers, designers, and other engineers 

  • Communicate clearly about progress, challenges, and decisions 

  • Turn requirements into working, user-focused solutions 

  • Write unit and integration tests to ensure quality 

  • Follow CI/CD and DevOps practices 

  • Help investigate and resolve production issues when needed 
     

What You Bring 

Core Skills 

  • Experience with Java and frameworks like Spring Boot 

  • Ability to build and work with REST APIs and backend services 

  • Strong understanding of programming fundamentals and problem-solving 

AI & Modern Tooling 

  • Experience with the adoption of AI-powered solutions to streamline workflows, improve productivity, and accelerate decision-making across engineering and operational processes. 

  • Drove innovation through the implementation of Model Context Protocol (MCP), enabling seamless integration between AI agents, enterprise systems, and business tools to create intelligent, context-aware workflows. 

  • Developed AI-driven accelerators that reduced manual effort, improved operational efficiency, and enhanced the quality and speed of execution across teams. 

  • Expertise in the use of Generative AI and Agentic AI frameworks to automate complex tasks, deliver actionable insights, and improve overall business outcomes. 

  • Experience using AI-assisted coding tools (such as Copilot or ChatGPT) 

  • Interest in applying AI to improve development workflows 

Frontend Experience 

  • Working knowledge of JavaScript, HTML, and CSS 

  • Experience with a framework like React, Angular, or Vue 

Full Stack Foundations 

  • Understanding of how frontend and backend systems work together 

  • Familiarity with databases (SQL or NoSQL) 

  • Exposure to cloud environments and deployment basics 

Engineering Practices 

  • Experience with Test automation and debugging. 

  • Familiarity with Git and CI/CD workflows 

  • Awareness of secure coding practices 
     

Nice to Have 

  • Experience with the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express, React, Node.js) 

  • Exposure to microservices or distributed systems 

  • Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, or similar tools 

  • Basic understanding of machine learning or data pipelines 

  • Experience with monitoring or observability tools 

 

About Adobe

Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.

Our 30,000+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours. 


Let’s Adobe together

At Adobe, we believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. Learn more about Adobe life, including our values and culture, focus on people, purpose and community, Adobe for All, comprehensive benefits programs, the stories we tell, the customers we serve, and how you can help us advance our mission of empowering everyone to create.

Adobe is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Learn more.

Adobe aims to make our Careers website and recruiting process accessible to any and all users. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation to navigate our website or complete the application process, email accommodations@adobe.com or call +1 408-536-3015. 

AI Use Guidelines for Interviews:
Our interviews are designed to reflect your own skills and thinking. The use of AI or recording tools during live interviews is not permitted unless explicitly invited by the interviewer or approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation. If these tools are used inappropriately or in a way that misrepresents your work, your application may not move forward in the process.

At Adobe, we empower employees to innovate with AI — and we look for candidates eager to do the same. As part of the hiring experience, we provide clear guidance on where AI is encouraged during the process and where it’s restricted during live interviews. See how we think about AI in the hiring experience.

JOB LEVEL

P50

EMPLOYEE ROLE

Individual Contributor

Adobe is looking for a dedicated Senior Product Manager to join our team in Noida. You will collaborate with a versatile team to craft the long-term vision for Adobe Document Cloud apps.

What you'll Do
  • Define and champion the product vision and strategy for your products.
  • Be a core member of the product management leadership team, guiding Adobe's overall product strategy for flagship offerings in Document Cloud.
  • Partnering with very hardworking engineering, marketing, and sales teams to drive business success.
  • Complete product strategy, roadmap, and requirements in collaboration with customers, partners, internal product teams, engineering, and senior management.
  • Conduct in-depth research on customer and market needs, and perform competitive analyses.
  • Define prioritized feature requirements and develop a comprehensive product roadmap.
  • Measure and assess the efficacy of the product roadmap to ensure customer delight and business success.
  • Deliver presentations and demonstrations that highlight product value.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams, marketing, support, and partners to deliver the right product to the market.

What you need to succeed
  • Proven track record of defining product requirements and delivering successful products.
  • BS in Engineering and an MBA from a top business school (IIM, XLRI, ISB) or equivalent experience.
  • 10-12 years of experience, with a minimum of 6-8 years in a post-MBA business role.
  • Ability to lead a cross-functional team of product managers, designers, and engineers to build products that impact millions of users.
  • Strong prioritization skills in ambiguous situations.
  • Proven ability to make data-driven recommendations and drive decisions.
  • Outstanding communication and social skills, with the ability to work across teams with geographically remote members.
  • Motivated self-starter with the ability to learn and adapt.
  • Experience in agile software development practices within a large team environment is desirable

Internal Opportunities

Creativity, curiosity, and constant learning are celebrated aspects of your career growth journey. We’re glad that you’re pursuing a new opportunity at Adobe!

Put your best foot forward:

1. Update your Resume/CV and Workday profile – don’t forget to include your uniquely ‘Adobe’ experiences and volunteer work.

2. Visit the Internal Mobility page on Inside Adobe to learn more about the process and set up a job alert for roles you’re interested in.

3. Check out these tips to help you prep for interviews.

4. If you are applying for a role outside of your current country, ensure you review the International Resources for Relocating Employees on Inside Adobe, including the impacts to your Benefits, AIP, Equity & Payroll. 

Once you apply for a role via Workday, the Talent Team will reach out to you within 2 weeks. If you move into the official interview process with the hiring team, make sure you inform your manager so they can champion your career growth.

At Adobe, you will be immersed in an exceptional work environment that is recognized around the world. You will also be surrounded by colleagues who are committed to helping each other grow through our unique Check-In approach where ongoing feedback flows freely. If you’re looking to make an impact, Adobe's the place for you. Discover what our employees are saying about their career experiences on the Adobe Life blog and explore the meaningful benefits we offer.

We do not discriminate based on gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other applicable characteristics protected by law. Learn more.

description_text:
The Opportunity


Are you passionate about securing global systems and mitigating risks in a fast-paced environment? Adobe Security is looking for a dynamic candidate to join its Vulnerability Operation Center (VOC). As a VOC Product Security Engineer, you will analyze and triage incoming identified vulnerabilities and engage with developers for all of Adobe’s products and online services. In this role, you will partner directly with developers and engineers to pave the way for measuring, prioritizing, and reducing risk across Adobe's suite of product offerings. This is a great opportunity to join in ground-breaking work to influence our organization's risk posture.


What you'll Do
Validate and assess severity of public and privately disclosed security vulnerabilities.
Drive security issues to resolution through continuous engagement with engineering teams.
Develop reporting metrics for leadership that highlight risks and trends.
Champion remediation efforts to Industry Wide Vulnerabilities and reducing
preventable vulnerabilities.
Identify security gaps and collaborate directly with product engineering teams on improved hardening opportunities.
Investigate systemic vulnerability trends to improve product risk posture and reduce preventable vulnerabilities.


What you need to succeed
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering or a related discipline and at least 4-6 years of practical experience.
Deep knowledge of infrastructure and application security vulnerabilities (OWASP Top10) and mitigation techniques.
Strong understanding of common security concepts that support root-cause analysis to make data-driven decisions on vulnerability patterns and trends.
Dependability - Meets commitments, works independently, accepts accountability, handles change, sets personal standards, stays focused under pressure.
Ability to speak and communicate professionally.

About Adobe

Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Our 30,000+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours. 


Let’s Adobe together

At Adobe, we believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. Learn more about Adobe life, including our values and culture, focus on people, purpose and community, Adobe for All, comprehensive benefits programs, the stories we tell, the customers we serve, and how you can help us advance our mission of empowering everyone to create.

Adobe is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Learn more.

Adobe aims to make our Careers website and recruiting process accessible to any and all users. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation to navigate our website or complete the application process, email accommodations@adobe.com or call +1 408-536-3015. 

AI Use Guidelines for Interviews:
Our interviews are designed to reflect your own skills and thinking. The use of AI or recording tools during live interviews is not permitted unless explicitly invited by the interviewer or approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation. If these tools are used inappropriately or in a way that misrepresents your work, your application may not move forward in the process.

We focus on developing innovative AI-powered search, recommendations, and assistive experiences using generative AI technologies across all modalities, including text, image, and videos, and create industry-leading experiences to improve creative efficiency for creators, marketers, and designers.

Our Company

Adobe is all about changing the world through digital experiences. We equip everyone—from emerging artists to global brands—with tools to invent and deliver outstanding digital experiences. We empower people to compose alluring and powerful images, videos, and apps. We help companies transform how they interact with customers across every screen. Our mission is to hire the very best and to develop outstanding employee experiences where everyone is respected and has equal opportunity. New ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. Your big idea could be next!

The opportunity

Adobe Photoshop is rapidly growing its Machine Learning team and is searching for an experienced Machine Learning Engineer skilled in Generative AI technologies. This position fits a hardworking individual who has practical experience deploying production-ready Machine Learning capabilities. They bring an AI-centered perspective to solving practical problems.

The successful applicant will have a track record of designing, rolling out, and scaling Machine Learning models for production use. They need strong familiarity with essential machine learning principles, contemporary generative strategies including diffusion models, transformers, and large language models, as well as significant experience in data administration, refinement, and analysis.

You will partner with engineering, product, and design teams in this role to develop innovative user-facing AI features. You will use current AI tools, platforms, and techniques across the software development lifecycle to boost system efficiency, developer productivity, and model performance.

What you will do

  • Deliver high-quality, scalable Machine Learning features, owning them end-to-end—from ideation, building, and development to shipping production-grade capabilities powered by Machine Learning models.
  • Work closely with Engineering, Product Management, and UX teams around the world to build innovative, technology-enhanced “Adobe magic” experiences for users.
  • Drive innovation in the digital imaging and creative AI space, finding opportunities to apply an AI-first approach to improve product capabilities.
  • Use modern tools, platforms, and standard methodologies across the SDLC (including experimentation, evaluation pipelines, automation, and observability) to improve system efficiency and developer productivity.
  • Conduct thoughtful, constructive code and build reviews, with a focus on quality, scalability, and responsible AI practices.
  • Mentor and guide engineers, acting as a role model in building AI-first systems, promoting guidelines in ML engineering, Generative AI, and production readiness.

What you need to succeed

  • Bachelor’s or graduate degree in Computer Science or related field.
  • 5+ years in software development with Machine Learning.
  • Hands-on experience with ML frameworks and generative models.
  • Demonstrated skill in developing, launching, and expanding AI models in a live environment.
  • Strong C++ development and performance optimisation skills.
  • Experience with AI-first engineering and modern SDLC practices.
  • Strong problem-solving skills; comfortable with ambiguity and complex challenges.
  • Experience working in Agile, cross-functional environments.
  • Strong communication skills across technical and non-technical collaborators.
  • Passion for innovation in digital imaging and creative AI and staying current with advancements.

Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.

Role Overview

As an Enterprise Architect within Adobe Professional Services, you will serve as a trusted advisor to Adobe’s enterprise customers, driving digital transformation using Adobe Experience Cloud. You will lead architecture strategy, solution design, and implementation guidance across complex, multi-solution engagements, ensuring customers realize maximum value from Adobe platforms.

This is a client-facing leadership role that blends deep technical expertise, consulting mindset, and business strategy alignment.

Key Responsibilities

1. Client Advisory & Strategic Engagement

  • Act as a strategic advisor to C-level stakeholders (CMO, CIO, CTO)
  • Translate customer business objectives into Adobe Experience Cloud roadmaps
  • Lead discovery workshops, architecture envisioning, and digital transformation strategy sessions
  • Provide thought leadership on DXP, personalization, and customer journey orchestration

2. Solution & Enterprise Architecture

  • Define end-to-end architecture across Adobe Experience Cloud, including:
    • Adobe Experience Manager (AEM – Sites, Assets, Headless, Cloud Service)
    • Adobe Analytics
    • Adobe Target
    • Adobe Journey Optimizer / Campaign
    • Adobe Real-Time CDP
  • Design scalable, secure, and high-performing solutions aligned with Adobe best practices
  • Establish reference architectures and reusable patterns for client engagements
  • Drive composable and API-first architecture approaches

3. Delivery Leadership & Governance

  • Provide architectural oversight across multiple concurrent implementations
  • Partner with delivery managers and engineering teams to ensure successful execution
  • Conduct architecture reviews, code reviews, and performance optimization guidance
  • Ensure adherence to Adobe’s implementation methodologies and standards

4. Integration & Data Strategy

  • Define integration architecture across enterprise ecosystems:
    • CRM (e.g., Salesforce)
    • ERP systems
    • Data platforms (data lakes, warehouses)
    • Third-party martech/adtech tools
  • Lead customer data strategy, including identity, segmentation, and activation
  • Enable real-time personalization and omnichannel experiences

5. Innovation & Adobe Alignment

  • Stay aligned with Adobe product roadmap and emerging capabilities
  • Advocate Adobe best practices and promote adoption of new features
  • Collaborate with Adobe product teams to provide field feedback and influence roadmap

6. Pre-Sales & Business Development Support

  • Support sales teams in:
    • Solutioning for RFPs/RFIs
    • Client presentations and demos
    • Effort estimation and high-level architecture proposals
  • Help position Adobe solutions as the preferred digital experience platform

Required Skills & Expertise

Adobe Ecosystem Expertise

  • Deep hands-on and architectural experience across Adobe Experience Cloud
  • Strong expertise in AEM (Cloud Service preferred)
  • Experience with Adobe Analytics, Target, and CDP
  • Knowledge of Journey Optimizer / Campaign for cross-channel orchestration

Technical & Architecture Skills

  • Strong understanding of:
    • Cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure/GCP)
    • Microservices and API-first design
    • Headless and composable architectures
  • Experience with:
    • Frontend frameworks (React, SPA)
    • Integration patterns (REST APIs, event-driven architecture)
    • DevOps and CI/CD pipelines

Consulting & Leadership Skills

  • Strong client-facing and stakeholder management skills
  • Ability to influence decisions at executive level
  • Experience leading distributed, cross-functional teams
  • Strong problem-solving and strategic thinking ability

Experience Requirements

  • 12+ years in digital, IT, or marketing technology
  • 5–8+ years of deep experience in Adobe Experience Cloud
  • Proven experience delivering large-scale enterprise implementations
  • Experience in consulting, system integrators, or professional services organizations

  • Research customer and market needs, conduct competitive analysis
  • Define prioritized feature requirements along with an overall product roadmap

  • Deliver presentations and demonstrations that highlight product value

  • Train models and run experiments to study data and model quality.
  • Iteratively refine research experiments and clearly communicate insights to the team.
  • Integrate core machine learning models into the Adobe Experience Manager and other products.
  • Collaborate with product, design, and engineering teams to rapidly prototype and transition conceptual prototypes from research to production.

Requirements

  • Proven expertise in one or more of the following areas: Computer Vision, Large Language Models, Natural Language Processing, Multimodal Content Understanding, Agentic Workflows.
  • Multiple publications in top-tier conferences such as CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, KDD, WWW, PNAS, Nature, Science, or related top conferences/journals.
  • Hands-on experience and a track record of deploying solutions in production environments.
  • Ability to derive actionable insights from large-scale visual and multimodal datasets.
  • Ability to take research risks and solve hard problems independently.
  • PhD degree or equivalent experience in industrial research in Computer Science, Statistics, Economics, or other relevant technical fields.

You Will Thrive In This Role If You:

Are a great teammate who is willing to take on a variety of tasks to contribute to the success of the team Have a proven track record and an impulse for empirical research, answering complex questions with data. Are capable of leading ambitious projects and possess clear communication skills. Have familiarity with crafting quality research experiments and evaluations with rapid iterations. Have experience working in complex technical environments, improving research velocity. Possess a flexible analytic approach that allows for results at varying levels of precision. Have familiarity with relational databases and SQL. Bonus: Experience with large-scale data systems such as Beam or Spark.

About Adobe's Firefly Group

Join a team where ambition meets brand new ideas! Adobe's Firefly Group offers an outstanding opportunity to be at the forefront of innovative technology. As leaders in digital experiences, we are determined to transform how companies interact with customers across every screen. Our mission is to empower engineers and researchers by providing world-class cloud solutions for ML workflows, using the latest technology and frameworks. If you are passionate about crafting flawless digital experiences and are eager to compete in a dynamic environment, this is the place for you.

Position Summary

The AI Platform team builds the compute infrastructure that enables AI workloads at scale — spanning job scheduling, resource management, and the control plane that ASML engineers at Adobe depend on daily. We sit at the intersection of distributed systems and machine learning infrastructure, building the foundational services that power model training across Adobe Firefly.

We are seeking a seasoned Senior ML Platform engineer to join our ambitious team in Noida/Bangalore. This role is ideal for a technical leader who can own and evolve complex scheduling and compute orchestration systems, work closely with ASML engineers as the primary consumers of the platform, and drive architectural decisions that meaningfully improve developer productivity and system reliability.

What You'll Do

• Design, build, and maintain core services of the AI compute control plane: job scheduling, cluster management, resource quota enforcement, and compute lifecycle management
• Lead the design and implementation of job scheduling, resource quota enforcement, and compute lifecycle management systems
• Own the control plane services that manage GPU/CPU workload orchestration — from job submission through execution, monitoring, and teardown
• Design reliable, fault-tolerant worker services and supervisor patterns for long-running compute workloads
• Build and evolve the data layer that tracks job state, cluster state, and resource ownership across the platform
• Partner closely with ASML engineers to deeply understand their workflows and translate requirements into robust platform capabilities
• Develop and maintain Python SDKs and CLIs that ML engineers use to interact with the platform — prioritizing developer experience and reliability
• Drive end-to-end ownership of features — from API design and data modelling through deployment and production operations
• Establish observability standards (metrics, tracing, alerting) for scheduling and compute systems
• Lead incident response and root cause analysis for production issues in compute orchestration
• Mentor junior and mid-level engineers on system design, scheduling patterns, and platform engineering best practices

What We're Looking For

• B.Tech / M.Tech degree in Computer Science from a premier institute
• 9+ years of proven experience in backend platform engineering, distributed systems, or infrastructure software
• Strong computer science fundamentals — particularly in distributed systems, concurrency, and system design
• Experience building or operating job scheduling, workflow orchestration, or compute management systems (e.g. Argo, Airflow, Ray, Slurm, or similar)
• Proficiency in Python and/or Java, with strong async programming skills
• Experience designing and operating services backed by relational databases (PostgreSQL preferred) at scale
• Deep understanding of Cloud Platforms, with preference for AWS; familiarity with Azure or GCP is a plus
• Proven track record of working directly with internal engineering customers (ML engineers, researchers) to shape platform roadmap
• Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to own ambiguous, complex systems independently
• Experience with Kubernetes at the workload/scheduling layer (not just operations)

Good to Have

• Hands-on experience with ML training workflows, distributed training frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow), or GPU resource management
• Familiarity with gRPC/protobuf or event-driven architectures
• Experience building developer-facing internal platforms consumed by ML or research teams
• Prior work in an AI platform, MLOps, or compute infrastructure role
• Understanding of ML lifecycle — experiment tracking, model versioning, training pipelines

About Adobe

Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.

Our 30,000+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours. 


Let’s Adobe together

At Adobe, we believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. Learn more about Adobe life, including our values and culture, focus on people, purpose and community, Adobe for All, comprehensive benefits programs, the stories we tell, the customers we serve, and how you can help us advance our mission of empowering everyone to create.

Adobe is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Learn more.

Adobe aims to make our Careers website and recruiting process accessible to any and all users. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation to navigate our website or complete the application process, email accommodations@adobe.com or call +1 408-536-3015.

Our interviews are designed to reflect your own skills and thinking. P50

EMPLOYEE ROLE

Individual Contributor

The Opportunity

At P50, you’ll be a technical leader shaping the plugin platform and engineering practices for extensibility at scale. You’ll drive architecture, guide major initiatives, and partner with PM/Design/Platform teams to deliver flexible, enterprise-ready plugin experiences. The problem we’re solving large creative organizations need a way to generate and iterate on brand-safe content inside existing creative workflows (where templates and day-to-day production happen). Without a plugin approach, teams are forced into tool switching, duplicated work, template rewrites, and brittle integrations that don’t scale across hosts or channels. We’re building an extensible plugin foundation that enables in-tool creation, consistent field-role mapping, robust API-driven generation/editing flows, and smooth handoff to GenStudio for downstream governance. This is still frontend-first, but you’ll be expected to operate confidently across boundaries—API design, service integration, and pragmatic full-stack problem solving.
 

What you’ll do

  • Lead the architecture of GeoStudio plugin experiences and shared frontend infrastructure (patterns, abstractions, extensibility strategy).
  • Drive complex, high-impact initiatives end-to-end: from ambiguous problem definition to delivery, rollout strategy, and iteration based on feedback.
  • Set engineering direction on quality, performance, reliability, accessibility, and maintainability for plugin UI and integration layers.
  • Define and influence API contracts with backend/platform teams to ensure developer-friendly, scalable integrations.
  • Establish durable patterns for async workflows (job polling, progress UX, cancellation, retries, partial failures, and user trust).
  • Mentor and raise the bar: guide senior and junior engineers, run technical reviews, and create a culture of strong ownership and crisp execution.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally at a high level: align with PM/Design on roadmap, scope trade-offs, and extensible product design.

What you need to succeed

  • 8–12+ years of industry experience with deep frontend expertise and strong architectural ownership.
  • Expert knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript and modern frontend architecture (component systems, state, performance, testing, build tooling).
  • Demonstrated success designing and shipping reusable, extensible frontend systems used across teams/products.
  • Strong experience integrating with REST/GraphQL APIs, handling auth and async workflows, and designing resilient client systems.
  • Ability to provide technical leadership, navigate ambiguity, and communicate clearly with engineering and product leadership.

  • Experience building products involving GenAI/LLMs (prompting patterns, model capabilities/limits, evaluation thinking, safety/guardrails).
