At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

At eBay, our SEO and Landing Page Platform powers how millions of buyers discover products through search engines and navigate our marketplace. Operating at the scale of hundreds of millions of live listings, we build intelligent systems that improve search discoverability, content understanding, taxonomy quality, and buyer experiences across global markets.

We are looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to lead the design, development, and deployment of large-scale AI and Machine Learning solutions that power search, discovery, content intelligence, and operational automation.

This role sits at the intersection of Machine Learning, Generative AI, Knowledge Graphs, Search Technologies, and Large-Scale Data Engineering.

What You'll Work On

You will help build next-generation AI systems including:

  • Large Language Model (LLM) applications and AI-powered experiences

  • Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems for knowledge retrieval and intelligent decision-making

  • Agentic AI workflows and autonomous reasoning systems

  • Knowledge Graph construction, enrichment, and entity understanding

  • Entity Resolution across large hierarchical datasets

  • Taxonomy optimization and automated catalog intelligence

  • Image understanding and quality scoring systems

  • Search relevance and discoverability improvements

  • Real-time and batch ML inference platforms

  • Large-scale ML pipelines and feature engineering systems

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and deploy production-grade Machine Learning and AI solutions at scale.

  • Develop scalable ML pipelines, feature stores, and inference systems using distributed computing frameworks.

  • Build and optimize RAG architectures leveraging vector databases, embeddings, retrieval systems, and LLMs.

  • Design Agentic AI solutions capable of orchestrating workflows, reasoning across multiple tools, and automating complex business processes.

  • Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Applied Scientists, and Leadership teams to define AI strategy and roadmap.

  • Drive innovation in Generative AI, Knowledge Graphs, Search, and Discovery technologies.

  • Mentor engineers and contribute to technical leadership across the organization.

  • Establish engineering best practices for model development, deployment, monitoring, and governance.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related field.

  • 10+ years of industry experience in Machine Learning, Applied AI, Data Science, or Data Engineering.

  • Strong production-grade programming experience in Python.

  • Proven experience building and deploying ML solutions into production environments.

  • Strong expertise in distributed data processing using Spark, PySpark, Hadoop, and SQL.

  • Experience designing scalable data pipelines and ML platforms.

  • Strong communication, collaboration, and technical leadership skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with:

    • Large Language Models (LLMs)

    • Generative AI applications

    • Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)

    • Agentic AI frameworks

    • Knowledge Graphs

    • Vector Databases and Embedding Models

  • Experience with MLOps, Model Serving, and Online Inference Systems.

  • Experience with Search, Recommendation, Ranking, or Discovery systems.

  • Cloud platform experience (AWS, GCP, or Azure).

  • Open-source contributions or leadership within AI/ML communities.

Why Join This Team?

This is an opportunity to solve some of the most challenging AI and Machine Learning problems at internet scale. Your work will directly influence how millions of buyers discover products, how eBay understands its vast inventory, and how emerging AI technologies transform the future of commerce and customer experiences.

Additional Details

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.

 

We use cookies to enhance your experience and may use AI tools for administrative tasks in the hiring process. To learn how we handle your personal data and use AI responsibly, please visit our Talent Privacy Notice, Privacy Center, and AI Hiring Guidelines.

We are seeking an Associate Manager, IT Audit with experience in assurance and controls background to join eBay’s Global Internal Audit team based in Bengaluru, India. This is a hybrid role, requiring onsite presence at least three days each week.

 

In this role, you will conduct IT audits within eBay Inc. You will collaborate with global audit team members and partners across different time zones. Your work includes performing control testing, identifying control gaps and business risks, and contributing to meaningful, outcome-focused audit results.

 

This position reports to the Senior Manager, Internal Audit and plays a key role in strengthening audit execution and collaboration across our global Internal Audit organization.

 

The ideal candidate is analytical, diligent, and collaborative, with a strong sense of ownership and a desire to contribute beyond meeting requirements.

 

What you will accomplish:

  • Independently complete technology audit programs, including control design and operating efficiency testing, in accordance with Internal Audit methodology.

  • Act as a key contributor within the cross-regional audit teams, coordinating workstreams and ensuring alignment across time zones.

  • Proactively identify and resolve coordination or execution issues that may impact timelines or quality.

  • Identify control weaknesses, process gaps, and business risks and the convert risks into clear, actionable audit issues and recommendations.

  • Draft audit documentation and findings, and support the preparation of clear, concise, and impactful audit reports.

  • Facilitate issue tracking, validation of remediation, and timely closure of audit findings.

  • Contribute to continuous improvement of audit processes and find opportunities to improve audit efficiency and value to the organization.

 

What you will bring:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

  • 6+ years of experience in technology audits, compliance, and/or risk management with a solid background in internal controls.

  • Professional certification such as CPA, CIA, CISA, or equivalent strongly preferred.

  • Strong  knowledge of business processes and internal controls, along with the skill to recognize control gaps and areas for operational advancement.

  • Analytical and problem-solving skills, with a practical attitude geared toward addressing challenges.

  • Demonstrated written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly share audit results with diverse collaborators across functions, regions, and levels (including senior management).

  • Ability to manage multiple audit assignments and priorities in a fast-paced, global environment.

  • Proactive, outcome-focused, and collaborative working style, with a strong focus on quality and accountability.

  • High attention to detail and dedication to accuracy.

  • Ability to travel occasionally, as business needs require.

Additional Details

description_text:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

Overview

We are seeking a skilled Report Developer to design, build, and maintain enterprise reporting and analytics solutions that enable data-driven decision-making across the organization. This role will focus on delivering high-quality dashboards, reports, and analytical applications using SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) and Looker, powered by modern data platforms.

You will work closely with business Business Partners, data engineers, and analytics teams to translate business requirements into intuitive, scalable, and performant reporting solutions. The ideal candidate combines strong data modeling and visualization expertise with a thorough knowledge of enterprise data structures and business processes.

Experience with modern cloud data platforms such as Google BigQuery (GBQ) is a strong plus, enabling efficient querying and modeling of large-scale datasets.

Key Responsibilities

Report & Dashboard Development

  • Design, develop, and maintain interactive dashboards and reports using SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) and Looker
  • Translate business and functional requirements into effective visualizations, critical metrics, and analytical views.
  • Build reusable reporting components and templates to ensure consistency across the organization.
  • Implement drill-downs, filters, and dynamic views to support self-service analytics.

Data Modeling & Semantic Layer

  • Develop and maintain semantic models in SAC and Looker (e.g., LookML), ensuring alignment with business definitions.
  • Collaborate with data engineering teams to define data structures, transformations, and access patterns.
  • Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and proper metric definitions across reporting layers.
  • Optimize queries and data models for performance and scalability.

Data Integration & Querying

  • Work with structured and semi-structured data from enterprise systems and cloud data platforms.
  • Write efficient SQL queries to extract, transform, and validate data for reporting use cases.
  • Leverage BigQuery (GBQ) or similar cloud data warehouses (preferred) for large-scale data analysis.

Quality, Governance & Support

  • Validate and reconcile report outputs to ensure accuracy, especially for business-critical and financial reporting.
  • Support testing, debugging, and issue resolution across reporting and data layers.
  • Adhere to governance standards, including naming conventions, documentation, and access controls.
  • Maintain documentation for reports, dashboards, and data definitions.

Collaboration & Business Partner Engagement

  • Partner with business users (e.g., Finance, Operations, Product) to gather requirements and deliver insights.
  • Communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical Business Partners.
  • Deliver training and support to end users to increase adoption of reporting tools.
  • Collaborate with cross - functional teams to continuously improve reporting capabilities.

Qualifications

Required

  • 5+ years of experience in business intelligence, reporting, or data analytics roles.
  • Hands-on experience with:
    • SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) for dashboarding and reporting
    • Looker, including LookML modeling and dashboard development
  • Strong SQL skills and experience working with relational data models.
  • Experience building interactive dashboards and data visualizations for business users.
  • Good understanding of data modeling concepts and semantic layers.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.

Preferred

  • Experience with Google BigQuery (GBQ) or other cloud data warehouses (Snowflake, Redshift, etc.).
  • Familiarity with enterprise data ecosystems, including ERP or financial reporting systems.
  • Experience with data governance, data quality validation, and metric standardization.
  • Exposure to both live and in-memory reporting models.
  • Understanding of financial or operational reporting use cases.

Soft Skills

  • Good communication and Business Partner management skills.
  • Ability to work in fast-paced, cross - functional environments.
  • Self-starter with a focus on quality, usability, and continuous improvement.

Additional Details

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.

 

We use cookies to enhance your experience and may use AI tools for administrative tasks in the hiring process. To learn how we handle your personal data and use AI responsibly, please visit our Talent Privacy Notice, Privacy Center, and AI Hiring Guidelines.

We design, deploy, and operate high-performance, fault-tolerant traffic routing solutions that handle billions of daily requests, ensuring seamless, low-latency connectivity for both internal microservices and external customer traffic. This involves continuous optimization of data plane performance, rigorous security enforcement at the edge and within the cluster, and developing self-service tools that empower application teams to configure their connectivity reliably and securely across our massive global footprint.

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Cloud Traffic Engineering Manager to lead a team responsible for the development, operations, and governance of one of the largest private clouds in the world based on Kubernetes.

You will guide and mentor a team of hardworking engineers in building and maintaining robust, secure, and scalable cloud offerings that empower eBay’s core product engineering organizations and initiatives.

We require a unique blend of cloud expertise, traffic management, software development management experience, and strong leadership skills. The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of cloud-native technologies, experience managing and developing software engineering teams, passion for building scalable and reliable systems, and excellent people skills to cultivate a high-performing team.

What you will accomplish:

Leadership & People Management

Lead and mentor a team of cloud engineers, fostering a strong culture of collaboration and continuous improvement.

Conduct regular one-on-one meetings with team members, providing guidance, feedback, and support for their career development.

Manage performance evaluations and provide constructive feedback and actively participate in all phases of growing the engineering organization through recruiting, team

building, etc.

Cloud Engineering, Operations & Governance: 

Lead and coordinate engineering activities to successfully plan, communicate, and deliver on product features on time while designing for quality, observability, and

scalability.

Ensure full software lifecycle instrumentation from requirement ideation to software development to deployment.

Drive the adoption of cloud-native technologies and standard processes, such as service mesh, microservices, etc.

Collaboration with internal partners and team members:

Cloud engineering and operations teams, product, and PMO on engineering resource allocation and project schedules in accordance with our strategic organizational priorities.

Cloud SRE team to champion automation to enhance efficiency and reliability.

Operations teams on maintaining a highly available cloud infrastructure to ensure eBay’s products and services are available to our customers.

Fleet management team on capacity planning, resource allocation, and cost optimization for the private cloud.

Information security teams to ensure integrity and compliance of the cloud infrastructure by implementing appropriate security controls and monitoring.

Global security teams to ensure the products are protected against external and internal threats

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.

  • 10+ years of software engineering experience, including 3+ years of people management or technical leadership.

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to bridge technical and design perspectives.

  • Strong technical background with a deep understanding of cloud-native architectures and technologies (e.g., Kubernetes, containerization, service mesh, microservices).

  • Experience with software development, networking, and security technologies in a large-scale cloud environment.

  • Experience working in large, distributed global teams and supporting medium or large-scale technology organizations with multiple internal partners.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Direct experience with customizing and maintaining Linux operating system kernels for large-scale, high-performance computing platforms.

  • Experience in capacity planning, resource allocation, and cost optimization for large private cloud infrastructure.

  • Knowledge of software development, networking, security, and storage technologies in a cloud environment and proven understanding of cloud-native architectures, microservices,

  • DevOps and SRE principles.

  • Deep expertise in implementing and championing automation to enhance efficiency and reliability.

  • Professional certifications related to Kubernetes (e.g., CKA, CKS) or cloud infrastructure.

  • Proven ability to work closely with Information Security teams on compliance, security controls, and monitoring for cloud infrastructure.

  • Understanding of developer experience (DX) principles for API-driven platforms.

  • Strong product mindset — balancing security rigor with customer empathy and usability.

At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

The eBay Cloud team powers the foundational cloud infrastructure that supports thousands of eBay applications. As one of the largest private cloud platforms in the industry, we operate and manage hundreds of Kubernetes clusters across diverse environments, comprising millions of compute instances.

Our team is responsible for the full lifecycle management of these clusters—including provisioning, OS and Kubernetes upgrades, technical refreshes, and decommissioning. We also customize the Linux operating system for our Kubernetes platform, enhancing the kernel to meet eBay’s rigorous scalability, reliability, and security requirements.

The ideal candidate will have at least 5 years of experience in the field, focusing on kernel development and cluster automation(build, os/kubernetes upgrade and decommission). You will also drive the implementation of observability practices to monitor, troubleshoot, and ensure the reliability of our infrastructure at scale.

What you will accomplish: 

  • Design, develop, and maintain a robust, high-performance Kubernetes fleet management system encompassing cluster, availability zone (AZ), and node lifecycle operations, with a rapid adoption of the latest Kubernetes releases.

  • Contribute to kernel development and performance tuning to enhance system scalability, reliability, and efficiency; stay up to date with the latest advancements in kernel and security technologies.
     

  • Build high-performance tools and services using Go and Python to support infrastructure automation and diagnostics.
     

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to validate, adopt, and integrate optimized Linux OS distributions across diverse infrastructure environments.
     

  • Implement robust observability frameworks to monitor system health, ensure performance, and support proactive issue resolution at scale.


 

What you will bring: 

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
     

  • Minimum of 8 years of hands-on experience with Linux systems, including a strong understanding of Linux kernel development and OS internals—such as process scheduling, memory management, file systems, and networking.
     

  • Proficient in programming with C++, Go, or Python.
     

  • Deep expertise in orchestrating containerized applications and building scalable cluster management systems.
     

  • Skilled at identifying system-level gaps and cross-functional issues, proposing effective solutions, and driving end-to-end resolution.
     

  • Demonstrated ability to lead and mentor team members, manage small projects, and collaborate effectively across teams to drive impactful change.

Additional Details

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

At eBay, we represent more than a global ecommerce leader — we are revolutionizing the way the world shops and sells. Millions of buyers and sellers rely on our platform in over 190 markets globally. We’re dedicated to breaking new ground and making our impact as we reshape the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Become part of a group of passionate problem solvers, creative individuals, and dreamers. Join us in bringing people together and encouraging communities to develop economic opportunities for all.

About the team and the role:

This role sits within eBay’s Technical Program Management organization and is focused on orchestrating large, cross-domain initiatives for the Payments & Financial Services Technology that power our marketplace experience. You will partner closely with Product, Engineering, Business, Design, and Product Marketing across several high-impact domains, as well as support key initiative such as Seller Payments & Payouts, and Seller Capital & Insurance, Monetization, and Merchant Services to plan, prioritize, and deliver programs that move billions of dollars annually for millions of buyers and sellers across 190+ markets. 

What you will accomplish:

  • Own the annual and quarterly planning activities across the Priorities and Domains, standardizing intake governance, prioritizing the projects, accessing cross-functional demand, and developing unified roadmaps with clear capacity framework to support that. 

  • Drive cross-functional alignment and execution for strategic and multi-domain initiatives, working with teams to identify the GETs/PUTs, putting work backwards plans, securing commitments from dependency owners,  facilitating trade-offs and sequencing the execution of the projects to ensure reliable delivery. 

  • Drive critical projects from inception through launch. Partner with Business, Product, Engineering, Build, Marketing, Analytics, and other key domains. Deliver projects on time and within budget while meeting goals and outcomes.

  • Proactively identify and mitigate Risks & Blockers impacting project outcomes and goals.

  • Build and own program health reporting and executive-ready status updates, including risk registers, tradeoff summaries, and playbooks for resolving customer concerns, and regularly present program status, blockers, and recommendations to senior leadership.

  • Establish and improve operating cadences and artifact standards (planning reviews, roadmap reviews, requirements reviews, project status check-ins, Scrum of Scrums, and executive summaries) that improve execution readiness and cross-team coordination.

  • Analyze program and product metrics; identify systemic risks, conduct root-cause analysis, balance trade-offs between business needs and technical constraints, and drive consensus across partners to keep programs on track.

  • Communicate and collaborate effectively at all levels, including executive updates, steering committee presentations, program documentation, and cross-functional tracking, keeping all collaborators aligned and accountable throughout delivery.

  • Purposefully employ artificial intelligence and generative technologies to improve program management efficiency by automating manual tasks. Define future work approaches, mentor TPMs and PMOs, lead retrospectives, and codify operating procedures to promote continuous improvement organization-wide.

What you will bring:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or equivalent; 10+ years of experience collaborating with Program, Development, Technical, Corporate Operations, and Sales/Marketing groups

  • Proven track record of leading large-scale, cross-functional programs in a product and technology environment from conception through completion, with the ability to operate independently under ambiguous or unfamiliar circumstances with little to no guidance.

  • Proven technical background — able to engage directly with engineering teams, understand system architecture, assess delivery risk, and translate technical trade-offs for business and executive partners credibly in both directions.

  • Practitioner-level experience with AI and GenAI tools (including ChatGPT Enterprise, Gemini, Glean, NotebookLM, Claude Code, and custom AI agents) actively applied to accelerate program planning, documentation synthesis, and execution — not as experiments, but as repeatable operational habits.

  • Proficiency in Agile methodologies and program tracking tools — Jira, Airtable, Confluence, and Google Workspace; comfortable writing queries, building dashboards, and creating templates that make program data effortless for teams; experience with Tableau, Looker or Power BI is a plus.

  • Capable of leading through influence, negotiation, and information management; holding stakeholders accountable to shared goals regardless of seniority; managing multiple partners across levels proactively and clearly, and prioritizing competing demands without loss of efficiency or visibility.

  • Strong executive presence and communication skills. Experience delivering presentations to steering committees. Manage blocking issue frameworks and program documentation for VP and C-suite audiences. Work with global, matrixed engineering organizations.

Additional Details

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Country Security Manager (CSM) to join our team! You will be the senior-most physical security leader responsible for protecting employees, assets and operations across our India locations. Based in Bengaluru, this role reports to the APAC Regional Manager, Global Physical Security (GPS), and serves as the in-country authority on risk management, crisis leadership, and security program execution.

This position defines and accomplishes the strategy for Physical Security in India, ensuring alignment with global standards while adapting to the local regulatory, geopolitical, and operational landscape. The CSM is accountable for delivering a scalable, high-performance security program that supports business growth and resilience.

Together, we are committed to providing a safe, resilient and welcoming environment that empowers our people and expresses our DNA, brand & culture!

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership & Governance

  • Develop and implement the India Physical Security strategy aligned to global security objectives and enterprise risk priorities.
  • Serve as the principal security advisor to India leadership.
  • Drive program maturity, standardization, and scalability across all India offices.
  • Deliver focused financial management and cost optimization in the security budget.

Risk & Threat Management

  • Lead country-wide risk assessments, threat analysis, and vulnerability reviews.
  • Help maintains a dynamic country risk register and mitigation roadmap.
  • Monitor evolving risks including civil unrest, geopolitical developments, labor dynamics, crime trends, and natural disasters.

Crisis & Incident Leadership

  • Lead crisis response and incident management for all India operations.
  • Coordinate with global and cross-functional teams such as GSOC, Crisis Management, Investigations & Threat Management, and Executive Protection teams when required.
  • Conduct post-incident reviews and ensure corrective actions are implemented.

Security Operations & Technology

  • Ensure standardized post orders, SOPs, and site security plans.
  • Conduct regular physical security audits and compliance reviews.
  • Coordinate security infrastructure encompassing access control, CCTV, intrusion detection, and alarm monitoring.

Vendor & Guard Force Governance

  • Own end-to-end vendor management, including contract oversight, RFP processes, and performance evaluations.
  • Implement SLAs through structured metric driven dashboards and quality assurance programs.
  • Optimize security spend while maintaining operational effectiveness.

Stakeholder & External Engagement

  • Partner with, but not limited to business functions such as Facilities and EHS&S, HR, Legal, IT, Communications.
  • Maintain cohesive relationships with local law enforcement, emergency services, and industry peers along with OSAC membership.

Qualifications

Required

  • Minimum 10+ years of dynamic experience in corporate physical security, with at least 3–5 years in a leadership capacity leading multi-site or country-level security operations.
  • Validated expertise in risk assessment methodologies, crisis management,  incident response and investigations.
  • Strong experience handling guard force vendors and implementing SLAs.

Preferred

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Security, Emergency Management, or a related field.
  • ASIS CPP, PSP professional certification.

Additional Details

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.

description_text:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

About the Team
We are the Product Development team within Customer Service Technology under eBay’s Global Technology Organization.
Our engineers build and operate customer-facing and internal platforms across frontend applications, backend services, APIs, and integrations. We use a modern, diverse tech stack including Java, Node.js, JavaScript, TypeScript, and NoSQL data stores, with a strong emphasis on scalability, observability, and collaboration in a distributed environment.

What You Will Do

  • Translate product and business requirements into scalable designs and high-quality, maintainable code.

  • Design, build, test, and deploy full-stack applications (UI, backend services, APIs, and integrations).

  • Develop scalable, resilient systems powering customer service experiences across web and internal platforms.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Design, Data, and Platform teams to deliver end-to-end solutions.

  • Build reusable, flexible components and systems that support rapid iteration and long-term velocity.

  • Improve developer productivity through tooling, shared libraries, and efficient CI/CD practices.

  • Ensure system quality through testing, observability, monitoring, and incident response best practices.

  • Contribute to architecture, participate in design and code reviews, and influence technical decisions.

  • Mentor and support junior engineers through code reviews, design guidance, and knowledge sharing.

  • Identify system gaps, propose pragmatic solutions, and contribute to the engineering roadmap.

  • Support production systems, including debugging, incident response, and on-call rotation for a 24/7 platform.

  • Actively participate in Agile ceremonies (scrum, planning, estimation, retrospectives).


What You Will Bring

  • 8+ years of software development experience with strong fundamentals (OOP, data structures, algorithms, design patterns).

  • Proven experience building and delivering full-stack applications in high-scale, Agile/DevOps environments.

  • Strong proficiency in TypeScript, Node.js, and React for building modern, performant web applications.

  • Solid experience developing REST and/or GraphQL APIs.

  • Strong expertise in Java (Java 17+), Spring Framework, and Spring Boot for enterprise application development.

  • Experience with test-driven development and modern testing tools (JUnit, Mockito, WireMock, UI/API testing).

  • Deep understanding of microservices, distributed systems, and event-driven architectures (Kafka, JMS, MQ, etc.).

  • Experience with relational and NoSQL databases, including data modeling and access patterns.

  • Knowledge of cloud-native architectures and modern infrastructure practices.

  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines and tools like Git and Jira.

  • Strong debugging skills across complex distributed systems and full SDLC ownership.

  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools to improve productivity and code quality.

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence diverse stakeholders.

  • Self-driven, detail-oriented, and able to perform in fast-paced, high-pressure environments.

  • Commitment to engineering excellence, continuous learning, and knowledge sharing.

Additional Details

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.

 

We use cookies to enhance your experience and may use AI tools for administrative tasks in the hiring process. To learn how we handle your personal data and use AI responsibly, please visit our Talent Privacy Notice, Privacy Center, and AI Hiring Guidelines.

Cloud Data Technologies (CDT) team at eBay is responsible for all the data infrastructure and management of end-to-end data lifecycle for all eBay data from onsite to analytics use cases.

  • Full-stack development skills including data manipulation

  • Frontend - React, HTML/CSS

  • Backend - Java, TypeScript

  • Experience on designing large-scale distributed systems:  ReactJS based UI and Java based backend

  • Ability to independently deliver complex projects from requirements to production.

  • Strong communication skills to influence cross-team technical outcomes.

At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

As a Senior Software Development Manager in the Customer Support Technology team, you will lead critical engineering initiatives that power eBay’s global customer service experience. You will drive the design, development, and operational excellence of systems that enable efficient, intelligent, and personalized support across both digital self-service and especially in agent-assisted channels.

This position is based in Bengaluru, India and will require active collaboration with global teams across North America, Europe, and APAC. Success requires a readiness to work across time zones and occasionally modify working hours to align with customers from different regions.

You’ll lead the creation and integration of scalable platforms that improve customer outcomes and support agent productivity—while developing a world-class engineering team focused on innovation, reliability, and measurable impact.

It is expected that the candidate will have solid understanding of computer science fundamentals, especially on SDLC in distributed applications. It’s essential that you will have strong software development experiences with SOA, SOAP web services, Restful APIs, and messaging solutions. This position would be a best fit for someone who has been a technical lead in the past in the development of complex distributed systems. You are expected to be self-motivated, produce high quality work and have strong communication skills in addition to being comfortable working in a matrix-ed environment, collaborating across globally distributed teams.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead the design, development, and end-to-end ownership of scalable APIs, internal frameworks, batch processing programs, and email systems that power customer support actions, automate workflows, enable case resolution, and deliver personalized, timely, and compliant customer communications.

  • Build, manage, and scale a high-performing, globally distributed engineering team, fostering a culture of technical excellence, collaboration, inclusion, and continuous learning.

  • Provide strong technical and people leadership, guiding system architecture, implementation, and career development for team members.

  • Drive seamless integration with world-class customer support platforms and tools, enabling robust workflows and extending internal capabilities with best-in-class SaaS solutions.

  • Champion the adoption of AI and intelligent tooling to enhance developer productivity, improve code quality, and automate testing, monitoring, and deployment processes.

  • Lead Agile software development practices, driving iteration, velocity, and alignment with evolving business goals.

  • Establish and evolve DevOps practices, including CI/CD automation, observability, reliability engineering, and infrastructure management.

  • Work closely with customers across Product, Design, Support Operations, and Infrastructure to align engineering priorities with strategic customer support objectives.

  • Ensure all systems are secure, resilient, and scalable, with proactive monitoring, incident management, and high availability.

  • Influence the long-term technical vision and roadmap for customer support technologies, contributing to platform strategy and innovation.

What will you bring?

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, with a minimum of 12 years of software development experience, including 6 years in engineering leadership and team management. Equivalent experience accepted.

  • A proven track record of building and scaling world-class engineering teams, with a strong emphasis on attracting top talent, mentorship, team engagement, and technical excellence.

  • Demonstrated success in leading globally distributed, high-impact teams that deliver complex backend systems and integrations.

  • Deep experience with enterprise-scale customer support tools and platforms

  • Technical expertise in Java, Python, Spring Boot, distributed systems architecture, data processing, and messaging technologies such as Kafka and Flink.

  • Strong hands-on experience with Agile methodologies and DevOps, including CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), infrastructure as code, and monitoring systems.

  • Passion for incorporating AI-assisted development tools and frameworks to accelerate delivery, ensure code quality, and optimize engineering workflows.

  • Strong critical thinking and effective communication skills, with the ability to influence collaborators, coordinate cross-functional teams, and translate business needs into scalable solutions.

  • A customer-focused approach, driven by the goal of transforming support experiences through technology that is fast, reliable, and human-centered.

  • Willingness to collaborate across global time zones, with flexibility to adjust working hours as needed to support cross-regional communication and decision-making.

Additional Details

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. description_text:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

Are you a skilled Java engineer with a passion for building platforms that empower other developers? The eBay Infrastructure Engineering team is looking for a Senior Platform Engineer to join our Bangalore team.

In this role, you'll be a core part of the Frameworks team, which is responsible for the Java frameworks that power all of eBay's site-facing REST, GraphQL, and Batch traffic. You'll work on Raptor.io, eBay’s Spring Boot-based Java Developer Platform. Your "customers" will be your fellow eBay developers, and you'll play a critical role in their success.

You'll collaborate closely with your US-based counterparts to deliver on the product roadmap and enhance our developer platforms.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Platform Development & Maintenance: Build, maintain, and improve our Spring Boot framework, ensuring it's robust and scalable for thousands of internal applications.

  • AI Powered Tooling: Identify problems and develop AI powered solutions to platform engineering problems

  • Build & Deployment Automation: Design and maintain CI/CD pipelines using tools like Jenkins and Tekton to ensure fast, reliable, and automated software builds and deployments.

  • Release Management: Coordinate software releases across multiple teams, managing dependencies and aligning with the product roadmap.

  • Docker & Containerization: Build and maintain optimized Docker images, run automated vulnerability scans, and manage our image repositories and registries.

  • Infrastructure Management: Set up and maintain our development, staging, and production environments, and monitor system performance to ensure stability.

  • Security & Compliance: Ensure the platform is secure by regularly patching images, handling sensitive data properly, and maintaining audit logs.

  • Documentation & Collaboration: Create documentation, best practices, and guides for developers while collaborating with QA and operations teams.

Required Skills and Experience

  • 3-5 years of professional experience in Java development 

  • Strong expertise in Maven and Spring Boot.

  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins and Tekton.

  • Strong knowledge of containerization technologies, including Docker and Kubernetes.

  • Experience with version control systems like Git and branching strategies.

  • A collaborative mindset with a desire to work with cross-functional teams.

If you're passionate about platform engineering and eager to contribute to the tools used by eBay's software engineers, we'd love to hear from you.

Please see the Talent Privacy Notice for information regarding how eBay handles your personal data collected when you use the eBay Careers website or apply for a job with eBay.

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

 

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

About the team and the role: 

We’re looking for a Product Manager for Assisted Services, with a specific focus on Financial Services, Risk & Trust. This role will be essential in crafting the future of how eBay’s customer support ecosystem ensures accuracy, efficiency and ease of use while mitigating risk exposure. You’ll define and deliver AI-powered flows that help our teammates navigate complex Financial Services and Risk related information—so they can focus on what matters most: crafting trust and delight in every interaction.

This role reports into the Global Customer Experience Product organization and works closely with engineering, data science, design, legal, and operations teams across the globe.

Our vision is a future where teammates are liberated from concerns about the tools they use, allowing them to focus entirely on building strong customer relationships and delivering outstanding support. This role will be central to that mission, focusing on the products that directly enable teammate success, ultimately driving improved Customer Experience (CX) ease.


 

What you will accomplish: 

  • Build intuitive user experiences and backend workflows that minimize friction and cognitive burden, helping our teammates stay focused and our operations stay efficient.

  • Define product requirements including writing clear, detailed, and thorough specifications for complex features and products

  • Translate insights into action by using analytics, teammate feedback, and customer data to find opportunities and improve product performance.

  • Analyze user behavior data, user experience research, and marketing research to understand and drive new features & improvements

  • Work with the Design team to ensure the user interface leverages industry and eBay standards, and fits into the overall product vision of the item details page

  • Work with the Product Development team to ensure extensibility and scalability with the technical design

  • Collaborate across disciplines—partner with Engineering, Legal, Risk, Operations, Trust, and Policy—to define roadmaps, shape data-driven decisions, and drive measurable outcomes.

What you will bring: 

  • Experience: 3+ years of product management or related experience. Background or strong interest in financial services, risk management, or customer experience platforms is a plus.

  • Analytical Skills: A solid understanding of data-driven decision-making and an analytical approach to problem-solving.

  • AI/ML Literacy: Familiarity with foundational Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning concepts, and an eagerness to support the integration of AI-driven features to solve customer problems and improve workflows.

  • Technical Familiarity: Exposure to or experience working with products that integrate across multiple systems (e.g., APIs, cloud services, internal enterprise tools).

  • Communication: Strong communication skills with the proven ability to collaborate effectively across different disciplines and explain product requirements clearly.

  • User-Centric Mindset: An understanding of how to embed necessary policy and risk controls into product design without sacrificing a seamless user experience.

  • Alignment & Execution: Detail-oriented with the ability to articulate product features, write clear requirements, and align with broader team goals.

Additional Details

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.

 

We use cookies to enhance your experience and may use AI tools for administrative tasks in the hiring process. To learn how we handle your personal data and use AI responsibly, please visit our Talent Privacy Notice, Privacy Center, and AI Hiring Guidelines.

description_text:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

About the Team and Role

eBay's Site Network Engineering team designs and engineers the production fabrics connecting eBay's server fleet across data centers, POPs, and other properties. We run 100% SONiC-based open networking in production across six switch vendor families on multiple merchant silicon families. Zero availability-impacting fabric incidents every year since the SONiC transition began.

You will establish SONiC platform engineering as an in-house function — this is a greenfield mandate, not a backfill. You own the full stack from ASIC layer through production deployment, with direct influence on architecture, release quality, and vendor strategy. A near-term goal is converging to a single SONiC release across all six vendor families; this role is central to that.

What You'll Do

  • Drive end-to-end platform enablement for new switch hardware (transceivers/CMIS, optics qualification and tuning, thermal/PSU/fan/watchdog/sensors, EEPROM, LED/CPLD/FPGA as required).

  • Lead ASIC SDK + SAI integration: vendor SDK integration/customization, SAI behavior tuning/modeling, syncd adaptations, dataplane correctness, performance, and stability.

  • Design production reliability across the stack: warm/fast reboot correctness, upgrade safety, and high availability under load (hitless patterns where applicable).

  • Debug and resolve complex issues across kernel/drivers → SDK/firmware → SONiC services (SWSS/orchagent, Redis DBs, containers), with strong bias for reproducibility and root-cause closure.

  • Deliver features on real hardware and meet scale/performance targets (buffers/QoS/queues/counters/telemetry, link/port behaviour, failure handling).

  • Define and operationalize release processes: gating, rollback strategy, known-issue management, and production-readiness standards.

  • Serve as key technical interface with ASIC vendors and ODMs, driving escalations and influencing outcomes.

  • Build CI/CD pipelines, automated testing (PTF, SpyTest or equivalent), hardware-in-the-loop validation, and regression coverage.

  • Contribute to upstream SONiC when appropriate and define a responsible fork/upstream strategy.

  • Mentor peers and contribute to team growth as we scale (people management not required).

What Success Looks Like (First 6–12 Months)

  • Enable or materially stabilize at least one ASIC/platform family with measurable improvements (reboot reliability, crash rate, performance baselines, scale targets).

  • Deliver a repeatable ASIC SDK integration + qualification pipeline.

  • Establish foundational processes (testing, CI/CD, release discipline, vendor engagement) so the capability scales smoothly.

Must-Have Qualifications

  • Production experience programming switching ASICs via vendor SDKs and/or SAI — including integration, behavioural tuning, and performance/stability troubleshooting.

  • Working knowledge of SONiC internals or equivalent NOS (SAI/syncd, SWSS/orchagent, Redis DBs, container model) with ability to ramp quickly.

  • Ability to lead ambiguous technical initiatives and drive cross-functional delivery across sites/time zones.

Strong Differentiators

  • Track record partnering with merchant silicon vendors, including escalation management and influencing outcomes.

  • Direct upstream contributions to SONiC, SAI, FRR, or Linux kernel networking.

  • Deep SAI behavioural expertise (ACL, QoS, buffers, ECMP, counters, telemetry).

  • Optics qualification, tuning, and vendor-specific behaviour across transceiver families.

Additional Details

title: Consultant, Client Success
description_html:
About Us
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Job Description

The Consultant, Client Success is an individual contributor responsible for owning the holistic post-sale Client Services operational relationship for applicable clients and providing operational support and assistance in growing clients’ business. The Consultant is a trusted client advocate and works proactively with their client portfolio to enable new capabilities, manage geographic expansion, and promote product adoption.


This role is an exciting opportunity to be at the forefront of Visa’s Client Success transformation by partnering closely with key Visa clients to maximize their benefits realization and value from Visa products through optimizing their performance. Working in conjunction with Account Team members from Sales and Product, you will proactively drive Client Success outcomes in alignment with Visa’s business agenda as detailed in the Sales Account Plan. The individual will also define and deploy client support and service implementation strategies, including automated tools and capabilities to enhance the client experience, that drive value for our clients and support Visa’s strategy.


All roles require digital fluency, including the ability to work with emerging technologies such as Generative AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot) to support everyday work.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Oversee the implementation of new Visa products the Client purchases by coordinating key Client and Visa teams to expedite implementation readiness activities and steer the client toward faster time to value and maximize adoption of deployed products.
  • Ensure Client operational goals and success metrics for their overall Visa product landscape are understood.
  • Build and sustain a trusted client advocate status with key client stakeholders by proactively executing against forward looking Client Success Plans, in alignment with the Account Team, to track client specific outcomes including a client’s adoption and performance of Visa products purchased.
  • Drive and deliver initiatives to improve client adoption of products and use of Visa’s self-service tools.
  • Stay current with the latest payment processing trends, Visa solutions and technologies to provide a great Client experience and generate new sales leads as solutions to identified client pain points.
  • Establish working relationships with Client Services and other cross-functional subject matter experts to orchestrate consultation to resolve complex client issues and optimize client performance.
  • Develop client education and training materials (including webinars) to communicate new Visa Rules, essential mandates, Visa Business Enhancement Releases and/or upcoming changes to ensure client readiness and service compliance.
  • Lead periodic operational reviews with clients and Visa stakeholders.
  • Act, on an ad-hoc and as needed basis for applicable clients, as the escalation point for managing significant issues and major incident/crisis responses.
  • Proactively identify and drive opportunities to optimize client performance by monitoring client health and liaising with specialist Visa teams as needed.

This is a remote position. A remote position does not require job duties be performed within proximity of a Visa office location. Remote positions may be required to be present at a Visa office with scheduled notice.#LI-Remote

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:

  • 5 or more years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or at least 2 years of work experience with an Advanced degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 0 years of work experience with a PhD


Preferred Qualifications:

  • 6 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or 4 or more years of relevant experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or up to 3 years of relevant experience with a PhD
  • Be based in Sao Paulo
  • Upper Intermediate English Level
  • Experience analyzing data and translating findings into actionable business recommendations.
  • Experience in using standard Microsoft Office tools (e.g., Excel, PowerPoint, Word).
  • Experience in representing technical and/or business issues and solutions to influence audiences at multiple levels of an organization.
  • Experience in communicating complex technical terms and/or processes in business language tailored to client.
  • Experience in building client relationships and creating trust-based relations.
  • Experience in success planning and building measurable action plans to help clients achieve their business goals.
  • Experience in client engagement and communicating clearly and effectively with clients.
  • Experience in prioritizing and multi-tasking under deadlines.
  • Experience in monitoring client health and liaising with specialist teams as needed.
  • Knowledge of the payment industry (i.e., trends, threats, competitors, regulatory environments).
  • Certifications or qualifications in Client/Customer Success, project management or related areas of practice and expertise.
  • Experience in becoming customer centric by listening to and prioritizing customer needs to drive value realization and build trusted partnerships.
  • Experience in proactiveness by thinking ahead and taking action.
  • Experience in critical thinking by taking ownership over problems and finding creative solutions to complex problems.
  • Experience in supporting development of client education and training materials (including webinars) to communicate new Visa Rules, essential mandates, Visa Business Enhancement Releases and/or upcoming changes to ensure client readiness and service compliance.

Visa is an EEO Employer

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

title: Sr. Product Manager – Payment Rails LAC
description_html:
About Us
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Job Description

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and execute the product strategy for Payment Rails in Brazil, Latin America and globally, leading the mapping and integrations for the evolution of the Pismo Core Banking platform to support multiple use cases in the region, mainly those focused on PIX, Bre-B, CoDi and other payment systems, domestically and internationally. 
  • Support the development of the expansion strategy for countries and regions that are part of our global expansion plan; 
  • Support Pismo teams and the partnership team in finding the most suitable partners and providers for the products to be enabled, ensuring efficient integrations with payment and financial services providers. 
  • Ensure evolution of products and features, supporting current and new clients, as well as monitoring industry standards, market trends and tech innovations. Mapping needs, insights and feedback from our clients, prospects and market. 
  • As Product Manager, together with other Payment Rails Product Managers, support the squad's product vision, developing the product roadmap, aiming the delivery of value to clients (current and future) and to Pismo Strategy; 
  • Evaluate and discuss, together with engineering and business areas, potential approaches for implementing the product roadmap: build, partner, buy. 
  • Structuring and improving product solutions throughout their entire life cycle, from their conception to the evolution of the service, from a technical and business perspective. 
  • Manage and prioritize the product backlog, together with other Payment Rails Product Managers, using appropriate criteria for recommendations and decisions about priorities and team allocation in developments. 
  • Work together with engineering, discuss products and prioritization, based on agile methods to deliver value in a continuous and increasing way. 
  • Cooperate and work together with other teams to develop “cross squad” solutions with dependencies and greater scale. 
  • Work closely with the sales and pre-sales teams to understand customer requirements. Assist in product demonstrations, presentations, and RFP responses during pre-sales engagements 
  • Ensure product scalability, including non-functional aspects such as integrity, resilience and scalability; together with the engineering team 

This is a remote position. A remote position does not require job duties be performed within proximity of a Visa office location. Remote positions may be required to be present at a Visa office with scheduled notice. #LI-Remote

Qualifications

  • Advanced English

  • 4+ years of experience in product management, with solid background in discovery and delivery within complex and scalable environments

  • Proven experience managing financial and payment products, especially in Real-Time and Instant Payments in Brazil

  • Strong understanding of end-to-end payment flows (cash-in/cash-out), including settlement, reconciliation, and transaction processing from both technical and financial perspectives

  • Experience in B2B financial services and banking, with a solid understanding of business dynamics and offered services

  • Strong knowledge of payment rails integrations, including domestic and international systems, with emphasis on LAC payment systems and market regulations

  • Experience monitoring regulatory requirements and market rules, ensuring compliance and prioritization of platform/service adjustments

  • Technical experience with: APIs and microservices architecture in cloud environments, Platform products (backend-focused) and integrations with internal and external systems, solution architecture in distributed/multi-domain environments, cloud computing environments

  • Hands-on product management experience, including: Writing specifications and user stories, managing product ceremonies, producing clear documentation for internal and external stakeholders

  • Experience with project management tools such as JIRA and Confluence

  • Strong strategic thinking, using benchmarking, insights, and feedback to define product evolution. improve services and drive client growth and profitability

  • Be based in Brazil
     

Desirable Qualifications

  • Familiarity with API testing tools such as Postman or Insomnia

  • Knowledge of cloud platforms such as AWS

  • Knowledge of various payment methods, including: Card networks
    Real-time and instant payments, Emerging models (e.g., on-us transactions)

  • Understanding of financial markets across different countries and regions in LAC

  • Intermediate to advanced Spanish

Visa is an EEO Employer

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

title: Sr. Engineering  Manager, PCI ISO
description_html:
About Us
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Job Description

The Sr. Manager; Software Engineering leads a team responsible for reviewing business requirements and developing functional and technical design documentation. This role oversees the design and implementation of testing procedures for APIs, abstractions, and integration patterns to address distributed computing challenges, including end-to-end and integration testing. The Sr. Manager participates in design reviews, providing input on requirements, product designs, schedules, and potential issues, and works across the team to ensure productivity, predictability, and delivery of high-quality results. 

The position includes accountability for code review and the team’s development and testing activities, as well as participation in proof of concepts and technical evaluations of new technologies. The Sr. Manager is expected to foster a collaborative environment, ensuring the team meets business needs and delivers robust solutions. 

All roles require digital fluency, including the ability to work with emerging technologies such as Generative AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot) to support everyday work. 

What You'll Do:

  • Lead, hire, and develop a high-performing engineering team through regular 1:1s, continuous feedback, and talent development initiatives, ensuring a collaborative and inclusive environment. 

  • Drive the team’s delivery of scalable, reliable, and secure services, ensuring alignment with business goals, engineering standards, and long-term platform evolution. 

  • Oversee the execution of the software development lifecycle, including technical planning, system design, implementation, testing, deployment, and production support. 

  • Ensure high engineering quality by enforcing best practices related to code quality, test coverage, performance, resilience, security, and scalability. 

  • Guide the team in designing and implementing distributed systems, APIs, and integration patterns to solve complex distributed computing challenges. 

  • Review and contribute to functional and technical design documentation, providing feedback on requirements, product design, timelines, and risks. 

  • Support the team in troubleshooting and resolving complex technical issues, acting as a key escalation point when needed. 

  • Promote strong testing practices, including unit, integration, and end-to-end testing strategies for robust and reliable systems. 

  • Ensure monitoring of services in production environments, maintaining compliance with SLOs and SLAs, and driving operational excellence. 

  • Lead incident management processes, including on-call rotations, ensuring high-quality incident response and customer experience. 

  • Identify and mitigate technical risks, including performance, reliability, and technical debt challenges. 

  • Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to translate business needs into effective technical solutions. 

  • Support strategic decision-making by contributing to prioritization of features, technical initiatives, and architectural improvements. 

  • Drive productivity, predictability, and high-quality delivery across the team, ensuring alignment with OKRs and organizational goals. 

  • Actively participate in architectural and technical discussions, contributing to innovation, scalability, and continuous improvement. 

  • Communicate effectively with global teams, leadership, and both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 

  • Leverage emerging technologies, including Generative AI tools, to improve engineering efficiency, productivity, and decision-making. 

  • Act autonomously in complex, high-impact scenarios, providing leadership during critical situations, conflicts, and crises. 

  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and technical excellence within the team. 

  • Be recognized as a technical and people leader, delivering impactful solutions and enabling team success.

This is a remote position. A remote position does not require job duties be performed within proximity of a Visa office location. Remote positions may be required to be present at a Visa office with scheduled notice.

#LI‑Remote

Qualifications

For this role, you must be based in Brazil 

Language Skills 

Proficiency in English at B2 level or above (Upper-Intermediate)

Basic Qualifications:

  • 8+ years of relevant work experience and a Bachelors degree, OR 11+ years of relevant work experience. 

  • Experience with Financial Industry or Payments / Authorization Systems  

  • Experience with Cards Issuing solutions (Mastercard, Visa, etc)  

  • Experience with ISO8583 messaging system 

Technical Skills 

  • Strong experience leading software engineering teams in production environments. 

  • Experience reviewing business requirements and developing functional and technical design documentation. 

  • Solid experience designing and operating distributed systems, APIs, and microservices architectures in cloud environments. 

  • Proven ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues in distributed systems. 

  • Experience implementing testing strategies, including unit, integration, and end-to-end testing. 

  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and cloud-native architectures. 

  • Understanding of CI/CD pipelines, observability (monitoring, logging, tracing), and modern engineering practices. 

  • Experience ensuring high standards of code quality, performance, scalability, and system reliability. 

  • Ability to contribute to architectural decisions and guide teams in system design and evolution. 

  • Strong collaboration skills to work with cross-functional stakeholders and international teams.

Preferred Qualifications 

  • Extensive experience in people management, including hiring, coaching, and performance management. 

  • Experience working with critical or mission-critical systems in high-availability environments. 

  • Experience with distributed computing challenges and large-scale systems. 

  • Familiarity with cloud-native infrastructure, CI/CD, and observability practices. 

  • Experience integrating emerging technologies, including Generative AI tools, into engineering workflows. 

  • Strong background in Agile methodologies and engineering management best practices. 

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders. 

Visa is an EEO Employer

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.
