title: Senior Account Executive
description_html:
About Us
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Job Description

The Account Executive is responsible for the commercial relationship with both existing customers and prospects and sells our cloud-based platform to a diverse set of accounts.

As an Account Executive at Pismo sales team, you will formulate and execute a sales strategy within an assigned territory and drive customer satisfaction together with revenue growth.

Guard our core values of total trust, minimum friction experience, state of the art technology and challenge the status quo.

Identify and develop business opportunities with both existing customers and prospects.

Articulate Pismo's platform differentiators through presentations to key stakeholders (including C-level), create winning proposals and lead deal negotiations.

Establish and nurture relationships with key stakeholders in customers and prospects, understanding expected business outcomes and ensuring their long-term success.

Pismo is a next-generation tech platform for banking and payments and fluency in some technology-related matters (public cloud, microservices, APIs, etc.) is a requirement.

Previous experience working with some of the largest financial institutions in the region or selling core banking and payments cards solutions will be evaluated as differentiators during the hiring process.

This is a remote position. A remote position does not require job duties be performed within proximity of a Visa office location. Remote positions may be required to be present at a Visa office with scheduled notice.  #LI-Remote

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:

2 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD, or PhD)

Preferred Qualifications:

3 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or more than 2 years of work experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD)

Manage complex sales-cycles with sense of urgency and disciplined use of CRM tools

Experience with New Revenue in the covered territory, Pipeline growth and Customer satisfaction

Experience with Technical Sales

Have been worked in a card processor company

Have been worked in a hunter position or something like

Have been experience with clients relationship

Intermediate English
Be based in Sao Paulo, SP

Visa is an EEO Employer

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

title: Sr. Engineering Manager, Cards
description_html:
About Us
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Job Description

The Sr. Manager; Software Engineering leads a team responsible for reviewing business requirements and developing functional and technical design documentation. This role oversees the design and implementation of testing procedures for APIs, abstractions, and integration patterns to address distributed computing challenges, including end-to-end and integration testing. The Sr. Manager participates in design reviews, providing input on requirements, product designs, schedules, and potential issues, and works across the team to ensure productivity, predictability, and delivery of high-quality results. 

The position includes accountability for code review and the team’s development and testing activities, as well as participation in proof of concepts and technical evaluations of new technologies. The Sr. Manager is expected to foster a collaborative environment, ensuring the team meets business needs and delivers robust solutions. 

All roles require digital fluency, including the ability to work with emerging technologies such as Generative AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot) to support everyday work. 

What You'll Do?

  • Lead, hire, and develop a high-performing engineering team through regular 1:1s, continuous feedback, and talent development initiatives, ensuring a collaborative and inclusive environment. 

  • Drive the team’s delivery of scalable, reliable, and secure services, ensuring alignment with business goals, engineering standards, and long-term platform evolution. 

  • Oversee the execution of the software development lifecycle, including technical planning, system design, implementation, testing, deployment, and production support. 

  • Ensure high engineering quality by enforcing best practices related to code quality, test coverage, performance, resilience, security, and scalability. 

  • Guide the team in designing and implementing distributed systems, APIs, and integration patterns to solve complex distributed computing challenges. 

  • Review and contribute to functional and technical design documentation, providing feedback on requirements, product design, timelines, and risks. 

  • Support the team in troubleshooting and resolving complex technical issues, acting as a key escalation point when needed. 

  • Promote strong testing practices, including unit, integration, and end-to-end testing strategies for robust and reliable systems. 

  • Ensure monitoring of services in production environments, maintaining compliance with SLOs and SLAs, and driving operational excellence. 

  • Lead incident management processes, including on-call rotations, ensuring high-quality incident response and customer experience. 

  • Identify and mitigate technical risks, including performance, reliability, and technical debt challenges. 

  • Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to translate business needs into effective technical solutions. 

  • Support strategic decision-making by contributing to prioritization of features, technical initiatives, and architectural improvements. 

  • Drive productivity, predictability, and high-quality delivery across the team, ensuring alignment with OKRs and organizational goals. 

  • Actively participate in architectural and technical discussions, contributing to innovation, scalability, and continuous improvement. 

  • Communicate effectively with global teams, leadership, and both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 

  • Leverage emerging technologies, including Generative AI tools, to improve engineering efficiency, productivity, and decision-making. 

  • Act autonomously in complex, high-impact scenarios, providing leadership during critical situations, conflicts, and crises. 

  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and technical excellence within the team. 

  • Be recognized as a technical and people leader, delivering impactful solutions and enabling team success.

This is a remote position. A remote position does not require job duties be performed within proximity of a Visa office location. Remote positions may be required to be present at a Visa office with scheduled notice.
#LI‑Remote

Qualifications

For this role, you must be based in Brazil 

Language Skills 

Proficiency in English at B2 level or above (Upper-Intermediate)

Basic Qualifications:

  • 8+ years of relevant work experience and a Bachelors degree, OR 11+ years of relevant work experience. 

  • Experience with Financial Industry or Payments / Authorization Systems  

  • Experience with Cards Issuing solutions (Mastercard, Visa, etc)  

  • Experience with ISO8583 messaging system 

Technical Skills 

  • Strong experience leading software engineering teams in production environments. 

  • Experience reviewing business requirements and developing functional and technical design documentation. 

  • Solid experience designing and operating distributed systems, APIs, and microservices architectures in cloud environments. 

  • Proven ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues in distributed systems. 

  • Experience implementing testing strategies, including unit, integration, and end-to-end testing. 

  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and cloud-native architectures. 

  • Understanding of CI/CD pipelines, observability (monitoring, logging, tracing), and modern engineering practices. 

  • Experience ensuring high standards of code quality, performance, scalability, and system reliability. 

  • Ability to contribute to architectural decisions and guide teams in system design and evolution. 

  • Strong collaboration skills to work with cross-functional stakeholders and international teams.

Preferred Qualifications 

  • Extensive experience in people management, including hiring, coaching, and performance management. 

  • Experience working with critical or mission-critical systems in high-availability environments. 

  • Experience with distributed computing challenges and large-scale systems. 

  • Familiarity with cloud-native infrastructure, CI/CD, and observability practices. 

  • Experience integrating emerging technologies, including Generative AI tools, into engineering workflows. 

  • Strong background in Agile methodologies and engineering management best practices. 

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders. 

Visa is an EEO Employer

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

title: Consulting Director (Credit Card Migration)
description_html:
About Us
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Job Description

A Consulting Director – Migration Practice leads Visa’s regional consulting capability for complex credit card migrations, sitting between clients, Visa’s product/technology teams and third‑party partners to make large, high‑risk moves work end‑to‑end.

They define and continuously refine Visa’s migration proposition and playbooks (value case, methodology, tools), shape and support key deals with issuers, and then provide solution leadership through design, troubleshooting and resourcing models on live programs.

The role manages a small core team plus virtual project and vendor teams across markets, ensures migrations are network‑sound, customer‑safe and compliant, and turns lessons from individual projects into repeatable best practices that scale across Asia Pacific

Practice Ownership, Proposition & Thought Leadership

  • Define and own Visa’s credit card migration consulting proposition in Asia Pacific (scope, use cases, differentiators, target client profiles).
  • Develop and maintain standard migration playbooks and toolkits (portfolio diagnostics, migration wave design, customer impact and risk assessment tools).
  • Articulate and regularly refresh the economic and strategic value case for card migrations (platform consolidation, network changes, product migration, digital enablement).
  • Partner with Market teams to embed migration as a strategic lever in account plans and joint business plans.

Business Development & Deal Shaping

  • Support origination of migration engagements, from early opportunity identification to signed SOW (pipeline reviews, co‑creation sessions, solution workshops).
  • Shape proposals, RFP responses and commercial constructs (scope, phasing, staffing, pricing recommendations) for migration projects.
  • Present and defend migration recommendations and proposals to C‑level and functional leaders at clients.

Solution Design, Troubleshooting, Resourcing Model & Delivery Oversight

  • Provide solution leadership on migrations: define high‑level target state and migration approach considering card/network rules, issuer platform constraints and regulatory requirements.
  • For engagements, develop Migration strategy (partnering with VCA Migration Tech) and lead non-Tech elements of migration (Segmentation, Comms, Product Mapping, Operational Resilience, etc)
  • Ensure migration strategies appropriately consider: BIN/portfolio structures, Processor and card management system capabilities, Authorization and clearing behaviour, Tokenisation/wallet enablement, Disputes/chargebacks and servicing implications.
  • Act as an escalation and troubleshooting point for complex issues during design and execution, working with Visa VCA Migration Tech, Product teams, Client IT/ops and external vendors to resolve roadblocks.

Project Resourcing

  • Design resourcing models for large migration projects that combine Visa consultants with third‑party resources (consultancies & contractors).
  • Manage the selection, onboarding and governance of third‑party delivery partners where Visa leads or co‑leads the migration (SoW, role clarity, performance measures).
  • Provide light‑touch program oversight on large engagements (often as sponsor or steering committee member), ensuring timelines, scope and risks are managed, and that Visa’s value is clearly delivered.

People Leadership & Capability Building

  • Lead virtual project teams drawn from Visa functions, as well as third‑party resources.
  • Champion a collaborative, inclusive culture across markets and time zones.

Governance, Risk & Measurement

  • Define standard KPIs and success measures for migration projects (e.g., activation/usage post‑migration, approval/decline metrics, incident rates, complaints/chargebacks, NPS, portfolio economics).
  • Ensure all work complies with Visa network rules, regional regulations and client risk frameworks, escalating issues where necessary.
  • Capture and codify lessons learned from engagements into updated playbooks, case studies and guidance.

Why is this important to VISA:

This role is critical to Visa because large‑scale credit card migrations are some of the most strategically sensitive moves our clients undertake. A strong Migration Practice Director helps issuers navigate processor and platform changes, network decisions, and product migrations in a way that protects end‑customer experience and regulatory compliance while unlocking better economics and modern capabilities tied to Visa’s network. By providing a repeatable methodology, credible solution leadership, and orchestration of third‑party partners, this role reduces execution risk for clients, differentiates Visa versus other networks and processors, and converts migration moments into deeper, long‑term partnership and growth opportunities across Asia Pacific.

This is a hybrid position. Expectation of days in the office will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:

  • 15 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or at least 8 years of work experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters/ MBA/JD/MD) or at least 3 years of work experience with a PhD

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 15 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or 8-10 years of experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 6+ years of work experience with a PhD
  • What you will need:
  • Experience: Minimum 12 years of relevant experience with a Bachelor’s degree
  • Track record of leading Card migrations
  • Outstanding problem-solving skills, with demonstrated ability to think creatively and strategically
  • Excellent communication skills plus the maturity and capability to interact and influence across multiple levels and organizations internal and external to Visa
  • Strong understanding of card network and issuing value chains, including BIN structures, authorization, clearing & settlement, disputes, tokenization and digital wallets.
  • Practical knowledge of issuer processing platforms and card management systems and their implications for migration.
  • Ability to see the challenges from an issuer perspective and develop an integrated migration strategy (partnering with VCA Migration Tech) – including customer comms, product mapping, segmentation to meet those challenges.
  • Ability to translate technical/operational trade‑offs into business and customer impact for executives.
  • Strong vendor and third‑party management skills.
  • High stakeholder management and influencing capability across clients, Visa teams and partners.
  • Calm, structured and solutions‑oriented under pressure when troubleshooting issues.

Visa is an EEO Employer

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

title: Client Consulting Manager
description_html:
About Us
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Job Description

Purpose

  • Primary focus: Support and execute portfolio strategy to drive acquisition, activation, engagement, and incremental spend across credit and debit card portfolios.
  • Core expertise: Cards portfolio optimization strategy, customer lifecycle management (CLM), and campaign management (design, targeting), with strong familiarity with payments industry rules and card-network/regulatory guidelines.

Responsibilities

  • Portfolio Strategy and Performance
    • Develop and refine end-to-end strategies to improve KPIs: acquisition, activation, usage, spend per active, retention, cross-/up-sell, attrition reduction, credit losses, and ROI.
    • Diagnose performance drivers and recommend segment-level interventions by lifecycle stage.
  • Customer Lifecycle Management
    • Design journeys for onboarding, early engagement, habituation, maturation, retention/win-back; define treatments and test plans (A/B and multivariate).
    • Identify friction points and opportunities to accelerate first-use, repeat use, and long-term engagement across digital and partner/merchant channels.
  • Campaign Strategy, Design, and Execution
    • Translate portfolio objectives into campaign strategies: offer constructs, eligibility, targeting rules, suppression logic, and measurement frameworks.
  • Insights, Analytics, and Forecasting
    • Support analytics to size opportunities and forecast impact (propensity, uplift, CLV, attrition, spend elasticities); drive a disciplined test‑and‑learn roadmap.
    • Prepare clear documentation and executive‑ready presentations communicating findings and recommendations to senior stakeholders.
  • Thought Leadership and Team Contribution
    • Monitor market trends (rewards, interchange, merchant offers, embedded finance, tokenization, BNPL, digital wallets) and recommend portfolio interventions.

Qualifications

Requirements

  • Experience: 
    • 6–8 years in cards/payments, banking, or consulting with hands‑on ownership of cards portfolio optimization, lifecycle programs, and campaign management.
    • Experience with offer optimization, rewards strategy, merchant‑funded offers, and partnerships.
    • Familiarity with credit risk fundamentals (underwriting policy, line management) and their interaction with spend growth strategies.
  • Functional expertise:
    • Deep understanding of credit/debit card economics (interchange, rewards liability, acquisition cost, NPV/CLV, revolve/repay dynamics) and spend drivers.
    • Practical knowledge of industry rules and guidelines (card network operating rules, compliance, data privacy, fair marketing practices) and their impact on strategy and campaigns.
  • Communication & Influence:
    • Excellent written and verbal communication; ability to craft executive‑ready presentations and translate complex analytics into clear business decisions.
    • Proven stakeholder management across product, marketing, compliance, and risk; track record of driving cross‑functional outcomes.
  • Project Delivery:
    • Strong project management; ability to run multiple initiatives, set priorities, and meet deadlines in a fast‑paced environment with disciplined documentation.

Visa is an EEO Employer

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

About Us
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

Job Description

This Staff Software Engineer role is for an individual with excellent software engineering with hands-on development experience and a strong foundation in computer science, full-stack development, and AI/ML technologies. This role involves software initiatives, leveraging modern programming languages, cloud platforms, APIs and Generative AI to deliver scalable, high-quality business solutions. Experience on AWS/GCP and Bigdata stack would be a strong plus.

  • Design, develop, test and deploy scalable full‑stack software solutions with end‑to‑end ownership.
  • Build and enhance front‑end applications using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and SQL, applying strong UI/UX principles.
  • Develop and maintain back‑end services using Python, Java, and related technologies, including API design and integration.
  • Leverage Generative AI (GenAI) to drive innovative solutions, improve productivity, testing, and automation.
  • Responsible for Big Data SRE and engineering activities across big data and cloud environments ensuring high performance, reliability and scalability.
  • Develop products, tools and processes to automate day-to-day task.
  • Collaborate with cross‑functional teams to translate business requirements into efficient technical solutions and tools.
  • Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills.

Qualifications

  • 7-10 years of work experience and a Bachelor's Degree or 5 years of work experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 3 years of experience with a PhD. 1+ year of experience with cloud platforms (AWS/GCP) and/or Big Data technologies (Hadoop, Kafka) is a plus 
  • Expertise in one or more programming languages Python(preferred) or Java
  • Hands-on experience in software engineering with strong coding skills
  • Solid foundation in computer science fundamentals and data structures
  • Proficiency in programming languages such as Python or JAVA and relevant AI libraries such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, etc.
  • Experience with full-stack development platforms, including SQL, VS Code, REST, XML, JSON, APIs
  • Strong experience developing front-end (React,HTML, CSS, JavaScript) and back-end services
  • Hands-on experience designing and consuming APIs
  • Demonstrated use of Generative AI in development and testing workflows
  • Experience with LLMs and frameworks such as LangChain or LangGraph
  • Hands-on experience in machine learning, deep learning or reinforcement learning
  • Working knowledge of Linux fundamentals and system concepts (CPU, memory, storage, networking)
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS/GCP) and/or Big Data technologies (Hadoop, Kafka) is a plus 
  • AWS experience with managed streaming or big-data services such as AWS MSK (Kafka) and/or EMR (preferred), plus cloud fundamentals (networking, IAM/security, observability). 

Visa is an EEO Employer

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

title: Associate Cybersecurity Analyst
description_html:
About Us
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Job Description

This position is for an associate Cybersecurity Analyst in the Applied Cryptography team who will assist in implementation, maintenance, documenting and support of Visa's Encryption Services, Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) and implemented key management systems and Host Security Modules (HSM) support. This opportunity will provide ongoing training and growth for the incumbent who desires to continually learn and improve.

Essential Functions

·        Assist in the maintenance and support of all Enterprise Encryption Services protecting Data at Rest, Data inflight, and Transaction Data.

·         Partner with senior members to evaluate upgrades and new products & technologies for the enterprise encryption solutions.

·         Proactively identify and recommend process improvement to reduce risk and improve operational efficiency and present complex security subjects to internal work groups and projects

·         Document design, installation, and Operations & Maintenance guides

·         Assist in audit and compliance related documentations

·         Assist and maintain internal inventory of assets

·         Implement changes and support end-to-end Visa PKI infrastructure. Deploy, maintain, and troubleshoot systems for PKI and HSM data protection systems in accordance with standard procedures and change control policies and procedures

·         Support Certificate Management requests as per pre-defined set of procedures and within agreed Service Level Agreements (SLA).

·         Resolve problem tickets and assist other staff members as needed

·         Monitor and troubleshoot PKI & HSM infrastructure services for problem and failures, providing support and resolutions.

·         Support Data Encryption Deployment and Applied Cryptography HSM & Key Management teams

·         Provide onsite support of encryption technologies such as general purpose and payment HSMs.

·         Support and facilitate the Global Key Custodian Program, PKI Vetter program

·         Work with the FIPS 140-2 level 2+ certified Hardware Security Modules, Key Management systems

·         Work with multiple database protection functionalities including Native and Transparent Data Encryption as well as operating systems and file systems.

This is a hybrid position. Expectation of days in office will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.


Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications •Bachelor's degree, OR 3+ years of relevant work experience Preferred Qualifications •Bachelor's degree, OR 3+ years of relevant work experience • Be a flexible, self-motivated and results-oriented team player with an attention to meeting tight project timelines and schedules. • The ability to build relationships to collaborate effectively with other functional areas and understand the operational and cultural issues relevant to achieving superior results • Familiar with wide range of key management systems, certificate automation solutions, operating systems, security protocols and native and transparent database protection functionalities. • Cloud security data protection experience • Understanding and experience with the cryptography fundamentals • Authorization to work in the U.S. Our preference is not to sponsor applicants for work visas in connection with this position.

Visa is an EEO Employer

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description_html:
About Us
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Job Description

The Site Reliability Engineer is responsible for supporting the deployment and configuration of monitoring and logging tools, automating routine operational tasks, and maintaining observability tools such as Splunk, ClickHouse, Grafana, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, Fluent Bit, ElasticSearch, OpenSearch, and CloudWatch. This role works closely with team members to implement and maintain monitoring solutions across development, staging, and production environments, and contributes to the setup and maintenance of CI/CD pipelines to support automated build, test, and deployment processes.

The engineer provides support in managing cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure) to ensure availability and security, learns and applies DevOps and SRE best practices, and assists with the implementation and management of containerization technologies like Docker and Kubernetes. Responsibilities include monitoring system performance, identifying and escalating issues, participating in troubleshooting and root cause analysis for production incidents, and creating and updating documentation for infrastructure and operational procedures.

All roles require digital fluency, including the ability to work with emerging technologies such as Generative AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot) to support everyday work.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Support deployment and configuration of monitoring and logging tools.
  • Automate routine operational tasks to improve efficiency and support system integration.
  • Assist with maintenance and management of observability tools (Splunk, ClickHouse, Grafana, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, Fluent Bit, ElasticSearch, OpenSearch, CloudWatch).
  • Implement and maintain monitoring solutions in development, staging, and production environments.
  • Contribute to setup and maintenance of CI/CD pipelines for automated build, test, and deployment.
  • Provide support in managing cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure) for availability and security.
  • Use infrastructure as code tools (Terraform, Ansible, CloudFormation) for environment configuration.
  • Monitor system performance and assist in identifying and escalating issues.
  • Support implementation and management of containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Participate in troubleshooting and root cause analysis for production incidents.
  • Create and update documentation for infrastructure, processes, and operational procedures.
  • Provide first-level support for routine infrastructure and deployment issues, escalating complex problems as needed.
  • Seek opportunities to automate repetitive tasks and suggest workflow improvements.

This is a remote position. A remote position does not require job duties be performed within proximity of a Visa office location. Remote positions may be required to be present at a Visa office with scheduled notice. #LI-Remote

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree, OR 3+ years of relevant work experience

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Hands-on experience designing and operating cloud‑native infrastructure.
  • Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), including contributing to reusable modules and platform components.
  • Good understanding of Kubernetes and container orchestration concepts.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD systems, pipeline configuration, automation, and secure deployment practices.
  • Basic understanding of database technologies including SQL, NoSQL, and common data storage patterns.
  • Experience using observability tools and stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, ELK/EFK, Datadog, or similar).
  • Basic automation experience using Bash, Python, or Ansible-like tools.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with demonstrated ability to reduce toil, address technical debt, and improve system stability.
  • Availability to participating in on-call rotations, incident response, and post-incident reviews.
  • Clear written and verbal English communication skills.

Visa is an EEO Employer

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

title: Senior Manager, Regional Payroll Lead (South Asia and CEMEA)
description_html:
About Us
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Job Description

The Senior Manager, Regional Payroll Lead role oversees payroll operations across South Asia and Central Europe Middle East and Africa (CEMEA), focusing on strategic leadership by translating priorities into objectives and roadmaps, managing payroll delivery with compliance and efficiency, developing governance policies and handling audits, engaging stakeholders and vendors, supporting acquisitions and leading projects, and fostering talent development and a safe work environment.

The high level role requirements are listed below -

  • Payroll Operations oversight and execution

    • Lead team to deliver end to end payroll, ensure compliance, maintain GL, improve efficiency.

    • Partner with global organization and stakeholders to develop and execute policies, handle requests, ensure alignment.

    • Provide context to the team in order to enable them to understand and execute efficiently and effectively.

    • Challenge the status quo.

    • Handle internal and external Payroll audits.

  • Stakeholders engagement and management

    • Lead payroll projects or change requests to improve the current processes and communication.

    • Build relationships with internal and external stakeholders. Communicate with them in a way that the message is tailored to the audience.

    • Share and retrieve information of strategic value to all parties. Use this information to create an execution strategy.

    • Ability to explain why work matters, what is the long-term value it delivers, and how it aligns with organizational goals.

    • Lead reviews with third parties vendors, ensuring adherence to SLAs.

    • Work with third party vendors and internal partners to remedy SLAs and delivery issues.

    • Facilitate regular payroll vendor discussion on service level and expectations, keeping the vendors accountable for their service delivery.

    • Use information acquired from conversations with stakeholders to enable our team to do their work.

    • Empower upstream reporting line and stakeholders by communicating information and events timely and with context.

    • Support acquisitions and lead projects.

    • Engage stakeholders early to avoid surprises.

    • Keep detailed records of roles and responsibilities, minutes of meetings and take initiative to drive accountability.

    • When projects involve change, develop concise summaries of outcomes and expectations, provide timelines and clarify what is required from each stakeholder group.

    • Engage timely and proactively to communicate any change to the parties involved and impacted by such changes.

    • Focus on delivering beyond the task at hand.

    • Regularly review progress and adjust plans to maintain strategic alignment.

    • Apply prioritization frameworks to focus on high-impact initiatives.

    • Support to build a roadmap that connects initiatives to strategic outcomes.

    • Validate assumptions through experiments and data.

  • People Leadership and Talent Development

    • Drive team performance, fostering accountability, and enabling long‑term career growth for each team member

    • Focus on measurable impact, not task-based metrics.

    • Empower team to take ownership of their work.

    • Support career growth and development planning with documentation, roadmaps and conversations.

    • Create and maintain inclusive, psychologically safe environment.

    • Create and share recognition and foster engagement as part of strategic leadership.

    • Coach team members on writing OKRs (Objectives and Key Results) that reflect organizational vision.

    • Use performance calibration conversations to set clear expectations and promote a growth mindset.

    • Ensuring every team member understands the strategic link between their work and organizational goals.

    • Ensure that the team is appraised on discussion, projects and that as such, they are enable to participate in conversations themselves and live changes and our values.

    • Include stretch goals that push the team beyond comfort zones while remaining achievable.

    • Define objectives that are qualitative, outcome-driven, and business-aligned.

    • Translating high-level strategy into actionable team OKRs.

    • Review build and execute an effectiveness framework.

    • Role-play and feedback sessions (for example using the GROW model) to refine strategic thinking within the team.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager. ​

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:

  • 12 or more years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor Degree or at least 5 years of experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 3 years of work experience with a PhD 

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 12 or more years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor Degree or 7 or more relevant years of experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 3 or more years of experience with a PhD
  • Core Leadership and People Management (Non-Negotiable):
  • More than 15 years of progressive leadership experience in Regional or Global Payroll or Shared Services environments, with a demonstrated track record of building, leading, and sustaining high performing, multi country teams at scale.
  • Minimum 12 years of people leadership experience, leading mid to large teams (more than 10 FTE), including developing future leaders, managing performance, driving engagement, and leading through change, particularly in remote and matrixed environments.
  • Proven ability to lead leaders, not just teams — with experience coaching managers or SMEs, setting clear accountability, and establishing strong people management rhythms in a shared services model.
  • Stakeholder and Executive Leadership:
  • Exceptional stakeholder management capabilities, with a consistent track record of partnering with senior business leaders and executives to balance service excellence, risk management, and operational efficiency.
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate complex payroll topics clearly and confidently to executives, people leaders, and employees, including ownership of employee facing communications during sensitive payroll matters or changes.
  • Strong executive presence with the ability to influence across regions, cultures, and functions, operating effectively in cross regional, highly matrixed organizations.
  • Shared Services and Vendor Leadership:
  • Strong experience operating within or leading shared services models, with clear accountability for service delivery, employee experience, and continuous improvement.
  • Proven vendor leadership and governance experience, including managing strategic vendor partnerships, contractual negotiations, service level agreements, and performance management to outcomes.
  • Technical and Regional Expertise (Enabling Skillset):
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Human Resources, or equivalent experience.
  • Deep working knowledge of payroll operations and labor regulations across South Asia and CEMEA regions, with key markets including (but not limited to) India, UAE, South Africa, Ukraine, and Egypt.
  • Strong understanding of payroll risk, compliance, and controls within complex, multi country environments.
  • Operational Excellence and Ways of Working:
  • Experience driving service metrics, process optimization, and transformation initiatives, with the ability to translate data into executive ready insights and actions.
  • Highly organized and outcomes focused, with the ability to prioritize, lead multiple initiatives, and deliver results in fast paced, evolving environments.
  • Comfortable operating in hands on yet strategic roles, balancing people leadership, executive engagement, and operational rigor.

Visa is an EEO Employer

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

title: Sr. Manager - Software Engineering (11-14 years' experience, Java/Python, Kafka, Spark, Hive, Hadoop)
description_html:
About Us
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Job Description

Visa’s Technology Organization is a community of innovators redefining the future of digital commerce. We operate one of the world’s most advanced payment networks—processing over 65,000 secure transactions per second across 80+ million merchants, 15,000 financial institutions, and billions of consumers globally.

Within this ecosystem, the Payment Fraud Disruption (PFD) organization plays a critical role in securing the network through advanced data platforms, AI/ML, and real-time risk intelligence capabilities.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a Senior Manager, Software Engineering to lead critical initiatives within Visa Account Attack Intelligence (VAAI)—a strategic platform within the Payment Fraud Disruption (PFD) organization, focused on protecting the global ecosystem from large-scale enumeration and account takeover attacks.

This is an AI-first engineering leadership role where you will:

  • Lead development of AI/ML-powered, real-time data platforms
  • Drive adoption of AI-augmented engineering practices
  • Scale teams building intelligent, global risk systems

You will play a key role in applying AI both to fraud detection platforms and to improving engineering productivity.

 

What You Will Do

  • Lead high-impact engineering teams building real-time, data-intensive risk platforms
  • Promote adoption of AI-assisted development workflows (e.g., Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude) to improve coding, testing, debugging, and documentation
  • Design and evolve real-time streaming and batch platforms integrated with AI/ML models for fraud detection and risk scoring
  • Provide hands-on technical leadership through architecture reviews and complex problem solving
  • Improve engineering velocity through automation and modern tooling across CI/CD and observability
  • Own end-to-end delivery from architecture through production
  • Ensure high availability, scalability, and operational excellence for mission-critical services
  • Collaborate with Product, Risk, Data Science, and Platform teams
  • Foster a culture of continuous learning, innovation, and engineering excellence

 

Core Responsibilities

  • Translate business requirements into scalable, high-performance architectures
  • Lead design and architecture reviews for real-time systems
  • Drive engineering best practices and productivity improvements
  • Mentor engineers in distributed systems, data engineering, and modern development practices
  • Build and retain high-performing global teams
  • Maintain hands-on capability in distributed and data-intensive systems

 

Why This Role

  • Opportunity to build AI-powered fraud and risk intelligence systems within the Payment Fraud Disruption organization
  • Lead transformation toward AI-augmented engineering practices
  • Work on real-time, mission-critical platforms at global scale
  • Combine technical leadership, people leadership, and platform innovation

 

Work Location

This is a hybrid position. Hybrid employees can alternate time between both remote and office. Employees in hybrid roles are expected to work from the office 2-3 set days a week (determined by leadership/site), with a general guidepost of being in the office 50% or more of the time based on business needs.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:

  • 12+ years of experience (or 10+ with advanced degree) in Computer Science or closely related field
  • Proven 3+ years of management experience leading high performing engineering teams while remaining hands-on
  • Strong experience building real-time or streaming data platforms
  • Deep understanding of distributed systems, data structures, and algorithms
  • Hands-on experience using AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude or similar) for coding, debugging, testing, or documentation
  • Experience working in Agile environments
  • Proven ability to partner effectively with Product teams
  • Track record of improving engineering productivity, quality, and processes.

​Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building data-intensive or AI/ML-driven platforms, preferably in fraud, risk, or cybersecurity domains
  • Practical understanding of LLM and GenAI capabilities in engineering workflows
  • Experience integrating AI-assisted practices into development processes
  • Hands-on expertise in:
    • Java or Python
    • Apache Kafka, Spark, Hadoop, Hive
    • MySQL, PostgreSQL
  • Proven experience leading distributed global teams
  • Ability to drive improvements in engineering velocity and system reliability
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Growth mindset with a strong focus on innovation

Visa is an EEO Employer

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

title: Sr. Systems Engineer (Mac)
description_html:
About Us
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Job Description

Visa’s Corporate IT organization is on a multi-year transformation to modernize the digital workplace, elevate employee experience, and enable secure, scalable, and frictionless productivity across the enterprise. Client Engineering is a critical pillar of this strategy, responsible for delivering highly reliable, secure, and intuitive endpoint platforms that support Visa’s global workforce.

We are seeking a dynamic, individual contributor to join our team as Sr. Systems Engineer (Mac). The successful candidate will be required to assist in defining and setting standards, applying solutions-based engineering, assisting in the design and architecture of the macOS Environment, as well as high level operations support within the department for escalations and communication

Job Scope

This role serves as a Senior Individual Contributor responsible for the design, engineering, and lifecycle management of the macOS platform at global scale. You will partner closely with Information Security, Workplace Technology, Enterprise Architecture, and business stakeholders to deliver a secure, reliable, and high-performing endpoint experience.

The role emphasizes deep technical expertise, hands-on execution, and end-to-end ownership of solutions, contributing to platform strategy through engineering excellence, innovation, and cross-functional collaboration—without direct people management responsibilities.

Key Responsibilities:

Technical Leadership & Ownership

  • Serve as a individual contributor on macOS platform engineering team, driving secure, scalable, and high-quality outcomes.
  • Translate platform strategy into well-designed solutions, configurations, and automation that deliver measurable improvements in reliability and user experience.
  • Lead by example through strong engineering practices, documentation, and technical mentorship for peers.

Platform Engineering & Execution

  • Design, build, and maintain macOS endpoint management capabilities using Jamf Cloud, including device lifecycle, provisioning, patching, software delivery, and compliance.
  • Develop and maintain automation, packaging, and deployment workflows (e.g., scripting, configuration profiles) to improve scale and reduce manual effort.
  • Drive adoption of modern Apple ecosystem capabilities (e.g., zero-touch provisioning, identity integration, declarative management) to enhance platform maturity.

Reliability & Continuous Improvement

  • Design and maintain secure, scalable macOS platform standards and configurations.
  • Ensure platform reliability and performance through proactive monitoring and optimization.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex macOS issues with strong root cause analysis.
  • Simplify systems and reduce operational overhead through automation and improvements.
  • Maintain runbooks and documentation while driving adoption of new technologies.

Continuous Learning & Innovation

  • Maintain expertise in macOS, Jamf, and endpoint management technologies, continuously improving skills and knowledge.
  • Evaluate new tools, technologies, and approaches, providing recommendations that enhance platform capability and developer/user experience.
  • Demonstrate curiosity and adaptability in learning new technologies, concepts, and operational practices.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:

  • 2+ years of relevant work experience and a Bachelors degree, OR 5+ years of relevant work experience

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 3 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or more than 2 years of work experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD)
  • 4+ years of progressive experience in endpoint/client platform engineering with deep expertise in macOS ecosystems.
  • 3–5 years of experience in an engineering role supporting macOS and Apple hardware at scale.
  • Hands-on experience with Jamf Cloud, Intune for device management and lifecycle operations.
  • Proficiency in packaging, scripting, and deployment automation using Jamf (e.g., Bash, shell scripting).
  • Strong knowledge of macOS systems management within enterprise Active Directory environments.
  • Proven ability to troubleshoot complex hardware and software issues across macOS platforms.
  • Solid understanding of enterprise network fundamentals (LAN/WAN/Wi-Fi) and their impact on endpoint performance.
  • Demonstrated ability to stay current with emerging technologies and industry trends, translating insights into actionable recommendations for tools, platforms, and solutions.
  • Experience providing L2/L3 support across multiple enterprise applications and platforms.
  • Familiarity with datacenter architecture and core security principles impacting endpoint environments.
  • Self-driven with the ability to operate independently and make sound technical decisions with minimal supervision.
  • Strong collaboration skills with experience working across cross-functional and cross-divisional teams.
  • Ability to translate technical concepts into clear, business-friendly language for non-technical stakeholders.
  • Skilled in incident response, root cause analysis, and problem resolution with a focus on minimizing business impact and downtime.
  • Analytical thinker with the ability to evaluate technical scenarios and recommend viable solution options.
  • Fast learner with the ability to quickly adapt to new tools, technologies, and operational processes.

Visa is an EEO Employer

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

Technical Leadership & Ownership

  • Serve as an individual contributor on the Windows platform engineering team, driving secure, scalable, and high-quality outcomes.
  • Translate platform strategy into well-designed solutions, configurations, and automation that deliver measurable improvements in reliability and user experience.
  • Lead by example through strong engineering practices, documentation, and technical mentorship for peers.

Platform Engineering & Execution

  • Design and maintain Windows endpoint management using Intune and SCCM
  • Manage co-management scenarios (SCCM + Intune) for cloud transition
  • Implement Windows Autopilot for provisioning and deployment
  • Develop automation using PowerShell and Win32 app packaging
  • Drive adoption of Entra ID and modern cloud management

Reliability & Continuous Improvement

  • Maintain secure Windows platform standards and configurations
  • Ensure platform reliability through monitoring and optimization
  • Manage patch compliance using Intune, SCCM, and Windows Update for Business
  • Track and improve patch compliance SLAs across fleet
  • Troubleshoot complex Windows issues with root cause analysis

Continuous Learning & Innovation

  • Maintain expertise in Windows endpoint technologies, continuously improving skills and knowledge.
  • Evaluate new tools, technologies, and approaches, providing recommendations that enhance platform capability and developer/user experience.
  • Demonstrate curiosity and adaptability in learning new technologies, concepts, and operational practices.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:

  • 2+ years of relevant work experience and a Bachelors degree, OR 5+ years of relevant work experience

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 3 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or more than 2 years of work experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD)
  • 4+ years of experience in Windows platform engineering
  • 3–5 years of experience supporting Windows at enterprise scale supporting Windows OS and hardware at scale.
  • Experience with Intune, SCCM, and co-management
  • Strong PowerShell scripting and packaging skills
  • Experience with Windows Autopilot and device lifecycle management
  • Knowledge of Active Directory / Entra ID
  • Strong troubleshooting and networking fundamentals
  • Experience with patch compliance and enterprise patch management
  • Experience driving SCCM to Intune transitions
  • Exposure to patch compliance reporting and remediation
  • Familiarity with endpoint security (Defender, BitLocker, Conditional Access)
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills
  • Analytical and problem-solving mindset

Visa is an EEO Employer

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. title: Assoc. Cybersecurity Engineer
description_html:
About Us
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Job Description

This position is for an Associate Cybersecurity Analyst in the Applied Cryptography team. The role supports the implementation, operations, documentation, and maintenance of Visa’s Tier‑0 Applied Cryptography services, including enterprise encryption, tokenization, secure file upload, and credential management platforms. The analyst will learn through guided execution, documented automation workflows, and AI‑assisted tools (e.g., copilots/checklists) under the supervision of senior engineers.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone early in their cybersecurity career who is eager to build strong fundamentals, work on critical security services, and grow through structured training and hands‑on experience.

Essential Functions / Key Responsibilities:

  • Assist in the maintenance and operational support of enterprise encryption services protecting data at rest, data in transit, and transaction data.
  • Provide onboarding and operational support for cybersecurity and data protection technologies including (but not limited to):
    • ProtectApp, ProtectFile
    • Vormetric Transparent Encryption Agent
    • Voltage Tokenization Secure Data Appliance
    • HashiCorp Vault
    • OPSWAT MetaDefender
  • Assist Cybersecurity Engineers in executing projects and service requests, use AI copilots to understand context and propose initial steps for review.
  • Work with application teams, vendors, and cybersecurity architects to troubleshoot and resolve issues, collect diagnostics using scripted tools and AI‑assisted checklists.
  • Support end‑to‑end implementation and change execution across Visa encryption services infrastructure.
  • Support data protection service requests using predefined procedures and within agreed SLAs.
  • Resolve incidents and problem tickets, collaborate with team members to drive timely remediation.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot encryption, tokenization, secure file upload, credential management solutions, operating systems, and security protocols, provide fixes and documented resolutions.
  • Support database protection capabilities including native and transparent database encryption, along with operating systems and file systems.
  • Certify new product versions/releases by executing AI‑generated validation checklists and recording results with proper documentation.
  • Support QA, UAT, and performance testing phases, automate routine test setup and data collection where possible.
  • Identify opportunities to improve processes, reduce risk, increase operational efficiency, communicate security topics to internal groups as needed.
  • Document learnings and contribute to KB/runbook updates using AI‑assisted drafting with accuracy ensured through peer review.
  • Participate in weekly on‑call rotation, including weekends, follow guided runbooks and escalate using structured AI summaries.

This is a hybrid position. Expectation of days in office will be confirmed by your hiring manager.


Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree or 3+ years of relevant work experience. Preferred Qualifications: 2 or more years of work experience. Basic knowledge of one or more programming/scripting languages such as Python, C, Java, or Ansible. Ability to follow structured procedures and operate in an SLA driven environment. Familiarity with data protection technologies, key management systems, credential management solutions, operating systems, and security protocols. Cloud security / cloud data protection exposure is a plus. Prior experience with automation using Generative AI tools and/or scripting (Python/Ansible/Java/C). Understanding of cryptography fundamentals and applied security concepts. Strong collaboration skills and ability to build effective working relationships across multiple teams. Self-motivated, flexible, results oriented, and comfortable with tight timelines.

Visa is an EEO Employer

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

title: Event Operations Specialist (Event Planning, Video Production, AV equipment, Live streaming)
description_html:
About Us
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Job Description

Visa Corporate Technology Support has embarked on a significant transformation, rethinking how we provide operational support for the services we deliver to our end users. As part of this strategy, we are aligning operational functions into a single area focused on providing world-class support. The Event Operations Specialist plays a crucial role in the planning, coordination, and execution of events. This position supports the Senior Event Operations Specialist and the Lead, Events and Video Production Specialist in ensuring seamless event operations. The Event Operations Specialist handles logistical details, provides on-site support, and ensures that all aspects of the event run smoothly and efficiently.

This role places the successful candidate at the forefront of end-user interactions. This position requires technical versatility, strong customer service skills, and the ability to work efficiently in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

Key Focus Areas:

  • Exceptional Customer Service: Actively engage with end users, ensuring their issues and requests are addressed with professionalism, empathy, and efficiency.
  • Proactive Problem Solving: Identify issues before they escalate, using strong analytical and diagnostic skills to minimize downtime and ensure high-quality service delivery.
  • Technology Optimization: Continuously refine and improve support processes, adopt best practices, and seek opportunities to enhance the end-user computing environment.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Event Planning Support:
    • Assist in the development of detailed event plans, timelines, and checklists.
    • Coordinate logistics, including vendor arrangements, equipment setup, and transportation.
    • Assist in the preparation and management of event budgets.
    • Help with site visits and inspections to evaluate venues and ensure they meet event specifications.
  • Vendor and Venue Coordination:
    • Liaise with vendors for services such as catering, audio-visual equipment, and event staffing.
    • Coordinate with venues to ensure all logistical requirements are met, including seating arrangements, lighting, and AV setups.
    • Ensure all necessary permits and licenses are obtained for events.
  • Logistical Execution:
    • Assist with the setup, execution, and breakdown of events, ensuring all elements are executed according to plan.
    • Provide on-site support during events, handling technical and operational tasks.
    • Oversee the setup and operation of AV equipment, including cameras, microphones, and lighting.
    • Manage live streaming and video production elements, ensuring smooth and uninterrupted streaming.
  • Stakeholder Communication:
    • Communicate effectively with internal teams, vendors, and venues to ensure alignment and support for events.
    • Provide regular updates to the Senior Event Operations Specialist and Lead, Events and Video Production Specialist on event progress and any potential issues.
    • Conduct pre-event briefings with stakeholders to review event plans and address any concerns.
  • Post-Event Analysis:
    • Assist in conducting post-event evaluations, gathering feedback from stakeholders and attendees.
    • Identify areas for improvement and suggest changes to enhance future events.
    • Help prepare detailed reports on event performance, including metrics on attendance, engagement, and technical performance

This is a hybrid position. Expectation of days in the office will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager. 

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:

  • 2 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD, or PhD)

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 3 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or more than 2 years of work experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD)
  • Bachelor's degree in Event Management, Communications, Media Production, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in event operations, with a focus on logistical coordination.
  • Proven track record of supporting successful events and delivering high-quality results.
  • Experience with live streaming and video production is a plus.
  • The ideal candidate will be a detail-oriented professional with a passion for event planning and a commitment to delivering exceptional experiences. If you have the expertise and dedication to excel in this role, we would love to hear from you
  • Event Planning and Coordination:
    • Experience in event planning and operations, with a focus on logistical coordination.
    • Strong organizational and multitasking abilities to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
    • Ability to develop detailed event plans and timelines, ensuring all logistical elements are covered.
  • Technical Proficiency:
    • Technical skills with AV equipment and live streaming platforms (YouTube Live, Facebook Live, Twitch, Zoom, Microsoft Teams).
    • Familiarity with video production tools and software (Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro).
    • Understanding of industry standards such as:
      • Video Codec Standards: H.264, H.265
      • Audio Standards: AAC, Dolby Digital
      • Streaming Protocols: RTMP, HLS, DASH
      • Resolution Standards: HD, Full HD, 4K
  • Problem-Solving and Adaptability:
    • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
    • Ability to manage high-pressure, time-sensitive tasks with a calm and strategic approach.
    • Adaptability to handle unexpected challenges and changes during events.
  • Communication and Interpersonal Skills:
    • Effective communication and interpersonal skills to liaise with stakeholders at all levels.
    • Ability to build and maintain strong relationships with vendors, venues, and internal teams.
    • Strong teamwork skills to support and collaborate with other event team members.

Visa is an EEO Employer

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

title: SW Engineer (1 - 2 years of exp in .Net / Python, Full-stack development, Angular / React, GenAI)
description_html:
About Us
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Job Description

This Software Engineer role is for a self-motivated individual with excellent software engineering skills on SAAS based platforms. Your primary focus will be on building and maintaining various critical solutions that integrates with internal/external systems, or works standalone. You will be working closely with business on various requirements and ensure a strong partnership with all stakeholders. This role is for an individual whose experience with software development forms a strong basis for designing scalable and resilient integration that ensures highest quality and availability.

Essential Functions:

  • As a SW Engineer, you will build and support lasting, scalable, and secure solutions which deliver a delightful user experience, are resilient, and promote learning.
  • Continue to learn about the industry, propose new learning and payments solutions to meet future needs.
  • Adhere to SDLC governance framework.
  • Install, review, analyze and evaluate existing solutions, recommend technologies for incubation and future solutions, and help implement recommendations for longevity, stability, performance, and availability.
  • Engage with product managers, and users to ensure that the right learning platforms and content providers are available and accessible to Visa employees and clients around the world.
  • Provide technical leadership and partner with technology groups such as Engineering, Network, Security, and Infrastructure on project delivery activities.
  • Design and own integrations for SaaS and hosted applications.
  • Produce development artifacts and participate in code-reviews.
  • Monitor, troubleshoot, and enhance existing integrations to ensure they are functioning optimally.
  • Ensure highest level of Engineering and Operational Excellence following Visa’s core principles.
  • Participate in vendor assessments and selection.
  • Work with limited direction, usually within a complex and fast paced environment to drive delivery of solutions and meet service levels.


In addition:

  • Visa does not support immigration for this role.
  • Visa is not offering relocation assistance for this role.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, or a related field with 3+ years of relevant experience.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 1 - 2 years of work experience
  • Experience in any full stack platforms (Like .Net, Python, etc).
  • Hands-on experience on any database system (Like SQL Server, MongoDB, etc).
  • Experience with integration technologies such as SOAP, REST, XML, XSLT, JSON, and API management.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to debug issues.
  • Excellent communication skills to effectively collaborate with teams.
  • Passion for clean code - coding standards, code quality, design patterns, code reviews, SCM.
  • Ability to adapt to next technology stack that is needed per project priorities.
  • Demonstrate passion for continuous learning.
  • Experience working with Microsoft Visual Studio, Microsoft Code, Azure Dev Ops.
  • DevOps/CI-CD exposure
  • Understanding of Agile development methodologies.
  • Understanding on AI/Data analytics capabilities. Have foundational knowledge and hand-on experience on GenAI technology space.
  • Knowledge on automation frameworks (Like Power Automate, LogicApps, etc.)

Visa is an EEO Employer

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.
