description_html:
About Us
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Job Description

JOB DESCRIPTION

 Visa is a world leader in digital payments, facilitating billions in payments transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories each year. Our mission is to connect the world through the most innovative, convenient, reliable and secure payments network, enabling individuals, businesses and economies to thrive.

When you join Visa, you join a culture of purpose and belonging – where your growth is priority, your identity is embraced, and the work you do matters. We believe that economies that include everyone everywhere, uplift everyone everywhere. Your work will have a direct impact on billions of people around the world – helping unlock financial access to enable the future of money movement.


TEAM SUMMARY

Visa Consulting & Analytics (VCA) is Visa's consulting division, serving Visa's clients (including card issuers, acquirers and merchants) and solving their strategic problems, focused on improving performance and profitability. Drawing on our expertise in strategy consulting, payments, data analytics, marketing, operational and macroeconomics, VCA drives high impact projects with tangible financial results.

VCA Implementation Services (VIS) is a critical component of our VCA strategy, providing our clients with the execution muscle they require to deliver and implement strategic projects. VIS brings the ‘best of Visa’ to the clients, playing the role of orchestration layer between client teams and Visa subject matter experts (SMEs). As clients confront increased challenges in their operating environment whilst also facing capacity constraints and capability gaps, VIS helps to drive implementation or delivery of their strategic initiatives, facilitating significant and tangible value creation.



What a Sr.Client Consulting Manager - does at Visa:

The Sr. Client Consulting Manager is responsible for project managing 1 or more complex engagements where a team of techno-functional individuals are tasked to work with the client in delivering, setting-up, and configuring their payment systems to enable new products, features, and functionality as well as addressing issues that block the successful usage of these products. In addition, in this specific team, you would have responsibilities to help stand up the Tech Delivery Center of Excellence.

Key activities are to:

  • Be a thought leader to drive one or more delivery teams wrt execution along VISA’s products and solutions at client side
  • Increase the use of Gen AI for optimizing daily work deliverables and share the knowledge across teams
  • Drive planning, executing, and delivering projects related to card products (debit, credit, prepaid, etc.), card scheme migrations and commercial money movement solutions within scope, time, and budget constraints along a project plan.
  • Work as a functional and technical champion within Visa to advocate for the client. Work with the solution architects and with the product teams to understand and navigate competing product development priorities and backlogs and to effectively communicate and manage client expectations.
  • Collaborate with IT, Operations, Risk, Compliance, and external vendors to gather project requirements and track progress, while building strong networking with cross functional teams.
  • Prepare and maintain project documentation, including project plans, schedules, reports, and meeting minutes.
  • Monitor project risks, issues, and dependencies escalate as necessary to ensure timely resolution.
  • Manage the testing, defect resolution, client sign-off, and product enablement for any delivered product, feature, or enhancement.
  • Ensure all project activities adhere to internal control standards, industry regulations, and data security policies.

Maintain a high level of expertise across Visa products and solutions with a detailed understanding and appreciation for overall strategic context, priorities, and revenue goals.

This is a hybrid position. Expectation of days in office will be confirmed by your hiring manager.

Qualifications

Professional:

  • 12 or more years of work experience with a bachelor’s degree or at least 7 years of work experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g., Masters, MBA, MD)
  • Payments and Financial Services and Technologies consulting background and experience
  • Experience in managing financial and payment system implementations, including card scheme migrations
  • Experience with software development testing, issues identification, and resolution
  • Experience in SDLC processes and tools (JIRA, Rally, Wikis, etc.)
  • Experience using Postman or other API platforms
  • Experience with REST processing language
  • Ability to analyze data sets to identify insights, risks, and improvement opportunities
  • Exposure to real world AI use cases in financial services, with an ability to translate opportunities to AI requirements
  • Ability to learn new systems with minimal training
  • Experience working with cross functional teams that delivered on system requirements, design, development, implementations, testing, training, and support
  • Ability to manage multiple work streams simultaneously, along project milestones, risks and dependencies
  • Understanding and working experience with Agile, Scrum delivery models to support Agile ceremonies
  • Experience providing direct customer support
  • Ability to manage customer expectations and negotiate and influence internal and external stakeholders
  • Project management certification (e.g. PMP, CAPM, Prince2 Foundation) is a plus
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills and an ability to simplify and communicate complex technical issues to non-technical executives, sales teams, and other stakeholders
  • Ability to inspire and lead high performing cross-functional teams who can envision and create innovative solutions that meet the needs of our global clients, leading large teams where there is not a direct reporting line

Visa is an EEO Employer

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

title: Sr Client Consulting Manager (Project Management/Operations/Vendor management/Card Benefits)
description_html:
About Us
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Job Description

Team Summary

Visa Consulting & Analytics (VCA) is Visa's consulting division, partnering with clients—including issuers, acquirers, and merchants—to solve complex strategic challenges and drive performance improvement. Drawing on expertise across strategy consulting, payments, data analytics, marketing, and operations, VCA delivers impactful, measurable results. Within VCA, VCA Implementation Services brings these strategies to life by delivering the operational capabilities and executional excellence our clients need.

As a Senior Manager, Operations – Card Benefits, you will define and drive the regional operations strategy for Visa’s card benefits program. You’ll lead transformation initiatives that establish scalable operating frameworks, enhance delivery performance, and strengthen cross-market collaboration. This role is ideal for a strategic operator and people leader who thrives in ambiguity, brings structure to complexity, and inspires a team to achieve sustainable, high-impact outcomes.

The core responsibilities of the role include:

  • Shape and Scale Operations: Lead the transformation of Visa’s card benefits operations across Asia Pacific, designing scalable frameworks, automation opportunities, and governance models to support long-term growth.
  • Own Client Onboarding and Delivery: Oversee onboarding for new issuers and markets, managing vendor relationships, contracts, and financial processes—including POs, renewals, and top-ups—to ensure seamless implementation.
  • Build Capabilities and Lead Talent: Recruit, lead, and develop a high-performing operations team, championing a culture of accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement.
  • Operational Intelligence and Insight: Define and implement analytics and reporting frameworks that provide visibility into performance, benefits utilisation, and commercial optimisation opportunities.
  • Drive Financial Discipline: Oversee billing, revenue, and expense recognition, ensuring accurate and efficient financial management across multiple markets.
  • Vendor and Partner Leadership: Build and manage strategic vendor partnerships, driving consistency, efficiency, and value across service delivery.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with key internal stakeholders—such as finance, sourcing and legal—to optimise processes and enhance operational outcomes.
  • Strategic Advisor: Act as a trusted advisor to regional leadership and market leads on operational strategy, cost optimization, and delivery excellence. Ensure at all times timely and relevant communication.
  • Lead Through Ambiguity: Navigate complex, evolving business contexts with agility and composure, bringing clarity, alignment, and focus to teams and stakeholders.
  • Champion Innovation: Lead or support special projects that modernise processes, expand services, and enhance client and cardholder experiences across Asia Pacific.

Why this is important to Visa

Based in Bangalore, this position plays a key role in scaling Visa’s Implementation Services capabilities across Asia Pacific—enabling diversification of Visa’s revenue streams through premium benefits programs. You’ll own the operational foundations that ensure exceptional issuer and cardholder experiences, building partnerships within Visa and externally with clients and vendors. Your leadership will directly contribute to driving Visa’s mission of delivering trusted, high-quality services that strengthen our regional value proposition.

This is a hybrid position. Expectation of days in office will be confirmed by your hiring manager.

Qualifications

What you will need:

  • Proven ability to define operational strategy and build scalable processes for long-term success.
  • Deep experience managing vendors, contracts, and commercial negotiations, including rate setting and performance review.
  • Strong financial acumen to manage budgets, forecasts, and multi-market billing accuracy.
  • Demonstrated success as a people leader, fostering high-performing, collaborative, and empowered teams.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills to influence and align across functions and geographies.
  • Strong organisational discipline, attention to detail, and results orientation.
  • Experience thriving in ambiguous, fast-evolving environments that require both strategic vision and operational agility.
  • 12+ years of professional experience in operations, consulting, or program management.
  • Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree (MBA or equivalent) strongly preferred.

What will also help:

  • Experience in consulting, managed services, or large-scale operations within payments or financial services.
  • Familiarity with card products, loyalty programs, or premium benefit ecosystems.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office and analytical tools.
  • Proven experience leading automation, transformation, or process redesign initiatives.

Visa is an EEO Employer

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

title: Senior Software Engineer – Open Banking
description_html:
About Us
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Job Description

Tink, delivering Open Banking Solutions as a part of Visa, is building an open banking platform that enables banks, fintech and startups to develop data-driven financial services. Through one API, Tink allows customers to access aggregated financial data, initiate payments, enrich transactions and build personal finance management tools. Tink connects to more than 3,400 banks that reach over 250 million bank customers across Europe & US. Our solutions are ready-to-go products, each developed to solve specific problems and bring value to both businesses and their customers.

As part of the initiative, we are building Visa’s Open Banking engineering team in Bangalore—designed from the ground up to be AI-first. Every engineer in this team will work in close collaboration with Generative AI agents as development companions, leveraging Visa’s extensive portfolio of AI models, tools, and experimentation platforms. This AI-augmented approach will supercharge every stage of the engineering lifecycle—from solution design and code generation to testing, deployment, monitoring, and continual service improvement—enabling us to deliver innovative, high-quality connectivity solutions at unprecedented speed and scale.

Role Overview:

As a Senior Software Engineer in this team, you will:

  • Build high-performance, scalable APIs integrating with both documented and undocumented banking interfaces.
  • Co-develop integrations / features side-by-side with GenAI agents to dramatically increase speed-to-market and code quality.
  • Operate in a true DevOps model—owning build, deploy, and maintain responsibilities in the cloud.
  • Continuously experiment with Visa’s rich portfolio of Generative AI models (transformers, LLMs, GANs, VAEs, multimodal models) and cutting-edge AI tools for production and innovation.
  • Deliver new features on a rapid cadence (every few days) with end-to-end accountability.

What You Will Do:

AI-Powered Development:

  • Partner with GenAI agents for code generation, refactoring, and automated testing.
  • Experiment in Visa’s AI sandbox, where multiple GenAI models and frameworks are available for employee-driven innovation.
  • Apply Generative AI models to API integration challenges, anomaly detection, and intelligent automation.

Open Banking Integrations:

  • Build components integrating with banks’ APIs to aggregate and enrich consumer financial data.
  • Handle high-load systems with stringent uptime requirements.
  • Work with Visa’s Tink technologies stack: Java, Node.js, JavaScript, AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, SQL, Datadog and much more.

Cloud-Native DevOps:

  • Own end-to-end delivery: design, build, deploy, monitor, and maintain services in AWS/Kubernetes/Docker environments.
  • Implement CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, and automated observability using Datadog and related tooling.
  • Participate in on-call rotations to ensure high availability and operational excellence.

Collaboration & Mentorship:

  • Coach junior engineers, especially in leveraging AI engineering assistants.
  • Contribute to AI-first engineering culture—sharing learnings from model experimentation.

This is a hybrid position. Expectation of days in office will be confirmed by your hiring manager.

Qualifications

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer with experience of building innovative and scalable products. You understand the trade-offs of speed vs quality on technical decisions and look at problems from different angles. You also invest time in your own, and the team's development to build up your overall knowledge.

We would like you to have:

  • Bachelor degree in Computer Science or related field and at least 2-8 years of Software Development Experience.
  • Extensive experience working with Java, Node.js and Javascript

Experience with Generative AI:

  • Understanding of transformers, GANs, VAEs, and other generative architectures.
  • Application of NLP, multimodal AI, and AI-powered developer tools in production systems.
  • Practical exposure to prompt engineering and tooling orchestration for AI agents in enterprise environments, ensuring reproducibility and compliance.

Experience with cloud-native DevOps:

  • AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code
  • Experience in agile product-centric environments with rapid iteration cycles.

Nice-to-have:

  • Operational excellence & incident response experience.
  • Financial API integration experience.
  • Experience mentoring engineers in AI-assisted development.

Visa is an EEO Employer

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

title: Senior Manager (10 - 13 years of full stack developement exp with Python, Angular / React, GenAI, Technically hands-on is a must)
description_html:
About Us
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Job Description

Visa’s Technology Organization is a community of problem solvers and innovators reshaping the future of commerce.   We operate the world’s most sophisticated processing networks capable of handling more than 65k secure transactions a second across 80M merchants, 15k Financial Institutions, and billions of everyday people.   While working with us you’ll get to work on complex distributed systems and solve massive scale problems centered on new payment flows, business and data solutions, cyber security, and B2C platforms.     

The Work itself: 

  • Provide visionary leadership and mentorship for multiple high-performing software engineering teams across general and specialized functions, including frontend, backend, and full-stack.

  • Drive technical strategy, architecture, and execution for complex, large-scale systems and projects, ensuring solutions aligning with organizational objectives and industry best practices.

  • Oversee the end-to-end software development lifecycle—including planning, estimation, system design, code reviews, testing, deployment, and support—while championing DevOps, Agile, and continuous improvement philosophies.

  • Ensure rigorous adherence to best practices in code quality, system security, accessibility, compliance, and automated testing for all deliverables.

  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional partners (product, design, QA, infrastructure, vendors, and stakeholders) to clarify requirements, prioritize work, and deliver scalable, reliable, and cost-effective solutions.

  • Manage resource planning, recruitment, performance, and professional development to build and sustain a talented, inclusive, and globally distributed engineering organization.

  • Foster a culture of innovation, knowledge sharing, and professional growth through mentorship, code reviews, and active participation in technical evaluations, proofs of concept, and emerging technology assessments.

  • Promote diversity, equity, and inclusion, and cultivate an environment that values teamwork, learning, and high performance.

  • Proactively identify and address technical and organizational risks, ensure timely resolution of production issues, and drive implementation of preventative measures.

  • Represent the engineering function to executive leadership, communicating progress, risks, opportunities, and recommendations.

  • Ensure all systems and code meet Visa’s security requirements, coding standards, and are designed for scalability, resilience, and monitoring.

  • Lead continuous process improvement by integrating lessons learned from sprint execution, maximizing team velocity, and optimizing Agile and DevOps practices.

  • Oversee the development and technical guidance for UI development, batch process automation, and the creation of technical specifications, test plans, and implementation strategies.

  • Facilitate collaboration with upstream and downstream systems, architects, and global teams—including vendors and offshore partners—to ensure integrated, scalable solutions.

This is a hybrid position. Expectation of days in office will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.


Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:
• 8+ years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or at least 5 years of experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 2 years of work experience with a PhD, OR 11+ years of relevant work experience.

Preferred Qualifications:
• 9 or more years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor Degree or 7 or more relevant years of experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 3 or more years of experience with a PhD
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
• Extensive experience (8-10+ years) in large-scale system/software design, architecture, and development, ideally in complex environments.
• Proven leadership in building, mentoring, and managing high-performing, diverse engineering teams—including across frontend, backend, full-stack, and specialized roles.
• Strong hands-on technical expertise with Java/J2EE, Oracle, MongoDB, SQL, Linux, JavaScript, and web technologies (HTTP/S, Spring, XML, JSON, REST, AngularJS).
• Deep knowledge of software engineering principles, design patterns, data structures, algorithms, and multi-tier application architectures.
• Advanced proficiency with CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins), version control systems (e.g., Git), automated build/deployment, and test automation frameworks (e.g., JUnit, Selenium, Playwright).
• Expertise in Agile/Scrum development methodologies, DevOps practices, and experience with project/requirements management tools (e.g., JIRA, TFS).
• Strong understanding of security standards, compliance, and best practices for secure application development and platform support.
• Experience with using and/or implementing GenAI tools to increase productivity
• Ability to lead architectural design and code review discussions, provide technical guidance, and ensure high code quality and maintainability.
• Demonstrated experience managing production support, rapid issue resolution, and implementing preventative solutions.
• Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate with diverse global stakeholders.
• Strong conceptual, analytical, and problem-solving skills—able to respond resourcefully to new demands and challenges.
• Commitment to ongoing learning, professional development, and staying current with emerging technologies, industry trends, and best practices.

Visa is an EEO Employer

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

title: Director, Cross Border
description_html:
About Us
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Job Description

Visa is seeking an experienced leader to serve as Director – Cross Border (Growth & Initiatives) as part of the Product org for India & South Asia. This role owns the end‑to‑end strategy, governance, and execution of Visa’s most complex and high‑impact cross‑border initiatives, spanning payment success rate (PSR) improvements, authentication readiness, acquiring expansion, and strategic pilots with issuers and acquirers.

The Director will operate as a senior leader, representing Visa in driving engagements with issuers, acquirers, and ecosystem partners, while also serving as the internal orchestrator across Product, Risk, Technology, Client Services, Legal, and PMO. This role combines strategic ownership, commercial accountability, and executive influence, with clear accountability for business outcomes.

Essential Functions:

End‑to‑End Program & Commercial Ownership:

  • Own the strategy, prioritization, and delivery of multiple cross‑border programs with clear accountability for outcomes (e.g., PSR uplift, Spend uplift, Acceptance expansion)
  • Translate regional and global cross‑border priorities into executable market programs, with defined success metrics, milestones, and governance cadence.
  • Drive commercialization of cross‑border initiatives, ensuring solutions are scalable, adopted by clients, and deliver measurable business impact.

Executive Issuer & Acquirer Engagement:

  • Lead negotiations on pilots, operating models, technical changes, and risk/coverage constructs required to unlock cross‑border growth.
  • Build durable, trust‑based partnerships that position Visa as a strategic cross‑border partner, not just a network provider.

Payment Success, Risk & Platform Enablement:

  • Own PSR improvement programs end‑to‑end, including issuer adoption of authentication solutions, recovery of ECI‑7 declined volumes, and readiness on disputes and chargebacks.
  • Coordinate closely with Risk, Authentication, and Technology teams to balance friction reduction with security, compliance, and resilience.
  • Drive acquiring expansion and cross‑border merchant enablement, working with acquirers, PayFacs, and ecosystem partners to scale acceptance.

Regional–Global Leadership & Representation:

  • Represent India & South Asia in APAC and global cross‑border forums, contributing market perspective and shaping global capability roadmaps.
  • Translate global cross‑border capabilities into locally compliant, executable solutions aligned to regulatory and market realities.

This is a hybrid position. Expectation of days in office will be confirmed by your hiring manager.

Qualifications

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 11+ years of experience in payments, financial services, or fintech, with significant exposure to cross‑border, cards, or acceptance ecosystems.
  • Proven ability to own and deliver complex, multi‑stakeholder programs with commercial and operational impact.
  • Demonstrated experience engaging and influencing C‑suite and senior executives at issuers, acquirers, or large ecosystem partners.
  • Strong executive presence with a track record of leading large, cross‑functional initiatives in matrixed environments.
  • Deep understanding of payment economics, risk/authentication dynamics, and regulatory considerations in cross‑border payments.
  • Strategic, analytical thinker with the ability to move from concept to scaled execution.
  • MBA or equivalent advanced degree preferred.

Visa is an EEO Employer

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

title: Sr. SW Engineer – PySpark | Spark SQL | Scala | Big Data | ETL
description_html:
About Us
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Job Description

At Visa, the Corporate Information Technology, Billing & Incentives Platforms team, enables Visa's revenue growth through flexible rules-based pricing engines and global revenue applications built on next-generation technologies. This includes managing system requirements, evaluating cutting-edge technologies, design, development, integration, quality assurance, implementation, and maintenance of corporate revenue applications. The team works closely with business owners of these services to deliver custom developed solutions, as well as implement industry leading packaged software. This team has embarked on a major transformational journey to build and implement best of breed revenue and billing applications to transform our business as well as technology.

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer who will work in Core Billing Platform with strong hands-on experience in PySpark, Spark SQL, and Scala to design, develop, and optimize scalable data pipelines for large-scale data processing.

The ideal candidate should have deep expertise in distributed data processing, ETL development, performance tuning, and big data ecosystem technologies. This role requires end-to-end ownership of data pipelines, from ingestion and transformation to storage and consumption, while ensuring high performance, reliability, and data quality.

Exposure to AI/GenAI enabled data engineering solutions is a plus.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines using PySpark, Spark SQL, and Scala
  • Build and optimize complex ETL workflows for extracting, transforming, and loading data across multiple systems such as Oracle, PostgreSQL, Hive, Hadoop, and cloud-based data platforms
  • Develop and optimize Spark jobs for large-scale batch and, where applicable, streaming data processing
  • Write efficient Spark SQL queries and optimize data transformations for performance and scalability
  • Implement data processing strategies including partitioning, caching, parallel processing, file format optimization, and job tuning
  • Architect and implement big data solutions using Spark, Hive, Hadoop ecosystem, Delta Lake, and related technologies
  • Build end-to-end data flows from data ingestion → transformation → storage → consumption layers
  • Develop config-driven, reusable ETL frameworks, automation utilities, and common data engineering components
  • Ensure data quality, integrity, accuracy, and consistency across data pipelines
  • Perform performance tuning, debugging, troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis of data pipeline issues
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders, data analysts, architects, and engineering teams to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, data flow diagrams, data models, and architecture artifacts
  • Follow engineering best practices around code quality, version control, CI/CD, testing, deployment, monitoring, and alerting
  • Mentor junior engineers and promote best practices in data engineering and big data development
  • Explore and integrate AI/GenAI capabilities where applicable for automation, data validation, anomaly detection, and ETL optimization

This is a hybrid position. Expectation of days in office will be confirmed by your hiring manager.

Qualifications

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or other relevant Engineering discipline with 3-5 years of experience in Data Engineering, Big Data Engineering, or ETL development
  • Strong hands-on experience with PySpark, Spark SQL, and Scala
  • Solid experience building and maintaining large-scale ETL/ELT data pipelines
  • Strong understanding of Apache Spark architecture, including executors, drivers, DAGs, stages, tasks, shuffle, caching, and memory management
  • Proven experience in Spark performance tuning and optimization
  • Strong SQL skills with experience writing complex queries, joins, aggregations, window functions, and query optimization
  • Experience working with big data technologies such as Hive, Hadoop, HDFS, Delta Lake, Parquet, ORC, and related ecosystem tools
  • Experience working with relational databases such as Oracle, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, or MySQL
  • Strong programming skills in Python and Scala
  • Good understanding of distributed computing, data partitioning, data modeling, and large-scale data processing patterns
  • Experience with data quality checks, reconciliation, validation, exception handling, and audit controls
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, Git/version control, code reviews, and deployment processes
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum delivery environments
  • Strong problem-solving, analytical, and communication skill

AI / GenAI Exposure — Good to Have:

  • Exposure to AI/ML or Generative AI concepts
  • Experience integrating AI/LLM APIs into data pipelines, applications, or automation workflows
  • Understanding of data pipelines supporting ML/AI model development and deployment
  • Experience using AI tools for:
    • ETL code generation
    • Data validation
    • Anomaly detection
    • Data profiling
    • Workflow automation
  • Ability to identify opportunities to improve data engineering productivity using AI-assisted development tools

Visa is an EEO Employer

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

title: Quality Assurance Engineer, Credit Rights
description_html:
About Us
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Job Description

Visa’s Technology Organization is a community of problem solvers and innovators reshaping the future of commerce.

Digital Receivables (Duplicatas Escriturais) are electronic representations of payment obligations between businesses. They serve as the foundation of the receivables marketplace, transforming traditional paper-based trade instruments into secure, digital assets that can be tracked, traded, and used as collateral in real-time.
When a business performs a service or delivers goods on credit, it creates a receivable representing the buyer's obligation to pay. The digital receivable system captures this obligation in a standardized format, establishing a unique identifier, recording the amount, due date, debtor information, and payment terms. Once registered, the receivable becomes visible to the entire market, enabling financial institutions to verify its existence and status before extending credit.

What You'll Do

  • Work closely with the Engineer and Product team to identify new automation opportunities and application faults
  • Work closely with other QAs within business to encourage best practices.
  • Be able to use and develop QA software tooling
  • Be aware of new and developing changes in QA technology
  • Establish design principles for automated software test procedures
  • Maintain the test automation frameworks
  • Write automation scripts and implementing it in software applications
  • Help teams develop complex end-to-end automated testing solutions and performance tests with integration in CI/CD tools
  • Create and document detailed, comprehensive, and well-structured test plans and test cases to assess software quality
  • Communicate test progress and results
  • Identify quality issues and create test reports
  • Review software bug reports and highlight problem areas
  • Ideate, implement, maintain, and reinforce high-quality standards leveraging reusability and scalability
  • Execute exploratory tests, usability tests, and manual tests when necessary
  • We do not expect that any single candidate would fulfill all of these characteristics. For instance, we have exciting team members who are really focused on building scalable systems but didn’t work with payments technology or web applications before joining Visa
     

This is a remote position. A remote position does not require job duties be performed within proximity of a Visa office location. Remote positions may be required to be present at a Visa office with scheduled notice. #LI-Remote

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications

  • 3+ years of relevant work experience and a Bachelors degree, OR 5+ years of relevant work experience or more than 2 years of work experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD)
  • Be based in Brazil
  • Proficiency in English at B2 level (Intermediate)
  • 3+ years of experience with working in the quality assurance area
  • Experience with REST APIs
  • Experience with multiple test types: e2e, contract, load and chaos testing
  • Proficiency at least in one programming language (preferrable Javascript)
  • Proficiency with Git and version control workflows
  • Understanding of observability practices (monitoring, tracing, alerting).


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Financial systems
  • Experience working in high-scale and high-availability environments.
  • Basic knowledge or experience with AWS services: SQS, SNS, DynamoDB, S3

Visa is an EEO Employer

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

title: Sr. Director, Head of Finance - India & South Asia
description_html:
About Us
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Job Description

Team Summary

The Finance team acts as a strategic partner to the business, ensuring strong financial discipline, controls, and decision support across the markets. They provide thought leadership on growth strategies, performance analysis, and pricing, enabling Visa to achieve both short-term targets and long-term objectives.

What a Senior Director, Head of Finance – INSA does at Visa

  • Serve as a member of the senior leadership team for India & South Asia (INSA) and be the focal point for all finance-related matters.

  • Responsible for creating and maintaining a high standard of financial discipline, controls, decision support, and accountability within the geography.

  • Act as a key advisor and thought partner to the Group Country Manager and Country Managers to facilitate delivery of short-term financial targets as well as long-term growth objectives.

  • Provide strong financial thought leadership on growth strategies, current performance, business case analysis of client incentive deals, sales, marketing and product initiatives, and pricing proposals.

Why this is important to Visa

There are 6 key markets/sub-region in INSA, namely India, Sri Lanka, Maldives, Bangladesh, Bhutan and Nepal, all with growth opportunities linked to the evolution of payment innovation and technology despite maturity in the payment industry.

This role is a critical business partner to the Group Country Manager, INSA, and will play a pivotal role in managing business activities across these markets to deliver financial targets and shape strategic development for future growth.

The position will be the focal point of contact for senior management on finance-related matters in the geography and will oversee all areas of Finance including FP&A, Controllership, Sourcing, etc. This is the most senior finance position in the INSA cluster and will have influence/decision authority over FTEs, expenses, client incentives, and revenue waivers.


Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

Qualifications

Qualifications

Key Competencies

  • Results-oriented and proven change agent with a track record of influencing business decisions and implementing change.

  • Strong commercial acumen with an aptitude for strategic thinking.

  • Ability to recognize key strategic issues, opportunities, and risks, and develop thoughtful financial perspectives that facilitate decision-making in complex, uncertain, and dynamic environments.

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, able to effectively present and communicate financial issues and results across all levels of the business.

  • Customer-focused (internal and external), with the ability to build effective organisational relationships.

  • Team player, adept at building and maintaining collaborative stakeholder relationships at all levels.

  • Capable of working with cross-functional teams and operating within a matrix-management structure.

  • Competent in internal and operational controls to manage local compliance for the company.

  • Leadership and management of the INSA Finance team, nurturing and developing talent within Finance and across the wider INSA organisation.

Required Experiences

  • Minimum 15 years of commercial finance, controllership, and/or auditing experience.

  • College graduate, business degree preferred, with at least 10 years of FP&A experience in a recognized, performance-driven multinational company.

  • Proven commercial and analytical experience, including FP&A roles in a business unit within a global organisation.

  • Prior experience successfully communicating with, influencing, and presenting to senior-level executives.

  • Demonstrated ability to deliver on multiple initiatives with tight timelines.

  • Strong knowledge of financial controls and procedures to safeguard company assets and ensure local compliance.

  • International experience ideally within a complex, matrix management organisation.

What will also help

  • Knowledge of the payments industry, particularly credit/debit card business within banking or eCommerce environments, is highly desirable.

  • Advanced business degrees would be an advantage.

Visa is an EEO Employer

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

title: Program Manager (Business Project Manager)
description_html:
About Us
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Job Description

 The Project Manager is an individual contributor role within the CEMEA Business Planning & Operations (BPO) team, supporting the region in delivering key business‑led and strategic initiatives.

The role focuses on structuring, managing, and driving execution of initiatives that enable regional priorities, working closely with stakeholders across Markets, Functions, and Geographies. Projects are primarily business in nature, rather than technical or IT‑led, and often operate in environments where objectives evolve and clarity emerges over time.

Success in this role requires strong project management discipline, sound business judgment, and the ability to operate with resilience and adaptability in a complex, matrixed organisation. Projects could span Central Europe, Dubai and Africa markets.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Manage end‑to‑end delivery of business and strategic projects, ensuring defined outcomes are delivered on time and with appropriate stakeholder alignment
  • Deliver initiatives that span multiple geographies and markets across CEMEA (Central Europe, Middle East and Africa), working effectively with stakeholders and teams based in different locations and time zones
  • Ensure project outcomes are clearly linked to relevant business priorities and Objectives & Key Results (OKRs), supporting alignment, focus, and measurable impact
  • Translate agreed objectives into clear project plans, milestones, dependencies, and governance structures
  • Work closely with business stakeholders to clarify scope, manage expectations, and enable informed decision‑making throughout delivery
  • Proactively manage risks, issues, and interdependencies, escalating appropriately and proposing practical mitigation options
  • Drive execution discipline across cross‑functional teams, influencing delivery without direct authority
  • Provide concise, structured project updates to stakeholders, clearly highlighting progress, risks, and required actions
  • Support change and adoption by ensuring initiatives are implemented in a practical and sustainable way
  • Capture lessons learned and contribute to continuous improvement of PM tools, standards, and ways of working
  • Manage multiple initiatives in parallel, adapting plans as priorities or business conditions change     

Key Competencies:

  • Delivers with discipline: Applies strong project management fundamentals to drive consistent execution and achieve agreed business outcomes
  • Acts decisively in ambiguity: Progresses work effectively despite incomplete information, changing priorities, or evolving requirements
  • Collaborates across boundaries: Builds productive working relationships across functions, markets, and geographies to enable delivery
  • Thinks in outcomes: Frames and tracks project delivery against agreed objectives and success measures, including relevant OKRs.
  • Influences with credibility: Engages stakeholders constructively, enabling alignment and informed decision‑making without formal authority
  • Executes with resilience: Maintains momentum, focus, and delivery discipline in a fast‑paced, matrixed environment
  • Thinks structurally: Breaks down complex initiatives into clear, manageable components with defined milestones and dependencies
  • Communicates with clarity: Produces concise, structured updates tailored to leadership and stakeholder needs
  • Improves how work gets done: Applies lessons learned to strengthen delivery approaches, PMO standards, and ways of working

This is a hybrid position. Expectation of days in office will be confirmed by your hiring manager.

 

Qualifications

Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience

Demonstrated experience delivering business initiatives or transformation projects in a corporate or consulting environment

Strong grounding in project management methodologies; formal certification (e.g. PMP, PRINCE2) advantageous but not essential

Experience working with multiple stakeholders across functions and geographies

Proven ability to operate effectively in dynamic, changing environments

Strong written and verbal communication skills in English

Proficiency in standard productivity and collaboration tools (e.g. Excel, PowerPoint, Teams)

Visa is an EEO Employer

description_html:
About Us
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Job Description

Responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining robust Identity and Access Management (IAM) solutions. This role ensures secure, compliant, and efficient authentication and authorization processes across hybrid and multi‑cloud environments. The position requires strong technical expertise, hands‑on experience with modern IAM platforms, and the ability to act as a technical reference for IAM architecture.

What You'll Do

  • Design, evolve, and maintain the companys IAM architecture aligned with security best practices.
  • Implement and maintain RBAC (Role-Based Access Control) models.
  • Manage and configure IAM tools such as Okta and Ping Identity.
  • Ensure secure integration of internal and external applications with IAM solutions.
  • Develop automation scripts for provisioning, deprovisioning, and access reviews using Python, PowerShell, or similar languages.
  • Develop, maintain, and review scripts, services, and automations related to Identity and Access Management (IAM)
  • Operate IAM services within AWS and support expansion into Azure.
  • Apply secure identity practices across multi‑cloud environments.
  • Implement and maintain IAM governance, policies, and regulatory compliance processes.
  • Support internal and external audits and access review cycles.
  • Collaborate with engineering, security, and business teams to ensure secure and efficient identity workflows.

This is a remote position. A remote position does not require job duties be performed within proximity of a Visa office location. #LI-Remote

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications

  • Be based in Brazil.
  • English (B2).
  • Bachelors degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field.
  • Solid hands on experience with IAM platforms, including Okta, Ping Identity or Microsoft Entra ID.
  • Strong knowledge of RBAC methodologies and access management practices.
  • Experience with cloud environments, Azure knowledge preferred.
  • Familiarity with authentication and authorization protocols (SAML, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect).
  • Ability to work independently as well as in distributed, multicultural teams.
  • Strong analytical and communication skills for interaction with business, technical teams, and auditors.
  • Experience integrating IAM controls into DevSecOps or CI/CD pipelines.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Knowledge of Zero Trust Architecture.
  • Certifications such as Okta Certified Professional, Ping Identity, AWS Security Specialty, Microsoft Identity and Access Administrator. 
  • Proficiency in automation and scripting (Python, PowerShell, or Bash).

Visa is an EEO Employer

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

title: Software Engineer, Sr. Consultant Level (11-15 years exp, Java-Python-AWS-GenAI)
description_html:
About Us
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Job Description

Visa is building a next-generation Agentic AI services that brings intelligent, autonomous agents into large-scale distributed applications across our global ecosystem. We’re seeking a Sr. Consultant Software Engineer who will architect, design, and build scalable backend systems that integrate AI agents into Visa’s enterprise infrastructure. You will work with other Senior Engineers and technical leaders to define the architecture, scaling strategy, and engineering standards for Visa’s AI-driven products. This is a role for a hands-on technical leader — a go-getter, builder, and problem solver with deep experience in Java microservices, GenAI integration, and distributed system design, and a true-north, entrepreneurial mindset focused on speed, quality, and innovation.

Key Responsibilities:

Architecture & Design:

  • Architect and evolve the Agentic AI Platform to support multi-agent orchestration, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and integration with existing Visa microservices.
  • Design scalable, secure backend systems using Java (Spring Boot) and Python (FastAPI/Flask).
  • Develop RESTful and gRPC APIs that connect backend services, AI agents, and React front-end applications.

AI & GenAI Integration:

  • Integrate Large Language Models (LLMs) such as GPT, Claude, Mistral, and Gemini into backend systems.
  • Build and optimize RAG pipelines using vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS).
  • Develop orchestration and agentic workflows using LangChain, LangGraph, or Autogen.

Scalability & Reliability:

  • Lead the design and implementation of distributed, fault-tolerant systems that scale horizontally.
  • Implement auto-scaling, monitoring, and observability using Kubernetes, Docker, and Prometheus/Grafana.
  • Drive best practices for latency reduction, cost optimization, and service reliability.

Leadership & Execution:

  • Partner with other senior engineers, ML engineers, and product leads to define and deliver the platform roadmap.
  • Mentor developers, set coding standards, and lead design reviews.
  • Deliver results with urgency — balancing innovation with enterprise rigor.

Innovation & Strategy:

  • Explore new frameworks, architectures, and deployment models to push the boundaries of Agentic AI in production.
  • Drive continuous improvement, automation, and open-source adoption across the engineering organization.

AI Security & Governance:

  • Design secure, compliant Agentic AI systems with built‑in safeguards for data privacy, prompt security, auditability, and responsible AI usage across enterprise environments.

LLM Quality & Evaluation:

  • Define evaluation metrics and testing frameworks to measure LLM and agent performance, accuracy, latency, cost, and reliability in production.

Platform & Developer Enablement:

  • Build reusable AI platform components, SDKs, and internal tooling that accelerate adoption and enable teams to safely develop, deploy, and scale Agentic AI solutions.

Observability & Explainability:

  • Implement end‑to‑end observability for AI workflows, including tracing, logging, and monitoring of agent decisions and tool usage across distributed systems.

Operational Excellence:

  • Lead production readiness, incident response, and post‑mortems for AI services, driving continuous improvements in resilience, scalability, and deployment practices.

Cross‑Functional Technical Leadership:

  • Collaborate with product, data, ML, and security teams to translate business needs into scalable AI architectures and influence platform strategy and roadmap.

This is a hybrid position. Expectation of days in office will be confirmed by your hiring manager.


Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field. 10+ years of backend software development experience with Java and Spring Boot. 2+ years of backend experience with Python (FastAPI, Flask, or similar frameworks). Production-level experience in building and deploying AI Agentic solutions, including orchestration of LLM-based agents, integration with enterprise microservices, and troubleshooting live production environments. Hands-on experience implementing LLM, GenAI, and RAG systems using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, or Autogen. Experience building and integrating Model Context Protocol (MCP) frameworks for tool and API interoperability Strong understanding of AI orchestration and LLM integration patterns in distributed environments. Proven experience building and scaling distributed microservice architectures. Proficiency in REST/gRPC API design, event-driven architectures, and message queues (Kafka, RabbitMQ). Experience with vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS) and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines. Hands-on expertise with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure). Familiarity with SQL and NoSQL databases (MySQL, DynamoDB, MongoDB). Experience with containerization and CI/CD pipelines (Docker, Kubernetes, ArgoCD, Jenkins, GitHub Actions). Excellent debugging, performance optimization, and system design skills at scale. Leadership Attributes: Go-Getter: Executes decisively, drives clarity, and thrives in ambiguity. Builder: Hands-on technologist who delivers high-impact systems from prototype to production. Hustler: Operates with urgency and persistence to overcome obstacles. Entrepreneurial: Innovates beyond defined scope, with ownership and bias for action. True North: Leads with integrity, clarity, and long-term vision. Lead by Example: Demonstrates accountability, openness, and excellence in technical and people leadership. Execute with Excellence: Sets a high bar for quality, collaboration, and delivery across multi-disciplinary engineering teams. Tech Stack Snapshot: Languages: Java (Spring Boot), Python (FastAPI, Flask), TypeScript AI Frameworks: LangChain, LangGraph, Autogen, LlamaIndex LLMs: GPT, Claude, Mistral, Gemini Data: MySQL, Hazelcast, Pinecone, FAISS Infra: Docker, Kubernetes, ArgoCD, AWS/GCP Frontend Integration: React, GraphQL, REST/gRPC APIs

Visa is an EEO Employer

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

title: Staff Software Engineer (8+ years, Java, GenAI) – Open Banking
description_html:
About Us
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Job Description

Tink, delivering Open Banking Solutions as a part of Visa, is building an open banking platform that enables banks, fintech and startups to develop data-driven financial services. Through one API, Tink allows customers to access aggregated financial data, initiate payments, enrich transactions and build personal finance management tools. Tink connects to more than 3,400 banks that reach over 250 million bank customers across Europe & US. Our solutions are ready-to-go products, each developed to solve specific problems and bring value to both businesses and their customers.

As part of the initiative, we are building Visa’s Open Banking engineering team in Bangalore—designed from the ground up to be AI-first. Every engineer in this team will work in close collaboration with Generative AI agents as development companions, leveraging Visa’s extensive portfolio of AI models, tools, and experimentation platforms. This AI-augmented approach will supercharge every stage of the engineering lifecycle—from solution design and code generation to testing, deployment, monitoring, and continual service improvement—enabling us to deliver innovative, high-quality connectivity solutions at unprecedented speed and scale.

Role Overview

As a Staff Software Engineer in this team, you will:

  • Lead the design and implementation of new features and systems, ensuring it meets the highest standards of scalability, reliability, and performance
  • Build high-performance, scalable APIs integrating with both documented and undocumented banking interfaces.
  • Co-develop integrations / features side-by-side with GenAI agents to dramatically increase speed-to-market and code quality.
  • Operate in a true DevOps model—owning build, deploy, and maintain responsibilities in the cloud.
  • Continuously experiment with Visa’s rich portfolio of Generative AI models (transformers, LLMs, GANs, VAEs, multimodal models) and cutting-edge AI tools for production and innovation.
  • Deliver new features on a rapid cadence (every few days) with end-to-end accountability.

What You Will Do

  • AI-Powered Development
    • Partner with GenAI agents for code generation, refactoring, and automated testing.
    • Experiment in Visa’s AI sandbox, where multiple GenAI models and frameworks are available for employee-driven innovation.
    • Apply Generative AI models to API integration challenges, anomaly detection, and intelligent automation.
  • Open Banking Integrations
    • Build components integrating with banks’ APIs to aggregate and enrich consumer financial data.
    • Handle high-load systems with stringent uptime requirements.
    • Work with Visa’s Tink technologies stack: Java, Node.js, JavaScript, AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, SQL, Datadog and much more.
  • Cloud-Native DevOps
    • Own end-to-end delivery: design, build, deploy, monitor, and maintain services in AWS/Kubernetes/Docker environments.
    • Implement CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, and automated observability using Datadog and related tooling.
    • Participate in on-call rotations to ensure high availability and operational excellence.
  • Collaboration & Mentorship
    • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to a team of engineers, fostering a culture of innovation and excellence.
    • Contribute to AI-first engineering culture—sharing learnings from model experimentation and leveraging AI engineering assistants.
    • Your DNA would include following and creating software best practices and processes
    • You’ll lead meeting and discussions with cross-functional and non-technical teams
    • You have excellent communication and interpersonal skills and above all, you are a team player!

This is a hybrid position. Expectation of days in the office will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.  ​


Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications: 5+ years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or at least 2 years of work experience with an Advanced degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 0 years of work experience with a PhD, OR 8+ years of relevant work experience. Preferred Qualifications: 5+ years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or at least 2 years of work experience with an Advanced degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 0 years of work experience with a PhD, OR 8+ years of relevant work experience. Bachelor degree in Computer Science or related field and at least 8-12 years of Software Development Experience or a Masters with at least 6-12 years of Software Development Experience. We are looking for a Staff Software Engineer with experience of building innovative and scalable products. You understand the trade-offs of speed vs quality on technical decisions and look at problems from different angles. title: Product Manager for Cyber Products
description_html:
About Us
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Job Description

The Product Manager is a key product-focused role responsible for coordinating the development and commercialization of specific cyber products and solutions in the cyber domain. This role will partner with stakeholders across and outside Visa to develop thoroughly vetted requirements, drive product development, and guide market positioning of Visa's cyber products, ensuring alignment with the company's overall business objectives and customer needs.

Key Responsibilities: 

  • Product and solution delivery:  Contribute to the development and delivery of innovative products and capabilities that are future-proof and accessible. 
  • Cross-functional collaboration:  Liaise with multiple teams across Visa to launch, commercialize, and scale cyber solutions innovatively and serve as a bridge between business and technology.   
  • Requirements management:  Translate customer and regional needs into comprehensive requirements, synthesize those requirements into a common set of platform and service capabilities with detailed user stories, and debate their rationale for roadmap prioritization. 
  • Product development:  Oversee product execution through all phases of development through implementation and user adoption, representing customer points of view in planning and technical discussions. 
  • Issue management:  Identify potential issues early, determine resolutions, communicate status, and track and resolve issues promptly. 

​This is a hybrid position. Expectation of days in the office will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:
5 or more years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor's Degree or at least 2 years of work experience with an Advanced degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 0 years of work experience with a PhD

Preferred Qualifications:
6 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor's Degree or 4 or more years of relevant experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or up to 3 years of relevant experience with a PhD
Knowledge of cybersecurity operations and the challenges faced by security leaders.
Understanding of product management principles with experience taking cybersecurity offerings to market preferred.
Strong communicator with excellent interpersonal skills and emotional intelligence.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with demonstrated intellectual and analytical rigor.
Ability to adapt to a dynamic, rapidly changing business environment.
Strong interpersonal and leadership skills to influence and build credibility as a peer among internal and external stakeholders.
Team oriented, collaborative, diplomatic, and flexible, with excellent presentation skills.

Additional information

Visa is an EEO Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

title: Sr. Analyst / Consultant (Fraud Risk)

About Us
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

Job Description

Consulting Expertise:

  • Drives client acceptance by leveraging relationships and strategies that align with Risk Solution Services goals, automation, and retention objectives

  • Regularly discusses and pursues client goals, demonstrating an understanding in clients’ evolving business strategies

  • Continually builds rapport with clients and the Visa account teams to promote retention and stay ahead of competitive risk

  • Anticipates fluctuations and proactively identifies anomalies with business relationships

  • Is an early adopter of complementary Visa products and offerings and is proactive in learning how to leverage updates and enhancements for Visa and client success

  • Advocates productively on behalf of the client about product feedback and enhancement requests

Analysis:

  • Uses Business Intelligence tools to continually highlight client return on investment, aligning acceptance and fraud KPIs with Risk Solution Services objectives

  • Efficiently adheres to clients' contractual reporting requirements

  • Contributes to the continual enhancement of analytical tools

  • Works with BI team to enhance current and future reporting capabilities

Solutions Delivery:

  • Optimizes client acceptance through increased automation, the use of machine-learning models, efficient use of manual review, and reduced reliance on rules

  • Maintains working knowledge of Visa and partner integrations, order and technical flow, and support resources

  • Participates in projects and events that advance Risk Solution Services and Visa success

  • Identifies and influences clients and internal business partners to explore Risk Solution Services and complementary Visa product offerings

  • Remains proficient in Visa and partner integrations, order and technical flow, and support resources

  • Understands how client strategies and risk configurations potentially impact Visa revenue

  • Evangelizes the value of Risk Solution Services and Managed Services by participating in pre-sale and proof of concept engagements

  • Embodies industry best practices

  • Manages projects or processes and provides guidance to colleagues

Communication and Presentation Skills:

  • Communicates independently, professionally, succinctly, and with relevance based on audience and topic

  • Collaborates consistently with internal partners on the status of portfolio

  • Shares efficiencies and best practices with colleagues

  • Provides appropriate detail and can confidently communicate at the executive level

  • Influences others within Risk Solution Services regarding practices, procedures, and policies

Industry Knowledge:

  • Builds industry knowledge through internal and external resources

  • Proactively discusses industry trends and innovations and educates clients on the basics of how payment ecosystems work

  • Understands regional risk regulations

  • Remains current on global competitive landscape

  • Confidently consults clients on how payment ecosystems work

  • Uses knowledge of competitive landscape to shape solutions delivery

This is a hybrid position. Expectation of days in office will be confirmed by your hiring manager.

Qualifications

Education & Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in finance, business, economics, statistics, computer science, or a related field.

  • Minimum 8 years of relevant professional experience, or at least 5 years with an advanced degree (e.g., Master’s, MBA, JD, MD)

Fraud Risk Expertise:

  • Demonstrated experience in payment risk mitigation, fraud detection strategy optimization, and fraud analytics across banking, payments, or financial services.

  • Hands-on experience with fraud detection systems, rule management, and real-time transaction monitoring (e.g., SAS Fraud Management, FICO Falcon, VRM, VCAS).

Technical Skills:

  • Proficient in SQL, Python, Java, or similar programming languages, with a focus on data analysis, machine learning, and algorithm development.

  • Skilled in using BI tools (Power BI, SAP BO, QlikView, Excel) for fraud data analysis and reporting.

  • Experience mining and managing large, diverse datasets.

Visa is an EEO Employer

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.
