title: Oracle Epm Technical Analyst
description_html:
Expedia Group brands power global travel for everyone, everywhere. We design cutting-edge tech to make travel smoother and more memorable, and we create groundbreaking solutions for our partners. Our diverse, vibrant, and welcoming community is essential in driving our success.

Why Join Us?

To shape the future of travel, people must come first. Guided by our Values and Leadership Agreements, we foster an open culture where everyone belongs, differences are celebrated and know that when one of us wins, we all win.

We provide a full benefits package, including exciting travel perks, generous time-off, parental leave, a flexible work model (with some pretty cool offices), and career development resources, all to fuel our employees' passion for travel and ensure a rewarding career journey. We’re building a more open world. Join us.

Team Overview

The Global Financial Technology organization is a strategic partner for all finance functions and a service delivery organization that ensures finance initiatives/dependencies are completed on time and within budget. As a part of the Financial Planning and Reporting team you will get to work on planning and forecasting systems that forms the backbone of our core FP&A processes for Expedia Group.

Position Responsibilities

Design, build, and support Oracle EPM Cloud solutions, with a strong focus on EPBCS, to enable accurate financial planning, forecasting, and reporting. Translate business and finance requirements into well-designed EPBCS models, calculations, and data integrations that align with enterprise standards. Participate in the full development lifecycle—from requirements gathering and design to build, testing, deployment, and ongoing support. Ensure EPM applications are scalable, reliable, well-documented, and easy for business users to adopt.

What You Will Do

  • EPBCS Application Development: Design, configure, and maintain EPBCS applications including dimensions, cubes, forms, dashboards, business rules, and calculations.
  • Business Rule & Calculation Logic: Develop and optimize business rules, Groovy scripts, and calculation logic to support planning, forecasting, allocations, and what-if analysis.
  • Data Integration & Automation: Build and support data integrations using Data Management, EPM Automate, REST APIs, and flat files to load actuals, targets, and reference data from source systems.
  • Operational Excellence: Follow best practices for testing, validation, performance tuning, security setup, and change management to ensure stable and predictable releases.
  • Business Partnership: Work closely with FP&A, Finance, and IT stakeholders to understand requirements, clarify assumptions, and deliver solutions that meet business needs.
  • Documentation & Support: Create clear technical and functional documentation. Provide production support, troubleshoot issues, and assist during forecast and close cycles.
  • Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to simplify models, improve performance, automate processes, and enhance user experience within EPBCS.
  • Cross-Module EPM Exposure: Work with and support integrations between EPBCS and other Oracle EPM Cloud modules, including FCCS, EPCM, and EDM.
  • Narrative Reporting Support: Assist in developing and maintaining Narrative Reporting reports and packages to support management commentary and financial narratives.

Who You Are

  • 4–7 years of experience working with Oracle EPM, with strong hands-on experience in EPBCS (Planning & Budgeting Cloud).
  • Working knowledge of EPCM, FCCS, EDM, and Narrative Reporting.
  • Solid understanding of financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and reporting processes.
  • Experience building dimensions, forms, business rules, and data integrations in EPBCS.
  • Familiar with Groovy scripting, EPM Automate, Data Management, and basic REST API concepts.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to debug calculation and data issues.
  • Good communication skills and the ability to work directly with finance partners.
  • Comfortable working independently while collaborating within a broader EPM or Finance Systems team.

Technical & Delivery Experience

  • Oracle EPBCS / PBCS application development and support
  • Working experience with EPCM, FCCS, EDM, and Narrative Reporting
  • Business Rules, Calc Manager, and Groovy scripting
  • Data Management, data loads, and integrations
  • EPM Automate and batch processing
  • Metadata and dimension design
  • Security and access control
  • Smart View, Narrative Reporting and Excel-based analysis
  • Experience delivering EPBCS enhancements across budget and forecast cycles
  • Participation in multiple planning, forecast, or reporting releases
  • Experience working in Agile or structured delivery models
  • Exposure to ERP or Financial source systems (preferred)

title: Software Development Engineer Iii
description_html:
Expedia Group brands power global travel for everyone, everywhere. We design cutting-edge tech to make travel smoother and more memorable, and we create groundbreaking solutions for our partners. Our diverse, vibrant, and welcoming community is essential in driving our success.

Why Join Us?

To shape the future of travel, people must come first. Guided by our Values and Leadership Agreements, we foster an open culture where everyone belongs, differences are celebrated and know that when one of us wins, we all win.

We provide a full benefits package, including exciting travel perks, generous time-off, parental leave, a flexible work model (with some pretty cool offices), and career development resources, all to fuel our employees' passion for travel and ensure a rewarding career journey. We’re building a more open world. Join us.

About the Team


Expedia Group's Reservations team owns the platform that processes and manages bookings across every Expedia point of sale globally. This is the system that turns a traveler's intent into a confirmed reservation and keeps that reservation accurate, accessible, and actionable throughout the trip lifecycle.

The platform runs on a modern microservices architecture in AWS. It handles millions of booking transactions daily with high availability and low latency. We are in the middle of a significant architecture evolution, making the reservation platform more flexible for product servicing while maintaining the performance and reliability bar our travelers and partners depend on.

This is infrastructure that matters. When it works well, travelers trust Expedia with their plans. When it doesn't, they feel it immediately.


The Role

We are looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer who will own critical backend systems end to end. You will design, build, and operate services that handle real money, real travelers, and real-time constraints. You will make technical decisions that affect the reliability and extensibility of a platform serving hundreds of millions of users.

You will not be handed a spec and asked to implement it. You will identify the right problems to solve, propose the architecture, drive alignment with stakeholders, make trade-offs explicit, and deliver. You will own the operational health of what you build. You will mentor engineers around you and raise the engineering bar for the team through code reviews, design reviews, and technical leadership in ambiguous situations.

This role requires someone who thinks in systems, not features. Someone who asks "what breaks at 10x scale" before writing the first line. Someone who treats operational excellence as a first-class engineering concern, not an afterthought.


What You Will Own

You will design and deliver backend services and APIs that are scalable, resilient, and maintainable. You will drive technical decisions on architecture, data modeling, and system boundaries in a complex multi-service environment. You will identify inefficiencies, performance bottlenecks, and reliability risks in existing systems and fix them without being asked. You will define and uphold engineering standards for code quality, testing, observability, and incident response. You will participate in on-call rotations and treat production issues with the urgency they deserve. You will mentor other engineers, unblock them technically, and help them grow. You will integrate AI/ML capabilities into backend services where they create real product value, with the engineering discipline to do so safely.


Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent professional experience. 5+ years of professional software development experience.


Preferred Expertise

Demonstrated track record of designing, building, and maintaining backend services and APIs at scale in production. Strong foundation in system design, data modeling, and writing secure, maintainable code. Proven ability to own and deliver end-to-end technical solutions in distributed, multi-service environments without close supervision.


Deep expertise in architecting, scaling, and operating distributed backend systems under real production load. Experience integrating AI/ML features into backend services with appropriate guardrails, evaluation, and observability. Track record of driving operational excellence, including monitoring, alerting, SLAs, and incident management. History of influencing technical direction beyond your immediate team through design documents, architecture reviews, or cross-team initiatives. Demonstrated ability to apply data-driven reasoning to engineering decisions, including cost optimization, performance trade-offs, and capacity planning.

If you need assistance with any part of the application or recruiting process due to a disability, or other physical or mental health conditions, please reach out to our Recruiting Accommodations Team through the Accommodation Request.

Introduction to the Team:

We're the Insurance team at Expedia Group, and we're on a mission to redefine how travelers experience peace of mind during their journeys. Whether it's trip protection, flight cancellations, or medical emergencies abroad, our goal is to deliver seamless, reliable, and intelligent insurance experiences across Expedia's suite of brands (like Expedia.com, Vrbo, Hotels.com, and more).
We work closely with different insurance suppliers to onboard their products into our systems and make them available to customers during various booking journeys — such as during checkout, post-purchase, and even through trip management pages. Our team ensures the right protection is offered at the right time, making travel safer and more confident for millions of users.

In this role, you will:

  • Design, develop, and maintain high-quality, scalable, and reliable software services and components, including robust low-level designs, APIs, and data models that support critical business capabilities.

  • Own end-to-end delivery of features and services from technical design and implementation through testing, deployment, and operational support, ensuring performance, security, and maintainability.

  • Lead and participate in system design and code reviews, providing constructive feedback, driving engineering best practices, and elevating code quality and technical standards across the team.

  • Collaborate closely with product managers, architects, and cross-functional engineering teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions, making pragmatic trade-offs between scope, performance, and long-term maintainability.

  • Diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve complex production issues, improve observability, and drive operational excellence through automation, runbooks, and continuous improvement of deployment and release processes.

  • Safely integrate and operate AI/ML‑enabled solutions that improve outcomes, including familiarity with AI-driven systems, tools, or workflows and applying AI/ML concepts to real world products where appropriate.

Experience and Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field; or equivalent related professional experience.

  • 8+ years of relevant experience in backend development in Java/Kotlin

  • Substantial experience as a software development engineer building, testing, and operating production-grade services or applications, including owning features or services through the full software development lifecycle.

  • Exposure to frontend technologies (React, Angular,Javascript) is preferred

  • Proven ability to design and implement clean low-level designs, APIs, and data models, write high-quality code, and apply core computer science and engineering fundamentals to solve complex technical problems.

  • Demonstrated experience with modern software development practices such as version control, CI/CD, automated testing, code reviews, and monitoring/alerting to ensure reliable operation of services in production, including familiarity with AI-driven systems, tools, or workflows and applying AI/ML concepts to real world products.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience designing and evolving large-scale, distributed systems or services, including making architectural decisions, defining interfaces and data contracts, and ensuring reliability, scalability, and performance.

  • Track record of leading technical delivery for complex projects, breaking down ambiguous problems, driving alignment on design decisions, and mentoring other engineers in system design, low-level design, API design, and data modeling.

  • Strong focus on operational excellence, including deep experience with observability, performance tuning, incident response, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement of deployment and release processes.

  • Demonstrated use of data and metrics to inform technical decisions, validate assumptions, and optimize system behavior, including experimentation or A/B testing where applicable.

  • Experience integrating or extending AI/ML capabilities within software systems (for example via platform APIs, SDKs, or services) to enhance user experiences or business outcomes, and the ability to guide teams on responsible, safe use of AI in production workflows, including safely integrating and operating AI/ML‑enabled solutions that improve outcomes.

title: Senior Manager Air Loss Optimization
description_html:
Expedia Group brands power global travel for everyone, everywhere. We design cutting-edge tech to make travel smoother and more memorable, and we create groundbreaking solutions for our partners. Our diverse, vibrant, and welcoming community is essential in driving our success.

Why Join Us?

To shape the future of travel, people must come first. Guided by our Values and Leadership Agreements, we foster an open culture where everyone belongs, differences are celebrated and know that when one of us wins, we all win.

We provide a full benefits package, including exciting travel perks, generous time-off, parental leave, a flexible work model (with some pretty cool offices), and career development resources, all to fuel our employees' passion for travel and ensure a rewarding career journey. We’re building a more open world. Join us.

Senior Manager, Air Loss Optimization

Introduction to the team

The Product Team creates high-quality end-to-end experiences for travelers, partners, and Expedia Group. Our focus on customer-centric innovation enables us to develop products that build loyalty and repeat business. We partner closely with teams across Expedia Group to drive growth and achieve results for our customers and the company.

The Senior Manager, Air Loss Optimization role sits at the intersection of air operations, traveler experience, and product improvement. You will lead the strategy and execution to identify, reduce, and prevent avoidable air-related loss while protecting traveler trust and long-term loyalty. Working closely with Air stakeholders, Operations, Product, Finance, and process owners, you will turn loss insights into measurable actions, stronger controls, and scalable improvements that balance financial outcomes with customer experience

In this role you will:

  • Define and lead the air loss optimization strategy, balancing reduction of avoidable air, agency debit memo, and agent error loss with sustainable financial return on investment

  • Lead and develop a team responsible for agency debit memo, agent error, and air loss prevention, fostering accountability, inclusion, and continuous improvement

  • Establish and run governance forums to align stakeholders on priorities, investment choices, and trade-offs between cost reduction, recovery, and operational efficiency

  • Own end-to-end agency debit memo and agent error management and prevention, including recovery strategies, controls, governance routines, and scalable operating playbooks

  • Identify systemic loss drivers and build data-backed business cases for product, process, or policy changes that reduce loss at scale

  • Partner cross-functionally with Product, Operations, Finance, and other teams to translate insights into implemented, measurable change

  • Recommend air compensation and related policy updates based on return on investment, operational impact, and performance outcomes

  • Set operating rhythms and performance reporting that track loss reduction, recovery effectiveness, and realized business value

  • Act as a senior leader on air loss topics, bringing sound judgment and a practical, value-focused approach to decision-making

  • Deliver a clear, data-driven view of the biggest air loss drivers and where intervention will have the highest return

  • Deliver a prioritized roadmap of operational, process, and product changes to reduce preventable loss

  • Provide stronger governance for agency debit memo and agent error management, including consistent recoup and prevention playbooks

  • Make decisions to support for compensation and policy changes tied to business performance and return on investment

  • Build a high-performing team with clear ownership, scalable processes, and measurable impact


Experience and qualifications:

  • You have 12+ years of total professional experience, including 7+ years of leadership experience leading managers and operational teams in fast-paced, cross-functional environments

  • You must have experience in airline, air servicing, airline policy, agency debit memo management, or other air-related environments

  • You have led operational, financial, loss, revenue recovery, or quality programs in related service environments

  • You use strong analytical skills to interpret trends, isolate systemic drivers, and convert findings into action

  • You can influence across stakeholder groups and lead governance forums or steering committees

  • You have a track record of building business cases and partnering on product, process, or workflow changes

  • You are familiar with agency debit memos, agent error, recoup, policy, and operational control frameworks

title: Lead User Experience Designer
description_html:
Expedia Group brands power global travel for everyone, everywhere. We design cutting-edge tech to make travel smoother and more memorable, and we create groundbreaking solutions for our partners. Our diverse, vibrant, and welcoming community is essential in driving our success.

Why Join Us?

To shape the future of travel, people must come first. Guided by our Values and Leadership Agreements, we foster an open culture where everyone belongs, differences are celebrated and know that when one of us wins, we all win.

We provide a full benefits package, including exciting travel perks, generous time-off, parental leave, a flexible work model (with some pretty cool offices), and career development resources, all to fuel our employees' passion for travel and ensure a rewarding career journey. We’re building a more open world. Join us.

Lead User Experience Designer

Summary
You’ll lead the design of the end-to-end insurance experience across all Expedia Group brands and lines of business, giving travelers confidence when the unexpected happens.

This role is a great fit if you:

  • Map journeys from first tap to claim resolution, using strong interaction and visual design craft plus systems thinking to create patterns and design systems that scale.
  • Focus on understanding the real problem (not just a preferred solution), welcome critique, and use research, data, and AI-powered tools to keep raising the experience bar for our travelers and the team.
  • Challenge the status quo when customer outcomes can be better, and collaborate closely with engineering to turn ambitious ideas into high-quality, resilient, and delightful shipped experiences.

In this role, you will:

  • Lead end-to-end product design for the insurance experience across Expedia Group brands, from clarifying problems and mapping journeys through claim resolution to delivering high-fidelity flows, UI, and prototypes ready for build.
  • Design intelligent, personalized insurance experiences by applying ML- and AI-first thinking to journeys, states, and content, safely integrating and operating AI/ML‑enabled solutions that improve outcomes for travelers and the business.
  • Define and evolve visual and interaction systems (typography, layout, color, motion, components) that scale across brands, platforms, and breakpoints, creating reusable design patterns and systems.
  • Grow our design system by contributing patterns, tokens, and documentation that improve quality, speed, and consistency for the broader team, ensuring solutions are fungible across multiple lines of business and product surfaces.
  • Build expressive, high-fidelity prototypes that bring complex, future-state insurance experiences to life, including motion, transitions, and micro-interactions that clearly communicate behavior and edge cases.
  • Apply strong interaction design, information architecture, accessibility, and inclusive design principles, collaborating closely with engineering and product to ship resilient, high-quality experiences that challenge the status quo when traveler outcomes can be improved.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Design, Human-Computer Interaction, Human Factors, Cognitive Science, or a related field; or equivalent practical experience in UX design.
  • Several years of professional experience as a UX, Product, or Interaction Designer delivering user-centered digital products, with ownership of end-to-end design for features or workflows.
  • Proven ability to independently drive UX design within a defined product area or customer journey, collaborating with product and engineering partners to ship experiences to production.
  • Experience designing complex, multi-step customer journeys or multi-surface experiences (web, mobile web, native app) within a large-scale or multi-domain product ecosystem.
  • Track record of influencing product roadmaps through UX insights, using experimentation, metric analysis, and research to drive iterative improvements and measure the impact of design.
  • Strong skills in interaction design, information architecture, visual design, and prototyping using industry-standard design and prototyping tools, including creating detailed specifications that support implementation.
  • Experience evolving and contributing to design systems, including working with reusable components, patterns, and tokens to drive consistency and quality.
  • Proficiency with using AI tools and agents in day-to-day design workflows to drive efficiency and innovation across the end-to-end design process (from exploration and prototyping to content and design-to-code).


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience planning and executing user research or usability evaluation activities, and applying research and product data to refine designs within a product team environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to work with technical partners on constraints, edge cases, and system behaviors, including designing for data-rich interfaces, recommendations, or personalization at scale.
  • Experience designing AI-driven user experiences—such as intelligent suggestions, automation, or conversational interfaces—and safely integrating and operating AI/ML‑enabled UX solutions in real-world products.

Traveler Service Associate, Premium

We’re looking for a talented customer advocate to join an elite team that will work with our top customers to resolve complex issues - so they can have the best travel experience imaginable! You’ll communicate with our customers in whatever format they prefer, could be a phone call or a chat conversation, or maybe even an email. The ideal candidate will be cool under pressure and comfortable working in situations that at times can be highly stressful. If you excel at figuring out complex problems and enjoy finding resolutions to tough situations, this job could be for you!

Our Corporate Functions are made up of teams that support Expedia Group, including Employee Communications, Finance, Traveler and Partner Service Platform, Legal, People Team, Inclusion and Diversity, and Global Social Impact and Sustainability.

What you'll do:

  • Lead the resolution of issues from online (voice & chat) and offline (Service Requests) sources from start to finish

  • Develop and build a world class travel agent skill set

title: Security Operations Analyst Ii Third Party Risk Management Operations Center
description_html:
Expedia Group brands power global travel for everyone, everywhere. We design cutting-edge tech to make travel smoother and more memorable, and we create groundbreaking solutions for our partners. Our diverse, vibrant, and welcoming community is essential in driving our success.

Why Join Us?

To shape the future of travel, people must come first. Guided by our Values and Leadership Agreements, we foster an open culture where everyone belongs, differences are celebrated and know that when one of us wins, we all win.

We provide a full benefits package, including exciting travel perks, generous time-off, parental leave, a flexible work model (with some pretty cool offices), and career development resources, all to fuel our employees' passion for travel and ensure a rewarding career journey. We’re building a more open world. Join us.

About the Team:

The Expedia Group Security Governance, Risk, Compliance and Privacy (GRCP) organization is building a world‑class Third Party Risk Management (TPRM) Operations Center to support global supplier security and compliance operations.

We are seeking a highly organized and detail‑oriented Security Operations Analyst to support end‑to‑end third party security due diligence, ongoing monitoring, evidence collection, control assessment, documentation, and coordination activities across Expedia Group’s vendor ecosystem.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast‑paced environment, has strong operational discipline, and enjoys working across technical, legal, procurement, and business teams to help manage security and compliance risk from third parties.

As part of the India‑based TPRM Operations Center, you will play a key role in how we execute day‑to‑day third party risk operations and respond to customer, regulatory, and internal stakeholder expectations.

In this role, you will:

  • Support end‑to‑end third party security assessments for new and existing vendors, including scoping, initiating assessments, collecting documentation, and tracking to closure.

  • Review and analyze vendor security evidence (e.g., SOC 2 reports, ISO 27001 certificates, penetration test reports, security policies, questionnaires such as CAIQ/VSAQ/SIG) to identify control coverage, gaps, and issues.

  • Perform structured security and risk evaluations against Expedia Group TPRM standards and industry frameworks (e.g., ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST CSF, PCI DSS, privacy requirements) and document clear, defensible conclusions.

  • Create and manage TPRM tickets and workflows (e.g., in Jira or a third party risk platform), ensuring assessments, findings, and remediation items are logged, updated, and closed within defined SLAs.

  • Coordinate with internal stakeholders (Security, Privacy, Legal, Procurement, Engineering, Product, Business Owners) to obtain required information, clarify use cases, and agree on risk treatment decisions.

  • Engage directly with vendors to clarify questionnaire responses, request additional evidence, explain control expectations, and follow up on remediation or risk treatment actions.

  • Document assessment results including risk ratings, control gaps, compensating controls, and recommended actions in a consistent and audit‑ready manner.

  • Support ongoing monitoring activities, including periodic reassessments, trigger‑based reviews (e.g., incidents, scope changes), certificate and report renewals, and continuous control monitoring where available.

  • Maintain organized repositories of TPRM evidence and artifacts to support repeatable processes, customer due diligence responses, and regulatory examinations.

  • Track and report status of third party assessments, issues, and remediation progress, highlighting risks, blockers, and trends to TPRM and GRCP leadership.

  • Contribute to process and tooling improvements for TPRM workflows, templates, questionnaires, and metrics to drive efficiency, consistency, and better risk decisions.

  • Support broader GRCP initiatives as needed, such as control mapping, new regulatory requirements impacting vendors, or integration of TPRM with other security and compliance programs.

Experience and Preferred Qualifications:

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Engineering, or a related technical field; or equivalent practical experience in security operations or incident response.

  • 3–5 years of experience in third party risk management, security GRC, IT audit, vendor risk, or related technology risk/compliance roles

  • Experience supporting vendor due diligence or security assessments, including reviewing security documentation such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, penetration test reports, or security policies/standards.

  • Familiarity with common security and risk frameworks such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST CSF, PCI DSS, and/or privacy requirements (e.g., GDPR, CCPA) and how they apply to third party environments.

  • Understanding of core information security concepts (e.g., access control, encryption, logging/monitoring, network security, vulnerability management, incident response) and ability to relate them to vendor controls.

  • Comfortable working in workflow and ticketing systems (e.g., Jira, ServiceNow) and ideally exposure to third party risk platforms (e.g., Archer, OneTrust, ServiceNow VRM, or similar).

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience handling complex, multi-stage security incidents in large-scale, distributed, or cloud-based environments, including root cause analysis and post-incident reviews.

  • Information security, audit, or risk certifications are a plus (e.g., CISA, CRISC, Security+, ISO 27001 Associate, CTPRP/CTPRP‑like third party risk certifications).

  • Proven track record of improving SOC effectiveness through detection engineering, runbook optimization, automation, or tuning of security tools to enhance signal quality and response speed.

  • Experience using data-driven approaches to identify security trends, measure operational performance, and prioritize improvements to controls, detections, and processes.

  • Background in integrating or supporting AI/ML-enabled security capabilities (for example behavior analytics, anomaly detection, or automated response) and safely operating these solutions in production.

  • Experience providing technical input into the design or improvement of security architectures, controls, and monitoring for new or existing services, working closely with engineering and platform teams to embed security by design.

At Expedia Group, Data and Analytics are the core of all our strategy and decisions, responsible for the impactful insights that guide and optimize our global sales performance.
Our team helps the commercial operations organization drive transformational projects across the Sales organization. By joining our team as a Data Scientist III, Commercial Operations Analytics, you will put your problem-solving skills to a challenge and contribute to enhancing the Account Management space at EG.
To achieve this, you will build a relationship of trust with stakeholders across Account Management, Commercial Operations, Data Engineering, Machine Learning Science and Product & Tech; and will have the opportunity to produce and deliver insights to commercial leaders.

  • Use your creativity and commercial acumen to frame business challenges as analytical problems and apply problem solving techniques to break it down into concrete set of analytical tasks
  • Extract data from multiple data sources and combine them into the required datasets
  • Apply analytics techniques to deliver insights supporting decision-making of account management stakeholders

  • Articulate confidently decision-making rationale, methodology and recommendation to both technical and non-technical partners, using clear and compelling storytelling in presentations

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a quantitative field such as Business, Economics, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related discipline or equivalent experience
  • Preferred: 5+ years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, or a related field, with a proven track record of delivering insights that drive business impact.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to frame complex business problems as analytical tasks.
  • Proficiency in SQL, Python; previous exposure to AI or automation tools/techniques are a plus
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels, including VP+.

We power the systems behind Pricing, Inventory, Content, and Marketplace Trust & Safety, ensuring travelers find the best deals and most reliable experiences across hotels, vacation rentals, flights, cars, packages, and cruises. Our platforms process trillions of events globally, connecting hundreds of millions of travelers across Expedia Group’s brands.

As a Senior Software Development Engineer, you’ll design and scale the intelligent systems that power Expedia’s global travel marketplace. You’ll work across Content, Pricing & Availability, Trust and Safety domains operating at massive scale and complexity.

Our Content systems manage hundreds of millions of digital assets—images, text, videos, and attributes—that bring destinations and experiences to life. You’ll use machine learning to automate content enrichment, enhance quality, and deliver personalized travel recommendations.

In Pricing & Availability, you’ll build models that optimize real-time pricing and inventory for hotels, rentals, and vehicles—processing millions of products and prices for users per second. Your work ensures travelers see the most accurate, competitive, and relevant prices worldwide.

Within Trust and Safety, you’ll develop models that uphold trust and fairness across Expedia’s two-sided ecosystem, detecting anomalies, mitigating fraud, and supporting partners in delivering high-quality traveler experiences.

If you’re passionate about applying machine learning to complex, high-scale systems that shape how the world travels, join us and help define the future of travel technology at Expedia Group.

In this role, you will:

  • Own end-to-end development of distributed services, including system design, APIs, and data models.

  • Lead delivery across the full SDLC, ensuring high standards for quality, performance, and reliability.

  • Drive technical direction and engineering best practices, including observability, testing, and operational excellence.

  • Partner with Product, Data Science, and ML teams to integrate ML models into scalable, production-grade systems.

  • Support ML-enabled workflows (e.g., feature pipelines, batch/real-time processing) and ensure safe, reliable model deployment.

  • Improve system reliability through monitoring, automation, and continuous improvement.

  • Mentor engineers and elevate team-wide engineering practices.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 8+ years of software engineering experience with ownership of scalable, distributed systems.

  • Strong system design, API development, and microservices experience.

  • Proficiency in Java, Scala, or Python.

  • Experience with CI/CD, testing, and production operations.

  • Working knowledge of ML concepts and experience integrating ML components into production systems.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with large-scale systems, big data technologies (e.g., Spark), and cloud platforms (e.g., AWS).

  • Familiarity with ML platforms (e.g., SageMaker, Databricks) and real-time or batch data processing.

  • Proven technical leadership and ability to influence engineering best practices.

Expedia Group brands power global travel for everyone, everywhere. We design cutting-edge tech to make travel smoother and more memorable, and we create groundbreaking solutions for our partners. Our diverse, vibrant, and welcoming community is essential in driving our success.

Why Join Us?

To shape the future of travel, people must come first. Guided by our Values and Leadership Agreements, we foster an open culture where everyone belongs, differences are celebrated and know that when one of us wins, we all win.

We provide a full benefits package, including exciting travel perks, generous time-off, parental leave, a flexible work model (with some pretty cool offices), and career development resources, all to fuel our employees' passion for travel and ensure a rewarding career journey. We’re building a more open world. Join us.

Senior Manager, Hotel Partner Solutions

Introduction to team

Travel Partnerships and Advertising helps partners, including hotels, vacation rentals, airlines, destination marketing organizations (DMOs) and more, deliver excellent traveler and B2B experiences. We drive growth for our partners and the Expedia Group marketplace through competitive supply and our leading advertising and travel media network.

Make an impact

As a leader within the Travel Partnerships and Advertising division, you will shape how Hotel Partner Solutions responds to and resolves complex, cross-system issues across critical products and partner experiences. This is a high-impact opportunity to lead the Hotel Partner Solutions team, improve reliability at scale, and influence how operational readiness, incident management, and AI-enabled knowledge solutions evolve across the business.

In this role, you will

  • Lead the Hotel Partner Solutions team, setting the vision, priorities, and operating standards for incident management, problem resolution, and operational excellence.
  • Own the end-to-end incident lifecycle for complex, business-critical issues, driving effective triage, stabilization, communication, documentation, and post-incident review.
  • Partner with engineering, product, data, support, and partner-facing teams to identify root causes, strengthen operational controls, and deliver durable fixes that improve reliability and scale.
  • Use operational metrics, SLAs, and SLOs to monitor performance, prioritize the highest-impact work, and improve customer and partner outcomes.
  • Build and scale high-quality runbooks, playbooks, and knowledge artifacts that enable consistency, self-service, automation, and AI-ready operational support.
  • Hire, develop, and lead a high-performing team, creating a culture of ownership, learning, continuous improvement, and psychological safety.

Experience and Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related technical field; or Equivalent related professional experience
  • 8+ years of experience in technical operations, site reliability, technical support engineering, or a closely related field supporting large-scale or business-critical systems, including 3+ years of people management experience leading technical teams
  • You have strong experience leading incident and problem management for complex, cross-system issues, including post-incident reviews and driving long-term corrective actions
  • You have demonstrated experience using operational metrics such as SLAs, SLOs, incident trends, volume, severity, AHT, and deflection to prioritize work and quantify improvements in reliability, efficiency, and customer and partner experience
  • You bring strong technical fluency across APIs, technical understanding of connectivity , cloud infrastructure, and observability and monitoring tools, with hands-on experience working with technical data formats such as JSON and XML and nice to have knowledge with CMR system such as Salesforce, Confluence and Jira
  • You communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders and can influence cross-functional decisions in a matrixed environment

Preferred Qualifications

  • You have experience leading technical operations Tier 3 support, customer- or partner-facing environment such as travel, e-commerce, marketplaces, or SaaS
  • You have worked closely with software engineering, SRE, or platform teams on reliability, performance, or observability initiatives
  • You bring familiarity with AI-powered operations tools such as automated triage, summarization, knowledge generation, or anomaly detection, along with an understanding of their risks and limitations
  • You have experience working with global, distributed teams and balancing priorities across time zones
  • You have a track record of building inclusive, high-engagement teams and developing future leaders

title: Advanced Traveler Escalations Manager
description_html:
Expedia Group brands power global travel for everyone, everywhere. We design cutting-edge tech to make travel smoother and more memorable, and we create groundbreaking solutions for our partners. Our diverse, vibrant, and welcoming community is essential in driving our success.

Why Join Us?

To shape the future of travel, people must come first. Guided by our Values and Leadership Agreements, we foster an open culture where everyone belongs, differences are celebrated and know that when one of us wins, we all win.

We provide a full benefits package, including exciting travel perks, generous time-off, parental leave, a flexible work model (with some pretty cool offices), and career development resources, all to fuel our employees' passion for travel and ensure a rewarding career journey. We’re building a more open world. Join us.

Advanced Traveler Escalations Manager

Introduction to the team

The Product Team creates high-quality end-to-end experiences for travelers, partners, and Expedia Group. Our focus on customer-centric innovation enables us to develop products that build loyalty and repeat business. We partner closely with teams across Expedia Group to drive growth and achieve results for our customers and the company.

We’re looking for a Manager in our VRBO Escalations team, a dynamic, people-first leader who thrives in fast-paced, high-impact environments. In this role, you’ll oversee a team that manages Expedia Group’s most complex traveler situations in real time, ensuring every experience is handled with empathy, expertise, and resolution ownership.

As part of the Escalations leadership team, you’ll play a key role in building and scaling a premium capability designed to support our most valued travelers across all Expedia Group brands. This is an opportunity to shape the traveler experience at its most critical moments and contribute directly to our mission of making travel easier and more joyful for everyone.

In this role, you will:

As an Advanced Traveler Escalations Manager, you’ll lead a passionate team that resolves our most complex traveler cases with empathy, accountability, and care. You’ll help shape an exceptional service experience, one that earns traveler loyalty and reinforces Expedia Group’s mission & vision to make travel easier and more joyful for everyone. You thrive in ambiguity, excel at cross-functional collaboration, and are motivated by the opportunity to make an impact in the global travel industry.

  • Build and nurture a high-performing team that’s connected to our mission of serving travelers with heart.

  • Create an inspiring environment where people feel trusted, supported, and motivated to deliver their best.

  • Coach and develop supervisors to grow as people leaders—fostering open, honest conversations that support individual development and team success.

  • Champion a diverse and inclusive culture where every voice is heard, respected, and valued.

  • Lead day-to-day operations with a clear focus on performance, quality, and traveler experience.

  • Define and communicate KPIs, OKRs, and success metrics that keep the team aligned and accountable.

  • Use data and operational reporting to identify opportunities, optimize processes, and drive continuous improvement.

  • Translate real-world frontline insights into smarter workflows, better tools, and scalable solutions.

  • Foster a culture of ownership and resolution—ensuring every traveler issue is handled end-to-end with care and accountability.

  • Empower your team to make confident decisions that prioritize traveler trust and satisfaction.

  • Champion traveler advocacy by listening, empathizing, and finding creative solutions that turn challenges into positive experiences.

  • Strive to deliver service so great, it becomes the reason travelers choose Expedia again and again.

  • Build strong, trusted relationships across partner teams, Operations, Training, Workforce, and beyond—to align on goals and remove roadblocks.

  • Representing the Escalations function as a voice of expertise and insight, ensuring business and traveler needs stay connected.

  • Collaborate across regions and function to drive consistency and share best practices across our global network.

  • Review resource and skill requirements across teams, ensuring coverage, readiness, and cross-training for peak moments.

  • Maintain business continuity plans that keep teams and travelers supported ~ even during unexpected disruptions.

  • Anticipate future needs and build flexible, scalable solutions that keep the business running smoothly.

  • Model Expedia Group’s values in everything you do ~ trust, accountability, inclusion, and transparency.

  • Promote a sense of shared purpose ~ we’re all Expedians, working together to deliver on our commitments.

  • Listen to team feedback, act on engagement insights, and drive initiatives that improve connection, trust, and retention.

  • Celebrate wins, learn from challenges, and create an environment where people grow and thrive.

Qualifications & Experience:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree from an accredited university, or equivalent related professional experience

  • Minimum 8+ years of work experience in Customer Experience domain, including 3+ years in a people management role

  • Proven experience managing customer service or escalations teams in a large-scale, fast-paced environment

  • Strong understanding of process optimization, performance management, and operational excellence principles

  • Demonstrated success in building, leading, and developing high-performing teams

  • Excellent analytical, strategic planning, and problem-solving abilities

  • Solid understanding of local employment laws and regulations

  • Experience in cultivating cross-functional relationships and collaborating effectively across business and technical teams

  • Familiarity with call center technologies and tools (CRM, telephony, workflow systems, etc.)

  • Experience working across multiple geographies and adapting to diverse cultural contexts

  • Willingness and ability to travel periodically, both domestically and internationally

  • Travel industry experience preferred

  • Willingness to work a rotating schedule across weekdays, and shifts as needed; adaptable to business needs across voice, chat, and email.

If you are passionate about elevating customer experience, driving operational excellence, and shaping the future of travel, this is the role for you.

Accommodation requests

If you need assistance with any part of the application or recruiting process due to a disability, or other physical or mental health conditions, please reach out to our Recruiting Accommodations Team through the Accommodation Request.

We are proud to be named as a Best Place to Work on Glassdoor in 2024 and be recognized for award-winning culture by organizations like Forbes, TIME, Disability:IN, and others.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description_html:
Expedia Group brands power global travel for everyone, everywhere. We design cutting-edge tech to make travel smoother and more memorable, and we create groundbreaking solutions for our partners. Our diverse, vibrant, and welcoming community is essential in driving our success.

Why Join Us?

To shape the future of travel, people must come first. Guided by our Values and Leadership Agreements, we foster an open culture where everyone belongs, differences are celebrated and know that when one of us wins, we all win.

We provide a full benefits package, including exciting travel perks, generous time-off, parental leave, a flexible work model (with some pretty cool offices), and career development resources, all to fuel our employees' passion for travel and ensure a rewarding career journey. We’re building a more open world. Join us.

Senior Software Development Engineer

Introduction to team

Expedia Product & Technology builds innovative products, services, and tools to deliver high-quality experiences for travelers, partners, and our employees. A singular technology platform powered by data and machine learning provides secure, differentiated, and personalized experiences for the traveler and our partners that drive loyalty and customer satisfaction.
We, in the Expedia Group’s Strategic Partnerships and Affiliates Team, are building the next-generation, scalable B2B partnership platform that will power hundreds of thousands of demand partners across the industry ranging from big businesses to small bloggers and micro influencers in helping them recommend Expedia Group brands to their audiences and in the process grow their businesses. We aim to redefine the travel partnerships sector by building innovative partner tools and solutions that incorporates the new ways in which today’s travelers discover and shop travel products.

In this role, your expertise and passion for innovation, developing cutting-edge technology and implementing industry-leading solutions, will improve the experience of millions of travelers and travel partners each year. You will work with a geo-distributed, cross functional team of 20+ engineers designing and developing solutions for complex problems with a wide-reaching business impact.

In this role, you will:

  • Design, build, and maintain highly available, performant, and secure services and applications, including clear low-level designs, API designs, and data models that align with Expedia Group engineering standards.

  • Lead end-to-end development of complex features, writing high-quality, testable code and ensuring robust automated testing, CI/CD integration, monitoring, and alerting for the services you own.

  • Design and develop complex software systems and services, applying advanced system design, API design, and data modeling techniques

  • Lead the implementation of scalable, reliable, and maintainable solutions across multiple domains or platforms

  • Drive technical decisions and mentor other engineers to elevate team knowledge and performance

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions

  • Safely integrate and operate AI/ML-enabled solutions that improve outcomes, ensuring responsible and effective use of AI technologies

  • Foster a culture of continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to optimize processes, code quality, and system performance


Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field; or Equivalent related professional experience

  • 8+ years of professional backend software development experience in an object‑oriented language (e.g., Java, Kotlin, or similar)

  • Demonstrated ownership of services, multi-service architectures, or domain solutions at an organizational level

  • Proven expertise in advanced system design, API development, and data modeling for large-scale distributed systems

  • Familiarity with AI-driven systems, tools, or workflows and applying AI/ML concepts to real world products


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Deep experience designing, scaling, and operating distributed systems in production environments

  • Track record of providing technical leadership and driving architectural decisions for complex projects

  • Experience leveraging AI/ML to deliver innovative solutions within system and software engineering contexts

description_html:
Expedia Group brands power global travel for everyone, everywhere. We design cutting-edge tech to make travel smoother and more memorable, and we create groundbreaking solutions for our partners. Our diverse, vibrant, and welcoming community is essential in driving our success.

About the role:

We’re building a scalable, cloud‑native foundation for all future accounting use‑cases. The successful candidate will own the design, implementation, and roadmap for our Oracle‑based PaaS stack (OIC + Oracle Financial Gateway) and ensure it can meet the evolving demands of transactional accounting.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own current OIC + Oracle Financial Gateway implementation: assess health, optimize performance, and ensure production stability.
  • Define the roadmap for extending the platform to cover new transactional accounting use‑cases
  • Collaborate with finance SMEs, data‑engineers, and product owners to capture functional requirements and translate them into integration patterns.
  • Set standards for integration design, testing, monitoring, and documentation across the finance PaaS stack.
  • Mentor junior engineers and act as the go‑to oracle‑PaaS subject matter expert within the broader engineering org.
  • Build observability & operability— logging, monitoring, alerting, and reconciliation/completeness checks; partner with operations on runbooks and supportability.


Qualifications

  • Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) – end‑to‑end design, deployment, monitoring, and performance tuning of integrations.
  • Oracle Financial Gateway (or an equivalent Oracle Finance middleware) – deep hands‑on experience configuring, securing, and troubleshooting the service.
  • Java / Spring Boot (or comparable JVM‑based backend) – building the service layer that consumes/publishes to OIC.
  • SQL / PL‑SQL – writing performant queries, stored procedures, and data‑validation logic for financial data.
  • CI/CD & Infra‑as‑Code – GitHub Actions / Jenkins pipelines, Docker + Kubernetes (or OCI container engine), Terraform/OCI Resource Manager.
  • Strong analytical ability to translate accounting use‑cases into robust integration flows.
  • Performance & reliability mindset— designing for volume growth, monitoring, error recovery, and reprocessing.
  • Experience with other PaaS integration platforms such as MuleSoft, Dell Boomi, Azure Logic Apps, or Google Cloud Workflows.
  • Familiarity with Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials or Oracle EBS Finance modules – understanding underlying data models helps with mapping.
  • Event‑driven architectures – Kafka, Pulsar, or OCI Streaming for real‑time accounting events.
  • NoSQL data stores (Cassandra, DynamoDB, OCI NoSQL) for audit logs or high‑speed lookup tables.
  • Advanced security/compliance knowledge – OAuth 2.0/OIDC, mutual TLS, SOX/PCI controls for financial data.
  • Oracle Cloud certifications— OIC Developer, OCI Architect, or Oracle Financials Cloud.
  • Automation testing frameworks for integration flows
  • Infrastructure monitoring & alerting

As a Competitive Intelligence Analyst, you will be working in one of the industry's leading competitive intelligence teams, supporting all lines of business within Expedia Group.

Your curiosity, ambition, and appetite for uncovering insights from competitors' data will directly impact many areas of the business, translating into increased competitiveness and revenue opportunities for Expedia.

Why Join Us?

To shape the future of travel, people must come first. Guided by our Values and Leadership Agreements, we foster an open culture where everyone belongs, differences are celebrated, and we know that when one of us wins, we all win.

If you enjoy solving complex problems, work effectively with cross-functional teams, and thrive in a constantly evolving landscape, then this opportunity will be exciting for you.

In this role, you will:

Analyse Data and Generate Insights

  • Create information flows to support business execution.

  • Drive data collection, scheduling, and build quality‑control monitoring to create and enrich datasets of competitive insights.

  • Develop systems and processes to monitor competitiveness through data sourced from external vendors.

  • Design workflows and define tests to ensure internal stakeholders leverage accurate and relevant data efficiently.

  • Fulfil ad‑hoc requests for data and analysis.

Streamline Case Operations and Resolution

  • Lead a small team of external contractors responsible for investigating and resolving pricing cases.

  • Act as the primary point of escalation for complex or high‑impact pricing issues.

Solving Problems and Communicating

  • Exhibit top‑class business acumen, rigor, and a problem‑solving mindset with attention to detail.

  • Demonstrate high intellectual curiosity and a focus on deriving actionable business insights.

  • Effectively visualize complex data.

  • Possess strong written and oral communication skills.

  • Be technically adept.

  • Partner with internal groups to support and understand their business needs.

Establish Trust and Collaborative Working Relationships

  • Provide high‑level daily customer service as the team's primary liaison to a large, multinational group of customers within Expedia's lodging organization.

  • Partner with internal data teams to identify and resolve data integrity issues.

Experience and Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, engineering, or a related field required. MBA from a top‑tier program preferred.

title: Learning And Development Trainer
description_html:
Expedia Group brands power global travel for everyone, everywhere. We design cutting-edge tech to make travel smoother and more memorable, and we create groundbreaking solutions for our partners. Our diverse, vibrant, and welcoming community is essential in driving our success.

Why Join Us?

To shape the future of travel, people must come first. Guided by our Values and Leadership Agreements, we foster an open culture where everyone belongs, differences are celebrated and know that when one of us wins, we all win.

We provide a full benefits package, including exciting travel perks, generous time-off, parental leave, a flexible work model (with some pretty cool offices), and career development resources, all to fuel our employees' passion for travel and ensure a rewarding career journey. We’re building a more open world. Join us.

Learning and Development Trainer

The L&D team is responsible for facilitating learning experiences in a job-specific area and for on-the-job capabilities needed for TPSP’s global footprint. We manage the activities involved in the preparation, delivery and assessment of training and development solutions for Expedia Group TPSP. The team collaborates with Instructional Designers, Operations and Quality Assurance representatives to improve performance. The ideal candidate will be a self-starter with a passion for talent development, a high level of flexibility, commitment, and the ability to train and coach within a high paced customer centric contact centre environment.

Expedia Group brands power global travel for everyone, everywhere. We design cutting-edge tech to make travel smoother and more memorable, and we create groundbreaking solutions for our partners. Our diverse, vibrant, and welcoming community is essential in driving our success.

Our Corporate Functions are made up of teams that support Expedia Group, including Employee Communications, Finance, Traveler and Partner Service Platform, Legal, People Team, Inclusion and Diversity, and Global Social Impact and Sustainability.

TPSP provides the platform and services to handle the service requests from travellers across the multiple brands of Expedia Group, in all locations. This role will partner with the global team, supporting team members, interacting with internal customers (employees) of all levels and external vendors in delivering our products and services.

What you’ll do:

  • Facilitate training to support global TPSP initiatives for different Line of Businesses

  • Manage the learning environment: in person and virtual learning and create a positive learning environment in which participants feel safe to try new skills

  • Prepare for training delivery by reviewing materials and participant needs

  • Facilitate training using various learning methods to meet the needs of learners and the curriculum. Encourage participation and builds learner motivation

  • Deliver constructive feedback to encourage self-discovery and continuous learning

  • Ensure learning outcomes by checking for understanding and skill acquisition and report findings and make recommendations to aid decisions making

  • Manage projects as assigned by the Learning Team leadership

  • Establishes and maintains positive working relationships with agents, peers, management, corporate, and partners

  • Report performance of training classes, conduct training needs analysis and plan interventions for performance improvement

Who you are:

  • Training: Facilitating adult learning solutions in a contact centre environment preferably within the travel industry

  • Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communications skills; ensures the intended message is communicated clearly and in ways that meet the learner’s needs

  • Strong organization skills: The ability to develop plans and set priorities; manage multiple priorities at one time

  • Problem solving: Analytical problem-solving skills; linear and logical troubleshooting skills

  • Business judgment: Ability to demonstrate good judgment and proactive problem-solving methods

  • Learning theory: Can apply principles of adult learning theory to learning experiences

  • Trust Each Other: We are all Expedians. We are accountable to each other to deliver on our commitments, and we will trust our team members to help get it done

  • Traveller Focus: Promote a strong disposition to Traveller advocacy. Convey to the trainees how to passionately meet or exceed traveller expectations

  • Embodies Expedia Inc. values and beliefs and shares these both internally and externally

  • 2 years + experience in contact centre

  • Travel knowledge: Minimum 1 year experience in the travel industry

  • Good knowledge of Data dashboards, LMS, MS-Excel and PowerPoint

  • Willing to work in rotational shifts and weekends as required by the business

Accommodation requests

If you need assistance with any part of the application or recruiting process due to a disability, or other physical or mental health conditions, please reach out to our Recruiting Accommodations Team through the Accommodation Request.

We are proud to be named as a Best Place to Work on Glassdoor in 2024 and be recognized for award-winning culture by organizations like Forbes, TIME, Disability:IN, and others.

            <h3>About us: Media.Net</h3>
<p>Media.net is a leading global ad tech company, building innovative products and solutions for advertisers and publishers. Media.net creates the most transparent and efficient path for ad budgets to become publisher revenue, while delivering meaningful value to advertisers, publishers, app developers, and end users across the open web. </p>
<p>We are one of the world’s largest independent contextual advertising businesses, with one of the industry’s most comprehensive advertising technology portfolios. Media.net powers major publishers and ad-tech platforms across formats, including display, video, mobile, native, search, and local. Our platform manages high-quality ad supply across 500,000+ websites and is licensed by the biggest publishers, ad networks, and technology partners worldwide.</p>
<p>Beyond our core advertising business, Media.net also operates at scale in performance-driven consumer acquisition, app development and distribution, and strategic technology investments. These efforts are supported by one of the world’s largest independent software development engines, enabling us to innovate rapidly and build products used across global markets.</p>
<p>Media.net is home to 1,300+ employees, with key operations across North America, Europe, and Asia. Our US headquarters is in New York, and our global headquarters is in Dubai. Across 50+ demand partners, 21K+ publishers, and a growing portfolio of products and services, we take great pride in driving trusted, transparent, and scalable results.</p>
<p>About the Role<br />
We are looking for a Data & Spam Analyst to join our growing AdTech team. This hybrid role combines data driven analysis with spam/fraud detection to ensure both accurate business reporting and a secure advertising ecosystem. The ideal candidate will be adept at analyzing large datasets, delivering actionable insights, and proactively identifying fraudulent or spammy activities that can impact performance and revenue integrity.</p>
<p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong><br />
<strong>Business & Data Analytics</strong><br />
• Manage business reporting for multiple teams and consistently monitor performance against KPIs.<br />
• Verify the integrity and accuracy of revenue reporting across systems<br />
• Track and analyze critical data points influencing core business activities, escalating insights to<br />
stakeholders when necessary.<br />
• Deliver ad-hoc reports and presentations for urgent business needs, ensuring accuracy and<br />
timeliness.<br />
• Execute daily, weekly, and monthly reporting processes as per business requirements to drive<br />
operational excellence.</p>
<p><strong>Spam & Fraud Analysis</strong><br />
• Monitor ad traffic, user behavior, and system logs to detect anomalies, fraudulent activity, and spam<br />
patterns.<br />
• Investigate suspicious activity, including invalid clicks, bot traffic, ad stacking, cloaking, and<br />
impression fraud.<br />
• Develop and refine rules, filters, and detection mechanisms to mitigate fraud and protect advertising<br />
integrity.<br />
• Collaborate with product, compliance, and engineering teams to strengthen spam/fraud detection<br />
systems.<br />
• Document fraud/spam cases with clear evidence, providing insights to prevent recurrence and<br />
improve platform trust.<br />
• Stay up to date with emerging spam and fraud trends in the AdTech ecosystem, recommending<br />
proactive defense strategies.</p>
<p><strong>Technical Skills</strong><br />
<strong>Required</strong><br />
• Proficiency in SQL and Excel for querying, reporting, and data manipulation.<br />
• Familiarity with Python for automation, anomaly detection, and data processing.<br />
• Skilled in creating dashboards and visualizations using BI tools (Tableau, Power BI, Looker, etc.).<br />
• Strong understanding of ETL processes and ability to manage master data across multiple sources.<br />
• Keen attention to detail with the ability to analyze numbers, spot patterns, and identify anomalies.</p>
<p><strong>Good to Have</strong><br />
• Experience with statistical and analytical tools (SAS, SPSS, R).<br />
• Knowledge of fraud/spam detection methodologies in digital advertising.<br />
• Familiarity with big data tools (Hive, Spark, Presto).<br />
• Understanding of advertising platforms (Google Ads, DSPs, SSPs, Exchanges).<br />
• Exposure to machine learning models for fraud detection is a plus.</p>
<p><strong>Soft Skills</strong><br />
• Strong communication skills to present insights clearly to both technical and non-technical<br />
stakeholders.<br />
• Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced AdTech environment.<br />
• Proactive problem-solver with an investigative mindset and high ethical standards.<br />
• Ability to work cross-functionally with product, finance, engineering, and compliance teams.</p>
<p><strong>Qualifications</strong><br />
• Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, or related<br />
field. (BE, BSc (IT), BCA, MCA, BSc(CS))<br />
• 3–5 years of experience in Data Analytics, Spam/Fraud Analysis, or related roles within AdTech,<br />
digital marketing, or internet technology companies.<br />
• Proven ability to work with large datasets and generate actionable insights.<br />
• Demonstrated experience in fraud/spam detection or risk analytics is highly preferred.<br />
• Strong business acumen with the ability to connect data insights to revenue, profitability, and<br />
operational efficiency.</p>
<p><strong>Why Join Us?</strong><br />
• Be part of a high-impact team safeguarding advertising integrity while driving business growth.<br />
• Work at the intersection of data analytics, fraud prevention, and AdTech innovation.<br />
• Opportunity to develop advanced skills in spam/fraud detection frameworks and data-driven<br />
business strategy.</p>
<h3>Benefits & Perks</h3>
<p>At Media.Net people love their jobs, and not just because we offer the most competitive salaries in the industry. Our excellent benefits include everything from great medical and life insurance to catered meals. Our workspaces are comfortable and fun, complete with bean bag chairs, ping pong tables, and all the snacks you can eat. We have no dress code (tee-shirts are a-ok!). We have flexible work hours and flexible holidays, which means that teams pick their own work hours. Media.Net has its own concierge desk that doubles up as a travel agency.</p>
<p>We are passionate about building the next generation of web products, and we believe that happy employees are the key to achieving this goal. If you like the idea of working in an exciting workspace on cutting-edge internet products that make a truly global impact (and wearing flip-flops to work), then we want to get to know you!</p>

            About us: Media.Net
Media.net is a leading global ad tech company, building innovative products and solutions for advertisers and publishers. Media.net creates the most transparent and efficient path for ad budgets to become publisher revenue, while delivering meaningful value to advertisers, publishers, app developers, and end users across the open web. 
We are one of the world’s largest independent contextual advertising businesses, with one of the industry’s most comprehensive advertising technology portfolios. Media.net powers major publishers and ad-tech platforms across formats, including display, video, mobile, native, search, and local. Our platform manages high-quality ad supply across 500,000+ websites and is licensed by the biggest publishers, ad networks, and technology partners worldwide.
Beyond our core advertising business, Media.net also operates at scale in performance-driven consumer acquisition, app development and distribution, and strategic technology investments. These efforts are supported by one of the world’s largest independent software development engines, enabling us to innovate rapidly and build products used across global markets.
Media.net is home to 1,300+ employees, with key operations across North America, Europe, and Asia. Our US headquarters is in New York, and our global headquarters is in Dubai. Across 50+ demand partners, 21K+ publishers, and a growing portfolio of products and services, we take great pride in driving trusted, transparent, and scalable results.
About the Role
We are looking for a Data & Spam Analyst to join our growing AdTech team. This hybrid role combines data driven analysis with spam/fraud detection to ensure both accurate business reporting and a secure advertising ecosystem. The ideal candidate will be adept at analyzing large datasets, delivering actionable insights, and proactively identifying fraudulent or spammy activities that can impact performance and revenue integrity.
Key Responsibilities
Business & Data Analytics
• Manage business reporting for multiple teams and consistently monitor performance against KPIs.
• Verify the integrity and accuracy of revenue reporting across systems
• Track and analyze critical data points influencing core business activities, escalating insights to
stakeholders when necessary.
• Deliver ad-hoc reports and presentations for urgent business needs, ensuring accuracy and
timeliness.
• Execute daily, weekly, and monthly reporting processes as per business requirements to drive
operational excellence.
Spam & Fraud Analysis
• Monitor ad traffic, user behavior, and system logs to detect anomalies, fraudulent activity, and spam
patterns.
• Investigate suspicious activity, including invalid clicks, bot traffic, ad stacking, cloaking, and
impression fraud.
• Develop and refine rules, filters, and detection mechanisms to mitigate fraud and protect advertising
integrity.
• Collaborate with product, compliance, and engineering teams to strengthen spam/fraud detection
systems.
• Document fraud/spam cases with clear evidence, providing insights to prevent recurrence and
improve platform trust.
• Stay up to date with emerging spam and fraud trends in the AdTech ecosystem, recommending
proactive defense strategies.
Technical Skills
Required
• Proficiency in SQL and Excel for querying, reporting, and data manipulation.
• Familiarity with Python for automation, anomaly detection, and data processing.
• Skilled in creating dashboards and visualizations using BI tools (Tableau, Power BI, Looker, etc.).
• Strong understanding of ETL processes and ability to manage master data across multiple sources.
• Keen attention to detail with the ability to analyze numbers, spot patterns, and identify anomalies.
Good to Have
• Experience with statistical and analytical tools (SAS, SPSS, R).
• Knowledge of fraud/spam detection methodologies in digital advertising.
• Familiarity with big data tools (Hive, Spark, Presto).
• Understanding of advertising platforms (Google Ads, DSPs, SSPs, Exchanges).
• Exposure to machine learning models for fraud detection is a plus.
Soft Skills
• Strong communication skills to present insights clearly to both technical and non-technical
stakeholders.
• Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced AdTech environment.
• Proactive problem-solver with an investigative mindset and high ethical standards.
• Ability to work cross-functionally with product, finance, engineering, and compliance teams.
Qualifications
• Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, or related
field. (BE, BSc (IT), BCA, MCA, BSc(CS))
• 3–5 years of experience in Data Analytics, Spam/Fraud Analysis, or related roles within AdTech,
digital marketing, or internet technology companies.
• Proven ability to work with large datasets and generate actionable insights.
• Demonstrated experience in fraud/spam detection or risk analytics is highly preferred.
• Strong business acumen with the ability to connect data insights to revenue, profitability, and
operational efficiency.
Why Join Us?
• Be part of a high-impact team safeguarding advertising integrity while driving business growth.
• Work at the intersection of data analytics, fraud prevention, and AdTech innovation.
• Opportunity to develop advanced skills in spam/fraud detection frameworks and data-driven
business strategy.
Benefits & Perks
At Media.Net people love their jobs, and not just because we offer the most competitive salaries in the industry. Our excellent benefits include everything from great medical and life insurance to catered meals. Our workspaces are comfortable and fun, complete with bean bag chairs, ping pong tables, and all the snacks you can eat. We have no dress code (tee-shirts are a-ok!). We have flexible work hours and flexible holidays, which means that teams pick their own work hours. Media.Net has its own concierge desk that doubles up as a travel agency.
We are passionate about building the next generation of web products, and we believe that happy employees are the key to achieving this goal. If you like the idea of working in an exciting workspace on cutting-edge internet products that make a truly global impact (and wearing flip-flops to work), then we want to get to know you!
            
            
    Apply Now
