            <h3>About us: Media.Net</h3>
<p>Media.net, powers the Yahoo! Bing Network Contextual Ads program and is a leading global contextual advertising company that provides a wide range of advertising and traffic monetization solutions. Our diverse client base includes web publishers with premium content as well as registrars, hosting companies and holders of high value domain portfolios. We aim to consistently deliver long-term superior performance by using leading-edge technology, high-quality research, and proprietary processes that allow us to display the most precisely targeted, highest paying sponsored links and ad topics. We serve our contextual real-time ads customized for each visitor and each page view across billions of visitors, across 10’s of millions sites/domains on a server infrastructure that runs 1000+ CPUs, terabytes of RAM, and 1000’s of terabytes of data.</p>
<p>With more than 1700+ employees, Media.net has one of the largest teams worldwide building a global contextual advertising business. By market cap, Media.net is one of the Top 5 largest ad tech companies worldwide. By revenue, Media.net is the #2 largest contextual advertising businesses worldwide.</p>
<p>Media.net is acquired by Chinese Consortium for $900 Million USD in 3rd Largest Ad Tech deal ever and this acquisition will fuel Media.net’s global expansion strategy and provide access to China’s world-class talent and capital markets.</p>
<p><strong>About The Role</strong></p>
<p>We are looking for creative and analytical minds that can conceptualize and execute on the synergistic union of technology, user experience and monetization of online products. These products range from fledgling ideas that need nurturing to become functional and scalable, to large multi-billion dollar brands looking to grow their user base, enhance user retention or optimize their monetization. Be it solving mundane problems with a utility focused approach or creating newer products that engage and excite a range of audiences, the role requires agile individuals who can leverage Media.net’s technology and resources to drive success.<br />
The role requires you to collaborate with creative, product, engineering, media, analytics, sales, publisher management, demand management and compliance/legal to develop impactful experiences that engage customers and drive adoption. You would work with partners, vendors and clients and synergize our businesses by integrating/supporting their products/offerings or taking on projects geared towards achieving a client’s specific goals. You will build competition and market intelligence through research to make decisions on branding, positioning, prioritization of features/integrations and ensure successful execution around the growth and monetization of the products/projects assigned. It would be crucial for you to track product KPIs and take data driven decisions for product enhancements that impact business</p>
<p><strong>What You Will Do</strong></p>
<p>Go-to-market Strategy<br />
• Target Market and Competitive Research<br />
• Product Positioning & Feature Conceptualization<br />
• Managing Product Launches<br />
• Content & Messaging Strategy<br />
• User segmentation & identifying targeted marketing strategies</p>
<p>Experimentation<br />
• Defining KPIs and goals<br />
• Measuring progress & assessing the impact of these products<br />
• Monitor Key Customer Satisfaction Indicators</p>
<p>Product Adoption & Growth<br />
• Onboarding Customers<br />
• User Engagement Strategy & Execution<br />
• Iterative Testing and Product Improvisation<br />
• Consumer Journey Optimization<br />
• Re-engagement Strategies</p>
<p>Team Building & Management<br />
• Build & manage a team to drive required efforts<br />
• Monitor performance and plan goal-setting for the future<br />
• Define processes & roles to be followed for task execution<br />
• Mentor existing reportees & train new employees</p>
<p>Monetisation<br />
• Drive monetisation strategy balanced by a customer centric approach<br />
• Identify new revenue sources and optimize existing ones<br />
• Maximize user LTV using a combination of best working and new market practices</p>
<p><strong>What We Look for in a Candidate</strong></p>
<p>Required Experience<br />
• You have 2-6+ of overall work experience<br />
• You have 2-5+ years of relevant experience in marketing/product/online customer success in a technology company or startup.</p>
<p>Leadership Qualities<br />
• You have the ability to collaborate and build relationships and influence decisions at multiple levels of an organization<br />
• You thrive in a robust environment and align available resources to a common goal</p>
<p>Creative Mindset<br />
• You have a passion for technology, and a keen eye to identify opportunity in an ever-changing landscape<br />
• You have strong analytical skills geared towards iterative solution of user problems based with data</p>
<p>Problem Solver<br />
• You are proactive in your approach to problem solving and navigating ambiguity and complexity</p>
<p>Logical Approach<br />
• You think quick on your feet and can derive actionable insights based on information available<br />
• You are an expert communicator who can lead and manage relationships across organizational boundaries and vendor relationships</p>
<h3>Benefits & Perks</h3>
<p>At Media.Net people love their jobs, and not just because we offer the most competitive salaries in the industry. Our excellent benefits include everything from great medical and life insurance to catered meals. Our workspaces are comfortable and fun, complete with bean bag chairs, ping pong tables, and all the snacks you can eat. We have no dress code (tee-shirts are a-ok!). We have flexible work hours and flexible holidays, which means that teams pick their own work hours. Media.Net has its own concierge desk that doubles up as a travel agency.</p>
<p>We are passionate about building the next generation of web products, and we believe that happy employees are the key to achieving this goal. If you like the idea of working in an exciting workspace on cutting-edge internet products that make a truly global impact (and wearing flip-flops to work), then we want to get to know you!</p>

            About us: Media.Net
Media.net, powers the Yahoo! Bing Network Contextual Ads program and is a leading global contextual advertising company that provides a wide range of advertising and traffic monetization solutions. Our diverse client base includes web publishers with premium content as well as registrars, hosting companies and holders of high value domain portfolios. We aim to consistently deliver long-term superior performance by using leading-edge technology, high-quality research, and proprietary processes that allow us to display the most precisely targeted, highest paying sponsored links and ad topics. We serve our contextual real-time ads customized for each visitor and each page view across billions of visitors, across 10’s of millions sites/domains on a server infrastructure that runs 1000+ CPUs, terabytes of RAM, and 1000’s of terabytes of data.
With more than 1700+ employees, Media.net has one of the largest teams worldwide building a global contextual advertising business. By market cap, Media.net is one of the Top 5 largest ad tech companies worldwide. By revenue, Media.net is the #2 largest contextual advertising businesses worldwide.
Media.net is acquired by Chinese Consortium for $900 Million USD in 3rd Largest Ad Tech deal ever and this acquisition will fuel Media.net’s global expansion strategy and provide access to China’s world-class talent and capital markets.
About The Role
We are looking for creative and analytical minds that can conceptualize and execute on the synergistic union of technology, user experience and monetization of online products. These products range from fledgling ideas that need nurturing to become functional and scalable, to large multi-billion dollar brands looking to grow their user base, enhance user retention or optimize their monetization. Be it solving mundane problems with a utility focused approach or creating newer products that engage and excite a range of audiences, the role requires agile individuals who can leverage Media.net’s technology and resources to drive success.
The role requires you to collaborate with creative, product, engineering, media, analytics, sales, publisher management, demand management and compliance/legal to develop impactful experiences that engage customers and drive adoption. You would work with partners, vendors and clients and synergize our businesses by integrating/supporting their products/offerings or taking on projects geared towards achieving a client’s specific goals. You will build competition and market intelligence through research to make decisions on branding, positioning, prioritization of features/integrations and ensure successful execution around the growth and monetization of the products/projects assigned. It would be crucial for you to track product KPIs and take data driven decisions for product enhancements that impact business
What You Will Do
Go-to-market Strategy
• Target Market and Competitive Research
• Product Positioning & Feature Conceptualization
• Managing Product Launches
• Content & Messaging Strategy
• User segmentation & identifying targeted marketing strategies
Experimentation
• Defining KPIs and goals
• Measuring progress & assessing the impact of these products
• Monitor Key Customer Satisfaction Indicators
Product Adoption & Growth
• Onboarding Customers
• User Engagement Strategy & Execution
• Iterative Testing and Product Improvisation
• Consumer Journey Optimization
• Re-engagement Strategies
Team Building & Management
• Build & manage a team to drive required efforts
• Monitor performance and plan goal-setting for the future
• Define processes & roles to be followed for task execution
• Mentor existing reportees & train new employees
Monetisation
• Drive monetisation strategy balanced by a customer centric approach
• Identify new revenue sources and optimize existing ones
• Maximize user LTV using a combination of best working and new market practices
What We Look for in a Candidate
Required Experience
• You have 2-6+ of overall work experience
• You have 2-5+ years of relevant experience in marketing/product/online customer success in a technology company or startup.
Leadership Qualities
• You have the ability to collaborate and build relationships and influence decisions at multiple levels of an organization
• You thrive in a robust environment and align available resources to a common goal
Creative Mindset
• You have a passion for technology, and a keen eye to identify opportunity in an ever-changing landscape
• You have strong analytical skills geared towards iterative solution of user problems based with data
Problem Solver
• You are proactive in your approach to problem solving and navigating ambiguity and complexity
Logical Approach
• You think quick on your feet and can derive actionable insights based on information available
• You are an expert communicator who can lead and manage relationships across organizational boundaries and vendor relationships
Benefits & Perks
At Media.Net people love their jobs, and not just because we offer the most competitive salaries in the industry. Our excellent benefits include everything from great medical and life insurance to catered meals. Our workspaces are comfortable and fun, complete with bean bag chairs, ping pong tables, and all the snacks you can eat. We have no dress code (tee-shirts are a-ok!). We have flexible work hours and flexible holidays, which means that teams pick their own work hours. Media.Net has its own concierge desk that doubles up as a travel agency.
We are passionate about building the next generation of web products, and we believe that happy employees are the key to achieving this goal. If you like the idea of working in an exciting workspace on cutting-edge internet products that make a truly global impact (and wearing flip-flops to work), then we want to get to know you!

            <h3>About us: Media.Net</h3>
<p>Media.net, powers the Yahoo! Bing Network Contextual Ads program and is a leading global contextual advertising company that provides a wide range of advertising and traffic monetization solutions. Our diverse client base includes web publishers with premium content as well as registrars, hosting companies and holders of high value domain portfolios. We aim to consistently deliver long-term superior performance by using leading-edge technology, high-quality research, and proprietary processes that allow us to display the most precisely targeted, highest paying sponsored links and ad topics. We serve our contextual real-time ads customized for each visitor and each page view across billions of visitors, across 10’s of millions sites/domains on a server infrastructure that runs 1000+ CPUs, terabytes of RAM, and 1000’s of terabytes of data.</p>
<p>With more than 1700+ employees, Media.net has one of the largest teams worldwide building a global contextual advertising business. By market cap, Media.net is one of the Top 5 largest ad tech companies worldwide. By revenue, Media.net is the #2 largest contextual advertising businesses worldwide.</p>
<p>Media.net is acquired by Chinese Consortium for $900 Million USD in 3rd Largest Ad Tech deal ever and this acquisition will fuel Media.net’s global expansion strategy and provide access to China’s world-class talent and capital markets.</p>
<p><strong>About the Role</strong></p>
<p>The campaign manager is responsible for the technical implementation, management, and optimization of Google Ads campaigns. This role involves ad trafficking, troubleshooting technical issues, and ensuring accurate and efficient campaign execution. The ideal candidate will have strong technical skills, a deep understanding of Google Ads, and a meticulous approach to campaign management.</p>
<p><strong>Key Responsibilities:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Campaign Setup and Management:</strong> Create and manage Google Ads campaigns across Search, Display, & UAC.</li>
<li><strong>Performance Optimization:</strong> Monitor and optimize campaigns to improve key metrics such as CTR, CPC, CPA, and ROI.</li>
<li><strong>Reporting & Analytics: </strong>Generate insightful reports to communicate actionable, campaign performance and ROI to stakeholders.</li>
<li><strong>A/B Testing:</strong> Conduct A/B tests on ad copy, creatives, and ASO to enhance campaign performance.</li>
<li><strong>Technical Troubleshooting:</strong> Identify and resolve technical issues related to ad delivery, tracking discrepancies, and ad disapprovals.</li>
<li><strong>Collaboration:</strong> Work closely with product and design teams to ensure campaign success.</li>
<li><strong>Competitor Research: </strong>Periodically monitor and evaluate competitor best practices to stay ahead and grow market share.</li>
<li><strong>Automation:</strong> Utilize Google Scripts/rules to automate repetitive tasks and optimize campaign management.</li>
<li><strong>Industry Trends:</strong> Stay ahead in the constantly evolving digital marketing landscape.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Qualifications:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Education:</strong> Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Advertising, Computer Science, Statistics, or a related field.</li>
<li><strong>Experience:</strong> 2-4 years of experience in digital ad operations with a focus on Google Ads.</li>
<li><strong>Skills:</strong>
<ul>
<li>Proficiency in Google Ads, Google Ads Editor, Tag Manager, Google Analytics.</li>
<li>Experience with AppTweak, Adjust, and other ASO and tracking tools.</li>
<li>Excellent at data handling and insight generation, proficiency in Excel & PPT.</li>
<li>Strong technical skills. Experience with HTML, JavaScript, SQL a plus.</li>
<li>Experience with tools like Tableau, Power BI</li>
<li>Experience with Microsoft Ads (Bing), Facebook, affiliate marketing a plus.</li>
<li>Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.</li>
<li>Ability to manage multiple campaigns and projects simultaneously.</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<h3>Benefits & Perks</h3>
<p>At Media.Net people love their jobs, and not just because we offer the most competitive salaries in the industry. Our excellent benefits include everything from great medical and life insurance to catered meals. Our workspaces are comfortable and fun, complete with bean bag chairs, ping pong tables, and all the snacks you can eat. We have no dress code (tee-shirts are a-ok!). We have flexible work hours and flexible holidays, which means that teams pick their own work hours. Media.Net has its own concierge desk that doubles up as a travel agency.</p>
<p>We are passionate about building the next generation of web products, and we believe that happy employees are the key to achieving this goal. If you like the idea of working in an exciting workspace on cutting-edge internet products that make a truly global impact (and wearing flip-flops to work), then we want to get to know you!</p>

            About us: Media.Net
Media.net, powers the Yahoo! Bing Network Contextual Ads program and is a leading global contextual advertising company that provides a wide range of advertising and traffic monetization solutions. Our diverse client base includes web publishers with premium content as well as registrars, hosting companies and holders of high value domain portfolios. We aim to consistently deliver long-term superior performance by using leading-edge technology, high-quality research, and proprietary processes that allow us to display the most precisely targeted, highest paying sponsored links and ad topics. We serve our contextual real-time ads customized for each visitor and each page view across billions of visitors, across 10’s of millions sites/domains on a server infrastructure that runs 1000+ CPUs, terabytes of RAM, and 1000’s of terabytes of data.
With more than 1700+ employees, Media.net has one of the largest teams worldwide building a global contextual advertising business. By market cap, Media.net is one of the Top 5 largest ad tech companies worldwide. By revenue, Media.net is the #2 largest contextual advertising businesses worldwide.
Media.net is acquired by Chinese Consortium for $900 Million USD in 3rd Largest Ad Tech deal ever and this acquisition will fuel Media.net’s global expansion strategy and provide access to China’s world-class talent and capital markets.
About the Role
The campaign manager is responsible for the technical implementation, management, and optimization of Google Ads campaigns. This role involves ad trafficking, troubleshooting technical issues, and ensuring accurate and efficient campaign execution. The ideal candidate will have strong technical skills, a deep understanding of Google Ads, and a meticulous approach to campaign management.
Key Responsibilities:

Campaign Setup and Management: Create and manage Google Ads campaigns across Search, Display, & UAC.
Performance Optimization: Monitor and optimize campaigns to improve key metrics such as CTR, CPC, CPA, and ROI.
Reporting & Analytics: Generate insightful reports to communicate actionable, campaign performance and ROI to stakeholders.
A/B Testing: Conduct A/B tests on ad copy, creatives, and ASO to enhance campaign performance.
Technical Troubleshooting: Identify and resolve technical issues related to ad delivery, tracking discrepancies, and ad disapprovals.
Collaboration: Work closely with product and design teams to ensure campaign success.
Competitor Research: Periodically monitor and evaluate competitor best practices to stay ahead and grow market share.
Automation: Utilize Google Scripts/rules to automate repetitive tasks and optimize campaign management.
Industry Trends: Stay ahead in the constantly evolving digital marketing landscape.

Qualifications:

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Advertising, Computer Science, Statistics, or a related field.
Experience: 2-4 years of experience in digital ad operations with a focus on Google Ads.
Skills:

Proficiency in Google Ads, Google Ads Editor, Tag Manager, Google Analytics.
Experience with AppTweak, Adjust, and other ASO and tracking tools.
Excellent at data handling and insight generation, proficiency in Excel & PPT.
Strong technical skills. Experience with HTML, JavaScript, SQL a plus.
Experience with tools like Tableau, Power BI
Experience with Microsoft Ads (Bing), Facebook, affiliate marketing a plus.
Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
Ability to manage multiple campaigns and projects simultaneously.



Benefits & Perks
At Media.Net people love their jobs, and not just because we offer the most competitive salaries in the industry. Our excellent benefits include everything from great medical and life insurance to catered meals. Our workspaces are comfortable and fun, complete with bean bag chairs, ping pong tables, and all the snacks you can eat. We have no dress code (tee-shirts are a-ok!). We have flexible work hours and flexible holidays, which means that teams pick their own work hours. Media.Net has its own concierge desk that doubles up as a travel agency.
We are passionate about building the next generation of web products, and we believe that happy employees are the key to achieving this goal. If you like the idea of working in an exciting workspace on cutting-edge internet products that make a truly global impact (and wearing flip-flops to work), then we want to get to know you!

            <div class="post-body">
            <p><strong><u>About Media.net</u></strong></p>
<p>Media.net is a leading online ad-tech company that develops innovative products for advertisers and publishers. Media.net has one of the most comprehensive portfolios of advertising technology in the industry across search, native, display, mobile, local, products and video. Media.net manages high-quality ad supply on over 500,000 websites and its platform and products are licensed by some of the largest publishers, ad networks and other ad tech companies worldwide.</p>
<p>Media.net is one of the largest contextual advertising company worldwide. Media.net has key operation centers across – North America, Europe and Asia. Media.net’s US HQ is based in New York, and Global HQ in Dubai.</p>
<p><b>Role:  </b><span style="font-weight: 400;">Director of Sales | East & Midwest</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"><br />
</span><b>Location:</b><span style="font-weight: 400;"> New York & Chicago</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"><br />
</span><b>Function: </b><span style="font-weight: 400;">Buyer Development (Sales)</span></p>
<p><b>Job Description</b></p>
<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">The </span><b>Director of Sales, Buyer Development (Programmatic)</b><span style="font-weight: 400;"> is responsible for generating, managing, and growing omnichannel opportunities with holding companies, agencies, and brands on Media.net Exchange, the marketplace featuring proprietary contextual enrichment and industry-leading efficiency across the premium programmatic supply. The candidate should strive to exceed revenue targets through evangelizing the platform, active selling, account management, and managing terms and expectations for new and existing clients.  They should also possess strong sales skills, self-serve programmatic experience, and buy-side relationships at holding companies, independent agencies, and in-house brand programmatic teams.</span></p>
<p><b>Desired Skills & Experience:</b></p>
<ul>
<li style="font-weight: 400;" aria-level="1"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Create and strengthen existing relationships with advertising agency customers in the East coast market with a focus on holding companies and their respective agencies</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;" aria-level="1"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Grow ad exchange spending to meet and exceed goals while continuously prospecting for new business among agencies and brands</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;" aria-level="1"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Work with advertiser partners on a daily basis while providing excellent client service including proactive media packaging of publisher opportunities resulting in higher revenue</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;" aria-level="1"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Identify additional revenue opportunities within existing clients</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;" aria-level="1"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Develop a strong understanding of Media.net technology and media solutions from an intellectual and applied perspective; communicate the value proposition to drive business growth</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;" aria-level="1"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Build and maintain close working relationships with multiple internal departments with a strong understanding of internal cross-functional communication/collaboration</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;" aria-level="1"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Attend industry events and conferences to network and grow your industry knowledge (as viable)</span></li>
</ul>
<p> </p>
<p><b>Basic Requirements</b></p>
<ul>
<li style="font-weight: 400;" aria-level="1"><span style="font-weight: 400;">A minimum of 4 years of applicable experience in either Programmatic Ad Sales, Business Development, Account Management, Relationship Management, or Sales roles in the online industry with proven experience and success selling Programmatic offerings into major Agency Programmatic Buying divisions, and Brands running Programmatic in-house</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;" aria-level="1"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Ideal desired experience includes coming from prior roles bringing both brand and advertiser relevant contacts as well as proven success selling Programmatic advertising solutions to Brands directly</span>
<ul>
<li style="font-weight: 400;" aria-level="2"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Knowledge of significant Brand/Advertiser focused programmatic space</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;" aria-level="2"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Knowledge of programmatic buying and selling including pricing models, optimization tactics, audience trends, and buying technologies</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;" aria-level="2"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Proficiency in Excel with a proven ability to convey data and analysis to drive business</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;" aria-level="2"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Bring pre-existing relationships with agencies and automated buying platforms</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;" aria-level="2"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Strong presentation (Including PowerPoint) and negotiation skills.</span></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<p> </p>
<p><strong><u>Compensation and Benefits</u></strong></p>
<p>Base Compensation Range: $130,000- $160,000</p>

<p>At Media.Net people love their jobs, and not just because we offer the most competitive salaries in the industry.             About Media.net
Media.net is a leading online ad-tech company that develops innovative products for advertisers and publishers. Media.net has one of the most comprehensive portfolios of advertising technology in the industry across search, native, display, mobile, local, products and video. Media.net manages high-quality ad supply on over 500,000 websites and its platform and products are licensed by some of the largest publishers, ad networks and other ad tech companies worldwide.
Media.net is one of the largest contextual advertising company worldwide. Media.net has key operation centers across – North America, Europe and Asia. Media.net’s US HQ is based in New York, and Global HQ in Dubai.
Role:  Director of Sales | East & Midwest
Location: New York & Chicago
Function: Buyer Development (Sales)
Job Description
The Director of Sales, Buyer Development (Programmatic) is responsible for generating, managing, and growing omnichannel opportunities with holding companies, agencies, and brands on Media.net Exchange, the marketplace featuring proprietary contextual enrichment and industry-leading efficiency across the premium programmatic supply. The candidate should strive to exceed revenue targets through evangelizing the platform, active selling, account management, and managing terms and expectations for new and existing clients.  They should also possess strong sales skills, self-serve programmatic experience, and buy-side relationships at holding companies, independent agencies, and in-house brand programmatic teams.
Desired Skills & Experience:

Create and strengthen existing relationships with advertising agency customers in the East coast market with a focus on holding companies and their respective agencies
Grow ad exchange spending to meet and exceed goals while continuously prospecting for new business among agencies and brands
Work with advertiser partners on a daily basis while providing excellent client service including proactive media packaging of publisher opportunities resulting in higher revenue
Identify additional revenue opportunities within existing clients
Develop a strong understanding of Media.net technology and media solutions from an intellectual and applied perspective; communicate the value proposition to drive business growth
Build and maintain close working relationships with multiple internal departments with a strong understanding of internal cross-functional communication/collaboration
Attend industry events and conferences to network and grow your industry knowledge (as viable)

 
Basic Requirements

A minimum of 4 years of applicable experience in either Programmatic Ad Sales, Business Development, Account Management, Relationship Management, or Sales roles in the online industry with proven experience and success selling Programmatic offerings into major Agency Programmatic Buying divisions, and Brands running Programmatic in-house
Ideal desired experience includes coming from prior roles bringing both brand and advertiser relevant contacts as well as proven success selling Programmatic advertising solutions to Brands directly

Knowledge of significant Brand/Advertiser focused programmatic space
Knowledge of programmatic buying and selling including pricing models, optimization tactics, audience trends, and buying technologies
Proficiency in Excel with a proven ability to convey data and analysis to drive business
Bring pre-existing relationships with agencies and automated buying platforms
Strong presentation (Including PowerPoint) and negotiation skills.



 
Compensation and Benefits
Base Compensation Range: $130,000- $160,000
As required by law, the salary range stated above represents Media.net’s reasonable estimate of the base salary associated with this position. The final salary offered may differ based on objective factors including experience, expertise, skills, and qualifications. Additionally, Media.net provides a bonus and a comprehensive benefits package in addition to the base salary.
 
 
Media.net is proud to be an equal opportunity employer; we don’t just value diversity, we promote and celebrate it. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
Benefits & Perks
At Media.Net people love their jobs, and not just because we offer the most competitive salaries in the industry. Our excellent benefits include everything from great medical and life insurance to catered meals. Our workspaces are comfortable and fun, complete with bean bag chairs, ping pong tables, and all the snacks you can eat. We have no dress code (tee-shirts are a-ok!). We have flexible work hours and flexible holidays, which means that teams pick their own work hours. Media.Net has its own concierge desk that doubles up as a travel agency.
We are passionate about building the next generation of web products, and we believe that happy employees are the key to achieving this goal. If you like the idea of working in an exciting workspace on cutting-edge internet products that make a truly global impact (and wearing flip-flops to work), then we want to get to know you!

            <h3>About us: Media.Net</h3>
<p>Media.net is a leading online ad-tech company that develops innovative products for advertisers and publishers. Media.net has one of the most comprehensive portfolios of advertising technology in the industry across search, native, display, mobile, local, products and video. Media.net manages high-quality ad supply on over 500,000 websites and its platform and products are licensed by some of the largest publishers, ad networks and other ad tech companies worldwide.</p>
<p>Media.net is one of the largest contextual advertising company worldwide.. Media.net has 1600+ employees in key operation centers across – North America, Europe and Asia. Media.net’s US HQ is based in New York, and Global HQ in Dubai.</p>
<p><b>Role:  </b><span style="font-weight: 400;">Manager, Agency Partnerships  (Experience based)</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"><br />
</span><b>Location:</b><span style="font-weight: 400;"> New York</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"><br />
</span><b>Function: </b><span style="font-weight: 400;">Buyer Development</span></p>
<p><b>Overall Responsibility</b></p>
<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">The </span><b>Manager, Agency Partnerships</b> <span style="font-weight: 400;">is responsible for developing and nurturing account teams at the largest holding companies and ad agencies at the account level across all verticals.  This entails engaging with the Account Directors at Agencies and Holding companies and their respective account teams to ensure a strong and positive relationship with customers while ensuring successful activation of media campaigns working with Media.net product and account teams to deliver on outcomes and optimize to their KPI.</span></p>
<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Success in this position requires proactive communication with our agency teams, strong project management skills, and a desire to grow accounts and assist in the growth of new business to meet specific revenue goals while understanding opportunities for improvement and being a leader in representing Media.net’s products and services.</span></p>
<p><b>What your day looks like</b></p>
<ul>
<li style="font-weight: 400;" aria-level="1"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Maintain strong relationships with advertising agency account teams (both holding company agencies and independent agencies) that represent top global brands to ensure client satisfaction and long-term partnerships.</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;" aria-level="1"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Review opportunities received through these account teams to develop tailored and custom solutions with the help of internal teams to deliver strong customer experiences and meeting advertiser campaign needs.</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;" aria-level="1"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Strategically prioritize accounts and create engagement plans for both quarterly and annual goals</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;" aria-level="1"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Serve as a leader in the activation of programmatic opportunities and private marketplace deals (PMP) to meet revenue targets from the VP of Buyer Development. </span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;" aria-level="1"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Stay informed about industry trends and developments to proactively advise clients on best practices and innovative solutions.</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;" aria-level="1"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Capture and relay new business requirements to the Product team to support revenue growth initiatives</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;" aria-level="1"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Maintain customer relationships and key information in Salesforce and help to share voice-of-the-customer to internal stakeholders.</span></li>
</ul>
<p><b>Basic Requirements</b><span style="font-weight: 400;">:</span></p>
<ul>
<li style="font-weight: 400;" aria-level="1"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Bachelor’s degree in business or related marketing field</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;" aria-level="1"><span style="font-weight: 400;">2 to 4 years experience in media buying, programmatic advertising at a brand, agency, or holding company</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;" aria-level="1"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Exceptional writing and communication skills</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;" aria-level="1"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Proficiency in using Google Slides and PowerPoint with strong project management skills</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;" aria-level="1"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Driven and strong customer-facing skills to ensure positive customer experiences</span></li>
</ul>
<p><strong><u>Compensation and Benefits</u></strong></p>
<p>Base Compensation Range: $75,000 – $90,000</p>
<p>As required by law, the salary range stated above represents Media.net’s reasonable estimate of the base salary associated with this position. The final salary offered may differ based on objective factors including experience, expertise, skills, and qualifications. Additionally, Media.net provides a bonus and a comprehensive benefits package in addition to the base salary.</p>
<p><strong><u>Additional Perks</u></strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Unlimited vacation days</li>
<li>Family-Focused Benefits and Parental Leave</li>
<li>Mobile Phone Benefit</li>
</ul>
<p><i><span style="font-weight: 400;">Media.net is proud to be an equal opportunity employer; we don’t just value diversity, we promote and celebrate it. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.</span></i></p>
<p> </p>
<h3>Benefits & Perks</h3>
<p>At Media.Net people love their jobs, and not just because we offer the most competitive salaries in the industry. Our excellent benefits include everything from great medical and life insurance to catered meals. Our workspaces are comfortable and fun, complete with bean bag chairs, ping pong tables, and all the snacks you can eat. We have no dress code (tee-shirts are a-ok!). We have flexible work hours and flexible holidays, which means that teams pick their own work hours. Media.Net has its own concierge desk that doubles up as a travel agency.</p>
<p>We are passionate about building the next generation of web products, and we believe that happy employees are the key to achieving this goal. If you like the idea of working in an exciting workspace on cutting-edge internet products that make a truly global impact (and wearing flip-flops to work), then we want to get to know you!</p>

Media.net is a leading online ad-tech company that develops innovative products for advertisers and publishers. Media.net has one of the most comprehensive portfolios of advertising technology in the industry across search, native, display, mobile, local, products and video. Media.net manages high-quality ad supply on over 500,000 websites and its platform and products are licensed by some of the largest publishers, ad networks and other ad tech companies worldwide.
Media.net is one of the largest contextual advertising company worldwide.. Media.net has 1600+ employees in key operation centers across – North America, Europe and Asia. Media.net’s US HQ is based in New York, and Global HQ in Dubai.
Role:  Manager, Agency Partnerships  (Experience based)
Location: New York
Function: Buyer Development
Overall Responsibility
The Manager, Agency Partnerships is responsible for developing and nurturing account teams at the largest holding companies and ad agencies at the account level across all verticals.  This entails engaging with the Account Directors at Agencies and Holding companies and their respective account teams to ensure a strong and positive relationship with customers while ensuring successful activation of media campaigns working with Media.net product and account teams to deliver on outcomes and optimize to their KPI.
Success in this position requires proactive communication with our agency teams, strong project management skills, and a desire to grow accounts and assist in the growth of new business to meet specific revenue goals while understanding opportunities for improvement and being a leader in representing Media.net’s products and services.
What your day looks like

Maintain strong relationships with advertising agency account teams (both holding company agencies and independent agencies) that represent top global brands to ensure client satisfaction and long-term partnerships.
Review opportunities received through these account teams to develop tailored and custom solutions with the help of internal teams to deliver strong customer experiences and meeting advertiser campaign needs.
Strategically prioritize accounts and create engagement plans for both quarterly and annual goals
Serve as a leader in the activation of programmatic opportunities and private marketplace deals (PMP) to meet revenue targets from the VP of Buyer Development. 
Stay informed about industry trends and developments to proactively advise clients on best practices and innovative solutions.
Capture and relay new business requirements to the Product team to support revenue growth initiatives
Maintain customer relationships and key information in Salesforce and help to share voice-of-the-customer to internal stakeholders.

Basic Requirements:

Bachelor’s degree in business or related marketing field
2 to 4 years experience in media buying, programmatic advertising at a brand, agency, or holding company
Exceptional writing and communication skills
Proficiency in using Google Slides and PowerPoint with strong project management skills
Driven and strong customer-facing skills to ensure positive customer experiences

Compensation and Benefits
Base Compensation Range: $75,000 – $90,000
As required by law, the salary range stated above represents Media.net’s reasonable estimate of the base salary associated with this position. The final salary offered may differ based on objective factors including experience, expertise, skills, and qualifications. Additionally, Media.net provides a bonus and a comprehensive benefits package in addition to the base salary.
Additional Perks

Unlimited vacation days
Family-Focused Benefits and Parental Leave
Mobile Phone Benefit

Media.net is proud to be an equal opportunity employer; we don’t just value diversity, we promote and celebrate it. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
 
Benefits & Perks
At Media.Net people love their jobs, and not just because we offer the most competitive salaries in the industry. Our excellent benefits include everything from great medical and life insurance to catered meals. Our workspaces are comfortable and fun, complete with bean bag chairs, ping pong tables, and all the snacks you can eat. We have no dress code (tee-shirts are a-ok!). We have flexible work hours and flexible holidays, which means that teams pick their own work hours. Media.Net has its own concierge desk that doubles up as a travel agency.
We are passionate about building the next generation of web products, and we believe that happy employees are the key to achieving this goal. If you like the idea of working in an exciting workspace on cutting-edge internet products that make a truly global impact (and wearing flip-flops to work), then we want to get to know you!

            <div class="post-body">
            <p><strong><u>About Media.net</u></strong></p>
<p>Media.net is a leading online ad-tech company that develops innovative products for advertisers and publishers. Media.net has one of the most comprehensive portfolios of advertising technology in the industry across search, native, display, mobile, local, products and video. Media.net manages high-quality ad supply on over 500,000 websites and its platform and products are licensed by some of the largest publishers, ad networks and other ad tech companies worldwide.</p>
<p>Media.net is one of the largest contextual advertising company worldwide.. Media.net has key operation centers across – North America, Europe and Asia. Media.net’s US HQ is based in New York, and Global HQ in Dubai.</p>
<p><b>Role:  </b><span style="font-weight: 400;">Account Executive</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"><br />
</span><b>Location:</b><span style="font-weight: 400;"> New York</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"><br />
</span><b>Function: </b><span style="font-weight: 400;">Buyer Development (Sales)</span></p>
<p><b>Overall Responsibility</b></p>
<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">The </span><b>Account Executive</b><span style="font-weight: 400;"> is responsible for partnering with the largest holding company account teams representing the largest advertisers across a large range of verticals.  This entails engaging with the Account Directors at Agencies and Holding companies and their respective account teams to nurture and develop strong relationships.  </span></p>
<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Success in this position requires an ability to navigate the agency teams, develop a strong rapport with key decision makers in conjunction with local Buyer Development Sales Directors at Media.net.  Additionally, a successful Account Executive will help project manage clients to specific revenue goals while understanding their future needs with a strong focus on building relationships through events and other marketing activities.</span></p>
<p><b>What your day looks like</b></p>
<ul>
<li style="font-weight: 400;" aria-level="1"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Build and maintain strong relationships with advertising agency account teams (both holding company agencies and independent agencies) that represent top global brands to ensure client satisfaction and long-term partnerships.</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;" aria-level="1"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Collaborate with clients to understand their objectives and develop tailored strategies that maximize the value of their inventory through our SSP technology.</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;" aria-level="1"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Advise on innovative revenue opportunities for sellers to enhance the value of their inventory and assist sales team in meeting revenue targets and activating new programmatic deals and PMPs</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;" aria-level="1"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Engage with account teams at advertising agencies and holding companies weekly by entertaining clients with lunch and learns, after-work social events, and event planning </span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;" aria-level="1"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Stay informed about industry trends and developments to proactively advise clients on best practices and innovative solutions.</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;" aria-level="1"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Maintain customer relationships and key information in Salesforce and help to share voice-of-the-customer to internal stakeholders.</span></li>
</ul>
<p><b>Basic Requirements</b><span style="font-weight: 400;">:</span></p>
<ul>
<li style="font-weight: 400;" aria-level="1"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Bachelor’s degree in business or related marketing field</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;" aria-level="1"><span style="font-weight: 400;">2 to 4 years experience in media buying, programmatic advertising at a brand, agency, or holding company</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;" aria-level="1"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Exceptional written and communication skills</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;" aria-level="1"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Proficiency in using Google Slides and PowerPoint with strong project management skills</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;" aria-level="1"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Driven and strong customer-facing skills to ensure positive customer experiences</span></li>
</ul>
<p><strong><u>Compensation and Benefits</u></strong></p>
<p>Base Compensation Range: $70,000- $90,000</p>
<p>As required by law, the salary range stated above represents Media.net’s reasonable estimate of the base salary associated with this position. The final salary offered may differ based on objective factors including experience, expertise, skills, and qualifications. Additionally, Media.net provides a bonus and a comprehensive benefits package in addition to the base salary.</p>
<p><strong><u>Additional Perks</u></strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Unlimited vacation days</li>
<li>Family-Focused Benefits and Parental Leave</li>
<li>Mobile Phone Benefit</li>
</ul>
<p> </p>
<p><i><span style="font-weight: 400;">Media.net is proud to be an equal opportunity employer; we don’t just value diversity, we promote and celebrate it. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.</span></i></p>
<h3>Benefits & Perks</h3>
<p>At Media.Net people love their jobs, and not just because we offer the most competitive salaries in the industry. Our excellent benefits include everything from great medical and life insurance to catered meals. Our workspaces are comfortable and fun, complete with bean bag chairs, ping pong tables, and all the snacks you can eat. We have no dress code (tee-shirts are a-ok!). We have flexible work hours and flexible holidays, which means that teams pick their own work hours. Media.Net has its own concierge desk that doubles up as a travel agency.</p>
<p>We are passionate about building the next generation of web products, and we believe that happy employees are the key to achieving this goal. If you like the idea of working in an exciting workspace on cutting-edge internet products that make a truly global impact (and wearing flip-flops to work), then we want to get to know you!</p>

            About Media.net
Media.net is a leading online ad-tech company that develops innovative products for advertisers and publishers. Media.net has one of the most comprehensive portfolios of advertising technology in the industry across search, native, display, mobile, local, products and video. Media.net manages high-quality ad supply on over 500,000 websites and its platform and products are licensed by some of the largest publishers, ad networks and other ad tech companies worldwide.
Media.net is one of the largest contextual advertising company worldwide.. Media.net has key operation centers across – North America, Europe and Asia. Media.net’s US HQ is based in New York, and Global HQ in Dubai.
Role:  Account Executive
Location: New York
Function: Buyer Development (Sales)
Overall Responsibility
The Account Executive is responsible for partnering with the largest holding company account teams representing the largest advertisers across a large range of verticals.  This entails engaging with the Account Directors at Agencies and Holding companies and their respective account teams to nurture and develop strong relationships.  
Success in this position requires an ability to navigate the agency teams, develop a strong rapport with key decision makers in conjunction with local Buyer Development Sales Directors at Media.net.  Additionally, a successful Account Executive will help project manage clients to specific revenue goals while understanding their future needs with a strong focus on building relationships through events and other marketing activities.
What your day looks like

Build and maintain strong relationships with advertising agency account teams (both holding company agencies and independent agencies) that represent top global brands to ensure client satisfaction and long-term partnerships.
Collaborate with clients to understand their objectives and develop tailored strategies that maximize the value of their inventory through our SSP technology.
Advise on innovative revenue opportunities for sellers to enhance the value of their inventory and assist sales team in meeting revenue targets and activating new programmatic deals and PMPs
Engage with account teams at advertising agencies and holding companies weekly by entertaining clients with lunch and learns, after-work social events, and event planning 
Stay informed about industry trends and developments to proactively advise clients on best practices and innovative solutions.
Maintain customer relationships and key information in Salesforce and help to share voice-of-the-customer to internal stakeholders.

Basic Requirements:

Bachelor’s degree in business or related marketing field
2 to 4 years experience in media buying, programmatic advertising at a brand, agency, or holding company
Exceptional written and communication skills
Proficiency in using Google Slides and PowerPoint with strong project management skills
Driven and strong customer-facing skills to ensure positive customer experiences

Compensation and Benefits
Base Compensation Range: $70,000- $90,000
As required by law, the salary range stated above represents Media.net’s reasonable estimate of the base salary associated with this position. The final salary offered may differ based on objective factors including experience, expertise, skills, and qualifications. Additionally, Media.net provides a bonus and a comprehensive benefits package in addition to the base salary.
Additional Perks

Unlimited vacation days
Family-Focused Benefits and Parental Leave
Mobile Phone Benefit

 
Media.net is proud to be an equal opportunity employer; we don’t just value diversity, we promote and celebrate it. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
Benefits & Perks
At Media.Net people love their jobs, and not just because we offer the most competitive salaries in the industry. Our excellent benefits include everything from great medical and life insurance to catered meals. Our workspaces are comfortable and fun, complete with bean bag chairs, ping pong tables, and all the snacks you can eat. We have no dress code (tee-shirts are a-ok!). We have flexible work hours and flexible holidays, which means that teams pick their own work hours. Media.Net has its own concierge desk that doubles up as a travel agency.
We are passionate about building the next generation of web products, and we believe that happy employees are the key to achieving this goal. If you like the idea of working in an exciting workspace on cutting-edge internet products that make a truly global impact (and wearing flip-flops to work), then we want to get to know you!

            <div class="post-body">
            <p>Media.net is a leading online ad-tech company that develops innovative products for advertisers and publishers. Media.net has one of the most comprehensive portfolios of advertising technology in the industry across search, native, display, mobile, local, products and video. Media.net manages high-quality ad supply on over 500,000 websites and its platform and products are licensed by some of the largest publishers, ad networks and other ad tech companies worldwide.</p>
<p>Media.net is one of the largest contextual advertising company worldwide.. Media.net has 1600+ employees in key operation centers across – North America, Europe and Asia. Media.net’s US HQ is based in New York, and Global HQ in Dubai.</p>
<p><b>Role:  </b>Director<span style="font-weight: 400;">, Agency Partnerships  (Experience based)</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"><br />
</span><b>Location:</b><span style="font-weight: 400;"> New York</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"><br />
</span><b>Function: </b><span style="font-weight: 400;">Buyer Development</span></p>
<p><b>Overall Responsibility</b></p>
<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">The </span><b>Director, Agency Partnerships</b> <span style="font-weight: 400;">is responsible for developing and nurturing account teams at the largest holding companies and ad agencies at the account level across all verticals.  This entails engaging with the Account Directors at Agencies and Holding companies and their respective account teams to ensure a strong and positive relationship with customers while ensuring successful activation of media campaigns working with Media.net product and account teams to deliver on outcomes and optimize to their KPI.</span></p>
<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Success in this position requires proactive communication with our agency teams, strong project management skills, and a desire to grow accounts and assist in the growth of new business to meet specific revenue goals while understanding opportunities for improvement and being a leader in representing Media.net’s products and services.</span></p>
<p><b>What your day looks like</b></p>
<ul>
<li style="font-weight: 400;" aria-level="1"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Maintain strong relationships with advertising agency account teams (both holding company agencies and independent agencies) that represent top global brands to ensure client satisfaction and long-term partnerships.</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;" aria-level="1"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Review opportunities received through these account teams to develop tailored and custom solutions with the help of internal teams to deliver strong customer experiences and meeting advertiser campaign needs.</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;" aria-level="1"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Strategically prioritize accounts and create engagement plans for both quarterly and annual goals</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;" aria-level="1"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Serve as a leader in the activation of programmatic opportunities and private marketplace deals (PMP) to meet revenue targets from the VP of Buyer Development. </span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;" aria-level="1"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Stay informed about industry trends and developments to proactively advise clients on best practices and innovative solutions.</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;" aria-level="1"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Capture and relay new business requirements to the Product team to support revenue growth initiatives</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;" aria-level="1"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Maintain customer relationships and key information in Salesforce and help to share voice-of-the-customer to internal stakeholders.</span></li>
</ul>
<p><b>Basic Requirements</b><span style="font-weight: 400;">:</span></p>
<ul>
<li style="font-weight: 400;" aria-level="1"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Bachelor’s degree in business or related marketing field</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;" aria-level="1"><span style="font-weight: 400;">4 to 8 years experience in media buying, programmatic advertising at a brand, agency, or holding company</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;" aria-level="1"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Exceptional writing and communication skills</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;" aria-level="1"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Proficiency in using Google Slides and PowerPoint with strong project management skills</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;" aria-level="1"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Driven and strong customer-facing skills to ensure positive customer experiences</span></li>
</ul>
<p><strong><u>Compensation and Benefits</u></strong></p>
<p>Base Compensation Range: $90,000 – $105,000</p>
<p>As required by law, the salary range stated above represents Media.net’s reasonable estimate of the base salary associated with this position. The final salary offered may differ based on objective factors including experience, expertise, skills, and qualifications. Additionally, Media.net provides a bonus and a comprehensive benefits package in addition to the base salary.</p>
<p><strong><u>Additional Perks</u></strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Unlimited vacation days</li>
<li>Family-Focused Benefits and Parental Leave</li>
<li>Mobile Phone Benefit</li>
</ul>
<p><i><span style="font-weight: 400;">Media.net is proud to be an equal opportunity employer; we don’t just value diversity, we promote and celebrate it. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.</span></i></p>
<p> </p>
<h3>Benefits & Perks</h3>
<p>At Media.Net people love their jobs, and not just because we offer the most competitive salaries in the industry. Our excellent benefits include everything from great medical and life insurance to catered meals. Our workspaces are comfortable and fun, complete with bean bag chairs, ping pong tables, and all the snacks you can eat. We have no dress code (tee-shirts are a-ok!). We have flexible work hours and flexible holidays, which means that teams pick their own work hours. Media.Net has its own concierge desk that doubles up as a travel agency.</p>
<p>We are passionate about building the next generation of web products, and we believe that happy employees are the key to achieving this goal. If you like the idea of working in an exciting workspace on cutting-edge internet products that make a truly global impact (and wearing flip-flops to work), then we want to get to know you!</p>

            Media.net is a leading online ad-tech company that develops innovative products for advertisers and publishers. Media.net has one of the most comprehensive portfolios of advertising technology in the industry across search, native, display, mobile, local, products and video. Media.net manages high-quality ad supply on over 500,000 websites and its platform and products are licensed by some of the largest publishers, ad networks and other ad tech companies worldwide.
Media.net is one of the largest contextual advertising company worldwide.. Media.net has 1600+ employees in key operation centers across – North America, Europe and Asia. Media.net’s US HQ is based in New York, and Global HQ in Dubai.
Role:  Director, Agency Partnerships  (Experience based)
Location: New York
Function: Buyer Development
Overall Responsibility
The Director, Agency Partnerships is responsible for developing and nurturing account teams at the largest holding companies and ad agencies at the account level across all verticals.  This entails engaging with the Account Directors at Agencies and Holding companies and their respective account teams to ensure a strong and positive relationship with customers while ensuring successful activation of media campaigns working with Media.net product and account teams to deliver on outcomes and optimize to their KPI.
Success in this position requires proactive communication with our agency teams, strong project management skills, and a desire to grow accounts and assist in the growth of new business to meet specific revenue goals while understanding opportunities for improvement and being a leader in representing Media.net’s products and services.
What your day looks like

Maintain strong relationships with advertising agency account teams (both holding company agencies and independent agencies) that represent top global brands to ensure client satisfaction and long-term partnerships.
Review opportunities received through these account teams to develop tailored and custom solutions with the help of internal teams to deliver strong customer experiences and meeting advertiser campaign needs.
Strategically prioritize accounts and create engagement plans for both quarterly and annual goals
Serve as a leader in the activation of programmatic opportunities and private marketplace deals (PMP) to meet revenue targets from the VP of Buyer Development. 
Stay informed about industry trends and developments to proactively advise clients on best practices and innovative solutions.
Capture and relay new business requirements to the Product team to support revenue growth initiatives
Maintain customer relationships and key information in Salesforce and help to share voice-of-the-customer to internal stakeholders.

Basic Requirements:

Bachelor’s degree in business or related marketing field
4 to 8 years experience in media buying, programmatic advertising at a brand, agency, or holding company
Exceptional writing and communication skills
Proficiency in using Google Slides and PowerPoint with strong project management skills
Driven and strong customer-facing skills to ensure positive customer experiences

Compensation and Benefits
Base Compensation Range: $90,000 – $105,000
As required by law, the salary range stated above represents Media.net’s reasonable estimate of the base salary associated with this position. The final salary offered may differ based on objective factors including experience, expertise, skills, and qualifications. Additionally, Media.net provides a bonus and a comprehensive benefits package in addition to the base salary.
Additional Perks

Unlimited vacation days
Family-Focused Benefits and Parental Leave
Mobile Phone Benefit

Media.net is proud to be an equal opportunity employer; we don’t just value diversity, we promote and celebrate it. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
 
Benefits & Perks
At Media.Net people love their jobs, and not just because we offer the most competitive salaries in the industry. Our excellent benefits include everything from great medical and life insurance to catered meals. Our workspaces are comfortable and fun, complete with bean bag chairs, ping pong tables, and all the snacks you can eat. We have no dress code (tee-shirts are a-ok!). We have flexible work hours and flexible holidays, which means that teams pick their own work hours. Media.Net has its own concierge desk that doubles up as a travel agency.
We are passionate about building the next generation of web products, and we believe that happy employees are the key to achieving this goal. If you like the idea of working in an exciting workspace on cutting-edge internet products that make a truly global impact (and wearing flip-flops to work), then we want to get to know you!

            <div class="post-body">
            <h3>About us: Media.Net</h3>
<p>Media.net, powers the Yahoo! Bing Network Contextual Ads program and is a leading global contextual advertising company that provides a wide range of advertising and traffic monetization solutions. Our diverse client base includes web publishers with premium content as well as registrars, hosting companies and holders of high value domain portfolios. We aim to consistently deliver long-term superior performance by using leading-edge technology, high-quality research, and proprietary processes that allow us to display the most precisely targeted, highest paying sponsored links and ad topics. We serve our contextual real-time ads customized for each visitor and each page view across billions of visitors, across 10’s of millions sites/domains on a server infrastructure that runs 1000+ CPUs, terabytes of RAM, and 1000’s of terabytes of data.</p>
<p>With more than 1700+ employees, Media.net has one of the largest teams worldwide building a global contextual advertising business. By market cap, Media.net is one of the Top 5 largest ad tech companies worldwide. By revenue, Media.net is the #2 largest contextual advertising businesses worldwide.</p>
<p>Media.net is acquired by Chinese Consortium for $900 Million USD in 3rd Largest Ad Tech deal ever and this acquisition will fuel Media.net’s global expansion strategy and provide access to China’s world-class talent and capital markets.</p>
<p><strong>Job Summary ?</strong><br />
We are seeking a highly analytical and data-driven individual to join our dynamic mobile apps business as a Business Analyst.<br />
As a Business Analyst, you will be responsible for extracting insights from large and complex datasets to drive data-informed decision-making and support our mobile app strategy. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams, including product managers, developers, marketers, and executives, to optimize app performance, identify growth opportunities, and enhance user experience.<br />
This role requires strong analytical skills, a deep understanding of mobile app metrics, and the ability to communicate complex findings in a clear and actionable manner</p>
<p><strong>Roles and Responsibilities</strong><br />
• Collect, analyze, and interpret data from various sources, including app analytics platforms and market research, to identify trends, patterns, and insights related to app performance and user behavior.<br />
• Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and visualizations to provide stakeholders with timely and accurate information on key performance indicators (KPIs) and business metrics.<br />
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, track, and analyze metrics that align with business goals and objectives, such as user acquisition, retention, engagement, and monetization.<br />
• Conduct ad hoc analysis to answer specific business questions and provide actionable recommendations for improving app performance and user experience.<br />
• Collaborate with the product team to identify and prioritize new features, enhancements, and experiments based on data-driven insights.<br />
• Identify and implement strategies for A/B testing and experimentation to optimize app features, user interface and conversion funnels.<br />
• Monitor and evaluate app store reviews and ratings, identifying trends and feedback to inform product improvements.<br />
• Stay updated with industry trends, new technologies, and emerging practices in mobile app analytics and business intelligence</p>
<p><strong>Qualification and Experience ?</strong><br />
• Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field such as Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, or Computer Science. A Master’s degree is a plus.<br />
• 3+ years of proven experience as a Business Analyst or similar role, preferably in the mobile apps or technology industry.<br />
• Proficiency in SQL for data extraction and manipulation from relational databases.<br />
• Strong analytical skills and experience working with large datasets, using tools such as Excel, Python, or R for data analysis and visualization.<br />
• Familiarity with app analytics platforms (e.g., Firebase, Google Analytics) and their key metrics.<br />
• Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) to create insightful reports and dashboards.<br />
• Knowledge of A/B testing and experimental design methodologies.<br />
• Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to translate complex data into actionable insights.<br />
• Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to effectively convey technical information to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.<br />
• Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.<br />
• Passion for mobile apps, technology, and the digital landscape.<br />
If you are a data enthusiast with a passion for mobile apps and want to play a pivotal role in driving data-informed decisions, we would love to hear from you. Join our team and help shape the future of our mobile apps business through insightful analysis and actionable recommendations</p>
<h3>Benefits & Perks</h3>
<p>At Media.Net people love their jobs, and not just because we offer the most competitive salaries in the industry. Our excellent benefits include everything from great medical and life insurance to catered meals. Our workspaces are comfortable and fun, complete with bean bag chairs, ping pong tables, and all the snacks you can eat. We have no dress code (tee-shirts are a-ok!). We have flexible work hours and flexible holidays, which means that teams pick their own work hours. Media.Net has its own concierge desk that doubles up as a travel agency.</p>
<p>We are passionate about building the next generation of web products, and we believe that happy employees are the key to achieving this goal.             About us: Media.Net
Media.net, powers the Yahoo! Bing Network Contextual Ads program and is a leading global contextual advertising company that provides a wide range of advertising and traffic monetization solutions. Our diverse client base includes web publishers with premium content as well as registrars, hosting companies and holders of high value domain portfolios. We aim to consistently deliver long-term superior performance by using leading-edge technology, high-quality research, and proprietary processes that allow us to display the most precisely targeted, highest paying sponsored links and ad topics. We serve our contextual real-time ads customized for each visitor and each page view across billions of visitors, across 10’s of millions sites/domains on a server infrastructure that runs 1000+ CPUs, terabytes of RAM, and 1000’s of terabytes of data.
With more than 1700+ employees, Media.net has one of the largest teams worldwide building a global contextual advertising business. By market cap, Media.net is one of the Top 5 largest ad tech companies worldwide. By revenue, Media.net is the #2 largest contextual advertising businesses worldwide.
Media.net is acquired by Chinese Consortium for $900 Million USD in 3rd Largest Ad Tech deal ever and this acquisition will fuel Media.net’s global expansion strategy and provide access to China’s world-class talent and capital markets.
Job Summary ?
We are seeking a highly analytical and data-driven individual to join our dynamic mobile apps business as a Business Analyst.
As a Business Analyst, you will be responsible for extracting insights from large and complex datasets to drive data-informed decision-making and support our mobile app strategy. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams, including product managers, developers, marketers, and executives, to optimize app performance, identify growth opportunities, and enhance user experience.
This role requires strong analytical skills, a deep understanding of mobile app metrics, and the ability to communicate complex findings in a clear and actionable manner
Roles and Responsibilities
• Collect, analyze, and interpret data from various sources, including app analytics platforms and market research, to identify trends, patterns, and insights related to app performance and user behavior.
• Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and visualizations to provide stakeholders with timely and accurate information on key performance indicators (KPIs) and business metrics.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, track, and analyze metrics that align with business goals and objectives, such as user acquisition, retention, engagement, and monetization.
• Conduct ad hoc analysis to answer specific business questions and provide actionable recommendations for improving app performance and user experience.
• Collaborate with the product team to identify and prioritize new features, enhancements, and experiments based on data-driven insights.
• Identify and implement strategies for A/B testing and experimentation to optimize app features, user interface and conversion funnels.
• Monitor and evaluate app store reviews and ratings, identifying trends and feedback to inform product improvements.
• Stay updated with industry trends, new technologies, and emerging practices in mobile app analytics and business intelligence
Qualification and Experience ?
• Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field such as Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, or Computer Science. A Master’s degree is a plus.
• 3+ years of proven experience as a Business Analyst or similar role, preferably in the mobile apps or technology industry.
• Proficiency in SQL for data extraction and manipulation from relational databases.
• Strong analytical skills and experience working with large datasets, using tools such as Excel, Python, or R for data analysis and visualization.
• Familiarity with app analytics platforms (e.g., Firebase, Google Analytics) and their key metrics.
• Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) to create insightful reports and dashboards.
• Knowledge of A/B testing and experimental design methodologies.
• Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to translate complex data into actionable insights.
• Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to effectively convey technical information to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.
• Passion for mobile apps, technology, and the digital landscape.
If you are a data enthusiast with a passion for mobile apps and want to play a pivotal role in driving data-informed decisions, we would love to hear from you. Join our team and help shape the future of our mobile apps business through insightful analysis and actionable recommendations
Benefits & Perks
At Media.Net people love their jobs, and not just because we offer the most competitive salaries in the industry. Our excellent benefits include everything from great medical and life insurance to catered meals. Our workspaces are comfortable and fun, complete with bean bag chairs, ping pong tables, and all the snacks you can eat. We have no dress code (tee-shirts are a-ok!). We have flexible work hours and flexible holidays, which means that teams pick their own work hours. Media.Net has its own concierge desk that doubles up as a travel agency.
We are passionate about building the next generation of web products, and we believe that happy employees are the key to achieving this goal. If you like the idea of working in an exciting workspace on cutting-edge internet products that make a truly global impact (and wearing flip-flops to work), then we want to get to know you!
