title: Senior Test Engineer (ETL/Datawarehouse Testing)
description_html:
About Gartner IT: 

Join a world-class team of skilled engineers who build creative digital solutions to support our colleagues and clients.  We make a broad organizational impact by delivering cutting-edge technology solutions that power Gartner.  Gartner IT values its culture of nonstop innovation, an outcome-driven approach to success, and the notion that great ideas can come from anyone on the team. 

About the role:

Gartner is looking for a strong ETL Datawarehouse Sr Test Engineer with a background in Enterprise Datawarehouse ETL and BI Report Quality validation expertise.

What you will do:

  • Develop, implement, and maintain comprehensive test plans and test cases for Enterprise Datawarehouse solutions.

  • Conduct thorough testing of ETL and BI Reports to ensure data accuracy, consistency, and reliability.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including data analysts, data engineers, and business stakeholders, to understand data requirements and business rules. Identify, document, and track defects and inconsistencies in data management processes.

  • Perform root cause analysis on data quality issues and recommend corrective actions.

  • Validate data integration and data migration processes to ensure seamless data flow across systems.

  • Develop test scripts for data testing in Enterprise Datawarehouse for data accuracy, data completeness & data integrity.

Who you are:

  • 4-6 years of experience in Information Technology with specialization in Dawarehouse/ETL Quality Assurance.

  • 4+ years of hands-on proficiency in SQL and data querying tools for comparing and testing data.

  • Strong understanding of Datawarehouse concepts, including Extract Transform Load(ETL), Business Intelligence Reports, Dimension and Fact tables.

  • Proven experience in quality assurance, specifically in Enterprise Datawarehouse environments.

  • Strong understanding of data management principles, data governance, and data quality standards.

  • Experience with ETL tools and Query platforms such as Informatica, Azure Data Factory, SSMS, TOAD

title: IT Incident & Problem Manager - incident managmt + process owner
description_html:
About Gartner:

Gartner, Inc. (NYSE: IT) is the world’s leading information technology research and advisory company. We deliver the technology-related insight necessary for our clients to make the right decisions, every day. We work with every client to research, analyze and interpret the business of IT within the context of their individual role. Founded in 1979, Gartner is headquartered in Stamford, Connecticut, U.S.A. - Visit www.gartner.comto learn more.

About this role :

This position is responsible for overall response to critical Incidents. This role facilitates, develops, and maintains the overall Incident Management process, and works with other team leads when process deficiencies or improvements are identified.
Responsible for coordination of Problem records including creation, assignment, follow-up and reporting, along with the growth and management of the Problem Management practice overall.
 

What you will do:

  • Acts as the 24x7 escalation point for critical service interruptions, ensuring effective incident control, coordination, and communication across all high-impact incidents.

  •  Leads and coordinates Major Incident Management activities to restore services swiftly, with full accountability for end-to-end incident resolution.

  • Owns stakeholder communications during critical incidents, providing timely, accurate status updates to business and technical leadership.

  • Ensures rapid service restoration and resolution of complex and high-impact incidents while minimizing business disruption.

  • Creates, manages, and governs Problem records throughout their lifecycle, including after-hours support during critical outages when required.

  • Facilitates and drives Major Incident Reviews (MIRs) and Problem Review meetings, ensuring clear actions, accountability, and closure.

  • Audits major incident tickets for correct prioritization, technical accuracy, business impact alignment, and adherence to SLA/OLA commitments.

  • Defines, develops, and tracks incident and problem management metrics, enabling proactive identification of trends, risks, and systemic issues.

  • Documents, implements, and continuously improves Incident and Problem Management processes, escalating risks and gaps to relevant process owners.

  • Leads Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for all Priority 1 and Priority 2 incidents and ensures corrective and preventive actions are effectively implemented.

  • Supports ITIL process maturity and standardization across Service Management functions in collaboration with other process owners.

  • Produces executive- and customer-facing incident reports and dashboards, supporting KPIs, SLAs, and OLAs.

  • Builds and maintains strong, trusted relationships with business, application, infrastructure, and vendor stakeholders to drive effective service management outcomes.

What you will need:

8-12yrs of experience as Incident and Problem Manager with atleast 2 years into coaching and mentoring teams

Must have

  • Bachelor’s degree required; Engineering or relevant technical discipline preferred.

  • Expert knowledge of writing and maintaining Incident and Problem Management Processes

  • Expert‑level knowledge in defining, implementing, and governing Incident and Problem Management processes

  • Proven experience managing critical outages, leading Major Incident reviews, and chairing Problem Review Boards (PRBs)

  • Demonstrated ability to drive continuous improvement and prudent change, challenging the status quo while balancing innovation, flexibility, and customer value -must

  • Strong judgment and accountability in decision‑making, with sound problem‑solving, risk assessment, and customer‑centric thinking - must

  • Proven capability to lead high‑performing teams through leading by example, coaching, continuous learning, and effective recognition-must

  • Able to clearly articulate incident impacts, risks, and remediation plans to diverse audiences

  • Familiarity with enterprise IT environments and integrations across IT infrastructure, applications, and ITSM tooling

  • Highly organized, proactive, and adaptable, with the ability to operate effectively in high‑pressure environments

  • Self‑motivated with demonstrated creative and critical thinking capabilities

  • Strong team orientation with a positive mindset, continuous learning attitude, and willingness to support others

Who you are

  • Fluent in English (written and spoken) with confidence engaging senior leadership and executive stakeholders Able to work independently or within a team proactively in a fast-paced AGILE-SCRUM environment.

  • Owns success – Takes responsibility for successful delivery of the solutions.

  • Ardent desire to improve upon their skills in software development, frameworks, and technologies.

  • Strong stakeholder management, mediation, and relationship‑building skills across technology and business teams

What we offer:

In addition to an outstanding work environment with rapid advancement potential, Gartner associates enjoy exceptional compensation and benefits, including:

An upbeat, positive culture. Integrity, objectivity, collaboration, results, and a no-limits mind-set are central to our values

Limitless growth. We work with you to help you meet your goals and advance within the company. Encouragement to be innovative and challenge status quo. Exposure to industry leading training and development. Performance-based recognition and rewards

title: Systems Engineer - Salesforce
description_html:
About Gartner IT:

Join a world-class team of skilled engineers who build creative digital solutions to support our colleagues and clients.  We make a broad organizational impact by delivering cutting-edge technology solutions that power Gartner.  Gartner IT values its culture of nonstop innovation, an outcome-driven approach to success, and the notion that great ideas can come from anyone on the team.  

About the role

The Systems Engineer provides direct end-user support to Gartner’s Salesforce CRM community, across multiple business units. The candidate will work directly with the end users, to make sure that they have the right access, knowledge, and data for their job responsibilities. The candidate will also work directly with IT colleagues, to resolve underlying issues, and collaborate on software design changes.
This role is primarily focused on Level 2 (L2) Support, handling escalations, advanced troubleshooting, and ensuring stability of Salesforce applications. Salesforce expertise is mandatory, and exposure to Anaplan is a good to have.

What you will do

Provide L2 support to CRM users worldwide while working closely with Engineering teams to maintain the operational integrity of production systems
• Act as an escalation point for L1 support and handle complex incidents and problem management activities
• Provide efficient application support and administration, including incident resolution and problem management follow up based on knowledge articles, SOPs and Run Books
• Configure, support, and provide subject matter expertise for Salesforce's Sales and Service clouds ( Salesforce expertise is mandatory )
• Maintenance and customization users, roles, profiles, groups, accounts, contacts, record types, sharing rules, custom objects, pick lists and page layout customization to support vital business functions
• Perform final Data Mapping and execution of Data import of any approved business requests into CRM
• Create reports and dashboards to perform data analysis and to troubleshoot and fix bugs
• Identify risks, deliver clear documentation, and work directly with internal stakeholders and external vendors to resolve escalations
• Develop and design data insights for monitoring and scaling business processes
• Support AppExchange and integrations that are in place for the Salesforce core org working with other internal and external systems as well as other vendors
• Monitor and address SFDC tasks and tickets within SLA timelines
• Develop and update reports as needed
• Create new reports
• Develop / configure report customizations
• Provide field level access to users
• Update and Create flows in SFDC
• Resolve end user problems by clarifying issues; researching and exploring answers and alternative solutions; implementing solutions; escalating unresolved problems
• Identify ticket trends and work towards reducing recurrences
• Identify opportunities to simplify, optimize, and automate business processes.

What you will need  

Bachelor's Degree with a minimum of 2-3 years of Salesforce administration and L2 application/system support experience

         Must have

Hands-on Salesforce (SFDC) experience is mandatory
• Experience working on data models with hands-on report and dashboard building to perform data analysis
• Experience understanding business logic
• Proven ability to manage users, data, and security
• Proven troubleshooting skills including the ability to analyze and resolve difficult problems quickly with keen attention to detail ( especially in L2 support environments )
• Demonstrated proficiency in the use of data management tools such as Data Loader
• Detail-oriented with excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Who you are

  • Bachelor’s degree or foreign equivalent degree in Computer Science or a related field required

  • Possess strong communication and interpersonal skills.

  • Must be familiar with systems scope and projects objectives to ensure design, build and test of a robust system

  • Able to work independently or within a team proactively in a fast-paced AGILE-SCRUM environment.

  • Strong desire to improve upon their skills in software development, frameworks, and technologies.

Don’t meet every single requirement? We encourage you to apply anyway. You might just be the right candidate for this, or other roles.

Who are we?

At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.

Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.

Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.

What makes Gartner a great place to work?

Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.

We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.

Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.

We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.

Gartner is the world authority on AI

At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.

It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.

What do we offer?

Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.

In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.

Ready to grow your career with Gartner? Join us.

title: Project Manager (IT Scrum Master: 5-6 yrs exp reqd)
description_html:
About the role:
Gartner is seeking a Project Manager to manage the day-to-day Project management activities of multiple IT projects or scrum teams operating within an Agile framework.
 

What you’ll need:

Strong IT professional with hands-on experience in Managing the IT projects and Agile Project Management knowledge. The candidate should have strong qualitative and quantitative problem-solving skills along with high level of ownership and accountability. 

Must have:

  •  4-5 years of experience in managing IT Projects and strong project management skills.

  •  3+ years in Strong Agile Scrum knowledge, and hands on experience with the full software development lifecycle

  •  Experience to apply Agile project management practices, facilitate Scrum ceremonies, and drive continuous improvement within the team.

  •  Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, stakeholders, and leadership to align project objectives with business goals.

  •    Identify, analyze, and resolve project risks and issues, maintaining clear communication throughout the project lifecycle.

  •    Foster a culture of ownership, accountability, and high performance within the team.

  •  Excellent communication skills both written and verbal.

  • Knowledge of IT documentation processes/procedures.

  •  Experience with on-site offshore model, flexible with shift timings (working with US clients).

  •  Support on weekends for releases, as and when the need be (once in a month/ adhoc basis).

  • Strong ability to understand business expectations and to resolve issues that may affect delivery.

​  Nice to have:

  •  Experience with CRM platforms such as Salesforce or similar market-leading products. 

  •  Experience managing CRM platforms and DevOps activities, including supporting technical teams during production deployments.

  •  Experience working on enterprise-level initiatives and collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.

  •  Experience collaborating with integration teams.

What you’ll do :  

  • Oversee day-to-day management of multiple IT projects or scrum teams operating within an Agile framework. 

  •  Lead projects using Agile Scrum methodologies, coordinating both small and large teams, including those with multiple scrum dependencies and vendor collaboration. 

  •  Ensure effective implementation of Agile/Scrum processes, providing coaching and guidance to maximize team performance. 

  • Manage project scope, schedules, budgets, risks, and deliverables, and communicate project status to stakeholders. 

  •  Experience collaborating with Development and QA teams to drive release activities and manage production deployments.

  • Ensure seamless execution of projects while aligning with the organization’s strategic objectives, commitments, and goals. 

  • Facilitate communication and collaboration across cross-functional teams within a complex organizational ecosystem. 

  • Quickly establish credibility with business units and IT partners as a proactive change agent, leveraging exceptional leadership and managerial skills to drive project success.

Who you are:

  • Bachelor’s degree or foreign equivalent degree in Computer Science or a related field required

  •  Motivated, high-potential performer, with demonstrated ability to influence and lead.

  • Strong communicator with excellent interpersonal skills.

  • Able to solve complex problems and successfully manage ambiguity and unexpected change.

  • Teachable and embracing of best practices and feedback as a means of continuous improvement.

  • Consistently high achiever marked by perseverance, humility and a positive outlook in the face of challenges.

  • Strong desire to improve upon their skills in tools and technologies

Don’t meet every single requirement? We encourage you to apply anyway. You might just be the right candidate for this, or other roles.

JOB LEVEL

P40

EMPLOYEE ROLE

Individual Contributor

The Opportunity

We are hiring for a Sales Operations Manager to join our India C&P Sales Operations team based in India.

This role partners closely with India Sales Leadership to drive forecasting discipline, pipeline management, business cadence, and operational execution across the region. We are looking for someone who can both run the business effectively today and help evolve the Sales Operations function over time.

Key Responsibilities

  • Drive weekly forecasting and quarterly outlook cadences with strong pipeline analysis and operational discipline
  • Partner with Sales Leadership to diagnose performance gaps and develop action plans to improve business outcomes
  • Support GTM planning, quota setting, territory planning, sales performance tracking, and pipeline governance
  • Improve operational processes, reporting frameworks, and CRM hygiene to increase efficiency and visibility
  • Build scalable dashboards and insights that help drive accountability and decision-making
  • Partner cross-functionally with Finance, Marketing, Channel, Renewals, and other ecosystem teams

What We’re Looking For

  • 7+ years experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, or related commercial operations roles
  • Strong hands-on experience across forecasting, pipeline management, QBR support, quota/territory planning, and sales performance management
  • Ability to influence stakeholders, solve problems proactively, and operate effectively and independently in a fast-paced matrixed environment
  • Strong Excel skills and experience with CRM/BI tools such as Dynamics, Power BI, etc.
  • Exceptional interpersonal, presentation, and communication skills
  • High proficiency in English (written and oral)

About Adobe

Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.

AI Use Guidelines for Interviews:

The use of AI or recording tools during live interviews is not permitted unless explicitly invited by the interviewer or approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation. This role provides an opportunity to work on modern AI technologies, including Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), knowledge systems, and cloud-native platforms at enterprise scale.

What You'll Do

  • Build, develop, and maintain AI-powered applications and backend services.
  • Improve LLM-based solutions using techniques such as RAG, Agentic RAG, and enterprise knowledge retrieval.
  • Build APIs, microservices, and workflows to embed capabilities into Adobe products and platforms.

  • Evaluate, monitor, and ensure the reliability and performance of AI systems.
  • Stay updated with emerging AI technologies and contribute ideas that improve engineering efficiency and product capabilities.

What You Need to Succeed

  • 3–5 years of experience building software applications, backend services, or distributed systems.
  • Strong programming skills in Python, Java, or a similar modern programming language.
  • Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals, data structures, algorithms, and system architecture principles.
  • Hands-on experience developing applications using Large Language Models (LLMs) and AI frameworks.
  • Familiarity with RAG architectures, vector databases, embeddings, and timely engineering techniques.
  • Solid grasp of database principles, data modeling, indexing, query tuning, and transactional systems.

  • Understanding of distributed programming concepts, including concurrency, scalability, fault tolerance, and distributed system development.
  • Familiarity with APIs, microservices, and cloud-native application creation.
  • Exposure to event-driven systems, messaging platforms, or streaming technologies.
  • Experience working with data platforms, data pipelines, or extensive data processing systems.

Preferred Qualifications

Senior Account Manager
Job post (R169937)for a marketing role in Noida
Job Code: MMKTP40
Job Level: P40
Region:AMER
By Shweta Chauhan 

Our Company

Changing the world through digital experiences is what Adobe’s all about. We give everyone from emerging artists to global brands' everything they need to design and deliver exceptional digital experiences! We’re passionate about empowering people to create beautiful and powerful images, videos, and apps, and transform how companies interact with customers across every screen.

We’re on a mission to hire the very best and dedicated to crafting outstanding employee experiences where everyone is respected and has access to equal opportunity. We realize that new ideas can come from everywhere in the organization, and we know the next big idea could be yours!

Job Description

We are seeking an AI-First Media Buyer to manage and scale paid advertising campaigns across Search & App platforms (Google, Bing, ASA, UAC etc.). The role combines high-level critical thinking with autonomous tools powered by artificial intelligence. The ideal candidate will move beyond manual campaign management to focus on creative strategy, advanced AI prompting, and data analysis to drive maximum ROAS (Return on Ad Spend)

Hands-on search buying role on Adobe’s in-house paid search team. The ideal candidate is an experienced search professional with 10+ years of buying, campaign management, and optimization experience in Search platforms (Google, Bing) as a mandatory requirement. Proven expertise in Google Campaigns is essential.

Additionally, experience in buying and campaign execution across UAC & ASA is strongly preferred. The candidate should be able to manage multiple campaigns concurrently, ensuring seamless coordination and execution across these platforms.

The ideal candidate understands search buying concepts, guidelines, and optimization strategies well. They can advise on campaign setup and creative direction for each platform’s strengths. Enjoys building cross-functional relationships and can collaborate effectively with internal team members and external partners to deliver on marketing objectives.

Responsibilities:

  • Complete search campaigns, ensuring campaigns are built, launched, optimized, and reported on successfully and within specified scope
  • Launch and QA campaigns with defined campaign parameters (budget, timing, objective, goals, audience targeting)
  • Monitor campaign performance across multiple search platforms on an ongoing basis, and drive insights and optimizations to drive higher ROAS
  • Analyze campaign build and management workflows and find ways to automate, to drive faster time to activation
  • Set and manage timing and deliverable expectations with campaign collaborators and ensure key deadlines are met

Skills and Qualifications:

  • Hands-on experience in multiple search platforms including Google, Bing, ASA and UAC.
  • Expert buying and optimizing experience in Google
  • Experience with MMPs such as AppsFlyer, Adjust, Branch, Singular, or Kochava.
  • Knowledge of SKAdNetwork (SKAN), AdAttributionKit, and App Tracking Transparency (ATT).
  • Understanding App Store Optimization (ASO) guidelines.
  • Experience with Apple Custom Product Pages (CPP) and Product Page Optimization (PPO).
  • Knowledge of Google Play Store Listing Experiments and conversion optimization.
  • Strong hold on Marketing fundamentals to help client drive maximum out of their digital Ad spends
  • Hands-on expertise in managing high-value campaigns across Google & Apple advertising platforms
  • Experience managing end-to-end search planning and buying workflows from discovery phase through post-mortem reporting
  • Solid comprehension of search buying optimization concepts and ability to communicate them clearly to non-technical audiences
  • Ability to analyze and draw meaningful and actionable insights from data
  • Excellent time management and multitasking skills with keen attention to detail
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills

Experience:

  • 10+ years of hands-on, in-platform search buying at an agency, media trading desk, or media vendor required.
  • 7+ years of managing Google campaigns from planning or buying workflows
  • Working proficiency with Excel (pivot tables, lookups, etc.)
  • Experience optimizing media toward multi-touch attribution data preferred
  • Bachelor's Degree or equivalent experience

Equal opportunity

We encourage candidates from all backgrounds. We value curiosity, empathy, and continuous learning. If you’re passionate about the mission and meet most requirements, we encourage you to apply.

This is your moment to become a member of Adobe's dynamic team and efficiently introduce powerful solutions that influence the digital landscape. If you are a proven technical expert with a passion for innovation, we invite you to get in touch.

Internal Opportunities

Creativity, curiosity, and constant learning are celebrated aspects of your career growth journey. We’re glad that you’re pursuing a new opportunity at Adobe!

Put your best foot forward:

Update your Resume/CV and Workday profile – don’t forget to include your uniquely ‘Adobe’ experiences and volunteer work. If you are applying for a role outside of your current country, ensure you review the International Resources for Relocating Employees on Inside Adobe, including the impacts to your Benefits, AIP, Equity & Payroll.

Once you apply for a role via Workday, the Talent Team will contact you within 2 weeks. If you move into the official interview process with the hiring team, make sure you inform your manager so they can champion your career growth.

At Adobe, you will be immersed in an exceptional work environment that is recognized around the world. You will also be surrounded by colleagues who are committed to helping each other grow through our unique Check-In approach where ongoing feedback flows freely. If you’re looking to make an impact, Adobe's the place for you. The Opportunity

Lead Adobe’s global in-house Social & Programmatic buying function across all regions! This role coordinates the regional pod for EMEA, driving unified execution across paid social, organic social, and programmatic channels to improve full-funnel performance.

What you'll Do

  • Remain hands-on in-platform (Meta, TikTok, Snap, LinkedIn, etc.), supporting campaign builds, optimizations, and troubleshooting

  • Convert global strategy into regionally appropriate action plans, taking into account market nuances and platform differences

  • Coordinate campaign lifecycle: planning, setup, QA, launch, optimization, and reporting

  • Ensure strong operational rigor across tagging, tracking, pacing, and delivery

  • Monitor performance and guide optimizations across audiences, creatives, bidding strategies, and placements

  • Partner with cross-functional teams (Creative, Analytics, Marketing Ops, Programmatic teams) to ensure seamless execution

  • Leverage platform automation and AI tools to improve efficiency and performance

What you need to succeed

  • 4–6+ years of hands-on paid social experience across major platforms

  • Proven experience managing campaigns end-to-end and optimizing toward performance goals

  • Prior team leadership or mentorship experience preferred

  • Solid grasp of regional market subtleties and audience behaviors

  • Familiarity with programmatic buying concepts or DSP platforms is a plus

  • Experience with social platform automation (Smartly.IO, Sprinklr etc), AI features, or performance tools

  • Strong analytical skills and ability to translate data into actionable insights

description_text:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

About the team

We are the Digital Services team within Customer Service Technology under eBay’s Global Technology Organization. We own the end-to-end online customer service experience across web and native mobile, helping millions of buyers and sellers get fast, effective help every day.

Our mission is to keep members in-journey and resolve issues through intuitive, compliant self-service experiences, driving high containment and deflection, lower customer effort (CES), and reduced assisted contact. We design and build the experiences that enable customers to quickly find answers, resolve issues through self-service, and get support when needed. . Partnering closely with Product, Design, Data, and Platform teams, we deliver intuitive, reliable, and scalable solutions that improve the end-to-end customer service journey. 

Our engineers work across backend services, APIs, frontend applications, and platform integrations using a modern, diverse tech stack that includes Java, Node.js, web services, native iOS and Android, and a variety of data stores such as NoSQL and Oracle, with a strong focus on quality, observability, and collaboration in a highly distributed environment.

This role is ideal for a senior engineer who combines deep backend expertise with strong technical leadership and full stack versatility. While the primary focus will be backend architecture, services, APIs, and platform integrations, this person will also contribute across the stack when needed and serve as the technical lead for the team.

What You Will Do

  • Translate product and business requirements into scalable software designs and deliver clean, efficient, extensible, and maintainable code.

  • Own the design, development, testing, and deployment of backend services, APIs, integrations, and distributed systems that power customer self-service experiences across web and mobile surfaces.

  • Design highly scalable, resilient, secure, and performant backend systems that support Help and Contact experiences used by millions of customers.

  • Partner closely with Product, Design, Data, and Platform teams to deliver innovative, end-to-end solutions aligned with business goals and customer needs.

  • Contribute to full stack development as needed, including frontend integrations and end-to-end solution design, to support flawless customer experiences.

  • Raise the team’s engineering standards through code reviews, design reviews, architecture guidance, technical mentoring, and the promotion of standards across the team.

  • Identify gaps and systemic issues, propose practical solutions, and help shape the engineering roadmap and technical priorities for the team.

  • Improve team productivity by seeing opportunities for better tooling, reusable frameworks, development processes, and platform improvements.

  • Ensure systems are testable, high-quality, observable, secure, and continuously deliverable through strong engineering and operational practices.

  • Support production systems through release management, debugging, monitoring, incident response, and on-call responsibilities for an always-on 24/7 site.

What you will bring:

  • 7+ years of software development experience with strong computer science fundamentals and problem-solving skills.

  • Deep expertise in Java (Spring / Spring Boot) and/or Python, with experience building scalable APIs using REST and GraphQL.

  • Full stack experience, including familiarity with frontend technologies such as JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, React, Marko, and modern web development frameworks.

  • 2+ years of experience designing and developing AI/ML-based applications.

  • Hands-on experience building or integrating AI-powered applications, including working with large language models, prompts, and evaluation/monitoring of AI features.

  • Strong expertise in Event Processing (Kafka, JMS, or MQ) 

  • Experience acting as a technical lead, mentoring engineers, driving design reviews, and influencing engineering best practices across a team.

  • Strong understanding of distributed systems, service integration patterns, scalability, reliability, observability, security, and performance optimization.

  • Solid understanding of databases and data access patterns, including Oracle, NoSQL, and modern API/query patterns.

  • Familiarity with Agile development, CI/CD pipelines, Git, testing strategies, and modern engineering best practices.

  • Experience leveraging AI-assisted development tools (e.g., code generation, test automation, code review aids) to improve productivity and code quality.

Additional Details

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.

 

We use cookies to enhance your experience and may use AI tools for administrative tasks in the hiring process. To learn how we handle your personal data and use AI responsibly, please visit our Talent Privacy Notice, Privacy Center, and AI Hiring Guidelines.

We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

Looking for a company that inspires passion, courage, and creativity—where you can help shape the future of global commerce? At eBay, you’ll work on technology that impacts how millions of people buy, sell, connect, and share around the world.

We’re a purpose-driven, inclusive community committed to innovation and empowering small businesses globally.

Join the Customer Support Technology (CS Platform) team to help build the systems that power eBay’s global customer service experience.

This is a full-stack engineering role where you will:

  • Contribute to backend services and APIs

  • Build user-facing web applications and internal tools

  • Support development of workflow systems and automation platforms

You’ll work on features that improve agent productivity and customer experience, collaborating closely with senior engineers.

This is a hands-on IC role:

  • 70–80% coding (frontend + backend)

  • 20–30% collaboration, reviews, and learning

You will primarily own well-scoped features with guidance.

Must-Have Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • BS/MS in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience

  • 2–4 years of full-stack software development experience

Backend

  • Proficiency in Java (or similar backend language)

  • Experience building or contributing to REST APIs

  • Basic understanding of databases (SQL; exposure to NoSQL is a plus)

Frontend

  • Proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript

  • Experience with React, Angular, or similar frameworks

  • Understanding of API integration and responsive UI development

General

  • Familiarity with:

    • Git and CI/CD pipelines

    • Basic testing and debugging practices

  • Strong problem-solving skills and willingness to learn

  • Basic familiarity with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Copilot, ChatGPT)

  • Awareness of how AI/LLMs are used in applications (APIs, simple workflows, automation)

Nice-to-Have

  • Exposure to Spring Boot or similar frameworks

  • Familiarity with Docker or cloud environments

  • Basic understanding of state management (Redux, etc.)

  • Exposure to monitoring/logging tools

  • Awareness of workflow or automation systems

  • Exposure to LLM-based features, such as:

    • Chat or summarization use cases

    • Prompt-based workflows

    • API-based AI integrations

What You’ll Do

  • Develop and maintain frontend and backend components

  • Build and enhance web applications and APIs

  • Write clean, testable, and maintainable code

  • Participate in code reviews and Agile ceremonies

  • Troubleshoot issues in development and production with guidance

  • Collaborate with engineers, product managers, and designers

  • Contribute to improving performance, scalability, and reliability

  • Support development of AI-enabled features or integrations (e.g., automation, assistive workflows)

What Success Looks Like

  • Delivers well-defined features with guidance

  • Writes clear, reliable, and maintainable code

  • Actively participates in team processes and code reviews

  • Demonstrates curiosity and continuous learning

  • Shows initiative in using modern tools, including AI, to improve efficiency and outcomes

  • Collaborates effectively within the team

Team & Impact

You’ll be part of a team building tools and platforms used by customer support agents globally, helping improve efficiency and customer outcomes at scale.

About eBay

At eBay, we connect millions of buyers and sellers around the world, crafting economic opportunity for individuals, entrepreneurs, businesses, and organizations of all sizes. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse workplace where everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and do their best.

Learn more: https://www.ebayinc.com/our-company/diversity-inclusion/

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. description_text:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

Job Description

Looking for a company that inspires passion, courage, and creativity—where you can help shape the future of global commerce? At eBay, you’ll work on technology that impacts how millions of people buy, sell, connect, and share around the world.

We’re a purpose-driven, inclusive community committed to innovation and empowering small businesses globally.

About the Role

Join the Customer Support Technology (CS Platform) team building the systems that power eBay’s global customer service experience.

This is a full-stack engineering role where you will:

  • Build scalable backend services and APIs

  • Develop user-facing web applications and agent tools

  • Contribute to AI-powered platform capabilities, including orchestration layers and automation systems

You will work on workflow systems, automation platforms, and UI experiences that improve agent productivity and customer outcomes.

This is a hands-on IC role:

  • 60–70% coding/design (frontend + backend)

  • 30–40% reviews, collaboration, and operational excellence

You’ll own features end-to-end (UI → services → data → actions).

Must-Have Qualifications

  • BS/MS in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience

  • 4–8 years of full-stack software development experience

Backend:

  • Strong proficiency in Java (11+) and Spring Boot

  • Experience building REST APIs and distributed systems

  • Familiarity with Kafka or similar messaging systems

  • Experience with SQL + NoSQL databases

Frontend:

  • Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript

  • Experience with React, Angular, or similar frameworks

  • Experience building responsive, performant web applications

  • Understanding of API integration and async UI patterns

General:

  • Experience with CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes

  • Strong testing practices (unit, integration, frontend testing)

  • Solid debugging and problem-solving skills

Additionally:

  • General familiarity with AI-assisted development concepts (LLMs, prompts, agent workflows)

  • Interest in building and evolving AI-powered systems such as orchestration layers, automation agents, and intent-driven workflows

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with customer support or workflow systems

  • Familiarity with state management (Redux, etc.)

  • Exposure to observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk)

  • Experience with OAuth2/OIDC and secure application design

  • Exposure to AI/agent-based systems, including:

    • prompt engineering

    • orchestration frameworks

    • tool/agent integration patterns

What You’ll Do

  • Design and build end-to-end features (UI + backend services)

  • Develop scalable APIs and user-facing web applications

  • Build and enhance agent tools, workflow engines, and automation platforms

  • Contribute to AI-powered capabilities, including:

    • agent orchestration

    • MCP layers and workflows

    • intent-to-action systems

  • Write high-quality, well-tested code across the stack

  • Improve performance, scalability, and reliability

  • Participate in on-call rotations (follow-the-sun model)

  • Collaborate with Product, SRE, and cross-functional teams

  • Review code, write design docs, and improve engineering practices

  • Reduce tech debt and drive operational improvements

  • Mentor junior engineers or lead small workstreams

Here at eBay, we love creating opportunities for others by connecting people from widely diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and geographies. So, being diverse and inclusive isn’t just something we strive for, it is who we are, and part of what we do each and every single day. We want to ensure that as an employee, you feel eBay is a place where, no matter who you are, you feel safe, included, and that you have the opportunity to bring your unique self to work. To learn about eBay’s Diversity & Inclusion click here: https://www.ebayinc.com/our-company/diversity-inclusion/.

Additional Details

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.

title: Sr. Business Analyst, Corporate Actions
description_html: About the Role: Grade Level (for internal use): 10 The Role: Sr. Business Analyst, Corporate Actions (Grade 10). The Team The Managed Corporate Actions (MCA) team is responsible for defining, enhancing, and scaling corporate actions data and processing capabilities across global markets. We work closely with Operations, Product, and Technology teams to translate complex market events and issuer announcements into structured, automated, and client-ready solutions, with a strong focus on client ready to consume files (e.g., agent validation services and ISO-aligned event models). The Impact This role is critical to ensuring accurate, timely, and scalable corporate actions processing across equities, fixed income, and funds. By converting unstructured market disclosures into clear functional logic, data rules, and platform requirements, the Business Analyst improves automation, data quality, and operational efficiency, reducing exceptions and risk across the post-trade lifecycle. A key focus will be on utilities and services (such as agent validation service) and strengthening standards-based mappings, helping drive consistent outcomes across markets and sources. What’s in it for you Build deep subject-matter expertise in global corporate actions while working on complex, real-world market events. Gain hands-on exposure to automation, rule engines, validation frameworks, and data platforms used by global financial institutions. Own end-to-end BA delivery across discovery, requirements, testing, and implementation support for defined MCA initiatives. Collaborate with senior stakeholders across Operations, Product, and Technology, building a path toward Senior BA / Lead BA or product-adjacent roles. Responsibilities Own and deliver business and functional requirements for defined corporate action initiatives/event domains, including user stories, acceptance criteria, and business rules. Analyze corporate actions and issuer disclosures to define event logic, workflows, key dates, options/entitlements, and exception scenarios. Produce and maintain BA artifacts: process flows, target-state designs, data definitions, source-to-target mappings, and transformation logic for ingestion, normalization, and distribution. Define and maintain ISO-structure-aligned event models (event taxonomy, options, key dates, narratives, validations) and drive consistent interpretation across systems and teams. Support integration and operationalization of utilities/services (e.g., agent validation service): workflow design, validation checkpoints, exception handling, and auditability/control requirements. Lead BA testing contributions: test planning, scenario/test case definition, UAT support, output validation, and defect triage/resolution with Technology and Operations. What We’re Looking For Key Qualifications 3–4 years of experience as a Business Analyst within capital markets, asset servicing, or financial data/platform environments. Corporate actions domain exposure across equities, fixed income, and/or funds, including event lifecycle concepts (key dates, options/elections, entitlements). Hands-on SQL capability for data analysis, validation, reconciliation, and impact assessment. Experience translating unstructured inputs into structured outputs: data models, mapping specifications, business rules, and functional logic, with working knowledge of ISO-style structures for corporate actions. Core Skills & Attributes (soft skills) Strong analytical mindset with the ability to work on large datasets, ambiguity, and complex event-driven workflows. Excellent documentation skills across BRDs/FSDs (or equivalent), process flows, mapping documents, and target-state designs. Confident stakeholder engagement and alignment across Operations, Product, and Technology (and external utilities/partners where applicable). High attention to detail and clear communication, especially around time-sensitive key dates, options, validations, and exception handling. title: Junior Associate, Risk & Chargebacks
description_html:
Razorpay is one of India’s leading full-stack financial technology companies, powering the way businesses move, manage, and grow money. Founded in 2014 by Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar with a simple vision - to simplify payments for Indian businesses - we’ve since grown into a fintech powerhouse driving India’s digital payment revolution.

Razorpay powers millions of businesses with a smarter, scalable stack that goes beyond transactions to help them truly build and grow.

From building AI-native agentic payments, to AI-assisted fraud detection and real-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners - including banks, networks, regulators - we are pioneering industry-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech

Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation - powering a fintech ecosystem that’s redefining how money moves across Asia.

Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early-stage startups to some of India’s largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently.

Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, WhatsApp, Airtel, CRED, BookmyShow, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme - and over 100 of India’s unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region.

We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India & SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, MasterCard, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions - including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), BillMe (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards-first UPI) - along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia.

But what truly sets Razorpay apart is our culture. At Razorpay, ownership is our oxygen - you own what you build, with no micromanagement or red tape, just the runway to make your ideas fly. Learning is a lifestyle - if you’re curious, you’ll feel at home here. People > Pedigree - we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. Transparency thrives over titles - this is where interns question CXOs and CXOs say “thank you.” Guided by our values of Customer First, Autonomy & Ownership, Agility with Integrity, Transparency, Challenging the status quo and a strong belief that Razorpay grows with Razors,  you’ll be part of a 3000+ strong team building not just products, but the financial infrastructure of the future.

Role Summary

We are looking for a detail-oriented Analyst / Jr. Analyst to join our SG & US— Chargeback Operations team. In this role you will own the end-to-end lifecycle of chargeback cases — from initiation through resolution — by working directly on the bank / gateway portal. You will collaborate cross-functionally with banks and internal teams to protect Razorpay’s acquiring interests while delivering fair and timely outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

Bank/Gateway Portal Operations

  • Log in to and navigate the respective portal daily to monitor, pick up, and action chargeback cases across all dispute types.
  • Submit chargeback representments, pre-arbitration responses, and arbitration filings within gateway-mandated timelines.
  • Track case statuses end-to-end and ensure no case breaches the response deadline.
  • Download and organise portal reports; maintain a daily tracker for open, pending, and closed cases.

Chargeback Types Handled

  • Fraudulent / Unauthorised Transactions — validate and compile fraud dispute evidence packets.
  • Technical Disputes (duplicate charges, incorrect amounts, processing errors) — gather transaction logs and switch-level confirmations.
  • Merchant Disputes (non-delivery, service/quality issues) — coordinate with merchant for proof of fulfilment.
  • Consumer Disputes — verify refund status, settlement records, and communicate resolution to the issuer.
  • Pre-arbitration & Arbitration — prepare case files and coordinate with the acquiring bank and gateway.

Evidence & Documentation

  • Collect, review, and compile evidence (transaction receipts, screenshots, settlement data, merchant responses) to build strong representment cases.
  • Ensure all supporting documents meet card network format and content guidelines before portal submission.
  • Maintain a structured repository of case files for audit readiness.

Merchant & Stakeholder Coordination

  • Reach out to merchants/cross functional teams proactively to obtain dispute documentation within internal SLAs.
  • Liaise with the gateway/acquiring bank’s chargeback desk for portal escalations or technical issues.
  • Update merchants and internal stakeholders on case progress and outcomes.

MIS & Reporting

  • Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly MIS reports on chargeback volumes, win rates, recovery amounts, and TAT adherence.
  • Identify trends in dispute reasons and flag recurring issues to the team lead.
  • Contribute data for monthly business reviews and card network compliance reporting.

Process Adherence & Improvement

  • Follow all card network chargeback operating procedures and Razorpay internal SOPs.
  • Flag process gaps or portal issues and propose solutions to improve efficiency or win rates or any spike in the chargeback

Required Qualifications & Skills

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Commerce, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.

Experience

  • Jr. Analyst: 0–1 year of experience in payments operations, banking operations, or chargeback handling.
  • Analyst: 1–3 years of hands-on experience in UPI chargeback operations, preferably on the fintech or international chargebacks.

Technical & Domain Skills

  • Working knowledge of the international chargebacks or willingness to learn it immediately upon joining.
  • Understanding of Singapore & US ecosystem — Card network rules, chargeback reason codes, dispute TATs, and representment guidelines.
  • Proficiency in MS Excel / Google Sheets for MIS, data reconciliation, and tracker management.
  • Ability to read and interpret transaction logs, settlement files, and switch reports.
  • Familiarity with International bank processes and NPCI circulars related to dispute management.

Soft Skills

  • High attention to detail — accuracy in case data and documentation is non-negotiable.
  • Strong written communication for drafting representment narratives and merchant correspondence.
  • Time management — ability to prioritise a high-volume queue and meet strict portal deadlines.
  • Problem-solving mindset with a proactive approach to dispute resolution.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with merchants, banks, and cross-functional internal teams.

 

Good to Have

  • Prior experience working on international cards chargeback process.
  • Exposure to other payment dispute platforms (Visa VROL, Mastercard MATCH, RuPay dispute system).
  • Knowledge of PCI-DSS, Regulatory guidelines on payment aggregators, or NPCI operating guidelines.
  • Experience with ticketing or case management tools (Freshdesk, Jira Service Desk).

What We Offer

  • Opportunity to work on International market chargeback stack.
  • Deep exposure to network regulations, acquiring bank operations, and fintech dispute management.
  • Structured learning path with access to internal knowledge base and Card association support.
  • Collaborative and ownership-driven team culture.
Razorpay believes in and follows an equal employment opportunity policy that doesn't discriminate on gender, religion, sexual orientation, colour, nationality, age, etc. We welcome interests and applications from all groups and communities across the globe.
 
Follow us on LinkedIn & Twitter

Learning is a lifestyle - if you’re curious, you’ll feel at home here. People > Pedigree - we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. Transparency thrives over titles - this is where interns question CXOs and CXOs say “thank you.” Guided by our values of Customer First, Autonomy & Ownership, Agility with Integrity, Transparency, Challenging the status quo and a strong belief that Razorpay grows with Razors,  you’ll be part of a 3000+ strong team building not just products, but the financial infrastructure of the future.
Role Summary
We are looking for a detail-oriented Analyst / Jr. Analyst to join our SG & US— Chargeback Operations team. In this role you will own the end-to-end lifecycle of chargeback cases — from initiation through resolution — by working directly on the bank / gateway portal. You will collaborate cross-functionally with banks and internal teams to protect Razorpay’s acquiring interests while delivering fair and timely outcomes.
Key Responsibilities
Bank/Gateway Portal Operations

Log in to and navigate the respective portal daily to monitor, pick up, and action chargeback cases across all dispute types.
Submit chargeback representments, pre-arbitration responses, and arbitration filings within gateway-mandated timelines.
Track case statuses end-to-end and ensure no case breaches the response deadline.
Download and organise portal reports; maintain a daily tracker for open, pending, and closed cases.

Chargeback Types Handled

Fraudulent / Unauthorised Transactions — validate and compile fraud dispute evidence packets.
Technical Disputes (duplicate charges, incorrect amounts, processing errors) — gather transaction logs and switch-level confirmations.
Merchant Disputes (non-delivery, service/quality issues) — coordinate with merchant for proof of fulfilment.
Consumer Disputes — verify refund status, settlement records, and communicate resolution to the issuer.
Pre-arbitration & Arbitration — prepare case files and coordinate with the acquiring bank and gateway.

Evidence & Documentation

Collect, review, and compile evidence (transaction receipts, screenshots, settlement data, merchant responses) to build strong representment cases.
Ensure all supporting documents meet card network format and content guidelines before portal submission.
Maintain a structured repository of case files for audit readiness.

Merchant & Stakeholder Coordination

Reach out to merchants/cross functional teams proactively to obtain dispute documentation within internal SLAs.
Liaise with the gateway/acquiring bank’s chargeback desk for portal escalations or technical issues.
Update merchants and internal stakeholders on case progress and outcomes.

MIS & Reporting

Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly MIS reports on chargeback volumes, win rates, recovery amounts, and TAT adherence.
Identify trends in dispute reasons and flag recurring issues to the team lead.
Contribute data for monthly business reviews and card network compliance reporting.

Process Adherence & Improvement

Follow all card network chargeback operating procedures and Razorpay internal SOPs.
Flag process gaps or portal issues and propose solutions to improve efficiency or win rates or any spike in the chargeback

Required Qualifications & Skills
Education

Bachelor’s degree in Commerce, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.

Experience

Jr. Analyst: 0–1 year of experience in payments operations, banking operations, or chargeback handling.
Analyst: 1–3 years of hands-on experience in UPI chargeback operations, preferably on the fintech or international chargebacks.

Technical & Domain Skills

Working knowledge of the international chargebacks or willingness to learn it immediately upon joining.
Understanding of Singapore & US ecosystem — Card network rules, chargeback reason codes, dispute TATs, and representment guidelines.
Proficiency in MS Excel / Google Sheets for MIS, data reconciliation, and tracker management.
Ability to read and interpret transaction logs, settlement files, and switch reports.
Familiarity with International bank processes and NPCI circulars related to dispute management.

Soft Skills

High attention to detail — accuracy in case data and documentation is non-negotiable.
Strong written communication for drafting representment narratives and merchant correspondence.
Time management — ability to prioritise a high-volume queue and meet strict portal deadlines.
Problem-solving mindset with a proactive approach to dispute resolution.
Ability to collaborate effectively with merchants, banks, and cross-functional internal teams.

 
Good to Have

Prior experience working on international cards chargeback process.
Exposure to other payment dispute platforms (Visa VROL, Mastercard MATCH, RuPay dispute system).
Knowledge of PCI-DSS, Regulatory guidelines on payment aggregators, or NPCI operating guidelines.
Experience with ticketing or case management tools (Freshdesk, Jira Service Desk).

What We Offer

Opportunity to work on International market chargeback stack.
Deep exposure to network regulations, acquiring bank operations, and fintech dispute management.
Structured learning path with access to internal knowledge base and Card association support.
Collaborative and ownership-driven team culture.

Razorpay believes in and follows an equal employment opportunity policy that doesn't discriminate on gender, religion, sexual orientation, colour, nationality, age, etc. We welcome interests and applications from all groups and communities across the globe. 
 
Follow us on LinkedIn & Twitter

title: Accountant (Experience in R2R)
description_html:
About Us
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Job Description

This role sits in Visa’s Global Finance Shared Service ATR team, which is responsible for supporting the accounting operations of the Visa business functions and corporate accounting activities for Visa. The team is part of the broader Global Controllership function within Global Finance. This role will be responsible for accounting activities including month-end close, as well as analysis including research of technical accounting issues.  The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of US GAAP, the ability to implement processes to improve operational efficiency, work with cross-functional teams, and handle analysis related to operational accounting issues, all with a strong sense of ownership and urgency.

Essential Functions:

  • Responsible for analyzing, interpreting, and recording financial transactions, as well as reporting this information.
  • Proactively research and document conclusions on accounting issues with appropriate references to US GAAP pronouncements. This includes interpretation of accounting guidance and the company's policy application of sound judgment to these projects.
  • Take ownership for specific components of the consolidated balance sheet and income statement, review and confirm consolidated balances during month-end closing and perform flux analysis for the same.
  • Complete complex account reconciliations and journal entries in support of the monthly close process.
  • Establish, maintain, and coordinate the implementation of accounting operational procedures and document such processes and procedures.
  • Complete and maintain process documentation and ensure SOX 404 compliance for areas of responsibility.
  • Partner with key stakeholders to resolve queries and issues.
  • Participation in special projects. Identify any potential financial related risk areas and provide sound recommendations and solutions to Visa for mitigation of the identified risk.
  • Handle ad-hoc projects as assigned by the Management
  • Timely resolution and non-recurrence of external audit issues.
  • Exercise good judgment to escalate issues to ATR Leadership along with recommended solution to resolve.
  • Liaise and respond to queries from internal / external auditors and other finance teams with recommendations on action plans to resolve detected discrepancies.

This is a hybrid position. Expectation of days in the office will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:

  • 3 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD, or PhD)
  • Atleast 4 years of work experience with an Advanced accounting degree

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 4 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or more than 3 years of work experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. MBA(finance) CA/CMA/CPA)
  • 4 years of work experience with a diploma/degree in accounting/finance (or related fields)
  • CA or ACCA or CPA equivalent with clear progressive professional accounting experience, preferably in a publicly-traded company and/or with a public accounting firm
  • Knowledge of US GAAP/IFRS and statutory requirements.
  • Proficient with Oracle or similar enterprise accounting system and proficient in utilizing Excel to efficiently analyze data.
  • Strong customer service and communication skills.
  • Must be comfortable working in a fast-paced, rapidly changing environment.
  • Project credibility and knowledge of business acumen.
  • Ability to define/solve end-to-end problems and issues.
  • Strong technical, quantitative and analytical skills. Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, including excellent written, oral, listening and presentation skills. Ability to work well under pressure and interact at all levels.
  • Capable of handling multiple tasks, possess good organizational and analytical skills, able to work independently, and be extremely flexible.
  • Welcomes challenging/complex projects and demonstrates an ability for working "smarter not harder" by making continuous improvement to the efficiency of processes he/she contributes to.
  • Teamwork is essential to the group, so it is critical that the candidate interact with other team members and managers collaboratively and effectively.

Visa is an EEO Employer

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

title: Sr SW Engineer
description_html:
About Us
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Job Description

Software Development Engineers are expert problem-solvers and builders who design, implement, and improve software applications and systems. In this role, engineers spend approximately 60–75% of their time coding, working hands-on with code, data, and modern tools (including AI-assisted development, cloud services, and automation frameworks) to deliver secure, scalable, and high-quality technology solutions that drive business outcomes in the fintech sector. They collaborate with cross-functional teams – product managers, designers, data scientists, QA, operations, and compliance – to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions, all while adhering to best practices, security standards, and regulatory requirements.

All roles require digital fluency, including the ability to work with emerging technologies such as Generative AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot) to support everyday work.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Collaborate with stakeholders to determine requirements for product components and incorporate feedback into future designs or solutions.
  • Translate functional requirements into system designs and communicate component interactions, ensuring alignment with business needs and timelines.
  • Design and develop product components, refine code plans, and lead design reviews to ensure completeness and adherence to requirements.
  • Contribute to project estimation, considering delivery costs and escalating issues that may cause delays.
  • Lead by example in creating, implementing, and maintaining extensible, reusable code, and drive code quality through metrics and best practices.
  • Apply debugging tools to resolve moderately complex issues and identify opportunities for automation across products.
  • Lead code reviews, ensuring adherence to coding standards and providing feedback to team members.
  • Create complex test plans, identify test gaps, and proactively address defects to minimize customer impact.
  • Leverage data analysis and monitoring standards to identify patterns and defects in all environments.
  • Respond to incidents during on-call rotations, troubleshoot complex issues, and assist in incident response and resolution.
  • Build, enhance, and identify new developer tools to support programs and applications.
  • Proactively seek new knowledge and adapt to trends and technical solutions to improve product performance and recommend resources to other engineers.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or at least 2 years of work experience with an Advanced degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 0 years of work experience with a PhD, OR 8+ years of relevant work experience.
  • Experience in software engineering or a directly related field.
  • Experience in developing and/or implementing web-based or mobile applications.
  • Experience in a leadership role with or without direct reports.
  • Experience in technologies/software systems or a directly related field.
  • Experience in creating and maintaining test plans and executing testing procedures.
  • Experience in debugging and troubleshooting software issues.
  • Experience in collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver technical solutions.
  • Experience in code review and applying coding standards.
  • Experience in building or enhancing developer tools.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • 6 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor's Degree or 4 or more years of relevant experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or up to 3 years of relevant experience with a PhD.
  • Experience working with container-based technologies.
  • Experience building and testing enterprise-scale web services.
  • Experience in product development.
  • Experience working on client-facing project or technical teams.

Visa is an EEO Employer

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

title: Sr. Consultant Data Engineer
description_html:
About Us
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Job Description

With data being the fuel that drives our future - our strategies, policies, and business successes around data will define our future growth prospects. Unlocking the value available through the innovative use of data on behalf of consumers, businesses, and communities is key to our future. With our ongoing commitment to Visa’s Data Values and the responsible use of data, we at Visa have a bold vision to continue to grow and accelerate our data-related businesses and capabilities.

Led by Visa’s first Chief Data Officer, the Global Data Office coordinates high-impact, complex, company-wide projects related to data business strategy, critical investments, policy development, and marketplace execution. Working closely with Visa’s Chief Privacy Officer, the Technology organization, the wider data community, and the full set of Visa’s global lines of business, the Global Data Office is evolving Visa’s data-related work with momentum and enthusiasm. Driven by its commitment to trusted use of data, Visa is seeking enthusiastic leaders who are change-agents and passionate about the future of data around the world.

This position will be part of the Data Engineering Bengaluru COE team under the Global Data Office, responsible for leading a team of data engineers while serving as a hands‑on architectural leader. This role is responsible for designing scalable, reusable data solutions, setting engineering standards and best practices, and driving framework‑led development to improve efficiency, quality, and speed of delivery across the data ecosystem.

This is a hybrid position. Expectation of days in the office will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager. 


Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:

8+ years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or at least 5 years of experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 2 years of work experience with a PhD, OR 11+ years of relevant work experience.

Preferred Qualifications:

9 or more years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor Degree or 7 or more relevant years of experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 3 or more years of experience with a PhD

10+ years of experience in data engineering, with at least 3 years in a technical leadership or people management role.

Strong hands‑on experience designing and building large-scale data platforms using modern data engineering stacks.

Proven experience defining standards, frameworks, reusable components, and reference architectures.

Deep understanding of data modeling (star/snowflake, domain‑oriented models), ETL/ELT patterns, and data quality engineering.

Experience driving automation and efficiency through framework‑led or platform‑based approaches.

Strong leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience operating in a COE or platform model supporting multiple product or analytics teams.

Familiarity with cloud-native data platforms, streaming architectures, and modern orchestration tools.

Exposure to data governance, metadata management, and observability frameworks.

Experience supporting BI, analytics, and AI/ML workloads at scale.

Visa is an EEO Employer

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.
