description_html:
About PhonePe Limited:

Headquartered in India, its flagship product, the PhonePe digital payments app, was launched in Aug 2016. As of April 2025, PhonePe has over 60 Crore (600 Million) registered users and a digital payments acceptance network spread across over 4 Crore (40+ million) merchants. PhonePe also processes over 33 Crore (330+ Million) transactions daily with an Annualized Total Payment Value (TPV) of over INR 150 lakh crore. 

 

PhonePe’s portfolio of businesses includes the distribution of financial products (Insurance, Lending, and Wealth) as well as new consumer tech businesses (Pincode - hyperlocal e-commerce and Indus AppStore Localized App Store for the Android ecosystem) in India, which are aligned with the company’s vision to offer every Indian an equal opportunity to accelerate their progress by unlocking the flow of money and access to services.

 

Culture:

At PhonePe, we go the extra mile to make sure you can bring your best self to work, Everyday!. And that starts with creating the right environment for you. We empower people and trust them to do the right  thing. Here, you own your work from start to finish, right from day one. PhonePe-rs solve complex problems and execute quickly; often building frameworks from scratch. If you’re excited by the idea of building platforms that touch millions, ideating with some of  the best minds in the country and executing on your dreams with purpose and speed, join us!

Why PhonePe:

At PhonePe our vision is to provide financial inclusion to a billion Indians. Today we have made significant progress on this vision by making digital payments far simpler and ubiquitous than it has ever been. However we wish to make it so easy, safe, and universally accepted that people never feel the need to carry cash or cards again. And not just in Urban India. At PhonePe, our aim to transform the entire Indian landscape so that every Indian, in every corner of the country, makes significant economic progress. Onwards and upwards! That is our goal.

Why PhonePe Design:

If you are sold on the vision of the company, you may want to consider the design team as a place to make this a reality. The design team at PhonePe is a bunch of creative trailblazers who are leading the effort to make a dent in the fintech universe. The design team consists of Product Designers, Visual Designers, Graphic & Motion Designers, and Illustrators who are all engaged in blending art and science into a promising value proposition for our users.

About Share.Market

Share.Market is how PhonePe is rebuilding trading and investing for India. It's a full-stack broking platform — stocks, F&O, ETFs, mutual funds, IPOs, and WealthBaskets — with a research and intelligence layer (factor analysis on every stock, expert-curated baskets) sitting on top. It's a separate app from the main PhonePe one, and it's backed by PhonePe's reach, trust, and distribution.

This is a hard, interesting design problem. You're working with regulated financial products, real money, and a spectrum of users that runs from a first-time investor buying their first stock to an active trader running F&O strategies. The job is to make something genuinely powerful feel calm and trustworthy — not to bolt more features onto a busy screen.

The role

You'll own design for Share.Market end to end. Today that means you, the craft, and a close partnership with product and engineering — this is a hands-on leadership role, not a manage-from-a-distance one. As the product grows, you'll build and lead the team around it.

You'll set the design direction, ship the work yourself when it matters, and be the person accountable for the quality of the experience. You'll report to the Head of Design (PhonePe Group) and work alongside the broader PhonePe design org, but Share.Market's design is yours to own.

What you'll do

  • Own the experience. Set the bar for what good looks like on Share.Market, and hold it. Strategy, flows, visual craft, microcopy — you're accountable for all of it.
  • Ship, don't just direct. Get into the file. Design the hard screens yourself. Prototype to find the answer rather than arguing about it in a doc.
  • Make complex things simple. Turn dense financial data and regulated flows into something a first-time investor trusts and a serious trader respects. This is the core craft of the job.
  • Partner closely. Work shoulder to shoulder with product and engineering as an equal. Bring the user's point of view to roadmap and tradeoff conversations early, not at the end.
  • Build the team. As Share.Market grows, manage and grow the designers around you, and set the standards they'll work to.

What we're looking for

  • 8+ years in product design, with real ownership of consumer products at scale. Some of that as a lead, whether managing people or anchoring quality for a product.
  • Proven craft. A portfolio that shows depth, not just breadth — interaction design, visual polish, and clear thinking about why each decision was made.
  • Domain knowledge is a strong advantage. This is a genuinely complex space — broking, F&O, market structure, the way regulation shapes every flow. If you've worked in trading, broking, or wealth, or you invest seriously yourself and understand it from the inside, that's a real head start. Not a hard requirement, but it counts for a lot.
  • Comfort with complexity. You've designed for data-heavy or regulated products — fintech, trading, health, anything where the details are hard and the stakes are real. Or you can show us you'll get there fast.
  • Systems thinking. You design with the whole product in mind, not one screen at a time. You're fluent with design systems and know when to extend one versus break from it.
  • Strong written and verbal communication. You can write clear microcopy, make a tight argument for a direction, and give direct, useful feedback.
  • Player-coach instinct. You're senior enough to lead and still want your hands on the work.

What we care about

We hire and grow people around three things: craft, context, and community.

  • Craft — the quality of the work and the attention to detail behind it.
  • Context — understanding the bigger picture: the user, the business, the system you're part of.
  • Community — building the people and the relationships around the work, not just the work itself.

We believe in subtractive design: the best version of a financial product usually has less in it, not more. We'd rather remove the right thing than add another feature. If that resonates, you'll like it here.

Why this matters

Most Indians have never owned a stock. The ones who do often find investing intimidating, opaque, or built for someone more sophisticated than they feel. Getting this right means more people participating in the country's growth, with confidence and without getting burned. That's the work.

PhonePe-rs solve complex problems and execute quickly; often building frameworks from scratch. If you’re excited by the idea of building platforms that touch millions, ideating with some of  the best minds in the country and executing on your dreams with purpose and speed, join us!

Role Overview

We're looking for a strategic, highly structured Lead Product Designer / Design Manager to head the design for our Payment Gateway and Web Platforms pod. You'll own the end-to-end design strategy for this scope, bring operational clarity to complex, multi-quarter projects, and lead and grow a team of 4–5 designers.

 

This is a high-leverage role. The Payment Gateway is how online businesses accept payments through PhonePe — the experience you design is felt by merchants and, downstream, by every customer who pays them. The details are hard, the constraints are real, and the work directly moves the business.

Key Responsibilities (G6 Competencies & Role Expectations)

  • Co-own Product Roadmaps: Work closely with leadership to understand the overarching business vision and translate it into actionable, design-first GTM strategies for our Payment Gateway and Web Platforms.
  • Mentorship & Team Structuring: Manage, mentor, and scale a pod of 4-5 designers. Pivot effectively from individual contribution to strategic delegation—optimizing team structures, guiding career growth, and overseeing the quality of hires.
  • Influence & Partner: Build deep trust with business unit leadership. Operate as a "first team" with leaders by helping them achieve their functional goals through design. Proactively resolve conflicts and align stakeholders toward common objectives.
  • Build to Learn: Direct intuitive product architecture with a strong “build to learn” mindset. Emphasize continuous prototyping, synthesize insights from usability testing, and weave them into the core product strategy.
  • Drive Measurable Outcomes: Define North Star metrics for your features and utilize data to form actionable insights. Ensure that design outputs directly influence business revenue and deliver measurable results.
  • Holistic Architecture: Direct the team to take a holistic view of the product ecosystem, employing journey maps and service blueprints to align stakeholders and improve end-to-end service delivery.
  • Orchestrate Complex Delivery: Own the planning, triaging, and delivery of multiple large, complex projects spanning across quarters. Balance competing priorities and tactically unblock teams to deliver work faster.
  • Elevate Visual Systems: Deliver best-in-class, cohesive visual experiences by unifying design systems, motion, and UX copy. Foster tight feedback loops between graphics, creative, and product design teams.
  • Technical Synergy: Translate complex technical/backend capabilities into highly scalable, delightful, and user-friendly interfaces, ensuring designs exploit technical constraints to enable speed and security.
  • High-Quality Handoffs: Leverage your deep understanding of frontend systems and code as a medium. Deploy robust processes for smooth, repeatable engineering handoffs through high-touch communication and clear documentation.

 

What We’re Looking For

  • 7–10 years of product design experience, with real ownership of complex enterprise, B2B, or fintech platforms.
  • 1–2 years managing and scaling direct reports — you've grown designers, not just reviewed their work.
  • Proven craft: A portfolio that shows depth: interaction design, visual rigor, and clear reasoning behind each decision.
  • Technical acumen: Deep comfort navigating technical constraints to design scalable, developer-friendly interfaces. You speak engineering's language.
  • Systems thinking: You design for the whole product and are fluent with design systems — when to extend one and when to break from it.
  • Strong communication: You write clear UX copy, make a tight case for a direction, and give direct, useful feedback. You manage stakeholders without losing the user's point of view.

The Mandate

PhonePe Group is building one of India’s first fully AI-native marketing organizations. We are not just looking for someone to experiment with AI. We want a leader who will change how our team of over 100 marketers thinks, works, and delivers. The AI Creative Head is the architect of this transformation. You will own the strategy, infrastructure, and culture change needed to empower every marketer at PhonePe. You will build a team of AI specialists, create the playbook, and set the metrics. You will be accountable for measurable improvements in marketing speed, creative quality, and operational efficiency. This is a strategic leadership role, not just a hands-on position. You will report directly to the HOD and help design the future of our marketing.

Core Competencies

  • Visionary Curiosity: You anticipate AI trends rather than just tracking them. You have been building with AI tools since the early days. You can see where the industry will be in a year and prepare the organization to get there first.
  • Focus on Architecture: You have moved beyond simple prototyping. You think in terms of scalable workflows, governance frameworks, and team structures that will last.
  • Executive Influence: You can confidently explain to senior leadership why AI needs budget, headcount, and strategic priority. You focus on business outcomes instead of just tool features.
  • Culture Engineering: You understand that new tools fail without a change in mindset. You have successfully built cultures of experimentation in the past.
  • Innovation with Accountability: You push boundaries while measuring everything. You can link every AI initiative to time saved, revenue growth, or improved quality.
  • Macro Understanding: You have a deep understanding of consumer behavior. You can spot cultural shifts and turn them into marketing strategies that connect with our diverse users.

What You Will Own

AI Transformation Strategy & Roadmap

  • Define the annual AI adoption plan for the entire marketing organization.
  • Identify and prioritize the most impactful AI use cases based on feasibility and team readiness.
  • Build the business case for AI integration by projecting efficiency gains, resource optimization, and quality improvements.
  • Share quarterly progress and recommendations with executive leadership using clear metrics.

Building & Leading the Team

  • Hire and develop a team of AI specialists and prompt engineers to work alongside marketing squads.
  • Design the best organizational structure for the AI function.
  • Create performance frameworks and career paths for this entirely new team.

AI Infrastructure & Tooling Ecosystem

  • Manage the marketing AI stack by evaluating and integrating tools like language models, image generators, and workflow automation.
  • Build and maintain a central playbook containing prompt libraries, workflow templates, and compliance guidelines.
  • Design workflows using tools like N8N, Zapier, Make, and custom APIs to automate marketing tasks.
  • Set up quality control processes, including brand safety checks and human review for AI-generated content.

Cross-Functional Enablement & Change Management

  • Run a structured training program with onboarding, skill assessments, and ongoing learning for over 100 marketers.

PhonePe-rs solve complex problems and execute quickly; often building frameworks from scratch. If you’re excited by the idea of building platforms that touch millions, ideating with some of  the best minds in the country and executing on your dreams with purpose and speed, join us!

The Opportunity 

We are building a first of its kind AI content factory. As our AI Video Specialist, you are the master of the final render. You are a Video Creator first. Your role is to bridge the gap between a scripted idea and a world class visual reality by orchestrating a complex, AI first production pipeline. You aren't just cutting footage: you are navigating the latent space to synthesize high fidelity, cinematic content that sets a new industry standard.

The Craft (The Hybrid Approach)

  • Neural Storytelling: You own the edit. Beyond just running models, you are responsible for the narrative flow, the emotional beats, and the hook-driven pacing required for modern platforms. You use AI to generate the assets, but you use your creator's instinct to assemble the story and ensure the human element remains front and center.
  • Orchestrate Node-Based Logic: You will spend the majority of your time in ComfyUI, building custom, repeatable pipelines. You design workflows and style transfers that allow us to scale our production without losing creative control.
  • Multi-Model Synthesis: You don't rely on a single tool. You know how to take a base generation from an open source model like LTX, Flux, or Wan (Qwen) and refine it using the high fidelity outputs of proprietary engines like Higgsfield.
  • Master Temporal Consistency: You design workflows that ensure stable, flicker free motion, maintaining character and environmental integrity across every frame of a production.
  • Cinematic Finishing: You provide the final human touch. This includes advanced color science, sound design, and audio-visual synchronization to ensure the final output feels like a high-budget production, not a generic AI clip.

The AI Technical Stack

  • Local and Open Source: ComfyUI, Flux.1, LTX-2.3 Video, Wan 2.7 (Qwen) models.
  • Cloud and Proprietary: Higgsfield Cinema Studio 3.5, Kling O3, SeeDance 2.0.
  • Control and Precision: ControlNets, IP-Adapters, and specialized temporal upscaling nodes.
  • Enhancement: Neural upscalers like Topaz and AI-driven audio cleanup tools.

You’ll be a great fit if…

  • You are a Filmmaker at heart. You understand the visual grammar of cinema: pacing, lighting, and composition. You know how to steer AI models to achieve those professional standards.
  • You think in data-flows. You understand the technical why behind a result, from sampler choice to CFG scales, and you can debug a complex node-based error in minutes.
  • You are a Researcher-Creator. You are comfortable navigating GitHub, managing Python environments, and staying ahead of the latest paper to code releases in the open source world.
  • You are obsessed with Automation. You don’t want to fix a single shot: you want to build a workflow that fixes the next thousand shots automatically.
  • You have a High Ownership Mindset. You are the final wall of defense for the soul of the video. You ensure that the technology always serves the story, never the other way around.

  • Insurance Benefits - Medical Insurance, Critical Illness Insurance, Accidental Insurance, Life Insurance
  • Wellness Program - Employee Assistance Program, Onsite Medical Center, Emergency Support System
  • Parental Support - Maternity Benefit, Paternity Benefit Program, Adoption Assistance Program, Day-care Support Program
  • Mobility Benefits - Relocation benefits, Transfer Support Policy, Travel Policy
  • Retirement Benefits - Employee PF Contribution, Flexible PF Contribution, Gratuity, NPS, Leave Encashment 
  • Other Benefits - Higher Education Assistance, Car Lease, Salary Advance Policy

Culture:

At PhonePe, we go the extra mile to make sure you can bring your best self to work, Everyday!. And that starts with creating the right environment for you. We empower people and trust them to do the right  thing. Here, you own your work from start to finish, right from day one. PhonePe-rs solve complex problems and execute quickly; often building frameworks from scratch. If you’re excited by the idea of building platforms that touch millions, ideating with some of  the best minds in the country and executing on your dreams with purpose and speed, join us!

About The Role 

You are the packaging expert for our content. A world-class video is useless if no one clicks on it, and you are the person who ensures they do. Your job is to take the core hook of a video and turn it into a high-impact visual that stands out in a crowded feed. You will work in an AI-first environment, using generative tools to create assets and variations that would take hours to build by hand.

Focus Area 1: Visual Storytelling and CTR Optimization 

You own the "click."

  • You design thumbnails that tell a story in a split second. You understand how to use composition, contrast, and color theory to guide the viewer’s eye exactly where you want it.
  • You are a master of "The Hook." You know how to pair a compelling image with minimal text to create curiosity or urgency.
  • You manage facial expressions and emotive triggers. You know how to select or generate the perfect "hero" image that connects with a human audience.
  • You work closely with the Channel Intelligence Lead to analyze A/B test results and refine your designs based on actual performance data.

Focus Area 2: AI-First Composition and Workflow 

You use the machine to outpace the competition.

  • You are a power user of generative AI tools like Midjourney, DALL-E 3, or Stable Diffusion to create unique assets, backgrounds, and characters from scratch.
  • You use the latest AI features in Photoshop (like Generative Fill and Expand) to manipulate images, swap elements, and clean up compositions in seconds.
  • You build and maintain a library of AI-generated assets that allow us to move from a concept to a finished thumbnail in record time.
  • You stay ahead of the curve. When a new AI model or technique drops that can improve our visual quality or speed, you are the first to master it.

Focus Area 3: Iteration and Data-Driven Design 

You don't just make one version; you build a system for winning.

  • You produce multiple variations for every video. You understand that the first idea isn't always the best, and you use AI to quickly test different angles, colors, and compositions.
  • You are obsessed with the "why" behind the click. You look at CTR (Click-Through Rate) data and qualified view metrics to understand which visual styles are resonating with our specific audience.
  • You ensure brand consistency. While every thumbnail is an experiment, you make sure the overall "look" of the channel remains premium and recognizable.

What We Are Looking For

  • Technical Agility: You are a master of the Adobe Suite and a power user of generative AI. You don't get hung up on tools; you use whatever gets the best result the fastest.
  • Attention to Detail: You have an eye for lighting, shadows, and perspective. You ensure that AI-generated elements blend perfectly into the final composition so they never look "fake."
  • Speed without sacrificing quality: You thrive on high-volume output. You can turn around multiple high-end thumbnails in a single day without the quality ever dipping.
  • Analytical Thinking: You don't just "feel" that a design is good. You look at the data and can explain why a certain visual is likely to perform better.
  • High Ownership: You treat the CTR of every video as your personal responsibility. If a video is underperforming, you are already building a new thumbnail before anyone asks.

  • Wellness Program - Employee Assistance Program, Onsite Medical Center, Emergency Support System

PhonePe-rs solve complex problems and execute quickly; often building frameworks from scratch. If you’re excited by the idea of building platforms that touch millions, ideating with some of  the best minds in the country and executing on your dreams with purpose and speed, join us!

About The Role

We are building a world-class, AI-first content factory, and you are the person who decides what we actually build. You aren't just a writer. You are the person who identifies what topics will work on YouTube and decides exactly how we should present them to the audience. Your job is to make sure our strategy turns into high-performing content.

Focus Area 1: Format and Strategy

You decide the "how" and the "what" of our content.

  • Topic Selection: You research what is currently getting traction on the platform and pick the angles that give us the best chance to win.
  • Format Ownership: You decide the style of each video. You determine if a topic works best as a story, a deep dive, or a specific format you've designed.
  • Platform Logic: You understand why people click and stay. You use that knowledge to design the structure of every video before a single word is written.
  • Performance Feedback: You look at the data from our videos to see what worked. You double down on what is winning and kill what isn't.

Focus Area 2: Scripting and AI Workflow

You lead the writing process using an AI-first approach.

  • Core Scripting: You write the main scripts, focusing heavily on the first 30 seconds (the hook) and the overall narrative flow.
  • AI Research: You use tools like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Claude to research complex topics in minutes and find unique data points.
  • Prompting for Writing: You use AI to generate outlines and drafts, then you refine them to make sure the tone and message are exactly right.
  • Workflow Speed: You find ways to use AI to get from a raw idea to a finished script faster than a traditional writing team.

What We Are Looking For

  • Deep AI Fluency: You already use AI tools to research and write. You don't just use them for simple tasks; you know how to get them to do the heavy lifting.
  • YouTube Knowledge: You have a clear understanding of the platform. You know what makes a good thumbnail and a good script.
  • Analytical Thinking: You don't rely on "gut feeling." You look at what is happening on the platform and use logic to make your decisions.
  • Problem Solving: You can take a complicated subject and find a way to make it simple and interesting for a viewer.

Mindset To Succeed

  • High Ownership: You treat the channel like it is yours. You don't wait for a brief. You see a gap in the strategy and you fill it.
  • Comfort with Ambiguity: The AI space and YouTube trends change every week. You are happy to figure things out as you go and pivot when necessary.
  • Builder Mindset: You are here to help build a new way of making content. You are always looking for a more efficient way to get work done.

Headquartered in India, its flagship product, the PhonePe digital payments app, was launched in Aug 2016. As of April 2025, PhonePe has over 60 Crore (600 Million) registered users and a digital payments acceptance network spread across over 4 Crore (40+ million) merchants. At PhonePe, we go the extra mile to make sure you can bring your best self to work, Everyday!. And that starts with creating the right environment for you. We empower people and trust them to do the right  thing. Here, you own your work from start to finish, right from day one. PhonePe-rs solve complex problems and execute quickly; often building frameworks from scratch. If you’re excited by the idea of building platforms that touch millions, ideating with some of  the best minds in the country and executing on your dreams with purpose and speed, join us!

 

About The Role 

You are the algorithmic brain behind our highest-velocity financial property. This channel caters to active, serious investors focused on Futures and Options (F&O), technical analysis, and market momentum. Your job is to decode the trading community’s unique psychology and use platform data to scale our viewership. You understand open interest, option chains, chart literacy, and the analytical mindset required to navigate the markets. Operating in our AI-first factory, you will use data models and automated scraping to spot macro trends and derivative catalysts before they hit the retail feed.

Focus Area 1: Derivative Market Trend Hunting & Catalyst Capture 

You don't wait for traditional planning cycles. You move at the speed of the market ticker.

  • You monitor live market catalysts, open interest shifts, option chain data, and technical setups to identify breaking content opportunities within minutes.

  • You translate complex technical analysis, derivative strategies, or macro announcements into high-impact, immediate concepts for our scriptwriters.

  • You run AI-powered social listening tools across financial platforms, specialized forums, and trading communities to catch retail sentiment shifts before they explode on YouTube.

You coordinate with the production team for rapid-response videos, ensuring we publish while market volume and volatility are still peaking.

Focus Area 2: F&O Psychology & Advanced Retention Mechanics 

You know exactly what makes a serious, active market participant click and watch.

  • You optimize for the specific psychological triggers of the derivative community: risk management, position sizing, leverage, volatility, and the search for a definitive edge.

  • You design hook structures that establish immediate analytical authority, keeping viewers locked in through complex technical setups without losing pacing.

  • You build a distinct packaging strategy for active trading content: utilizing clean chart patterns, clear data overlays, and high-intent thumbnail concepts that command attention on a crowded screen.

  • You guide the editing team on the pacing of technical breakdowns, ensuring that option strategies and chart analysis are snappy, visually engaging, and highly scannable.

 

Focus Area 3: Algorithmic Agility & Real-Time Channel Management 

You manage the channel like an active portfolio.

  • You monitor immediate velocity metrics: tracking click-through rates (CTR) and view-count acceleration within the critical first two hours of an upload.

  • You leverage YouTube Community posts, polls, and live alerts to keep the audience highly engaged around expiry days, market openings, and critical economic data releases.

  • You optimize live stream metrics, managing real-time engagement, interactive charts, and viewer retention during high-impact market hours.

  • You collaborate with the Creative Project Manager to dynamically pivot the content backlog based on daily market performance and viewer drop-off zones.

What We Are Looking For

Deep Derivative Literacy: You possess a strong understanding of F&O mechanics, trading psychology, and technical analysis. You know how to read market depth, price action, and option Greeks.

Data and Analytics Fluency: You can read a charting screen and a spreadsheet of audience analytics with equal comfort. You know how to extract actionable video concepts from raw platform metrics.

Platform Mastery: 3 to 5 years of experience scaling hyper-engaged YouTube channels, specifically within the finance, equity markets, or active trading niches.

Speed with High Precision: You thrive in high-pressure environments where getting an accurate, high-quality analysis out in two hours beats getting a perfect video out tomorrow.

 

Mindset to Succeed

Market-Driven: You love the energy of active markets. You see a sudden market correction or an expiry day surge as a high-value content opportunity.

Audience-Centric: You understand the active trader's risk tolerance and pain points. You know exactly how to structure titles and thumbnails that address their market concerns or validate their strategies.

Data-Obsessed: You do not guess what content works. You let the retention graphs, traffic sources, and performance data dictate the channel's next tactical move.

Automation-First: You embrace the automated factory. You are excited to use AI tools to scrape market indicators, generate title variations, and analyze competitor packaging instantly.

  • Insurance Benefits - Medical Insurance, Critical Illness Insurance, Accidental Insurance, Life Insurance
  • Wellness Program - Employee Assistance Program, Onsite Medical Center, Emergency Support System
  • Parental Support - Maternity Benefit, Paternity Benefit Program, Adoption Assistance Program, Day-care Support Program
  • Mobility Benefits - Relocation benefits, Transfer Support Policy, Travel Policy
  • Retirement Benefits - Employee PF Contribution, Flexible PF Contribution, Gratuity, NPS, Leave Encashment

description_html:
About PhonePe Limited:

Headquartered in India, its flagship product, the PhonePe digital payments app, was launched in Aug 2016. As of April 2025, PhonePe has over 60 Crore (600 Million) registered users and a digital payments acceptance network spread across over 4 Crore (40+ million) merchants. PhonePe also processes over 33 Crore (330+ Million) transactions daily with an Annualized Total Payment Value (TPV) of over INR 150 lakh crore. 

 

PhonePe’s portfolio of businesses includes the distribution of financial products (Insurance, Lending, and Wealth) as well as new consumer tech businesses (Pincode - hyperlocal e-commerce and Indus AppStore Localized App Store for the Android ecosystem) in India, which are aligned with the company’s vision to offer every Indian an equal opportunity to accelerate their progress by unlocking the flow of money and access to services.

 

Culture:

At PhonePe, we go the extra mile to make sure you can bring your best self to work, Everyday!. And that starts with creating the right environment for you. We empower people and trust them to do the right  thing. Here, you own your work from start to finish, right from day one. PhonePe-rs solve complex problems and execute quickly; often building frameworks from scratch. If you’re excited by the idea of building platforms that touch millions, ideating with some of  the best minds in the country and executing on your dreams with purpose and speed, join us!

About PhonePe

PhonePe is India’s leading digital payments platform with over 700 million registered users and 50 million registered merchants. Using PhonePe, users can send and receive money, recharge mobile, DTH, data cards, pay at stores, make utility payments, buy gold, and make investments. PhonePe went live for customers in August 2016 and was the first non-banking UPI app and offered money transfer to individuals and merchants, recharges and bill payments to begin with. PhonePe is one of the leading payments providers for merchants in India. PhonePe provides digital payments for offline merchants as well as online merchants.

Opportunity:

PhonePe is on a mission to change the landscape of digital payments and financial services in India. On this mission, we are committed to hiring the best while creating an environment of equal opportunity and empowerment. As an Associate Director of Product at PhonePe, you will own and drive the roadmap for our payment solutions and devices products for offline merchants. You will work with other pod members and a diverse set of stakeholders towards a collective set of objectives. We work on complex technology, scale while iterating quickly and have a bias for impact in everything we do. 

Leading our Offline Payment Solutions and devices product portfolio, you will be working with leaders in the offline merchant business unit to determine the portfolio product strategy. You will be responsible for evangelizing and aligning all the cross-functional stakeholders on the strategy and plans and work on the execution and delivery to realize the identified opportunity and impact.

Culture:

At PhonePe, we take extra care to make sure you give your best at work, Everyday! And creating the right  environment for you is just one of the things we do. We empower people and trust them to do the right  thing. Here, you own your work from start to finish, right from day one. Being enthusiastic about tech is a  big part of being at PhonePe. If you like building technology that impacts millions, ideating with some of  the best minds in the country and executing on your dreams with purpose and speed, join us!

As an Associate Director of Product/ Product Lead, you will:

  • Defines a portfolio product strategy from first principles that becomes the org’s reference point; drives multi-pod execution and measurable portfolio outcomes
  • Identifies and delivers multiple Annual Operating Plan-shaping bets; consistently makes correct profitability vs growth calls across portfolio, shifts business trajectory with durable levers (pricing, distribution, unit economics, cost-to-serve)
  • Designs pod-level org structure and capability plan that materially increases throughput and quality; shapes cross-functional Hiring AOP with high accuracy; prevents bottlenecks before they form.
  • Builds a strong leadership bench; direct reports consistently progress levels. Establishes pod-wide talent mechanisms with counterparts that raise performance across functions.
  • Designs and evolves the pod operating system (planning, decision forums, execution reviews, launch readiness, learning loops) with measurable improvements in reliability and speed.
  • Demonstrate thought leadership and be the go to person for product decisions for internal and external stakeholders.
  • Engage with external customers and stakeholders, communicate objectives and progress.

What we look for:

  • Excellent communication skills.
  • At least 10+ years of experience in Product / Platform building and development.
  • Strong business acumen and ability to partner with cross-functional teams.
  • Contributes to business decisions regularly and proactively.
  • Can build credibility via knowledge and judgment to persuade others.
  • Conducts interviews for PM/SPM roles and for specific competencies.

PhonePe Full Time Employee Benefits (Not applicable for Intern or Contract Roles)

  • Insurance Benefits - Medical Insurance, Critical Illness Insurance, Accidental Insurance, Life Insurance
  • Wellness Program - Employee Assistance Program, Onsite Medical Center, Emergency Support System
  • Parental Support - Maternity Benefit, Paternity Benefit Program, Adoption Assistance Program, Day-care Support Program
  • Mobility Benefits - Relocation benefits, Transfer Support Policy, Travel Policy
  • Retirement Benefits - Employee PF Contribution, Flexible PF Contribution, Gratuity, NPS, Leave Encashment 
  • Other Benefits - Higher Education Assistance, Car Lease, Salary Advance Policy

Risk Investigator

The PhonePe Fraud Risk Operations team is a high impact team whose goal is to mitigate risk and improve the trust and safety for various PhonePe products. If your dream is to build processes and tools that would impact millions of customers, partnering with some of the best minds and executing on your dreams with purpose and speed, join us! The Key to success in this role is the ability to understand the team’s vision and raise the bar on the job core responsibilities of Operate, Continuous Improvement, Communicate and People Development. 

The incumbent is required to demonstrate strong performance in the following areas:

1. Responsible for the prevention and detection of potential fraud across all payment channels by reviewing customers’ accounts
2. Work with data to understand patterns and anti-patterns to determine risk activity ranging from fraud, AML, identity theft, KYC, and non-compliant activity per RBI.
3. Proactively identifying fraud risks and assessing the adequacy of controls to manage such risks, including recommending enhanced or additional controls
4. Working with support areas such as operations, finance, settlements, risk analytics, compliance and technology in ensuring a high level of control is maintained
5. Proactive in identifying and following up on anomalies/areas of concern
6. Identify fraud patterns through the monitoring of high-risk users and merchants
7. Contribute to the creation of fraud rules by providing analytical data to support decisions
8. Monitor fraud alerts daily and take necessary action to protect customers.
9. Daily updates on any new fraud trends to senior management.
10. Ensure information flows and deliverables are met to mitigate fraud by facilitating weekly calls with stakeholders.
.
Role Requirements:
● Minimum of 2-3 years of relevant experience in risk operations or fraud investigations or fraud risk analytics.
● Proven experience across the domain of Risk management & Fraud.
● Strong oral and written communication skills
● Team player, ability to build relationships at all levels internally and externally
● Education qualification - Any graduate/PG
● Ability to work independently and to liaise with other departments and coordinate with various stakeholders.
● Has and added advantage if CFE.
● Basic working knowledge of MS Office, SQL

Assistant Manager/Manager - Regulatory Compliance - Cross-Border

Experience

5–6 years of relevant experience in regulatory compliance, must be within payments, fintech, banking, or regulated financial services.

Role Overview

The Cross-Border Regulatory Compliance role is responsible for ensuring regulatory compliance across international payment flows, foreign exchange transactions, and cross-border financial products. The role focuses on interpreting and implementing regulatory requirements across multiple jurisdictions, with particular emphasis on India-outbound and inbound cross-border transactions.

The role partners closely with Product, Legal, Operations, Risk, Treasury, and Business teams to embed compliance-by-design into cross-border products while supporting business growth within regulatory boundaries.

Key Responsibilities

1. Cross-Border Regulatory Compliance & Advisory

  • Interpret and implement cross-border regulatory frameworks including FEMA, RBI Master Directions, Liberalised Remittance Scheme (LRS), Export/Import guidelines, and foreign exchange guidelines.
  • Provide regulatory advisory on cross-border payment flows such as:
    • Inbound and outbound remittances
    • Merchant cross-border collections
    • Card-based international transactions
    • FX conversion and settlement models
  • Assess permissibility of cross-border use cases, structures, and partnerships under applicable regulations.

2. Regulatory Change Management & Prioritization

  • Track regulatory developments across India and relevant foreign jurisdictions impacting cross-border products.
  • Conduct regulatory impact assessments for new RBI circulars, FEMA notifications, and supervisory communications.
  • Prioritize regulatory changes based on risk, business impact, and implementation timelines.
  • Drive timely implementation of regulatory changes across systems, processes, and documentation.

3. Product & Business Partnership

  • Work closely with Product and Business teams during ideation and launch of cross-border products to ensure regulatory alignment.
  • Review and challenge product flows, fund movement, and FX structures to ensure compliance with regulatory intent.
  • Support business teams in balancing commercial objectives with regulatory constraints through pragmatic, compliant solutions.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders on cross-border regulatory strategy.

4. Control Design & Governance

  • Design and implement regulatory controls for cross-border transactions, including:
    • Transaction flow controls
    • Regulatory limits and thresholds
    • Reporting and reconciliation frameworks
  • Establish governance frameworks covering policies, SOPs, regulatory attestations, and internal approvals.
  • Ensure regulatory obligations are embedded into operational processes and system logic.

5. Regulatory Engagement & Audit Support

  • Support regulatory inspections, audits, and supervisory interactions related to cross-border activities.
  • Prepare responses to regulatory queries, inspection observations, and audit findings.
  • Coordinate with internal teams to ensure timely remediation and closure of regulatory observations.
  • Assist in regulatory reporting and periodic submissions related to cross-border transactions.

6. Stakeholder Management & Communication

  • Act as a central compliance point of contact for cross-border initiatives across teams.
  • Communicate regulatory expectations clearly to non-compliance stakeholders.
  • Escalate material regulatory risks appropriately with clear options and recommendations.
  • Influence decision-making through structured, risk-based regulatory analysis.

Must-Have Qualifications & Experience

  • 5–6 years of experience in regulatory compliance, must be in payments, fintech, banking, or financial services.
  • Strong working knowledge of:
    • FEMA and RBI Master Directions
    • Cross-border payment regulations
    • FX and remittance frameworks
    • LRS, export/import and international payment regulations, etc.
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams such as Product, Legal, Operations, Risk, and Treasury.
  • Hands-on experience in regulatory interpretation, advisory, and implementation.
  • Exposure to regulatory audits, inspections, or supervisory interactions is highly desirable.
  • Ability to translate complex regulations into practical, implementable business solutions.

Good-to-Have

  • Experience working in a global or multinational organization.
  • Exposure to multiple jurisdictions or international regulatory frameworks.
  • Experience with Payment Aggregators, AD-II entities, or card networks.
  • Prior involvement in launching cross-border products or new regulated use cases.
  • Certifications or qualifications in compliance, risk, or finance (e.g., CA, CIA, MBA, LLB, CAMS, etc.).

Key Skills & Competencies

  • Strong regulatory interpretation and analytical skills
  • Structured problem-solving and decision-making
  • Ability to balance regulatory risk with business impact
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills
  • High ownership, judgement, and attention to detail
  • Comfort working in fast-paced, evolving regulatory environments

PhonePe Full Time Employee Benefits (Not applicable for Intern or Contract Roles)

  • Insurance Benefits - Medical Insurance, Critical Illness Insurance, Accidental Insurance, Life Insurance
  • Wellness Program - Employee Assistance Program, Onsite Medical Center, Emergency Support System
  • Parental Support - Maternity Benefit, Paternity Benefit Program, Adoption Assistance Program, Day-care Support Program
  • Mobility Benefits - Relocation benefits, Transfer Support Policy, Travel Policy
  • Retirement Benefits - Employee PF Contribution, Flexible PF Contribution, Gratuity, NPS, Leave Encashment 
  • Other Benefits - Higher Education Assistance, Car Lease, Salary Advance Policy

Role Overview: The Lead Payroll & Benefits to own and manage the entire payroll and benefits operations for over 30,000 high churn salesforce. The responsibilities include guiding the team for accurate and timely processing of salary, benefits and related payouts, compliance with statutory and audit requirements, and efficient management of payroll-related processes for the multiple legal entities in the PhonePe group. 

Responsibilities:  

  1. Payroll Management:
  • End to end ownership: Lead the strategy and execution of end-to-end payroll operations, ensuring timely and accurate salary disbursements for all employees. Ensure payroll data integrity, and implement system upgrades and enhancements. 
  • Ensure thorough documentation of payroll reports, tax filings, benefits deductions, and other required reports, maintaining compliance with regulatory requirements.
  • External Partner Management: Manage the external payroll partner, ensuring adherence to predefined service levels. Establish robust governance and review mechanisms to ensure adherence to payroll processes with the necessary checks and balances.

    2. Compliance and Audits:
  • Regulatory Compliance: Ensure adherence to all payroll compliance regulations and tax laws, ensuring timely remittances of deductions and statutory dues.
  • Audit Management: Support the statutory and tax audits, providing necessary audit evidence and clear responses to audit-related queries. Maintain organized and thorough documentation to support audit processes.

    3. Team Management:
  • Guide the team members and ensure their development through relevant interventions and regular feedback. Identify and address skill gaps to enhance team performance. 
  • Ensure the team members discharge the following assigned payroll benefits activities within required timelines:
  • Payroll Validation: Ensure accuracy and integrity in payroll processing by validating payroll inputs and outputs.
  • Salary Advances: Process salary advances in accordance with company policies.
  • Exit Management: Support the high volume employee exits by obtaining and documenting all necessary clearances, process full and final settlement, and issue required letters (including the showcause and termination letters abscinding or involuntary exit cases). Ensuring proper documentation and approvals in cases of payroll recoveries and write-offs as applicable. 
  • Benefits Administration: Administer retirals (provident fund, NPS, gratuity) and employee benefits (insurance, car lease, etc.) ensuring compliance with company policies and regulations.
  • Year end activities: Oversee the year-end tax proof submission process, ensuring compliance and timely employee submissions and timely form-16 generation.
  • TDS Returns: Handle quarterly TDS return filing and report validation.
  • Ensure timely resolution of employees’ payroll and leave related matters.

    4. Process Improvement:
  • Process Improvement: Conduct periodic reviews of payroll processes, identify areas for improvement, and implement changes to enhance efficiency and accuracy.
  • Standardization: Establish and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs) and FAQs to ensure uniform and standardized payroll process steps.
  • Documentation: Prepare and maintain accurate payroll records, ensuring they are up-to-date and readily accessible for audits and reporting.
  • Reporting: Ensure timely and accurate submission of payroll data for statutory and internal reporting requirements and closure of company books.

 

Capabilities & Requirements:

  • Master's degree in Human Resources, Labour Laws, or related field. 
  • Thorough understanding of the Indian payroll processes, tax laws and payroll related compliance regulations. Knowledge of US payroll is a plus.
  • 7 to 8 years experience in payroll and benefits management, with at least 2-3 years in a managerial role, within a large organization. 
  • Experience in managing payroll for multiple legal entities is preferred.
  • Proven experience in handling statutory and tax audits.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex data and resolve discrepancies.
  • High level of accuracy and attention to detail in payroll processing and compliance.
  • Demonstrated experience in process improvement and change management, with the ability to implement efficient and effective payroll processes.
  • Ability to handle confidential and sensitive information.
  • Very high proficiency in MS Excel

PhonePe Full Time Employee Benefits (Not applicable for Intern or Contract Roles)

  • Insurance Benefits - Medical Insurance, Critical Illness Insurance, Accidental Insurance, Life Insurance
  • Wellness Program - Employee Assistance Program, Onsite Medical Center, Emergency Support System
  • Parental Support - Maternity Benefit, Paternity Benefit Program, Adoption Assistance Program, Day-care Support Program
  • Mobility Benefits - Relocation benefits, Transfer Support Policy, Travel Policy
  • Retirement Benefits - Employee PF Contribution, Flexible PF Contribution, Gratuity, NPS, Leave Encashment 
  • Other Benefits - Higher Education Assistance, Car Lease, Salary Advance Policy

At PhonePe, we go the extra mile to make sure you can bring your best self to work, Everyday!. And that starts with creating the right environment for you. If you’re excited by the idea of building platforms that touch millions, ideating with some of  the best minds in the country and executing on your dreams with purpose and speed, join us!

Reporting To: Head – People Experience

Role Overview:

We are looking for a Lead People Experience to own and scale end-to-end employee lifecycle operations for a large, distributed, feet-on-street workforce with high monthly churn, ensuring accuracy, speed, compliance, and cost efficiency. The role is critical in enabling uninterrupted business operations through robust onboarding, offboarding, payroll and statutory compliance, particularly in a piece-rate compensation environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Employee Lifecycle Management
  • Own and continuously improve end-to-end lifecycle processes, including:
    • Offer issuance and acceptance at scale
    • Bulk onboarding and induction readiness
    • Background verification (BGV) initiation, tracking, and closure
    • Data integrity across HRMS, payroll, and compliance systems
    • Exit processing, final settlements, and statutory closures
  • Ensure lifecycle SLAs are met despite high daily transaction volumes.
  • High-Volume Onboarding & Workforce Readiness
  • Design and operate bulk hiring and onboarding models capable of handling ~1,000 joiners per week.
  • Ensure seamless coordination between recruitment, business HR, HRMS, payroll, and compliance teams
  • Drive standardisation of documentation and exception handling for ensuring deployment-readiness from Day 1
  • FTC Management 
  • Own the entire lifecycle processes for the fixed-term contract employees on third party payroll.
  • Guide the team for timely payroll and F&F process for disbursements and the required vendor compliances.
  • Oversee process alignment, adherence and exception management with Business HR team, Finance team and Compliance team.
  • Review of the vendor (third party payroll provider) and their performance evaluation on process and compliance adherence.
  • Statutory Compliance & Remittances
  • Ensure full compliance across central and state labour laws, including 
    • Registrations and remittances for EPF, ESI, PT, LWF
    • Adherence to the Minimum Wages (time-rate floors in piece-rate scenarios)
    • CLRA (in cases of third party roll employees) and state-specific registrations
    • Timely statutory filings, challans, and remittances
  • Own audit readiness for internal, statutory, and external audits.
    • Partner closely with Legal, Finance, and Internal Audit for supporting the audit processes
  • Vendor & Partner Management
  • Manage multiple vendors across:
    • Payroll processing
    • Background verification
    • Compliance filings
  • Define clear SLAs, KPIs, and penalty structures for meeting timelines and quality
  • Drive cost optimisation without compromising compliance or employee experience
  • Ensure vendor scalability aligns with business growth and churn dynamics
  • Technology & Process Excellence
  • Leverage HRMS, payroll systems, attendance/productivity tools, and automation
  • Drive digitisation and straight-through processing wherever possible
  • Continuously improve TATs, reduce manual effort, and enhance scalability
  • Ensure systems can handle extreme transaction volumes without failure
  • Process Leadership and Team Management
  • Provide in-depth guidance to the team, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and functional expertise.
  • Act as a functional expert within HR Operations, bringing deep expertise and a point of view on the broader business landscape.
  • Lead a multi-layered operations team and fostering a culture of rigor, ownership, and continuous improvement

Key Qualifications & Experience

  • 12+ years of progressive experience in HR Operations, Shared Services, or Payroll Management with a proven track record of handling high-volume, blue-collar, or salesforce (preferably 15,000+ headcount).
  • Deep functional expertise in managing the full employee lifecycle and high-stakes statutory compliance (registrations, remittances) in India.
  • Proven experience in designing and executing scalable, automated solutions for payroll and BGV in a high-attrition environment.
  • Strong problem-solving and exception-handling capability
  • Data-driven decision making
  • MBA / PG Diploma in HR or equivalent is preferred.
  • High proficiency in MS Excel

  • Retirement Benefits - Employee PF Contribution, Flexible PF Contribution, Gratuity, NPS, Leave Encashment

Our goal is to make payments so easy, safe and universally accepted that people never feel the need to carry cash or cards again. We believe India is at the cusp of a new mobile revolution, which will change the way we manage our money on the go. We see ourselves facilitating this change, through technology and dogged customer centricity. PhonePe went live in 2016 and till date has got over 600 mn registered users and 38 mn merchants. PhonePe has forayed into diverse areas with its offerings in almost all fintech segments including insurance, lending, mutual funds and stock broking. In 2024, PhonePe also launched Indus AppStore - its own native Android-based mobile app store built for Indian consumers providing app discovery and content in 12 Indian languages.

Role Objective

Seeking a proactive and detail-oriented professional payroll specialist to join our HR team in Bangalore. The role will report into the Lead - Payroll and Benefits Administration and will be responsible for managing the end to end payroll processing for 30,000+ salesforce ensuring seamless employee experience. 

Key Responsibilities:

  1. Payroll Administration
  • Manage end-to-end payroll processing for the salesforce for ensuring accurate and timely payment of salaries in compliance with local regulations and company policies.
  • Review and update salary structure components as per the change requirements.
  • Collaborate with internal/ external stakeholders to collate and process payroll inputs.
  • Validate various payouts and support bank transfer process
  • Oversee the Payroll Portal for timely publishing of payslips, related documents for the employees. TDS sheets, Form 16, and loan deduction slips.
  • Manage investment declaration and proof collection processes.
  • Coordinate with the payroll partner and payroll audit partner for timely deliverables and completion of the various payroll deliverables and reports.
  • Prepare and upload the payroll related employee letters as required.
  • Resolve payroll related tickets from employees ensuring timely resolution.
  • Investigate and resolve payroll discrepancies and reconcile payables vs receivables.
  • Take care of other related processes like salary advance, data for actuarial valuation of the liabilities, etc.

    2. Payroll and Audit Compliance
  • Ensure adherence to statutory deductions and remittances. Coordinate with Finance for fund disbursement and challan payments.
  • Monitor compliance deadlines for filings and returns. Liaise with internal or external teams for the same as required.
  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge payroll and taxation related laws and regulations.
  • Ensure complete documentation and audit trails for audit readiness.
  • Support audits and inspections from statutory authorities. Prepare evidence related to audit queries, tax notices and related issues as required.

    3. Vendor Coordination:
  • Ensure timely deliveries of various outputs and reports from the vendor partners as per the agreed timelines.
  • Track vendor SLA adherence and escalate any delays or inaccuracies.
  • Coordinating with PhonePe internal teams for timely release of PR/PO and payout of Vendor Invoices.

         4.Process Documentation, Process Improvement and Reporting

  • Develop and update SOPs, Checklists, Trackers, Dashboards, etc. for payroll processes and related compliances.
  • Identify opportunities for workflow automation, accuracy improvements, and turnaround time reduction.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align and reconcile payroll records with other HR, finance, and compliance processes.
  • Support the HR team members with other HR related activities.

Capabilities & Requirements:

  • Master’s degree in HR, Commerce, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • 3–5 years of experience in end-to-end payroll processing and payroll compliances.
  • Strong understanding of Indian payroll laws and statutory deductions. Exposure to piece-rate payroll is a plus.
  • Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and process orientation. Proficiency in MS Excel 
  • Excellent stakeholder communication and coordination skills.

PhonePe Full Time Employee Benefits (Not applicable for Intern or Contract Roles)

  • Insurance Benefits - Medical Insurance, Critical Illness Insurance, Accidental Insurance, Life Insurance
  • Wellness Program - Employee Assistance Program, Onsite Medical Center, Emergency Support System
  • Parental Support - Maternity Benefit, Paternity Benefit Program, Adoption Assistance Program, Day-care Support Program
  • Mobility Benefits - Relocation benefits, Transfer Support Policy, Travel Policy
  • Retirement Benefits - Employee PF Contribution, Flexible PF Contribution, Gratuity, NPS, Leave Encashment 
  • Other Benefits - Higher Education Assistance, Car Lease, Salary Advance Policy

About the role:  We are looking for specialists for the Inhouse Greivance team. In this role, you will provide support to ensure that issues are either resolved faster or flagged accordingly. One will contribute to consistently better and streamline the support systems by flagging patterns to always optimize for better customer experience

Responsibilities:

 Act with integrity & think customer-first in every interaction
 Handle basic PhonePe account and transaction related queries
 Ability to flex between phone & data channels
 Follow specified process guidelines to bring about resolution
 Build customer trust through their interaction
 Ability to meet hourly & daily productivity goals
 Leverage internal processes and resources to drive resolution
 Escalate appropriately taking support from relevant teams to resolve customer issues
 Recommend process improvements
 Engage & Educate customers so they’re able to leverage PhonePe to the fullest

Ideal candidate should :
 Have excellent written and verbal communications
 Have good learnability
 Be an active listener and deal well with objection
 Have strong customer orientation and ability to adapt/respond to different scenarios
 Be a team player, flexible and open to feedback

 Ability to multitask, prioritise, and manage time effectively
 Should be able to speak in English and Hindi
 Graduation (10+2+3) is Mandatory 
 0 - 2 years of work experience in a customer facing role

Other Benefits:
 Your lunch is on us!
 5 day working week (2 rotational week off)

PhonePe-rs solve complex problems and execute quickly; often building frameworks from scratch. Job Description:

The Share.Market Customer Experience Operations team is focused on addressing complex and advanced problems that our customers encounter while using our platform.

As part of the Customer Support Specialists ) team, you will move beyond basic query handling to resolve high-stakes issues and manage critical escalations. You will look to understand customer pain points better and improve customer experience by working with internal product, tech, and compliance teams to forge robust, timely solutions. Customer Experience Operations in stockbroking offers a dynamic landscape of varied challenges, given the nature of market volatility and financial transactions. This offers us a significant opportunity to develop deep domain expertise and challenge ourselves as we advance in our careers.

Role Responsibilities:

  • Own the Customer Experience: Act with deep integrity and think customer-first in every interaction, particularly when handling complex or sensitive issues.
  • Manage High Interaction Tickets (HIT): Take full ownership of and resolve High Interaction Tickets (HIT)—issues requiring multi-touch communication, in-depth investigation, or personalized care.
  • Resolve L1 Escalations: Efficiently address and resolve issues escalated by L1 agents, serving as the definitive resolver for complex non-tech inquiries.
  • Ensure SLA Adherence: Manage your queue diligently to ensure all customers' tickets are closed within the stipulated Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
  • Handle Tech Dependencies: In cases of technical dependencies, escalate promptly to the appropriate product or engineering stakeholder, following up rigorously until resolution is achieved and communicated to the customer.
  • Demonstrate Ownership & Rigor: Display exceptional execution rigor and ownership by managing the end-to-end resolution of complex issues, leaving no stone unturned.
  • Process Improvement: Recommend process improvements based on root cause analysis of frequent escalations to reduce ticket volume.
  • Documentation: Maintain meticulous documentation of escalated cases for reporting and compliance purposes.

Experience, Skills, Qualifications:

  • Multilingual Skills: Ability to speak fluently in English and Hindi is essential.
  • Communication: Have excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex financial or market concepts clearly.
  • Ownership: Proven ability to take full responsibility for outcomes and drive issues to completion.
  • Rigorous Execution: Detail-oriented with strong prioritization and time-management skills to maintain performance in a high-pressure environment.
  • Problem Solver: Be an active listener with a strong customer orientation and the ability to adapt/respond to different scenarios.
  • Bonus Skills (Preferred): Prior experience in Stockbroking Operations, a strong understanding of financial markets, or experience in a senior Customer Experience role.
  • Technical Bonus: Basic knowledge of Excel and/or SQL for data retrieval and analysis is a significant plus.
  • Qualifications: Graduation (10+2+3) is mandatory. NISM certifications (e.g., Series VI, VII) are mandatory.

 

PhonePe Full Time Employee Benefits (Not applicable for Intern or Contract Roles)

  • Insurance Benefits - Medical Insurance, Critical Illness Insurance, Accidental Insurance, Life Insurance
  • Wellness Program - Employee Assistance Program, Onsite Medical Center, Emergency Support System
  • Parental Support - Maternity Benefit, Paternity Benefit Program, Adoption Assistance Program, Day-care Support Program
  • Mobility Benefits - Relocation benefits, Transfer Support Policy, Travel Policy
  • Retirement Benefits - Employee PF Contribution, Flexible PF Contribution, Gratuity, NPS, Leave Encashment 
  • Other Benefits - Higher Education Assistance, Car Lease, Salary Advance Policy

description_html:

Headquartered in India, its flagship product, the PhonePe digital payments app, was launched in Aug 2016. Job Summary:

We are seeking a passionate and skilled Firmware Engineer to join our team working on the Phonepe devices like Smart speaker, DQR devices, Printer etc. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining firmware solutions for the smart speaker and various other devices within Phonepe's ecosystem. If you are enthusiastic about hardware, firmware development, and device integration, we would love to hear from you.

Responsibilities:

● Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including hardware engineers, software developers, and product managers, to define firmware requirements and specifications for the smart speaker and associated devices.
● Design, develop, and test firmware solutions for the smart speaker, ensuring high performance, reliability, and compatibility with the desired devices.
● Implement firmware features to enable support for smart speakers and various other IOT devices around payments domain within Phonepe's ecosystem.
● Optimize firmware code and algorithms to ensure efficient resource utilization and enhance overall system performance.
● Conduct thorough testing and debugging of firmware to identify and resolve issues, ensuring high-quality deliverables.
● Collaborate with the QA team to develop test plans and participate in the verification of firmware functionality.
● Stay up-to-date with industry trends, emerging technologies, and advancements in firmware development, hardware, and device integration.
● Document firmware designs, specifications, and development processes.

Requirements:

● Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
● Proven experience in firmware development for embedded systems, preferably in consumer electronics or IoT devices.
● Strong programming skills in Java/C/C++ and familiarity with firmware development tools, compilers, debuggers, and version control systems.
● Experience with hardware-software integration and working closely with hardware teams to define firmware requirements.
● Knowledge of hardware architectures, microcontrollers, and peripheral interfaces.
●Familiarity with wireless communication protocols and their integration into firmware solutions.
● Experience with device drivers, low-level hardware interfaces, and firmware debugging techniques.
● Understanding of software development practices, including agile methodologies and version control systems (e.g., Git).
● Ability to work independently and in a team environment, with excellent problem-solving and communication skills.
● Understanding of basic data structures and algorithms.

If you are excited about pushing the boundaries of firmware development, hardware integration, and device compatibility within the smart speaker industry, we would love to have you join our team. Apply now and be part of shaping the future of smart speakers and Phonepe ecosystem of devices.

  • Insurance Benefits - Medical Insurance, Critical Illness Insurance, Accidental Insurance, Life Insurance
  • Wellness Program - Employee Assistance Program, Onsite Medical Center, Emergency Support System
  • Parental Support - Maternity Benefit, Paternity Benefit Program, Adoption Assistance Program, Day-care Support Program
  • Mobility Benefits - Relocation benefits, Transfer Support Policy, Travel Policy
  • Retirement Benefits - Employee PF Contribution, Flexible PF Contribution, Gratuity, NPS, Leave Encashment 
  • Other Benefits - Higher Education Assistance, Car Lease, Salary Advance Policy

About the Role

We are building an in-house team to maintain and contribute to our internal Apache Kafka distribution. About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Information Security Engineer with deep Linux expertise and a strong background in vulnerability remediation, penetration testing, network security and system hardening.

Responsibilities

  • Proven expertise in Rust development is highly valued and will be considered independent of a formal information security background.
  • Develop, implement, and maintain system hardening standards across diverse Linux distributions; perform ongoing validation to ensure sustained security efficacy
  • Create, manage and maintain the security analytics platform on Elasticsearch and build kibana dashboards, and keep alerting accurate and actionable
  • Contribute to, execute, and troubleshoot shell scripts and ansible playbooks; automate repetitive security tasks using Python, Bash or Rust
  • Conceptualise and build bespoke security tooling and products to address Infosec requirements, moving beyond the limitations of commercial software offerings
  • Conduct penetration tests across web applications, mobile apps, and infrastructure; document findings with clear reproduction steps and remediation guidance
  • Identify, validate, and track vulnerabilities at scale; work with engineering teams to drive timely remediation
  • Analyse network traffic, application logs, SSH logs, and auditd events to detect anomalies and support incident investigations
  • Participate in on-call rotation for security incident triage and response on Linux-based infrastructure
  • Work with application protocols and REST APIs to identify security weaknesses
  • Manage Nginx configurations from a security standpoint; analyse and assist with WAF rule tuning on Akamai or Cloudflare
  • Present security findings and risk posture clearly to technical teams, stakeholders, and leadership

 

Skills & Qualifications

  • 5+ years of deep hands-on experience in Linux security, including system administration, hardening, and extensive log analysis (auditd, syslog, SSH, application logs) in large environments.
  • Strong working knowledge of ELK stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana).
  • Essential proficiency in shell scripting and automation using Python or Bash; expertise in rust or go is a big advantage.
  • Proven hands-on experience with git and software development.
  • Hands-on exposure to OWASP Top 10 across web, mobile, and systems, with proficiency in tools like Burp Suite and Nessus.
  • Thorough understanding of network protocols, cyber risks, threats, application protocols, and REST APIs.
  • Expertise in Nginx and a strong preference for understanding WAF operations (Akamai or Cloudflare).
  • Strong communication skills for translating technical findings into reports for engineering and executive audiences.
  • Familiarity with BFSI regulatory frameworks (RBI, SEBI, IRDAI, ISO 27001).
  • Certifications such as OSCP, RHCE, CCNP, or CISSP.

Job Summary:
As a Network Delivery Engineer, you will be responsible for the execution of network provisioning tasks and 24/7 continuous monitoring, initial troubleshooting, and escalation of network infrastructure and service incidents. This role requires strong problem-solving skills, a foundational understanding of networking concepts, and the ability to work effectively under pressure in a fast-paced environment to ensure maximum network uptime and performance.
 
Experience bucket: 1-3 years
 

Key Responsibilities:

● Handling BAU tasks:

    • Conduct network provisioning deployments.
    • Perform Firewall configuration which includes ACL management, Periodic Firewall reviews and IPSec/NAT.
    • Perform periodic Patch Management for Network switches/firewalls and servers.
    • Upgrade OS for network devices to maintain a stable environment.
    • Undertake network maintenance activities during business off-peak hours.
● Performance Optimization:
    • Conduct performance analysis and implement optimizations to ensure the network operates at peak efficiency.
    • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to fine-tune network parameters and troubleshoot performance bottlenecks.

● Network Automation:

    • Develop and implement automation scripts to streamline routine network tasks and enhance operational efficiency.
    • Integrate automation tools and frameworks to support network provisioning, monitoring, and management.

● Incident Response and Resolution:

    • Act as a primary on-call engineer in resolving complex network incidents and outages and file RCAs wherever applicable.
    • Function as L1 point of escalation for Network Operations.

● Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
  • 1-3 years of experience in network operations, network engineering or a related role.
  • Familiarity with Data Center topologies and network routing and switching concepts like BGP, OSPF, VLAN, VRRP, etc. Knowledge of VxLAN will be an added advantage
  • Basic scripting and automation skills, with entry-level proficiency in languages like Python, Go, Shell and orchestration tools like Ansible, Salt or similar.
  • Basic fundamental knowledge of Linux esp. Distributions like Ubuntu and RHEL and web-servers like Nginx and Apache2.
  • Experience in a 24x7 on-call rotation environment and in handling critical incidents.
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
  • Excellent leadership and communication skills.
  • Certifications/Course Completion for Cisco CCNA/Juniper JNCIA or equivalent would be an added advantage.

Team:
The SRE - System Delivery team at PhonePe is a cross-functional, centralized, and horizontal team. We collaborate with other SRE teams to build various infrastructure services and carry out routine production management activities, including infrastructure scaling, database maintenance, and operating system vulnerability rollouts etc.


Job Overview:

As an Service Delivery Engineer, you will be part of a team responsible for building, managing, and scaling the production systems of PhonePe to ensure uninterrupted services to users across the country. You will primarily work on well-defined tasks under supervision and by following predefined SOPs.


Responsibilities and Duties:

  • Build & manage various distributed systems such as Galera, Nginx, Aerospike, ElasticSearch and RMQ.
  • Deploy operating system vulnerability fixes to production systems.
  • Perform routine database maintenance activities.
  • Build and roll out proxy configurations to production systems.
  • Understand the criticality of production infrastructure.
  • Be willing to work 24/7 shifts and provide on-call support across the SRE Organisation.

Core Technical Skills Required:

Minimum Qualifications

  • Linux CLI Tools for System Administration - Proficiency in using command-line tools for managing Linux systems
  • Disk & LVM Management - Hands-on experience with disk management and Logical Volume Manager (LVM)
  • System Services - Understanding of managing and configuring system services
  • Package Management - Understanding of package management tools and processes
  • File Permissions - Understanding of Linux file permission systems
  • Crontab & Scheduling - Understanding of cron jobs for task scheduling
  • DNS Concepts - Understanding of DNS and its configuration
  • Using Salt/Ansible for IaC - Understanding of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Salt or Ansible
  • Database Concepts & Administration - Understanding of Shards, Partitions and Truncations
  • Bash / Python Scripting - Proficiency in writing and debugging Bash / Python Scripts

Knowledge of the following will be a plus

  • MariaDB or similar Distributed Database Systems
  • Docker or similar Containerization technology
  • Nginx or similar Proxy technology
  • GIT
  • Basic Networking Concepts
  • Linux-based Firewall
  • Basic understanding of HTTP & TLS Security
  • Ability to write Python based scripts for various automations

Softskills:

  • Good Interpersonal Communication Skills
  • Ability to understand & follow SOPs

Qualifications:

  • Minimum of 1-3 years of hands-on experience in Linux / Unix System Administration.

 

Work Location: Bangalore

Note: This role requires the candidate to be available for on-call shifts on a rotational basis, covering 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

  • Insurance Benefits - Medical Insurance, Critical Illness Insurance, Accidental Insurance, Life Insurance
  • Wellness Program - Employee Assistance Program, Onsite Medical Center, Emergency Support System
  • Parental Support - Maternity Benefit, Paternity Benefit Program, Adoption Assistance Program, Day-care Support Program
  • Mobility Benefits - Relocation benefits, Transfer Support Policy, Travel Policy
  • Retirement Benefits - Employee PF Contribution, Flexible PF Contribution, Gratuity, NPS, Leave Encashment 
  • Other Benefits - Higher Education Assistance, Car Lease, Salary Advance Policy
